tib: @##/ / rgya gar skad du/ pa dAr+tha tsan+d+ra ka pra b+hA ba ti nA ma aSh+TAM ga hr-i da ya br-it+ti/ bod skad du/ yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa'i tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai DUr+ya'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /

bstan bcos rtsom pas ni mngon par 'dod pa'i lha la phyag bya dgos pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa dang po 'di smos pa yin te/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nad sel sman pa de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ / 'dir 'dod chags la sogs pa ni 'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs pa yin la/ 'dod chags la sogs pa de nyid ni gnod cing gzir bar byed pas na nad de/ lus dang sems gdung bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de yang gang gi phyir lus can rnams shin tu gzir bar byed pa yin la/ de gang gis sel bar mdzad pa'o/ / de ji lta bu zhe na/ rgyun du 'brel ba zhes bya ba smos te/ rtag tu rjes su 'brang zhing dus thams cad du kun tu 'brel la lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ba'i don de dang bral ba'i 'khor ba ni nam yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / lus kun khyab ces bya ba ni lus kyang yin la kun yang yin pas na lus kun zhes bya ste/ skyes bu dang / phyugs dang / glang po dang / rta dang / ba lang dang / ba lang rgod dang / 'bu srin dang / grog sbur la sogs pa dang 'brel ba'i lus ma lus pa de thams cad la mchog tu khyab par gnas pas na ma lus khyab ces bya ste/ rtsa ba dang bcas shing sa bon dang bcas pa ma lus pa la khyab ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /

'dod pa ni yul rnams la 'dod cing chags pa la mngon par zhen pa'o/ / gti mug ni bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa mngon par ma rtogs shing mi shes pa'o/ / khro ba ni sems kyis zhe sdang zhing gang du yang mngon par chags pa med pa ste/ gang de lta bu sel zhing 'joms par mdzad pa'i sman pa sngon med de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba yin te/ ngo mtshar du gyur cing rmad du byung ba'i tshul can gyi sman pa sngon med de la phyag 'tshal zhing 'dud par ni gang gi phyir sman pa 'di ni lhan cig skyes pa'i tshul can rtag tu 'brel la/ khyab par gnas pa rtsa ba dang bcas pa gsor mi rung ba'i nad dang mtshungs pa'i rnam pa can/ 'jig par mdzad pa yin la/ sman pa gzhan dag ni rims la sogs pa'i nad rnams mtshan ma 'di dag dang ldan na sel bar mi nus so/ / yang na gang zhig gi sngon du gzhan med pa gang yin pa de ni sngon med ces bya'o/ / 'di skad ston te/ de nyid ni de thams cad las thog mar gyur pa yin no/ / gang gi phyir mngon par 'dod pa'i lha la phyag bya ba sngon du 'gro bar ni rtsom pa la 'jug pa thams cad ring po mi thogs par gegs med pa nyid du rdzogs shing 'bras bu dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ / de'i phyir 'dod pa'i lha la phyag byas nas/ de'i 'og tu sman dpyad kyi rgyud byed pas/ rgyud 'di thams cad rtsom pa la 'jug pa yin no/ / de bzhin du 'dir yang 'brel pa la sogs pa bzhi bya dgos la/ tshig ni rim gyis 'jug pa yin pas/ 'di dag cig car brjod par mi nus so/ / de bas na dang por re zhig 'brel pa bshad par bya'o/ / de yang / gang phyir 'brel pa brjod pa yis/ / nyan pa po yi 'jug pa 'grub/ / de bas bstan bcos thams cad la/ / 'brel ba dang por brjod par bya/ / zhes bshad pas na/ 'brel ba brjod dgos la/ dgos pa yang / bstan bcos dag ni thams cad dang / / las rnams ci yang rung ba yi/ / ji srid dgos pa ma smras pa/ / de srid de ni su zhig 'dzin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de la 'dir 'brel pa ni thabs nad kyi mtshan nyid dang / thabs las byung ba nad nye bar zhi ba'i tshe'i rig byed de/ de dag thabs dang thabs las byung ba'i mtshan nyid du 'brel pa ni 'brel pa'o/ / dgos pa ni khams dang rang bzhin gyi bya ba yang ston pa ni gzhung 'di'i dgos pa yin la/ dgos pa'i dgos pa ni chos dang / nor dang 'dod pa rdzogs pa yin no/ /

tib: 'dir de nas zhes bya ba'i sgra ni bkra shis pa dang / dbang du bya ba dang / de ma thag pa'i don gyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ de yang / yi ge oM dang de nas sgra/ / gnyis po 'di dag sngon tshangs pa'i/ / mkhur tshos brtol te mngon par byung / / des na 'di gnyis bkra shis yin/ / zhes smos pa yin la/ bkra shis pa la sogs pa ni de 'don par byed pa rnams la bar chad med par rab tu 'jug cing / mngon par 'dod pa'i don bsgrub pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ / dbang du bya ba ni tshe ring bar 'dod pa la phan pa'i bstan bcos kyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ gang 'di nas nye bar brtsams te/ gzhung yongs su rdzogs pa de dag thams cad ni tshe ring bar 'dod pa rnams la phan pa yin no/ / de ma thag pa yang lha la phyag byas pa'i rjes thogs nyid la tshe ring bar 'dod pa rnams la phan par bshad pa yin no/ / de nas zhes bya ba ni rgyu'i don te/ gang gi phyir 'gal ba dang / the tshom dang bcas pa dang / don med pa dang / zlos pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa dang bcas pa'i gzhung mang du yod pa'am/ 'gro ba'i khongs su gtogs pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams nad kyi zil gyis non par mthong ste/ de bas na tshe la phan pa dang / nad med pa'i 'gro ba la phan pa bshad par bya'o/ / zhes pa'o/ / tshe zhes bya ba ni 'gro bas na tshe ste/ rgyun mi 'chad par 'gro zhing skad cig kyang mi sdod pa'o/ / tshe de 'dod pa rnams la phan pas na tshe ring bar 'dod pa'o/ /
shes par byed pas na le'u ste/ de yang yi ge bsdus pa ni ngag yin la/

sna tshogs shing du mar phye ba ste/ tshig dang / don dang / dris pa dang / lan te/ gzhung yongs su rdzogs kyi bar du/ gang cung zad bshad pa de thams cad ni tshe ring bar 'dod pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir bshad cing /

tib: rgyun shes las skyes pas na rgyun shes kyi bu ste/ 'dis ni rigs yongs su dag par ston par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du tshe'i rig byed kyi bstan bcos 'di lung gi tshad ma dang ldan pa yang yin no/ / rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa yang yin la/ drang srong chen po yang yin pas na/ rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa'i drang srong chen po rnams te/ 'dis ni rang bzo byas pa bkag pa yin te/ kho bos ni rang dgar ni cung zad kyang smra bar nus pa ma yin no zhes pa'o/ / 'di ltar zhes bya ba'i sgra ni 'di skad ces bya ba'i don to/ / bshad de zhes bya ba'i sgra ni sngon gyi dus su smra zhing ston pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /

chos dang nor gyi bde ba tshe 'dod pa'i skyes bus tshe'i rig byed bstan pa mchog tu gus par bya ba ni/ rang ngam gzhan las shes te bya'o/ / de la tshe zhes bya ba ni 'tsho ba ste/ lus dang dbang pos sems can bdag / 'dus pa bzhi yis 'tsho ba ste/ / rtag par 'gro zhing rjes 'brel ba/ / tshe yi rnam grangs yin par bshad/ / ces bya ba yin la/ tshe de rig par byed pas na tshe'i rig byed do/ / ji lta zhe na/ phan pa dang / phan pa ma yin pa dang / bde ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / tshad ma dang / tshad ma ma yin pa nyid las shes so/ / de yang lung las/ phan dang mi phan bde sdug bsngal/ / de yi tshe yin phan mi phan/ / gang du tshad du bshad pa ni/ / tshe yi rig byed yin par bshad/ / ces smos pa yin no/ / yang na gang gis gang la tshe yod par 'gyur ba de ni tshe'i rig byed de/ de yod par shes pa thob cing / rnam par dpyod par 'gyur ro/ / de'i lung bshad pa ni tshe'i rig byed ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos te/ de ltar na tshe'i rig byed ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos la rab tu gus shing 'bad pas go bar gyis shig ces bya ba'i don to/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe de ni chos la sogs pa sgrub par byed pa yin no/ / de la chos zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten pa rnams 'dzin cing 'tsho bar byed pas na chos so/ / blang zhing don du gnyer bar bya ba yin pas nor ro/ / bde ba ni sdug bsngal dang bral ba'o/ / de rnams bsgrub pa ni sgrub pa'i thabs su gyur pa'o/ / da ni bstan bcos gcig las gcig tu brgyud pa yin par bstan pa'i phyir/ tshangs pas tshe yi rig byed dran/ / skye dgu'i bdag la bshad pa yin/ / de yis tha skar des brgya byin/ / des rgyun shes sogs drang srong la'o/ / de yis me bzhin 'jug la sogs/ / de rnams kyis rgyud so sor byas/ / zhes smos pa yin no/ / de la tshangs pa ni mes po chen po ste/ / des ni tshe'i rig byed dran pa yin te/ tshe'i rig byed ni rtag pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ / skye dgu'i bdag ces bya ba ni myur ba zhes bya ba ste/ de la bshad cing 'dzin du bcug go/ / de yis tha skar zhes bya ba ni skye dgu'i bdag po des lha'i sman pa tha skar gyi bu gnyis la bshad cing 'dzin du bcug go/ / des brgya byin zhes bya ba ni tha skar gyi bu gnyis kyis/ brgya byin mig stong ldan 'dzin du bcug go/ / des rgyun shes la sogs pa drang srong la zhes bya ba ni/ brgya byin des rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa'i drang srong rnams 'dzin du bcug ste/ rgyun shes kyi bu ni nab so skyes so/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni thang la 'bar dang / rkang gnyis spyod dang / mu khyud dang / 'drob skyong gi bu la sogs pas gzung ngo / /

rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa'i drang srong de rnams kyis/ / drang srong me bzhin 'jug la sogs pa la bshad de/ sogs pa'i sgras ni drang srong lug dang / rgya skyegs sna dang / mda'i mchog dang / lan tshwa'i lag pa zhes bya ba'i bar la bshad cing 'dzin du bcug go/ / de rnams kyis rgyud so sor byas/ / zhes bya ba ni/ / me bzhin 'jug la sogs pa de rnams kyis kyang so sor zhes pa re res/ rgyud ces pa sman dpyad kyi gzhung byas shing rgya cher sbyar ba yin no/ / de yang gzhung 'dis tshe'i rig byed kyi don 'dzin cing sdud pas na rgyud zhes bya'o/ / gal te drang srong chen po rnams kyis byas pa'i gzhung rnams yod bzhin du/ rgyud 'di ci'i phyir rtsom par byed/ de la 'bad pa don med pa bskyed pa 'ba' zhig tu zad do zhe na/ de'i phyir shin tu 'thor ba de rnams las rig byed kyi don 'dzin cing sdud pas na rgyud ces bya'o/ / rab ces phal cher bsdus pa ni/ / shin tu bsdus min rgyas min par/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po byas/ / zhes bya ba smos pa yin te/ shin tu 'thor zhing ma 'dus la/ tshig mthon dman can gyis don phan tshun 'phyan par 'gyur ba'i gzhung de rnams las/ shin tu zhes pa phal mo che mang du bsdus nas/ yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po ngas byas la/ de yang shin tu bsdus pa'am/ shin tu rgyas pa ni ma yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ / tshig gi don ni rnam par 'thor ba'i tshig rnams las btus shing legs par bsdus pas btus pa'o/ / de yang gces pa nyid las phal cher btus pa yin te/ gzhung gzhan dag tu gces pa tsam zhig bsdus pa yin la/ 'di ni rab tu gces pa bsdus pa yin no/ / shin tu

śoṇitameva vā | yadi kupyati vātasya kriyamaṇi cakissite | cathotvaṇasya doṣasya tatraṃ kārya bhiṣagjitam‌? iti | tathāca tantrāntare'pi śavye śoṇitaṃ doṣalenokta, ^^teretaiḥ śoṇitacaturthaiḥ iti vacanāt‌ | navaṃ, doṣo hi svatanduṣaṇātmaka ucyate | yato na vātādayo dṛddhāḥrvicidpekaṣya dūṣayanti kintu svata eva.oṇitaṃ tu duṣṭa vātādisaṃsarmamapaṣtheva dūṣakaṃ bhavati | nahi śoṇitaṃ viḍatavātādisambandhamantareṇa vikṛtaṃ syātsarvadā vātādijanakaireva śoṇitaduḥ | tathā sadhaidā vātādilakṣaṇayuktasthaiva śoṇitasya duṣṭatvāt‌ | yaśca hetvādiviśeṣa uktaḥ sa̱ṃvātādiyuktasyeva śoṇitasya syāt‌ | etana vātādaya eva tatrāpi dūṣaṇātmakāḥ | śoṇitaṃ tu svapamāṇātiriktimapi duṣyameva, na ca dūṣyasya hetvādayo visi na bhavanti| yato māṃsaddīnāmapi haitvādivikñeṣo'sti, māṃsadudhe “māṃsatrāhīni duṣyanti bhukvā ca svapato divā" ityādi vakṣyati | māṃsaduṣalakṣaṇa “śṇa māṃsapradoṣajān‌"' ityadinā vividhāśitapītīye vakṣyati yān‌ vikārāste jñeyāḥ | yata etāneva māṃsadoṣavikārān‌ sotovimāne māṃsaduśilakṣaṇatavenātiderādamidhāsyati | iuṭamāṃsavi-kārādhimāṃsārudādaya uktāḥ | upakramaśca “māṃsajānāṃ tu saṃśyadadhiḥ śacakṣārābhikarama. ca "° ityuktaḥ | tasmādduṣyādhikāre doṣakate yadathai cikitsā tān‌ doṣānāha-tatra yoḥ prāgupādāne kāraṇaṃ vakyāti “visutvā7dukāritavādrakhisvādanyakopanāt‌ | svātanbyādrahugilvādoṣāṇāṃ prabalo'nilaḥ ||` tadanantaraṃ prāyeṇe †reva hetubhiḥ pittasya pariyarahaḥ | tathā kaphasya ginarāktiravādalparogisvādante nirdeśaḥ | caśabdo gaiṣāntarāstitvasūcanārtham‌ | doṣāntaraṃ rajastamasī -ktamapi ca keṣāṃcit‌ | itibdaḥ parasamāpivacanam‌| (vāvanta evādau vaktavyatayā parisamāptā | jaya ti grahaṇaṃ niyamārtham‌ | traya eva doṣā na caturtho'tāti . yathā'nyatanaśroktāditi bhiyamayati | yato yādhijanane kevaḍhasya tasya sāmarthyaṃ na dṛṣṭam‌ | thā cāhuḥ-“ pāratantyānna doṣatvai doṇitasyānnaṣavat‌ | tairadāhavadasyāyaṃ vyapadeśo gadaḥ kūtaḥ||? thā saṃmrahe'pyuktap‌-^“rasādiṣyeṣu doṣeṣu vyādhayaḥ tbhavanti ye | tañjānilyupacareṇa tānāhūdhatadādu t‌ |; rasa ādiryeṣāṃ te rasādayaḥ saptadhātavaḥ | |thāhi-rasāsaṅmāṃsamedo'sthimanjāukrāṇe dhāvaḥ | teṣu tiṣṭhanti | rasādiṣu rasādestheṣu doṣeṣu ye vyādhayaḥ sambhavanti utpadyante nāḥ kathayanti | tat‌ jānanti tajjñāḥ āyurvedaverāṃsa iyevaprakāraṃ vakṣyamāṇam‌ upacāreṇa upādhekaruṇāḥ kiṃścit‌ ghṛtadāhavat‌ | dhratena dāho dhṛta7haḥ pṛtadāha iva dhṛtaṃ naisābhaikaṃ guṇaiḥ sītaṭaṃ tadesarippaṇadhakābayarasaṃbarite a0 1. vābhinā santaptam‌ abhiriva dahati tadat‌ | rasādyā dhātavaḥ svabhāvenāvikāriṇaste'pi vātādayadūpitā rogān‌ janayantītyathaḥ | dūṣaṇātmakatvādoṣāḥ samāsataḥ saṃkṣepataḥ, - vistarataḥ sasagasaṃnipātakṣayasamatābraddhimistathā tāratamyaparikarpanayā vikaspamānā vātādaya ānantyaṃ majante
tib: bsdus pa ni gzhung nyung ngu zhig sbyar ba'o/ / rgyas pa ni gzhung mang po sbyar ba yin no/ / gang gi phyir shin tu bsdus pa ni blo dman pa rnams kyi don du mi 'gyur la/ / de rnams nyid la shin tu rgya cher bshad na yang mnyan pa dang / go ba dang nyams su len par mi nus so/ / de bas na blo dman pa dang / bar ma dang / mchog dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams kyi don du rgyud 'di byas pa yin no/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba ni/ yan lag brgyad po rnams kyi snying po ste/ de ni snying dang 'dra bas na snying po ste/ snying po'i sgra ni gces pa'i tshig yin te/ gces par gyur pa gtso bor byas pas gces pa'i don to/ / yan lag brgyad po de rnams kyang gang zhig yin zhe na/ lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod/ / mtshon dang mche ba rgas ro tsa/ / gso dpyad gang la gnas pa yi/ / yan lag brgyad du de bshad do/ / zhes smos pa yin te/ tshe'i rig byed ces bya ba'i rgyud de'i yan lag rnam pa brgyad ni lus kyi yan lag gso ba'i dpyad gnas shing brten pa'i yan lag brgyad du drang srong rnams kyis bshad cing bstan to/ / de la gso dpyad ces bya ba ni/ nad bsal zhing zhi bar byas nas/ khams mnyam par bya ba'i don gyi bya ba'o/ / de yang lung las/ sman pa la sogs rnam pa bzhi/ / bsngags pas khams ni 'gyur ba la/ / khams snyoms phyir ni rab 'jug pa/ / gso dpyad ces ni bya bar bshad/ / ces 'byung ba yin no/ / de la lus kyi gso ba ni yan lag thams cad la brten pa'i nad rims dang / 'khru ba dang / skrang pa dang / khrag dang / mkhris pa dang / mdze dang / gcin rtug 'gags pa la sogs pa nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i don to/ / byis pa gso ba ni gzhon nu gso ba na ma'i nu zho'i nyes pa sbyang ba'i phyir te/ gnod pa byed pa'i nu zho las byung ba'i nad nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i don to/ / gdon gso ba ni lha dang / lha ma yin dang / dri za dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / klu la sogs pa'i gdon gyis sems zin pa la zhi ba'i las dang / gtor ma sbyin pa la sogs pa gdon nye bar zhi ba'i don du bya'o/ / lus kyi stod kyi yan lag gso ba ni/ nam tshong yan chad du gtogs pa'i nad kyi rnam par gyur pa ste/ mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / kha la sogs pa'i nad nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i don du bya'o/ / mtshon gyis smas pa gso ba ni/ rtswa dang / shing dang / rdo dang / sa rdul dang / lcags dang / bong ba dang / rus pa dang / skra dang / sen mo sna tshogs kyi rnag 'dzag pa dang / rma mi bzad pa dang / nang du nub pa'i zug rngu dbyung ba'i don du bya'o/ / mche ba'i gso ba ni/ sbrul dang srin bu la sogs pas zin pa bsal ba dang / dug sna tshogs kyis bcom pa nye bar zhi ba'i phyir bya ba'o/ / rgas pa la gso ba ni lang tsho la gnas par bya ba dang / tshe dang blo 'phel ba dang / / nad nye bar zhi ba'i don du bya'o/ / ro tsa bar bya ba'i phyir gso ba ni/ khu ba chung ba dang / gdug pa dang / zad pa dang / bskams par gyur pa rnams sa bon 'phel zhing rab tu dang ba bskyed pa'i phyir dang / rab tu dga' ba bskyed pa'i phyir bya ba'o/ / de ltar na yan lag rnam pa brgyad du bshad pa yin no/ / gang gi don du gso bar bya ba'i nyes pa de bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ 'di ltar/ rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan yang / / nyes pa rnam gsum mdor bsdus yin/ / zhes smras pa yin te/ de la dang por rlung smos pa'i rgyu bshad par bya ste/ khyab dang myur du byed phyir dang / / stobs ldan gzhan dag 'khrug byed cing / / rang rgyud grub dang nad mang phyir/ / kun las rlung ni stobs ldan yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de'i 'og tu ni phal cher rgyu 'di dag nyid kyis mkhris pa smos pa yin la/ / de bzhin du bad kan ni nus pa chung ba dang / nad nyung ba yin pa'i phyir tha mar bstan pa yin no/ / yang zhes bya ba'i sgras ni/ nyes pa gzhan dag kyang yod pa nyid du ston pa yin te/ nyes pa gzhan dag ni 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang gti mug go/ la la ni khrag kyang yin no zhes zer ro/ / gnod cing sun 'byin par byed pas na nyes pa'o/ / rnam gsum zhes smos pa ni nges pa'i don te/ gsum nyid yod kyi bzhi pa ni yod pa ma yin no zhes pa ste/ ji ltar gzhung gzhan las bshad pa lta bu'o zhes nges par bya ba yin te/ / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / khrag gcig pus nad skyed par nus pa ni ma mthong ngo / / de yang / nyes pa gzhan ltar khrag dag ni/ / gzhan gyi dbang gis nyes yod min/ / 'di ni til mar tshig pa ltar/ / nad kyi ming du byas pa yin/ / zhes bshad pa dang / de bzhin du bsdus pa las kyang / khams sogs gnas pa nyes pa las/ / nad ni gang zhig 'byung 'gyur bas/ / nye bar gdags pa de bskyed par/ / bshad pa tshig pa'i mar dang mtshungs/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / mdor bsdus yin zhes bya ba ni bsdus nas bstan pa'o zhes bya ba ste/ rgyas par ni rlung la sogs pa ldan pa dang / 'dus pa dang / zad byed dang / mnyam pa dang / rnam par 'phel ba dang / de bzhin du shin tu shas che bar yongs su brtags pas kyang mtha' yas par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: te vātādayo vikrṛtā aviṣtā dhnanti vakaiyanti. ca | vikṛtāḥ svarūpāt‌ pracyutāḥ śārīraṃ ghnanti nāśayanti pīḍayanti | avichtāḥ sararūmasthitāḥ samvenāvasthitāḥ śarīre vartayanti sthāde0-dopāvasyādnayamāha-vikarṛtācikrateti-tacca vikṛta tvamavikarṛtatvaṃ ceti| tatra vikṛtā dehaṃ śanti, avikratā de vartayanti kramāditivakṣyamāṇaṃ pada vākyatrayaśeṣatvena vyākhyānādiha saṃbadhyate

skt: te doṣā bāttādayo vyāpino'pi sakara kārīragocarā api santo niyataderāsthā vijñeyāḥ | ca nābhiśca hannāmī tayoḥ hannābhyoḥ adhaśca madhyaṃ ca udhvai ca etāni saṃśrayo yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | asyāyamatheḥ. | hṛnnābhyoradho vāyoḥ sthānam‌ | tayomadhye pittasya | taryahihaṣyai kaphasya sthānam‌

te doṣā vayañadīnāṃ antamadhyādigā bṛddhi bhājo bhavanti kamāt‌ paripāṭathā na vyukamataḥ| kāṭa. karatā śarīrasyāvasthā yauvanādirvayaḥ) ahardinaṃ rāni yāminī | bhaktamitam‌ | vayaścādaśca rātriśca muktai ca etāni teṣām‌ antaśca madhyaṃ ca ādiśca tepu gacchantīti antamadhyādigāḥ | tenaitaduktaṃ bhavati | vayaso'nte bṛddhāvasthāyāṃ vāyovaraddhiḥ | madhye pintasya yauvanāvasthāyāṃ brūṣiḥ | ādau bāsyāvasthāyāṃ kaphasya varāda: | tathā-alo'vasāne vāyogaraddhiḥ aho madhye pittasya bṛddhi; ahaḥ pūvaibhāge kaphasya | rātreravasāne bāyeovṛddhiḥ ātrimadhye pittasya syādau kaphasya vṛddhiḥ) yuktāvasthāyāṃ vāyodaraddhiḥ yuktamadhye'mchāvasthāyāṃ pittasya muktasyādau madhusāvasthāyāṃ kaphasya baddhaḥ |] 10 || „ he0--doprakāṭānāha-baya iti|tatra vayaḥ dārīrapariṇāmaḥ tasyānta; braddhatvāvasthā vāyo; kālaḥ| madhyaḥ yauvanāvasthā pittasyaṃ | ādivaulyāvasthā kaphasya | aho$ntaḥ aparāhu; vāyoḥ | madhyo madhyāhaḥ pittala | ādiḥ pūrvāhanaḥ kaphasa -} madhyo madhyarāraḥ pittasya ] ādiḥ pūrvarātraḥ kaphasya | bhuktaṃ nigīṇa̭manne tasyāntaḥ pakvāvasthā vāyoḥ |. madhyo vidagdhāvasthā pittasya | ādirāmāvasthā kaphasya | vyāpino'tyadavate kāravideprastu sthānarigeṣavat‌
tib: rlung la sogs pa de rnams khyab cing lus ma lus pa la rgyu bar gyur kyang / gnas nges pa yod par shes par bya ste/ de'i snying ga dang lte ba'i 'og bar steng na gnas zhes bya ba yin no/ / de'i don ni 'di yin te/ snying ga dang lte ba'i 'og man chod ni rlung gi gnas yin no/ / de gnyis kyi bar ni mkhris pa'i gnas yin no/ / de gnyis kyi steng yan chod ni bad kan gyi gnas yin no/ / na tshod nyin zhag zas zos la/ / de yi mtha' dbus sogs gtogs rim/ / zhes bya ba ni nyes pa de rnams na tshod la sogs pa'i mtha' ma dang / dbus la sogs par gtogs pa na rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin no/ / rim zhes bya ba ni ji lta bar yin gyi/ rim pa 'chol bar ni ma yin no/ / de yang na tshod ni dus su rnam par gzhag pa'i lus kyi gnas skabs gzhon nu la sogs pa'o/ / nyin zhag ni nyin mo dang mtshan mo'o/ / zas zos pa ni zas la spyod pa'o/ / de'i mtha' ma dang dbus dang thog mar gtogs pas na mtha' dbus gtogs zhes bya'o/ / des ni 'di skad ston par 'gyur te/ na tshod kyi mtha' rgas pa'i dus su ni rlung 'phel bar 'gyur la dbus te lang tsho'i dus ni mkhris pa 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / dang po ste byis pa'i dus su bad kan 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du nyin mo'i tha mar ni rlung 'phel lo/ / nyi ma phyed na mkhris pa'o/ / snga dro ni bad kan no/ / mtshan mo'i mthar ni rlung 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / nam gyi gung la ni mkhris pa'o/ / nam stod ni bad kan no/ / de la zas zos pa'i mtha' ma la/ kha tsha bar bro bar gyur pa'i dus su ni rlung 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / zas zos pa'i bar skyur bar gyur pa'i dus su ni mkhris pa'o/ / zas zos nas dang po mngar ba'i dus su ni bad kan 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / des ni 'ju ba mi snyoms rno/ / chung dang mnyam pas mnyam par 'gyur/ / zhes bya ba ni rlung la sogs pa de rnams kyi me'i drod kyis 'ju ba mi snyoms pa la sogs pa rnam pa bzhir 'gyur ro/ / de yang rlung gis ni 'ju ba mi snyoms par 'gyur ro/ / mkhris pas ni 'ju ba'i me drod shin tu rno bar 'gyur ro/ / bad kan gyis ni me drod chung bar 'gyur ro/ / mnyam pas ni me drod mnyam par 'gyur te/ nyes pa gsum 'phel 'grib med pas mnyam par 'gyur ro/ / de la gang legs par zas zos kyang yun ring po zhig nas 'ju ba dang / lan 'ga' legs par ma zos kyang shin tu myur bar 'ju ba ni mi snyoms pa'o/ / gang dus thams cad du zas ran par ma zos kyang myur du 'ju ba de ni rno ba yin no/ / gang dus thams cad du zas ran par zos kyang yun ring mo zhig nas 'ju ba de ni chung ba yin te/ rgyu ma 'khrug cing ltam ltam por gyur pa'o/ / gang ran zhing legs par ma zos kyang bde bar 'ju ba ni mnyam pa zhes bya'o/ /

skt: teśca vātādibhiḥ koṣṭhcaturvidho bhavati | vātokatkarṣeṇa krūraḥ koṣṭho bhavāti | iyāmādibhivirecyaḥ. pavittotkarveṇa mṛduḥ koṣṭho bhavati | mastukṣārādibhiḥ suverecyaḥ | -kaphokkarṣeṇa madhyaḥ ko āragbadhādibhidhirecyate | samekhipamidoṣimadhya eva nakarūse na mṛduḥ
tib: rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa de rnams kyis ni lto ba rnam pa bzhir 'gyur te/ rlung shas che bas lto ba sra bar 'gyur te/ dur byid la sogs pas kyang 'khru ba dka' bar 'gyur ro/ / mkhris pa shas che bas lto snyi bar 'gyur te/ zho ga chu dang / 'o mas kyang 'khru nus par 'gyur ro/ / bad kan gyis ran par 'gyur te/ dong ga la sogs pas kyang 'khru nus par 'gyur ro/ / mnyam pas zhes bya bas ni nyes pa gsum mnyam ste/ des ni bar mar 'gyur zhes bya ba/ sra ba yang ma yin/ snyi ba yang ma yin par 'gyur ro/ / skye ba'i dang por khu khrag gnas/ / dug can srin bu'i dug dang mtshungs/ / de ni rang bzhin rnam gsum ste/ / chung 'bring chen po so sor blta/ / ma lus pa la khams mnyam pa/ / mchog yin nyes pa gnyis 'byung smad/ / ces bya ba ni/ rlung la sogs pa de dag ni re re zhing rang bzhin gsum du 'gyur te/ chung ngu dang / 'bring dang / / chen po'o/ / rang bzhin zhes bya ba ni lus kyi rang gi ngo bo'o/ / de ni skye ba'i dang po'i mngal du 'jug pa'i dus skye ba rtsom zhing mngal na gnas pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ / khu ba ni sa bon no/ / khrag ni zla ba'i dus su rgyu bas zla mtshan te/ de la gnas pas na khrag gnas zhes bya'o/ / dris pa gang gi tshe khu ba dang khrag la shas cher gnas pa de'i tshe/ lus rdzogs par ga la 'gyur/ de las nyes pa gang lhag par 'gyur ba de nyid ni rnam par 'gyur zhing 'jig pa yin na/ nyes pa lhag par gnas pa de rang bzhin gyi rgyur ji ltar 'gyur te/ rang bzhin las nyams pa yin la/ rang bzhin las nyams par ni/ rang bzhin gyi rgyur nam yang mi 'gyur ro/ / de yang 'bras bu ni rgyu dang 'dra bar gnas pa yin no zhes rtogs pa dag la dpe bstan pa'i phyir/ dug can srin bu'i dug dang mtshungs/ / zhes bya ba smos te/ dper na dug can ni srog 'jig pa'i rgyu yin yang / dug ni srin bu 'di skye ba'i rang bzhin 'byung bar snang ngo / / de bzhin du 'di dag ni gnod pa'i rang bzhin can yin yang / rang gi tshad las lhag pa'i nyes pa khu ba dang khrag la gnas pas/ skye ba'i dang po lus 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de yang rlung shas che bas ni rang bzhin chung bar 'gyur ro/ / mkhris pa shas che bas ni 'bring ngo / / bad kan shas che bas ni chen po'o/ / ma lus pa ste khams thams cad kyi nang nas khams gang mnyam pa'i rang bzhin de ni mchog ste/ thu bo dang dam pa yin la 'di ni bzhi pa'o/ / de yang gang gis khams mnyam par gyur pa de ni khams mnyam pa ste/ khams kyi sgra ni nad gzhi'i nyes pa la bya'o/ / nyes pa gnyis 'byung smad/ ces bya ba ni gang nyes pa gnyis 'dres pa las byung ba'i rang bzhin gsum ni smad pa yin te/ nad med pa ma yin pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i phyir ro/ / de ni rlung dang mkhris pa las byung ba dang / rlung dang bad kan las byung ba dang / mkhris pa dang bad kan las byung ba'o/ /

skt: tatreti nidhīraṇe | tatra teṣu doṣeṣu madhye anilo vāyuḥ rukṣaḥ ghu cītaḥ kharaḥ amṛduḥ sūkṣmaḥ kharotaḥbhaveritatvāt‌| caro gamanarīṭaḥ caikatra tiṣṭhatīti | nanvaṭuṣṇārīto vāyuḥ kāṇādaiḥ paṭhitaḥ | ihāpi yogavāhyujñānāduṣṇāsīta pveṣyata iti | tathāca vakṣyati | yogavāhī paraṃ vāyuḥ. sayogāsmakaḥ| dāhakṛttejasā yuktaḥ śītachṛcchappasaśrayāriti | tathā pavane yogavāhitvācchītakṣeṣmayute bhavet‌! dāhaḥ pittayuta iti ucyate | sasyametat‌ | auṣṇārīta eva vāyuḥ | tasya yogavāditve'pi tāvanmātradāhodayāt‌ rotyaṃ svābhāvikaṃ na vinaryati | śītarāṇanyāvaṇene cedaṃ prayojanayuṣṇenāyuparāmyatīti śratipattyaratham‌

tib: de la zhes bya ba ni nges par gzung ba ste/ nyes pa de rnams kyi nang nas/ rlung ni rtsub pa dang / yang ba dang / grang ba dang / sra ba dang / phra ba ste/ rtsa sbubs phra mo la 'jug pa dang g.yo ba ste/ 'gro ba'i ngang tshul can gcig tu mi gnas pa yin no/ / dris pa gzegs gzan la sogs pas ni/ rlung grang ba dang / dro ba yin par bshad la/ 'dir yang zung du 'jug pa'i rjes su gnang bas grang ba dang / dro ba gnyis ka ma yin par 'dod de/ de yang / zung du 'jug pa rlung gi mchog / yang dag sbyor bas don gnyis byed/ / nyi ma ldan pas sreg byed la/ / zla bar gnas pas bsil bar byed/ / ces bshad pa de bzhin du/ rlung ni zung du 'jug pas na/ / bad kan ldan pas bsil bar 'gyur/ / mkhris pa ldan pas tsha ba yin/ / zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ 'dir lan brjod par bya ba ste/ / rlung grang ba dang dro ba nyid ma yin pa ni bden mod kyi/ de zung du 'jug pa yin yang de tsam gyi dro bas grang ba'i ngo bo nyid med par mi 'gyur ro/ / rlung gi mtshan nyid grang ba yin par bshad pa'i dgos pa ni 'di yin te/

tib: snum bcas zhes pas ni/ cung zad snum pa ste/ bcas pa'i sgra ni cung zad tsam gyi don te/ dper na kha ba dang bcas pa'i sha kha ra zhes zer ba ltar cung zad snum bag can gang yin pa de ni snum bcas zhes bya'o/ / rno ba ni khab kyis 'bigs pa ltar myur du 'byed pa ste/ dman pa las go bzlog pa'o/ / dro ba ni tsha ba 'ur 'ur po skyed pa'o/ / dri mnam pa ni nya rul lta bu'i dri mnam pa lta bu'o/ / 'khru ba ni bshang ba sla ba'am/ steng dang 'og tu khyab cing rgyu ba brtan pa yin pa'o/ / gsher ba ni sla ba'o/ / bad kan snum bsil lci ba dang / / brtul zhing 'jam brtan 'byar bag can/ / zhes bya ba ni snum pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas na snum pa'o/ / bsil ba ni tsha ba med pa'o/ / lci ba ni yang bar ma gyur pa'o/ / brtul ba ni yun ring po zhig na ldang ba'o/ / 'jam pa ni mi rtsub pa'o/ / brtan pa ni khyab pa'i ngang tshul can no/ / 'byar bag can ni mnyes pa na sor mo la chags shing / 'jam bag nal nal po la 'tsher bag can no/ / de ltar na yon tan de dang ldan pas/ yon tan dang yon tan can tha mi dad pa'i nye bar gdags pas/ rlung la sogs pa'i yon tan nyid du bshad pa yin no/ / 'di dag 'dres par gyur pa'i tha snyad gzhung du bstan par bya ba'i phyir ming gnyis smos pa ni/ de gnyis gsum zad 'khrugs pa las/ / ldan pa dang ni 'dus pa yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ kun tu 'dus pa'i rnam pa gcig ni ldan pa zhes bya la/ gnyis pa ni 'dus pa zhes bya ste/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni gnyis dang gsum zhes bya la/ zad pa dang 'khrugs pa ni zad 'khrugs zhes bya ste/ gnyis dang gsum gyi zad pa dang 'khrugs pa zhes bya ste/ de ltar na gnyis dang gsum zad pa dang 'khrugs pa de las ming gnyis 'byung ngo / / 'di skad ston pa yin te/ gnyis 'khrugs shing rang gi tshad las lhag par gyur pa'am/ zad par gyur pa las 'dres par gyur pa ni ldan pa zhes bya la/ nyes pa gsum po zad pa'am/ 'phel bar gyur pa las 'dres par gyur pa ni 'dus pa zhes bya'o/ / de yan chad nyes pa rnams smras nas/ khams rnams bstan pa'i phyir/ lus zungs dngas ma khrag dang sha/ / tshil dang rus rkang khu chu ste/ / gnod bya bdun yin zhes smos te/ bcud kyi dngas ma la sogs pa bdun ni lus zungs zhes bya ste/ lus 'dzin par byed pa yin pa'i phyir lus zungs so/ / de rnams kyang gnod bya zhes bya ste/ rlung la sogs pas gnod cing nyes par bya ba'i gzhi yin pas gnod bya zhes bya ste/ gang gi phyir rlung la sogs pa ni gnod pa'i ngo bo yin pas/ don dang ldan pa'i ming nyes pa zhes btags pa yin la/ des na de rnams ni gnod par bya ba la ltos dgos te/ las med par byed pa po las rtsom par mi 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du gnod pa med par dngas ma dang lus zungs la sogs pas gnod bya'i ming mi 'thob la/ de med par yang rlung la sogs pas gnod pa'i ming mi 'thob bo/ / de bas na gcig la gcig ltos pa yin pa'i phyir gnod pa dang gnod par bya ba dag gnod par bya ba nyid dang / gnod pa nyid kyi ming 'thob pa yin no/ / dri ma/ gcin/ bshang ba/ / rdul la sogs pa'ang yin zhes bya ba'i sgras gnod bya yin par ston te/ bcud kyi dngas ma la sogs pa 'ba' zhig gnod bya yin par ma zad kyi/ dri ma la sogs pa de rnams kyang rlung la sogs pas gnod par bya ba yin no/ / de ltar na dngas ma la sogs pa ni gnod bya dang / lus zungs zhes bya ba yin la/ de bzhin du bshang ba dang gci ba la sogs pa yang dri ma zhes bya ba dang / gnod bya zhes bya ba yin no/ / de ltar gnod pa dang / lus zungs dang / dri mar bstan pas lus bshad pa yin te/ / de yang gzhung 'di nyid kyi 'og nas/ nad dang lus zungs dri ma ni/ / rtag tu lus kyi rtsa ba yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de ltar bshad pa'i lus te thabs 'ga' zhig gis dus thams cad du yongs su srung ba rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i thabs de bstan pa'i phyir/ thams cad mnyam pas 'phel 'gyur zhing / / de las bzlog pas gnod par 'gyur/ / zhes bya ba smos pa yin te/ thams cad ces bya ba ni gnod pa dang / lus zungs dang / dri ma lus la brten pa rnams te/ de dag mnyam zhing cha mtshungs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pas brtas shing 'phel bar byed de/ rang gi tshad las lhag par gyur la/ de las bzlog pa ni mi mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa ste/ des gnod par 'gyur ba ni zad par 'gyur zhing 'bri bar 'gyur ba'o/ / spyi dang khyad par la ni rdzas dang yon tan dang / las kyi dbye bas gsum du 'dod de/ de yang / kun gyi rnam kun 'phel ba ni/ / rdzas dang yon tan bya bar mtshungs/ / bzlog pa yis ni dngos po rnams/ / de las gzhan du 'gyur ba yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de yang rdzas la ni khrag ni khrag gis brta bar bya'o/ / sha ni shas so/ / tshil ni tshil gyis so/ / rus pa ni rus pas so/ / rkang ni rkang gis so/ / khu ba ni khu bas so/ / de bzhin du mngal ni phyis 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i mngal gyis so/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de la khrag gis khrag go zhes bya ba ni gnyi ga chu'o/ / sha ni shas so zhes bya ba ni sa'o/ / de bzhin du chu'i bdag nyid can gyi chus ni de'i bdag nyid can gyi bad kan 'phel bar 'gyur la/ de bzhin du mar dang 'o mas ni khu ba 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du sman 'tsho byed dang nye'u shing la sogs pa ni zla ba'i bdag nyid can te/ tshim par byed pas rdzas kyi khyad par rnams kyis/ lus zungs mnyam por byed pa nyid du bya ba gcig pa yin pas/ lus snum zhing stobs dang skyes bu nyid kyi gzi mdangs bskyed pa yin no/ / na le sham dang / tsha ba lnga dang / bse shing gi 'bras bu la sogs pas ni blo dang shes rab dang / me drod la sogs pa 'phel bar byed pa yin no/ / yon tan las ni btso tsa dang / mo tsha dang / kha ru tsha la sogs pa sa'i khams can gyi rdzas su bstan du zin kyang chu'i bdag nyid can bad kan 'phel bar byed de/ snum pa dang / lci ba dang / bsil ba la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi cha dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ / las kyang rnam pa gsum ste/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi bya ba'i bdag nyid can no/ / de la lus kyis ni rgyug pa dang / mchong ba dang / rkyal ba la sogs pas ni bskyod pa nyid du mthun pas rlung 'phel bar byed do/ / ngag gis ni klog pa dang / smra ba dang / 'don du 'jug pa dang / glur len pa rnams so/ / yid kyis ni yid kyi bya ba ste/ sems shing dpyod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / mya ngan dang / 'jigs pa'o/ / de dag kyang yid 'khrugs par byed pa'i rgyur gyur pas rlung 'phel bar byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du gdung ba bskyed par mthun pas na/ khro ba dang phrag dog la sogs pas ni mkhris pa 'phel bar byed do/ / gnyid log pa dang / snyom las dang / mal stan bde ba la chags pas ni bstan par mthun pas bad kan 'phel bar byed pa yin no/ / khyad par du gyur zhing mi mnyam pas ni zad par 'gyur ro/ / dper na rdzas las 'bras ga b+he d+ha ni skem par byed pa yin la/ de rlung gi bdag nyid can yin pas sa'i bdag nyid can gyi sha la sogs pa zad par byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du me'i bdag nyid can gyi lan tshwas ni bad kan zad par byed do/ / yon tan las ni dper na skyur rtsa bas ni chu'i bdag nyid can yin pas/ bad kan la de dang mi mthun pas yang ba dang / rtsub pa dang / dro ba dang / rno ba dang / skam pa'i yon tan gyis zad par byed do/ / las las ni gnyid dang / snyom las dang / / yid mi bde ba dag ni rlung kun tu g.yo ba dang bcas pa yin la/ 'di dag yongs su mi g.yo ba'i mtshan nyid can yin pas na 'bri bar byed pa de bzhin du yongs su g.yo ba'i tshul can sems las dang / phan tshun bskyod pa dang / rtsol ba la ni mi 'gul ba'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs yin pas na bad kan zad par byed do/ / de ltar na/ thams cad mnyam pas 'phel 'gyur zhing / / de las bzlog pas gnod par byed/ / ces bshad pa yin no/ / rlung la sogs pa de rnams gang las 'phel ba dang / zad par 'gyur ba de bshad par bya ba'i phyir/ ro ni mngar skyur lan tshwa dang / / tsha dang kha dang bska ba ste/ / rdzas drug la gnas de rnams kyang / / bzhin du stobs chen yin/ / zhes bya ba smos pa yin te/ mngar ba la sogs pa'i ro drug ni lce'i dbang po'i yul yin pas na ro'o/ / de dag kyang 'byung ba lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi rdzas la brten pa yin te/ ji lta ba bzhin du mthu stobs che ba yin te/ sngon ma sngon ma rnams stobs thob cing nus pa che ba yin no/ / de bas na ro thams cad la ro mngar ba ni lus can rnams kyi stobs shin tu 'ang bskyed pa yin la/ bska ba ni thams cad las stobs bskyed pa la dman pa yin no/ / de la mngar ba ni bu ram dang / mar la sogs pa ro mngar ba rnams so/ / skyur ba ni skyur rtsi chen po la sogs pa shin tu skyur bar byed pa yin no/ / lan tshwa ni lce myang tsha la sogs pa'o/ / tsha ba ni na le sham la sogs pa'o/ / kha ba ni nim pa la sogs pa'o/ / bska ba ni a ru ra la sogs pa'o/ / drug ces bya ba ni drug po nyid de lhag pa'am/ chad pa ma yin pa'o/ / ro de rnams kyi yon tan dang / ro la sogs pa'i bye brag dang / de bzhin du sbyar zhing 'dres pa dang / ro'i rjes nyid dang / shin tu myur bar brtag pa la sogs pa'i dbang gis tha dad par 'gyur du zad kyis/

skt: tasya dehasya yathā-satataṃ kenacidupāyena pīrapālya niṣpadyate tamupāyaṃ dadauyannāha-sarveṣāṃ doṣadhātumalādīnāṃ śarīrāśrayāṇāṃ samānaiḥ dravyaguṇakriyābhistulyasramāvaivaṃsatubhiḥ svamapramāṇādhikyam‌ | viparītaiḥ viriṣṭatayā vyavasthitedhipayayaḥ kṣayaḥ | ayanaṃ ayaḥ gatiḥ | viparītā gatirviparyayo'pacayaḥ 1 sāmānyaviroṣaiḥ dravyaguṇakabhebhedena triprakārānadhigacchanti) tathā cāhuḥ-““charbeṣāṃ saṣedā vṛddhista̱lyadravyaguṇaniyiḥ .| bhatraimavati bhāvānāṃ viparītevipayayaḥ ||? dṛṣṭānto yathoktam‌) raktamapyāyatena raktena māsi, māṃsena, medo, medasā. asthi, asathnā majjā, manjayā śukraṃ tathā ruka śakreṇa, gbha āmagarbheṇa | raktena ̱raktamityubhayamapyodakam‌ | māṃsaṃ māseneti pārthavam‌ | tathā saṅiṅātmakaṃ payaḥ| tathālamakameva śepmāṇamabhivardhayati | tadt‌ kṣīra ghṛta śakram‌ | tathā jīvantīkākolyādayaḥ somāsarippagakāyasṣalite a0 1. tmāno dravyaviroṣāḥ saumyadhāsaikakaraṇāni sada~ balapuṃsatvījāṃsi | marīcapa̭cakoṭhamahātakādayo buddhimedhāranyādīn‌ saṃvadheyanti | guṇataścocamocakharūrāṇi pāthivāni dravyato nidiṣṭanyapi śemāṇasu-dakātmakamamivardhayanti | rinigdhaguruśītādiguṇasā. mānyāt‌ | kamapi crividhaṃ kāyavāṅmanovyāpārātmakam‌ | tatra kāyikaṃ~dhāvanalaḍgaghanapravana dīni caṭatvasāmānyāhmayeovṛddhaye | vācikāni-māṣyā. ghyayanageyādīni | mānasaṃ-manovyāpāraścintākā~ marokabhayādīni | tānyapi manasaḥ kṣobhadaitutvāt‌ vāyograuddhikasādhi] tathā saṃtāpakasatvasāmānyāt‌ krodhe" . ṣyāīdi pittasya | svapnāṭasyadāyyāsulādīni sairayasāmānyāt‌ kaphasyeti | viśeṣastu kṣayāya | yathāha dramyato gavedhukānāṃ kṣaṇīyānām‌ | tatra vāyvāsmikayā gavedhukayā pāthaivānāṃ māṃsādīnāṃ kimā kriyate ! tathā taijasena kṣāreṇa śeṣmaṇaḥ | guṇato yathā āranāramaudakaṃ dachaṣmāṇam‌. | vadviparītaighurakaṣo-. pṇatīṇavirādagaṇaiḥ kṣapayati | karmato nidrarasyasaumanasyānai saparispaṃdaṃ vātamaparispandasvabhāvatayā'pacinvanti| tathā parispandarūpāśintāvyavāyavyā-. yāmā mandapariṣpandadhaiparītyāt‌ kaphamiti vi~ tam‌ | brāddhaḥ samānaiḥ kṣayo viparītairite | tautu, vṛddhikṣayau yato vāyvādīnāṃ bhavataḥ

tadrayāpārāthamāda--ṣvādrādayaḥ ṣar̤asāḥ rasane ndariyagāhayavavādrasāḥ | rasā dravya paccabhūtātamamakamā1 .kṣaraṇātakṣāyo nāsau rasaḥ, dravyaṃ tadanekarasasamutpabharamanekarasaṃ kaṭukavaṇabhūciṣṭaṭhamanekendhiyārthasamanvitaṃ karaṇābhinirvṛttam‌ iti caskaḥ | kṣaraṇādadhogamanakriyāyogāt‌ kṣāro dravyaṃ nāsau rasaḥ, rasasya hi ni criyasya kriyā'nupapanevyathaḥ, kṣaraṇaṃ ca kṣārasya pānīyayuktasyādhogamanena "vadanti hi okikāḥ-kṣāraṃ ghāvayāmaḥ' iti, śāghca ca~ “cavā chitvā''ādratṣāraḥ kṣārvāte kṣārayadyadhaḥ'* iti | -etayantaramāha-ravyaṃ tadanekarasodapanramiti, anekarasebhyo suṣkakāpāmārgādibhya ulapannamanekarasotapane, yataśvānekarasasamutpananamataevanikaras‌, kāraṇaguṇājuvidhāyitvātkārathaguṇasyetti bhāvaḥ| anekarasatve cāha-kaṭakalvaṇabhūyiṣṭam‌hati| bhūyiṣṭhaśabdenāparadhānarasāntarasaṃbandho'sti iti dardīyati| hetvantaramāha-anekendiyāthasramanvitamiti kṣāro hi sparasaina gandhena cānvitaḥ, tena dravyaṃ, rase hi guṇe na sparśo nāpi gandha iti māvaḥ| hetvantaramāha -karaṇāminirṛttamiti| karaṇena 'minirtta kṛtamityarthaḥ | na raso'nena prakareṇa kriyata iti -bhāvaḥ | iti cakradttarīkāyām‌ | aṣṭaṅhadye | [ vatta bhitāste tu yathāpūvai barakhāvahā baraprāpakā balamāv‌hanti | āpayantīti yāvat‌ | tasmatsarvabhyo rasebhyo madhure rasaḥ prakarṣeṇa dehināṃ balakaraḥ | kapāyastu sarvebhyo jaghanyaḥ balāpahaḥ ! tatra svādurmaghuro ghṛtaguḍādiḥ | amcho'mlikā mātuuṅgādiḥ | khvaṇaḥ sendhavādiḥ 1 tikto nimbādiḥ| ṅaṣaṇaḥ kaṭuko marīcādiḥ| kaṣāyo harītakyādiḥ ! savāṭumaghurapayauyaḥ| uṣaṇaḥ kaṭupayauyaḥ | yathaḥ dyū trikaṭukamucyate | kaṣāya eva kaṣāyakaḥ | yathā kaṭureva kaṭukaḥ!ṣaḍite ṣaḍeva na nyūnāḥ samadhikā vā | yadyapi te rasaguṇāḥ savādrādibhedatastathā saṃsagetaḥ tathāturakhataḥ tāratabhyaparikaspanāvaśato'pi bhidyamānāstathāpi paṭatvaṃ mātivatainte

tasya vīyaimāha~tatra tasmin‌ dravye vī dvividham‌ } viratiguṇānāṃ madhyāt‌ dvāvupaṣṇaśotau tadutkarādvīyaimiti savīyurvedapabhasiddhau | dvāveva guṇau śītoṣṇau vīryakāyakāraṇahetū | vīya śākteruṣṇaṇuṇotkaṣaṃ uṣṇaguṇātiśaya eva | kathiduṣṇavīyaukhyāṃ bhate ! tathā śītaguṇotkarṣaḥ rītaguṇātiraśaya eve iṇitākhyām‌. 1 yadyapi nānātmakamāpi dravyaṃ tathāpyamrīṣomātmakatvāñjagato dvipaiva vīryam‌

dravye cipākaḥ-vipākakcividhaṃḥsadhaidaravyāṇoṃ pariṇāmakārabhāvī kāyīnumeyaḥ jāṭharābhanisambandhād‌ dravyasya kharūpāntaraprādubhāvaṃḥ| sa cidhaiva rasaṣaṭke'pi na poḍhā|tena kiccit‌ khāduvipākaṃ kiñcidaschayipākaṃ kithvitkaṭukavipākai dranyam‌ | tatra madhurachavaṇayobheuravipākaḥ | amṭasyāmḥ | tiktakaṭakakaṣāyāṇāṃ kaṭukaḥ sa̱ ca kāryānumeyaḥ | tathāca vakṣyati-“jāṭareṇābhinā yaugāthadudeti rasāntaram‌ | rasānāṃ pariṇāmānte sa vipāka iti smarataḥ ||1 ata eva sopasargaḥ pākaśabd‌ upāttaḥ | tiśaṣa pāko vipāko na pākamātrasvahūpaḥ ! tathāca bhaṭarārakacarakamunī--“rso bipāke dravyāṇāṃ vipākaḥ karmaniṣṭhayā | vīrtha̭yāvaddhīvāsānnipātācoparabhyate ||";. evaṃ karmaniṣṭhānumita | jāṭarāmnisaṃyogādho rasānāṃ rasāntaroddhavaḥ sa eva vipākaḥ | natu yo jāṭharabhisaṃyogamātrāt‌ rasāna manekāvasthaḥ prāṅ‌ madhuro'nantaraṃ sa eva pacyamano'mrūpo vipacyamānaḥ sa eva kaṭuvipākaḥ
tib: de la ro de rnams kyi nang nas/ dang po ni gsum ste/ mngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan tshwa rnams ni rlung 'joms shing zhi bar byed pa yin no/ / gzhan dag tsha ba dang / kha ba dang / bska ba gsum po dag ni rlung de nyid skyed par byed cing / 'khrugs par byed pa yin no/ / tsha sogs bad kan sel zhes bya ba ni/ tsha ba dang / kha ba dang / bska ba gsum ni bad kan sel ba yin la/ mngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan tshwa ste gsum po gzhan dag ni bad kan skyed pa yin no/ / bska ba dang / kha ba dang / mngar bas ni mkhris pa sel ba yin no/ / skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang / tsha ba ste gzhan dag ni mkhris pa de nyid skyed par byed pa yin no/ / des ni 'di skad ston par 'gyur te/ mngar ba ni rlung dang mkhris pa sel zhing bad kan skyed pa yin no/ / skyur ba ni rlung sel zhing bad kan dang mkhris pa skyed pa yin no/ / lan tshwa ni rlung sel zhing bad kan dang mkhris pa skyed pa yin no/ / tsha ba ni bad kan sel zhing rlung dang mkhris pa skyed pa yin no/ / kha ba ni bad kan dang mkhris pa sel zhing rlung skyed pa yin no/ / bska ba ni bad kan dang mkhris pa sel zhing rlung skyed pa yin no/ / ro de rnams kyi rten gyi rdzas rnam pa gsum yod par bshad pa ni/ de ltar rdzas ni rnam pa gsum/ / zhi 'khrugs tha mal gnas la phan/ / zhes smos pa yin no/ / de ltar zhes pa tshul 'dis rdzas zhi ba la sogs pa'i dbye bas rnam pa gsum du 'gyur ba yin gyi/ rnam pa gzhan gyis ni gnyis sam/ yang na rnam pa du ma nyid yin no zhes so/ / de ltar gyi sgras ni dam pa'i don du bshad pa yin no/ / de la gnod pa gang 'khrugs par gyur pa zhi bar gyur pa de ni zhi ba ste/ dper na til mar dang / mar dang / sbrang rtsi lta bu'o/ / de la til mar ni snum pa dang / dro ba dang / lci ba dang ldan pas rlung gi de dang mi mthun pa'i mtshan nyid zhi bar byed pa yin la/ mar sar ni mngar ba dang bsil ba dang brtan pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas/ de dang mi mthun pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i mkhris pa sel ba yin no/ / sbrang rtsi ni rtsub pa dang / rno ba dang / bska ba dang ldan pas de dang mi mthun pa'i mtshan nyid can bad kan zhi bar byed do/ / de la 'khrugs pa ni gang rlung la sogs pa'i gnod pa rnams dang / bcud kyi dngas ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs rnams dang / gcin la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams 'khrugs par byed pa ni 'khrugs pa'o/ / de ni dper na nas thug dang / ba ta la dang / ma sha dang / nya sha dang / rdo gu rlon pa dang / yungs kar dang / zho sar pa dang / phrum dang / mi mthun pa'i kha zas nya dang 'o ma lhan cig bza' ba lta bu la sogs pa'o/ / tha mal par gnas pa la phan pa ni gnod pa nas dri ma'i mthar thug gi bar du rang gi tshad dang ldan par gnas pa ni/ mnyam par 'jug cing tha mal bar gnas pa ste/ de la phan pa'i rdzas gang yin pa de ni tha mal gnas la phan zhes bya ste/ de ni dus su spyad pa la brten pa'i skabs su 'og nas bshad pa dang / de bzhin du zas kyi tshod ran par bza' ba'i le'u las bshad pa dang / sA lu rtsa snar dang / drug cu pa dang / nas dang / gro dang / srog chags skams la gnas pa'i sha dang / 'tsho byed kyi tshod ma la sogs pa dang / zho ga chu dang / / 'o ma la sogs pa dang / de bzhin du gang stobs skyed cing bcud kyis len pa dang / ro tsa bar byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du bza' bar bya ba nyid du bstan pa rnams so/ / de'i nus pa bshad pa ni/ de la tsha bsil phul byung bas/ / nus pa rnam pa gnyis su bshad/ / ces bya ba yin te/ de la zhes pa rdzas de la nus pa rnam pa nyi shu yod pa'i nang nas/ tsha ba dang bsil bdag ni phul du byung ba yin pas nus pa zhes bya ste/ tshe'i rig byed thams cad las tsha ba dang bsil ba'i nus pa gnyis po nyid du bshad pa ni/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i don yin no/ / de la nus pa ni yon tan la bya la/ tsha ba dang bsil ba phul du byung ba ni/ tsha ba dang bsil ba khyad par du 'phags pa nyid de/ la la ni tsha ba'i nus pas phul du byung bas tsha ba'i nus pa'i ming thob la/ de bzhin du bsil ba'i nus pas phul tu byung zhing / bsil ba'i nus pas khyad par du 'phags pa nyid kyis bsil ba'i nus pa'i ming thob bo/ / gal te rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs pa yod mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'gro ba ni me dang zla ba'i bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir/ nus pa'i rnam pa gnyis kho nar bshad do/ / sman zhu ba'i rjes bshad pa ni/ rdzas kyi zhu ba rnam gsum ste/ / mngar skyur tsha ba'i bdag nyid can/ / zhes smos pa yin te/ zhu ba ni rnam pa gsum ste/ rdzas thams cad yongs su zhu bar gyur pa'i dus su/ 'bras bu las rjes su dpag par bya ste/ pho ba'i me dang phrad pa las/ ro rnams rang gi rang bzhin las gzhan du 'gyur la/ de ni rnam pa gsum nyid yin gyi/ ro drug yod kyang drug ni ma yin no/ / de la rdzas ni la la ni mngar bar zhu'i/ la la ni skyur bar zhu/ la la tsha bar zhu ba yin no/ / de la mngar ba dang / lan tshwa ni mngar bar zhu ba'o/ / skyur ba ni skyur bar zhu ba'o/ / tsha ba dang / kha ba dang / bska ba ni tsha bar ro/ / de ni 'bras bu las rjes su dpag pa yin no/ / de yang / pho ba'i me dang phrad pa las/ / gang zhig ro ni gzhan gyur pa/ / ro rnams zhu ba'i tha ma dag / de ni zhu ba zhes bshad do/ / zhes 'byung ba yin no/ / de bas na khyad par du smin par gyur pa las zhu ba zhes bya'o/ / cung zad smin pa ni ma yin no/ / de bzhin du mtho btsun drang srong tsa ra kas kyang / rdzas kyi ro ni 'bab pa na/ / las kyi mtha' ni zhu ba yin/ / ji srid gnas pa yon tan te/ / 'dus pa las ni shes par 'gyur/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de ltar na las byas pa rjes su dpag pa'i tshul gcig pa'i gnas skabs pho ba'i me drod dang phrad pa las ro rnams ro gzhan du gyur pa gang yin pa de nyid ni zhu ba zhes bya'o/ / gang pho ba me dang phrad pa tsam gyis ro rnams gnas skabs du mar 'gyur te/ dang po ni mngar ba'o/ / de'i rjes thogs la de nyid smin pa ni skyur ba'o/ / de las kyang smin pa'i mthar thug pa na tsha bar gyur pa la ni mi bya'o/ / rdzas kyi yon tan rnams bshad pa ni/ yon tan lci rtul bsil dang snum/ / 'jam dang bska ba mnyen dang brtan/ / phra dang bcas shing skam bag can/ / de bzlog pa ni nyi shu yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ de la rdzas kyi yon tan ni/ lci ba la sogs pa bcu yin la/ de las bzlog pa dang / nyi shu yin par shes par bya ste/ 'di dag rim gyis bzlog pa ni yang ba dang / rno ba dang / tsha ba dang / / rtsub pa dang / sla ba dang / sra ba dang / g.yo ba dang / sbom pa dang / sla bag nal nal po yin no/ / de ltar na go bzlog pa ni/ de dag yin pas spyir nyi shur 'gyur ro/ / nad kyi rgyu bshad pa ni/ dus don las kyi sbyor ba rnams/ / dman dang log pa lhag pa dang / / yang dag sbyor bas nad dang ni/ / nad med rgyu gcig yin zhes bya ba yin te/ de la dus ni bsil ba dang / tsha ba dang / char 'bab ba'i dus te gsum mo/ / don ni 'byung ba chen po'i yon tan sgra dang / reg bya dang / gzugs dang / dri dang / ro'o/ / de yang lung las/ / don ni sgra sogs yin zhes bya/ / spyod yul yul dang yon tan yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / las ni bya ba ste/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi kun tu spyod pa'o/ / de ltar dus dang don dang las ni dus don las te/ de rnams kyi sbyor ba ni 'brel pa'o/ / ji lta bu zhe na/ dman dang log pa lhag pa dang / / zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin du yang dag pa'i sbyor ba yin te/ gang dus la sogs pa'i sbyor ba dman pa dang / log pa lhag pa ste/ de ni nad kyi rgyu gcig pu yin la/ de rnams nyid kyi yang dag pa'i sbyor ba gang yin pa de ni nad med pa'i rgyu gcig pu yin no/ / de la yang dag pa'i sbyor ba smos pa ni nad dang nad med pa'i rgyu bzhin du shes par bya ba'i phyir 'di logs shig tu bstan pa yin no/ / rgyu gcig yin zhes bya ba ni rgyu gcig pu yin pa ste/ gcig gi sgra ni gtso bor gyur pa'i tshig yin no/ / de yang dper na gzhu 'dzin pa ni srid sgrub gcig pu yin no zhes zer ba lta bu'o/ / dus kyi sbyor ba dman pa ni rang gi rang bzhin las nyams pa'o/ / lhag pa'i sbyor ba ni rang gi rang bzhin las lhag par gyur pa'o/ / log pa'i sbyor ba ni rang gi rang bzhin las phyin ci log tu byed pa'o/ / de yang dper na dman pa'i bsil ba dang / dman pa'i tsha ba dang dman pa'i char ni dman pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / dper na grang ba'i dus kyi gnas skabs su shin tu grang ba ni lhag ba'i sbyor ba'o/ / dper na lhag par bsil ba dang / lhag par tsha ba dang / lhag par char 'bab pa ni lhag pa'i sbyor ba ste/ / sbyor ba 'di gsum ni nad kyi rgyu yin no/ / mnyam pa'i sbyor ba ni yang dag pa'i sbyor ba ste/ rang bzhin ji lta ba bzhin du gnas pa ni nad med pa'i rgyu yin no/ / yang don ni dbang po rnams kyi rang rang gi don dman pa la sbyor ba ni dman pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / shin tu sbyor ba ni lhag par sbyor ba'o/ / rtsub cing mngon par mi 'dod pa la sogs pa'i sbyor bar gyur pa ni log pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / lus la sogs pa'i las dman pa la 'jug pa ni dman pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / lhag par 'jug pa ni lhag pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / bshang gci la sogs pa'i shugs 'gags pa dang / phyed tsam za zhing mang du smra ba la sogs pa dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang la sogs pa rang rang gi bdag nyid kyis 'og nas bshad pa rnams ni log pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / thams cad kyang mnyam par 'jug pa ni yang dag pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / de bas na dman pa la sogs pa'i sbyor ba gsum ni nad kyi rgyu yin no/ / yang dag pa'i sbyor ba ni nad med pa'i rgyu yin no/ / nad dang nad med pa'i zhes gang la bya zhe na/ nad kyi nyes pa ma snyoms pa yin no/ / nyes pa snyoms pa nad med nyid/ / ces bshad pa yin no/ / rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa rnams gcig gam gnyis sam gsum rang gi tshad las 'phel lam zad par gyur na/ nad kyi rgyu yin pas nad nyid ni ma snyoms pa yin par brtag par bya ste/ rang gi rang bzhin las g.yos par gyur pa yin la/ de bas na rgyu dang 'bras bu tha mi dad ba'i nye bar gdags pas nad ces bya'o/ / nyes pa rnams snyoms shing rang gi rang bzhin las mi 'gyur ba mnyam par gyur pa de ni nad med pa nyid ces bya ste/ tha mal par rang bzhin du gnas pa zhes bya'o/ / de'i dbye ba bstan pa ni/ / de la nad ni rang bzhin gnas/ / glo bur cha yis gnyis su bshad/ / ces bshad pa yin no/ / de la zhes pa nad dang nad med pa de dag la nad ni rang bzhin du gnas pa dang / glo bur ba'i dbye bas gnyis su bshad do/ / de la rang bzhin gyis gnas pa ni/ rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa las byung ba'o/ / glo bur ba ni phyi rol nas 'ongs pa'o/ / de yang slob dpon gyis/ / nyes pa gsum las byung ba ni/ rang bzhin gyis gnas pa yin la/ phyi rol gyi rgyu las byung ba'i glo bur ba yin no/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni 'di yin te/ rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i nad rlung la sogs pa ni/ dang po ma snyoms par gyur nas/ / phyis zug gzer bskyed pa yin la/ yang glo bur ba ni dang po nyid du zug gzer bskyed nas/ der rlung la sogs pa 'khrugs par 'gyur ro/ / rang bzhin gyis gnas pa dang / glo bur ba'i khyad par gyis phye ba'i nad 'di gnyis kyis sems kun tu gdung ba yin par shes par bya'o/ / gang gi phyir 'di ltar lus dang sems ni nad kyi gnas nyid du gnas pa yin te/ lus gcig pu'am sems gcig pu ni ma yin no/ / de bas na de'i rjes thogs la 'di skad ces bshad pa yin te/ de rnams lus sems dbye ba yis/ / gnas kyang rnam pa gnyis yin no/ / zhes bya ba las yang rang bzhin gyis gnas pa dang / glo bur ba'i nad de rnams ni lus dang sems kyi dbye bas gnas rnam pa gnyis yin te/ rims dang / khrag dang / mkhris pa dang / lud pa la sogs pa'i gnas ni lus yin la/ myos pa dang / / brgyal ba dang / sgyid lug pa dang / gdon dang / 'byung bo dang / smyo ba dang / dran pa nyams pa dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang la sogs pa'i gnas ni sems yin no/ / de yang 'di las gnas pas na gnas so/ / dris pa lus kyi nad skyed pa'i rgyu ni rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa rab tu 'khrugs pa yin par bshad kyi/ sems kyi nad kyi rgyu gang zhig yin zhe na/ de'i phyir bshad pa ni/ 'dod chags gti mug kyang yid kyi/ / nyes pa gnyis su bstan pa yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ yid ni sems la bya la/ de ni 'dod chags dang gti mug bde zhing ma rig pa las byung ba yin la/ 'dir yang gtso bor gyur pas dang por 'dod chags smos pa yin no/ / kyang zhes bya ba'i sgras ni rlung la sogs pa yang nye bar bsdu ba'i don yin te/ gang gi phyir de rnams kyang sems la brten nas/ rnam par 'gyur bar byed pa yin te/ dus dag tu rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan dang ldan pa dang 'dus pa dang / dug gi rgyu las byung ba'i smyo nad drug yod pa yin no/ / bstan pa yin zhes bya ba ni tshe'i rig byed kyi bstan bcos dag tu tshig gis mdo tsam du bstan gyi/ rlung la sogs pa bzhin du 'dod chags dang gti mug gi mtshan nyid ma lus par ni ma yin no/ / 'dir rang bzhin gyis gnas kyi mtshan nyid la sogs pas/ rlung la sogs pa'am ma lus pa bshad pa yin gyi/ 'dod chags dang gti mug ni ma yin no/ / nad kyis bcom pa'i lus shes par bya ba'i thabs bstan pa ni/ nad pa blta dang rig pa dang / / dris pa yis ni yongs su brtag / ces bya ba smos pa yin te/ nad yod pas na nad pa ste nad kyis gdungs pa'o/ / de ni blta ba la sogs pas yongs su brtag par bya'o/ / de la blta ba ni mig gis te/ / mig ser ba la sogs pas nyam thag pa rnams la mdog ser ba dang / dkar por snang ba dang / dbyibs kyi tshad kyis 'phel 'grib dang / mdangs dang bshang gci dang / skyugs pa la sogs pas brtag par bya'o/ / reg pa ni lag pa dang / lus kyi reg pas rims dang / skran dang / ma zhu bas nyen pa dang / de bzhin du grang ba dang / tsha ba dang / rengs pa dang / 'dar ba dang / 'jam pa dang / rtsub pa la sogs pa reg pas brtag pa dang / dris pa ste gzer dang / yi ga 'chus ba dang / slon ba dang / lto sra ba dang / snyi ba dang / rmi lam du mthong ba dang / bsam pa dang / na tshod dang / nad kyi mgo gang nas zug pa dang / skar ma dang / mdza' bo dang / dgra bo dang / bde ba dang / sdug bsngal la sogs pa dang / nad pa'i tshig las yongs su brtag par bya'o/ / nad kyi bye brag shes par bya ba'i thabs bshad pa ni/ nad kyi gzhi yi dang po'i tshul/ / mtshan nyid nyer bstan thob pa yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ nad ni nad gzhi la sogs pa lngas yongs su brtag par bya ste/ nad gzhi dang rgyu dang byed pa zhes bya ba ni ming gi rnam grangs so/ / de yang nye ba dang ring ba'i bye brag gis rnam pa gnyis yin la/ nye ba yang nye ba dang shin tu nye ba'i dbye bas gnyis so/ / de la nye ba ni rtsub pa dang / yang ba dang / grang ba la sogs pa'i rdzas dang 'dres par gyur pas so/ / shin tu nye ba ni dper na rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa rnams gang dag gi rjes thogs nyid la nad 'byung bar 'gyur bas 'khrugs par 'gyur ro/ / ring ba ni gang rims la sogs pa'i dang po'i dus nyid du 'byung ba ste/ dper na phyi rol du sha bkra la sogs pa 'byung ba dang / mdze dang gcin nad la sogs pa ste/ des na 'di lta bu'i don bskyed pa dang / 'di lta bu'i nad kyi rgyu nyid du nye bar gnas pa yin la/ de ltar byung ba yin pas de'i phyir nad gzhi las nad shes par bya'o/ / dang po'i tshul ni phyis 'byung ba'i nad mi gsal ba'i khyad par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid de/ rims la sogs pa'i nad 'byung bar 'dod pa na/ rlung la sogs pa'i gnod pa'i khyad par gyis khyad par mi snang ba la/ gang gis snang bar 'gyur zhing ci nas chung ba nyid kyis gang mi gsal zhing rtags mngon du ma gyur pa de ni dang po'i tshul lo/ / mtshan nyid kyang dang po'i tshul las mtshan nyid tha dad pa ste/ gang gis nyes pa ma lus pa'i bye brag gis khyab pa'i rtags dang ldan par nad gsal ba nyid du mthong zhing shes pa'o/ / nyer bsten ni bde ba dang / rjes su 'brel pa'i kha zas la sogs pa la spyod pa ste/ 'di lta bu'i kha zas la sogs pas ni/ 'di'i nad 'di na ma byung ba 'di lta bus ni deng 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bstan pa las nad 'di yin no zhes shes pa'o/ / nad de ni gso ra rung zhing bde ba'i rgyu yin pas na bde ba thob pa yin no/ / thob pa dang rdzogs pa dang yang dag par thob pa dang 'ongs pa dang / skyes pa zhes bya ba ni don gyi rnam grangs yin no/ / de yang 'di lta bu'i mi mthun pa dang / gnas 'di lta bu gnas pa dang / 'di ltar rjes su 'gro ba dang / brtag pa 'di dang / lam 'di dang nyes pa 'di thob pa yin no zhes yongs su brtag pa ste/ de bas na thob cing mthar phyin pa las/ nad 'di yin no zhes shes pa'o/ / nye bar bstan pa la sogs pa'i skabs kyi yul dang dus la sogs pa dang nye bar sbyar dgos te/ de bas na de gnyis kyang bshad pa ni/ sa dang lus kyi bye brag gis/ / 'di la yul sa rnam gnyis bshad/ / ces bya ba yin te/ tshe'i rig byed kyi bstan bcos 'di la yul sa ni slob dpon dag gis rnam pa gnyis su bshad do/ / de gang zhe na sa'i bye brag dang lus kyi bye brag gis so/ / de la lus kyi yul ni mgo bo dang lag pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan par grags pa'i lus nyid do/ / sa'i yul bshad par bya ste/ skams phal cher rlung skyed cing / / rlan can bad kan 'phel ba yin/ / cha mnyam nyes pa mnyam pa ste/ / sa yi phyogs ni gsum du bshad/ / ces bya ba la/ / yang sa'i phyogs ni rnam pa gsum du bshad de/ de la skam sa'i chu dang shing dang ri bo nyung zad cig yod pa ste/ 'og nas bshad do/ / phal cher rlung skyed cing zhes bya ba ste/ de las skyes pa'i sman ni rtsub pa dang / sra ba yin pa dang / la sogs pa yang rlung gi shas che ba yin no/ / rlan can ni chu dang / shing med pa dang / rlung med pa dang / than pa nyung ba'o/ / de ni bad kan 'phel ba yin te/ de las skyes pa'i sman la sogs pa yang / snum la sogs pa dang ldan pa yin no/ / cha mnyam pa ni mtshan nyid gnyi ga dang ldan pa ste/ 'dres pa'i tshul can no/ / nyes pa mnyam pa ste zhes bya ba ni rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa mnyam pa'o/ / sman rnams kyis yang dag par sbyar ba'i rgyu'i dus bshad pa ni/ skad cig la sogs nad kyi skabs/ / dus su sman ni sbyor bar byed/ / ces bya ba yin te/ dus ni rnam pa gnyis te/ skad cig la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang / nad gyi gnas skabs kyi mtshan nyid do/ / sman ni sbyar bar bya zhes bya ba ni sman gyi sbyor ba byed do/ / de'i don rdzogs par byed nus so zhes pa'i don to/ / de la skad cig ni grags par zad do/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni thang cig dang / yud tsam dang / thun gcig dang / nyin zhag dang / zla ba phyed dang / zla ba dang / dus dang / lho phyogs dang / byang phyogs su 'gro ba dang / lo rnams gzung bar bya'o/ / skad cig la sogs pa'i dus kyi dper brjod par 'di ltar/ snga dro'i dus su skyug sman gtang / / nyi ma'i gung la 'khru sman te/ / nyi ma gung las cung zad yol/ / sman nas sman ni mkhas pas gtang / / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / nad kyi gnas skabs ni ma zhu ba dang / zhu ba dang / dal ba dang / bar ma dang / drag pa nyid kyi de dang 'tsham pa'i sman gyi sbyor ba gtang bar bya'o/ / de ni 'di ltar/ smyung ba dugs dang rtsa ba lnga/ / nas thug tig ta sha khu dang / / dri ma rnams ni smin bya ba/ / gnas skabs kyis sam rim pas so/ / zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin du/ rims la thug pa ska ba dang / / mar sar 'o ma bkru sman dag / nad stobs yod med bltas nas ni/ / nyi ma drug drug sbyar bar bya/ / zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin du/ rims ni rtse zhil lus yang la/ / dri ma la sogs g.yos pa na/ / rims btab yun ring ma lon kyang / / de tshe sman gyi sbyor ba bya/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ gnas skabs 'dir byin pa'i sman ni nad med pa'i don du 'gyur ro/ / sman de yang rnam pa gnyis su bshad do/ / mdor na sman ni rnam gnyis te/ / sbyang ba dang ni zhi ba'o/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ mdor bsdu na 'jig rten dag na sman rnams yod pa de rnams du mar yod du zin kyang tshul gnyis las 'da' bar mi byed de/ sbyang ba dang zhi ba'i mtshan nyid rnam pa gnyis su bshad pa yin no/ / de la sbyang ba ni nyes pa 'khrugs pa phyi rol du bton nas nad nye bar zhi bar byed do/ / zhi ba ni gang rang gi gnas na gnas pa nyid la cha mnyam par byed pas zhi ba yin no/ / sman bshad nas de'i yul bshad pa ni/ lus las byung ba'i nad rnams kyi/ / rim gyis sman gyi dam pa ni/ / mas gtong bkru sman slon sman dang / / de bzhin til mar mar sbrang rtsi/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ lus las byung ba'i nad rlung la sogs pa rnams kyi rim gyis zhes bya ba grangs ji lta ba'i gyis bstan pa dang / bshad par gyur pas sman gyi dam pa zhes bya la/ sman gtso bor gyur pa ni mas gtong ba nas slon pa'i bar gyis sbyang bar bya ba dang / de bzhin du til mar nas sbrang rtsi'i bar ni zhi bar byed pa'i tshul can yin no/ / des na rlung la ni mjug ma nas sbrang rtsi dang sman bskol ba lgang pa nas gtang bar bya ba sman gyi mchog yin no/ / mkhris pa la ni bkru sman kha nas btung zhing mjug ma'i las kyi mtha' nas dbyung ba sman gyi mchog yin no/ / bad kan la ni slon sman kha nas 'thungs pas/ de nyid nas nad dbyung ba sman gyi mchog yin te/ de dag ni nad rnams sbyangs pa'i tshul gyi sman yin no/ / til mar la sogs pa zhi ba'i rang bzhin can gyi sman yin no/ / de bzhin du zhes bya ba ni rim gyis te rlung la til mar ro/ / mkhris pa la ni mar sar ro/ / bad kan la ni sbrang rtsi sman gyi dam pa ste/ sman gyi gtso bo yin zhes bya ba'i don to/ / dus la sogs pa'i yul la brten pa thams cad du lus las byung ba'i nad thams cad kyi sman gyi dam pa bshad zin kyang / de'i 'og tu sems kyi nad gso ba'i mchog gang zhig yin zhe na/ de'i phyir bshad pa ni/ blo dang brtan bdag sogs shes pa/ / sems kyi nyes pa'i sman mchog yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ sems kyi nyes pa 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug dag la ni nad sel bar byed pa'i sman gyi mchog ni blo dang brtan pa la sogs pa yin te/ de la blo ni shes rab ste/ phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can gyi dngos po rnams la phan pa dang / phan pa ma yin pa'i bye brag gis cha rnam par 'byed shes par bya'o/ / brtan pa ni sems mi 'gyur zhing brtan pa nyid de blo mi rgod pa'o/ / de yang gong gis bkag pa rnams la 'jug par mi byed pa dang / phan pa ma yin pa rnams dang sdug bsngal la yid zhum pa med pa'o/ / bdag nyid shes pa ni rnal 'byor gyi ngo bo nyid shes pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi don dam pa'i bdag nyid shes pa'o/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni ye shes dang / rnam par shes pa dang / dran pa dang / yul dang / dus la sogs pa shes pa yongs su bsdu'o/ / sems kyi nyes pa 'byung ba 'dod pa la sogs pa nad bsal ba'i don du mchog ces bya ba'i sgra ni khyad par gyi tshig tu bstan pa yin no/ / de ltar na re zhig 'dis ni gso ba ma lus par bstan pa yin la/ de yang yan lag bzhi dang ldan na dgos pa byed pa yin pas/ de'i phyir bshad pa ni/ gso ba dag tu bstan pa ni/ / sman pa sman dang nad g.yog dang / / nad pa yan lag rnam bzhi ste/ / re re'ang rnam pa bzhi bzhi yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ gso ba zhes bya bas nad nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i mtshan nyid kyi yan lag ni rnam pa bzhi yod par bshad la/ de re re la yang rnam pa bzhi bzhi yod de/ de ltar na yon tan rnam pa bcu drug yin par gso dpyad mkhas pa'i sman pa rnams 'dod do/ / de la sman pa ni de'i gtso bo yin pas dang por bstan te/ de yang lung las/ sbyor zhing rab sbyor ston pas na/ / 'di ni sman pa gtso bo yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de bzhin du bsdus pa las kyang / sman pa yon tan med yan lag / yon tan ldan yang don med yin/ / de yi yon tan ldan yan lag / mtshang na yang nad pa 'tsho/ / de bas gso dpyad la de nyid/ / rgyu yis gtso bo yin zhes bya/ / zhes bshad do/ / sman ni rdzas rnams so/ / nad g.yog ni bsnyen bkur byed pa'o/ / nad pa ni nad kyis nyam thag pa ste/ de dag ni slob dpon gyis mdor bstan pa yin no/ / de rnams kyi yon tan rgyas par bshad pa ni/ sman pa mkhas stegs gzhung dan shes/ / las rnams mthong zhing gtsang ba yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ de la sman pa'i yan lag bzhi ni mkhas pa ste/ las rnams la byang ba'o/ / stegs ni rang gi mkhan po'i lung gi don shes pa las/ bstan bcos kyi gzhung gi don la shes shing khong du chud pa gang yin pa de ni/ sman pa mkhas stegs gzhung don shes/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ lung brgyud pa las bstan bcos kyi don rtogs pa thob ba'o/ / las rnams mthong zhing zhes bya ba ni/ gang gis gso ba'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i las mang po mthong ba de ni/ las rnams mthong zhing zhes bya ba ste/ lan mang zhing nad pa gsos shing las goms par gyur pa'o/ / gtsang ba zhes bya ba ni lus dang ngag dang yid kyi bya ba rnams la sdig pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'o/ / sman yang rnam pa bzhi ste/ de ni/ sman ni cho ga mang po dang / / yon tan mang ldan phun tshogs 'phrod/ / ces bya ba ste/ de la sman gang la cho ga mang po yod pa de ni cho ga mang po ste/ bcud dbyung zhing bskol ba dang / phye ma la sogs par byas pas na nad rnams sel nus pa ste/ lan tshwa ltar cho ga gcig yod pa ni ma yin te/ de ni kha gcig pu'i nang du dgos pa byed pa yin no/ / yon tan mang ldan zhes bya ba ni sems can sred pa tha dad pa dag la lci ba dang rtul ba la sogs pa'i yon tan mang po yod pa de ni yon tan mang ldan no/ / yang na gang nad du ma dag gi tshogs rnams sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'o/ / phun sum tshogs pa ni phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin gyi/ yon tan ma tshang bar gyur pa ma yin pa ste/ sa gzhi bzang po las skyes pa la sogs pa'o/ / de yang gzhung las/ sa phyogs cha mnyam bsngags pa ni/ / gzhi mnyam sa bzang gtsang ba dang / / dur khrod mchod rten nye 'khor dang / / g.yang sa grog mkhar rnams spangs pa'o/ / zhes bshad pa'i sa gzhi bzang po las skyes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ / yang na legs par smin cing sbyar ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ / 'phrod pa ni sbyor bar 'os pa ste/ gang gang la 'phrod cing 'os pa de de la sbyar ba'o/ / de yang nad dang / yul phyogs dang / dus dang / gnod pa dang / gnod par bya ba dang / lus dang / na tshod dang / stobs la sogs pa shes par byas nas sbyor zhing ster ba dag nad pa dang / nad kyi tshogs las dpag ste 'phrod cing 'os pa dang / phan par gyur pa'o/ / nad g.yog gi yon tan yang rnam pa bzhi ste/ nad g.yog rjes brtse gtsang sbra can/ / sgrim zhing blo dang ldan pa yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ rjes su brtse ba zhes bya ba ni nad pa la byams shing dad pa'o/ / gtsang sbra can ni lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las ngan pas ma gos pa'o/ / sgrim pa ni bya ba thams cad la gshor zhing brtson pa'o/ / blo dang ldan pa ni blo gros khyad par can yod pa ste/ mkhas shing byang ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ / nad pa'i yon tan yang rnam pa bzhi ste/ nad pa phyug cing bsgo ba nyan/ / shes par nus shing snying stobs ldan/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ phyug pa ni nor dang ldan pa'o/ / bsgo ba nyan pa ni sman pa'i dbang du gyur cing bsgo ba nyan pa'o/ / shes par nus zhes bya ba ni/ ci las gyur pa'i nad kyi gzhi la sogs pa shes par nus pa ste/ na ba'i zas dang spyod pa la sogs pa sman pa la brda sprad par nus shing zas dang spyod pas ji ltar gyur pa'i lo rgyus ston par nus pa'o/ / snying stobs ldan pa ni sman dang dpyad kyi bya ba la sems zhum pa med cing phog snya che la blo dang ldan pa'o/ / da ni gso sla ba la sogs pa'i nad rnam pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/ sman kun bzod par nus pa'i lus/ / skyes bu gzhon zhing bdag nyid thul/ / gnad du ma song rgyu sngar tshul/ / mtshan nyid chung dang gnod pa med/ / gnod bya yul dus rang bzhin rnams/ / mtshungs min yan lag phun sum tshogs/ / gza' ni rjes su mthun pa la/ / nyes pa lam gcig gsar gso sla/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ sman kun bzod par nus pa'i lus la nad skyed par gyur na gso sla ba zhes bya ba ste/ gso ba'i thabs bde zhing sla ba yin no/ / de yang gzhung las/ gso sla ba ni thabs bde ba/ / cung zad dus kyis bsgrub tu rung / / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de la/

skt: dranyasya guṇānāha~tatra dravyeṣu gubīdayo daśa guṇāḥ -savipayeyā viratirñeyāḥ viparītā chaghutīṣṇoṣṇarūkṣakharadranyakaṭinasarasyūlapiccharāḥ | gurustadvipayeyo khghuḥ | mandastaddhiparyaḥ yastīkṣṇaḥ | himastadvipayaiya uṣṇaḥ | sanigdhastadviparyayo rūkṣaḥ | chakṣṇastadvipyayaḥ kharaḥ | sāndra staddhiparyayo dravaḥ| maradustadviparthayaḥ kaṭhinaḥ ! sthirastadvipatheyaḥ saraḥ | sṛkmastadviparyayaḥ sthūlaḥ | virādastaṣipayayaḥ picchikhaḥ 1 26||
tib: gang gis sman thams cad bzod cing bsten par nus pa ste/ rno ba dang / bar ma dang / 'jam pa'i tshul yul sna tshogs nas skyes pa dang / zhi bar bya ba dang / de bzhin du sbyang ba dang / dug dang lan tshwa la sogs pa bsten par bzod pa'o/ / skyes bu zhes smos pa ni bud med dag ma yin te/ gang gi phyir bud med dag ni rtag tu sdang zhing blo dang mi ldan pa yin pas/ ji skad bshad pa'i nad pa yon tan dang mi ldan pa yin la/ de ni shin tu gzhon sha can yin pas/ sman rnon po bsten par mi bzod pa yin no/ / gzhon zhing zhes bya ba ni/ lang tsho la gnas shing gzhon pa nyid ces bya ba'i don to/ / bdag nyid thul zhes bya ba ni/ brkam zhing chags pa ma yin pa ste/ / gang gi yul la mngon par 'dod pa spangs pas bdag nyid thul ba'o/ / gnad du ma song zhes bya ba ni/ gnad la mi gnas pa ste/ gnad ni mgo dang / snying ga dang / mdoms la sogs pa ste/ de rnams su ma song zhing / snying dang lkog ma la sogs par shas cher gnod mi nus pa'o/ / rgyu sngar tshul/ / mtshan nyid chung dang zhes bya ba ni/ rgyu dang sngar gyi tshul mtshan nyid dag ni/ rgyu sngar tshul gyi mtshan nyid ces bya ste rgyu dang sngar gyi tshul dang / mtshan nyid de dag chung ba gang yin pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ / de la rgyu ni nad kyi gzhi'o/ / sngar gyi tshul ni sngar dang po byung ba'i tshul lo/ / mtshan nyid ni rtags kyi tshul te/ de dag chung ba gang yin pa de ni gso ba sla ba yin no/ / gnod pa med ces bya ba ni gang la 'tshe zhing gnod pa med pa de ni gnod pa med pa zhes bya ste/ 'di ltar sngar nad gcig bskyed pa la/ de'i 'og tu gang nad gzhan bla brnan du byung ba ni/ de'i mtshan nyid ma yin zhing / gtso bo ma yin la/ rang gi mtshan nyid ji lta bzhin ma yin te/ nad snga ma de sel bar byed pa la gnod pa byed pa yin no/ / de yang lung las/ nad kyi steng du nad gang zhig / phyis dus dag tu 'byung ba dag / gso ba dag la gags byed pa/ / de ni gnod pa zhes bshad do/ / zhes 'byung ba ni yin te de med pa la gnod pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /

skt: rogakāraṇamāha-- kāraḥ śotoṣṇava lakṣaṇasividhaḥ | arthāḥ rābdaspahīrūparasagandhā ma bhūtaguṇāḥ | tathā cāgamaḥ-“arthāḥ śabdādayo 3 gocarā biṣayāstathā |kar kriyā kāyavādmanaśe kāṭhaścārthāśca karmaca tāni kāṭhārthakarmāṇi : yogaḥ sambandhaḥ kāṭhārthakarmaṇāṃ yogaḥ | kiṃbhūtaḥ | 1 mithyāktemārakaḥ | tathā samyagyogaścoti ! ye kāḥ diyogā hadīnamithyātimātrakāḥ te rogaikakāraṇaḥ teṣāmeva yaḥ samyagyogaḥ sa̱ āsegyekakāraṇaḥ rogārogyayoyethāsaṃkhyajñāpanāai samyagyoga iye prathak‌ nirdiṣṭam‌ | ekaṃ ca tat‌ kāraṇaṃ ekakāraṇaṃ pradhānakāraṇamiti | ekaśabdaḥ praḥ navacanoḥ yathā--: ekaḥ pārtho dhalurdharaḥ ? kāsya dīnayogaḥ kharūpahāniḥ | atiyo svarūpātirāyaḥ | mithyāyogaḥ savarūpāvaiparālama yathā-hīnaśīkhatā hīnopṇatā hīnavarṣatā hauniyoga yathā--kītakārāvasare'yupṇam‌ | uṣṇakāṭāvara sthānam‌ ] rogakāraṇam‌ | yathāsvaṃ samayogaḥ ārogyakāraṇam‌ | kāṅādikarmaṇo dīnapravṛttirnayogaḥ | atipvarattiratiyogaḥ | vegodīraṇādikaṃ sābhibhutabhāṣaṇādikaṃ -rāgadreṣādikaṃ ca yathāsvasuttasatra bakyamāṇaṃ mithyāyogaḥ | sveṣāṃ samā vṛttiḥ samayogaḥ | tena dīnādayo yogākhayo rogakāraṇam‌ 1 samyamyogastvārobhyakāraṇam‌

yata evaṃ dehamanasī rogādhiṣṭhānasvena sthite na kevacho deho nāpi kevaraṃ manaḥ | tasmādato'nantaramidmāh‌-teṣāṃ nijāgantukānāṃ rogāṇāṃ kāyamano ~ aṣṭaṅgahadayaṃ | [ sa̱tabhidena davividhamādheṣṭhānam‌ | avarākhapittakāsādīnāṃ kāyaḥ | madamūracchasaṃnyāsagrahabhūtonmādāpasmārarāgadveṣādīnāṃ manaḥ | adhitiṣṭhantyasiminnadhiṣṭhānam‌ | kāyaḥ dāsīra | mantaḥ

nanu kāyikānāṃ rogāṇāmusapattau hetavo vātāda yo doṣāḥ prakupitā uktāḥ 1 mānasānāṃ ca rogāṇako hetustadathemāha-ena ityādi | manaśvetastasya rajastamasī doṣāvupaṣṭavāvavidyāsambhavau | atra ca prādhānyādādau rajo nikṣiptam‌ | carābdaḥ pavanādīnāmapyupasaṃpradārthaḥ | yasmātte'pi manaḥ saṃbhitya vikurbate| samaye hi ṣaṭ‌ unmādā bhavanti bātapittakaphasannipātādhiviṣayanimittā udāhṛtā iti udāhraṇamātaramudeśamātre vacanamātramāyurvedākhre | rajastamaso sākasyena vyākarṇamanikhādīnābhiva | te khalvatra svabhāvakhānasasānādimiḥ prakārairaśeṣayuktāḥ | na tu rajastamasī
tib: gnod bya dang / yul dang / dus dang / rang bzhin rnams ni/ gnod bya yul dus rang bzhin rnams/ / zhes bya ste/ gang gi de rnams mtshungs ba ma yin pa ni mtshungs min no/ / de la de rnams mtshungs pa ma yin pa ni/ dper na gnod par bya ba rkang dang tshil la sogs pa dang / shin tu rlan che ba'i yul dang / grang ba'i dus dang / nad pa'i rlung gi rang bzhin de la mkhris pa 'khrugs par gyur na gso sla ba yin no/ / gnod par bya ba mtshungs pa ma yin no/ / dper na bad kan gyi mtshan nyid grang bas khrag dro ba la gnod pa yin no/ / yul mtshungs pa ma yin pa ni/ dper na rlan can shing rtsi mod pa'i yul du mkhris pa skyes pa'o/ / dus mtshungs pa ma yin pa ni dper na ston ka'i dus su bad kan skyes pa'o/ / rang bzhin mtshungs pa ma yin pa ni dper na mkhris pa'i rang bzhin can la bad kan gyi nad skyes pa lta bu'o/ / 'dir dris pa/ gnod bya dang / yul dang / dus dang / rang bzhin rnams mtshungs pa ma yin pa ni gso bar dka' ba'am/ spang bar bya ba yin gyi gso sla ba ma yin te/ sgo du ma nas gso ba tsam dgos pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ltar gnod bya la sogs pa 'dra ba ma yin pa dag la/ phan tshun gso ba'i rtsom pa gzhan dang gzhan dag kyang bya dgos kyi/ sgo gcig nas gso ba ni gso ba sla ba yin no zhe na/ de'i lan brjod par bya ste/ / gnod bya la sogs pa mtshungs pa ni rang bzhin stobs dang ldan pa yin zhing / rtsom pa che bas gso dka' ba'i nad nyid 'byung bas de gso sla ba ma yin no/ / la lar ni gnod bya la sogs pa mtshungs su zin kyang / gso sla ba dag ni yod do/ / de yang gzhung las/ rims la yul dus mtshungs pa dang / / gcin 'gags gnod bya mnyam pa dang / / khrag gi skra ni rnying pa nyid/ / gso sla ba yi rgyu nyid yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / yan lag phun sum tshogs zhes bya ba ni/ sman la sogs pa yan lag bzhi'i phun sum tshogs pa ni 'byor bar gyur pa ste/ yan lag bzhi po ste yongs su rdzogs par gyur na/

skt: rogopahatarārīrajñānoṣāyamāha-rogoḥ'syāstīti rogī vyādhitaḥ taṃ daṃnādabhiḥ rakṣeta | dadanena thānam‌ ] dṛṣṭayā kāsamehādayarviṣu pītaruṅvaṇasaṃsānamramāṇopacayacchāyāviṇmūtrachadavitādikam‌ | sapaśnena hastakāyasapaśanena avaragusmīvadradhyādayārtam‌ 1 tathā śītoṣṇastacdhaspandṣṣṇakharaspaśaudikai ca | prabhena pracchayā śarārocakasucchanvaduśachandalaṃ khadu rūrakochaṭhatāṃ svapnaddonamabhiprāyaṃ janmāmayapravṛntinakṣataradṭhieṣṭasukha` duḥkhāni cetyāturasukhātparīkṣeta
