bhūmideśa ucyate-tatra jāṅgalo deo'syodakapaitatvena vakṣyamāṇaḍhakṣaṇo vātamūiṣṭho vātamracuraḥ | tatra jātauṣadhikhagapuruṣasgādayo vātapradhānā vanti | pracurodakavṛṣo yo nivīto dukhamātapaḥ saro'nūpa iti| sa̱ ca kaphamradhānastañjāgcaupadhādayaḥ -stigdhā mabanti | sādhāraṇaḥ punarubhayalakṣaṇo sadhya-pītato vyāmiśrarūpaḥ | sa ca samamaṭo vātādisamadoṣaḥ ! atra doṣā eva malaśabdenoktāḥ | vakṣyati hi-dehasya machinīkaraṇādāhāramaṅtvācaca malāḥ| 35]
tib: gza' ni nyi ma la sogs pa ste/ de dag rjes su mthun pa zhes bya ba/ skar ma'i khyim rjes su mthun pa na gnas shing / gnas bzang po na gnas par gyur na yang nad gso sla ba yin no/ / nyes pa lam gcig ces bya ba ni nyes pa dang lam gnyis gcig dang ldan pa ni/ nyes pa lam gcig ste/ nyes pa ni rlung la sogs pa'o/ / lam ni gsum ste/ 'og nas bshad pa'i yan lag gam/ yal ga la sogs pa ni phyi dang nang dang bar gyi dbye bas so/ / des na gang yang rlung la sogs pa'i nang nas gang yang rung ba gcig las skyes kyi/ gnyis sam gsum las ma skyes pa dang / de bzhin du phyi rol lam nang ngam bar ma ste lam gcig las skyes pa de ni gso sla ba yin no/ / gsar pa zhes bya ba ni nad ma rnyings pa ste/ skyes nas ring po ma lon pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ / gang gi phyir lo gcig yan chad 'das pa'i nad ni gso dka' ba yin no/ / de ltar na de lta bu'i nad ni gso sla zhing / gso ba'i thabs ni sla ba nyid yin no/ / gso dka' ba'i nad bshad pa ni/ nad ni mtshon sogs kyis gdab cing / / gso ba dka' zhing de las 'dres/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ nad gang mtshon la sogs pas bsgrub cing gdab dgos pa de ni/ gso dka' zhing bzlog par dka' ba yin pas/ thabs mang po dang yun ring pos gso dgos pa yin no/ / de yang gzhung las/ gso dka' ba la dka' ba dang / / thabs mang yun ni ring pos so/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / so la sogs pa'i sgras ni nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal bas bsku ba dang / me gdab pa dang / dug gis bsku ba la sogs pas bsdu'o/ /

skt: meṣajasya sambagyogadatukārasāha--kālo dvividhaḥ, kṣaṇādilakṣaṇā vyādhyavasthākhṛścaṇandha || mepajasyauṣadhasya yogaṃ karoti | tadaśrasaṃpādanasāmathyai kayotītyaśacaḥ | bheṣajasya yogo bhepajayogastaṃ karoti | kaṣaṇādiḥ prasiddhaḥ | ādapradaṇālvaccikhabhalaṃyāmā~ horātrapakcamāsaratvayanasaṃvatsarāṇāṃ parimarahaḥ | śchaṇādi~ kāṭhasyodāharaṇaṃ yathā-“^ūīhe vamanaṃ deya madhye ta̱ birecanam‌| madhye kicidāghratta vasti dvyāddhicakṣaṇaḥ|? vyāghyavasthā-sāmanirāmasudusadhyatīkṣṇakhena tacogyaupadhavisaraṣṭiḥ | yadhā--““chaṅnvana svedanaṃ kāṭo yavāgṛptiktako rasaḥ | malāna pānāni sayuthethāvasthaṃ krameṇa vā 1 avare peyāḥ kaṣāyācca sadhi: kṣīraṃ virecanam‌ ! yaha vā paḍa yuñajyādvīśtya dauṣabaṭhāvaṭham‌ |'? tathā-“mṛdujairo khurdehaccaṅtācca mā yadā ] aciraṃ uvaritasyāpi ṣaja yojayettadā || ?' asyāmavamthāyāṃ danattamauṣadhamārogyāya bhavati

tannoṣadhaṃ dvirakāramāha~-samāsāt‌ saṃkṣepataḥ yatkiñcit‌ jagatyauṣadhaṃ saṃbhavāta tadanekaprakāraṃ saṃbhavadāpi davairūpyānatikramāt‌ rodhanadmanalakṣaṇādvipesyuktam‌ | ekaṃ sodhanarūpamaparaṃ śāmanarūpamiti | rodhanaṃ yat‌ kupitān‌ doṣān‌ bahirniḥsārya rogopasāmanaṃ karoti | ramanaṃ yat‌ svasthānasthitānāmeva sāmyahetuḥ

kālā (yā) diderāmāraśaritya sarvatra samamava śasīrajānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ krameṇa paramaupadhasuktam‌ | atha mānasayodoṣayoḥ kiṃ tat‌ paramauṣadhaṃ syāditi tadarthamāhamanodoṣayo rajastamasoḥ sogaviṣnakāre dhathiyīdikaṃ paramauṣadhaṃ syāditi | dhīśca dharyaṃ ca ātmādiṣijñānaṃ ca tattathāvidham‌ | tatra dhīvuddhiḥ bāhyādhyātmikānāṃ bhāvānāṃ hitāhitaparicchedavibhāgakāriṇī.dhetha dhṛtiśetasaḥ sthiratvamacāpalam‌ | yena pratiṣiddheṣu na pravatatate! ahiteṣu ca na sīdati | ātmavijñānaṃ yogābhyāsasamādhinā paramātmasvarūpavijñānam‌ | ādi` mahaṇāt‌ smṛtiderākāṭādīnāṃ pariprahaḥ | manodoṣasamutthakāmādijarogātheḥ | paraśābdo viroṣaṇasvena nirdiṣṭaḥ
tib: de las zhes bya ba ni sngar bshad pa'i gsor rung ba'i mtshan ma las/ nad dang 'dres pa zhig byung na de yang gso bar dka' ba yin no/ / de la de las 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid ni sngar bshad pa'i gso sla ba'i mtshan nyid las 'dres shing gnyis sam gsum tshogs par gnas pa ste/ dper na gzhon pa na yang bdag nyid thul ba dang / dbang po thul ba yin yang / nad gnad kyi gnas su song ba dang / sman thams cad bzod par nus pa'i lus dang ldan yang rgas pa dang / gal te gzhon du zin kyang sman thams cad kyis bzod par mi nus pa'o/ / de ltar na phyogs 'dis thams cad la bsgre bar bya'o/ / gso ba tsam du bya ba bshad pa ni/ tshe yi lhag ma lus phyir 'tsho/ / go bzlog pa la goms phan nyid/ / ces bya ba yin te/ phyin ci log rnam pa mang pos bsgrub par bya ba'i gso ba'i thabs dang mi mthun par gyur la/ tshe'i lhag ma ni ma zad pas/ nad kyis gso bar mi nus pa dag la ni kha zas dang spyod lam phan pa dag gis re zhig gso zhing 'tsho ba tsam du bya'o/ de yongs su spang bar ni mi bya'o/ / 'di dang yongs su spang bar bya ba'i nad kyi khyad par ni 'di tsam zhig yod do/ / 'di la ni tshe'i lhag ma tsam zhig yod pas/ re zhig spang bar mi bya ba yin gyi/ mtshan nyid gzhan thams cad ni phal cher mthun pa yin no/ / go bzlog ces bya ba gang zhig bzlog pa yin zhe na/ 'das ma thag pa'i rang bzhin gso sla ba las bzlog pa'o/ / goms pa ni yang dang yang du bya zhing bslab pa ste/ de bas na phan pa'i zas dang / spyod lam gyis gso bar bya'o/ / de yang gso bas bde ba cung zad cig bskyed cing / yang rgyu cung zad kyis ni 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / de yang bsdus pa las/ bde ba cung zad skyes nas ni/ / cung zad rgyu ni 'phel 'gyur zhing / / nad kyi lhag ma med mi 'gyur/ / las skyes tshe ni nges pa yin/ / lhung ba las ni 'jus pa bzhin/ / nad la phan pas gzung bar bya/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / spang bar bya ba bshad pa ni/ bcos pa'i thabs med nyid du 'gyur/ / shin tu phyin ci log par gnas/ / 'dod dang rmongs dang khro bar byed/ / 'chi ltas snang zhing dbang po nyams/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ gang la bcos shing gso ba'i thabs med par gyur pa de ni bcos pa'i thabs med pa ste/ spang bar bya ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ / bcos pa'i thabs med pa de gang zhig yin zhe na/ gang shin tu phyin ci log la gnas pa zhes bya ba yin no/ / nad gang gso ba tsam gyi tshul las kyang / shin tu phyin ci log par gnas pa ste bya ba'i las kyi lam thams cad las 'das shing / nad rkang dang khu chu la sogs pa lus zungs shin tu gting ring bar zhen pa gnad dang tshigs kyi nang du zhen pa de ni bcos pa'i thabs med cing gso bar mi nus pa yin no/ / de bzhin du 'dod pa la sogs pa byed pa yang gsor mi rung ba nyid de/ / 'dod pa ni yul rnams la lhag par chags shing zhen pa'o/ / rmongs pa ni sems dang bral zhing dran pa nyams la mi shes par gyur pa'o/ / khros pa ni gnas dang mal la sogs pa gang du yang mi dga' zhing sems ldog pa'o/ / byed pa zhes bya ba ni gang de dag ltar byed pa de yang bcos pa'i thabs med pa yin no/ / de bzhin du 'chi ltas snang zhing dbang po nyams pa yang spang bar bya ba yin no/ / de la 'chi ltas snang ba ni 'chi ba'i mtshan ma snang ba'o/ / dbang po nyams pa ni mig la sogs pa'i dbang po nyams shing dbang po 'gags par byed pa'i nad kyang bcos pa'i thabs med pa yin te/ myur du dbang po 'joms pa yin no/ / de ltar na dang po nad yongs su brtags la gso ba brtsam par bya'o/ gzhan du sman pa'i rang gi don la sogs pa nges par nyams par 'gyur ro/ / de yang gzhung las/ dang por 'di ltar nad brtags la/ / de nas las ni brtsam bya yi/ / gzhan du rang don rig pa dang / / grags pa nyams pa nyid thob 'gyur/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / nad pa bcos pa'i thabs yod pa dag kyang / spang bar bya ba dag bshad pa ni/ sman pa rgyal po la sdang dang / / de dang mi mdza' sdang ba dang / / yo byad mi 'byor brel ba dang / / nyan du mi btub tshe zad dang / / gtum zhing mya ngan la mnan 'jigs/ / byas pa mi gzo sman brnyas spang / / zhes bya ba yin te/ nad pa de lta bu ni gsor rung yang spang bar bya'o/ / sman pa rgyal po la sdang zhing / / zhes bya ba ni sman pa dag dang rgyal po ste/ sa bdag la sdang ba dang / de bzhin du de dang mi mdza' zhes bya ba/ sman pa dang rgyal po la sdang zhing mi mdza' ba de yang spang bar bya'o/ / sdang ba dang zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid la sdang zhing dgrar byed pa'o/ / yo byad mi 'byor zhes bya ba ni yo byad mtshang ba ste/ gso ba'i yan lag dang mi ldan pa'o/ / brel ba ni bya ba mang ba ste/ bya ba gzhan la ltos shing / / las gzhan la sems zhen pa'o/ / nyan du mi btub pa ni sman pa'i bsgo ba mi byed pa gang yin pa de yang spang bar bya'o/ / tshe zad pa ni 'tsho ba yongs su zad pa'o/ / gtum pa ni 'phral du gnod pa byed cing gdug pa'i chos can no/ / mya ngan la mnan pa ni chung ma la sogs pa shi ba las byung ba'i mya ngan gyis gzir ba'o/ / 'jigs pa ni 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'o/ / byas pa mi gzo ba ni gang la yang phan par byas su zin kyang / gnod pa byed pa'o/ / sman pa brnyas pa ni bdag nyid sman pa ma yin du zin kyang / sman pa lta bur 'chos shing rmongs pas rang dgar sman dpyad byed pa ste/ de yang spang bar bya'o/ / de ltar le'u dang por gzhung ma lus pa'i don mdor bsdus pa bshad nas/ de'i 'og tu bde blag tu dran par bya ba'i phyir/ le'u'i grangs kyi mdor bsdus pa bshad pa ni/ de nas gzhan yang rgyud 'di yi/ / le'u bsdus pa bshad bya ste/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ de nas de'i 'og tu bde bar dran par bya ba'i phyir/ le'u bsdus pa bshad par bya'o zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ / rgyud ces bya ba 'dis tshe'i rig byed kyi don 'dzin cing sdud pas na rgyud do/ / le'u bsdus pa ni le'u rnams bsdus shing phung po gcig tu byed pa'o/ / de dag kyang gang zhig yin zhe na/ tshe ring nyin re dus spyod dang / / nad med bya dang btung ba dang / / zas shes bya dang zas bsdam bya/ / zad tshod sman dang ro la gnas/ / nad shes bya dang de'i dbye ba/ / de gso ba dang gso thabs gnyis/ / sbyang sogs snum chos khrus brta bya/ / sman dud khar dor mig bkru dang / / gso dang dbyung thabs zug rngu mtshon/ / gtar dpyad zug rngu dbyung ba'i dpyad/ / mtshon dang thal sman me btsa'i las/ / mdo gnas le'u sum cu ni/ / 'di yin/

jauṣadhamapi catudhidham‌-bahavaḥka sambhavanti svarasakrāthacūṇauyāstadūhukara nāṃ nivāraṇakṣamaṃ na tu chabaṇavede taddhi sukhamucyate | nānāśaktayo bahavo guṇā yaśya gurumandādayaḥ ṇam‌ 1 athavā yadnekarogavināśanasamatha sampattiyuktam‌ | athavā pākasaṃskārā yogyaṃ dātuṃ yadrāti tatra yojyam‌ | kāṭdoṣarūpadehavayovalādīn‌ jñātvā yu iti tat‌ yogyaṃ rogasya rogiṇaśca ||| 42
tib: de ltar sngar bshad pa'i le'u sum cus ni mdo'i gnas bshad pa yin te/ tshe ring bar 'dod pa dang / nyin re dang dus su spyod pa dang / zhes pa gnyis pa'i mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / des na tshe ring bar 'dod pa dang / nyin re spyod pa dang / dus kyi spyod pa dang / nad med par bya ba dang / btung ba'i rdzas shes par bya ba dang / zas kyi rang bzhin shes par bya ba dang / zas legs par bsdams par bya ba dang / zas kyi tshod zin par bza' ba dang / sman la sogs pa'i rdzas shes par bya ba dang / ro rnams shes par bya ba dang / nad la sogs pa shes par bya ba dang / nad de'i bye brag shes par bya ba dang / nad gso ba bstan pa dang / gso thabs rnam pa gnyis dang / sbyang ba la sogs pa'i tshogs bsdu ba dang / snum chos kyi dpyad dang / dugs kyi dpyad dang / slon dang khrus kyi dpyad dang / mdoms kyi dpyad dang / sna nas gtong ba'i sman dang / sman gyi dud pa'i dpyad dang / sman khus mkhur ba bkang zhing dor ba la sogs pa'i dpyad dang / mig sman blugs te mig nad bkru ba'i dpyad dang / mig gso zhing tshim par bya ba'i dpyad dang / sman gyi phur ma btso zhing sman khus mig brta ba'i cho ga dang / mtshon gyi dum bu lus las dbyung ba'i cho ga dang / gtar dpyad kyis dbug pa'i cho ga dang / mtshon gyi las kyi cho ga dang / thal sman rnon po dang me btsa'i las kyi cho ga'o/ / 'di dag gis ni rgyud kyi don ma lus pa mdor ston pa yin pas na mdo'i gnas te rgyud ma lus pa'i mgo bo lta bu yin no/ / da ni/ lus kyi brjod bya ste/

sukhasādhyādicatuṣṭayaṭakṣaṇasucyate svauṣadhakṣame dehe utpanno vyādhiḥ sukhasādhyaḥ sukhopāyaḥ kāṭhenāspena sādhyate | sarvāṇyauṣadhāniṃ yaḥ kṣamate sahate tīkṣṇamadhyasudurūpāṇi nānādeśajāni rāmanāni tathā śodhanarūpāṇi tathā viṣakṣārādīni ca | yūno- vayasyasya taruṇasyevyarthaḥ | pasaḥ na siyā | pugrahaṇaṃ khīnivṛtyatham‌ 1 yatastasyā; savaidā bhīratamavuddhitvam‌ } ato yathoktāturaguṇābhāvaḥ | sātu yasmāttīkṣṇānyoṣadhāni na sahate saukumāyāīdiyogāt‌ | jitātmanaḥ-akhodaṭupasya jita ātmā yena viṣayābhirāṣaṃ parihastaḥ | amarmago-na marmasthaḥ | mamā sirohadayavasipramaratīni teṣu gacchatīti ! na marbhago'marmaigaḥ hatkaṇṭhādipīḍākaraṇāsamatha̭; | aspahetvamraśūparūpa iti, detuścāmrūpaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca tābha hesvrarūparūpāṇi | alpāni hetvagrarūparūpāṇi yasya sa tathāvidhaḥ | dahetunidānam‌ | agrarūpa̭pūvairūpam‌ | rūpaṃ rakṣaṇam‌. etānyaspāni : yasya. | anupadrava iti | na vidyate upadravo yasya utpannasya vyādheranantaraṃ jāyate yo'nyo ' vyādhi`na tahścaṇabhūto'pradhāno na yathāsvarakṣaṇastadupakra` manisodhakaḥ sa upadravaḥ | tathā ca āgamaḥ-“yādhe` rūpari yo vyādhibhavalyuttarakāṭhajaḥ | upakramavidhātī ' ca sa hyupadraba ucyate ||| ? atukhyadṛṣyaderatuṃ.. prakaratiriti-dṛṣyaṃ ca deśaśca ` ṛtuśca prakṛtiśca tāḥ dṛṣyadeśasupakṛtayaḥ | atulyā dṛṣyadeśuṅṛaṣṭaṅhadayaṃ | [ satra tayo yasya | atulyā visadṛkhī | yathā~dṛṣye medomajjādāvanūpadere śītartau āturo vātaśrakara tistasya kupitaṃ pittaṃ sukhasādhyamiti | atulyadubhyo yathā-na śe'maṇā śītena raktamuṣṇaṃ dūṣitam‌ | atulyadeśe vyādhirya̭thā-anūpadero pittaṃ saṃmatam‌ | atulyaturyathā-dāradi kaphoddhavaḥ | atusyaprakaratiyathā-pittamachṛteḥ ṣamoddhavo vyādhiḥ | nanvatusya-. daṣyadeśatupakṛtitvādasau kṛcchrasādhyo yathā vā yāpyo na sukhasādhyaḥ ! anaikasukhopakramasādhyatvāt‌haḥ yato dṛṣyādīnāmatulyatvāt‌. paraspasmanya evopa kramaḥ | ekasukhopakramaḥ sukhasādhyo vyādhirata eva sādhyayāpyapariyānyā mehāḥ śeṣmapittavātotthāḥ samāsamakriyatayā mahāyayatayāpi ceyevaṃ nidiśāti | atrocyate | tathā pramāvatvāt‌ pramehākhyasya vyādheyahuta śaṣmapramehaḥ samakriyatvāt‌ sādhyaḥ | pittaprameho viṣamakriyatvāt‌ yāpyaḥ |! mahātyayatvāca vātapramehaḥ pratyākhyeyaḥ | kiṃca ̱tusyadṛṣyadeśatuprakūtitvānmahārambho nipmaratīko vyādhijīyate | tato'sau na sukhasādhyaḥ | kutracidyādhau tulyadṛṣyādirapi sukhasādhyatve jyāyān‌ ! tathāca anthaḥ~ ^“ vare tusyatudoṣatvaṃ bhamehe tukhyadupyatā | raktarāsme purāṇatvaṃ sukhasādhyavvahetavaḥ || › pādasaṃpadi bhiṣagādīnāṃ caturṇa pādānāṃ ` saṃpat‌ samṛddhiḥ tasyāṃ satyāmaṅgacacatuṣṭaye saṃpūrṇe sati | aheṣvatuguṇeṣviti mahāḥ sūryādayaḥ teṣvanugaṇeṣvanukūkayisthiteṣu ` śobhanasthānagateṣu sasya | ekadoṣamāga iti-doṣaśca mārgaśca doṣamārmam‌ | ekaṃ doṣamārgī yasya sa tathoktaḥ! doṣo vātādiḥ | mārgasakhividhaḥ rākhādirvakṣyamāṇo vāhyābhyantaramadhyabhedena | tenaikena vātādīnāmanyatamena doṣeṇa yo jāto na dvābhyāṃ tribhirvā tathā nekenāpi sargeṇa vāhyena madhyenābhyantareṇa vā jātaḥ navo na̱ jaraṭhaḥ acirotpanna ityathaiḥ | yasmādratsarātītā vyādhayo'sādhyāḥ | sa tathā. vidho vyādhiḥ sukhaḥ sukhena sādhyate | tathāca manthaḥ-“ sukhasādhyaḥ sukhopāyaḥ kāṅenāspena sādhyate ?

skt: athoti sarvaipbadhyāyeṣu maṅgalāḥ | tathā atha ityānantayeṃ prastutābhisambandhe vā | athetyādi śabdā nāṃ pū'dhyāye vāṇaita evāthaḥ | māṅgachiko hyācāyaiḥ pryadhyāyārambhe maṅgalāthamathaśabdaṃ prayuṅkte | dine dine caryā dinasya bā cyā dinacaryā ! caraṇaṃ cayā| ubhayarokahitamāhārabihāraveṣṭetti yāvat‌ | pratidinaṃ yatkartavyaṃ tamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ prastutādāyupkāmīyādadhyāyādanantaraṃ ko'sya sambandhaḥ ! ucyate | yasmādāyupkāmeṇa puruṣeṇa yataspradhānamāyuṇyaṃ tadā sevyam‌ prathamataḥ tadanvanyāna yānyāyuṣkāṇi | ataḥ prathamaṃ tāvadācāragradhānena bhāvitavyam‌ | yataṃ ācārādāyukabhyata ityācāryāḥ | yadyapi ca rāraicayāpe cidahitā tathāpi prādhānyādinacayā'sminnadhyāye nirdiṣṭā | ato dinacayādhyāyo'yamucyate 1|| hai0-dinacaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyā pratijānīte-mathāto dinacayodhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma dati-yataḥ pūrvādhyamara vyādhiprātakiraḥ sāmānyasaṃkaṣepābhyāṃ vyākhyātaḥ sa evedānīṃ sāmānyavistarābhyāṃ vyākhyeyaḥ, sa nva hetvādikrameṇa tatrādya ca bahuvaktavyavvādvahiraṃgo heḥ sa dadhā-vidāraḥ āhāsdha | 'sminanadhyāye| ata pvāyaṃ dinacayīkhya; | vihāro dedhā-niyatakālo'niyatakā~ chaśca | niyate dvidhā-dainaṃinaḥ ārvavaśca | taca dainadinorataraśavatudaśo sa̱ho rāhma suhūrato viduvati samarātidine kāre dviṣaṭikālakṣaṇaḥ | mudtaṃsya ceha diṣaṭikopalakṣaṇāthelātsarvmin‌ kāṭe. ratreśavatuṣaiṭikāvareṣe samutthāne kāryamiti sthitam‌ | sastho nīrogaḥ katpaḥ sa āyuṣo yathopacaritasya jīvitasya rakṣārtha brāhma sudratai uktaṣaṭhidabhyutthāna yāt‌ | purto nāḍikādayam‌ | brahma jñānaṃ tadarthamadhyayanādayayapi brahma tastha yogo suratā brāhmaḥ pāśremayāmasya nāḍikādrayaṃ tasmin‌ braha muhūtaṃ uktiṣaṭhet‌| kiṃbhūtaḥ | khastho'nāturaḥ | "samadoṣaḥ samābhniśca samadhātumaṅakriyaḥ 1 prasannāmedriyamanāḥ sa stha ilyamidhīyate |' iti svasthalakṣaṇam‌ | kimarthabhuttiṭat‌ | rakṣāthamāyuṣo jīvitasya | tadā hayṛttiṣaṭhato vyādhyalakṣamyāyabhāva evāyuṣo rakṣā bhavati ! atureṇa dhātusāmyārtha chapatavyameva

svastho nīrogakaspaḥsa āyuṣo yathopacaritasya jīvitasya rvā brāhaye sudala uttiṭhedabhyutathānaṃ kuryāt‌ | yuhūrato nāḍikādrayaṃ badyajñāna tadarthamadhyayanādyavi brahma tasya yogyo muhūrto brāhmaḥ pancimayāmasya nāḍikāṭrayam‌ | svasthavṛttādhikāsāyaṃ cijñeyaḥḥ abhyutthāne charutvā kimāsevyam‌

śarīracintāṃ vinivartya sūtnapuyīṣotsargādichaṣṣaṇāmavakayakāryauparaparyāyāmanantaradtaraucavidhiḥ san‌ dantapavanaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ bhakṣayet‌ samānayet‌ | prātaḥ śryuṣasi sucvā ca bhojanaṃ katvā, taca mṛcya kavitā śuṇṇamakavṛśvabhavaṃ, nyamrojaṃ, karaja, kamumajaṃ tathā kapāyakaṭutiktakam‌ | anyadpyevai(tiktaka śreṣṭhaḥ kaṣāye khadirastathā || madhūko madhure śreṣṭhaḥ karajaḥ kaṭuke tathā | kaṣaudaranyopatrivargālaṃ satailaṃ sedhavena ca || cūrṇe na tejñovatyāśaca dantānanilaya vidyodhayet‌ | ekaika ṣaraṣayedataṃkhadunā kaikena ca ` || dantaśodhanacūrṇena dantamāṃsānyabādhayan‌ 1, tahairganyopadehau tu śeṣmāṇaṃ cāpi karṣati || vedāya -srabhiruci saumanasaṃ karoti ca | na khadedaralatātvoṣṭhajihāro-rāsamuddhave || tathāsyapāke śvāse ca kāsadikāvamīṣu ca | durva- -lo'jīśamaktaś mūrcchā madapīḍitaḥ || śirosatistṛṣitaḥ śrāntaḥ pānaṅkamānvitaḥ | arditaḥ karṇaśūlī ca dantarogī ca mānavaḥ ||'" jihvāmakhadaraṇaṃ "ca “jihvāniraikhanaṃ raupyaṃ savarṇaṃ vākṣamevaḥ ca | tanmalāpaharaṃ śastaṃ khadu śakṇa darśāgutam‌ || sukhesakhayadaugīndhyaśoṣajāḍacaharaṃ khakham‌| dantadāḍharthakaraṃ rucyaṃ snahagaṃṅṣadhāraṇabh‌ ||" iti suścataḥ | | aṣaṭāgahdaye 1 vidham‌ | ādimarahaṇena sajīsmido'pāmāgīmālatyādiparimahaḥ | tacca dantamāṃsānyavādhayan‌ ardisan‌ bhakṣayet‌ | dantamāṃsaduḥsvāpanāt‌ tatpāko'kasmāujāyate
tib: de nas zhes pa ni le'u thams cad la bkra shis pa'i don yin pa'am/ de bzhin du de ma thag pa dang / rtsom pa dang / rjes su 'brel pa yin no/ / de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sgra le'u snga mar don bshad zin mod kyi/ bkra shis ba'i don du slob dpon gyis le'u re re'i rtsom pa la bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ de nas zhes bya ba'i sgra ni smos pa yin no/ / nyi ma re re zhing bya ba'i spyod pa yin pas na/ nyin re zhing spyad par bya ba'am/ nyin mo spyod pa yin pas na/ nyin re'i spyod pa ste/ 'jig rten gnyi ga la phan par bya ba'i zas dang / spyod lam gyi spyod pa spyod par byed pa ste/ nyi ma re re zhing gang zhig bya ba'i le'u de bshad par bya'o zhes pa'o/ / tshe ring bar 'dod pa'i le'u'i rjes thogs su 'di bshad pa'i 'brel pa gang zhig yin zhe na/ de brjod par bya ste/ gang gi phyir tshe ring bar 'dod pa'i skyes bus/ gtso cher tshe la phan pa gang yin pa de dang por kun tu bsten par bya ba'am/ de'i rjes la ni phan ba gzhan gang dag yod pa bsten par bya ba yin no/ / de bas na dang po re zhig kun tu spyod pa gtsor gzung bar bya'o/ / de yang gang gi phyir kun tu spyod pa las/ tshe ring ba 'thob par 'gyur bas na kun tu spyod pa yin no/ / gang 'dir mtshan mo'i spyod pa dag kyang bshad mod kyi/ 'on kyang gtso bor gyur pas/ le'u 'di las nyin mo'i spyod pa bstan pa yin no/ / de bas na 'di la ni nyin re'i spyod pa zhes bshad do/ / gzhung 'di las ni tshe bskyang ba'i rang bzhin can ston la/ de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ tha mal par bde bar gnas pa'i 'jug pa dang / nad pa'i 'jug pa'o/ / de la bkra shis pa'i phyir dang / smra bar bya ba nyung zad cig yod pa'i phyir dang / nad pa la yang dgos pa'i phyir/ tha mal par bde bar gnas par 'jug pa nyid thog mar bshad pa yin te/

skt: tadanu dantakāṣṭhabhakṣaṇādanantaraṃ jihvāṃ chidit‌| tena mukhasya makhvairasyādayo doṣā na bhavanti | ` śucyādayo guṇā bhavanti | kiṃ sarve tadbhakcayantyāhāsvit‌ kecit‌ tademāha-tadantapavanaṃ nādayānna bhaśnayet‌ | ajīrṇamapariṇatamannaya | vamathuḥ chardiḥ | śvāsādayo vakṣyamāṇalaścaṇāḥ | ajīṇamamyāstītyajīrṇī | evaṃ savatra yojyam‌ | arditaṃ vadanā cāyunā vakram‌ | āmayaśabdena rogapayīyeṇa vṛpṇādīnāṃ sambandhaḥ | tena vṛṣṇāmayī sukhapākamayī hadāmayī netrāmayī śirāmayī kaṇāṃmayī ca tadahantakāṣṭhaṃ varjayet‌

dantadhāvanādanantaramajanaṃ kāryaṃ tada̭thamāha-tena sauvīrāṃjanena netre snigdhādiśuṇayute bhavataḥ | nityaṃ svakāṃ sattaṃ prātaḥ sāyaṃ cākṣṇenaitrayoḥ sauvīyāanaṃ hitaṃ pathyam‌ tasmādnet‌ rīkhyet‌

ki savakrālaṃ tadthamāṭa-yanedhaśruntajāmayamamirūpam‌ | vyapadeśo'tra mūca, cataḥ paṃcamahābhūtātmakamindriyaṃ tasya ca vānādito viroṣān‌ ūṣmato | vravatvāddhayaṃ bhiruddhavvādato'smaḥn‌ kāragān‌ stha snāvanimittaṃ kaphaniharaṇāya samarāpre savrarātre gave. saprādāt‌ saprāhādanantaraṃ rasā jñanaṃ yojayet‌ | tato nāvanādikaṃ kāyaim‌ | krameṇa tadarthamāha | tathā ca saṃgrahe-““ aṃjanoṣcheritaṃ nasthaiḥ kavalenīvaneritam‌ 1 dhūmena kavaṭodchiṣṭaṃ kamārātakaphāpaham‌`
tib: bde bar gnas shing nad med la dge ba des ni/ tshad ji tsam du 'ongs ba'i srog bsrung ba'i phyir tshangs pa'i yud tsam na ldang zhing langs par bya'o/ / de la yud tsam ni chu tshod gnyis so/ / tshangs pa'i ni mya ngan las 'das pa la bya'o/ / de'i don du 'don pa la tshangs pa zhes bya'o/ / de bya ba dang 'tsham pa'i yud tsam ni/ thun tha ma'i chu tshod gnyis so/ / 'di ni bde bar gnas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin par shes par bya'o/ / langs nas ci zhig la brten par bya zhe na/ de'i phyir bshad pa ni/ lus kyi bya ba rdzogs byas nas/ / de nas gtsang sbra'i cho ga bya/ / arka n+ya gro d+ha seng ldeng / / ka rany+dza ka ku la sogs/ / bska dang tsha dang kha ba dag / rtse 'jam nang par zas spyad nas/ / so dang rnyil la ma gnod par/ / so yi dag byed bca' bar bya/ / zhes bya ba yin te/

skt: tat‌ kiṃ sarvairāsebhyamuta kauścattadatha̭māha--ścaḥ raktapittāścupahatānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ ca tattābūlamapathyam‌ ṣatañcaraḥkṣatam‌ | pittā raktapittam‌ | kakṣe nimittenoschupitāni cakṣuṣi yeṣāṃ te rukṣotacharupi tacaścapasteṣāmathavā rūkṣāṇāmutkupitacadhcuṣāṃ ca viṣaṃ āṅgīviṣādi | mū mūrkhāya: | mado madātyayaṃ vakṣyamāṇaḥ | śoṣo rājayakṣmā teṣapāmapaśyam‌ }

nasyādi kūtvā'bhyaṅgaḥ kāryastadathaimāda-nilyaṃ vamaikāṭamabhyaṅgamācaret‌) so'bhyaṅkho jarāśramavātāna. hantīti tathā dṛṣṭe; prasādaṃ nairmasyaṃ karoti iārīrasyeva ṣṭhi poṣamāyuṣo'bhibṛddhaṃ nidra sutvachasvaṃ ca | chobhanā tvak‌ sutvak‌ tasyā bhāvaḥ suṃtvaksvam‌ | ḍya dṛḍhatā kamaṇi sāmadhyem‌

ropānnenābhyaṅga kvāna māha--khatharāyāsajanane karama vyāyāma unyane| tesmā dathāyāmādupasevitāhyāghavādikasupajāyata | sārakaṃ bhagadvārīrāyāsajanane karasa vyāyāmaraṃknitam‌ | tatakalvā tu deṣṭaḥ vibhvīyātsamantataḥpadararopacayaḥ kāntirgātarāṇāṃ muvibhaktatā 1 dīktāmitvamanālasvaṃ sthiratvaṃ savava ma̱nā || dharamakṛmapipāsoṣmakītādaunāṃ sadiṣṇutā | jārogya nāpi paramaṃ vyrāyāmā-dupajāyate(|tathāsi sadadāṃ tena kiṃcirasthaulyāpakarvaṇam‌ | na ca vyāyāminaṃ matya sardayaṃtvarayo bhayāt‌ || na yenaṃ ` sahasā ''kamya jarā samadhiyohati||| sthirībhavati saṃni ca vyāyammamiratasya ca || vyāyārsanuṇṇagātrasna padaṭrayasudarātinamya ca vyādhayo nopasaryanti si śramaṇā data || rorpamuṇarīna mapi kuryāt‌ ghudadaun‌. | vyāyām‌ ryato 1 visramapi bhojanam‌ 4 vidgthasavidagdhe vā nirdodhaṃ paripyate | svāma di sadā pathyo balināṃ kigdhabhojanam‌ || sa ca ne casanto ca teṣāṃ pathyatamaḥ prataḥ | sarvatuṣavaharaḥ umbhiratmahitaipibhiḥ || ṣalasāena kartavyo vyāyāme hantyato'nyathaḥ 6 hṛdi sthani sthito vāyuryadā vga prapadyate || vyāyāmaṃ kuvaita jantotadvārdasya lakṣaṇam‌ | vayovaladārīrāṇi raiśakāsmacahanāni caṃ || samīkṣya yaudvayāyāmamanyayā sesamapluyāta 1** dati suśṭhavaḥ 1 dehalaghutvam‌| karmaṇi sāmarya-śaktatā ṭatā ! dīpo'bhirvahidīpratā | medaso-dhātoḥ kṣayaḥ alpatā | vibhaktāni-vibhāgasthitāni, dhanāni-niviḍāni dṛḍhāni, gātrāṇi-spīrāvayavāḥ, yasya sa̱ vibhaktavanagātaghraḥ | tasya bhāvastakhamiti
taṃ ca vyāyāmaṃ karatvā nidhetyaṃ yathāsukhaṃ madayat‌ | sama̭tattaḥ sabaimāpādatalamastakaṃ, par̤a pāṃḍayat‌
tib: bshang ba dang / gci ba dor ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can te/ rnam grangs gzhan du na nges par bya ba'i bya ba byas nas/ de nas de'i 'og tu gtsang sbra'i cho ga byas la/ so dag par byed pa'i so shing bca' bar bya'o/ / de'i nang par te tho rangs dang / zas spyod de zas zos zin nas bca' la/ de yang rtse mo 'jam pa ste/ pir lta bur gyur pa tsam du bca' la bya'o/ / de bzhin du bska ba dang / tsha ba dang / kha ba'i zhes bya ba yin te/ / ro de lta bu dag go/ / de yang gang zhig ce na/ arka zhes bya ba la sogs pa yin no/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni/ shing sad dza dang / a ri me da dang / a ba marga dang / dzA ti'i shing la sogs pa bsdu'o/ / de yang so dang rnyil la mi gnod cing / ma gtses par bca' bar bya'o/ / ci thams cad kyis bca' bar bya ba'am/ 'on te 'ga' zhig gis she na/ de'i phyir bshad pa ni/ ma zhu slon bro dbugs mi bde/ / lud pa lu rims kha yon can/ / skom zhing kha skams snying mig rna/ / mgo bo na bas 'di mi bca'/ / so shing de ni 'di dag gis bca' bar mi bya'o/ / gang gis she na/ ma zhu ba ste/ kha zas ma zhu ba dang / slon bro zhing skyugs pa dang / dbugs mi bde ba la sogs pa/ 'og nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'o/ / can zhes bya ba ni thams cad la sbyar te/ gang la ma zhu ba yod pa de ni ma zhu ba can no/ / de bzhin du gzhan dag la yang sbyar ro/ / kha yo ba ni kha'i phyed rlung gis yon por gyur pa'o/ / na ba zhes bya ba ni skom pa la sogs pa kun dang sbyar te/ des na skom dad can dang / kha skoms pa'i nad can dang / snying nad can dang / mig nad can dang / rna nad can dang mgo na ba dag gis so shing bca' ba de spang bar bya'o/ / so shing bca' ba'i 'og tu mig sman bya ste/ de'i phyir bshad pa ni/ rtag tu mig sman skyer khaN+Da/ / mig la phan pas de phyir bsten/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ rtag par dus thams cad du rgyun du nang par dang dgongs ka mig gnyis su skyer khaN+Da bcug pa ni phan zhing bde bar byed pa yin no/ / de bas na de'i phyir de bsten cing goms par bya'o/ / ci dus thams cad du de nyid bsten par bya ba yin nam zhe na/ de'i phyir bshad pa ni/ de ni me yi rang bzhin te/ / lhag par bad kan la 'jigs pas/ / mchi ma 'dzag phyir skyer khaN+Da/ / zhag bdun zhing ni blugs par bya/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ gang gi phyir mig de ni me'i rang bzhin can nam/ tshul can yin pa'i phyir bas/ de'i phyir dbang po rnams ni 'byung ba lnga'i bdag nyid can yin par phal cher bshad la/ mig de ni rlung la sogs pa bas khyad par du bad kan la lhag par 'jigs pa yin zhing brten pa yin la/ de dag phan tshun mi mthun pa yin la/ de bas na bad kan dbyung zhing 'dzag par bya ba'i phyir/ zhag bdun bdun 'das pa dang / skyer khaN+Da blugs par bya zhing bsten par bya'o/ / de nas snar blugs pa la sogs pa bya dgos te/ de'i phyir 'di'i 'og tu sna sman bshad pa yin no/ / de yang bsdus pa las/ mig sman sna sman khar gzhag dor/ / dud pa brngub par bya ba dang / / du ba so rtsi dor ba yis/ / rim gyis bad kan rlung las rgyal/ / zhes bshad pa yin pas na 'dir/ / de nas sna sman mkhur bkang dor/ / dud pa so rtsi bsten par bya/ / zhes pa yin te/ / de nas zhes bya ba la mig sman gyi rjes thogs la/ sna sman la sogs pa bsten par bya'o/ / sna sman ni sna nas gtang ba'i sman no/ / mkhur bkang dor ba ni/ sman gyi khu ba bskol ba la sogs pas mkhur ba bkang ste cung zad gzhag la dor ba'o/ / du ba ni 'og nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi sbyor ba'o/ / so rtsi tam po la ni grags par zad do/ / de dag kyang ci thams cad kyis bsten par bya ba'am/ 'on te la la zhig gis bsten par bya zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ so rtsi glo 'grams mkhris pa khrag / rtsub pas mig ni na ba dang / / dug gis brgyal zhing chang nad gzir/ / lus skem gyur la gnod pa yin/ / zhes bya ba smos pa yin te/ mkhris pa khrag gis gnod par gyur pa'am/ lus skem por gyur pa la/ so rtsi tam po la de gnod pa yin no/ / de la glo 'grams pa ni glo rdol ba'o/ / mkhris pa khrag ni mkhris pa las gyur pa'i khrag go/ / rtsub pa'i rgyus gang gi mig gnod cing na bar gyur ba de ni/ rtsub pas mig ni na ba dang / / zhes bya'o/ / yang na rtsub par gyur pa dang / mig na bar gyur pa'o/ / dug ni kha lkugs pa la sogs pa'o/ / brgyal ba ni 'bog pa'o/ / chang nad kyis gzir ba ni chang gis gnod par gyur pa ste/ 'og nas bshad pa'o/ / lus skems gyur pa ni gcong chen pos thebs pa ste/ 'di dag la ni gnod pa yin no/ / snar blugs pa la sogs pa byas nas/ bsku byug bya ba yin pas na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ rtag tu bsku byug spyod byed na/ / de ni rgas ngal rlung 'joms yin/ / mig gsal lus rgyas tshe 'phel zhing / / gnyid 'ong lpags 'jam brtas byed yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ rtag par dus thams cad du bsku byug la spyad par bya'o/ / ci'i phyir zhe na/ bsku byug de ni rgas pa dang / ngal ba dang / rlung 'joms pa yin pa dang / de bzhin du mig gsal zhing dngas par byed pa dang / lus rgyas shing 'phel ba dang / tshe shin tu 'phel bar byed pa dang / gnyid legs par log par gyur pa dang / pags pa shin tu 'jam zhing mdog gsal ba nyid dang brtas pa ste/ brtan pa nyid kyis las rnams nus par byed pa yin no/ / de ni mgo dang rna ba dang / / rkang par khyad par dag tu bsten/ / zhes bya ba ni bsku byug bya ste/ mgo bo la sogs pas khyad par du bsten zhing goms par bya'o/ / gang gis spang bar bya zhe na/ / bad kan skyes dang ma zhu dang / / bkru sman sogs gtang bsku byug spang / / zhes bya ba ste/ bad kan gyis gzir zhing skyes pa la sogs pas spang bar bya zhing bsten par mi bya'o/ / de yang bad kan skyes pa ni/ bad kan gyis gzir zhing gnod par gyur pa ste/ skyes pa smos pa ni shin tu gzir bar gyur par bstan pa'i phyir ro/ / ma zhu ba ni zas kyi lhag ma ma zhu bar gyur pa'o/ / bkru sman sogs gtang zhes bya ba ni/ bkru sman dang skyug sman la sogs pa byas pa ste/ lus sbyangs nas dus yun ring por ma lon par des bsku byug bsten par mi bya'o/ / bsku byug byas nas lus kyi rtsol ba la brten par bya ba yin pas/ de'i phyir bshad pa ni/ yang zhing las ni nus pa dang / / me yi drod skyed tshil 'bri la/ / lus kyi skabs phyed mkhregs pa nyid/ / rtsol ba las ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ lus dub par byed pa'i las la ni/ rtsol ba zhes bya'o/ / de bas na rtsol ba bsten pa las ni yang ba la sogs pa nye bar 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de la yang ba ni lus kyi khong yang ba nyid do/ / las nus pa ni nus pa brtan pa nyid do/ / me'i drod bskyed pa ni 'ju ba'i me drod bskyed pa'o/ / lus zungs kyi tshil bri ba ni tshil chung bar 'gyur ba'o/ / lus kyi skabs phyed pa ni lus kyi stod smad kyi cha phyed par gnas pa'o/ / mkhregs pa ni lhod cing grims la brten pa ste/ de lta bu'i lus kyi yan lag gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi skabs phyed mkhregs pa zhes bya'o/ / de lta bu'i rang bzhin can nyid du 'gyur bas na/ lus kyi skabs phyed mkhregs pa nyid/ / ces bya'o/ / de kun gyis kyang bya ba'am 'on te ma yin zhe na/ de'i phyir/ rlung mkhris nad can byis pa dang / / rgas shing 'khogs pas de spang bya/ / zhes bya ba smos te rlung dang mkhris pa'i nad kyis gzir ba dang / byis pa dang / rgan pos rtsol ba de spangs shing dor bar bya'o/ / de la rlung nad can ni rlung gi nad kyis nyen pa'o/ / mkhris nad can ni mkhris pas nyen pa'o/ / tha dad pa smos pa la ni/ rlung dang mkhris pa gnyis ka smos kyang spang bar shes par bya'o/ / rgan po ni lo bdun cu yan chad yin par shes par bya'o/ / gzhan yang ji ltar bstan par bya zhe na/ stobs ldan snum bag za ba dang / / grang ba'i dus dang dpyid dus dang / / nus ldan dag gis de bsten bya/ / de las gzhan tshe dal ba nyid/ / ces bya ba la/ rtsol ba de yang skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa dang / zas snum bag can za ba dang / grang ba'i dus te/ dgun stod dang / dgun smad dang / dpyid kyi dus dang / nus ldan dag gis zhes pa/ ji srid shin tu nub par ma gyur pa de srid kyi bar du bsten par bya'o/ / de las gzhan tshe zhes bya ba ni/ de las dus gzhan pa'i tshe ste/ so ga dang / dbyar dang / ston gyi tshe ni dal ba nyid de ran cing cung zad tsam nyid bsten par bya'o/ / de byas ci bder lus dag ni/ / kun nas yongs su mnye bar bya/ / rtsol ba de byas zin nas ni/ / bde bar lus kun gnas par bya/ / zhes bya ba la/ / rkang pa nas mgo bo'i bar thams cad du/

skt: prasaṅgenāha-priṣedhamanyatrāpi-vyāyāmādīnāṃ sāhasamatisevāṃ bhajan‌ puruṣo vinadayati | yathā siṃho vikramavānitti svaspabaro mahābalaṃ dantinamākaṣana. svayameva śraṭathati | yadyāpi siṃho dhaiyavāṃstathāpi kiṃ gajaṃ sthānāt‌ sthānāntaraṃ setuṃ śaktaḥ saṃgamākarṣanneva prāṇāṃsvyajet‌ | ppa nanu dhanusakarṣaṇādikaṃ sāhasaṃ bhajan‌ vinaśyati 1 jāgaramasvapnaḥ | adhvā panthāḥ | slīsevā 1 dāsyaṃ bhāṣaṇamevamādivyāyāmādanantaraṃ kaṣāyadranyerudaramanaṃ kāryam‌

dbang po ste lce la sogs pa kha zas shin tu ngan pa la sogs pas gnod cing gzir bar mi bya la/ yang dbang po 'di dag longs spyod kyi bde ba la 'bad pas brtsal nas brten cing rab tu bde ba'i nyams su yang mi bya'o/ /

tshoms gsum ni chos dang / nor dang / longs spyod ces bya ba yin te/ bzhi ba thar pa'i ni chos kyi khongs su gtogs pa yin no/ / de lta bu'i sde tshoms gsum med cing / stong pa'i rtsom pa ste/ spyod pa'i 'bad pa la brten par mi bya zhing gnas par mi bya'i/ ci nas kyang chos dang mi 'gal ba'i bya ba gang yin pa de ni sde tshoms gsum dang mi 'gal ba nyid du skyes bus bsten par bya'o/ / de yang chos la kun tu brten pa na/ ci nas kyang nor dang longs spyod dang 'gal bar mi 'gyur ba de ltar bya la/ nor la brten pa na yang chos dang 'gal bar mi bya la/ longs spyod la brten pa na yang /

chos rnams kun te/ dngos po thams cad la lam zhes bya ba bsgrub cing / bya ba'i gnas rnams la dbu ma ste/ dman pa yang ma yin la/ shin tu mtho ba yang ma yin pa de ni rjes su 'jug cing spyad par bya'o zhes bstan pa yin no/ / skra sen kha spu ring mi gzhag /

skra dang sen mo dang / kha spu ring por ma gyur par bregs pa ste/ kha spu zhes bya ba ni ko sko'i phyogs kyi spu'o/ / sgo dgu dang rkang pa ni/ sgo dgu dang rkang pa ste/ de dag dri ma med par bya'o/ / de la sgo dgu ni dri ma'i gnas kyi sgo rnams te/ mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / kha dang / bshang ba'i sgo dang / gci ba'i sgo la sogs pa'o/ / rkang pa ni rkang pa gnyis te/

khrus la dga' ba ni rtag tu khrus byed pa'o/ / dri zhim bsgo zhes bya ba ni/ ga pur la sogs pa'i dri zhim pa'i rdzas rnams kyis lus rjes su bsgo zhing byugs pa'o/ / chas bzang ba ni dri dang byug pa dang / phreng ba dang / gos dang / rgyan gyi rnam pas brgyan gyis chas par bya'o/ / mi 'phyar ba ni khengs shing 'phyar ches pa ma yin par byas nas/

rin po che ni marka ta dang / pad+ma rA ga dang / bai DUr+ya dang / gser sa le sbram dang / rdo rje la sogs pa'o/ / grub pa'i gsang sngags ni/ rab tu grub par grags shing / mthu sngon du snang ba'i gsang sngags/ 'jig rten pa dang bstan bcos las grags pa'o/ / sman chen po ni lag smi dang / gu ha dang / dzA ti la dang / shu dag dang / yungs kar la sogs pa'o/ / rin po che dang sngags dang sman de dag ni mgo dang mgul dang dpung pa la btags te bcang bar bya'o/ /

skt: nidi rātrau na viṣaret‌| ātyayike tu bhrayojanavadāto ` rātrivicaraṇasādhye kārye daṇḍī, maurī, -sadahāyavān‌ vicaret‌ ! athabakhāyuktamanātyathike naiva vicarennirīti | daṇḍo'syāstīti daṇḍī | daṇḍadābdo dṛṇḍaḥ-sapīdīnāṃ tu trāsanārtha, skhakitapratiṣṭhānātha, śanrunivāraṇārtham‌ | maurī-veṣṭitāśirāḥ | rirasi prāvṛtamupāra ṣṭātpatavāṃ khūtāpatadgakīṭādīnāmārakṣaṇātham‌ | sadāyavān‌-caurayakṣarakṣaḥpiśācādipratibhayaṃ-niṣedhāyem‌ 11 43||
tib: gdugs dkar po ni tshad pa 'gebs ba'i gdugs so/ / lham ni rkang pa skyob par byed pa ste/ skyes bus de gnyis dang ldan pa dang / gnya' shing gang tsam du blta zhing 'gro bar bya ste/ de tsam zhig tu mdun du blta'o/ / des ni sbrul dang / phyugs dang / ba lang dang / rta dang / rdo rtsub mo la sogs pa dag gi gnod pas nye bar mi 'gyur ro/ / mtshan mo don chen dag la ni/ / dbyug thogs mgo dkri grogs ldan bya/ / zhes bya ba ni/ / mtshan mo'i dus su ni 'gro bar mi bya'o/ / gal te shin tu don che zhing bstan pa'i bya ba'i las la 'gro zhing / mtshan mo rgyu bas nges par 'gro ba yin na/ dbyig pa dang / mgo dkri ba dang / grogs dang ldan par byas la 'gro bar bya'o zhes ston te/ don gyi shugs kyis na mtshan mo nges par 'gro ste/ mi byar mi rung ba'i bya ba ma yin pa'i don du chung ngu dag la ni 'gro bar mi bya'o zhes ston to/ / de la ber ka yod pas na dbyig pa can te/ sbrul la sogs pa skrag par bya ba'i phyir/ dbyig pa sgra dang ldan par bya ba dang / 'gyel ba las brten par bya ba'i phyir dang / dgra bo bzlog par bya ba'i phyir bya'o/ / mgo g.yogs pa ni mgo bo dkris pa ltar steng nas 'bab pa'i bya dang / phye ma leb dang / 'bu srin la sogs pa las bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ / grogs dang ldan pa ni rkun po dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / sha za la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa las bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir bya'o/ /

mchod rten ni mchod rten nyid dag dang / khyad par can gyi lhas gnas bcas pa'i zhing gi khyad par 'jig rten na grags par gang gyur pa'o/ / mchod bya ni bla ma la sogs pa'o/ / rgyal mtshan ni gtsug lag khang dang / lha khang gi nang du btags pa mdung ngam 'khor lo dang ldan pa'i ba dan no/ / mi shis pa ni bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po ste/ de rnams kyi grib ma 'gom par mi bya zhing / brdzi bar mi bya'o/ / thal ba ni lci ba la sogs pa tshig pa las byung ba'o/ / phub ma ni 'bras kyi shun ba'o/ / mi gtsang ba ni bshang ba dang gci ba la sogs pa'o/ / gseg ma ni rdo'i dum grugs so/ / bong ba ni sa'i rang bzhin la rdo dang 'dra ba'o/ / gtor ma'i gnas ni 'byung po la sogs pa la zas sbyin pa'i gnas so/ / khrus byas pa'i sa ni gang du 'ga' zhig gis khrus byas pa ste/ de thams cad 'gom par mi bya zhing yongs su spang bar bya'o/ / chu bor rkyal te 'gro mi bya/ / me tshan phung por 'gro mi bya/ / zhes bya ba la chu bo ste/ klung gi chu chen po la lag pa gnyis brkyang zhing 'gro bar mi bya ste/ chu srin dang rus sbal la sogs pas gnod par 'gyur ba'i 'jigs pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du me'i phung po chen po'i tshogs kyi thad du 'gro bar mi bya'o/ / the tshom bcas pa'i gru shing la/ / bzhon pa mi srun bzhin mi 'dzeg / ces bya ba la/ the tshom dang bcas pa'i gru ni chings ma lhod cing rnyings pas pha rol du skyel mi nus so/ / de bzhin du the tshom dang bcas pa'i shing ni/ dug la sogs pa'i gdug pa yod pa'am/ lha la sogs pa gnas pa'am/ chag tu nye ba dag tu 'dzeg par mi bya zhing / de dag gi steng du gnas par mi bya'o/ / ji lta zhe na/ bzhon pa mi srun bzhin zhes bya ba yin te/ dper na rta la sogs pa'i bzhon pa mi srun pa la bzhon du mi rung ba dang mtshungs so/ / 'dis ni zur gyis bzhon pa mi srun pa la yang zhon par mi bya'o zhes ston pa yin no/ /

sbrid pa ni sbrid pa 'byung ba'o/ / gad mo ni dgod pa'o/ / glal ba ni bya rmyang ste/ de la kha gdangs par mi bya'o zhes pa ste/ kha mi dgab par mi bya'o/ / sbrid pa la sogs pa 'byung ba na lag pa'am gos kyis dgab par bya'o zhes pa'i don to/ /

skt: nadī-saritaṃvāhṛbhyāṃ-yujābhyāṃ,na tarenna ṭhaṃghayet‌, makarakamīdibhirvighātabhayāt‌ | tathā'bhiskaṃdhamahāntamābharārai, nābhitrajet‌-na saṃmukho ganacchediti| sandgdhāṃ nāva-śithirbandhanāṃ, jajeritāṃ, pāragamanāsamarathām‌ ! tathā sandigdhavṛkṣaṃ-viṣādinirdhiṣṭha, debatādhiṣṭhitaṃ vā bhaṃruraṃ vā nārohet‌-tayorupari na tiṣṭhet‌ | kathaṃ duṣṭayānavat‌ | yathā~duṣṭe yāne'śvādike, evaṃ bhaṅgayā tasyāpyārohaṇaṃ niṣiddha bhavati
tib: sna brud cing shas cher gnod par mi bya ste/ shu ba dang thor bu la sogs pa'i gnod pa spang bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ / don med cing dgos pa 'ga' zhig med par sa la sor mo la sogs pas de la 'dri zhing drud par mi bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /

lus kyi yan lag lag pa dang rkang pa la sogs pa gcu ba ste/ mi mthun par byas nas bya ba'i las mi bya'o/ / 'di dag gis ni lag pa dang rkang pa'i rnam par 'gyur ba spang bar bya'o zhes ston pa yin te/ gzer dang yan lag chag par 'gyur ba'i nyes pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du tsog tsog por gnas te 'dug par mi bya ste/ tsog tsog por gnas pas yun ring por 'dug na/

lus dang ngag dang yid kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba las su bya ba ni snga nas te/ ngal bar ma gyur pa'i dang po nyid nas bzlog par bya ste/ ji tsam gyis shin tu dub par ma gyur pa de tsam na bshol bar bya'o/ / des ni 'di skad ston pa yin te/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis 'gro ba dang / bklags pa dang / sems pa la sogs pa'i las rnams ni ji srid shin tu dub par ma gyur pa de srid kyi bar du bya'o zhes pa'i don to/ / pus bsgreng yun ring gnas mi bya/ / mtshan mo shing drung bsten mi bya/ / zhes bya ba ni pus mo gyen du bsgreng ba gang yin pa de ni pus bsgreng zhes bya ste/ gan rkyal du 'dug nas pus mo brkyang ste/ yun ring du gnas par mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du mtshan mo shing chen po dag tu gnas shing bsten par mi bya'o/ /

skt: tathā-catvarādīn‌ naktaṃ na seveta| catvaratripathamāduḥ | casaraḥ-radedāvireṣo nagarādamāmādrhi maya yo bhavapi yatra nagaranivāsino prāmanivāsino vā svaireṇāgadaya nānāvidhāḥ kathāstāstādhint‌yanti sa catvara iti | keciccailayāntaśraiyasarmāpi, catuṣpatha catvāro mārgāḥ yatraikīmavanti | surāṭhyo devagṛhama | sūnādikaṃ divāpi na seveta | sūnā-yātanāsthānam‌ | aṭavī-araṇyam‌ | śūlyayūṣanijanamandiram‌ | smaśārna-rabadāhasthānam‌ | etāni divaḥpina seveta kita ratrau
tib: sum mdo la sogs par yang de bzhin du mtshan mo bsten par mi bya'o/ / de la sum mdo ni lam gsum 'dus pa la bya'o/ / de la la la dag gis phyogs gang du/ gang zhig grong ngam ljongs nas phyir byung ste/ gnad du grong na gnas par ram/ ljongs na gnas pa las rang dgar 'ongs te/ sna tshogs pa'i gtam de dang smra ba'i gnas la bya'o zhes 'dod do/ / mchod rten gyi drung ni mchod rten gyi nye 'khor ro/ / gzhi mdo ni gang du lam bzhi gcig tu 'dus pa'o/ / lha'i khang pa ni lha rnams kyi gnas kyi khang pa'o/ / gsod sa 'brog stong khang stong dang / / dur khrod du ni nyin mo'ang min/ / zhes bya ba ni gsod sa la sogs pa nyin mo'ang bsten par mi bya'o/ / de la gsod sa ni rkun po la sogs pa gsod pa'i gnas so/ / 'brog stong ni dgon pa'o/ / khang stong ni skye bo med pa'i khang pa'o/ / dur khrod ni ro bsregs pa'i gnas te/ 'di dag tu ni nyin par yang bsten par bya ba ma yin na/ mtshan mo lta smos kyang ci dgos/

tib: rnam pa kun tu zhes pa rnam pa thams cad du nyi ma la blta zhing brtag par mi bya'o/ / de yang gzhan dag las/ 'char dang nub par 'gyur tshe dang / / phyed dus gzugs brnyan rtog pa dang / / gos kyis bsgribs par byas pa las/ / nyi ma blta bar mi bya'o/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de bzhin du mgo bo ste/ / spyi bos khur bskur bar mi bya zhing /

shin tu phra zhing blta dka' ba dag la rtag par rgyun tu blta zhing brtag par mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du 'tsher ba ste/ me la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang shin tu 'tsher zhang gzi mdangs dang ldan pa la blta bar mi bya'o/ / mi gtsang ba ni btsog par gyur pa ste/ bshang gci la sogs pa ste/ de la yang mi blta'o/ / mi sdug pa ni mngon par mi dga' zhing sdang bar gyur pa la blta bar mi bya'o/ / chang 'tshong ba dang sbyor ba dag /

skt: purovātādīn‌ pumān‌ yajet‌ | pūaisyāṃ diśi āgataḥ ātapo'kaikhantāpaḥ | rajo-dhūkiḥ | tuṣāraṃ himam‌ | paruṣānikhśaṇḍo vātaḥ } acruḥ-vakraḥsan‌, vathvādikāsyajet‌ | kṣavathudchakṣā | udrāra-ūvaṃ cātasya pravṛttiḥ kasanaṃ-kāsaḥ | khapno-nidrā ! annasāhāropayogaḥ | yaithuna̭-vyavāyaḥ | kaṭhacchāyānadīsamīpe śvabhracchāyā | carapadviṣṭho-rājñaḥ śatruḥ | vyāro-siṃhādayaḥ| daṃṣṭriṇaḥ sapāḥ | viṣāṇino-mahiṣādyā: | hanādīnāṃ sevāmāśrayaṃ tyaje | dīno'kurakhīnaḥ kukhācārādibhiḥ | anāryo'sādhuḥ | atinipūṇa. kukācārādīnāmalayantamādase yasya durāśrayatvāt‌ | sandhyāsbhyavahārādīn‌ vyajet‌ | abhyav‌hāso-mojanam‌ | sakhrī-yoṣit‌ | svapno-nidrā | adhyathanaṃ-anthaṃpāṭhaḥ | cintṃ-śtādau bhūyaḥsmaraṇam‌ | dadvata^ satrārdānāmaścanamannaṃ tyajet‌ | dātraḥ-ariḥ | yajñāṣanamabhiṣṭomādiyajñāśanam‌ | kasigādīn‌ varjayitvā | anyasya tadadānāt‌ pāpaṃ saṅkramate ¦ yato yajñānte tadudbhūtapāpakṣapaṇārtha̭ṃ̱prāyadhittaṃ śruyate | gaṇākarīṇainhugaṇādhyapitam‌| raṇaiḥ kathakacāraṇairvā vyāpm‌ | gaṇikā-vedyā, tatsambandhi yadaśānaḥ tadri nādāt‌, pāparsakramaṇāt‌ | paṇiko-vaṇikṛ, tadaśanaṃ pāpasaṃkramaṇāt‌ tyajet‌ } tathā gātravakranakheraṅgasukhakasamaiṣaudayaṃ yajet‌ | hastakeḍānāṃ cāvadhūnarna kampana cālanaṃ tyajet‌ | toyābhipūjyeṣu saṅilvahipūjanīyeṣu madhye yānaṃ gamanaṃ tyajet‌ | pūjyā guvadiyaḥ dhūmaṃ śavāśrayaṃ mṛtakaṅarīrajātaṃ syajet‌ | tathā madayādisakti madadūtaslīviṣayātisākte punaḥ punarāsevahe tyajet‌ | tathā sakhīṣu nārsaṣu viśrabhaṃ syātancyaṃ viśvāsādhikyāṃ tyajet‌ parideraditi
tib: mdun gyi bser bu la sogs pa skyes bus spang bar bya'o zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ / de la mdun gyi bser bu ni shar phyogs nas ldang ba'i rlung ngo / / nyi tshan ni nyi ma'i than pa'o/ / rlung ni rdul gyi tshogs so/ / ba mo ni ba mo lhags pa'o/ / rlung rtsub pa ni rlung drag pa'o/ / sgregs pa ni rlung gyen du rgyu ba'o/ / lud pa ni lud pa lu bar gyur pa'o/ / zas ni zas la spyod pa'o/ / nyal po ni 'khrig pa spyod pa ste/ de dag gcus shing yon por gyur pa mi bya bar spang bar bya'o/ / gad ka'i grib ma ni chu bo'i 'gram gyi gad ka'i grib ma'o/ / rgyal po sdang ba ni rgyal pos dgra ba'o/ / sbrul gdug ni mche ba gdug pa can no/ / gcan gzan ni seng ge la sogs pa'o/ / rwa can ni ma he la sogs pa'o/ / dus mtshams thams cad du zas la spyod pa la sogs pa yang spang bar bya'o/ / bud med ni de dang nyal po bya ba'o/ / nyal po ni gnyid log pa'o/ / klog pa ni gzhung 'don pa'o/ / sems las ni thos pa la sogs pa yang yang du dran par bya ba'o/ / dgra bo'i nar ma'i zan la sogs pa yang spang bar bya ste/ nar ma'i zas zhes bya ba ni/ me lha bstod pa'i cho ga la sogs pa'i dus su ster ba'i zan te/ mdun na 'don la sogs pa ma gtogs par gzhan dag gis de zos na/ sdig pas gos par 'gyur bar 'dod de/ gang gi phyir mchod sbyin rdzogs khar de las byung ba'i sdig pa zad par bya ba'i phyir/ nyes pa 'chags pa las 'go bar 'gyur ro zhes zer ro/ / tshogs 'dus ni skye bo mang pos bstan pa'o/ / yun du tshogs te gtan du zlos par byed pa mang po 'dus par byed pas khyab pa'o/ / smad 'tshong ni 'phyon ma ste/ de dang 'brel pa'i zas gang yin pa de yang bza' bar mi bya ste/ sdig pas gos par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / tshong pa ni nor bsgyur mkhan te/ de'i zas kyang sdig pas gos par byed pa yin par 'dod pas bza' bar mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du lus dang / mchu dang sen mo ste/ yan lag dang kha dang / lag skyes kyi sgra 'byin pa yang spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du lag pa dang / skra sprugs shing bskyod pa yang spang bar bya'o/ / chu me mchod bya'i bar du 'gro/ / zhes pa ni chu dang me dang mchod par bya ba dag gi bar du 'gro zhing / song ba yang spang bar bya'o/ / mchod bya ni bla ma la sogs pa'o/ / ro bsregs pa la brten pa'i dud pa ni/ mi ro bsregs pa las byung ba'i dud pa yang spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du chang la sogs pa la chags pa ste/ chang dang / rgyan po dang / bud med dang / yul gzhan dag la chags shing yang nas yang du bsten pa yang spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du bud med la yid rton pa dang / rang dbang du bya ba'i yul de spang bar bya'o/ /

skt: dhīmato buddhimataḥ savaiceṣṭāsu savaikriyāu loka eva vidiṣṭaloka ācārya upadeṣṭā! ato'smatkāraṇāttameva viśiṣṭalokamevātukuryāt‌ ! tatsadaṭarāme. vācāra kuryāt‌ | yo laukike'thaṃ parīkṣakaḥ parīścapūrvakārī heyopadeyarūpaṃ sobhanāśobhanaṃ jānāti |5daḥ

skt: katavo-baṣīdyaḥ vapīrāraddhemantākhyāstrayaḥ dakṣiṇāyanaṃ sūaisya dakṣiṇadigagamanam‌.) sa ca kā sthnim‌ visagāṣyaḥ; saumyaśca yasmādādānakāṭagarahachachataṃ kṣu` pitaṃ baraṃ sāraṃ caraṇāṃ pratidinaṃ bhagavān‌ sadakhadīdhitiḥ dīdhitībharaiḥ punavijati dadāsyato visarjanāṣaṭisargo'nvadhasajño'satau kāṭhaḥ saumyatvāt‌ kālasya saumyaśūpasvādatra visargākhye kāṭhe yasmat‌ soaśvandrau balavān‌ ucchṛṣṭaśaktidīyave raviḥ | tadānīṃ hīnakaktimāluḥ saṃpadyate, dīnasāktitavaṃ cāsya praca somaradimābhaiḥ śītasvabhataviḥ criyate bhārausvabhāvāca
tib: lho phyogs su 'gro ba zhes bya ba ni nyi ma lho phyogs su 'gro ba'o/ / de'i dus ni dbyar la sogs pa yin te/ dbyar dang / ston dang / dgun stod ces bya ba ni gsum mo/ / dus de ni slar bskyed pa zhes bya ba dang / bsil zhing zhi ba zhes bya ba yin te/ gang gi phyir nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi stobs 'phrog pa'i dus su mi rnams kyi stobs kyi bcud 'phrog cing zad par byed pa ste/ slar gtong zhing skyed par byed pa yin te/ de bas na 'di ni slar gtong ba yin pas na/ don dang mthun pa'i ming du dus 'di la skyed pa zhes bya'o/ / slar bskyed pa'i dus 'dir ni bsil zhing zhi ba yin pas zla ba stobs dang ldan zhing nus pa che ba yin la/ des ni nyi ma 'bri ba yin te/ de'i tshe nyi ma'i stobs chung bar 'gyur ba yin te/ 'di'i nus pa 'bri ba na/ zla ba'i stobs 'phel bas bsil bar byas pa dang / lho phyogs su 'gro ba'i lam gyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /

skt: ihāsmin‌ kāṅe visagakhye snigdhā rasākhayo'mṭachavaṇasadhusaḥ svapratyayotpannā mahābhūtānāsū nādhikamvena de balinaḥ saṃpadyante | kāchasya sāsyalvāttā teṣatraṣaṭavātra vayaiṇāniedhotaiḥ śītaiḥ śītañca; śāntatāpe'pagatasavāpe mahītaṭe mūdeya satyatrāpi kavrahaṇamajuvakate | tena varṣavamṭo raso vī, śaradi--khvaṇo, demante-madhura hate
tib: 'dir ni zhes pa slar stobs bskyed pa'i dus 'dir snum pa dang / ro gsum po skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang / mngar ba mthu che zhing stobs bskyed pas rang gi nus pa gsal bar byed la/ 'byung ba chen po rnams che chung gi shas snyoms pas/ ro de rnams mthu che bar 'gyur ba yin no/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dus bsil ba'i phyir te/ char gyi tshogs 'bab pa dang / rlung bsil zhing grang bas sa'i steng gi tsha ba zhi zhing than pa dang bral bas mthu skye ba yin no/ / 'dir yang rim pa bzhin du sbyar bar bya ste/ dbyar ni ro skyur ba mthu bskyed pa yin la/

dgun ni grang ba'i dus te/ dgun stod dang dgun smad ces bya ba'o/ / che ba ni de'i tshe mi rnams kyi mthu stobs mchog tu che bar 'gyur ro/ / 'dir dgun zhes smos pas ni/ dgun stod dang dgun smad gnyi ga yin par shes par bya ste/ de'i tshe ni mi'i stobs shin tu che ba yin no/ / char dus dang / tsha dus ni dbyar dang so ga'i dus te/ de'i dus su mi'i stobs chung ba yin no/ / lhag ma ste/ ston dang dpyid dag la ni/ mi'i stobs 'bring zhing ran pa yin no/ / de la re zhig dgun gyi dus kyi spyod pa smras pa ni/ stobs ldan grang bas bkag pa ni/

tib: stobs zhes bya ba skyes bu'i me dgun gyi dus su stobs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ / de yang dgun ni slar stobs bskyed pa'i dus yun ring du bsags pa yin pas/ mi'i stobs bstan par gyur pa yin gyi/ dang po rtsom pa tsam gyis ni ma yin pas/ stobs 'phrog pa'i dus kyi stobs rdzogs pas/ de la gnod par mi nus so/ / de bas na dgun ni stobs mchog tu che bar grub pa yin no/ / de nyid kyis na dang po nyid du/ stobs ldan grang bas bkag pa ni/ / zhes smos pa yin te/ stobs ni 'di ltar byed de/ slar stobs bskyed pa'i dus su stobs bsags pas/ de'i tshe skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa yin la/ stobs de grang bas bkag pas mi smin par nus pa'i stobs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ / 'dir dngos po'i chos nyid ni 'di yin te/ pho ba'i me drod kyi tshogs gang yin pa ba spu'i bu ga rnams las phyir 'byung ba ni grang ba'i reg pas ba spu'i bu ga bkag pas nang du 'dus la/ nang du zhugs pa des rang gi me'i drod des pho ba'i me drod de nyid mngon par 'phel bar byed do/ / pho ba'i me drod 'phel ba des ci zhig byed ce na/ de ni rlung gis sbar bas na/ / zas nyung gyur na lus zungs skems/ / zhes smos pa yin te/ pho ba'i me drod de rlung gis sbar zhing bus pas/ zas nyung bar 'gyur zhing / de'i tshe kha zas legs par 'grangs par zos na dngas ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs rnams btsos shing skems par 'gyur ro/ / de bas na dgun gyi dus su ni me'i drod bsrung ba'i phyir/ kha zas legs par 'grangs par bza' ba nges pa kho nar bya dgos te/ pho ba'i me drod kyis zas kyi tshod lci ba 'ju bar nus pa yin gyi/ dus gzhan dag tu na de ltar ma yin no/ / de bas na zhes pa ni rlung gis pho ba'i me sbar ba na stobs can yin pa de las rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ / dgun ni kha ba 'bab pa'i dus dag tu mngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan tshwa'i ro bsten par bya zhing longs spyad par bya'o/ /

skt: niścānāṃ satrīṇāṃ dadhyāt‌ dīrghabhāvāt‌ etā `asminakāṭe prātareva pratyuṣasyeva bubhukṣitaḥ sajāta iva -bhotumicchan‌ naro'vadayakāya malotsaga̭daucaviradhaṃ dantadhāvanagaṇḍūṣādikam‌ | yathoktaṃ dinacayādhyāyo~ tam‌| sambhāvya nippāya kṛtvā'nu paścāt‌

vātnataṅaivītavyādhici kitsānidiṣaṭerabhyaṅkhaḥ mrakṣaṇaṃ śīkhyet‌ abhyasyāt‌ | tathā mūdhni śirasi teṃ rīkhyet‌ | vimadena vireṣeṇāṅgasya karābhyāṃ pīḍanam‌] niyuddhaṃ bāhuyudara uścherabhinnaiḥ chṛtābhyāseḥ sādhe saṃhaṃ tathā pādāghātaṃ pādābhyāṃ madanaṃ yuktito yuktyā yathā svajgadūṣaṇe romādivighāto notpadyate
tib: dgun gyi dus de'i tshe/ mtshan mo nam ring bas nang par te/ tho rangs kyi dus nyid du bkres shing zas 'dod par 'gyur ro/ / de bas na de'i tshe nges par bya ba zhes bya ba/ bshang gci dor nas gtsang sbra'i cho ga bya ba dang / so shing bca' ba dang / mkhur ba bkang ste dor ba la sogs pa ni nyin re spyad pa'i cho ga'i le'u las ji skad bshad pa rdzogs shing zin par byas la/ / de'i rjes la rlung 'joms shing sel ba'i til mar gyis rlung gi nad gso ba las bstan pa bzhin du byugs shing mnye ba bsten par bya'o/ / de bzhin du spyi bo ste/ mgor til mar gyis byugs pa dang / mnye ba ste khyad par du yan lag rnams lag pa dag gis mnye ba dang / bag yod pa ni mkhas shing goms pa ste/ de dang lhan cig lag pa'i stobs 'gyed pa'i tshul gyis mnye bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du rkang pas ran par mnye ba ste/ rkang pa gnyis kyi pags pa dang / spu la sogs pa la mi gnod par ran zhing ci rigs par mnye bar bya'o/ / de nas bska bas snum bsal la/ / cho ga bzhin du khrus dag bya/ / gur kum gla rtsi dang bcas pas/ / lus bskus a ka ru yis bdug /

skt: māṃsarasān‌ snigdhān‌ ṣṛtādisaṃyutān‌ 1 1 māṃsaṃ puṣṭaṃ bhṛ sīkhayet‌ tathā gauḍa guḍcharataṃmadyam‌ acaḥ sasaṃsurābhparaṃ ghanāṃ śīkhayetat‌|tathā godhūsavilaratī mo kāyaśca śīṭayet‌| śubhā hayāḥpiṣṭavikrutīḥ śārkhi evikrṛtī ḥ,pūpaṭhikāyā māṣaviṅkatīrbhakṣakarasādika| iṣṭhavikrṛtīḥ-pānakaguḍādhāḥ, kṣīravidtīḥ-kikhāṭaḥ dhikūcakācāstāḥ savauḥ rīlayet‌ | tathā-nabamanna varṣoṣitam‌ | basalāṃ-śuddhamāṃ sasyāmedurasya pakrasyapa yo haryate stehaḥ sa basārābdavācyaḥ } tathā āgamaḥ-“śuddhamāṃ sasya yaḥ snehaḥ sā vasā parika titā |'› tāṃ śīryeta | tailaṃ tiloddhavam‌| yathā-sa kārye snānādike sukhodakaṃ sa̱khopṇa pānī sīkhayet‌prāvārādimirāvṛtaḥpracchāetaḥ |māvār‌-vapa kambalam‌ | ajina̭-carama| kāśeyaṃ-paṭval‌ | praveṇī sūcīdhānam‌ | kaucavo-rāṅkavaḥ ! uṣṇaprāyaiḥ-romasi kāsvabhāvairaghubhiḥ tanubhiḥ prāvaraṇaiḥ parāvṛtaḥ; prakarṣe chāditaḥ pumān‌ śayanaṃ bhajet‌ | tathā yuktayā prayoge mādiṃ pariharan‌ arkakiraṇānādityaradamīn‌ bhajet‌ tathā svadaṃ tāpādibhedena yathāyogyaṃ catudharidhami bhajet‌ | pādtrāṇaṃ-pātraṃ svīsimin‌ kāṭhe'smidaraṃ bhajet‌ iti
tib: de ltar lus bkrus pa'i 'og tu sran chung gi phye ma la sogs pa rdzas bska bas snum bsal zhing med par byas la/ de'i 'og tu cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du zhes pa cho ga dang mi 'gal ba ste/ chu dron pos lus kyi smad bkru ba la sogs pa sngar ji skad bshad pa bzhin du lus bkru bar bya'o/ / de nas ni gur kum gla rtsi dang bcas pas lus bkru bar bya'o/ / de'i 'og tu skyes bu'i lus a ka ru'i bdug pas bdug par bya'o/ / sha tshon ni sha bzang po'o/ / khu ba ni sha khu'o/ / snum can ni mar la sogs pa dang ldan pa'o/ / de la bu ram chang ni bu ram las byas pa'i chang ngo / / chang dngas ma ni shin tu dngas pa'i chang ngo / / yang chang zhes smos pa ni yang de las gzhan pa chang bska ba dag btung ba'o/ / de bzhin du gro las byas pa'i khur ba dang la du la sogs pa bza' ba dang 'bras khur te/ 'bras btags pa las byas pa'i chang ngo / / chang ngam sha las byas pa'i bza' ba dang / kr-i sa ra la sogs pa'i bza' ba dang / 'o ma las byas pa'i phrum dang zho dang chur ba la sogs pa dang / bu ram shing las byas pa ste/ btung ba dang / bu ram la sogs pa ste/ de thams cad bza' bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du kha zas sar pa ni gsar thog las byas pa'o/ / zhag ni tshil med pa'i sha btsos te tshos pa dang / de'i steng na snum gang zhig 'byung ba de la ni zhag gi sgrar bshad do/ / de yang lung las/ tshil med sha yi snum gang yin/ / de ni zhag tu yongs su bsgrags/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / til mar ni til las byung ba yin no/ / de bzhin du dro 'jam chu ni ran par bsros pa'i chu ste/

de'i tshe skyes bus mal la brten par bya'o/ / ji lta bu zhe na be'u ras zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ be'u ras ni be'u phrug gam lwa ba dmar po'o/ / slag pa ni pags pa'i gos so/ / dar ni rgya las byung ba'o/ / sogs pa ni gos bzang po gzhan dag bsdu'o/ / dre'u rngog re'u bal can ni/ skyin la sogs pa'i spu las byas pa'o/ / rang bzhin dro ba ni phal cher spu dang ldan pa'o/ / yang ba ni phra ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ / de bgos pa ni de dag steng nas bgo ba dang / 'og tu bting ba'i mal stan la skyes bus brten par bya'o/ / de bzhin du nyi ma'i 'od la ran par zhes bya ba/ 'gro ba la sogs pa spangs la/ nyi ma 'di zhing bsten par bya'o/ / de bzhin du dugs te bsro ba la sogs pa'i dbye ba rnam pa bzhi dag kyang ci rigs par bsten par bya'o/ / de bzhin du lham zhes bya ba dus 'di'i tshe rnam pa thams cad du rtag par lham bgo bar bya'o/ /

de'i tshe chung ma gzhon zhing dar la bab pa dang / yid du 'ong zhing snying du sdug pa dang / nu ma dang brla dang ro smad kyi cha shas shin tu rgyas pa dang / spos kyis bdugs pa la sogs pas lus kyi drod kyis grang ba sel nus pa bsten par bya'o/ /

skt: aṅgārāṇāṃ tāpo'ṅgāratāpaḥ tena santaptaṃ garbhabhūvedama tadaṅgāratāpasetaptagamaṃbhūvedama tatra̱ caraṇaṃ dīṭnaṃ tasya jantoḥ rītapārapyajanitaḥrītaparuṣabhāvenotpanno doṣo jātu kadācana na jāyate utpadyate | yat‌ gṛhasyābhyantare gṛhai, bhūmigṛhaṃ yadbhi ni khanya kriyata dati
tib: sa khang ni gang sa brkos nas khang par byas pa'o/ / khang pa nyis rim ni khang pa'i nang du khang par byas pa'o/ / mdag me dag ni drod kyis bsros pa'i sol ba mdag mer lhags par byas pa'i drod kyis khang pa gang bsros par gyur pa der gnas shing spyod par byed pa'i skyes bu de la ni grang ba dang rtsub pa las byung ba'i zhes pa/ grang ba dang rtsub pa'i dngos po las gyur pa'i nyes pas gnod pa nam yang 'byung zhing skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ / da ni dgun smad kyi spyod pa bstan par bya ba'i phyir smras pa ni/

skt: adha riśiracthāmāha--ayameva dai-antiko vidheḥ ririre'pi kāle vidareṣato'tirāyena kāryaḥ karaṇīyaḥ | tena rasān‌ snigdharasān‌ demante rīlyedivyuktaṃ, śirire tenā'tirayena snigdhādīn‌ śīṭyedevamanyadapi ca -yādka'citsevanīyasveneoktaṃ ttasmin‌ kāke atiśayīkrutya : sarya śīranīyam‌ } tadā tasmin‌ kāle yasmāddhemantakāṭādapyādhekaṃ rītaṃ bharvati | kārusmabhāvāttayā raukṣyaṃ rakṣatam‌ ādānakāṭajaṃ tadopannaṃ kiñcit‌ saṃbhāvyamiti
tib: dgun stod kyi bya ba 'di nyid ni/ / dgun smad kyi dus su yang lhag par te/ khyad par du bya'o/ / des na snum pa dang / ro gsum po dgun stod kyi dus su bsten par bshad pa ste/ dgun smad kyi dus su shin tu snum pa bsten par bya la/ de bzhin du bsten par bya ba bshad pa gzhan gang dag yin pa de rnams de'i tshe lhag par shas che bar byas nas thams cad bsten par bya'o/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dgun stod kyi dus las kyang de'i tshe lhag par grang bar 'gyur ba ni dus kyi rang bzhin yin la/ de bzhin du stobs 'phrog pa'i dus las byung ba'i rtsub pa yang de'i tshe 'byung ba yin no/ / dpyid kyi dus kyi spyod pa dag bstan pa ni/

skt: vasantacayīmāh‌-diśābdo yasmādaratha| rita sāmānyād‌ dvāvapi sītasvamāvau hemantaridira gṛhītau boddhavyau | kaphaḥ-epmācitaḥ saṃciraḥ yataḥ śītakāṭhe śītākhye śirire kaṭe ca snigdhe payogāt‌ 1 tathā kāṭajena rītenādhikema styāna bhūto'pi vasantasamaye punaḥ prāpya rabikarasantāpe' tāpito vidīnatigrahatāṃ prāpitaḥ, udakamivādi pratipakṣo bhavatyasmājjāṭhasābh hatvā nivaupya rogā kuruta janayatīsyataḥ prāpramātra eva basanta tatka sīghra jamiva pravāhāthetuṃ setubhedādi bhakhyaissa kṇevemanādayupakranaijayedupakramettīkaṣṇadravyanippāditaiḥ epmaratipakṣe tathā ṭaghurukṣaimajayaistiktakapāyaḥ prāthairanaistathā vyāyāmādibhiḥ śaṣmāṇañuddhatasurya ' jitvā nighatyānantaraṃ snātaḥ kapūrīdibhiraluli syāt‌ pradigdhāṅgaḥ
tib: dgun zhes pa ni grang bar cha mthun pas/ dgun stod dang dgun smad gnyi ga yin par shes par bya'o/ / de'i tshe ni bad kan khong du sogs shing 'phel ba yin no/ / de yang gang gi phyir dgun stod dang / dgun smad kyi dus su snum bag la spyod pa dang / de bzhin du dus las byung ba'i grang bas 'di lhag par bsgongs par gyur pa dang / de dpyid kyi dus la bab pa dang / nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi tsha bas gdungs pa dang / gzugs zhu ba nyid du gyur nas/ chu ltar me'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs su 'gyur ro/ / des na pho ba'i me drod nyams par byas shing bcil nas/ nad skyed par byed cing 'byung bar byed do/ / de bas na dpyid kyi dus la bab ma thag bad kan chu'i tshogs ltar gnas pa de myur du zam pa lta bu'i skyug sman la sogs pas bad kan bdo ba bsal zhing bzlog par bya'o/ / de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs ni sman rnon po rnams gtang ba dang / de bzhin du yang ba dang rtsub pa'i kha zas te/ zas phal mo che kha ba dang / bska ba la sogs pa dang ldan pa bza' ba dang / de bzhin du bcag pa la sogs pas bad kan bdo ba bsal zhing bzlog nas/ de'i 'og tu khrus byas la/

tib: skyed mos tshal gyi nags tshal du 'dug la/ nyi ma phyed kyi dus su bde ba nyid kyis dus 'da' bar bya'o/ / ji ltar zhe na/ dga' 'dun gtam ni sna tshogs pa/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ dga' 'dun ni glu dang rol mo sna tshogs len pa dang / gtam ste snyan dngags kyi gtam sna tshogs pa bya bas so/ / gang du zhe na/ lho phyogs bser bus bsil ba dang / / zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ lho phyogs kyi rlung ni rjes su mthun par ldang ba'i rlung gang yin pa ste/ rdul dang bye ma dang gseg ma dang bcas par ldan pa ni ma yin te/ de lta bu'i rlung gis bsil bar gyur pa'i skyed mos tshal du'o/ / yang na lho phyogs nas ldang ba'i rlung ni bsil ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du mtha' ma kun tu chu 'bab pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa'o/ / de bzhin du/ nyi ma'i 'od ni mi snang dang / / zhes pa ste/ ji srid nub pa de srid kyi bar du nyi ma mi snang ba ste/ de ltar shin tu stug pa'i nags tshal der ro/ / yang na phyogs la la ni mi snang zhing cung zad snang la/ la la ni rnam pa thams cad mi snang bar gyur pa'o/ / de bzhin du/ nor bu bcag 'dra'i mdangs ldan pa/ / zhes bya ba ste/ bai DUr+ya la sogs pa'i nor bu bcag pa lta bu'i 'od dang ldan pa gang yin pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ / de bzhin du/ khu byug snyan pa'i sgra sgrogs shing / zhes bya ba ste/ skyed mos tshal de la khu byug rnams sgra sgrogs shing ca co 'don pa dang / de bzhin du/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod ldan pa'i sa/ / zhes pa ste/ sna tshogs pa'i gzugs yid du 'ong ba dang / 'dod pa'i yul du ma dang ldan pa'i nags tshal lo/ / de bzhin du/ sna tshogs me tog ldan pa'i shing / / zhes bya ba ste/ sna tshogs shing tha dad pa'i ste/ me tog dang ldan pa'i shing du ma dang / de bzhin du dri zhim pa ste/ yid du 'ong ba'i dri 'byung ba'i tshul can gyi skyed mos tshal du nyi ma phyed pa'i dus bde bar bya'o/ /
de'i tshe lci ba nas skyur ba'i bar ni bad kan 'phel bar byed pa yin pas de'i phyir spang bar bya'o/ /

tib: nyi ma ni 'od zer stong ldan no/ / de ni so ga'i dus su tsha bar 'gyur te/ stobs 'phrog pa'i rang bzhin mthar thug pa'i dus yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de ni 'phrog pa dang 'dra bar ston pa yin te/ sngar rnam par dpyad pa'i las gzhan dag bya bar rigs pa ma yin no/ / de bzhin du bsil ba'i yon tan dang / 'gro ba'i snum pa dag kyang 'phrog pa 'dra ba nyid yin no/ / de bas na de'i tshe lan tshwa sna tshogs la sogs pa yang spang bar bya ste/ de ni stobs sel bar byed pa yin no/ / de tshe zhes bya ba 'dis ni/ 'di skad ston pa yin te/ dman zhing shes chung ba'am/ log par gyur pa'i tshe/ lan tshwa la sogs pa spang bar mi bya'i rang gi mtshan nyid ji lta bu dang ldan pa de'i tshe bya ba yin no/ / de la tsha ba ni na le sham la sogs pa'o/ / skyur ba ni dar ba skyur ba dang skyur po la sogs pa'o/ / rtsol ba ni lus dub par byed pa'i las rnams so/ / nyi ma'i 'od zer ni nyi ma tsha ba'i 'od de de dag spang bar bya'o/ / de nas dus de'i tshe ci zhig bsten par bya zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/

tib: chu shing gi 'bras bu dang / / rgya star gyi 'bras bu'i dum bu dang bsre ba dang / skyur bcas zhes bya ba ni/ se'u dang skyu ru ra la sogs pas ro skyur bar byas pa'o/ / kham phor snod kyis zhes bya ba ni/

ni/ pad+ma'i rtsa ba gzhon nu'o/ / pad+ma'i me tog ni pad+ma'o/ / ut+pa la ni ut+pa la sngon po'o/ / gzhan yang ci lta bu zhe na/ me tog rgyas te me tog gi yal ga dgod pa lta bu dang ldan pa gang yin pa der ro/ / yang me tog rgyas pa ni/ lo 'dab kyi mtha' mar me tog cung zad rgyas pa dang ldan pa der/ nyi ma phyed kyi dus su nyi mas gdungs pa na nyal bar bya'o/ / chu yi khang pa ni/ / bud med bcos gzugs nu ma lag /

yang na nyi ma phyed kyi tsha bas gdungs pa'i dus su chu'i khang par nyal bar bya'o/ / de yang bud med bcos ma zhes bya ba ste/ shing las bud med kyi gzugs byas la/ khong du chu drangs te de'i nu ma dang / lag sor dang / kha las pu shel tsi dang sbyar ba'i chu 'bab pa'i drung du 'dug cing des reg par bya'o/ /
mtshan mo'i dus su khang steng gi yang thog rdo thal gyis byugs shing / zla ba'i 'od kyis bsil zhing khyab

skt: kāyamāne veṇvādinippādite vedamaviśeṣe sugandhinā kūrādipāśmikhalagarena himena śītaṭena cāriṇā toyena sicyamānā''drīkriyamāṇā parānāmāṣa; paikithasya tasmistathāvidhe tathocite cūtapravāṭapharṭumbibhiḥ cūtā ācrāḥ pravākhāḥ pravārusadarā abhinavā pahanā: pravākhāśca phalakāni ca cūtasya ravāṭaphalāni cṛtapravāraphalāni teṣāṃ chumbā; saṃghātāste vidyante yeṣāṃ te prabāruphalaṭaṭumbibhiḥ teśite samantādrathāpre kāyamāne kiṃ teṣu vaneṣu

tathā kāmayamāne evameva sayyāṃ vinā svapyān‌, uta rāyyāyāmata āha-karpite tasme racite sayane| ṭhaiḥ: kadalīdakhādibhiḥ| komadaiḥ-mūdubhiḥ | kadasyā data ti kadarchapitrāṇi | kahāro-gandhasomakaḥ, mṛṣā khāni komachānyabhinavāni bisāni kamaṭamutp cīroslam‌ , anyacca kiṃbhūte hasanta iva kusuma havāḥ puṣpapalāścā yasmin‌ tathābhūte | jathavā dame nti kuumāni kicit‌ ehāni pahavapayainte yagaya talpasya tasmin‌ śvapyāditi athavāṃ ghārāguḥḥ svapyāt‌
niśāsu rātriṣu saudhapṭha-harmyamūdhi niśākarakarākīrṇe candramaso radimabhivyatari svapyāt‌ śayīta | āsanā āsyā hamdhemastake rātrau śasyate
tib: mal stan bde ba bting nas khang steng du 'dug pa ni/ mtshan mo bsngags pa yin la/ de bzhin du sems bde ba ste/ sdug bsngal gyi gdung ba med pa dang / de bzhin du tsan+dan lde gu ste/ tsan+dan gyi lde gus lus byugs pa dang / phreng ba thogs pa ste/ me tog gi phreng ba rnams kyis brgyan pa dang / de bzhin du/ rab tu phra ba'i gos bgos shing / / zhes bya ba ste/ / shin tu phra zhing srab pa'i gos bgos pa dang / de bzhin du/ 'dod pa'i rgyun las ldog par bya/ / zhes bya ba ste/ bud med nyal po byed pa spang zhing 'khrig pa mi bya ste/

dus 'di'i tshe na/ ta la'i rlung yab la sogs pa snyom zhing tsha bas zhum pa sel bar byed pa yin no/ / de la ta la'i bsil yab spos chus btab pa ni/ shing ta la'i lo ma spos chus sbangs shing brlan par byas pa'am/ yang na ta la'i bsil yab ces bya ba ni/ rma bya'i 'jug ma la sogs pa las byas pa'i rdul yab tsha ba sel ba'i bya ba byed nus pa la bya'o/ / pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa ni/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma dag nyid rgyas pa bsil yab tu byas pa dang / rlung yab ces bya ba'i rma bya'i sgro las byas pa rlung yab nus pa'i rnam par byas pa dag gis te/ de dag dang dal gyis legs par g.yob cing / sgeg pa dang bcas pas gyen du bteg pa gang yin pa de ni dal gyis legs par g.yob pa'o/ / de bzhin du rdzi char ser bu dang ldan par byas te/ rdzi char dang ser bu bsil ba'i bya ba byed pa dang ldan par g.yob par bya'o/ / de bzhin du ga pur gyis bsgos pa'i mA li ka ni/ ga pur gyi mA li ka ste/ de'i phreng ba ni/ ga pur mA li ka'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'am/ yang na mA li ka khyad par can gyi phreng ba la de skad ces bya ste/ de gdags pa dang / de bzhin du mu tig do shal ni mu tig gi rgyan chun 'phyang zhes bya ba ste/ tsan+dan dkar po dang bcas par gnas pa la de skad ces bya'o/ / de bzhin du byis pa yid du 'ong bar smra ba dang / ne tso dang / sha ri ka la sogs pa sgra yid du 'ong bar sgrogs pa dang / de bzhin du chung ma gdu bu pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar ba thogs shing / pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa ltar bzhin ras shin tu mdzes pa de la 'di ltar blta ba ni/ pad+ma can ni 'gro ba 'dra/ / zhes bya ste/ pad+ma can gyi mtsho 'gro zhes pa lta bur blta zhing dga' ba bskyed par bya'o/ / dbyar gyi spyod pa smras pa ni/ / mthu 'phrog pa ni na ba'i lus/ / dman pa las kyang dman 'gyur te/ / dbyar ni gnod pas/

skt: varṣāsu doṣaiḥridirāthā rīṣmāntā ṛtavakha ādānakālāḥ| tenādānākhyena kālena gchānamapaci vapuḥrarīraṃ yaṣāṃ ta ādānamḍānavapuṣasteṣāmabhiḥ ra nno'pi pūraimeva mandaḥ punabharṣāsa̱ doṣaivītādibhiḥvu pitaiḥ sīdatyavadyaṃ sādaṃ yāti maṃdtavaṃ gacchati||39 de0--atha varpācaryā-sā ca cayapūrvake prakope yodhaacayapūrvake dāmanī | tatra sopapattikamubhayacaryāṃ sādha| raṇaṃ vidhatte-ysādhāraṇaṃ-sarvadopraharaṃ, yaccopmaṇastejanaḥ athidīpatatikaraṃ, tatsavaṃ vapu bhajet‌ | keṣu satsu teṣva cidoṣreṣnayonyadūpriteghu ṛtaparaspareṇa duparaṇeṣu sa sarveṣāṃ dutvātsarvaṃ sādhāraṇe bhajedityarthaḥ | kathamanyeonya dūṣaṇam‌ ityanena prakāreṇa ādanināvasannadehānāmabhrairā dedāvayavatvādavasanno'pi punardra; sīdati-mandatvalaśnaṇa du yāti
tib: dgun smad nas so ga'i bar dus gsum po ni/ mthu 'phrog pa'i dus yin te/ mthu 'phrog pa'i dus des na zhing nus pa 'bri ba'i lus gang yin pa de ni/ mthu 'phrog pa na ba'i lus su shes par bya'o/ / de'i mi dman pa las sngar dman zhing zhen par gyur pa las kyang yang dbyar gyi nyes pa rlung la sogs pas 'khrugs shing zhum pas dman pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ / gnod 'gyur te/ / mkha' la sprin 'dus chu yis brlan/ / chu thigs bcas pa'i rlung dang ni/ / grang ba drag por ldang ba dang / / sa yi rlangs pa skyur min dang / / chu ni rnyog pa can dag gis/ / me drod chung bas gnod par byed/ / ces bya ba ni/ nyes pa de dag gis gnod par 'gyur zhing / sdug bsngal bskyed pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ / gang gi tshe zhe na/ mkha' la sprin 'dus chu yis brlan/ / zhes bya ba ste/ chus rgyas pa'i char sprin mkha' la 'dus par gyur pas/ gang chu thigs phra mo dang bcas pa'i rlung grang mo drag cing shugs che bar ldang ba dang / de bzhin du sa'i rlangs pa byung zhing khug rna byung ba dang / de bzhin du chu skyur ba'i rnam par smin zhing mthu skyed pa dang / de bzhin du chu rnyog par bcas shing dri ma yod pa dag gis/ me'i drod chung bar byed pas nyes pa de 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /

phan tshun gcig la gcig gnod par byed pa'i ngang tshul can gang yin pa de ni phan tshun gnod pa ste/ gcig la gcig gnod par byed pa ni rang gi ngo bo las nyams par byed pa yin no/ / tshul 'dis na phan tshun gnod pa dag la ni rlung la sogs pa'i thun mong gi nyes pa gsum char sel bar byed pa'i bza' ba dang btung ba dag sman la sogs pa bstan cing goms par bya'o/ / de yang dro zhing pho ba'i me drod skyed par byed pa/ tsha ba lnga la sogs pa bsten par bya'o/ / sbyang bas lus ni dag byas la/ / zas ni yang bag khu ba bza'/ / skam sa'i srog chags sha khu dang / / sbrang rtsi can ni rnying pa btung / / zhes bya ba ni slon sman la sogs pas lus dag par byas shing / nad la sogs pa bsal ba la brten par bya'o/ / de bzhin du zas yang ba ste/ gsar thog dang khu ba ste sha khu la sogs pa dang sbyar ba bza' bar bya'o/ / skam sa'i srog chags kyi sha dang khu ba ste/ sran mung+ga la sogs pa sbyar ba'i khu ba'o/ / sbrang rtsi ni sbrang rtsi las byas pa'i chang gi khyad par te/
dar ba'am kha ru tsha sbyar ba ni/ lan tshwa kha ru tsha zhes pa dang ldan pa'o/ / de bzhin du tsha ba lnga'i phye ma can nam/ yang na khron pa'i chu'am/

skt: tāsu vaṣausvapādcārī syādyathoktaḥ reṇusukhya bhiḥ surabhiḥ sugandhakāyo'gurakūra kukumādibhirdiga dehaḥsyāta | satataṃ--sataikāraṃ, varāguvīdibhirṣūpiḥ vāsaḥ syāt‌ | hamya̭ṛṣaṭhe gṛhamastake bāppādivaśji vaset‌ | vāppamūpmā, śīkarā--jakhkaṇāḥ
tib: shin tu char ches shing yul rmus pa'i dus su bza' ba'i kha zas ni/ rab skyur lan tshwa snum dang bcas/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ shin tu skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang bcas pa'i kha zas gang yin pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ / skam pa ni phal cher skam po dang bcas pa'o/ / sbrang rtsir ldan pa ni sbrang dang bcas pa'o/ / yang ba ni rang bzhin gyis yang ba'am/ tshod zin par bza' ba ste/ de lta bu dag bsten par bya'o/ / de yang dus 'di'i tshe ni lus zungs rnams shin tu sla bar gnas pa de bas na sla bas na bsrung ba nyid kyi/ / sbrang rtsi'i nus pa der thim par 'gyur bas/ sbrang rtsis rlung skyed mi nus so zhes sman dpyad kyi lung 'chad pa rnams zer te/ de yang / rlung can rlung ni 'khrugs byed kyang / / dbyar ni sbrang rtsi bsngags pa yin/ / zhes smos pa yin no/ / rkang gis mi 'gro dri zhim byugs/ / rtag tu gos ni spos kyis bdug / khang steng du ba mo bsil/ / char gyi zer sbangs gnas par bya/ / zhes bya ba ni dbyar gyi dus de'i tshe rkang gis 'gro bar mi bya zhing / ban glang mo la sogs pa'i bzhon pa brtan zhing mtho bas 'gro bar bya'o/ / dri zhim byugs zhes bya ba ni/ ga pur dang gur kum la sogs pas lus la byugs pa dang / dus rtag tu gos la sbos kyis bdug pa dang / / a ka ru la sogs pa'i bdug pas gos la bdug cing bgo bar bya'o/ / khang steng zhes bya ba ni khang thog ste/

dbyar gyi dus der chu bo rnams kyi chu dang phyer sbyar ba la/ mar dang bcas pa mi btung ngo / / de bzhin du nyin par gnyid log pa dang / rtsol ba ste drag shul gyi ngal bag dang / nyi tshan te nyi ma'i 'od zer spang zhing dor bar bya'o/ /

skt: rārcaryāmāh-'“dāradi vyauma śubhaṃ kiśviyaṅkāṅkitā mahī} prakāśakāśasaptāhakukhudārākiśchinī || viśadhipratīkṣṇakiraṇo medhaughaviṣamādrāviḥ | vadhuvarṇātivimaṭāḥ kara camāṭāṅukhā viśaḥ| | ntassakīnamīnadaisādiṣaṣṭitaiḥ | taragabhaṅgatuṅgāni sasi vimalā ca 112? varṣīrītocitāṃgānā-pābrapi śītasārabhyakaśaṣayīrāṇāṃ sadasaivaṃ salaṭityeva śaradi rāpnāyāmakaradimarbhādcamābhistaparānāṃ puṃsāṃ vṛṣṭo varṣāsu saṣvitakhadhāmnyeva rāddhaṃ gataṃ pittaṃ kupyati, svara" katyādhikyena svasthānāt‌ sthānāntaraṃ gasvopatāpaṃ karoḥ syasāghujanavaditi ! atastajjayāya pittanivāraṇīya ghṛtaṃ tiktaṃ kuṣṭhoktaṃ prayojyaḥ vireko-virecanaṃm‌ } ramo sādibhiḥ kāyama ma ṭha kalamā eta kāḥ kavinmūre'pi dyante! tatoraktamokṣaṇa̱ pittādhārvāhe2--atha śaraccaryā-sā ca caya yapṛke śamanī | tatra sopapattikaṃ yodhana pa pte -yapaula sātaṃ pitta vārdhikagītasakhatmyadarīrama duṃ saradayakararimabhiḥ saṣyaiva naptānāmanācvara yi atastasya pittasya samarāya vi | pe tsitauktaṃ canaṃ kadāṃ kībhye modhraṇam‌ } 4 || tikta khāda kāyaṃ ca śudhitī'nanaṃ bhajadagha 4 rālimudrasitādhāsīpaṭāṭapnadhu bhogyam‌ | 86 cadhitamrahaṇamatibumudhitagratipādanāpaḥ, | anupatya bhojanādhikārābhāvāt‌ | kiṃ tacatiktādariyuṇayunaḥmivyāh‌ | rārīvyādi | śāvyāradīn‌. matta bhajan‌
tib: dbyar lus bsil bar gyur cing char gyis grang ba'i bdag nyid can du gyur pa la/ 'phral du zhes pa'i mod la/ ston gyi dus la bab pan nyi ma'i 'od zer tsha ba rnams kyis gdungs shing / dros par gyur pa'i skyes bu la ni char 'bab tshe na/ zhes pa dbyar gyi tshe na bsags shing rang gi gnas su 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i mkhris pa ston ldang bar 'gyur te/ rang gi nus pa lhag pas rang gi gnas nas gnas gzhan du song ste/ skye bo mi srun pa ltar gnod par byed par 'gyur ro/ / de bas na mkhris pa de bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ sman mar kha bo ru rta dang sbyar ba bsten pa dang / bkru sman gtang zhing khrus bya ba dang / /

nam bkres par gyur pa na/ bza' ba'i rnam pa kha ba dang / mngar ba dang / bska ba dang / yang ba bsten zhing bza' bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du 'bras sA lu'i chan dang / mung+ga ste/ mon sran sde'u dang / sha ka ra dang / skyu ru ra dang / sbrang rtsi dang / skam sa nas skyes pa'i srog chags kyi sha dang / pa to la'i tshod ma bza' bar bya'o/ /

yang ston ka'i dus de'i tshe/ nyin mo nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis gdungs shing rnam pa thams cad du tsha bar gyur pa dang / mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsil zhing grang par byas pa ste/ de ltar dus kyis bcos shing smin par byas pa dang / r-i Shi shar bas dug med par shes pa/ skar ma r-i Shi zhes pa shar ba na dug med pa ste/ de shar bas bar snang las 'bab bcing byung nas chu bo dang / rdzing bu la sogs par gnas pa'i gnod pa rnams ston gyi tshe dug med pa nyid du byed pas na de skad ces bya'o/ / khron pa'i chu ni ma yin te/ de ni thams cad du dug med pa yin no/ / dngas pa'i dri med chu zhes pa ni/ nyi ma dang zla ba dag la bya ste/ de gnyis kyis bsten cing dri ma med la rdul dang bral ba ni/ dri ma zhes pa rlung la sogs pa sel zhing 'joms par 'gyur ba yin no/ / mi 'brug ces bya ba ni chu mig ltar de snum zhing lci ba ma yin pas/ bad kan skyed par mi byed la/ 'brug pa ma yin pa nyid kyis na rtsub pa yin no/ / btung ba la sogs pa zhes bya ba ni/ tsan+dan u shir ga pur dang / / mu tig chun 'phyang phreng gos mdzes/ / khang rdo thal gyis dkar zhing / / zla zer can du mtshan gnas bya/ / zil pa thal sman ha cang 'grangs/ / zho dang til mar zhag nyid mtshan/ / mi bzad chang dang nyin par nyal/ / mdun gyi ser bu yongs su spang / / dgun dang dbyar ni dang po'i gsum/ / dpyid ni tha ma'i ro gsum bsten/ / so ga mngar ram ston ka ni/ / mngar dang kha dang bska ba bsten/ / mdor na zas dang skom dag ni/ / ston dang dpyid ni rtsub pa ste/ / so ga dbyar mthar bsil bar bya/ / gzhan dag tu ni de las bzlog / rtag tu ro kun bsten pa las/ / rang rang dus su lhag par bsten/ / dus gnyis thog mtha'i zhag bdun ni/ / dus mtshams yin par shes par bya/ / des ni snga ma'i cho ga spang / / 'og ma rim bzhin bsten par bya/ / ma spangs na ni nad 'gyur te/ / 'phral du nad ni 'ong bar 'gyur/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ / slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/

tib: dus su spyad par bya ba'i le'u bshad pa'i 'og tu/ nad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i le'u brtsams pa yin te/ de yang gang gi phyir ji skad du bshad pa'i dus su spyad par bya ba'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du/ rang rang gi dus su spyad cing nyams su blang ba la spyod par byed du zin kyang / bshang ba dang gci ba la sogs pa'i shugs bkag pas/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i nad 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin la/ de yang dus su spyad pa'i cho ga las gzhan du log par spyad pa dang 'dra ba yin te/ / de bas na 'di'i rtsom pa byas pa yin no/ / de la nad ni lus dang sems la gnas ba'i bye brag gis gnyis su bshad par bya ba yin la/ de rnams mi 'byung bar bya ba le'u gang na yod pa de bshad par bya'o zhes pa ste/ / 'di ni tha mal par nad med par gnas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ tha mal par gnas par gyur pa des nyin re spyad pa'i le'u las bshad pa'i bya ba'i cho ga nyams su blang bar bya ba dang / de bzhin du dus su spyad pa'i le'u las bshad pa rnams spyad do/ / de bzhin du nad 'byung bar 'gyur ba spang ba la ni/ rlung la sogs pa shugs bkag pa dang / nan kyis btsir ba la sogs pa yang mi bya ba las spyad par bya ba yin pas na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ phyi'i dbugs bshang gci sbrid pa dang / / bkres skom gnyid dang lud pa dbugs/ / glal dang mchil ma skyug pa dang / / khu ba'i shugs ni dgag mi bya/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ rlung la sogs pa'i shugs dgag par mi bya'o/ / ngal dbugs zhes bya ba ni/ ngal zhing dub pa las byung ba'i dbugs ni ngal ba'i dbugs te mi dgag pa'o/ / shugs zhes bya ba ni khu ba'i bar de dag 'byung ba la/ rjes su phyogs par gnas pa nyid ni shugs zhes bya ste/ shugs de dag dang 'brel ba de nan gyis dgag par mi bya'o/ / de la rlung ni gtso bor gyur pa yin la/ des na de bkag pa las byung ba'i nad ni shin tu bzlog par dka' ba'i nyes pa yod pas 'jigs pa dang por bstan pa yin no/ / de'i phyir smras pa ni/

skt: pāyudvāreṇādhovātasya sedhādagusmādayo jāyante | udāvataiḥ rakṛdādīnāmūṣyaigamanam‌| rakū`yam‌ | chamo-gāni : vātamūtryakaratāṃ saṅgo'pvṛttiḥ ` daṣṭatharanyoṣaidho vināśaḥ | dadrado--hṛdrogaḥ
