tib: shugs bkag pa dang btsir ba yis ni nad kun kyang zhes pa nad ma lus pa dag kyang 'byung zhing skye bar 'gyur te/ shugs bkag pa dag tu nad gang zhig smras pa de 'ba' zhig 'byung ba tsam du zad pa ma yin gyi/ rims la sogs pa gang yin pa ci yod pa thams cad skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni kyang zhes bya ba'i sgra'i don yin no/ / gang yang nad shin tu mang po yod pa de'i phyir/ gso zhing bcos pa'i cho ga'i dpyad 'dir bstan cing bshad pa yin no/ /

de las zhes pa ni shugs 'gags pa dang btsir ba las/ / phal cher zhes pa mang du/ rlung dag du mar zhes pa rnam pa du ma'i tshul gyis rab tu 'khrugs par 'gyur zhing / rnam par ldang bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa de'i phyir/ rlung des zas dang skom dang sman mnyam par 'gyur ba zhes pa/ rlung snyoms par 'gyur zhing lam log pa na gnas par rang gi mal la gnas par byed cing / gnod pa sel bar 'gyur ba de sbyar bar bya zhing spyad par bya'o/ /

skt: imān‌ punarvegāṃhobhādīnāṃ jitendriyo nare hitaiṣī ditepsuditamicchaḥ preya ceha ca idarokapara rokathorapi hitaiṣī savaidā sarvasmin‌ kāre dhārayet‌ kobho'nyasve spṛhayā | raipyā'kṣamā | dveṣaḥ prāṇin‌ deṣṭi | māssarya-massaratvam‌ | rāgasūyādiṣvabhiṃ khāṣaḥ | ādirahaṇādyakrodhadmmamadādīna grahaṇam‌
tib: yang skyes bu dbang po thul zhing 'di dang gzhan la phan par 'dod pas/ yang 'dod chen la sogs pa la zhugs pa'i shugs 'di dag rtag par dus thams cad du dgag par bya'o/ / de la 'dod chen ni gzhan gyi rdzas rnams la re zhing 'dod pa'o/ / phrag dog ni gzhan gyi rdzas phun sum tshogs pa la mi bzod pa'o/ / zhe sdang ni srog chags rnams la rab tu sdang ba'o/ / ser sna can ser sna nyid do/ / 'dod chags ni bud med la sogs pa la zhen pa'o/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni 'jigs pa dang khro ba dang / g.yo sgyu dang / dregs pa la sogs pa bsdu ste de dag gi shugs rnam par bkag cing dbang po thul ba'i rang bzhin can nyid du bya'o/ / dri ma rnams ni sbyang ba'i phyir/ / ci bzhin dus su nan tan bya/ / de ni shin tu sogs gyur na/ / shas cher 'khrugs pas srog rgyun gcod/ / ces bya ba ni rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan dang / bshang gci la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams sbyang bar bya zhing / rnam par bsal bar bya ba'i 'bad pas nan tan du bya'o/ / gang gi tshe zhe na/ ji bzhin dus su zhes bya ba ste/ dus las ma yol bar ro/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dri ma de rnams ni shin tu sogs shing rang gi gnas su 'phel bar gyur na/ lan 'ga' zhig na zas dang spyod lam gyi tshul gyis 'khrugs par 'gyur ba'i rgyu la brten nas gang gi tshe shas cher 'khrugs shing dkyel du gyur pa de'i tshe/ dri ma 'khrugs par gyur pas srog gi rgyun gcod par 'gyur zhing tshe 'phrog par byed par 'gyur ro/ / de bas na de rnams sbyang ba nyid du bya'o/ / 'di ltar shin tu bsags pa'i zil gyis mnan pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo ni sbyang ba'i phyir te/ gang gi phyir des shin tu myur bar 'gyur la/ phal cher sogs pa dag la ni smyung ba dang / gzhu bar byas pa yun ring por byas bas bsal te/ smyung ba dang gzhu bar byas pa dag / de bsal ba'i cho ga'i gtso bo dag yin no/ / de ltar na la lar ni sbyang ba gtso bo yin la/ la lar ni smyung ba dang gzhu bar bya ba dag go/ / la lar ni smyung ba nyid nad zil gyis gnon pa'i cho ga'i gtso bo yin la/ gang gi phyir de ltar yin pa des na/ gzhung 'di brtsams par rigs pa yin no/ / gnod pa smyung dang gzhu byas pas/ / bsal yang slar ni ldang srid kyi/ / gang zhig lags par sbyangs pa dag /

skt: dopāḥ-vānādūyo datamapāyapajināḥ santaḥ kadācita kutrācin‌ kṛbhyanti-da] santi | yeḥ punardopāḥ saconavamanādvaḥ pradhānayā ladāna dapu 31. doṣāṇāṃ bhavet‌ | chinnamṛṭanvān‌ pananta na :.rahunti | tammā chavanapācanayoḥ kratayorathi sanāvanamupakramaḥ kisutāṛtayoḥ | ṇva tāvahaṃ napācanavipaye snodhanamapyupakramaḥ | saṃyodhanavipave'pi deśakāle vaṃ śarīrādīnāmapeśṣaya chaghanapācane nipratyayopāttatayo-pakramaḥ kyaḥ
tib: rlung la sogs pa'i gnod pa rnams smyung ba bya ba dang / gzhu ba byas pas bsal zhing rgyal bar byas su zin kyang / nam zhig na slar sdang bar 'gyur ba srid kyi/ yang gnod pa gang zhig slon sman la sogs pas dag par 'gyur zhing / legs par sbyangs pa'i gnod pa dag pa'i gtsang bas dag pa de rnams ni slar yang 'byung zhing skye bar mi 'gyur te/ rtsa ba nas bcad pa yin pa'i phyir/ de rnams slar skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ / de bas na smyung bar byas pa dang / gzhu bar bya ba byas su zin kyang / sbyang ba bya dgos pa yin na/ ma byas pa la de'i tshe brtsam pa bya dgos par lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de ltar smyung ba dang smin cing gzhu bar byas pa dag la yang sbyang ba'i brtsam pa bya dgos pa yin no/ / sbyang ba'i gnas dag la yang yul dang dus dang / lus kyi stobs la sogs pa las dpags te/ smyung ba dang smin par bya ba rlung gis gnod par ma gyur pa'i tshul gyis brtsam pa bya dgos so/ / dus shes pa yis de phan chad/ / rim pa bzhin du ci rigs par/ / bcud kyis len rnams grub pa dang / ro tsa'i sbyor ba sbyar bar bya/ / zhes pa ni/ dus shes pa'i mkhas pas sbyar bar bya ba ste/ dus la sogs pa gang gis shes pa de ni dus shes pa yin gyi/ dus tsam ni ma yin no/ / de bas na yul dang / lus kyi stobs dang / zas dang / khu bcud dang / rang bzhin dang / snying stobs kyi tshul gang gis shes pa des/ de phan chad ces bya ba sbyang ba byas pa'i rjes thogs la/ rim pa bzhin du zhes bya ba/ ma 'chol bar thug pa la sogs pa'i zhag bdun gyi bar du byas nas/ de'i 'og tu lus kyi stobs mthar phyin pa thob pa dang / tha mal pa'i kha zas zos nas/ de'i 'og tu ci rigs par zhes pa/ rigs pa mi 'gal bar bya ba ste/ bcud kyis len 'di ni rlung gi rang bzhin can no/ / 'di ni bad kan gyi rang bzhin can no/ / 'di ni bad kan gyi rang bzhin can no zhes bya ba dang / bcud kyis len de yang grub pa ste/ grub pa'i drang srong dag gis bshad pa yin gyi/ rang bzo'i ci dga' bas khu bcud dang yon tan dang / nus pa'i mthu las dpags nas blo dang ldan pa'i sman ba rang nyid kyis/ yongs su brtags pa ni ma yin no/ / yang na grub pa zhes bya ba mang po'i mngon sum du gyur pas yid ches pa ste/ tshangs pa dang / gnas 'jog dang / ri byi dang 'pho byed kyis sbyar zhing longs spyod pa dag go/ / ro tsa'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba ni bud med la phod par bya ba grub pa rnams te de dag sbyar bar bya'o/ /

skt: nare bheṣajakṣapite vamanā bṛhaṇamādahārai staśāsyādebhi kamāt‌ krameṇa sahasā pathyaṃ hitaṃ; dīpanīyāni tāni bhaiṣañyānyauṣadhya jyāni ādraka-pippali-marica-ḥ saindhavādīni taiḥ saṃyogaḥ saṃra tasmāt‌ saṃyogāde rucipaktī dadya dyanti te tathāvidhāḥ| tanrābhyaṅgānaṃ nirūha ākhāpna, snehavastiranuva
tib: skyes bu sman gyis lus sbyangs shing skyug sman la sogs pas lus kyi nyams dmad pa la/ lus brta bar bya ba'i phyir/ sA lu rtsa snar la sogs pa'i zas rnams dang / bsku ba dang bcas pa la sogs pas rim gyis lus brta bar bya'i 'phral du ni ma yin no/ / phan pa zhes bya ba ni lus la phan par 'gyur ba'o/ / yid du 'ong ba yang ma yin la/ drod skyed pa'i sman yang yin pas na yid 'ong drod skyed sman te/ sge gsher dang / pi pi ling dang / na le sham dang / se'u 'bru dang / bi dza pu ra dang / dar ba rnying pa dang / lce myang tshal sogs pa ste/ de dang sbyar zhing 'dres pa'i kha zas gang yin pa de ni sbyor ba de las yig 'bye zhing 'ju bar byed la/ zas 'dod cing smin par byed nus pa ste brta ba dang / lus bsku ba la sogs pa ni grags par zad do/ / drag po ni bkru sman drag po mas gtong ba'o/ / 'jam rtsi gtong ba ni snum gyi sbyor ba mas gtong ba ste/ de dag gis brta bar bya'o/ / des ni me kun stobs ldan zhing / / blo mdog dbang po dri ma med/ / de bzhin tshe ring ro tse dang / / dpal dang gzi mdangs thob par 'gyur/ / zhes bya ba ni de ltar rnam pa de dag byas shing bshad ma thag pa'i bya ba rdzogs pa des na/ skyes bu de dpal dang gzi mdangs thob par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du me kun zhes pa/ lus zungs rnams kyi me'i drod kyi me thams cad dang / 'byung ba'i me rnams dang / pho ba'i me drod stobs dang ldan zhing gsal la smin par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de ltar na me bcu gsum smin pa'i nus pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du blo mdog dbang po dri ma med/ / ces bya ba ste/ blo gros dang / kha dog dang / mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rnams dri ma med cing dang bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du tshe ring ba ste/ lhag par 'tsho bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du ro tsa ba zhes pa khu ba rnam par 'phel bas/ bud med la phod par 'gyur ba dang / dpal dang gzi mdangs thob par 'gyur ro/ / 'byung po dug dang rlung dang me/ / mtshon rmas chag grugs sogs byung dang / / 'dod chags zhe sdang 'jigs sogs gang / / de ni glo bur nad ces bya/ / zhes bya ba ni nad 'di dag ni glo bur ba zhes bya ste/ / de yang gang 'byung pos mthong zhing zin pa dang / dug gis reg cing zin pa dang / gnod pa'i rlung dang / me dang mtshon gyis rmas pa dang / rdo la sogs pas yan lag chag grugs su gyur cing / nye bar bcom pa la sogs pa las byung bar gyur pa gang yin pa dang / de bzhin du 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / 'jigs pa dang / khong khro ba dang / mi bzod pa dang / brkam chags la sogs pa yid kyi nad du gyur pa gang dag yin pa ste/ de dag kyang glo bur ba'i nad ces bya ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /

skt: tathā tena prakāreṇānantaroktenāsevitena sa0-prakñāyā aparatra vāraṇāna nu satā pumān‌ dāma̭khmet‌ preyaḥ prāproti | tathā | yāṇaḥ| tadhadvisāṇā crugadīnānuvane sapā sarveṣāṃ pāvakānāṃ dhādvaśrīnāṃ jadaṭharātreśca pāṭavaṃ | 'tipravṛttānāṃ sadāmanamahubhya ja vipaye pravṛhanaḥ caṃ paṭusve pacanasāmarṇyaṃ chabheta | evaṃ trayodśānāmasnīnāṃ | manamaloṭupatavyathaḥ | tathā sṛniratītādhānummaraṇama pacanarāktirappathate | tathā dhīvarṇandiyanaimaṃsyaṃ-buddhi- | tathā deevyādi | daiādīnāṃ vijñānama | praḥ varṇacakṣurādīnāṃ nitaṃ kameta | tathā vṛpatāṃ-rukata- | bāhasyāt‌ khasaṃ sāmathyai chamate | dīṣaimāyuṣe jīvitasyādhikyaṃ ramaṃte }} 32 ||

te gadāḥ-saregā āgantavaḥ syuḥye bhūtasaṃdarau- śubhādyubharūpā smatevyā naktadinelayādivākyana dina naviṣaspadīvātāiśakhakṣatapāṣāṇāyaṅgabhaṅgaparahāravama- | cayodhyāyoktā | tathā ka daudibhyo bhaveyustathā rāgadaveṣamayakrodhāmarṣalomāthā | kanva uta ānūpaḥ sādhāraṇo ^ ta mānakhasti'pyāgantavo vyādhayaḥ syuḥ
tib: shes rab kyi nyes pa yin pas na/ shes rab nyes pa ste/ dam pa ma yin pa'i spyod pa byed cing / bkag pa rnams la spyod pa ste/ lha'i mig dang ldan pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis rnam par bkag pa'i yul dag sten par byed cing / bsgo zhing bstan pa'i don mi byed pa de lta bu'i shes rab kyi nyes pa yin te/ mdor na lus dang ngag dang yid kyi nyes pa spyod par byed ba'o/ / de spang ba ni mi byed par gtong zhing spang pa'o/ / dbang po nye bar zhi ba ni mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rnams mi dge ba'i rang bzhin can gyi yul la 'jug pa las ldog cing nye bar zhi ba'am/ yang na sgra la sogs pa'i yul la shin tu zhen pa las yang dag par sdom pa'o/ / dran pa ni sngar rjes su myong ba'i don yid la sems pa ste/ de yang dge ba dang mi dge ba'i tshul dran par byas nas/ len pa dang spong bar byed pa ste/ nyin dang mtshan du zhes bya ba la sogs pa rtag tu spyod pa'i cho ga las bshad pa'o/ / de bzhin du yul dus bdag nyid rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di/ ci yul 'di skabs dgon dung can yin nam/ rlan can yin nam/ 'on te cha mnyam pa yin/ ci rlung gi rang bzhin can nam/ 'on te mkhris pa'i rang bzhin can nam/ yang na bad kan gyi rang bzhin can yin zhes shes par bya ba dang / de bzhin du dus zhes pa ste/ ci 'di ni dgun stod yin nam/ 'on te dgun smad la sogs pa gzhan dag yin zhes pa dang / 'di ni skad cig la sogs pa'i dus yin no/ / zhes pa dang / 'dir phongs par 'gyur ba dag kyang gzung bar bya'o/ / bdag ces pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ nga'i rang bzhin ni 'di yin te/ 'di la ni ngas brten par bya'o/ / 'di la ni brten par mi bya'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa bdag nyid shes pa ni gcig yin no/ / gnyis pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i rang bzhin can yin zhes pa ste/ de med par 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nad gzhan dag gis bsal bar bya bar mi nus pas de shes par bya'o/ / dam pa'i spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug pa zhes pa ni/ dam pa rnams kyi spyod par gyur pa gang yin pa de'i rjes su 'jug cing slob la nyams su len pa'o/ / lhan cig skyes pa la ni lus las byung zhing / lhan cig skyes pa'o/ / glo bur ba ni 'byung po la sogs pa dang 'brel pa las skyes pa'o/ / de lta bu'i nad kyi rnam par 'gyur ba des ma skyes pa rnams mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir dang / de bzhin du lhan cig skyes pa dang / glo bur ba'i nad skyes pa rnams zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ cho ga 'di nyid mdor bsdus nas slob dpon gyis bstan cing bshad pa yin no/ / de bas na/ dri ma rnams ni sbyang ba'i phyir/ / ci bzhin dus su nan tan bya/ / zhes bstan pa yin no/ / 'o na dus gang zhig yin zhe na/ de'i phyir 'di smas pa yin te/

skt: ata idamāha-rītaśbdena demantaririrau ga daṇaṣāṇāṃ cayo doṣacayaḥ|sa ca rītoddhavaḥ sīte u janma yasya ta̭ doṣacayaṃ vasante virodhayan‌ niḥ tathā bhīṣmajaṃ doṣacayamabhrakāṭhe vapaukāle vido tathā vārṣikaṃ doṣacaryaṃ ghanātyaye ghanāpāye ?i dhayan‌ āḍu sīdha samyaka katavā śākhādiḥ vidhinā pravāhayan‌ ṛtujān‌. doṣānna jātu kadā puruṣaḥ prāprovyāsādayati | vasante vido rasyata prārambha eva caitre māsi pravāhayānniti = vyam‌ atipratyavāyabhayāt‌ | asyatudrayasaści doṣacayasya vidodhanatāṃ prāptasya kārāntayā kartuṃmarākyatavāt‌ | prīpmajamabhrakācha ityatrāpi : kāṭaprārambhamātra eva | nāsāditaṃ sītamārute tuṣā ghaniṣyandodbhūtavāte, ghanāsyaye vādhikamityatra 4 nāmasyayo'syantaghanavināśo yasmin‌ kale rā dhime bhāga iti boddhavya na prāravdhamātrāyāṃ śara tathāca mnthakāreṇoktaṃ--“śrāvaṇa kārtike caitre sādhāraṇe kamāt‌ | rīṣmavarṣāhimacitān‌ vāśva nāḍu nidairet‌ '”
tib: grang ba zhes bya ba'i sgra ni dgun stod dang / dgun smad gnyi ga gzung ngo / / nyes ba rnams kyi tshogs yin pas na nyes tshogs te/ de ltar grang ba las byung zhing skyes pa'i nyes pa'i tshogs gang yin pa de ni dpyid kyi tshe rnam par bsal zhing bsal bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du so ga'i tshe bsags pa las byung ba'i nyes pa'i tshogs ni dbyar gyi dus na rnam par sbyang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du dbyar bsags pa'i nyes pa rnams ni sprin bral dus te/ ston gyi dus su myur zhing rings par gso dpyad kyi bstan bcos las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du legs par sbyangs shing rnam par bsal na/ dus las byung ba'i nad skyes bu de la nam yang 'byung zhing skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ / dpyid kyi tshe rnam bsal zhes smos pa 'dir ni dpyid zla 'bring po mgo zug pa kho na'i dus su sbyang bar bya ba yin par khong du chud par bya ste/ de ltar ma byas na bzlog dka' ba'i nyes pa yod de/ dus gnyis po 'di la bsags pa'i nyes pa'i tshogs sbyang bar bya ba'i dus la bab pa dag ni dus gzhan dag la bsdad pa na bsal bar dka' ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ / so ga las byung dbyar dus na/ / zhes bya ba'i skabs 'dir yang dbyar gyi dus rtsom pa nyid na yin par bya zhing / ji srid grang ba dang / rlung dang / ba mo dang / char gyi rgyun dang / 'dres pa'i dus su ma phyin par bya ba yin no/ / dbyar bsags sprin bral dus zhes bya ba 'dis/ dus gang gi tshe sprin dang shin tu bral zhing / nam mkha' dang bar gyur pa ste/ ston zla gnyis kyi phyi ma'i cha/ ston zla tha yin par shes par bya'i mgo rtsom pa la ni mi bzung ngo / / de skad du gzhung rtsom par byed pas kyang / dbyar dang ston zla dpyid 'bring / / zla ba rim bzhin thun mong yin/ / so ga dbyar dgun la bsags pa'i/ / rlung la sogs pa myur du bsal/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / ji ltar na mi rnams rtag tu nad med par 'gyur ba de bstan pa'i phyir smras pa ni/ rtag tu phan pa'i zas dang spyod lam bsten/ / brtags te byed cing yul rnams la mi chags/ / gtong ldan sems snyoms bden brtson bzod dang ldan/ / nyams ldan sten par byed na nad med 'gyur/ / zhes bya ba ni yon tan 'di lta bu dang ldan pa'i skyes bu ni nad med cing tha mal par bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ / de yang gang zhig ce na/ gang rtag tu zhes pa dus thams cad du phan zhing 'phrod pa'i zas dang / spyod lam bsten zhing goms par byed pa ste/ phan pa'i zas ni 'og nas bshad pa dang / dus su spyad pa'i le'u las bshad par bya'o/ / spyod lam ni lus dang ngag dang yid kyi kun tu spyod pa ste/ de yang nyin re brtag par spyad pa'i le'u las bshad pa yin te/ de dag la brten pa dang / de bzhin du brtags te byed cing zhes bya ba ste/ gang dang gang byed pa de dang de spang ba dang blang bar bya ba legs par brtags shing byed de/ / 'di byas na ni rdzogs par 'gyur la/ 'di byas na ni mi rdzogs shing mthar phyin par mi 'gyur ro zhes pa de ltar shes par byas nas/ dge ba byed cing mi dge ba spong bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du yul rnams la mi chags zhes pa ste/ gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri la sogs pa la sems chags pa med pa dang / gtong ldan zhes pa gtong zhing sbyin par byed pa'i ngang tshul can dang / sems snyoms zhes pa sems can thams cad nye dur gyur cing rjes su chags pa dang / khong khro ba med pa dang / bden brtson zhes pa bden pa gtso bor lhur byed cing / bden par dam 'cha' la/ slu ba med pa'i tshig phyin ci ma log par smra ba dang / bzod pa dang ldan zhes pa ste/ bzod cing des pa'i ngang tshul can dang / de bzhin du nyams ldan sten par byed pa ste/ mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can yin pas na mkhas pa ste/ 'jig rten gnyi ga la slu ba med cing chags pa dang / 'tshe ba med pa'i dngos po mthong ba la mkhas pa zhes bya'o/ / de yang drang srong tsa ra kas/ gang zhig dus gsum dri med par/ / shes shing rtag tu ma nyams pa/ / de mkhas phul byung blo rgyas yin/ / de'i tshig the tshom med cing bsten/ / skyon bral rmongs pa med pa ste/ / mi bden par ni ji ltar smra/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ mkhas shing lung dang ldan pa de la brten na nad med par 'gyur ro/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel ba tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/
/ / de nas chu sna tshogs pa la sogs pa'i bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /

skt: tathā nase nisyamasego bhavati tathā drīyannāha-ṣavevidhaḥ puruṣaḥ aegaḥ svastho bhavati | yo nityaṃ sarvakāraṃ ditau pathyāvāhāraviddārau sevate tacchīle hitādāravida raseva edaita āhāro vakṣyaparāṇa uktaḥ | ṛtucayautvidhāne vihāraḥ | kāya vāṅa manasāṃ ceṣṭā sāṣyuccha dinacayodhyāyi | tathā samīkṣyakārī yadyaddhi karoti tattadadhikhaśya heyopādeyaśūpatayadaṃ kledaṃ sampadte,idaṃ tve sampadyate evaṃ jñāsvā śubhaṃ karoti adyuṃ pariharati | tathā viṣayeṣvasaktaḥ-śabdaraparīdiṣvasataktacetāḥ | dātā-tyāgī dānaśīlaḥ | samaḥ-sarvaśrāṇiṣu bandhubhūto rāgadadheṣādirahitaḥ| satyaparaḥ-sasyapradhānaḥ | saṃsyapratijño'vitathavacanaḥ } kṣamāvāna--kṣamāsīraḥ | tathāptopasevī-āptāmupasevate | tancchīraḥ | āprā~-ubhayakhokāvivādinaḥ niṣprītyupatāpadākna ucyante | | suniḥ-śayiāṃ trikālamamalaṃ jñānamavyādate | āprāḥ śiṣṭā vivudhāsteṣāṃ vākyamasaṃśayam‌ | vakṣyanti te'kasmānnīrajastamaso mṛṣā"? naḥ | na rogī mavatīti madram‌
tib: sngar gong du rtag tu phan pa'i zas dang spyod lam bsten na/ nad med par 'gyur ro/ / zhes bstan la/ phan pa'i zas dang spyod lam de gnyis kyang ming tsam zhig bstan pa yin no/ / de la spyod lam ni rtsol ba la sogs pa'i rang gi ngo bo dang / las kyi bye brag bshad pas/ phal cher bshad zin pa dang / 'og nas kyang ston to/ / zas kyis kyang rang gi ngo bo dang / las dang yon tan dag 'dir cung zad kyang ma smos so/ / de bas na da ni de'i rang gi ngo bo dang las dang yon tan bshad par bya ba'i phyir dang / le'u 'di gnyis brtsams pa yin la/ de gnyis las kyang chu sna tshogs pa gsher ba'i rdzas kyi bye brag shes pa ni gtso bo yin pas dang por bstan pa yin no/ / chu sna tshogs pa ni chu rnams dang / 'o ma dang bu ram shing gi khu ba dang / til mar dang / chang la sogs pa'o/ / de rnams kyi bye brag shes par bya ba ni phan pa dang gnod pa nyid kyis ro dang nus pa dang / 'ju ba dang yon tan la sogs pa shes shing rtogs pa'o/ / de la phan zhing dgos pa ni le'u ste/ de bshad par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de la dang por ni chu'i yon tan gyi nges pa ston pa yin te/ de ni thams cad la dgos pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de yang slob dpon gyis/ chu ni srog chags rnams kyi tshogs/

skt: gagāmbu namasa śaraṣṭamākārāradhitajīvanabhojo'bhivṛddhikara taraṇaṃ chamadhara hṛdayāya hita hṛ hṛdayasya vā śriyaṃ shādiṃ sukhajananaṃ gchānyapanut‌ ddhaḥ prabodhanaṃ prajñādhikāsajanakaṃ yāvatī yasya prajñā vataite tāvatyeva taca sphuṭapratimāsā tyogātsampaśate | nanvasānadram‌ ! avyaktarasamanyaktā madhurādyo rasā jāyante yarsamastadavyaktapsaṃ mṛṣṭa svādu śubhaṃ ktvā pānāthamabhilaṣyate prāṇibhiratyarthaṃ yathā sīta ḍaci divaṃ mṛṣṭamiti muniḥ paṭhati | rītamubhayathāpi saśavīyābhyāṃ raghuyuṇayogāhaghu | tathā'parateparamamamṛtaguṇaṃ sadaṇakaspayuktam‌ | eva śuṇayuktamapi nabhaso'ntarikṣāddhaśaṭhaṃ patat‌ | spraṣṭa̭ṃsambadadhamakenumāruteḥ ādityacandrapavaneḥ | tadambu bhūyaḥ punarapi (hitāhitasva pathyāpabhyamāve deyakāṭāvapekṣṛte daśakālāvanuvatate | derākāṭaguṇānāmātmasāt‌ karopati tahuṇaṃ sampadyate iti yāvat‌ ] yasmin‌ bhūmideśe patitamānūpāyantatame tatrāpi kimapsite śvetādhanyatame trākache ṣar̤atvākhye ca
tib: nam mkha' las 'bab pa'i gang gA'i chu ni/ yon tan 'di dag dang ldan pa ste/ 'tsho byed ces bya ba mdangs 'phel bar byed pa'o/ / ngoms byed ni ngal ba sel bar byed pa'o/ / dga' bar byed pa ni snying dga' bar byed pa'o/ / yang na snying la phan par byed pa'o/ / tshim byed ni bde ba skyed pa'am nad sel ba'o/ / blo sad par byed pa ni shes rab kyi kha 'byed par byed pa ste/ gang la shes rab ci tsam zhig de la gsal bar snang ba nyid du de 'thungs pa las gyur pa'o/ / sla ba ni ska ba ma yin pa'o/ / ro mi gsal ba zhes bya ba ni/ mngar ba la sogs pa'i ro de la gsal ba med pas na ro mi gsal ba'o/ / zhim pa ni ro bda' ba ste/ srog chags rnams kyis shin tu sred par byas nas/ btung ba'i don du 'thung ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de yang gang gi phyir drang srong dag gis/ bsil zhing gtsang la dge zhing zhim/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / bsil ba zhes bya ba ni reg pa dang nus pa gnyi ga sbyar ro/ / yang ba zhes bya ba ni yang ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ / de bzhin du bdud rtsir mtshungs zhes bya ba ni bdud rtsi'i yon tan dang ldan pa ste/ yon tan dam pa'i tshogs dang ldan pa'o/ / de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa dag kyang nam mkha' ste/ bar snang las bab cing lhung ba ni/ nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / rlung gis reg cing phrad par gyur pa'i chu de yang yul dang dus la ltos shing yul dang dus kyi rjes su zhugs pas/ yul dang dus kyi yon tan dang 'dres shing bdag gir byed la/ des na phal cher slar zhing phan pa dang gnod pa ste/ lus la phan par 'gyur ba dang / gnod par 'gyur bar byed pa yin te/ de yang rlan che ba la sogs pa'i yul phyogs gzhan 'ga' zhig tu 'bab pa na/ de yang nag po'am/ dkar po la sogs pa las gzhan du 'gyur ba dang / dus te dus drug la ltos na phan pa dang gnod pa yin no/ /

skt: yanābhimūṣṭamābhimakhyataḥ siktaṃ dātyarna, tacca rājate sthite rajatasyeda̭ rājataṃ rūpyabhāṇḍa tatraśthaṃ tacchālyannam‌ | anyathā'ṅdhinnamavivaṇi syāt‌ tadrāṅgaṃ vidayāttaca peyaṃ pātavyam‌
tib: chu gang legs par char du 'bab pas brlan zhing spangs pa'i sA lu'i chan te/ dngul phor gyi nang na gnas pa de yang rul bar ma gyur cing / mdog kyang gzhan du ma gyur na/ chu de ni gang gA'i chu zhes bya ste/ / de ni 'thungs na gnod pa med pa yin pas na btung bar bya ba yin no/ /

skt: paṅkadovāṅadibhisavimāstṛtaṃ ca toyaṃca pivet‌ | tatra paṅkaḥ-karda̭maḥ tenāviṭhaṃ-kaṭapīkaratam‌ | vāraḥ-rauvalo jachapradhye jāyate | tṛṇāni paṇau[ ca prasiddhāni taisasṭhataṃ saṃchāditam‌ | tathā sūryai-pavanādṛṣṭamādityacandravātairanāsevitam‌ | tathā'vṛṣṭamābhimukhyena siktamanyena toyena parāritaṃ tacca dhakāṭasthitatvāttanvāpi sāndra saṃpannam‌ | tathā bhbapi yathā-gura jāta, pheniraṃ-saphenaṃ, jantumat‌bheyuktaṃ, taptamarkāditāpena saṃyuktaṃ tathātiśītakhtavena hantaprāhi taśca pibet‌ | & ||
tib: chu de spangs pa'i 'bras sA lu'i chan rul ba'am/ mdog gzhan du gyur na/ de ni rgya mtsho'i chu dang 'dra ba yin pas btung bar mi bya ste/ ba tsha la sogs pa'i skyon dang 'dres pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / ci dus thams cad du btung bar mi bya'am/ 'on te lan 'ga' zhig btung bar mi bya zhe na/ ston zla 'bring po min par btung mi bya/ / zhes bya ba smras pa yin te/ ston zla 'bring po ma gtogs par dus gzhan dag tu de btung bar mi bya'o zhes ston pa yin te ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i tshe drang srong r-i Shi 'char ba'i dus yin pas/ des mtsho dang rdzing bu la sogs par gtogs pa'i chu thams cad gnod pa dag kyang phan par sgrub par byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /

char pa'i chu ni dbang pos bar snang la char du 'bab pa'i chu'o/ / snod bzang bzhag ces pa ni snod bzang po bzed de bsags pa'o/ / 'gyur ba med ces bya ba ni kha dog dang ro ma nyams shing 'gyur ba med pa ste/ de ni rtag tu zhes pa dus thams cad du btung zhing spyad par bya'o/ /

de med na zhes pa bar snang gi chu bsags pa de ma rnyed na/ / thang la gnas zhes pa/ sa la lteng kar gnas pa'i chu ni bar snang ba dang rjes mthun yin/ zhes bya ba/ bar snang gi chu dang 'dra bar 'tsho bar byed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan cha mthun par byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du sa phyogs kha dog dkar ba dang / / gnag pa dag gi cha 'dres pa ste/ phal cher dkar gnag tu gnag pa na yod pa dang gtsang ba ste/ dag pa dang yangs pa ste sa phyogs rgya che ba na yod pa de nyi ma'i 'od dang rlung gi ser bus kun nas phog cing bsten pa'i chu gang yin pa de bsngags pa yin pas btung bar bya'o/ /

skt: tathā anārtave ca yadinyaṃ toyaṃ tanna pibet‌ dinyatvādasya pethatva prāpa tadanārvavatvācca pratiṣidhyate | anārvavasya pratiṣedhe ārvaivasya vidhirathāṃt‌ peyatve'bhyanajñāto bhavati | tasmādiriṣṭasyāntarikṣaprabhavasya jaṅasya peyatayā'vadayaraturabhipretaḥ sa ca varṣī vṛṣṭikārakaḥ yasmistat‌ | nabhasaḥ patite peya tenābhyalujñāyate | anyatupramavaṃ tadanātaivatvānna pibet‌ | kimāsevaṃ smeva pibeduta ātatavamapi kiścinna pived‌ta āh‌--ātavaṃ prathamaṃ ca yat‌. prathamap‌titaṃ yadāpaivaṃ tanna pibet‌ | ṛtau bhavamārapavaṃ na mataiḥ vamanārvaivam‌ | tenedamuktaṃ bhavati-varṣākāṭe paratirta. pibet‌ tattu prathamavṛṣṭamātevamapi na pibet‌| chādaya udrajantavaḥ bhrāṇiviśoṣāsteṣāṃ tantuviṣmūtraviṣasaṃ* ṣāt‌ saṃpakaut‌ yadduṣitaṃ toyaṃ tanna piṣetat‌ | tantudabdena khalā bhaṇyate
tib: lteng ka dang 'dam rdzab la sogs pas rnyog pa can du gyur pa'i chu de btung zhing longs spyad par mi bya'o/ / de la 'dam rdzab ni 'dam gyi rnam pa ste/ des rnyog pas nag nog can du byas pa'o/ / nya lcibs ni chu'i nang nyid nas skyes pa'o/ / rtswa dang lo ma ni grags par zad do/ / des rnyog pa can du gyur pa ni g.yogs pa'o/ / de bzhin du nyi zla rlung gis ma phog pa zhes bya ba ste/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od dang rlung gi zer gyis ma phog pa'o/ / de bzhin du mngon du 'bab pa zhes pa ste/ mdun du 'bab pa dang 'dres shing chu gzhan gyis gang bar 'gyur ba'o/ / chu gar ni yun ring por gnas pa'i phyir ro/ / sla ba ma yin pa las ska ba nyid du gyur pa'o/ / de bzhin du lci ba ste/ yang ba las kyang lci bar gyur pa'o/ / sbu ba can ni sbu ba yod pa'o/ / srog chags can ni 'bu srin dang ldan pa'o/ / dro ba ni nyi ma la sogs pa'i tsha bas gdungs pa'o/ / de bzhin du shin tu grang ches pas/ so dang reg par mi bzod pa de yang btung bar mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du char pa gang dus su ma bab pa yang btung bar mi bya ste/ char chu yin pa'i phyir btung bar bya ba nyid yin yang / char 'bab pa'i dus su ma bab pa nyid kyis na gnod pa yin pa'i phyir bkag pa yin no/ / dus ma yin par 'bab pa bkag pa las na dus su 'bab pa las na bar bya'o zhes gnang bar don gyis go bar bya'o/ / de bas na bar snang las 'bab pa'i chu khyad par can de ni btung bar bya ba nyid yin pa las/ de dus su btung bar bya ba yin la/ de yang dbyar gyi dus yin te/ gang gi tshe dbyar nam mkha' las 'bab pa btung bar bya ba nyid yin gyi/ dus gzhan dag tu 'bab pa ni dus ma yin par btung bar mi bya'o/ / ci dus su bab pa thams cad du btung bar bya ba'am/ dus su bab pa yin du zin kyang btung bar mi bya ba cung zhig yod dam zhe na/ de'i phyir dus kyi dang por 'bab pa gang zhes bya bar smos pa yin te/ dus dang por 'bab pa'i chu gang yin pa de ni btung bar mi bya'o/ / des na 'di skad ston pa yin te/ dbyar gyi dus su 'bab pa ni btung bar bya la/ de las kyang dang por 'bab pa ni dus su 'bab pa yin yang btung bar mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du srog chags gdug pa dang / lu ta la sogs pa rnams kyi/ rgya dang / bshang ba dang / gci ba dang / dug dang 'dres pas rmas par byas pa'i chu gang yin pa de btung bar mi bya'o/ /
chu bo gang nub phyogs nas mi 'bab pa dang / de bzhin du myur bar mi 'bab pa dang / rdul med pa ma yin pa ste gong ma las bzlog pa de dag ni bzang po ma yin pa ste/

rdo'i tshogs la shugs drag pos rdebs par byed la/ des rgyun chad cing rnam par 'thor bas g.yengs shing sprugs pa'i chu gang dag yin pa de dag gangs can te ri kha ba can dang / ma la ya'i ri las byung ba ste/ de gnyis las 'thon cing 'bab pa'i chu bo ni dge'o zhes pa ste phan zhing bsod pa yin pa'o/ / de ni brtan g.yung na/

kha ba can dang ma la ya'i ri las byung ba de nyid brtan zhing g.yung ba ste/ dal gyis 'bab pa yin na/ srin bu la sogs pa skyed par 'gyur ro/ / rkang bam ni tshil dang sha la brten te/ rkang pa dag tu rkang pa dag 'byung ba ste/

shar gyi lho bal gyi yul nas 'bab pa dang / nub phyogs te/ stag gzig gi yul nas 'bab pa dang / mtha' las byung ba lho nub kyi mtshams kyi yul ma la ya las byung zhing 'bab pa'i chu bo ni/ gzhang 'brum zhes bya ba'i nad skyed par byed do/ / dbang chen 'bab/

skt: upalāsphāṭhanāṣepavicchedāḥ taiḥ rave śramitasudakaṃ yāsā tāsvathāvidhāḥ } dahimavanma parvatau tābhyasudbhūtā sasukhannā nibhetā navyaḥ pa“ hitāḥ | tā evaṃ sisaḥ tāeva dimavanmakhyauḥ nadyaḥ sathirā mandagamanāḥ kṛmyādīn‌ prakuvete 1 ` pado-medomāṃsādhitaḥ śophaḥ pādrayoveksyasa ṭhachakṣaṇaḥ
tib: dbang chen zhes bya ba'i ri las 'bab cing rgyu ba'i chu bo ni dmu rdzing gi nad dang / rkang bam gyi nad skyed par 'gyur ro/ /

ri bo sad h+ya dang / ri bo bin da zhes bya ba'i ri gnyis las 'bab cing / de las 'thon pa'i chu bo ni mdze dang / skya rbab kyi nad dang / klad pa'i nad skyed par 'gyur ro/ / pa ri yad tra'i nad kun sel/ / zhes bya ba ni ri bo pa ri yad tra zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de las byung ba'i chu bo ni nyes pa gsum char sel ba yin no/ /

khron pa dang / rdzing bu la sogs pa'i chu yang ba dang / lci ba dang / yon tan dang / skyon gnyis ka yang skam sa dang / gsher sa rlan can dang brag las shes par bya ste/ skam sa la sogs pa'i yon tan gyis/ de'i khron pa la sogs pa'i chu'i bye brag shes par bya'o/ / de yang / khron pa rdzing bu mtshe'u dang / / mtshor bcas chu mig la sogs chu/ / skam sa rlan can brag las ni/ / yon tan skyon dag shes par bya/ / zhes drang srong tsa ra kas bshad pa dang / bsdus pa las kyang / skam sa gsher sa ri bo dang / / nye las yang dang lci ba 'byung / / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / des na 'di skad ston pa yin te/ skam sa'i sa phyogs na gnas pa'i khron pa la sogs pa'i chu ni yang ba nyid yin la rlan can gyi phyogs la gnas pa'i khron pa la sogs pa'i chu ni lci ba nyid yin no/ / ri bo'i phyogs na gnas pa'i khron pa la sogs pa'i chu ni nyes pa skyed pa yin la/ ba ri ya tra'i phyogs na gnas pa'i ni nyes pa 'joms pa yin te/

skt: aspābhiparabhṛtibhistoyaṃ na peyaṃ na pātata mam‌! aṅctyā taiḥ pipāsāsadahipṇubhiḥ sātmya7kāṭaprakrātidasīsvaśyāt‌ svasyaṃ peyam‌ | śarannidhābhyām‌ ṛte śāra dmrībhmau varjayisvā anyasmi-tī demantaśiriravasantavaṣīsa svastho'pi naro'ro'spamalpaṃ chararvodakaṃ pivet‌} 12||
tib: drod chung ba la sogs pas chu btung bar mi bya'o/ / gal te brnag bar dka' zhing skom pa mi bzod par gyur na/ rang gi rang bzhin dang / yul dang / dus dang / spyod lam dang / lus kyi tshod las dpags te/
ston ka dang so ga'i dus ma gtogs par dus gzhan dgun stod dang / dgun smad dang / dpyid dang / dbyar dag gi tshe nad med pa'i mis kyang cung zad btung /

skt: nākhikiraphaṭakhādudakamevāntaḥsthaṃ prādhānyata grāhyaṃ nānyat‌ | tathā'vayavāntaramiti jñāpanāthama smin‌ toyavagesya nirdaiśaḥ karataḥ | tacca nāṅikera phalasya madhyādudakaṃ snigdhasya guṇayogāt‌ sani svaduḥ madhuraṃ, vṛṣya-ṭukbṛddhikaraṃ, himaṃ-śītavīyaṃ tapṇāpittānikhahara-pipāsāpittavātaghnam‌ | dapinama bhevastemūtrādhārasya rodhanaṃ śuddhikaram‌
tib: zas zos pa'i bar dang mtha' ma dang / / thog mar chu 'thungs na/ lus sbom phra ran pa dang / sbom pa dang / skem par 'gyur ro/ / des ni 'di skad ston par 'gyur te/ mis zas zos pa'i bar du skom 'thungs na lus zungs ran pa ste/ phra sbom 'tsham par 'gyur la/ zas zos pa'i bar mar skom 'thungs pas ni sbom zhing rags par 'gyur la/ zas zos pa'i thog mar 'thungs pas ni skems par 'gyur ro/ / de yang skom bar du 'thungs pas lus zungs mnyam por skyed cing ran pa nyid du byed do/ / mtha' mar 'thungs pas ni ma zhu ba'i gnas su bad kan 'phel bar byed pas sbom po byed do/ / zas kyi thog mar 'thungs pas ni zas kyi shing med pas/ pho ba'i me nyams par byed de/ me'i drod kyis mi mthun pa'i phyogs su gyur pas/ me'i drod 'bri bar byed la/ / des na zas legs par 'ju bar mi nus la/ zas mi 'ju bas de'i tshe/ dngas ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs ji lta ba bzhin du rgyas par mi 'gyur la/ de rgyas shing 'phel bar ma gyur pas skyes bu skem por 'gyur ro/ /

chu bsil bdag ni chang drags pa'i nad la sogs pa sel zhing 'joms la zlog par byed pa yin no/ / de la chang nad ni chang drags pa las gyur pa'i nad do/ / de la nad ces bya ba ni/ gnod pa sogs shing snyon rmongs par byed pa'o/ / brgyal ba ni dran pa stor ba'o/ / skyugs pa la sogs pa ni go bar zad do/ / lus tsha ba ni zas dang spyod lam tsha bas tsha bar gyur pa'o/ / mkhris pa dang khrag rgyas pa de ni de dag 'phel ba'o/ / dug ni rgyu ba dang / rgyu ba las byung ba'i dbye bas gnyis so/ / sel byed yin zhes bya ba ni/ 'thungs pa dang gtor ba la sogs pas 'di dag sel zhing 'joms par byed pa'o/ /

chu bskol zhing tsha bar byas pa dag ni me'i drod skyed par byed pa dang / de bzhin du ma zhu ba'i nyes pa sel bar byed pa dang / mgul pa bde zhing lkog ma sbyong la/ gdangs snyan pa dang / yang ba'i yon tan dang ldan pas/ lus yang bar byed ba dang / gcin nad sel zhes pa gcin gyi gnas ni chu so ste/ de la gnod pas khebs par gyur pa sel bar byed pa'am/ yang na de na gnas pa'i gcin gyi skyon sel bar byed pas na/ gcin nad sel zhes bya'o/ / yang chu bskol ba 'di ni skyigs bu la sogs pa'i nad rnams la yang bsngags pa yin te/ skyigs bu la sogs pa ni 'og nas bshad par bya'o/ / cham sar ni cham pa yang yin la/ sar pa yang yin pas cham sar zhes bya ste/ de la yang bsngags pa yin te/ gang gi phyir drod skyed pa dang / zas 'ju bar byed pa yin par gong du bshad pa des na/ 'ju zhing smin par byed pas ni ma zhu ba yin pas de la bsngags pa yin no/ / chu ni bskol nas grangs pa dag / bad kan mi skyed lus yang zhing / / mkhris pa can la phan pa yin/ / de ni zhag lon nyes gsum skyed/ / ces bya ba ni/ chu bskol nas bsgrangs pa ni bad kan skyed par mi byed de/ ma bskol ba'i chu las rang bzhin gyi yon tan dang ldan pa yin pa las kyang bskol nas bsgrangs pa na/ shin tu yang ba yin la/ bskol nas bsgrangs pa de yang rlung dang bad kan gyi nyes pa gang yang rung ba mkhris pa dang ldan pa la phan pa yin la/ gsum char 'dus pa las byung ba'i nad la ni gnod pa yin no/ de yang / yul dus lci dang yang ba las/ / bzhi cha gsum cha phyed 'dus par/ / lbu ba med par bskol ba ni/ / shugs med dri ma med cing phan/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de ltar yon tan dang ldan zhing / / de ltar bskol nas bsgrangs pa de ni zhag lon pa ste/ nyin zhag gcig 'das pa'am/ yun ring por bzhag pa de ni/ nyes gsum skyed ces bya ba yin te/ rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa gsum skyed par byed do/ / dus kyi rang bzhin nyid dang / me'i yon tan las nyams pa dang / skyur pa'i rnam par 'gyur bas nyes pa rnams skyed pa yin no/ / rgya star chu ni snum pa dang / / ro mngar ro tsa bsil zhing yang / / skom dang mkhris pa rlung nad sel/ / drod skyed lgang ba'i nad sbyong byed/ / dbyar ni char chu chu bo'i chu/ / mchog tu bzang dang ngan par bshad/ / ces bya ba ni/ rgya star gyi 'bras bu'i nang na gnas pa'i chu gtsor gzung bar bya'o/ / de'i cha shas las byung ba gzhan dag ni ma yin no zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir chu'i sde tshan 'dir bstan pa byas pa yin la/ rgya star gyi 'bras bu de'i nang gi chu ni snum pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas na/ snum pa dang ro mngar zhing zhim pa dang / ro mngar zhing khu ba 'phel bar byed pa dang / / bsil zhing grang ba'i stobs dang ldan pa dang / yang ba la sogs pa dang ldan pa dang / me'i drod skyed par byed pa dang lgang pa ste/ gcin gyi gnas kyi nad sbyong zhing dag par byed pa yin no/ / char 'bab pa ste bar snang las 'bab pa'i chu dang chu bo'i chu ste/ de ltar char gyi chu dang chu bo'i chu ste/ de las dbyar gyi char gyi chu shin tu bzang zhing mchog tu gyur pa yin la/ chu bo'i chu ni dbyar mchog tu ngan zhing smad par bya ba yin par bshad do/ / chu'i sde tshan no/ / da ni 'o ma thams cad kyi spyi'i yon tan dang / las rnams smras pa ni 'di yin te/ de yang ci ltar chu ni 'tsho bar byed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa de bzhin du/ 'o ma yang yon tan mang po dang ldan pa yin pas/ sde tshan gzhan dag las 'o ma'i sde tshan nyid mchog tu gyur pa yin pa dang / gzhan yang gang gi phyir/ zhun mar ni snum thams cad kyi mchog yin la/ de'i skye ba'i gnas ni 'o ma nyid yin te/

skt: atra kṣīreṣu madhye yadranyaṃ kṣīraṃ talnīvanīyam‌ 1 vāṇi kṣīrāṇi jīvanīyāni 1 idaṃ punargokīrasirayena jīvanīyam‌| ojasya saumyadhāturaṣdhikarama) pāyanabhitti rasāyanaṃ prāṇarasaghāramakāraṇatvāt‌ | dhācāgyasaṅparahe|ṣīraghṛtābhyāso-rasāyanam‌ |'ṭāpāyo hi rāstānāṃ rasādyīnāṃ rasāyanam‌ ` kṣata)ṇadivasuraḥkṣadayukchāya śvaṇiāya ca hitaṃ pathyam‌ | paṇaḥ kṣīṇadhātuḥ | medhāthai--buddhayai hitaṃ-medhyam‌ | chasya hitaṃ balyam‌ | stanya̭kare ṇāṃ stanyavṛṣdhi roti |kṣīradhātutvāt‌ kharīstanyajanakam‌|saraṃ-saraṇa1kha m‌ bhedi-śramādīn‌ hanti | śramaḥ-khedḥ, śamarṇa-saḥ, mado bakṣyamāṇaḥ| ādhistu-manaḥpīḍā|| 21) hai --ganyaguṇānāha--jīvanīrya--prāṇadhārṇa, rasāyana ` (sthāpanaṃ, kṣataṃ--kṣatakāsaḥ, kīṇaḥ--kṣayarogī, tayorditaṃ ya medhājananaṃ, ; balyaṃ --balkaram‌) alakaṣamīrachmīrādetuḥ, ādhirmanaḥ pīḍā, śut‌--satibuśakṣāḥ tasyā eva 7tvāt‌ {
tib: 'o ma phal cher zhes pa ni 'o ma phal mo che'i yon tan 'di dag yin gyi/ thams cad kyi ni ma yin no/ / de la 'o mar gtogs pa thams cad kyi ni ro mngar ba dang zhu ba'i rjes la mngar zhing 'jam pa yin pas/ de dag ni khyad par med par ro mngar ba dang zhu ba'i rjes mngar ba yin no/ / snum pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas snum pa'o/ / gzi mdangs skyed pa la phan pas na mdangs skyed de/ mdangs zhes bya ba lus zungs rnams kyi snying por gyur pa/ 'og nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de skyed par byed pa dang / lus zungs zhes pa dngas ma'i bcud la sogs pa 'phel bar byed pa dang / rlung dang mkhris sel zhes bya ba/ / rlung dang mkhris pa'i nad 'joms par byed pa dang / ro tsa byed ces pa khu ba 'phel bar byed pa dang / bad kan skyed ces pa bad kan 'phel bar byed pa dang / lci ba'i yon tan dang ldan pas lci ba dang / bsil zhing grang ba ste/ yon tan de dag dang ldan pas lci ba'o/ / de dag ni phal mo che'i spyi'i yon tan yin gyi/ thams cad kyi yon tan 'di lta bu ni ma yin te/ la la ni gzhan dag tu yang mthong ste/ dper na rnga mo'i cung zad rtsub cing tsha ba dang / lan tshwa bro ba yang ba dang / de bzhin du ra'i 'o ma yang yang ba dang / lug gi 'o ma'i nus pa tsha ba skyed pa dang / rmig pa gcig pa'i 'o ma tsha ba'i nus pa can nyid yin no/ / 'dir spyi'i yon tan bshad pa las/ gang de dang mi mthun pa'i khyad par gyi yon tan bshad pa de ni spyi'i yon tan dang mi mthun pa nyid yin par shes par bya'o/ / 'on te cha 'dra ba dag yin na ni/ de nyid stobs skyed cing grogs su gyur pa yin no/ / 'dir khyad par du bya ba ni/ ba yi 'o ma 'tsho byed cing / / bcud kyis len yin glo rdol dang / / glo gcong la phan yid gzhungs byed/ / stobs skyed nu zho skyed dang 'khru/ / ngal dang mgo 'khor myos dbal nyams/ / lud pa dbugs mi bde bkres skom/ / rims rnying gcin ni sri ba dang / / khrag dang mkhris pa sel ba yin/ / zhes bya ba ni 'dir 'o ma'i nang nas gal te/ de ba'i 'o ma yin na 'tsho bar byed pa yin pas na 'tsho byed cing zhes bya ste/ 'o ma thams cad kyang 'tsho byed yin mod kyi/ ba'i 'o ma 'di yang shin tu 'tsho bar byed pa yin te/ mdangs skyed cing lus zungs mnyam por 'phel bar byed pa yin no/ / bcud kyis len yin zhes bya ba ni/ srog yang dag par 'dzin par byed pa yin pas/ bcud kyis len dang 'dra ba'i phyir bcud kyis len zhes bya ste/ de yang bsdus pa las/ mar dang 'o ma bsten pas ni/ / bcud kyis len ni 'thob pa yin/ / gang phyir 'o ma bsngags pa yi/ / bcud rnams kyi ni bcud len yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / glo rdol dang gcong la phan pa ni glo dang brang rdol ba/ lus zungs zad par byed pa'i gcong la phan zhing rjes su mthun pa yin no/ / de bzhin du blo gros te/ yid gzhungs ba la phan pa yin pas na/ yid gzhungs byed ces bya'o/ / stobs la phan pas na stobs skyed do/ / nu zho skyed pa ni bud med rnams kyi nu zho 'phel bar byed pa ste/ nu zho snum pa bud med kyi 'o ma skyed pa'o/ / 'khru ba ni khong nas 'khru ba'i ngang tshul can no/ / de bzhin du ngal ba la sogs pa yang sel ba yin no/ /

skt: māhiṣaṃ kṣīramanyimpantavā'nidrabhyo nabhyo ditaṃ pathyam‌ | tace garayeo rurtaramanyasyaḥ kaṣīrebhyaḥ | himaṃ yītavīyamanilayena
tib: ma he'i 'o ma ni 'ju drags pa ste me'i drod che bas 'grangs mi shes pa dang / gnyid med pa la phan pa dang / de 'o ma gzhan dag las rab tu zhi zhing 'ju dka' ba dang / bsil zhing grang ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin no/ /

skt: vātaśca pittaṃ ca asak‌ cābhighātaścate vaḥ pittāsgabhighātāsatairakṣirogāstān‌ jayatīti vinna! kāryaḥ | tena mānuṣaṃ kṣīraṃ bātapittākhagabhidhaṣa rutannānakṣirogān‌ jayati nāśayati | kathamiṭaḥ cyate } kena tapaṇenāścotanena nasyena ca} etā| cāsminrvasthāne vakṣyamāṇaścaṇāni tarṣaṇaṃ netra pūraṇaṃ yavamāṣamayīṃ pārī kalā } ñaścotanaṃ-khīta pṇamṛdunā pariṣekaḥ | nāvanaṃ nasyam‌
tib: ra'i 'o ma ni/ chu nyung ngu 'thung ba la sogs pa'i rang bzhin ni yin te/ 'dir rgyu smos pa ni gzhan dag kyang 'di bzhin du rgyu dang ldan pa'i dbang gis 'o ma yang ba nyid du shes par bya ba'i phyir smos pa yin te/ 'di las go bzlog pa'i rang bzhin can ni lci ba yin par shugs kyis go bar bya'o/ / chu nyung ngu 'thung ba la sogs pa'i rang bzhin ni dus dang yul la sogs pa la ltos nas bya ba yin no/ / ra'i 'o ma 'di ni skem pa la sogs pa'i nad skyed pa yin te/

rnga mo'i 'o ma ni cung zad rtsub pa dang / cung zad dro ba dang / cung zad lan tshwa bro ba yin zhing / me drod che bar skyed pa dang / yang ba yin la/ rlung dang / bad kan dang / lto sbos pa dang / srin nad dang / 'or nad dang / dmu rdzing dang / gzhang 'brum gyi nad la phan zhing bsngags pa yin no/ / bud med nu zho rlung mkhris khrag /

skt: averidmāvikaṃ, kṣīramaharadya--hṛdayābhiyam‌ | sāghu vā na bhavati | uṣṇamuṣṇavīryaṃ dātavyā` dhihara-vātanyādhibhināśanam‌ | hiṣmāścāsapittakaphamradam‌
tib: bud med kyi 'o ma de ni rlung dang / mkhris pa dang / / khrag dang / snad pa las byung ba'i mig nad gang yin pa dag sel zhing 'joms par byed do/ / ji ltar na de sel bar byed ce na/ tshim byed mig dang snar blugs phan/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ tshim par byed pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ gnas 'di nyid kyi 'og nas bshad pa yin te/ / tshim par bya ba ni mig bkang ba ste/ nas sam sran ma sha'i zan gyi reng bu sbom par byas la bskor te bkang ba'o/ / mig tu blugs pa ni mig 'bras kyi steng du blugs pa'o/ / snar blugs pa ni sna nas gtong ba'o/ / lug gi 'o ma snying gnod tsha/ / rlung 'joms skyigs bu dbugs mi bde/ / mkhris pa bad kan skyed pa yin/ / zhes bya ba la lug gi 'o ma ni snying la gnod pa ste/ shin tu mi dga' ba'am/ snying nad skyed pa'o/ / tsha ba ni nus pa tsha ba dang ldan pa'o/ / rlung 'joms pa ni rlung gi nad 'jig pa'o/ / de la skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde ba dang / mkhris pa dang / / bad kan ni skyed par byed pa yin no/ / ba glang mo yis rab brtan byed/ / ces bya ba ni/ ba glang mo'i 'o ma ni rab tu brtan par byed pa yin te/ lus shin tu brtan par byed pa yin no/ / rmig pa gcig pa'i 'o ma tsha/ / yan lag rlung sel skyur bcas shing / / lan tshwa bro zhing rmongs par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ rmig ba gcig pa ni/ rmig sbubs gcig yod pa ste/ rmig ba la kha brag tu ma gyur pa/ rta dang bong bu la sogs pa rnams la rmig pa gcig pa zhes bya ba ste/ de dag gi 'o ma ni tsha zhing dro ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa yin no/ / yan lag ni khrag la sogs pa'i lus zungs rnams te/ de la gnas pa'i rlung sel zhing 'joms par byed pa dang / skyur dang bcas pa dang / lan tshwa bro ba ni cung zad skyur ba dang / cung zad lan tshwa bro ba'o/ / rmongs par byed ces bya ba ni rmongs rmongs por byed cing / lus mi gsal ba bems po nyid du byed pa'am/ shes rab la

skt: ekaśaphāstaveknakhā; | ekaḥ advibhāgaḥ śaphaḥ khuro yeṣāṃ te ekadāphāḥ teṣāṃ kṣīram‌ | ekaśaphānāmibhmekaraṣpe kṣīrayapṇavīryam‌ ! śākhā-raktādayo dhātavaḥ;savaka tatrasthaṃ vātaṃ haranti } dākhāvātadaharadākhāsthitasya vātasya nāśanama | sāmṭakhvṇakiñvidamchaṃ kiściddhavaṇa ca jaḍatākaram‌ | dārīrasyāpadutvaṃ janayati prajñāmapaharati vā | jaḍatāspaimityamiti kecit‌

tib: 'o ma thams cad ma bskol ba ni bad kan skyed cing 'phel bar byed pa yin te/ dri ma dang ldan pas lus kyi mi rgyu ba yin par ro/ / lci ba ni yun ring zhig na 'ju ba ste/ sa ni zla ba'i yon tan gyi shas che ba yin pas de las 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ / rigs par bskol na zhes bya ba ni 'o ma de nyid rlon pa las go bzlog par bstan na de las gzhan pa ste/ bad kan skyed pa ma yin lci ba yang ma yin te/ bad kan sel zhing yang bar gyur pa'o/ / de la legs pa ni sbyor ba'i thabs te/ ji ltar 'o ma'i phyed kyi chus bsnan la bskol ba ni/ 'o ma rlon pa bas shin tu yang ba yin no/ / zhes rgyud gzhan nas bshad pa yin no/ / yang na shin tu bskol ba ma yin la/ cung zad bskol ba yang ma yin pa ni rigs pa yin te/ mi rigs par bskol ba ni me dang phrad pa yin du zin kyang lci ba nyid du 'gyur ro/ / de yang gang gi phyir mi rigs par bskol zhing / chu med par bskol ba las/ cha gcig dang / cha gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi nas cha brgyad lus pa'i bar gyis ni/ gong nas gong du snying po 'dus par 'gyur ro/ / de yang rgyud gzhan las/ 'o ma chu med par bskol ba/ gnyis gsum bzhi nas brgyad cha lus/ / ji ltar shin tu bskol ba bzhin/ / snying po lci zhing rab stobs ldan/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de bas na shin tu bskol na 'ju dka' zhing rab tu lci bar 'gyur ro/ bzhos ma thag pa'i 'o ma dro ba ni 'phral du bzhos pa'o/ / de ni phan pa nyid kyis na bdud rtsir mtshungs/ zhes bya ba ste/ bdud rtsi dang 'dra ba yin no/ / da ni 'o ma las zhor gyur ba las/ gnas skabs du ma nyid du gyur ba/ ma rdzogs pa las ji skad du bshad pa'i skyur ba dang / shin tu skyur ba la sogs pa'i tshul gyis zho ma langs pa dang / legs par langs pa dang / langs nas thal ches pa nyid du yongs su gyur pa las/ ji ltar zho'i gnas skabs du mar gyur pa'i rang bzhin gyi gnas skabs gzhung rtsom pas snying la bzhag ste/ smras pa ni/ zho ni ro dang zhu rjes skyur/ / rtug skems lci la rlung nad sel/ / tshil dang khu chu stobs bad kan/ / khrag mkhris drod skyed 'or nad skyed yig 'byed cing kha zas len/ /

skt: dṛdānī kṣīrādadhi pariṇamati, trānekarūpatathā'namivyaktāmkamamiṣyaktāmchamatyamlarūpatayā citayā'nabhiṣyaktāmchātyamchasvarūpāyā mandajātasamyagjātāni jātāni | yukhyatayā pariṇamatyeva dadhno'nekāmabhyo'vasthābhyau jātāvasthaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā'ya andhakāra āha-amchau pākarasau yasya tadampā) karasam‌ ! māhi-rakaradādīna bhinnāna. piṇḍīkaroti ! guraguṇayogādbharaṃ upṇamuṣṇavīyaṃ vātaṃ jayati vātajit‌ ! tathā medaḥśukhādīn‌ kasoti | rociṣṇu recanarīṭaṃ sādhu rocate | carasya pyante'bhyavaharaṇāyatvādarūcau śastaṃ pathyam‌ anyacrāhāraṃ rocayati | tathā śītake-rītapūvake biṣamalvare satatakādau śastam‌ | tathau pīnase pratidyāye rāstam‌ | mūtra śastam‌] śakṣantu grahaṇī gade dāstam‌| tacduśratasāratayā | kameṇa yathāyathamatijātatvādatidāyana | tadapi niṣe rātrau naivā dayāt‌ na bhakṣayet‌ | ekānte na skhtyācāravirodhāt‌| naiboṣṇamuṣṇīkaratamagnyāditāpāttapm‌ | tathā śaradaoīpmavasanteṣu nacādyāt‌ | uṣṇaśabdena brīpmo'bhidhīyate| yadā tu bhakṣayettadā nudarasūpaṣa-sudrasapena vinā nādāt‌, kṣaudreṇa vinā nādāta, tathā nādhṛtasitopalaṃ dhataśarkarābhyāṃ rahitaṃ na bhakṣayennādyāt‌ | nacā nāmalakamāmarukīrvainā na bhakṣayet‌ ` | naca nityaṃ sātasyanaṣyāt‌ | no mandaṃ naca mandajātamadyāt‌ | yadā suktakṣīramāvai naca jāta̭ṃtadā mandakamiti ṇyate anyathā pūrvoktaṃ vidhiṃ syaktvā yadi kathi ḍane tadā .tahadhi jvarādīn‌. dadāti
tib: zho gang ro dang zhu ba'i rjes skyur ba ni ro dang zhu rjes skyur ba'o/ / rtug skems zhes bya ba ni bshang gci la sogs pa rang gi gnas nas bskul nas gong por byed pa la bya'o/ / lci ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa ni lci ba'o/ / rlung gi nad sel bas na rlung sel lo/ / dro ba ni dro ba'i nus pa bskyed pa'o/ / de bzhin du tshil dang khu chu dang stobs la sogs pa rang gi gnas nas/ de bzhin du yig 'byed cing 'grangs su zin kyang 'dod par byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du kha zas len zhes bya ste/ yig 'chus pa la phan zhing zas gzhan dag kyang yi gar 'ong bar byed pa'o/ / de bzhin grang ba'i rims dang zhes pa/ grang ba las gyur pa'i rims dang / rims ldang dub mi snyoms pa la sogs pa dang / cham pa dang gcin 'gags par gyur pa dang / 'khru ba'i nad rnams la phan pa yin no/ / de la rtsub pa ni legs par langs pa'i zho las dus 'das nas/ rim gyis shin tu smin par gyur pa ni rtsub po yin ba'am/ yang na spris ma bshus pa'i zho ni rtsub po yin no/ / zho dron dpyid dang so ga dang / / ston dus mtshan mo btung mi bya/ / de ni mung+ga'i sran tshod dang / / sbrang rtsi mar dang sha kha ra/ / skyu ru ra ni med mi btung / / rtag tu ma yin ma langs min/ / gzhan du rims khrag me dbal dang / / mdze dang skya rbab mgo 'khor skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ zho de ni dron por mi btung ba dang / de bzhin du dpyid dang so ga dang / ston gyi dus su btung bar mi bya'o/ / de ltar na sngar dron por zhes smos pa ni so ga'i dus yin par shes par bya ste/ de'i tshe btung bar mi bya ste/ de bzhin du mtshan mo yang btung bar mi bya'o/ / gal te de 'thung bar byed na sran mung+ga ste/ mon sran sde'u'i tshod ma dang sbyar ba btung bar mi bya ba dang / de bzhin du sbrang rtsi dang mar dang sbyar ba'am/ mar dang sha kha ra dkar po dang / sha kha ra dang mi ldan par btung ba dang / skyu ru ra ma zos par mi btung ngo / / de bzhin du rtag par rgyun du mi btung ba dang / ma langs min zhes bya ba ste/ / legs par ma chags la/ gang gi tshe 'o ma'i rang bzhin ma spangs shing zhor legs par ma chags pa de'i tshe ma langs pa zhes bya ste/ de mi btung ngo / / gzhan du zhes bya ba ni sngar bshad pa'i cho ga dang mi ldan zhing de ma spangs par/ la la zhig spyod par byed na/

tib: dar sar zhes bya ba la zho srub shing la sogs pas bsrubs pa las byung ba ste/ srub shing snum med pa dang / mar gyi phyed phyung ba dang / mar ma phyung ba ste/ gsum char yang yang ba yin la/ de las ro ni bska ba dang skyur ba yin no/ / drod skyed pa ni pho ba'i me drod 'phel bar byed pa'o/ / bad kan rlung dag sel zhes bya ba ni/ de las gnyis bsrubs pa las byung ba/ de bzhin du skran nad dang dmu rdzing la sogs pa sel bar 'gyur ba dang / chu sri ba ste/ gcin sri ba dang mcher ba zhes pa lto ba'i g.yon logs na brten pa'i rnam pa na ba dang / mar ma zhu zhes pa mar lhag par zos pa'am/ / ma legs par zos pa las byung ba'i nad la ni mar ma zhu ba zhes bya'o/ / sbyar dug ni bcos ma'i dug go/ / skya rbab kyi nad ni skya rbab las nad du gyur pa ste/

skt: tatra teṣveṣu madhye pauṇḍka śṣuḥ rau prasannasavāt‌ mādhuryācca varaḥ bhraṣṭha; | etānyasya ṣaṭāni sambhavanti tamatuvāṃikaḥ hīnaḥ svalpaḥ re dibhirauṇithukta ityathaḥ 43 ||
tib: de 'dra zhes pa ni dar ba sar pa ste de dang zho ga chu yon tan 'dra zhing mtshungs par shes par bya la/ de yang 'khru ba ste cung zad khong 'khru ba dang / yang pa zhes pa dar ba sar pa yang yang ba yin mod kyi/ 'di ni shin tu yang bas na khyad par smos pa yin no/ /

skt: śātaparvakādayaḥ ikṣavaḥ -karamāduntaroraṃ rau dimihīnāḥ tatastasmādikādikṣoḥ| tena vāṃ draṇa: śātapavako hāniḥ | tato'pi kāntārastataṃ nepāṭa ityanyeṣvapi yojyam‌ | te sakṣārāḥ-daiṣaḥ rāḥ sakaṣāyā daṣatkaṣāyāḥ sopṇāḥ īṣaṭaduṣṇa tathā kiśvididāhino vidahanaśīkhaḥ
tib: 'phral gyi mar sar zhes pa ni bsrubs zin ma thag phyung ba'i mar sar ro/ / ro tsa ba ni khu ba 'phel ba'o/ / bsil ba ni nus pa bsil ba'o/ / de bzhin du mdog dang stobs la sogs pa yang skyed par byed pa yin no/ / 'khru ba gcod pa ni bshang gci sla ba las ska bar byed do/ / de bzhin du rlung dang mkhris pa'i khrag sel ba yin te/ rlung gi khrag ni rlung las gyur pa'i khrag go/ / mkhris pa'i khrag ni mkhris pa las gyur pa'i khrag ste/ de dag dang gzhang 'brum la sogs bsel zhing bsngags pa yin no/ / zhun mar blo rno dran gsal zhing / / yid gzhungs drod skyed stobs tshe 'phel/ / mig dang byis rgan bu 'dod dang / / mdangs rab gzhon skad snyan phan/ / glo rdol skem dang gcong dang 'bras/ / mtshon rmas mes tshig rma la'ang bsngags/ / rlung dang mkhris pa dug dang smyo/ / lus skems mdangs nyams rims rnams sel/ / snum gyi nang na snum mchog ste/ / bsil zhing na tshod 'jog pa'i mchog /

zhun mar ni blo rno ba la sogs pa la phan pa yin no/ / de la blo rno ba ni blo gros dang ldan pa ste/ dngos po rnams 'dzin par nus pa'o/ / dran pa ni 'das pa'i dngos po yid la dran par nus pa'o/ / yid gzhungs pa ni dngos po rnams bye brag phyed pa'i shes rab 'dzin par byed pa'o/ / drod skyed pa ni pho ba'i me drod skyed pa'o/ / stobs ni nus mthu'o/ / tshe ni srog dang 'tsho bar ldan pa ste/ de dag 'phel bar byed pa'o/ / mig ni mig nyid la phan par byed pa ste/ zhun mar ni de dag la bsngags pa yin no/ / byis ba ni bcu drug lon gyi bar ro/ / rgan po ni drug cu yan chad lon pa'o/ / bu 'dod pa ni bu skye bar 'dod pa'o/ / mdangs ni lus la gnas pa'i mdzes sdug pa'o/ / rab gzhon ni lus gzhon sha chags shing mi rtsub pa'o/ / skad snyan pa ni tshig gsal ba'o/ / phan zhes pa ni de dag 'dod pa la phan zhing rjes su mthun pa yin no/ / de bzhin du glo rdol ba la sogs pa rmya zhing snyon rmongs pa'i bdag nyid can rnams la yang bsngags te phan pa yin no/ / lus skem pa ni lus zungs zad pa'o/ / gzhan dag ni go bar zad do/ / snum gyi nang na zhes pa ni til mar dang zhag dang / rkang rnams kyi nang na'o/ / snum mchog ste ches pa ni gtso bo yin pa'o/ / bsil ba ni bsil ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'o/ / na tshod 'jog pa ni rgas pa 'joms pa ste/ gzhon nu nyid du dus yun ring por 'jog pa'o/ / mchog ces bya ba ni shin tu dam pa yin pa'o/ / stobs stong dang ldan pa ni nus pa mtha' yas shing mthu du ma yod pa'o/ / de bzhin du sbyor bas zhes bya ba cho ga tha dad pa ste btung ba dang / sna nas btang ba dang / bsku ba dang / 'jam rtsi mas gtong ba la sogs pa'i sbyor bas so/ / las ni stong byed 'gyur/

skt: phāṇitaṃ-udaraguḍāparapayauyaṃ+tatusa) tathābhipyandi, śeṣmaprakopakāri ca yakkacarīn‌ doṣānācinoti tridoṣasa̭cayakrṛdisyathaḥ| tathā mūtryodhanai mūra dodhayati nirmalīkaroti athavā'tivāhayāti |\45||
tib: mar rnying ba sar pa ma yin pa lo mang po lon pa ni smyo ba la sogs pa'i nad sel ba yin pa dang / de bzhin du dang / rna ba dang / mig dang / mngal gyi nad rnams sel ba yin no/ / smyo ba dang brgyal ba dag ni 'og nas chang nad kyi nad gzhi'i skabs na bshad par bya'o/ / brjed byed kyang 'og nas bshad par bya'o/ / rma rnams sbyong zhing zhes bya ba ni rma'i rnag la sogs pa sel ba'o/ / de bzhin du 'tshob cing 'byor par byed pa yang yin te/ 'tshob ba ni rma de pags pa gzhan dang mdog mnyam par byed pa'o/ /

tib: phrum sar zhes bya ba ni 'o ma dang dar ba las byas pa ste/ grags par zad do/ / spri ni ba la sogs pa 'brangs ma thag pa'i 'o ma las byas pa'o/ / rgya phrum ni 'o ma'i btso phrum a mi tsha zhes grags pa'o/ / chur ba ni zho ga chu las gdus pa'i gong bo'o/ / 'o ma las gyur pa 'di dag ni stobs skyed cing 'phel bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du khu ba dang / gnyid dang / bad kan 'phel bar byed pa yin no/ / gzhan yang rtug skams byed pa dang / lci ba dang nyes pa dang ldan pa ste gnod pa'i 'gyur ba dag ston pa'o/ / sogs pa zhes smos pa ni 'o ma las byas pa'i rnam pa gzhan gang dag yod pa bsdu'o/ /
