tib: ba'i mar dang 'o ma dag ni mchog yin te zhes bya ba/ kun gyi mchog gtso bo yin zhing dam pa yin la/ lug las byung ba'i mar dang 'o ma ni smad cing mi bsngags pa yin no/ / 'o ma'i sde tshan no/ / 'o ma'i sde tshan gyi 'og tu bu ram shing gi sde tshan smos pa'i dgos pa ni ji ltar 'o ma'i ro dang / zhu ba'i rjes mngar ba yin pa de bzhin du/ bu ram shing gi khu ba yang ro dang zhu ba'i rjes mngar ba yin no/ /

skt: madhu-mākṣikacakṣurabhyo hita cakṣupyam‌+kedikedanaśīkham‌ | ubhayathā āścotane vraṇalepādāvupayuktam‌ | tathā'bhyavahāre'pi kaphamanthyādinidhautaṃ karoti | tekṣaṇyādehe piṇḍitān‌. bhāvān‌ chinatti vibhajati | tathā vraḍādīni nudati nādayati | tathā kuṭhamedādikākhayati tathā vraṇān‌ pūyayaicchisyādibhyaḥ hodhayatīti śodhanama | sandhīyate'neneti sandhānaṃ karoti drau vraṇatekīkarotati | ropayatīti ropaṇaṃ rūḍhasya vraṇasya svakūsāvaṇya janayati | vātara-vātakoṣapi, rūkṣa ca | rase kaṣāyamadhuram‌ | tattusyā sadhurārkareti tena mākṣikeṇa guṇaistuyā ye mākṣikasya guṇāste sarave maghuśakairāyāṃ boddhavyāḥ | madhuno jātā śakarā madhurasā
tib: bu ram shing las byung ba'i khu ba ni 'khru ba ste/ bshang ba la sogs pa sla bar byed pa dang / lci ba dang / snum par byed pa dang / sha skye ba dang / lus sbom zhing 'phel bar byed pa dang / ro tsa zhing khu ba 'phel ba dang / bad kan dang gcin 'phel bar byed pa dang / bsil ba ste nus pa bsil ba dang / de bzhin du khrag dang mkhris pa sel zhing 'joms pa dang / ro dang zhu ba'i rjes mngar zhing bda' ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin no/ / de tshe lan tshwa bro zhing sos/ / bcas na kha ra dag dang 'dra/ / zhes bya ba la/ / bu ram shing de'i rtse mo cung zad lan tshwa bro zhing / sos bcas shing zos pa dang / de'i yon tan sha kha ra dang 'dra ba yin no/ / rtsa ba rtse mo 'bus zos sogs/ / btsir dang dri mas sbags pa dang / / dus ni cung zad lon pa las/ / 'khrul 'khor can ni rnam 'gyur te/ / tsha zhing lci la
rtse mo dang rtsa ba 'bus zos pa la sogs pa rtsa ba rtse mo 'bus zos sogs/ /

de rnams btsir ba dang / de bzhin du dri mas sbags shing gos par gyur pa dang / de bzhin du dus cung zad lon par gyur zhing / / dus cung zad 'das par gyur pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis btsir ba'i bu ram gyi khu ba de ni rnam par 'gyur bar byed cing / gzhan du gyur pa nyid du 'gyur te/ 'gyur pa zhes bya ba ni rang gi ngo bo las gzhan du 'gyur ba'o/ / des na de'i tshe bsil ba yin pa las/ tsha bar 'gyur ba dang / / yang ba las lci bar 'gyur ba dang / 'khru ba yin pa las mkhregs par 'gyur ba ste/ 'di dag ni de'i 'gyur ba yin no/ / de la gong du tsha ba zhes smos pa ni gang la tsha ba yod pa de ni tsha ba ste/ pho ba'i me drod dang phrang nas gang 'ju bar gyur pa de ni/ 'ju ba'i gnas skabs phyed zhu tsam du gyur pa na/ rnam par tsha zhing mkhris pa skyed par byed pas yun ring du gnas kyi myur du 'ju bar mi byed do/ / de ni lci ba yin pa'am/ dngos po'i rang gi rang bzhin yin pas na/

skt: bhūritarajanopayogātatekhavarga dṛṣubagānantaramā saḥ bhyate|tathā bātaṭaṃ madhiviti niradiṣṭaḥtasya vātasya rāma tekhānanānyadudaravyāntaramata āha-svayoninā turyaṃ guṇe bharte dati svayonivat‌ yo yasya yonirākāraḥ prabhavaṃ yato yato yadabhinirvṛttaṃ yadayadutpyate tayā yonya tusyaguṇaṃ tattaikhaṃ jānīyāt‌ | tassvarūpameva tadityathaḥ svākāreṇa samatusyaguṇamiti yāvat‌ | tatra taideṣve raṇḍa-saṣapeṅguda-piyāṅa-badaratuvarāruṣkara~-kuumbhya diāpāgura-devadāra--trapusivaurakapmāṇḍavātāmākṣo ḍomādijeṣvākāreṣu madhye sakhyaṃ tisoddhavaṃ vairaṃ tīka mandaguṇavipaśataṃ takṣaṇyāddhātūn‌ vikarṣati, sandhi bandhān‌ visuṃcati | vyavābhe-vyāpnirīṭaṃ yada vyāpya pākaṃ yāti) tathā ca saḍgrahe-““vyavā?i dehamakhira vyāpya pākāya karpate 1 savagdoṣakcha dupayukta̭ṃpānābhyāsena tvaca̭ duṣayāti | athaka svaṇdoṣān‌ kṛntati-kinatti “śrutī chedane? itya sūra ghātorayaṃ prayogaḥ | acṣuyaṃ-cṣuṣorapathyaṃ suṣ sūṣṣamakhalotaḥpverāt‌ | upṇasupṇavīyai tiroddha tvāt‌, śeṣmakaratvamasya prāpa tannivāthete | kaphakarannakapa na karotītyarthaḥ
tib: de la zhes bya ba ni bu ram shing de rnams kyi nang nas kha ra dkar po'i bu ram shing ni bsil zhing dri ma med pa dang / mngar bas mchog ste dam pa yin no/ /

kha ra dkar po'i shing de las bang shi ka zhes bya ba'i bu ram shing sbubs che ba bsil ba la sogs pa'i yon tan chung ba yin te/ bsil ba la sogs pa'i yon tan nyung zad cig dang ldan zhes bya ba'i don to/ / tshigs brgya pa dang kan ta ra/ / bal yul skyes sogs de las rim/ / cung zad tshwa bro bska ba dang / / dro bcas cung zad tsha ba skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ tshigs brgya pa la sogs pa'i bu ram shing rnams ni/ rim gyis 'og nas 'og tu bsil ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dman pa yin te/ sbubs can de las yon tan tshigs brgya pa dman pa yin la/ de bas kyang kan ta ra'i sa bya ba'i bu ram shing phra mo zhig yod pa dman pa yin la/ de bas kyang bal yul gyi dman pa yin te/ de bzhin du gzhan dag la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ / de rnams kyang cung zad lan tshwa bro ba dang / cung zad bska ba dang / cung zad dro ba dang / cung zad tsha ba skyed pa'i ngang tshul can yin no/ /

skt: karānāṃ bahaṇāyāramiti | ihaṃ didhidhāḥ {śāḥ | eke prakaraṣiddhadaya eva bījasvamāvājjāyante | pare ścādāravihāsādinā janmontarakāṭabhāvinaśca| pā~ draśānāṃ sani khotā ki sadaseva saṃkocaṃ niti | sakhkudhitasarotasāṃ tailamuksvā taiṭaguṇavisataguṇānyanyāni yāni dravyāṇe mandadadiguṇayu" (121) ktāni tāni nāntaḥsotaḥ praveṣṭaṃ samathāti bhavanti | yathā teṃ sūṣmavyavāyādibhiśuṇaiḥ sahasāntaḥ pravi śati chṛśānāṃ vṛhaṇāyāṭaṃ bhavati | asumabārtha pratipādayan‌ pranthakāraḥ tairas satehādiguṇayuktasya pahaṇate samarthasyāpi taile bahaṇāyāṭamiti kaṇḍoktamasya pāṭhe paṭhati | paraṅaratikraśānāmapi tathaiva taddha haṇam‌ | yadyapi kukhjā vikāsa asādhyā dati nirdi; | kicānuktamapi yadadravyamīdaguṇaṃ taikhattakaṣṇyādiguṇayuktaṃ tadapi tepāmasmāt‌ gharadaritāddhetoḥ kadakhāsvanivāraṇāya prayojyabhityadhiko'rtho'pi jñāpito bhavatīvyāgāmikā } tathā gurasigdhanasyavātaghnāpradīpananatvaśuṇasamanvitātikhājñātaṃ tatsvabhāvā. yavrattiyuktaṃcentasya dhaṭhate, evaṃ dehasya sthūrakāriṃ sathūānāṃ kaṣaṇāya ca | sthūlā api vidhāḥ | eke martisthūhā bījasvabhāvā jñāyante) janmāntasmāviḥ naścāpare slinagdhābhyavahārasevanāt‌ sampadyante | teṣāmubhatheṣāmapi teṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ sadṣmatyavāyagabherca saratasa viśudadaitusānyadoṭekhanamapi yuste | tamāt‌ rathānāṃ taṭaṃ konācāpyahaṃ sekāpadivasādrā baddhabiṭkaṃ vaddhapṛrīpaṃ baddharāvrakārisvāt‌ puraiṣa badhnāti) tathā brusīn‌ hantīti chamidhn‌ saṃskārādivakṣādudravyapākādibhiḥ siddhaṃ tekhaṃ san‌ rogān‌ jayati
tib: sbu ba can zhes bya ba ni bu ram phra mo dag gi dzi rnam grangs yin te/ de ni lci ba dang / bad kan skyed cing 'khrugs par byed pa dang / / sogs byed ces bya ba nyes pa gsum sogs shing sdud par byed/ /
gcin sbyong zhing dri ma med par byed pa'am/

bu ram skam po dang po bskol ba na/ / rnyog pa dang bral bar byas pa ni/ bad kan cher mi skyed ces pa ste/ bad kan cung zad tsam zhig skyed/ / ces bya ba'i don te/ / de bzhin du/ bshang dang gci ba bde bar 'byin/ / zhes bya ba ste/ bshang ba dang gci ba bde blag tu phyi rol du 'byin zhing 'byung bar byed pa yin no/ / dmar nag phal cher srin bu khrag / rkang tshil sha dang bad kan skyed/ / ces pa ni/ bu ram dmar nag rnyog pa can ni khong pa'i 'bu srin mang du skyed pa la sogs pa byed pa yin no/ /

skt: peraṇḍaṃ taṭaṃ -satiktoṣaṇamīṣattīṣṣṇamīṣarkakaṃ ca tathā khvādu-madhuraṃ, rasataḥ saṃmedi guru ca | tathā ca varman‌ jayet‌ vadhvṛddhiḥ | viṣamañca sanvatādiḥ | rak‌ ca śophasa rakūrophau tau ca karṭīguhyakoṣaṭhaparaṣāśrayo tatrasthau jayet‌ guhya--riṅgam‌ | phoṣṭhamudaram‌
tib: bu ram rnying pa lo mang po lon pa ni yid du 'ong / zhes bya ba ste/ yi gar 'ong zhing sems dga' bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du phan pa ste/ lus zungs rnams dang / gnod pa rnams la phan pa yin no/ / sar pa drod 'bri bad kan skyed/ / ces bya ba ni/ bu ram sar pa dag ni bad kan skyed cing me'i drod 'bri ba yin no/ /

hwags zhes bya ba ni bu ram gyi dngas ma'i sha kha ra ste/ ga la zhes ming du grags pa'o/ / khaN+Da ni de las kyang dngas shing dri ma med pa'o/ / kha ra dkar po ni de bas kyang ches dngas shing rnyog pa med pa'i kha ra dkar po'o/ / de ltar na rim gyis yon tan che ba'o/ / de dag ni ro tsa ba ste khu ba 'phel bar byed pa dang / gcod dang glo rdol ba la sogs pa la phan pa yin no/ /

ya ba ka ra zhes 'jig rten na grags pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na ya shA ba ra zhes bya'o/ / la la dag ni byi tsher ba'i khu ba las byed do/ / zhes zer ro/ / de'i yon tan yang ro tsha ba dang / mngar ba dang / bska ba'i rgyus hwags la sogs pa de dang 'dra zhing mtshungs pa yin no/ /

skt: nimbajaṃ telaṃ-nātyupṇaṃ kiśidupṇaṃ tiktarasaṃ kṛmipittakaphān‌ praṇudati nāśayati pittakaphapraṇut‌
tib: kha ra 'di dag dang kha ra gzhan gang dag yod pa de thams cad ni tsha ba la sogs pa sel zhing 'joms pa yin no/ /

bu ram shing gdus pa ni bu ram shing gi khu ba gdus pa rnams kyi nang na kha ra ni mchog yin la/ dbu ba can zhes pa bu ram phra mo rnyog pa can ni tha ma yin no/ / sbrang rtsi mig phan gcod skom dang / / bad kan skyigs bu khrag mkhris 'joms/ / tshil chen mdze nad gcin nad skyug/

sbrang rtsi dag ni mig la phan zhing bsod pa yin pa dang / gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ngang tshul can yin pa ste/ bad kan dang mdud pa ltar 'dril te gnas pa de/ rang gi mtshan nyid rno ba las gcod cing 'jig par byed pa yin pa dang / / de bzhin du skom pa la sogs pa sel zhing 'jig par byed pa dang / de bzhin du mdze nad dang gcin nad la sogs pa la phan par byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du rma'i rnags pa dang / 'drul ba la sogs pa sbyong bar byed pas na/

skt: umā--atasī, kusumbhaṃ padyottayāpa tañjanma taduddhavaṃ vairayuṣṇaṃ vītaḥ | tathā ṣakaphāpettānai karoti | vvdoṣaḥ--kuṣṭham‌ | de0--atasītailakusumbhatailaguṇānāha--yananakta , “vipāke kaṭu sakṣāraṃ kausumbhaṃ sarvadoṣakṛt‌ | kitasavaṃdoṣaviṣay‌ prathampūtaṃ ṭha vāyu hantyeva, yadā ṇādiḥ--.kausumbhaṃ kaḍa sakṣāraṃ vātna pittalam‌? iti
tib: 'dir 'tsho bar byed pas na rma 'tsho ste/ pags pa 'tshob cing mdog ma nyams par byed pa'o/ / chag grugs 'byor pa ni 'dis rma gnyis gcig tu 'byor pa dang / chag pa 'byor par byed pas na de skad ces bya'o/ / rlung skyed par byed pa ni rlung gi nad 'khrugs par byed pa'o/ / de bzhin du rtsub pa dang / ro bska ba dang mngar ba yin no/ /
sbrang rtsi'i yon tan ji snyed yod pa de thams cad sbrang rtsi'i khaN+Da'i yon tan yang yin pas na/ de gnyis yon tan mtshungs shing 'dra ba yin pas shes par bya'o/ /

sbrang rtsi de tsha zhing zhes pa/ me la sogs pas bsros na/ des mi bsod cing 'joms par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du tsha gdungs zhes pa/ nyi tshan la sogs pa tsha bas gdungs pa'i sbrang rtsis bsod par byed do/ / de bzhin du tsha bar ldan zhes bya ba tsha ba'i dus sam/ tsha ba'i yul du sbrang rtsi zos na mi bsod bar byed do/ / de bzhin du tsha ba zhes bya ba/ me la sogs pas bskol zhing tsha bar byas pa'i sman dang lhan cig sbrang rtsi zos na yang mi bsod par byed do/ / skyugs sman sman mar mas gtong la/ / sbrang rtsi dro ba bkag pa med/ / ces bya ba la/ sbrang rtsi dro ba dag kyang skyugs sman gtong ba dang / sman mar mas gtong ba la dgag pa med de/ gang phyir de ni mi 'ju bar/ / myur du ldog bar 'gyur phyir ro/ / zhes bsdus pa las gtan tshigs bshad pa yin no/ / bu ram shing gi sde tshan no/ / / / 'bru mar rang gnas lta bu yin/ / de la til mar til dang mtshungs/ / gtso bo rno zhing khyab pa yin/ / pags pa'i nyes sel mig la gnod/ / tsha zhing rno la bad kan sel/ / skem po dag ni sha skyed cing / / sbom po'i sha 'bri mkhregs par 'ong / / rtug 'gags srin bu 'joms pa dang / / sbyar bas nad rnams thams cad sel/ / e raN+Da'i mar tsha zhing kha/ / zhu rjes mngar lci 'khru ba yin/ / rlig rlugs skrang rlung bad kan dang / / lto nad ldang dub rims rnams sel/ / 'or nad sked pa gas pa dang / / lto ba ro rgyab nad la phan/ / e raN+Da ni dmar po'i mar/ / rno tsha dri nga rab 'byil 'greng / / yungs mar tsha dro rno ba dang / / bad kan rlung sel khu ba 'bri/ / yang zhing khrag mkhris skyed byed la/ / sha bkra mdze 'brum rmen bu sel/ / ba ru ra'i mngar bsil zhing lci/ / skran skyed rlung dang mkhris pa sel/ / nim mar rab tu tsha min kha/ / lto srin mkhris pa bad kan sel/ / zar ma le brgan rtsi yi mar/ / dro zhing pags nad bad mkhris skyed/ / zhag dang rkang ni rlung 'joms shing / / stobs dang khu chu bad kan skyed/ / sha ni rang dngos rjes mthun la/ / tshil yang de dag 'drar shes bya/ / til mar la sogs pa'i sde tshanano/ / / / chang gi sde tshan brtsams pa'i dgos pa ni/ chang ni nad med par byed pa dang / / me'i drod skyed cing yi ga 'bye ba la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs rnams dang ldan pa'i phyir bstan pa yin no/ / de yang til mar dang thun mong gi yon tan cung zad yod pas/ til mar la sogs pa'i 'og tu chang thams cad kyi spyi'i yon tan smos pa ni/ chang ni drod 'bar yig 'byed/ / rno zhing drod skyed khong brta dga'/ / mngar bcas kha zhing tsha ba dang / / zhu rjes skyur zhing cung zad 'khru/ / bska bcas gdongs snyan nad med dang / / spobs skyed mdog 'gyur khong yang la/ / gnyid med pa dang gnyid che la/ / phan zhing khrag dang mkhris pa skyed/ / rigs 'thungs skem dang sbom phan zhing / / rtsub rno lus sgo khyab cing sbyong / / rlung dang bad kan sel ba yin/ / gzhan du bsten na dug dang mtshungs/ / zhes bya ba 'di ni chang thams cad kyi thun mong gi yon tan brjod pa yin te/ de la chang ngo cog thams cad ni drod 'bar bar byed cing me'i shas bskyed pas na drod 'bar ro/ / yi ga 'bye zhing zas la sred pa skye bas na/ yi ga 'byed ces bya ste/ 'bras chan la sogs pa 'dod pa skyed pa'o/ / rno ba ni lus zung rnams spyod par byed cing / tshigs kyi mtshams 'byor dam po lhod par byed pa'o/ / drod skyed pa ni nus pa dang ldan pa dang / khong brta ba ni lus rgyas par byed ba'o/ / dga' ba ni sems mgu bar byed pa'o/ / mngar

skt: stehaprasaṅgena vasāmalajnāmedasāṃ guṇanirdairāmāhavasā tumedorūpā krāthitamāṃsasyopari gato'cchasneh‌bhāga iti kecit‌ } tathā~“śuddhamāṃsasya yaḥ stedaḥ sā vasā parikītyeteḥḥ ityanye | majā'sthno'ntadhaturasthnāṃ madhyavartī | tau vātnau vāte nāśayataḥ balpittakaphāṃśca tathā | māṃsānugatasvarūpau ca | yasya prāṇinaḥ sambandhinau tau bhavatastanmāṃsasadṛrasvarūṣau vijñeyau śaivyaupṇyādimirīṇaiḥ | tathāca carakamunivinirdiśet‌ tena jāṅgalādimedabhinnāyā yonethathāsvaṃ guṇistañnā vasāmajā viniradairot‌ | medo'pi tāviva vasāmajayoḥ sadaśaphachaṃ vijñeyamiti tairuvaiḥ
tib: ro cung zad mngar ba dang / cung zad kha ba dang / de bzhin du zhu ba'i rjes dang / ro cung zad skyur ba nyid yin pa dang / 'khru ba ste khong 'khru bar byed pa dang / bska bcas zhes bya ba/ cung zad bska ba'i ro dang ldan pa'o/ / de bzhin du gdangs snyan par byed pa'ang yin te/ gdangs snyan pa ni tshig gsal zhing gdangs mtho ba'o/ / nad med pa ni tha mal par gnas pa nyid de/ de byed pa dang / spobs pa ni smra ba las zhum pa med par 'gyur ba dang / mdog ste mdangs dang ldan la yang ba nyid dang / gnyid med pa dang / / gnyid che ba la phan zhing bsod pa ni chang thams cad ma yin gyi/ gang bad kan la sogs pa 'phel bar byed pa ni gnyid med pa la phan te/ dper na 'bru'i chang la sogs pa lta bu'o/ / chang la la ni gnyid che ba la phan te/ gang bad kan la sogs pa sel bar byed pa sbrang chang la sogs pa lta bu'o/ / yang na mthu nyid kyis chang thams cad gnyid med pa dang / gnyid che ba la phan no/ / khrag dang mkhris pa skyed pa ni khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad sel bar byed pa'o/ / rigs 'thungs skems dang sbom phan zhing / / zhes pa ni mi skem po dang tsho zhing sbom pa la phan zhing bsod pa yin no/ / zhes spyir smos su zin kyang chang la la ni skem pa la phan pa yin la/ chang la la ni sbom pa la phan pa yin gyi/ sbom pa la phan pa de nyid skem pa la phan pa ni ma yin no/ / yang na zas la sogs pa dang ran par 'thungs pa'i dbang gis sam/ sbyor ba la sogs pa'i dbang gis sam/ rdzas kyi nus pa'i dbang gis thams cad kyang skem pa dang sbom pa la phan pa yin no/ / de bzhin du rtsub pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / rno ba ni rtsa phra mo rnams la 'jug par byed pa'o/ / lus kyi sgo khyab cing sbyong ba ni bad kan dang / rlung dang / tshil dang / / dri mas yongs su gang ba rnams dri ma med par byed pa'o/ / de bzhin du de ran par 'thungs na rlung dang bad kan dag kyang sel zhing 'joms pa yin no/ / de la ran pa zhes bya ba ni cha mnyam pa'i sbyor ba ste/ thun tshod dang / yul dang dus la sogs pa'i rnam pa shes par byas nas/ de dang rjes su gang mthun pa gang 'thung ba de ni/ de'i rigs pa'am ran pa yin no/ / de nyid kyis na gzhung las/ de bas 'di yi sbyor bshad pa/ / gang zhig bder gyur 'ba' zhig phyir/ / zhes bshad pa dang / de bzhin du nus stobs dang dus dang / / yul dang / bdag nyid kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa dang / mthun pa'i grogs dang / nad kyi tshul dang / na tshod kyi rim pa shes par byas nas/ de dang rjes su mthun par 'thungs na bdud rtsi 'thungs pa dang mtshungs pa yin gyi/ de las gzhan par rigs pa dang mi ldan zhing / rnam par ma dpyad par 'thungs na dug dang mtshungs shing 'dra ba yin no/ / mi rigs par 'thungs pa ni dman pa'am/ log pa'am ha cang mang du 'thungs pa yin no/ / de yang bsdus pa chen po las chang la sogs pa bsten pa ni blo dang brtan pa dang / dran pa 'phrog par byed pa yin no zhes bshad do/ / chang sar lci zhing nyes skyed yin/ / chang rnying de las gzhan du byed/ / ces bya ba la/ chang de thams cad las chang sar pa ni lci zhing nyes pa rnams 'khrugs la skyed par byed pa yin no/ / chang rnyings shing grungs mar gyur pa/ kha dog dang dri dang ro phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i chang thams cad ni sngar bshad pa'i chang sar pa de las gzhan du byed de/ de yang zhing nyes pa sel bar byed pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang mkhris pa ni skyed la/ rlung dang bad kan ni 'joms pa yin par sngar bshad pa yin no/ /

skt: tacra madyayuṣṇopacareṇa-na peya na pātyam‌) capvāra; kriyā sā cāhāstavahāraśūpā | uṣṇenāhareṇoṣme ca kale bhapmādye upmenātapādinārtaina puruṣeṇa na peyama | tathā virakte kṛtavirecanena dhārtera bubhukṣitena na yeyam‌ | gulmodasaśobhad‌ṇīdovasya sā'vasthā yasya pyaṃ nivāsyate tathā nātha mṛṭu madhyaṃ peyaṃ vaśvā'spattamāsam‌ aspena sambharaṇa drākṣeubhabharatinā katata sāyattā sokapāśeḥ daveta sasbhāreṇa sandhīyate tadapekṣayā cādpaklambhāre tathā kaluṣa pāṃrukayadipabhiryutaṃ la peyam‌
tib: chang de thams cad tsha zhing dro ba'i kun tu spyod pa dang ldan pa'i skyes bus btung bar mi bya'o/ / de la spyod pa zhes bya ba ni bya ba ste/ de yang zas dang spyod lam gyi tshul te/ zas tsha ba zos pa'i rjes dang / so ga la sogs pa tsha ba'i dus dang / nyi tshan la sogs pas gdungs shing tsha ba'i skyes bus btung bar mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du chang gis sun pas de'i tshe/ btung bar mi bya ba dang / de bzhin du bkres pas nyen zhing zil gyis mnan pa'i mis mi btung ba dang / de bzhin du nad pas btung bar mi bya ste/ de bas na lus kyi gnas skabs las dpags te/ chang mi btung ba yang yod pas shes par bya'o/ / de bzhin du shin tu rno zhing tsha bas mi btung ba dang / shin tu gzhon zhing 'jam pas ni mi btung ba dang / de bzhin du legs par ma bslangs pa ste/ rgun 'brum dang / bu ram shing dang / 'bras bu dang / sbrang rtsi la sogs pa dang / ta ki la sogs pa'i rtsi nyung zad dang sbyar zhing / chang du legs par ma reg pa yang btung bar mi bya'o/ / rnyog can yin zhes bya ba ni rdul dang / / 'dam rdzab dang / bong ba dang / rdo'i gseg ma la sogs pa dang ldan pa dang btung bar mi bya'o/ / 'bru chang skran dang dmu rdzing dang / / rtug skem glo gcong sel ba dang / / rlung 'joms tshil dang khrag skyed cing / / gcin bder 'byin dang bad kan skyed/ / ces bya ba ni/ chang gang 'bras sA lu btags pa las byas pa/ ska zhing dkar ba de'i yon tan 'di dag yin te/ chang des skran la sogs pa sel zhing 'joms pa dang / tshil skyed par byed pa dang / de bzhin du lci zhing rlung 'joms par byed pa dang / tshil la sogs pa skyed cing 'phel bar byed do/ /

chang gi dngas ma steng du byung ba rnyog pa med pa chu lta bu de la ni dngas ma zhes bya ste/ de yang lung las/ dngas ma chu zhes bya bar bshad/ / 'dzag bde de bzhin chang yin la/ / de 'og bska ba zhes bya ste/ / de yi 'og ma snyigs mar bshad/ / ces 'byung ba yin no/ / chang gi dngas ma de ni snga ma'i chang ska ba'i yon tan gang yin pa de thams cad dngas ma 'di yang yin pas/ yon tan snga ma de dang 'dra bar shes par bya ba dang / de ni yang yid du 'ong zhing snying dga' bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du yang ba dang rno bas bad kan dang tshil la sogs pa sel bar byed pa dang / gzer ba la sogs pa yang 'joms shing sel ba yin no/ /

ba ru ra las sbyar ba'i chang ni ba ru ra'i chang ste/ de ni yang ba dang phan pa dang / shin tu ra ror mi 'gyur zhing / / zhes pa shas cher myos par mi byed pa dang / de bzhin du rma dang skya rbab kyi nad dang / mdze nad dag la de chang gzhan ltar ha cang mi gnod pa yin no/ / rdzas bzhin yon tan rjes mthun chang / / chang gi yon tan kun las lhag / pho nad skya rbab mdze gzhang 'brum/ / lus skem skrang 'or dmu rdzing rims/ / skran dang srin nad mcher nad sel/ / ro ni bska zhing tsha rlung skyed/ / ces bya ba la/

skt: susa-śadipiṣṭena karatā tasyā ime guṇāḥ suṇa gāsmādīn‌ harati | śobo-rājayakṣmā | tathā snehayatīti snehanī 1 gukhaḥ, aniruṣnī-vātarāmanī, tathā medaḥprabhṛtīnyāvahati prāpayati janayatītyadhaiḥ | stantha--khīkṣīram‌

dayusayā accha upariṣaṭānṇḍo vāra parasannivayucyataṃ | tathā ca āgasaḥ-prasannā vāraṇa ñcayā pariṣnbhadiya yathā || dasra canasuḥ sad‌ jagalaḥ smṛtaḥ | 2 taddhaghomoge canājamara sā vāṇī, tadraṇā pasthā paryāsaḥ; susayā gaṇāsti spa prasannāya apari cikṣiyāḥ | tethā dyā hṛdayāya hitā } ṭhaṣcī tīkṣṇā ca chapmasadaḥpraḥ tīn‌ kṣipati nihanti vindaścaṣayati | tathā śṭa dīn‌ nihanti-nilāśayati | civandhaḥ--śrautasāsu" lepena dauṣādīnāmavahanam‌

ariṣṭo--dravyasaṃyogasaṃskārakrāthavidhinā karataḥ | sa ca yaidaivayiṣkādhya saṃdhīyate āsutyayā kriyate teṣāṃ ya guṇāstānaṅakaroti anugacchati tadahuṇo bhavatītyathaiḥ | svemadyaguṇādhdhakaḥ-saravedīpanādhemedyaguṇiradhikaḥ | tathā prahaṇyādikāṃśca rogāna hanti-~nārāyati ) prahā vāmapāścaivaratī | sa cāriṣṭau staḥ kaṣāyaḥ kaṭuśca tathā vātaro , vātakārī ca
tib: rdzas gang bskol nas byas pa'am/ mnan nas byas pa na/ de rnams kyi yon tan de de'i rjes su 'gro zhing rjes su 'brang ba ste/ de'i yon tan dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ / zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de yang chang gi yon tan kun las lhag ces bya ba yin te/ drod skyed pa la sogs pa'i chang gi yon tan thams cad las yon tan lhag cing mang ba yin pa dang / de bzhin du pho ba'i nad la sogs pa'i gnod pa rnams sel zhing 'joms pa yin no/ / de'i ro ni bska ba dang tsha ba yin zhing rlung skyed par byed pa yin no/ /

skt: mṛīkāyā ida mādrīka~mṛdrīkārasoḥ madyaṃ sadā peyam‌ | taca ṭhekhanaṃ-vikaṣaiṇam‌ | ā tekṣaṇyāt‌ śepmādīnapanudati | tathā hya hadaya! priyam‌ | nādyuṣṇe na kicittathā rasato madhuram‌ tathā sara̭-bhedi | tathā atpapittāniṭamaspāṃ pira niṅau yasya tattathā | anyamadyāpekṣayā'spau karyo tathā pāṇḍumehācaḥkramīn‌ nāśayati
tib: rgun 'brum las byas pa'i chang ni rgun chang ste/ de ni nad sbyong zhing sel ba yin te/ / shin tu rno ba yin pas bad kan la sogs pa sel ba yin no/ / snying la phan pa ni snying dga' bar byed pa'o/ / shin tu dro ba ma yin pa ni cung zad dro ba'o/ / mngar ba ni ro mngar ba'o/ / de bzhin du 'khru bar byed pa dang / mkhris pa dang rlung cung zad skyed pa ni/

bu ram las byas pa'i chang gi bye brag gis ni bu ram chang ste/ de ni gcin rtug 'gags pa 'byin pa yin te/ gcin 'gags pa dang rtug pa dang 'phyen 'gags pa 'byin zhing phyi rol du bde bar byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du/ tshim zhing ngoms par byed pa dang / me'i drod gsal bar byed cing skyed par byed pa yin no/ /

skt: tathā medaraḥlopodasaśausi hanti vināśapati ! tatra tayohayosīdhvobhedhye pakvarasaḥ sādhuḥ raḥ śreṣṭhaḥ 1} 56 || ha° tayormadhye pakrarasaḥ śreṣṭha;
tib: bu ram chang ni bu ram shing gi khu ba bskol ba dang / ma bskol ba las byung ba ste/ de yang lung las/ bu ram shing khu'i bu ram chang / / rlon pa yis ni nus pa bsil/ / bskol ba bskol ma'i chang zhes bya/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / bu ram chang de ni rlung dang mkhris pa skyed par byed pa yin la/ snum las byung ba dang / bad kan las byung ba ni 'joms shing sel bar byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du tshil dang / 'or nad dang / gzhang 'brum dang / sbos pa sel ba yin no/ / de las zhes pa bu ram shing las byung ba'i chang gnyis kyi nang nas khu ba bskol ba'i chang ni mchog ste dam pa yin no/ /

skt: śuktaṃ-ruktākhyaṃ madayamevaguṇaṃ bhavāti | sarva maca prāyeṇa pecarsamapi kāṭhāntareṇa yadā tasya sandhitasya catvāro ssā madhurādayo yinivartyante | amla ekaḥ sutarāmabhivadhaite | tathā śuktasaṃjñāmāsādayati ) ataevāmṭapākarasabhiti savai mada nirdiṣ śuktamāhaḥ | savai madaya kāṭāntareṇāsyarthamamḍībhūte śuktamucyate ityāgamaḥ | taca raktapintakapocchedi teṣāsūlchedaḥ svasthānāt‌ cyāvasa̭ṃ vyastasamastānāṃ raktapintakaphānābhukledaṃ karoti raktapintakaphorchedi tathā vātamanukhīmayati vātānulomanam‌ | aturo myate'neneti vā | māga̭ntarebhyo vātamānīya svamāpratipannaṃ karoti | bātānulakhemanaṃ vātasātmyakaramityarthaḥ | tacca mūṛśāmalayatha tīkṣṇamuṣṇaṃ śakṣamabhṭaṃ ca ) tathā sādhuṃ hya tathā ruci karotīti rucikaraṃ tathā sara-medi dīpayatīti dīpanamabhisandhukṣakam‌ | vathā rikiraspadī śiiraḥ sparśo yasya tattathā|tathā pāṇḍ‌ragaṣṭat‌-pāṇḍūyegaṃ daherate tathā chakamīn‌ nārāya" tīti karamināśnam‌ |} 58 ||
tib: sbrang rtsi dang da ta ki la sogs pa sbyar ba las byas pa'i chang ni sbrang chang ste/ de ni 'grib byed ces bya ba tshil la sogs pa 'grib par byed cing / rno ba las lus zungs rnams sel bar byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du gcin nad dang / cham pa dang lud pa'i nad sel zhing rgyal bar byed pa yin no/ / tsha ni khrag mkhris bad kan dag/ 'ju zhing rlung ni snyoms byed la/ / rab tu tsha zhing rno rtsub skyur/ / yid 'ong yi ga 'byed cing 'khru/ / drod skyed reg na bsil ba dang / / skya rbab srin sel mig la gnod/ / ces bya ba ni/ chang thams cad phal cher ro lnga dang ldan pa yin du zin kyang / dus las yol zhing gzhan du gyur pa na/ gang gi tshe de'i mngar ba la sogs pa'i ro bzhi yal nas ro skyur ba 'ba' zhig shas cher 'phel zhing bdo ba de'i tshe/ de ni tsha zhes bya ste/ de nyid kyis na chang thams cad ni zhu ba'i rjes skyur ba yin no/ / zhes bstan pa yin no/ / de yang lung las/ shin tu skyur ba tsha zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de'i phyir chang thams cad ni dus yun ring po lon pa dang / shin tu skyur bar 'gyur ba ni tsha zhes bya'o/ / zhes sman dpyad kyi lung la brten pa rnams zer ro/ / tsha de ni khrag dang mkhris pa dang bad kan dag 'ju bar byed cing rang gi gnas nas skyod par byed de/ tha dad pa las 'dres pa yin par shes par bya'o/ / de bzhin du rlung snyoms par byed pa yin pas na/ rlung ni snyoms byed la zhes bya ste/ 'dis snyoms pa'am zhi bar byed pa'o/ / de yang lam gzhan na gnas las byung ba drangs nas/ rang gi gnas su gnas par rdzas gang gis byed pa de ni/ rlung 'joms par byed pa ste/ lam log pa na gnas pa rang gi gnas su 'jog par byed do zhes bya ba'i don to/ / yang de ni rab tu rno ba dang / rtsub pa dang / skyur ba dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / yi ga 'byed par byed pa dang / khong 'khru ba dang / pho ba'i me drod skyed pa dang / reg pa bsil ba dang / bskus shing byugs na bsil bar byed pa dang / mig la gnod pa yin no/ /

bu ram la sogs pa'i tsha ni phyi ma ji lta ba bzhin du yang ba yin te/ de yang bu ram chang gi tsha las bu ram shing gi khu ba'i tsha yang ba yin la/ bu ram shing gi khu ba'i tsha bas ni chang gzhan gyi tsha ba yang ba yin la/ chang thams cad kyi tsha bas ni rgun chang gi tsha ba yang ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /

skt: kaṃdādi tadā''sutaṃ guḍayuktādiyutaṃ tadat‌ | tacchuktasamānayuṇaṃ jānīyāt‌ | chuktenādhyudāktinā parityajya nijaṃ svabhāvaṃ varīkṛvyā''saga nīyata iyathaḥ | āyaprahaṇātkāṃḍatakpatrādihaḥ | tena koṃḍāyapi tatheva vedyam‌
tib: de la tsha de rnams nyid dang / sdong bu dang / rtsa ba dang / 'bras bu la sogs pa mnan pa las byung ba yang de dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ / tsha shin tu dro ba'i nus pa dang stobs su ldan pa dang 'dra bar sdong bu la sogs pa las mnan te byas pa yang de dang 'dra ba'o/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni shun pa dang lo ma la sogs pa bsdu'o/ /

rdo gu la sogs pa'i tshod ma'i rnam pa mnan nas skyur por byas pa de ni yang ba dang / zas len zhing yi ga 'byed pa yin la/ de bzhin du rdo gu dang / rtsa ba dang / 'bras bu la sogs pa'i dus ring por skyur por gyur pa dang / yang zhing zas len par byed pa yin no/ / des na de gnyi ga yang yi ga 'byed par byed pa yin no/ /

'bras khu'i rang skyur ni 'bras kyi khu le mnan nas/ rang skyur du gyur pa'i btung ba kany+dzi zhes bya ba ste/ de ni chang dang / tshwa dang / skyur po dang / cung zad skyur bas sde tshoms 'di'i nang du bstan pa yin te/ ji ltar chang yo byad bsags nas nad pa de bzhin du rang skyur 'di yang byed pa dang / gzhan yang chu mang ba nyid kyis/ chang dang 'dra zhing reg pa bsil ba yin no/ / de 'khru ba ste/ khong 'khru ba yin no/ / de skad du lung las/ bshang ba la sogs gang po ni/ / 'jig pas 'khru ba zhes bshad de/ / de las bzlog pa 'gags pa ni/ / rtug skam zhes ni bya bar bshad/ / ces 'byung ba yin no/ / rno ba ni bad kan la sogs pa 'jig pa'o/ / mkhris pa skyed pa ni mkhris pa 'phel bar byed pa'o/ / bskus na bsil zhes bya ba ni/ lus kyi phyi rol nas bskus na tsha ba sel ba'o/ / ngal rmya sel zhes bya ba ni/ / rtsol zhing las su byed pa la sogs pas zhum zhing zhan par gyur pa ni/ ngal ba sel zhes bya ba la sogs pa mi byed par lus zhum zhing nyam chung ba ni rmya ba zhes bya ste/ de dag sel bar byed pas na/ ngal ba dang rmya sel zhes bya'o/ / yi ga 'bye ba ni zas 'dod pa'i ngang tshul can no/ / yi ga 'chus par byed pa nges par 'joms pa yin pa'i phyir drod skyed pa'o/ / chu so'i nad sel zhing zhes bya ba ni/ lgang pa'i nad sel zhing 'byin par byed pa yin pas na de skad ces bya'o/ / mas gtong la phan yid du 'ong / / yang zhing rlung dang bad kan 'joms/ / zhes bya ba la/ / de bzhin du mas gtong ba la phan pa zhes bya ste/ mas gtong ba ni rlung las gyur pa'i nad la/ sbu gu nas mar khu la sogs pa bshang ba'i lam nas 'dzud pa ste/ de ni 'og nas bshad par bya'o/ / gzhan dag ni go sla'o/ / ba gcin ra lug ma he dang / / glang po rta bong rnga mo'i

skt: dahāṇḍākī śāṃlādyāsurya kiyate sā sa canī, chuṣvī ca | tathānyat‌ kandabhūlapharādi kāe~ nāmḍībhūta yecanaṃ rucyai, chghu ca | tena tadkukhayaṃ secanaṃ rucikaram‌

gomūtradirmatarasyāevidhasyed‌ nirdaśo oṣṇaguṇamayasavāta|taccāṣṭakāra pittaṃ pittara tathā hadca tīkṣṇabhupṇaṃ ca khavaṇo'nuraso yasya vaṇānussam‌| anuraso-rakhasya yaḥ paścādbhavati eyakta vyakto vīḥ kiñvirdante ca } tathāca yati | tatra vyakto rapaḥ smṛtaḥ | agyakto'nusaḥ vadante bhyakto'pi cekṣate | tathā ssatastatkaḍ‌rādīśca jayet‌ lghu ca bhavati |1 86 || de0-mūñvaguṇānāha--mādidhīti dīliṅganirdeyo māhi (nāṃ khī, saṃjādīnāṃ puṃsā muta grāhyamiti jñāpanātha la vīśṇoṇavvādisābhyānmacayavarge nirdeśaḥ | saṃgrahe galaḥ pācano prādahī raśastadvaca mecakaḥ | vakasa sārābhī-doṣakopanaḥ || kadalī vṛṇī guvīṃ | chaṣmalchu madhṛṭakaḥ | sādvīkālvāntaraguṇaṃ saṅgaraṃ vātale gura || śārkaraḥ surabhiḥ svadudaiyo nātimado dadhuḥ surāsavastīvamadaḥ sadasatadaṇo'nikhāpaṭaḥ || bhairetho madhuro iṣyaḥ saraḥ saṃtapapaṇe guruḥ| dhātukyamiputo jīrṇo rakṣo rocanadīpanaḥ| drākṣāsavo madhutamaḥ parama pa tu dīpanaḥ) mārakaḥ dhokte mṛdīekṣarasāsavaḥ; || samāsādāsavo hyo vātalaḥ svīpadhānugaḥ | dīpane prāne bhedṭhi teṣu momūtaramuttamam‌ || śadhāsakāsaṃhraṃ chāga praṇā ṇaṃyukhbhit‌ | dākṣi | parinsama ca gavā jisamuddhavam‌ ` || hansayunmādamapasmāraṃ kṛrmanyih‌ ca rāsamabham‌ | kapāyatiktametapāṃ dibhamāśrāsaha rt‌ || pittaṃ ̱tiktaṃ kamidaraṃ ronākapaphavātajit‌ ) tiktaṃ pāmāharaṃ mūṃ mānupaṃ 8 vipāpaham‌|| !2 ini || ini sathapūñcavarmaḥ 1} 83 || toyasīteṭhānāṃ varmasya ca tamāt‌ | hṛti dramekadeśā'ye yathagasthūṭamudāhataḥ 585 ||
tib: ba gcin la sogs pa'i gcin rnam pa brgyad 'dir bstan pa ni dro ba dang rno ba'i yon tan mang bas/ chang dang cha mthun pa yod pa bshad pa yin la/ rnam pa de brgyad char yang mkhris pa skyed ces bya ba ste/ mkhris pa 'phel bar byed pa dang / rtsub pa dang / rno ba dang / tsha ba yin zhing 'thungs pa'i rjes lan tshwa bro ba gang yin pa de ni 'thungs rjes tsha bro zhes bya ste/ 'thungs pa dang ro gzhan gyi rjes la lan tshwa bro ba yin la/ de yang gsal ba dang mi gsal bar bshad do/ / de la ro ni gsal zhes bya/ / mi gsal ba ni 'thungs rjes ro/ / mthar gsal bar yang 'dod pa yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de bzhin du ro las tsha ba yin pa dang / srin bu la sogs pa 'joms shing yang bar 'gyur ba yin no/ / de ltar chu bo bu ram shing / / til mar chang gi sde tshoms rim/ / gsher pa'i rdzas phyogs gcig pa 'di/ / rags rim ji bzhin bstan pa yin/ / zhes bshad pa ni/ / de ltar zhes bya ba bshad ma thag pa'i rnam pas chu dang 'o ma la sogs pa gsher ba'i rdzas kyi sde tshoms kyi tshogs kyi rim pa'i bstan pa dang / bshad pa'i tshul ji lta ba phyogs gcig ces pa/ yan lag gi phyogs gcig gam/ cung zad tsam bstan pa yin gyi/ gsher ba'i rdzas mtha' dag ma lus pa bstan cing bshad pa ni ma yin te/ de dag ni rags rim ji bzhin bstan pa yin/ zhes bya ba ste/ rags shing sbom pa ma bor ba tsam du rags rim mthong ba bstan pa yin gyi/ zhib tu phra ba las rnam par dpyad pa ni mtha' yas pa yin no/ / de bas cung zad tsam zhig kho bos smras pa yin no/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/

skt: ayamasya sambandhaḥ | ādikāle bhagavān‌ chakān‌ siyaśanuḥ pūve madhamevāsūjat‌ | tato'nantaramanna tataḥ prajā evamato'nantaramannasvarūpavijñānīyo'bhyāya ārabhyate | annasvarūpaṃ saṃskaratamasaṃchṛtaṃ, tasya rasanīyavipākamrabhāvaruṇakarmāṣi tasya vikṣānamavanarodhaḥ tasme hito'dhyāyastamannaṃ ca yada, thataṃ dharānyamāṃsādi ; dhānyaṃ highānagukaja-kinidhānyaseena 1 tannāpi prādhānyāt‌ śukadhānyasyāmara nirdeśaḥ) prādhānyaṃ ca tasya bhūyassavenopayogāt‌
tib: / / de nas kha zas kyi tshul brtag cing shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ / zhes bya ba la/ 'di'i 'grel pa ni 'di yin te/ gna' dang po 'jig rten chags pa'i dus su dang po ni chu nyid byung ba yin la/ de'i 'og tu ni zas byung ngo / / de'i 'og tu ni sems can byung ba yin no/ / de ltar na 'di'i rjes thogs la kha zas kyi tshul brtag cing shes par bya ba'i le'u brtsams pa yin no/ / de la zas kyi rang bzhin gyi tshul ni g.yos su byas pa dang / g.yos su ma byas pa ste/ de'i ro dang / nus pa dang / zhu ba'i rjes dang / mthu stobs dang / yon tan la sogs pa dang / de brtag cing shes par bya ba ni khong du bcud pa ste/ de la phan par byed pa'i le'u gang yin pa de bshad par bya'o/ / de la zas ni gang bza' bar bya ba ste/ 'bru la sogs pa'o/ / 'bru yang gra ma can dang / gang bu can gyi dbye bas rnam pa gnyis so/ / de las kyang gra ma can gtso bo yin pas dang por bstan te/ de gtso bor gyur pa ni mang du dgos shing zhes pa yin gyi/ gang bu can gyi 'bru ni sran tshod la sogs pa nyid kyis cung zad dgos pa'i phyir gtso bo ma yin/ de bas na 'dir smras pa ni/

skt: ri vidhānyasya tu supādinā vahyajanasena svaspopayogitvādaprādhānyamityāh‌-anyebhyaḥ parādi bhyā raktaśālyādīnāṃ śraṣṭhasvātt‌ prathamamabhighānam‌ | raktadyāstapanāyāntāḥ | rāṭayaḥ| anye ca tatsa drāḥ śubhāḥ rākhyaḥ | te sarvai svādupākarasāḥ 1 “raktaśāliverapteṣu vadhyau varṇya̭khidoṣājet‌ 1 caśṭhuṣyo mūtralaḥ syaḥ chukaṭhastṛḍjvarāpahaḥ || viṣavaṇaśrā sakrāsadāhanudrāhi puṣṭida: | tasmādrpāntarayuṇāḥ śñākhyo saha dādayaḥ || (bhā. bhra. ) ^ staśārinidoṣannī caṣuṣyā mūtra gahā | sahārāliragurayaṣyā cakṣuṣyā badatārdhana| || iti hārītaḥ | 2 koṣṭakāntageto'trādhikaḥ pāṭho chakhaṃyatate ! sthānam‌ ] | saṭipyaṇaradīkābhayasaṃvise a0 6, ( 931) madhurātaipākā madhurarsāśca | snigdhāstathā vṛṣyāḥ śuklāḥ ! vaddha. rathitamaspaṃ ca varca̭ḥ purīṣaṃ kurvanti ye te baddhālpavacaisaḥ | kaṣāyā'nnaraseoyeṣāṃ te kaṣāthānurasāḥ | pathyā-hitāstathā rucavo ṭhaghuyuṇayuktāḥ | bhūtralā-mūtrajanakāḥ | himāḥ śīttavīyauḥ | tatra teṣu śukeṣu madhye
tib: 'bras gzhan dag las sA lu rtsa snar rak+ta li/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni gtso bo yin pas na dang por smos pa yin no/ / de la rak+ta sha li nas gser mdog can zhes/ Ta pa li zhes bya ba'i 'bras dang / gzhan yang gang dag de dang 'dra ba'i 'bras dkar po bzang po de thams cad ni ro mngar ba dang / zhu ba'i rjes mngar ba yin pa dang / snum pa dang / ro tsa zhing khu ba 'phel ba dang / bshang gci ska zhing bsgongs pa chung ngur byed pa dang / ro'i rjes bska zhing bska ba'i ro dang ha cang mi gsal zhing / shas chung ba dang ldan pa dang / phan zhing gnod pa sel ba dang / de bzhin du yang ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / gcin mang zhing 'phel bar byed pa dang / bsil zhing grang ba'i nus pa yod pa ste/

skt: yo rakto śāliḥ savara śraṣṭhaḥ tathā vṛṣṇā hdakhidoṣapnaś
tib: de la rtse mo rno zhing gra ma can de rnams kyi nang na rtsa snar te/ rak+ta sha li ni mchog dang dam pa yin la/ de ni skom dad sel ba dang / nyes pa gsum sel bar byed pa yin no/ / de yi 'og tu 'bras chan dman/ / de'i 'og ka ma la de'i 'og / ces bya ba ni/ rak+ta sha li de'i 'og tu ni 'bras chan te/ ma hA sha li zhes bya ba yon tan gyis snga ma las dman pa yin la/ ma hA sha li de'i 'og ka ma la ni de bas kyang yon tan chung ba yin no/ / de bas kyang de'i 'og ma drug cu pa la sogs pa de rnams rim gyis/ snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma yon tan chung ba yin no/ /

skt: yaṃvakādyāḥ śāṅyaḥ svādavo ` madhurarasāḥ tāthoṣṇavīyau guravaśca, snigdharuṇayogāt‌ snigdhāsathā pake'mchāḥ-amkaṃ pacyante | śeṣmapintachāḥ śepmapittajanakāḥ | sajanti bahiḥ kṣipanti mūtrapurīṣaṃ yete saṣṭamūtrapurīṣāḥ | tathā pūrvai pūrvai ca ninditāḥ | yoṃ yasmāt‌ yasmāsapūrvaḥ sa tasmātta smāninditi; garhitaḥ tena neṣadhaghakāt‌ pāṃḍubāppo ninyaḥ | pāṃśubāpyāddhāyanaḥ | hāyanādyavakaḥ | evaṃ thayako'tirāyena sarvaibhyo ninya;
tib: nas 'dra zhes bya ba ya ba ka la sogs pa'i 'bras rnams ro mngar zhing bsil ba dang / de bzhin du/ nus pa dro zhing lci ba dang / / snum pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas snum pa dang / zhu ba'i rjes skyur ba nyid du smin par 'gyur ba dang / bad kan dang mkhris pa skyed cing 'phel bar byed pa dang / bshang ba dang gci ba thur du 'byin zhing phyi rol du 'byung bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du snga ma snga ma ste/ gang zhig gang las snga mar gyur zhing / gong ma yin pa de smad cing mchog ma yin pa nyid yin no/ / des na ni shad las char ma rdul can du skyes pa smad pa yin la/ char ma las ni ha yan smad pa yin la/ de las nas 'dra zhes pa smad pa yin te/ de ltar na thams cad las ya ba ka zhes pa nas 'dra smad pa yin no/ / 'bras nang drug cu pa mchog ste/ / rtsa ser shun pa gnag pa dag /

'bras sha sri ka zhes bya ba drug cu pa ni snum pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas na snum pa'o/ / brtan pa ni lus brtan par byed cing / de bzhin du ngal ba dang / dub pa dang / rmya ba sel ba yin te/ de nyid kyis na bcud kyis len dang / rims la sogs pa de dang der lus nyam chung zhing sbeg pa la sbyin pa nyid du bstan pa yin no/ / de ni 'bru rnams kyi yon tan gyi nang na mchog yin la/ de la yang rtsa ser ba dang / shun pa gnag pa'i dbye bas rnam pa gnyis yod la/ de gnyis las kyang shun pa gnag pa bas rtsa ser ba mchog yin no/ / de las rim bzhin thug chen dang / / shun gnag rgya skyegs tshigs ma 'dra/ / khyim bya'i sgong 'dra 'ur pa'i mig /

drug cu pa dang / 'bras chan la sogs pa nas/ kun bin da'i mthar thug pa dag ni bzhin du yon tan dag chung zhing dman pa nyid du shes par bya'o/ / de ltar na thug po che'i yon tan las ni shun pa gnag pa dri sna bri ha zhes bya ba yon tan chung ba yin la/ de las ni rgya skyegs tshigs ma 'dra ba yin pas na/ 'bras thams cad las kun bin da yon tan chung ba nyid yin par shes par bya'o/ / 'bras gzhan mngar zhing zhu rjes skyur/ / mkhris pa skyed cing lci ba dang / / gcin rtug mang zhing tsha ba yin/ / pa ta la nyid nyes gsum skyed/ / ces bya ba ni/ 'bras gzhan zhes bya ba gong du ma bshad pa'i 'bras rnams ni ro mngar ba dang / de bzhin du zhu rjes skyur zhes pa/ zhu ba'i rjes skyur bar 'gyur ba dang / mkhris pa skyed cing 'phel ba dang / lci ba dang / / rtug pa mang bar 'gyur ba dang / tsha ba yin zhes bya ba drod skyed pa ste/ 'dir tsha ba'i sgra ni drod skyed pa la bya'o/ / mkhris pa ni ma yin te/ gong du mkhris pa skyed ces smos pa'i phyir ro/ / pa ta la nyid nyes gsum skyed/ / ces bya ba ni/ pa ta la zhes bya ba'i 'bras bu ni nyes pa gsum char skyed pa yin te/ gnod pa gsum shin tu 'khrugs pa yin par shes par bya ste/ nyes pa gsum skyed pa nyid kyis ni 'di bza' ba bkag pa yin no/ /

skt: vaśājāto dhajo, vayo veṇuyavā ityāsnāyāt‌ | sa vaṃkhajau yavo saknopṇa; | tethoṣṇaḥ uṣradhībhaiḥ
tib: ci tse la sogs pa'i rtsa can gyi 'bras bu ni bsil ba ste grang ba'i nus pa yod pa dang / yang ba dang rlung skyed cing 'phel bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du khong rtsub cing 'khrugs pa dang / bad kan dang mkhris pa sel zhing 'joms pa yin no/ / de la khre ni brta byed lci/ / lus kyi chag grugs 'byor bar byed/ / ces bya ba ni/ de la rtsa can gyi 'bru de rnams kyi nang nas khre ni lus brta bar byed pa dang / lci ba dang lus kyi yan lag gi chag grugs 'byor cing 'tsho bar byed pa yin no/ /

skt: godhūmo-raṣyaḥ khīgamanaśaśantikaraḥ, sīta śītīḥ, guruguṇayogādvaraḥ | tathā jligdhaḥ, jīvanaṃ ojasyaḥ, vātapitte hantīti vātapitta) sandhāḥ karotīti sandhānakārī, sadhuro-madhurassaḥ, sra karotīti bhinatti
tib: rtsa can gyi 'bru'i nang nas khre rgod de/ / ko tra ba ni shin tu yang 'khru ba gcod cing / sdud pa'i ngang tshul dang / reg na bsil ba ste/ phyi rol du bsku ba la sogs pa la sbyar na/ reg na bsil ba nyid kyis tsha ba sel bar byed do/ / dug sel zhing 'joms pa yin pas na/

nas ni rtsub pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas na rtsub pa'o/ / de bzhin du lci ba dang / ro mngar ba dang / cung zad khong 'khru ba dang / bshang ba dang / rlung 'phel zhing skyed pa yin te/ de nas bshang ba zad pa dag la drang srong dag gis 'di'i sbyor ba bshad pa yin no/ / de bzhin du ro tsa ba dang lus brtan par byed pa dang / gcin dang tshil la sogs pa sel zhing 'joms par byed pa yin no/ /

skt: nandīmukhī-kāpānī dīsakṣmā jātirgodhūmasya sā pathyā-pathyādanapetā, doṣāṇāṃ dhātūnāṃ ca sāmya 8 1) “godhūmaḥ chumano'pi sakhatrividhaḥ sa ca kīrtitaḥ mahāgodhūma ilyādyaḥ padhadiśātsamāgataḥ || madhūlī tu taḥ kithidaspā sā madhyadedajā | niḥścho dīdhagodhūmaḥ kiḥ ndībhukhāmidhaḥ || godhūmo madhuraḥ rīto vātapittaharo guraḥ kaphaśukaramado balyaṃ: ligdhaḥ sandhānakṛtasaraḥ ||| ovana vṛṇa varṇyo vraṇyo racyaḥ sthirasahṛt‌. | madhūlī śītalā kaṣiga pitataknī madhurā lakṣaḥ || śakla vṛhaṇī pathyā tṛdarndīmura sthānam‌ ] sarippaṇadhekāyaṃsaṃbaśite a0 6 ( 119 ) hatutyāt‌ hitā | śītā-sītavīrya, rase kaṣāyā, madhurā ca tathā ṭhaghuḥ chaṣvīti śūdhānyavageḥ
tib: nas dang dbyibs 'dra ba las/ shin tu phra ba la ni nas rgod ces bya ste/ de ni nas kyi yon tan las dman zhing zhan pa yin no/ /

smyig ma las skyes pas na smyig skyes pa ste/ 'od ma'i 'bras bu'i nas zhes lung las bshad pa'o/ / smyig ma las byung ba'i nas de ni smyig ma'i 'bras bu nas 'dra ba de rtsub pa dang / / de bzhin du tsha ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa yin no/ / gro ni ro tsa snum bsil lci/ / 'tsho byed rlung dang mkhris pa sel/ / chag grugs 'byor byed mngar ba dang / / sha mkhregs byed cing cung zad 'khru/ / zhes pa la/ gro ni ro tsa ba ste/ bud med la phod par byed pa dang / snum pa dang bsil ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin no/ /

nan di mu kha ni phran pa ste/ gro'i rigs su gtogs pa phra zhing ring ba yin te/ de ni bsil zhing ro mngar ba dang / bska ba dang yang ba'i yon tan dang ldan zhes gnod pa dang / dri ma rnams la phan zhing bsod pa yin no/ / gra ma can gyi 'bru sna tshogs kyi sde tshan no/ / / / tshod ma bya ba'i don du/ gra ma can gyi sde tshan gyi 'og tu/ gang bu chags pa'i 'bru'i sde tshan ston pa yin te/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/

skt: ñyajanār śukdhānyavaragādanantaraṃ divīdhānyasyārambhaḥ| jādakī-tumbasai| ādigrahaṇāt‌ kaṣātāṃ parimahaḥ ) tanmudrāri śimbidhānyaṃ srotasāṃ ndhaṃ karotīti vinta 1 tathā kaṣāyaṃ, madhura -se| saṃgrāhi-saṃmrahasīraṃ bhavatati, yaddhinnāmāṃ | purīṣārdāniāṃ piṇḍitavvaṃ saṃhatatvayutpādayati stambhayati | tathāṃ kaṭupākaṃ-kaṭukaṃ pacyate, jāṭareṇānninā yogādrasāntasameti | hima̭-sītavīrya raghu ca } bhedaḥ ṛṣmarkapitteṣu ṭepāvasekayo; pradehasecanayorhitaṃ pathyam‌
tib: mon sran sde'u ni sran mung+ga'o/ / mon sran dkar ru ni a d+ha ka zhes sam/ to ba ri zhes grags pa'o/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni sran ma la sogs pa yongs su bsdu'o/ / mon sran sde'u la sogs pa'i gang bu can gyi 'bru de rnams ni rtsa sbubs rnams kyi sgo 'gags par byed pas na/ rtsa sgo 'gags pa'o/ / de bzhin du ro ni mngar ba dang bska ba yin no/ / 'khru ba gcod pa ni gang bshang ba la sogs pa sla ba'am/ 'bye ba bsdus shing gong por byed pas na 'khru ba gcod pa yin no/ / de bzhin du zhu ba'i rjes tsha ba ste/ pho ba'i me drod dang phrad pa las ro gzhan du 'gyur ba'o/ / de bzhin du bsil zhing yang ba dang / tshil dang khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad brtags te/ bskus pa'i lus la khu ba blugs na phan zhing bde bar 'gyur ro/ /
gang bu can gyi 'bru 'di dag gi nang na mung+ga ni zhes pa/ mon sran sde'u mchog ste dam pa yin pa dang / de bzhin du rlung chung zhes bya ba ste/ rlung cung zhig skyed pa yin no/

mon sran dkar po rtsam sha zhes bya ba ni/ rlung shas cher skyed bar byed pa dang / rtsub pa dang / lci ba dang / bshang ba che zhing 'phel bar byed pa yin no/ / rgya sran nag tsha zhu rjes skyur/ / khu chu'i rde'u cham lud pa/ / dbugs mi bde rlung bad gzhang 'brum/ / 'joms shing khrag mkhris mchog tu skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ rgya sran nag po ku lang+tha zhes bya ba ni tsha ba ste/ nus pa tsha ba dang ldan pa dang / zhu rjes skyur ba ste/ smin pa dang skyur ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ / khu ba las skyed pa'i rde'u ni khu chu'i rde'u ste/ de la sogs pa 'joms pa dang / de bzhin du khrag mkhris mchog tu shas cher spyod par byed pa yin no/ / nis pa pa ni rlung mkhris khrag /

skt: niṣpāvo-vātapittaskallīstanyamūnnāṇi ccha roti, śudha | saro-bhedenaśīkhaḥ) vidādahī-vivṛraharasi garubhāvāṣidadyate | tathā dṛiṅukkapa soptaṃ si ca hanti ||.20 || |
tib: nis pa pa zhes bya ba'i sran rgod ni rlung dang / khrag dang / mkhris pa dang / bud med kyi nu zho dang / gcin 'phel bar byed pa dang / lci ba dang / khong 'khru ba dang / lus tsha bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du mig la gnod pa dang / khu ba 'bri zhing zad pa dang / bad kan zad pa dang / 'or nad dang / dug rnams sel bar byed ba yin no/ / ma sha snum stobs bad kan skyed/ / bshang gci mkhris pa 'phel byed 'khru/ / lci zhing tsha la rlung 'joms dang / / khu ba 'phel zhing 'byin par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ ma sha zhes bya ba mon sran gre'u ni snum zhing stobs skyed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin du khu ba mang du 'phel bar byed cing / khu ba de nyid mtshan gyi lam nas phyir 'byin par byed do/ /

ka kan du la zhes bya ba ni/ ming 'di nyid 'jig rten pa la grags pa yin no/ / kha sral phre'u ni sran ma ad ma ku pa ta ste/ sa la 'bying bar skye ba'o/ / 'bru de dag gi 'bras bu ni mon sran gre'u dang yon tan bar shes par bya ste/ sran ma ma sha la yon tan gang dag yod pa de thams cad dang ldan pa'i don to/ / til 'bru dro zhing pags pa 'jom/ / bsil zhing skra dang stobs skyed pa/ / lci zhing gcin nyung zhu rjes tsha/ / yid gzhungs drod skyed bad mkhris skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ til gyi 'bru ni dro ba ste/ nus pa dro ba dang / pags pa 'jam zhing mnyen par byed pa dang / bskus na reg pa bsil ba dang / skra skye ba dang / stobs skyed pa dang / de bzhin du lci ba dang / gcin nyung ngur byed pa dang / de bzhin du zhu ba'i rjes tsha ba dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / me'i drod skyed cing bad kan dang mkhris pa 'phel zhing skyed pa yin no/ /

skt: tilaḥ-uṣṇavīthastvacyassvavi sādhuḥ | 'himaḥ-ghṣe rītaḥ | keryaḥ-keśebhyo hitaḥ | bachaya hito vasyastathā guraḥ ! aspa̭ṃmūtrai karotīsyabhedopacāśat‌ aspamūṣraḥ sa evocyate | tathā pāke kaṭuḥ kaṭukaṃ vipacyate, medhābhbhikaphapittāni kaśeti | bhadhā prajñā
tib: zar ma'i 'bras bu ni snum pa dang / ro mngar zhing kha ba dang / nus pa dro ba dang / lci zhing bad kan dang mkhris pa skyed par byed pa dang / de bzhin du mig la gnod pa dang / khu ba skems shing zad pa dang / zhu ba'i rjes tsha ba yin no/ /

me tog le brgan rtsi'i sa bon yang bshad ma thag pa'i zar ma'i yon tan dang nyes pa cha mtshungs pa yin par shes par bya'o/ / gra ma can las nas rgod dang / / ma sha gang bu can tha tshad/ / ces bya ba la/ sngar gyi gra ma can rnams kyi tha chad ni nas rgod yin la/ gang bu can 'di dag gi nang na ni mon sran gre'u ste/

gra ma can gyi 'bru dang / gang bu can gyi 'bru gsar thog lor ma lon pa ni bad kan skyed cing 'phel bar byed de/ rtsa sbubs rnams nas sla zhing 'dzag pa las mngon par phyogs par zhu ba'i tshul gyis bad kan skyed pa yin la/ don gyis na rnying pa ni bad kan sel ba yin no/ / lor lon zhes pa lo gcig 'das pa'i 'bru thams cad ni yang ba yin pas/ 'bru gsar pa lci bar bshad du zin kyang / lci ba nyid yin par don gyis ston pa yin te/ lo gcig lon pa 'dis lci ba 'ba' zhig dang bral ba yin gyi/ nus dang bral ba ni ma yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang snum pa'i yon tan rim gyis nyung zad 'bri ba yin gyi/ de la rtsub pa zhes bya ba'i gnas skabs gzhan du gyur pa ni ma yin no/ / de yang rgyud gzhan dag las/

skt: umā-atasī stigdhā svādutiktā, se aṇā vīrye kaphapitte karotīti kaphāpittakarī; guvīṃ ca | tathā ṣṭi śuktaṃ ca harati dakḍukahan‌ | kaṭukaṃ pacyate tadradunantaroktatasīvadrairaru boddhavyam‌
tib: myur skye zhes bya ba ni myur du skye zhing smin pa'i 'bras bu ni yang ba yin pa dang / de bzhin du sran ma zhes pa/ mon sran sde'u la sogs pa'i gang bu can gyi 'bru rnams sbun med ces bya ba spun ma ma lus par bsil zhing shun pa med par byas pa dang / legs par brngos pa'i tshod ma'ang yang ba yin no/ / gang bur chags pa'i 'bru sna tshogs kyi sde tshan no/ / / / gra ma can dang gang bu can gyi 'bru sna tshogs kyi sde tshan bstan pa de dag kyang / / me la btsos pa la sogs pa'i g.yos su byas pa nyid kyis legs par dgos pa byed pa yin gyi gzhan du ni ma yin no/ / de bas na gra ma can dang gang bu can gyi sde tshan gyi 'og tu kha zas kyi sde tshan brtsams pa yin pas/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ 'bras thug sla ska gar ba dang / / 'bras chan rnams ni snga ma bzhin/ / yang ngo / / zhes bya ba ni 'bras thug slan te la sogs pa ni/ snga ma bzhin du yang ba yin par shes par bya ste/ des na 'bras ni yang ba yin la/ de las 'bras thug gar po yang ba yin/ gar po bas kyang 'bras thug skan te ches yang ba yin la/ de bas kyang 'bras thug slan te shin tu yang ba yin no/ / 'dir yang thug pa la sogs pa las thug pa slan te mchog yin pas na dang por bstan te/ 'di zas kyi rnam pa thams cad las mchog tu gyur pa ni/ rlung lugs dang mthun par 'jug pa la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams 'di nyid la yod pa'i phyir mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ / de yang / pi pi ling dang / dong gra dang / se'u 'bru dang / 'bras yos la sogs pa las byas pa'i zas kyi rnam pa shin tu sla ba ni/ 'bras thug slan te zhes bya ste/ de yang tsa ra kas/ pi pi ling dang dong gra dang / / se'u 'bras yos chur bcas bskol/ / thug pa slar sbyar me drod skyed/ / rlung yang lugs mthun rgyu bar byed/ / ces bshad pa yin no/ / 'bras thug slan te rkyang rkyang po/ / de las cung zad ska ba ni thug pa ska ba zhes bya la/ de bas kyang shin tu ska ba ni gar po zhes bya'o/ / de yang sman dpyad kyi lung las/ lci dang bral bar thug sla yin/ / lci ba dang ldan thug pa ste/ / lci ba ska ba gar po yin/ / nas thug 'bru ni tha dad gnas/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / 'bras chan ni 'bras bskol ba'i chan la bya la/ de las sla ba ni/ dge zhing rlung ni lugs mthun byed/ / skom rmya nyes pa lhag ma 'joms/ / 'ju zhing lus zungs mnyam par byed/ / rtsa sbubs mnyen byed rngul ba dang / / me yi drod ni skyed par byed/ / ces bya ba ni/ de la thug pa la sogs pa de rnams kyi nang nas 'bras thug slan te ni dge zhing nyes pa med cing bde bar gnas par byed la/ bsod cing phan pa yin no/ / zhes bya ba'i don to/ / rlung ni lugs mthun byed/ / ces bya ba ni/ lam log par zhugs pa rang gi rgyu ba'i gnas su 'jog par byed pa dang / mi bde ba bde bar byed do zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de bzhin du/ skom rmya nyes pa lhag ma 'joms/ / zhes bya ba ste/ skom gyis gdungs pa dang / rmya zhing nyam chung ba dang / nyes pa'i lhag ma rnams 'joms shing sel ba yin te/ skyug sman btang ba'am/ 'khru sman btang ba'am/ 'jam rtsi btang ba las nyes pa ste/ nad cung zad lus pa gang yin pa de ni nyes pa'i lhag ma ste/ skyug sman dang / 'khru sman dang / 'jam rtsi btang ba las nyes pa'i lhag ma yod pa la bya ba nyid du shes par byed pa ni 'di nyid yin par shes par bya ste/ nyes pa'i lhag ma cung zad yod pa'i phyir ni skyug sman dang / 'khru sman dang / 'jam rtsi mas gtong bar mi bya ste/ / sbyor ba thal ches pa'i nyes pa'i 'jigs pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ / 'ju zhing lus zungs mnyam par byed/ / ces bya ba ni/ lus zungs sam nyes pa rnams 'ju zhing smin par byed pas na 'ju zhing zhes bya'o/ / de bzhin du/ lus zungs rnams dang / / rlung la sogs pa mnyam zhing snyoms par byed pas na lus zungs mnyam par byed ces bya'o/ / de bzhin du/ rtsa sbubs mnyen par byed pa ste/ rtsa'i sbubs kyi tshogs mnyen zhing 'jam par byed pa dang / de bzhin du lus las rngul 'byung ba dang / pho ba'i me drod skyed cing zas rnams bde bar 'ju bar byed pa yin no/ / thug ska bkres skom nyam chung rmya/ / lto nad rims nad sel ba yin/ / dri ma 'gags la phan pa ste/ / drod skyed nad ni 'ju bar byed/ / ces bya ba ni/ thug pa cung zad ska ba ni bkres nas rims nad kyi bar sel zhing 'joms pa yin te/ nyam chung ba ni 'tsho ba'i stobs chung ba'o/ / rmya ba ni rid cing skem pa'o/ / lto nad ni tshad pa'i nad du 'khru ba dang / gzer dang skran la sogs pa'o/ / dri ma 'gags pa la phan pa ni dri ma rnams bde bar 'byin pa la phan zhing snyoms pa'o/ / drod skyed pa ni 'dis me'i drod 'phel ba'o/ / 'ju bar byed pa ni nyes pa rnams 'ju zhing smin par byed pa'o/ / thug gar 'khru gcod yi gar 'ong / / skem sel drod skyed rma dang mig /

skt: parayā-śudādijvaraparyantaṃ hanti | mṭānirapa cayaḥ, dauvasya̭--śalyaprāṇitā ! kaścirogātīsārama.haṇīdoparadyalagutmavidradhyādivātādīnanalomayati | vātāvulomanī vātādeḥ tasya̱ svamāmdhāpinī | pabhyā-hitā | dīpayayanmimiti dyīpanī, pācayanyāmabhiti pācanī ca
tib: thug pa gar po ni 'khru ba gcod pa ste/ bshang gci sla ba gong bur byed pa dang / yi gar 'ong ba ste/ yid du 'ong zhing dga' bar byed pa dang / skom sel zhes bya ba skom gyis gdungs pa zhi bar byed pa dang / drod skyed ces pa me drod skyed pa dang / de bzhin du rma byung ba dang / mig nad can dang / bkru sman dang skyug sman gyis sbyangs pa'i rjes la/ nyam chung zhing sbeg pa dang / mar la sogs pa'i snum bag 'thungs pa rnams la yang phan zhing bsod pa yin no/ /

skt: ya odanaḥ yudhautaḥ suṣṭu prakṣāṭitaḥ tathā prasarataḥ-prakarṣaṇa srāvitaḥ, sinnaḥ-susiddhaḥ | tathā ugyaktāṣmā'parityaktabāppaḥ santapro khghuḥ | yaścā pyodena ābhayānāṃ pacakorādīnāṃ kāthaḥ sādhita aṣṭa taṇḍulaḥ bhraṣṭapakailījādibheḥ siddhaḥ sa ghu viparīto ya odanaḥ pūrvāktāyatheoktaṭakṣaṇāt‌ sa 1 yīvaguraḥ! yona dhauto, nāpi bharato, na ca sinaṣa taśca, na ṣṭo,nāeyauṣadhakāthasādhitanca sa śuruḥ|yaśca ṣīramāṃsāthaiḥ sādhitaḥ so'pi śuraḥ | ādigrahaṇācchāgavasātaikadhṛtamaña'jāpharamāṣatiṭamudrādisādhitā nāṃ grahaṇam‌
tib: 'bras chan gang legs par bkrus pa ste/ dag par bkrus pa dang / de bzhin du khu btsags zhes pa ste/ phyed tsam btsags nas khu ba btsags pa dang / tshos pa ste legs par tshos pa dang / rlangs pa dang bral bar gyur pa yin no/ / gang yang tsha ba'i sman rnams kyis bskol ba'i 'bras tshos yang ba yin zhes bya ba ni/ gang tsha ba'i sman rnams tsha ba lnga la sogs pa'i chu dang bskol ba'i 'bras chan dang / brngos pas tshos par byas pa'i 'bras yos la sogs pa ni yang ba yin no/ /

'bras chan gang sngar bshad pa'i mtshan nyid las bzlog pa de ni lci ba yin no/ / gang ma bkrus pa dang / legs par ma btsags pa dang / ma tshos pa dang / grang mo dang / ma brngos pa dang / / tsha ba'i sman gyi khu ba dang ma bskol ba de ni lci ba yin no/ / de bzhin du 'o ma dang / sha khu la sogs pa de yang lci ba yin no/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni tshod ma dang / til mar dang / mar dang / 'bras bu dang / ma sha dang / til dang / mon sran sde'u la sogs pa dang lhan cig bskol ba yang lci ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /

de ltar phyogs 'dis 'dir ma smos pa'i g.yos su byas pa'i zas kyi rigs rdzas dang bya ba dang / sbyor ba dang tshad la sogs pas thams cad bstan zhing shes par bya'o/ / de ltar rdzas las ni dper na 'bras sA lu dang / drug cu pa dang / mon sran sde'u dag ni rang bzhin gyis yang ba lta bu dang / 'o ma dang / bu ram shing dang / mon sran gre'u dang / rlan can gyi sha rnams rang bzhin gyis lci ba lta bu'o/ / des na 'bras sA lu rtsa snar las byas pa'i 'bras chan ni yang ba yin la/ 'o ma dang bu ram shing la sogs pa las byas pa ni lci ba yin no/ / bya ba ni las su bya ba ste/ las mngon par 'du byed pa'o/ / de yang chu dang me phrad pa'i mthu dang / snod la sogs pa las byung ba'o/ / de skad du drang srong tsa ra kas byas pa yin/ gang rdzas kyi rang bzhin rnams mngon par 'dus byas shing tshogs pa'i yon tan las skyes pa yin la/ yon tan de dag kyang chu dang me 'dus pa dang / bcing ba dang / dkrugs pa dang / dus dang / yul dang / gnas dang / / mthu la sogs pa las byung ba yin no/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / sbyor ba ni rdzas dang lhan cig sbyor zhing sbyor ba'o/ / de yang drang srong tsa ra kas/ sbyor ba ni rdzas gcig gam/ mang po lhan cig sbyor ba ste/ de ni khyad par skyed par byed pa ni gang gcig ma yin no/ / zhes bshad pa'o/ / tshad ni srang tshad do/ / zho gnyis dang / srang gcig dang / phul dang / bre la sogs pa dang / de bzhin du tshad las lhag pa'i 'bras bu nges par shes par bya'o/ / sogs pa smos pa ni yul dang / dus dang rgyu'i yul/ lus kyi yan lag la sogs pa yongs su bsdu'o/ / de yang slon dpon gyis/ spyod dang lus kyi yan lag dang / / rang bzhin lus zungs bya ba dang / / mtshan ma tshad dang las su byas/ / tshad dag 'dir ni brtag par bya/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / 'di'i dpe'i phyogs gcig bstan pa yang de nyid kyis mdzad pa yin te/

skt: dasyevamanayā diśā svamaṭhukta̱kṛtānnajātaṃ dravyakriyāyogamānātharādiret‌ jānāt‌ dravyato yathāśāliṣaṣṭikaharibheṇamudrādīni dravyāṇi prakarutila dhūni kṣīrekcumāṣānūpamāṃsādīni praṅṛtiśurūṇi tena rtarālyādiprabhavasyaudanasya, ṭhādha, kṣīrekṣvādi prabhavasya gauram‌| karaṇa riyāsaskāraḥ| saca toyāpisaṃnikaṣabhāvanābhājanādibhirapajanyate |: tathā. carakayuniḥ| karaṇaṃ punaḥ svābhāvikānāṃ dravyāṇāma bhisaṃskāse śuṇastoyabhisaṃnikaṣaśaucamanthanade~ rākālvāsanābhājanādimiścāmidhīyate | yogaḥ saha sayoga ucyate | dravyasya dranyāntareṇa sambandhaḥ || tathāca carakasuniḥ | saṃyogastu dayodhehūnāṃ vaṣa dravyāṇāṃ shatī bhāvāt‌ saviśeṣamārabhate yananaikadapeḥ rabhyāṇe māna, parimāṇe, karaṣapalakuḍavaparasthādikaṃ> tañca mātrāmātraphachaniścayāthem‌ | ādigrahaṇāderakāṅaśarīrāvayavādīnāṃ pāśaha | tathā cācāyaivacanam‌ | carakaḥ śarīrāvayavāḥ svabhāvo dhātava kriyāsaṃskāro, mātrā, cāsmannisakṣate | tatra cod‌ā~ ` haraṇāni tenaiva dattāni | baro'nṛpajakhākāśadhanvadhobhakṣasaṃvidhiḥ | nakhajānupajāścaiva jalaṭānūpacarāścaye | guśmakṣāśca ye satvāsate sve guravaka smṛtāḥ | ṭhadhubhṣayāca raghavo dhanvanā dhanvā riṇaḥ | iti | ^“ śārsarābayavāḥ sakthi raskandhādyastaṃthā | sakthimāṃsādraruḥ skandhastataḥ koḍastataḥ śiraḥ || pṛṣaṇaścmamede ca bharoṇī vṛkte yaṣṛduraṃ | māṃsāduratara̭ṃvidyāthāsva madhyamasthi ca | iti rārīrābayavāḥ | “svabhāvāhavavo mudrā~ stathā chāvakapiśrakhāḥ | svabhāvādraravo māṣā vasaha mahiṣastathā | ? iti svabhāvaḥ | “ dhātanā roṇi~ tādyānāṃ gura vidyādhyathottaram‌ | ?' iti dhātavaḥ || “alasebhyo viśiṣyante chaghabo ye bahukriyāḥ | 2? iti kriyā“ “gauravaṃ liṅgasāmānye pasāṃ khaṇāṃ tu.khāghavam‌] iti liṅgam‌ | ¢“ madāpramāṇā guravaḥ khajāktai ṭhaghavo'nyathā |2› īti pramāṇam‌ 1 ““ gurūṇā lāghava viṃyāssa̭skāsassaviparthayam‌ 1 brīdekhījā yathā ca syuḥ saktanāṃ siddhapiṇḍikā | iti sāraḥ || asapādāne gurūṇāṃ .ca raghūnāṃ cātibhojane|mātrākā~ ` raṇasudadiṣaṭha dravyāṇāṃ gururādhave | gurūṇāmaspamādeṣyaṃ chaghūnāṃ kapiriṣyate | mātrāmpekcate dravyaṃ mānatraṣaḥ cāmrimapekṣate || › iti mātrā | sarvametaccāsminirīkṣyamiti
tib: lus kyi yan lag go/ / rang bzhin gyis yang mung+ga dang / / de bzhin zla ba pin dza la/ / rang bzhin gyis lci mon sran gre'u/ / de bzhin phag dang ma he sha/ / zhes bya ba ste/ 'di ni rang bzhin no/ / khrag la sogs pa'i lus
lus zungs so/ / gang zhig myur zhing bya ba mang / / le lo can las khyad 'phags yin/ / zhes bshad pa ste/

las su byas pa'o/ / lci las nyung ngu bza' ba dang / / yang ba lhag par bsten pa ni/ / rdzas kyi lci dang yang ba dag / tshad kyi rgyur ni bshad pa yin/ / tshad ni rdzas dang mtshon pa dang / / me yi drod la ltos byas las/ / lci las nyung zhig sbyin par bya/ / yang ba 'grangs pa nyid du 'dod/ / ces bya ba ni tshad de/ de ltar na 'dir de dag thams cad brtag par bya ba yin no/ / khu ba nyams brtas tshim byed cing / / ro tsa mig phan rma la gnod/ / ces bya ba la/ khu ba ni sha khu la bya ste/ de yang sman dpyad kyi lung las/ khu ba khyad par med bshad par/ / sha khu yin par shes par bya/ / zhes 'byung ba yin no/ / bsdus pa las kyang / de la khu ba sha yi yin/ / sran khu 'bru yi 'bras bu dang / / kha ba'o rtsa ba til lde gu/ / cung zad skyur ba skyur po yin/ / de ni g.yos byas ma byas te/ / snum la sogs dang bral shes bya/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / khu ba de yang nyams brtas byed/ / ces bya ba ste/ lus nyams brtas shing rags par byed pa dang / tshim byed cing zhes pa/ lus zungs rnams rgyas shing 'phel bar byed pa dang / ro tsa zhing khu ba skyed pa dang / mig la phan zhing bde bar byed pa dang / /

skt: sudrānāmayaṃ maudro rasaḥ | saṃhuddhānāṃ traṇināṃ kaṇṭharogiṇāṃ tatra rogiṇāṃ ca pathyo hitaḥ
tib: mon sran sde'u mung+ga zhes bya ba bcos pa'i khu ba ni/ skyug sman la sogs pas lus sbyangs pa dang / rma byung ba dang / lkog man pa dang / /

skt: kaulastho raso-bātānulomī bātamanulakhomayati tacchīraḥ } tathā guma tūtī, pratūnīṃ ca jayati| tūnībhatūnyokṣaṇe śusmanidāne vakṣyamāṇam‌ | tantrāntare'pyuktam‌-““adho yā vedanā yāntī bacobhūtnācayasthitā|bhinantīva gudopasthaṃ sā tūnī nāma nāmataḥ|'' tathā-“śudopasthoṣthitā caiva prātikhomapradhāvitā | vegaiḥ pakrārāyaṃ yāti pratitarūnīti sā smaratā?" 34
tib: rgya sran ku lang+tha'i khu ba ni rlung lugs su 'byung bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du skran dang / ro smad chu so'i nad dag sel bar byed pa yin te/ de dag gi mtshan nyid ni skran ni nad gzhi las 'og nas bshad par bya'o/ / de bzhin du gzhung gzhan dag las kyang /

til gyi tshigs ma ni til btags pa'i lde gu'o/ / des g.yos su sbyar ba ni tshod ma nyid du byas pa'i rnam par 'gyur ba'o/ / tshod ma yang yin la skam pa yang yin pas na tshod ma skam mo/ / myu gu ni 'bras kyi khyi so 'thon pa'o/ / skyur por bcug pa'i chang bu ni skyur por chang bu bcug pa las tshod ma'i g.yos su byas pa'o/ / 'di dag thams cad ni mig la gnod pa ste/ mig nad skyed pa dang / nyes pa skyed pa dang / rmya bar byed pa dang / lci ba yin no/ / de la skyur por chang bu bcug pa zhes smos pa ni/ chang bur bya ba skam po rkyang rkyang po ste/ sha la sogs pa las byas pa yin par gzung ste/ sngar skyur po smos pa'i skabs su rdzas gsher ba'i rnam pa 'dis zin pas/ 'dir la phug dang / yungs kar la sogs pa'i tshod ma bskol ba'i 'og tu phyis ske tshe'i phye ma bcug pa skyur zhing tsha la sogs pa rno ba la skyur po'i sgrar bshad pa yin no/ / dri 'dzin lus brta ro tsa zhing / / snum zhing stobs skyed yi ga 'byed/ / ces bya ba la/ dri 'dzin zhes bya ba ni zho dang spod sbyar nas dkrugs pa ste/ zho lag pas mnyes la shing tsha dang / sug smel dang / gan+d+ha b+ha dra dang / na le sham dang / sha ka ra'i phye ma btab la ras las btsags pa ni dri 'dzin zhes bya ste/ de ni lus brtas shing 'phel bar byed pa dang / ro tsa ba dang / snum pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / stobs skyed par byed pa dang / yi ga 'chus pa yi ga 'byed par byed pa yin no/ /

skt: pānakai--jalakṣaudratrijātakamaricadrākṣākhajadikṛtamanekaghidhaṃ ścatṛṭkchamān‌ harati śragaśutataṭ‌emaharam‌, prīṇayatīti prīṇanaṃ, sataka, gura ca | ṣaembhi-khotoviṣṭambharkāra, mūtraru-mūtrajanakaṃ, bahu tarai karoti | hṛ̭-hṛdayapriyam‌ | yathā yathā dravyaiḥ bhyate trijātakamāśṣikaguḍadarākṣādibhisteṣāṃ ye ṇāste save pālakasya boddhabhyāṃ hatyarthaḥ
tib: rgun chu'i btung ba ni btung ba tha dad yod pa de/ chu dang / sbrang rtsi dang / dri sna gsum dang / na le sham dang / rgun 'brum dang / 'bra go la sogs pa las byas pa dag ste/ des ni dub pa dang / bkres pa dang / skom pa sel zhing tshim par byed pa dang lci ba yin no/ / rtug skam ni bshang ba ska zhing 'dril ba'o/ / de bzhin du gcin mang zhing yi gar 'ong ba yin no/ / de'i yon tan zhes bya ba ni/ btung ba de dri sna gsum dang / bu ram dang / rgun 'brum la sogs pa sman dang / rdzas gang dang gang las byas pa/ rdzas de'i yon tan ci yod pa thams cad btung ba de la yod par shes par bya'o/ /

skt: haritadhānyani-nistuṣabhṛṣṭamuraṭāhatāni, parathakarabdabācyāni | pradhukā bhṛṣṭataṇḍuḍhā iti kecit‌ | prathukaśipido jñeya hati | te guravaḥ,basyāḥbalāvahāḥ, kaphaviṣṭammaṃ ca kunti kaphaviṣṭambhakto. riṇastacchīlāḥ
tib: 'bras yos ni so ba rtse rnon la sogs pa las byas pa ste/ des ni skom dad la sogs pa sel zhing / zhi bar byed pa yin la/ de bzhin du lud pa dang mkhris pa nye bar zhi bar byed pa dang / pho ba'i me drod skyed pa dang / yang ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / bsil zhing grang ba'i nus pa skyed pa yin no/ / srus leb lci zhing stobs skyed la/ / bad kan bshang ba sra byed yin/ / zhes bya ba la/ / srus leb ces bya ba ni nas dang 'bras kyi srus brngos te/ spun pa med par byas pa gtun gyis brdungs pa la sogs pa ni srus leb ces bya'o/ / yang na srus brngos pa nyid la yang bya'o/ / yang na btags pa'o/ / de ni lci ba dang / stobs skyed pa dang / bad kan dang bshang

nas brngos pa'i yos de ni rtug pa mkhregs shing rtsa sbubs 'gags par byed pa dang / rtsub pa dang skom dad skyed pa dang / khong 'khrugs pa dang bad kan la sogs pa dkrug cing sel ba dang lci ba yin no/ /

skt: yavādyā bhṛṣṭā dhānā iti saṃjñitāḥ bharūmaparaparyāyā sā dhānā-viṣṭamminī śrotasāṃ sambhajananī, rūkrā-rūkṣaguṇayuktā, tapaṇī-vṛdūjananī, kekhanī śepmādīṃlikhati, hinasti, guvīṃ ca
tib: nas phye ni nas las byung ba ste/ de ni khong yang ba dang bkres pa la sogs pa la phan pa dang / chu la sogs pa la sbyor zhing skyo mar byas te 'thungs pas/ 'phral du zhes pa de ma thag tu stobs skyed cing /

chu dang phye sbel zhing bza' bar mi bya ste/ dang por phye 'gams nas bar du chu/ de nas yang phye bza' ba dang / yang chu btung ba'i tshul gyis spel zhing bza' bar mi bya ste/ chu 'thungs nas bar bar du phye mi bza' bar bya ba'i don to/ / dus gnyis zhes bya ba'i dus gnyi gar phye mi bza' ba dang / mtshan mo'i dus su phye mi bza' ste/ de ni bkra mi shis par bshad do/ / de bzhin du phrad med pa ste/ chu la sogs pa gsher dang mi ldan par yang bza' bar mi bya ste/ 'grangs rjes zhes pa 'bras chan la sogs pas 'grangs pa'i 'og tu yang phye zan mi bza' ba dang mtshan mo'i dus su lag par bzhag pa'i zan gang sos gcad cing mi bza' ba dang / phye zan ha cang 'grangs ches pa yang bza' bar mi bya'o/ / 'ba' cha nyams 'bri rtsub pa dang / bshang mkhregs mig la gnod pa yin/ /

skt: pivyākastirakcauḍādīnāṃ - niṣṇīḍitatati khānāṃ karkaḥ sa gpano'ṅgaṇchāni karoti, viṣṭa sbhī sotasāmavaṣṭambhaṃ karoti, dṛṣṭidūṣaṇaḥ--dṛṣṭighnaḥ
tib: til dang star ga'i 'bras bu la sogs pa btsir nas mar dang phral ba ste/ de ni nyams 'bri zhing rmya bar byed pa dang / rtsub pa dang bshang gci mkhregs shing 'byung dka' ba dang / mig la gnod pa yin no/ /

skt: besavāro nāgaśdhānyakājāñyādi saṃsdharadhara piṣṭaṃ māsaṃ vesavāraśabdavācyam‌ | tathācāgamaḥ māraḥ syātparumāmiṣam‌, piṣṭaṃ ca vesavāra syāditi tca hiḍaśukhaṇadhṛttataikhādibhiyaṃthāyogaṃ saṃtaṃ 2 vesavāse gurustathā snigdho, baropacayau vardhayati balopacayavardhanaḥ tatheorṛddhikārī | bara-~sāmaryam‌ upacayā-ghadhātūna| poṣaḥ

mudrādinā vesavārādayo maddhavaṭakādibhiḥ ṣamacchinanaiḥ kariyante | te savai guravaḥ tathā yathādrayaśuṇaghugāḥ paṣratidravyayuṇā bhavanvīsyathaiḥ | tena drādīnāṃ ye guṇāste takchṛtānāṃ vesavāsaṇāsapi ddhamyāḥ | eṣāṃ vesavāraśabda uthacāreṇa prayujyate] thā maudro rayaḥ, kauṭattho raso vā | sukhyayā tu tyā māṃsasecharateṣu vesavāraśabdaḥ
tib: sha g.yos spod dang sbyar ba ni bca' sga dang / 'u su dang go snyod la sogs pa dang sha btags pa ni g.yos su sbyar ba ste/ de yang lung las/ sha ni rlon pa btags nas ni/ / g.yos su sbyar ba sha g.yos te/ / zhes bshad pa yin la/ sha btags pa de yang shing kun dang / tsha dang / mar dang / til mar la sogs pa dang ci rigs par sbyar zhing btsos pa'o/ / de lta bu'i sha g.yos spod dang sbyar ba de ni/ snum pa dang / lci ba dang / stobs skyed cing sha 'phel ba dang brtas par byed pa yin te/

skt: kukūādiṣu vipācitān‌ siddhānapūpānekayonīnekarālyadisambhavānapi sato yathottaramuttaramatikramya chaṣūn‌ vidyāt‌ jānīyāt‌ | yonirākāraḥ, sāṅiyavagodhūmasāpaprabhutayaḥ | sajātīyavikṣayaikaḥyonitvaṃ kadācicchāṅipiṣaṭena criyate, kadācidrodhūmapiṣaṭena kadācidyavapiṣṭena = ( viksādinā ), kadācinsapitrabhṛtibhiḥ | yānapṛṇān‌ kukūrapakāṣūn‌ vidyāt‌ } tebhyo'pi karpaiṭapakān‌ raghutarān‌ vidyāt‌ | tebhyo bharāupakāna. ṭaghutamān‌ vidyāt‌ , yāvavaṅgārapaktān‌ ayatha raghutamānekenaiva raktaśāchinā kṛtān‌ | athavā godhūmayavādīnāmanyatamena vā. | bukūṃ gadabhaḥ bāppaḥ; tena̱ radālipiṣṭamakedūḥ-aṅgārataprā bhittiḥ | adgāraṃ-gorākradārdāna dagdhānāṃ cūrṇaiḥ, prasiddhasvarūpaḥ | dravasinnapiṣṭāckarataḥ pūpaḥ, bhiparītapūpo'pūṣa iyāneva vidoṣaḥ | pupāpūpayoriti katānnavagaḥ
tib: sran mung+ga ste/ sde'u la sogs pa dang sbyar ba'i sha'i g.yos su byas pa ste/ / phra mor btus nas brngos pa ni thams cad kyang lci ba dang / de bzhin du sman gyi yon tan mtshungs shing 'dra ba ste/ mung+ga la sogs pa'i yon tan gang yin pa de la g.yos su byas pa'i yang yon tan yod pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /

'bras kyi khur ba mdag ma la sogs par btsos pa ni rigs gcig pa ste/ 'bras la sogs pa'i rgyu gcig yin na yang / phyi ma phyi ma yang ba yin par shes shing rtogs par bya'o/ / de la rigs ni rgyu ste/ 'bras dang / gro dang / mon sran gre'u la sogs pa ste/ de dag ni rigs mthun pa la ltos nas rigs gcig pa zhes btags so/ / de nas 'bras la sogs pa'i skya khur mdag mar btsos par byas pa ni yang ba yin la/ de bas kyang dog le dang / sla ngar btsos pa ches yang ba dang / de bas kyang sa slang du btsos pa rab tu yang zhing / de bas kyang da nur btsos pa rab tu yang la/ rgya sol la bsregs pa ni yang ba'i mchog yin te/ 'bras sam gro'am nas la sogs pa gcig las bya na yang khyad par du yang ngo / / de la mdag btsos ni mdag ma'i shas chung ba la btsos pa'o/ / gzhan dag ni rlangs pa la btsos pa'o zhes zer ro/ / kha cig ni thal ba me ma mur du 'dug pa la bsregs pa yin no zhes zer ro/ / dog le me 'bar ba la btsugs pa'i lcags sam/ sa'i snod la bsregs pa'o/ / g.yos su byas pa'i kha zas kyi sde tshan no/ / / / de la re zhig g.yos su byas pa'i kha zas btsos pa ste/ de yang sha dang tshod ma la sogs pa dang lhan cig sbyar zhing / de dang ldan na legs par dgos pa byed pa yin la/ zas ni mang du dgos pa yin pa ltar sha la sogs pa de lta ma yin no/ / de'i spags tsam du zad pa yin no/ / de bas na g.yos su byas pa'i kha zas kyi sde tshan gyi rjes la/ sha dang tshod ma'i sde tshan bstan pa yin no/ / de gnyis las kyang sha ni zas dang lhan cig zos na nyes pa med cing bsten par bya ba yin pas/ sha'i sde tshan dang por smos pa yin no/ / sha ba dgo ba ku rang ga /

skt: phatai tāvat‌ paktamapaktasannaṃ saṃskṛtasupayu ` ujīta, pakaṃ tadapi māṃsaśākādibhiḥ kṛtereva 1 saha annasya ca bhūyasopayogo na tathā māṃsādīnām‌ | mā sādayastadraya nasvenopayulñyāḥ | ato'nantaraṃ māṃsakṣākavargayocirdeśaḥ 1 prādhānyaṃ cāsya bhaktena saha bhūyasaropayogo'pi na doṣāya yathā śākasyeti | hariṇādyā rarabhāvasānā mṛgā mṛgajātayaḥ } ādiprahuṇena kāṭapraṣadādisaṃrahuḥ | tāmravarṇo-hariṇaḥ, kapṇavaṇaiḥ-eṇaḥ;kamachuditīyanāmā | tathā cāgamaḥ “tāśro'nna hariṇaḥ karapṇassveṇaḥ kamalaṅasaṃkñitaḥ*46|| hel-atha māṃsavargaḥ māṃsamaṣṭadhā-pṛgatariṣkirapratadātiṭeyayaprasahasadahāgacaracaramaraspabhedena | tatra̱ mṛgānāhadariṇādameo magāstaṣu dariṇastāgramṛgaḥ) eṇaḥ chuṇo vdhucaturagatiḥ, ṛṣtau-nīlāṇḍaḥ, gokarṇo--gokaṇasadkakarṇo rāsamākāraḥ, mṛgamātṛkā vdharuprathudarāḥ | śadāgmāḥ-śamo--barikhechayaḥ, dovaraḥ--vikaṭavahūviṣāṇaḥ, myārapkaśārtanuḥ; śarabhocaraṇaḥ ādraśṣabdāt‌ prapratakarāyādayaḥ | uktaṃ hi saṃprahe-“kālucchakacāraṣkavarapotayākoraṇā; śaravaṣṭāsamasataramakeśkākharavarāḥ || karā tamāṭī ca parataśca mṛgāḥ smṛtāḥ 12 dati | viṣkirānāha-pakṣimadhye ye vikī bhakṣayati te viṣkirāḥ 46|| lāvavartīkavātīrartavatmakaṅukkubhāḥ | kapijalopacakrākhyacakoraṅurubāhavaḥ || vataiko vavikā ceva tittiriḥ kakaraḥ śikhī | tāsracūḍākhyavakaragonadaigirivarikāḥ | tathā śārapadaidrābhavāraṭāśveti ṣiṣkirāḥ ||*557|!
tib: sha ba nas ldang sgo'i mthar thug pa rnams ni/ ri dwags kyi rigs su gtogs pa yin la/ sogs pa'i sgras ni mjug nag gam/ sring sha ta la sogs pa bsdu'o/ / de dag ni 'jig rten du grags par zad do/ / la ba bar ti bar ti ka/ / go tsa dmar dang gong mo dang / / sreg pa u pa tsa kra dang / / ka bin dza ra ku ru ba/ / ba ta ka dang ba ti ka /

skt: chāvādyo vāraṭāntā viṣkaya pakṣijātayaḥ| vika ye dhānyādikaṃ bhakṣayanti te viṣkarāḥ| cā kā jātyantaram‌+natu vikasya yoṣit‌ | tatra śima mayūraḥ 1 tāmracūḍaḥ-kukkuṭaḥ | itiśabdaḥ prakāre 1 eva̭bharakārā anye'pi saṃti 1 47 ||
tib: la ba nas ri bya'i bar 'di dag ni gzas khron gyis rko ba zhes bya ba ni/ / gang rko zhing rko zhing 'bru la sogs pa za bas na/ gzas khron rko zhes bya'o/ / 'di dag zhes bya ba ni rnam pa'i tshig ste/ rnam pa de lta bu'i bya gzhan dag kyang yod do zhes ston to/ / shang shang te'u de tu ha/ / bung 'dra ne tsho sha ri ka/ / la twa khu byug ha ri ta/ / byi'u la sogs mchus

shang shang te'u nas byi'u'i bar ni mchus rko zhes bya ste/ mchus rko zhing za ba'i don gyis na mchus rko zhes bya'o/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni sha ta pa tra dang / khan dza ri la sogs pa'i bya rnams bsdu'o/ /

skt: bhakāhimodhāścāvidādyā bideśayā; | vile raṇate śerate iti bikeśaṣayāḥ | ādiśabdena śalā7disaṃgrahaḥ | bheko'tra maṇḍūkaḥ | śvāvit‌-sāhakaḥ | hiḥ saiḥ
tib: sbal pa nas byi thur bar ni khung na gnas pa yin te/ sa'i khung bu dag na gnas shing nyal bas na khung na gnas zhes bya'o/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni sha la ma ka la sogs pa bsdu'o/ / ba lang rta bong dre'u dang / / stag gzig seng ge dom spre'u/ / byi ba byi la spyang ki dang / / sre mong dang ni dred dag dang / / wa dang 'phar ba khra dang ni/ / chun lag khra ljang bya rog khyi/ / bya rigs khra sngon bya ku ra/ / bya rgod 'ug pa ka ling ga /

skt: gavādayā sadhuṭāvasānāḥrānāśyani panana teca prasahāḥ | prasadyāpadrasya māṃsādikaṃ sa prasahāratana saṃkalitāḥ | "vikī vitkasadaya pyatha mtudāḥ smṛtāḥ |** jarāyāṃ jānapanaraḥ ! vasaga iti prabhiddhuḥ | aḥ-tugyaḥ | dapācinraraḥ | siho-mdraḥ | tareṣathṛco-mājāraḥ | 2 e; | ““chopāko losadaḥ smṛtaḥ" | | vaśarunakuṭaḥ | deyana-garaṭāddhaniḥ cahaṃ śvā| cāyasaḥ-kākaḥ 1 vaṭṛkau-yābhisācaraḥ| karapṇacaṃṭakaḥ, kaṭaviṅkāparapayāsaḥ 1 ādayarthaṃ
tib: ba lang nas ma du ha'i bar gyi phyugs dang / gcan gzan dang bya dag ni rtsal dang mthus za ba zhes bya ba ste/ mngon mthon du stobs kyis 'phrog cing / sha la sogs pa rtsal mthus za bas na/ khron du rko ba dang / mthus za ba ni khron du rko ba la sogs pa'i tshul gyi bya ba dang ldan pas za bas na ming de skad ces bya ste/ de yang drang srong tsa ra kas/
phag rgod nas smyig glang gi bar ni ri dwags chen po zhes bya'o/ /
ngang pa nas ka dam pa'i bar ni chu la gnas pa yin te/ de dag ni chu la spyod pa yin pas na chu la gnas pa'o/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni mgo dmar dang / pad+ma'i mig dang / sha la ri la sogs pa

skt: varāhādigavayāntā mahāsyāḥ 1 cadābd‌ ārthe } varāhaḥ-śrakaraḥ | mahiṣotāvayāparapayīyaḥ vāraṇo-hastī
tib: nya ro hi ta nas tsi li tsi ma'i bar ni/ chu las byung zhing chu la gnas so/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni rnam pa'i don te/ de lta bu dang gzhan dag kyang rnam pa du ma yod do/ / ka ra ka ta ni ku la ra zhes bya'o/ / sham bu ka ni phyung ba'i dung zhes bya'o/ / 'di dag ni rnam grangs mi shes pa dag gis ni yul phyogs kun tu phyin pa dag las shes par bya ste/ gang gi phyir 'dir smos pa'i srog chags yul la lan med pas mi shes pa/ kha cig ni yul gzhan dag tu grags pa yod do/ / de bas na 'di rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs yul tha dad pa na grags pa ni ri brags pa dang / / nya pa la sogs pa las ming du ji skad grags pa gang yin pa las shes par bya'o/ / de ltar sha ni brgyad du bshad/ / ces bya ba ni/ de ltar zhes pa bshad ma thag pa'i rnam pas sha brgyad du zhes pa/ sha'i rnam grangs mdor bsdu na rnam pa brgyad yod par slob dpon gyis bshad cing bstan pa yin no/ /

skt: yoniṣvetāsṣṭasu madhye ajāvī--chagaroravaniścitau niścayena noktau | tasmāt‌ vyāmiśraḥ gocarasvāt‌ vyābhiśro jāṅgalo'mūpaḥ ] te hi jāṅgadera kadācid‌āśrayante,kadācidānūpaseva khakābhtena | ra tittirirapi prāproti, tasyāpyubhayacārisāt‌. + thā carkasuniḥ-““śurūṣṇamadhuse nātitatvānūpaniraṇāt‌ | tittiriḥ sakhayecchīśra crīndoṣānanisaṇān‌|)'"yadayāpi tittirisibhayacarastathāpi niyarava hi tittirijauṅgarānūpau dvāvapi niṣevate dayasāvekaviṣayaniṣevaṇaratijītuciddhavatyanyanra paña tidhāt‌ | ajāvī tu kadācidekānte dhanvadeśameṣa dāvcidekānte ānūpaderāmeṣa,carata evaṃ svamāvatvāugameṣayoḥ
tib: rigs brgyad po de dag gi nang nas/ ra dang lug gi nges pa med pa yin pas nges ba ma bshad de/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ spyod yul 'dres pa yin pa'i phyir te/ / spyod yul 'dres pa ni rlan can dang / skam sa'i gzas kyi spyod yul 'dren mar gnas pa ste/ lan 'ga' ni gcig tu rlan can na gnas pa/ lan 'ga' ni skam sar gcig tu gnas pa yin no/ / de ltar na rgya bya yang de dang 'dra ba yin te/ de yang gnyi ga na spyod pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de yang drang srong tsa ra kas/ skam sa gsher sar gnas pa'i phyir/ / shin tu lci mngar tsha min pa'i/ / rgya bya'i sha ni rlung la sogs/ / nyes pa gsum po sel ba yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de ltar na rgya bya ti ti ra zhes bya ba ni gnyi gar spyod pa yin du zin kyang / 'di yul gcig la nam yang gnas par dga' ba ma yin pas/ gzeb tu bcug pa ma gtogs par/ / gsher sa dang skam sa gnyi gar yang brten pa ma yin no/ / ra lug kyang ched 'ga' ni skam sa chu nyung ba na 'tsho la/ ched 'ga' ni rlan can chu mang ba na 'tsho ste/ rang bzhin des na ra dang lug ni nges pa ma yin pa yin no/ / thog ma tha ma skam gsher gnas/ / bar ma gnyis po thun mong bshad/ / ces bya ba la/ bar ma ni gnyis po zhes gnyis par bshad pa las thog ma dang tha mar ni sde tshan gsum gsum yin te/ dang po'i sde tshan gsum ni ri dwags dang khron du rko ba dang / mchus rko ba gsum ni skam sa la gnas pa yin pas/ skam sar sgrar brjod la/ tha ma'i gsum po ri dwags chen po dang / chu la spyod pa dang / nya rnams ni gsher sa nyid la spyod pa yin pas na gsher sa'i sgrar bshad do/ / bar gyi sde tshan gnyis po khung na gnas pa dang / rtsal mthus za ba zhes bya ba gnyis ni thun mong ste/

de las byas pa ni nges par bzung ba ste/ skam sa dang / gsher sa dang / thun mong gi gnas na spyod pa yin par bshad do/ / skam sa'i sha ni rtug pa 'gags par byed pa dang / / nus pa bsil ba dang yang ba yin no/ / de bzhin du 'dus pa'i nad mkhris pa'i shas che zhing rlung che chung 'bring du gnas pa dang / bad kan shas chung ba la phan zhing / gnod pa 'joms pa yin te/ 'dus pa'i nad gang mkhris pa'i shas che ba dang / rlung 'bring tsam du gnas pa dang / bad kan ches chung ba de la phan pa yin no/ /
