tib: srog chags thams cad kyi pho dang mo las ji lta ba bzhin du pho'i mgo bo nas brtsams te/ lte ba'i bar gyi lus kyi phyed kyi sha lci ba yin la/ mo'i lte ba man chad kyi ro smad kyi phyed kyi sha lci ba yin no/ / sbrum mar gyur pa'i sha ni ma lus pa thams cad lci ba yin no/ / rkang bzhi mo yi yang ba yin/ / bya rnams kyi ni pho yi yang / / zhes bya ba la rkang bzhi ste/ ri dwags dang ra lug dang ma he la sogs pa'i nang nas ni mo'i sha yang ba yin la/ bya rnams til ba dang / ngang pa dang / rma bya dang / khyim bya la sogs pa gshog pa can rnams kyi sha yang ba yin no/ /

mgo bo la sogs pa'i yan lag gi cha shas las ni bzhin du zhes pa 'chol bar lci ba nyid yin par bstan to/ / des na dpyi'i sha bas ni rked pa'i sha lci la/ rked pa'i sha bas ni rgyab kyi sha lci/ rgyab kyi sha bas ni brang gi sha lci la/ brang bas ni ro stod lci/ ro stod kyi sha bas ni mgo'i sha shin tu lci ba yin no/ / de bzhin du zhu ba'i gnas rgyu ma la sogs pa'i sha bas ni ma zhu ba'i gnas pho ba'i sha lci ba yin te/ des zas zhu ba rnams kyi gnas ni zhu ba'i gnas te/ lte ba man chad do/ / zas ma zhu ba'i gnas ni ma zhu ba'i gnas te/
khrag la sogs pa'i lus zungs drug po rnams phyi ma phyi ma lci ba yin par bshad do/ /

skt: rākevu madhye suniṣaṇṇo'nni karotīyabhi" t‌ ! tathā vṛṣyaḥ-śyukrakhaḥ
tib: lus thams cad las byung ba'i sha rnams las ni rlig pa la sogs pa'i sha shin tu lci ba yin no/ / 'di la rlig pa zhes bya ba ni 'bras bu shubs can zhes ming gi rnam par grags pa'o/ / pho mtshan ni mje'o/ / mkhal ma ni lto ba'i cha la gnas pa'o/ / mcher pa ni gsus pa'i g.yon logs na gnas pa nag po can zhes ming gi rnam par grags pa'o/ / gzhang ni bshang ba'i lam ste/ de dag ni lci ba yin no/ / 'dir sha rnams pho dang mo'i khyad par du byas pa dang / rigs gcig pa dang / rigs tha dad pa de rnams kyi spyi dang khyad par du gnas pa las stobs che chung yod pa brtag par bya ba ni/ ci rigs par rang gi blo nyid kyis rnam par dpyad par bya'o/ / sha'i sde tshan no/ / / / sngar tshod mar bstan pa de rnams kyi lhag ma de brtsams pa ni 'di dag yin te/

skt: cādgheyamṭā-rase tathā'rase tathā'bhidīpanī viṃ dīpayati | prahaṇyādīnāṃ hitā | uṇṇā vīya | prāhiṇī-sanradaṇaśṣīkhā tathā khaghuḥ
tib: pa tha la sogs pa'i tshod ma rnams ni nyes pa gsum sel bar byed pa yin pas/

de bzhin du rtug pa sri zhing mkhregs pa dang yang ba yin no/ / de la ba tha ni ming gi rnam grangs ba pa tsa li ka zhes bya ba'o/ / su ni sha na ni su la zhes bya ba 'dab ma bzhi ba btsong gi dri 'dra ba zhig chu'i nang na skye'o/ / sa ti na dza zhes bya ba ni dzak+Sha pa ni/ ming gi rnam grangs bkres byed ces bya bar grags pa'o/ / de las su ni sha na dro/ / ro tsa zhes bya ba tshod ma de rnams kyi nang nas su ni sha na ni drod skyed pa dang ro tsa bar byed pa'o/ / ra dzak+Sha pa ti/ pho ba gzhang 'brum nad sel mchog / ces bya ba la/ pa ta la sogs pa de rnams nang na ra dzak+Sha pa zhes bya ba ni pho ba dang gzhang 'brum gyi nad sel ba'i mchog yin no/ /

tshod ma 'di rnams kyi nang nas rgya sne'u'i tshod ma ni rtug skam 'joms shing 'khru ba yin no/ / mon sne'u dme ru nyes gsum 'joms/ / mdze sel ro tsa bcud len dro/ / 'khru zhing mgul pa snyan par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ mon sne'u dme ru ka ka ma tsa zhes bya ba ni nyes pa gsum po ni rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan zhes bya ba 'joms pa dang / de bzhin du mdze nad sel ba dang / ro tsa zhing khu ba 'phel ba dang / bcud kyis len du 'gyur zhing tshe 'phel ba dang cung zad drod skyed pa dang / 'khru zhing bshang ba sla bar byed pa dang / mgul ba gsal zhing snyan par byed pa yin no/ /

skt: paṭokhādi sadośātakakakaiśāndaṃ śā sīta-lītavīyai, tiktaṃ rase, kaṭukaṃ pāke, prāti dākaradā di ratambhayati | vāta-vātajanakam‌ | kapa pitte jayatīti kaphapittajit‌ | paṭo kuraḥ maroktam‌ | khaprarā-sātaṭā | ariṣṭo-nimbaḥ ` | śaddha ṣṭā-aṅgāravadikā | avasyujaḥ-somarājī | asata śuḍcī |, vetasābhra-vetasaprāntam‌ | vahatī-sidī vāsā-varūṣa āṭarūṣakapayauyaḥ | vutirā-suṣmatira jātiḥ | tikhapaṇikā-vādyakaḥ | maṇḍrakapaṇī-saṇḍūkī karkoṭakaṃ-kakoḍakam‌ | kāraveraha-kerarakm‌ | papara śītapriyākhyaḥ 1 nāḍīkarapa-śakukhākhya; suvacaṃ khachāmidaḥ | gojihṇā-gojā; karoṣṭukamūḍhāparapayāya vanatiktako -vatsakaḥ | kurakaṃ-kākatihukaḥ | nandī jayavṛkṣ śabditaḥ | kucaiṭā-pāṭhābhedaḥ | śākulā dano kaṭukā | kaciṣ-rtapuṣpaṃ vaṣaubhūḥ | kodya takaḥ-paṭoḥ | kakaṃraḥ-kampilakaya | sāmānyaguṣaṃ uktāḥ
tib: tsang gi ri ni ro skyur ba dang / de bzhin du pho ba'i me drod skyed pa dang pho ba la sogs pa la phan pa yin no/ /

pa to la nas kar sha dang bcas pa'i bar gyi tshod ma rnams ni bsil ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa dang / ro kha ba dang 'ju ba'i rjes tshab dang / bshang ba la sogs pa mkhregs shing sri ba dang / rlung skyed pa dang / bad kan dang mkhris pa dag sel bar byed pa yin no/ / de la pa to la ni kha ba zhig go/ / sab ta ni sa ta la zhes bya'o/ / nim pa ni a ri sta'o/ / shang gash+tha ni ang ka ra ba li ga'o/ / a bal gu za ni so mar dza'o/ / rtswa'i myu gu ni rtswa gzhon nu'i rtse mo'o/ / bri ha ti ni sing hi 'o/ / ba sha ni bri sha'o/ / til par+Ni ni rgya shug gi lo ma'am/ yang na til gyi lo ma'o/ / man du ka'i 'dab ma ni man du ki zhes bya'o/ / kar ka ta ni lug gi ra 'dra'o/ / kar be la ni ka du ka bi la'i 'bras bu'o/ / par pa ta ni ldum bu skra / / Na ti ka ni sran ma'i sbur ro/ / go dzi hA ni gla sgang gi lce 'dra ba ste/ kro sha ka mu la zhes bya'o/ / ban ti ga ta ni bad tsha ka'o/ / ku li ka ni kA kA tin du ka'o/ / nan ti ni me tog dzA ti'i shing ngo / / shag ku nad ni ka ru ka'o/ / ka ti la ni me tog dmar ba'i pur+Na rna ba'o/ / ko sha ta ka ni sbubs can no/ / kar sha ni grags par zad do/ / pa to la zhim srin nad sel/ / zhu rjes mngar zhing yi ga 'byed/ / ces bya ba ni/ pa to la sogs pa'i sde tshan gyi nges par bzung ba ston te/ pa to la ni zhim zhing tshim par byed pa dang / srin nad sel zhing 'joms pa dang / zhu rjes mngar ba ste/ zhu ba'i rjes mngar ba dang / shin tu yi ga 'bye bar byed pa yin no/ /

bri ha ti gnyis la gcig ni sbom mo/ / bri ha ti zhes bya ba yin la/ gnyis pa ni kaN+DA kA ri zhes bya ba ste/ ming gzhan k+shu ta zhes bya'o/ / bri ha ti gnyi ga yang mkhris pa 'khrugs shing skyed par byed pa dang / de bzhin du me'i drod skyed pa dang / khong 'khru ba dang rlung 'joms shing sel ba yin no/ /

skt: darṛpaṃ ṭhadikāsau hanti, raktapittaṃ cātyathaṃ jayati
tib: bri shan ni ba sha ka ste/ de ni slon zhing skyug bro ba dang / lud pa 'joms pa dang / de bzhin du khrag dang mkhris pa shin tu sel ba'i mchog dam pa yin no/ /

skt: kāsavehamīṣatata. sase kaṭukamabhidīpnikaraḥ matigpmadhnam‌ 11 88 || ` kaṭukamaśnidīpikaramatihe8--kāramerakhguṇānāha-kāravehmiti
tib: ka ra bel la ni kha ba ste/ cung zad kha ba dang / pho ba'i me drod skyed pa dang / de bzhin du bad kan sel zhing 'joms pa'i mchog yin no/ / bar ta ka'i ro tsha zhing kha/ / mngar bro bad kan rlung dag sel/ / lan tshwar bcas pa me drod skyed/ / yid 'ong zas len mkhris mi skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ bar ta ka zhes bya ba ming gzhan ben dang zhes bya ba'i tshod ma ni ro tsha zhing kha ba dang / mngar ba dang dro ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa dang / bad kan dang rlung 'joms shing sel ba dang / lan tshwar bcas pa ste/ cung zad lan tshwa bro ba dang / me'i drod skyed par byed pa dang / yid du 'ong zhing dga' bar byed pa dang / zas len cing yi ga 'byed par byed pa yin pa dang / mkhris pa mi skyed ces pa mkhris pa la mi gnod pa yin no/ /
ka ri ra'i tshod ma ni lto sbos par byed pa dang / de bzhin du ro bska ba dang / mngar ba dang kha ba yin no/ /

skt: anayośca pittakāritvaṃ, bātakaphadhnatvaṃ ca yam‌ \ prāyeṇa yacayṛkṣa śuṅdhyāṣidravyaṃ tādhittaḥ |takaphaharaṃ ca ṭṭam‌ | tathācāha guniḥ-kaphavātahvyuja iti | tadevamanyatrāpyaucisatyena doṣapvādi kalyam‌ | prahe chanye'pyuktāḥ | yathāsatū karda̭baṃ ca rukṣa prāhi himaṃ gura | kumārī [varoṇikā nalinī gucupaṇikā | svādu hdha chavaṇaṃ vātakhepmakaraṃ guraṃ | cayāmākāsmalkiryaḥ phī karaṇikathūyikā || vṛkṣādanī śṣīrayṛkṣā srī tanikavṛkṣakā | rodhaḥ dāṇaḥ kabadāraḥ sare mūṣikā mahātakaḥ kovidāraḥ kamalotparukiścu pa | parokhadigaṇaṃ svādu kaṣāyaṃ picajañitparam‌ || tapittahasa raṃḍī pathiṇī paveṣuṣikā | khadhuraṣṇava tiktā sāruvṛūkrā ca chāṅgaṅī || vātakā kaṭuktāmlabhedinau tilvetasau | viśva̭ rāsnā vakhākaṃ vātaghnamati sāratut‌ | bātaṃ vatsādanī hanyāt‌ ‡ keḍīracinrakau' deti | suninā cānye'pyuktāḥ | modhodumbarāścavthagkṣapadyādipahavāḥ }| kaṣāyāḥ bhanā hṛdyāḥ sītāḥ pittātisāiṇām‌ | atha te gaditam‌ -“ karīskughumaṃ jñeya kaphapittaṃ ` | āgastyaṃ nātikñītopṇaṃ naktāndhānāṃ prahāsyate | (kañvaraharaṃ nasyayogena śīlitam‌ | rājavṛkṣasya | asya riproḥ sihayukhasya ca || kaphapittaharaṃ puṣpaṃ ṣnaṃ kuṭajasya ca | prayasī bidvaparṇī ca visvapatraṃ prātanut‌ | iti
tib: ko sha ta ka ni a pa marga'o/ / bal gu za ni so ma ra dza'o/ / de dag ni bshang gci sla zhing 'khru bar byed pa dang / drod skyed par byed pa yin no/ /

tan du li ni be'u li ste/ de ni bsil ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin no/ / mun dza las byung rlung mkhris sel/ / snum bsil lci zhing mngar ba dang / / lus brtas khu ba 'phel ba'i mchog / ces bya ba ni/ rtswa mun dza las byas pa'i tshod ma ni rlung la sogs pa sel ba'i mchog yin no/ / pa lag kya lci 'khru bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ pa lag kya'i tshod ma ni lci ba'i yon tan dang ldan pas na khong 'khru bar byed pa'o/ /
u po da ka ra ni po ta ki ste des ni chang gis myos pa 'joms shing lci ba dang 'khru ba yin no/ /

skt: tandukhīyo maraṭhīrakālyaḥ--rītavīrya, rukṣaḥ, svādupākaraso,khadhuḥ+madādinārānaśca ||92]|| hai0--tedukīyaguṇānāha~tedukhīya iti | taṃdurīyoitpamāriḥ
tib: tsu tsu'i tshod ma'i yon tan ni pa lag kya dang 'dra la/ de ni yang yon tan 'dra ba gcod pa'i bdag nyid can yin gyi/

bi da ri ni ming gi rnam grangs/ sri ga li kha zhes bya ba yin la/ / de ni rlung mkhris sel ba la sogs pa'i yon tan byed pa dang / 'tsho bar byed pa zhes bya ba dang mdangs 'phel zhing lus zungs snyoms par byed pa dang / lkog nad sel ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can yin no/ /

skt: mulāta-vātapittaṣṭat‌, kligdhādiguṇayutamati śukrakraca
tib: dzi ban ti'i tshod ma ni mngar zhing bsil ba'i nus pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /

skt: śītavīrya-saṣṭamūtpusaṣa ca jati vahiḥ kṣipati | biṣaṭabhyodarapradeśe piṇḍībhūya jīti pā ṇamati | prāyodhrahaṇa kiṃñvideṣāṃ madhye naivaṃ svarūpa miti jñāpanārtham‌ | kaṭhamba̭~kadmbaḥ] nālikā-dīthenāruṣaṭapā kalambusejñā | mārpo-gandhārikā || kuṭi laraṃ-tānnamūkam‌ | kutumbako-droṇapuppī | ciṣṭhī pudhupatraṃ yavaśākaṃ kumāmasaṃjñam‌ | khaṭūvāko-gugguḥ | loṇīkā~loṇāraḥ | kuraṃṭakaḥ-sitatapā ~ ṭakaḥ | gavedhukaṃ-tṛṇadhānyaviroṣaḥ ! jīvanto-yṛ‌ drāndhāram‌ 1 ccaiñucaścarukaḥ | eḍagajaḥ-grapuṣnāṭaḥ 1 yavarākaṃ-hasvapatrā cihaṇī 1 subacaikhā-evimaktā | ākāni ca sarvāṇi nānāvidhāni raktāṭukama -. ghukādibhedena | sūpyāni-yudrarajamāṣādipatrāṇi | rakṣmaṇaṃ-madhaghuṣṭikā | tatra sarvaṃ khinnaṃ niṣpīḍana rasamatibahusnehe ca nātyapathyam‌ | suśratenoktama ~. “saṃskṛtaṃ vesavāreṇa sasnehaṃ śākamiṣyate | rāti kāsaktabhaktādisaiskāraṃ cānuvatate?
tib: ku sman da la sogs pa'i tshod ma ni/ rlung dang bad kan gnyis skyed par byed pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can yin no/ / de la ku sman da ni pu sha pa la zhes bya ba ku ba 'dra ba la/ nang sa bon mang pos gang ba'o/ / bum sha ni ku ba'i sha'o/ / ka ling ka dang kar ka dang / er ba ru dang / lo ma shing dag ni ga gon gyi rnam grangs yin no/ / 'khri shing 'bras bu'i nang na mchog / ku sman da ste rlung mkhris sel/ / gcin nad sel zhing ro tsar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ ku ba la sogs pa 'khri shing la brten te/ skyes pa'i 'bras bu rnams kyi mchog ni ku sman da yin te/ de ni rlung dang mkhris pa sel ba'i dam pa yin pa dang / gcin nad kyi rgyun lam sbyong zhing sel bar byed pa dang / ro tsa ba yin no/ /
'khri shing la brten pa'i 'bras bu'i nang na/

skt: tarkāryaraṇikā | caraṇo~māḍhaḥ ! samāhā ¶ tayendraḥ | tat‌ khadu, kiṃñcitiktaṃ, kaphātarghna ca
tib: ka ling ka dang er ba ru dang / / tsi bi ra ni mkhregs pa ste/ bshang ba la sogs pa sri zhing 'byung ba dka' bar byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du gzhon pa zhes pa ma smin zhing / ro dang nus pa dang smin pa ma rdzogs shing dang po skyes pa'i gzhon nu ni mkhris pa sel ba yin la/ nus pa ni bsil ba yin no/ / smin pa ni de las gzhan du byed bar shes par bya ste/ mkhris pa skyed pa dang nus pa tsha ba yin no/ / des na gzhon nu las go bzlog par shes par bya'o/ / 'bras bu rnying pa ni 'khri shing la brten pa'i 'bras bu'i lung ste/ gang na ka ling ga'am/ er ba ru'am/ tsir bi ra de gsum gyi lung dengs shing rnyings par gyur pa smin pa las kyang thal bar gyur pa de ni lan tshwar bcas zhes bya ba cung zad lan tshwa bro ba dang / de bzhin du mkhris pa skyed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin no/ / hen langs shing lto spos pa ni nang na mdud par 'chas pa snyam byed cing gyen du ldang ba dang / zug gzer dang bcas pas shing mkhan gyi tho ba lta bu skyes pa snyam byed pa ste/ de ni hen langs shing lto sbos pa'i nad gzhi'i skabs nas bshad pa yin no/ / de yang gzhung gzhan dag las/ tho ba lta bur srar gyur cing / / gyen du rgya cher ldang ba dang / / rlung gis lto sbos zhes bya ste/ / phyir 'byung lam ni 'gags byed yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / pad rtsa rtsa ba ut+pal rtsa/ / ku mu ut+pal chu ba dang / / chus pa sha lu ka ta dang / / sring ga dang ga shru ru ka /

pad+ma'i rtsa lag gi sdong bo nas/ ka lo da'i bar gyi tshod ma ni rtsub pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas na rtsub pa'o/ / bshang ba sri ba ni 'khru ba las go bzlog pa'o/ / de yang sman dpyad kyi lung las/ bshang ba la sogs 'jig byed cing / / gong po med byed gang de 'khru/ / de las bzlog pa bshang 'gags te/ / de ni sri ba zhes byar bshad/ / ces bshad pa yin no/ / bsil ba ni nus pa'o/ / lci ba ni yon tan yin no/ / pad+ma'i rtsa lag ni pad+ma'i rtsa ba phra mo'o/ / gzhan dag ni pad+ma'i rtsa ba'i myu gu yin no zhes zer ro/ / pad+ma'i rtsa ba de nyid kyi sbom po ni pad+ma'i rtsa ba'o/ / sha lu ka ni pad+ma'i rtsa ba nyid do/ / ut+pal dang ku mu da'i rtsa ba dang / chu ba gang yin pa ni kun nas khyab par gnas pa'o/ / ka lo da ni ut+pal thung ngu'o/ / kron dza da na ni ka na da la'o/ / de dag ni rtsub pa dang bshang gci 'gags shing sri ba dang / bsil zhing lci ba yin no/ / ka lam pa dang na li ka / mar she zhes ni bya ba dang / / ku ti na dza ra ku kha/ / seng phrom yungs ma lo ni ka / ka ru da ka ga pe ru/ / 'tsho byed dang ni dzun dzu dang / / e da ga dza dag dang ni/ / ya ba sha ka lcam pa dang / / a lu ka sogs thams cad dang / / sran lo shing mngar lo ma dag / mngar zhing rtsub la lan tshwa bro/ / bad kan rlung skyed lci ba dang / / bsil zhing bshang gci 'byung sla byed/ / phal cher zhu nas bshang gci mkhregs/ / tshos shing khu ba legs btsir la/ / mar cher btab ba nyes mi skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ ka lam pa nas nags ma'i bar gyi tshod ma ni ro mngar ba dang / rtsub pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / cung zad lan tshwa bro ba dang / bad kan dang rlung skyed par byed pa dang / de bzhin du lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / phal zhes pa mang du ste/ 'di dag ni nang nas tshod ma'i khyad par la la ni rang bzhin 'di lta bu ma yin no/ / zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir sgra smos pa yin no/ / yang ka lam pa la sogs pa'i tshod ma de rnams kyang / tshos shing zhes pa legs par tshos par byas pa dang / de bzhin du khu ba legs par btsir ba zhes bya ba/ tshos par byas pa'i 'og tu lag pas khu ba legs par btsir ba gang yin pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ / mar cher btab pa zhes bya ba ni snum shas cher btab ba dang ldan pa'o/ / nyes mi skyed ces bya ba ni nad kyi nyes pa rnams shin tu bskyed pa ma yin no zhes pa'i don no/ / 'di rnams kyang ming gi rnam grangs dang / yul yul gyi skad dag las shes par bya'o/ / 'on kyang 'dir cung zad cig bshad par bya ste/ ka lam ba ni ri las skyes pa/ ka li ka zhes bya'o/ / mar she ni gnad ri zhes bya'o/ / ku ti na dza ra ni 'bras bu las tshod mar byas pa'o/ / seng phrom ni sha bar pa da ste ro da'o/ / lo ni ka ni kha tse nA lo nA ra zhes grags pa'o/ / ka rud ka ni 'bras bu phra mo ste/ shi ti bar zhes bya'o/ / ga be+e du ni 'bru'i bye brag gcig go/ / 'tsho byed ni dzi ban ti'o/ / dzun dzu ni dzi ni'o/ / e da ga dza ni pu na la'o/ / ya ba ka ni nas kyi nang nas skye ba kun lan zhes bya ba rgya sne'u'i khyad par gyi sne'u tshod do/ / lcam pa ni grags par zad do/ / a lu ka ni rnam pa mang ste/ a lu ka dmar po dang / a lu ka bse shing gi 'bras bu ba la ta ka zhes bya ba ste/ ming gi rnam grangs a ru kar zhes bya ba de ni shun pa dang / nang gi sha ni khong brtas shing lus rgyas par byed pa dang / ro mngar zhing zhim pa dang / bsil ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin no/ / de'i rus me mnyam yid gzhungs byed/ / bad kan rlung ni sel ba'i mchog / ces bya ba la/ bse shing gi 'bras bu de'i rus pa ste/ tshi gu ni rno bas me dang mnyam pa dang / phyi rol du bskus na chu bur 'byung bar byed pas na/ me dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba yin la/ de bzhin du nang du btang ba'i sman dang sbyar ba las kyang / myur du zas 'ju bar byed cing drod mchog tu skyed par byed pas tsi tra ka dang mtshungs pa yin te me dang mnyam zhes bya'o/ / la la ni rno ba dang tsha ba dang me ltar chu bur 'byin par byed pas me dang mnyam pa yin par 'dod do/ / gzhan dag ni me dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba/ tsi tra ka dang mnyam par yon tan dang nyes pa skyed par byed pas tsi tra ka dang mtshungs pa yin no/ / zhes zer mod kyi/ / de ni rigs pa ma yin te/ tsi tra ka'i stobs me dang mnyam/ / zhes bya ba'i skabs su tshul ji ltar bshad par bya ste/ 'dir ni me nyid dang mnyam par dper sbyar bar rigs kyi/ bse shing gi rus pa dang mi sbyar ro/ / yid gzhungs byed ces bya ba ni/ blo rno ba la phan pa ste shes rab thob par byed pa'o/ / de bzhin du bad kan rlung ni sel zhes bya ba ste/ bad kan dang rlung sel zhing 'joms par byed la/

'bru spang bya/ / zhes bya ba la/ / 'bru kha ba la sogs pas nyen cing nyams pa rnams spang bar bya ste/ gnod pas nyen pa'i sgra ni kun la sbyar bar bya ste/ des na kha ba'i gnod pas nyen pa dang / de mthun pa dang 'dres pa spang bar bya'o/ / la la dag ni 'bru gra ma can ni 'bru gang bu can dang mi mthun pa yin no zhes zer ro/ / de bzhin du gzhan dag ni sar pa dang rnying pa 'dres pa dag ni 'bru gzhan 'dres pa yin no zhes zer ro/ / de bzhin du mthu nyams shing shin tu rnying pa ste/ lo mang por lon pa nyid kyis shin tu rnying par gyur pas mthu nyams shing nus pa zad pa'i 'bru spang bar bya'o/ / de yang rgyud gzhan dag las/ lo gcig lon na 'bru thams cad/ / lci ba nyid ni spong gyur gyi/ / de yi nus pa 'dor ma yin/ / de nas rim gyis 'dor bar 'gyur/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / des na mthu nyams tib: 'bras bu shing thog kyang phal cher mang du de bzhin te/ ji ltar 'bru kha ba la sogs pas nyen cing snad pa dang / 'bus zos pa dang / chur lhung ba dang / sa ngan pa las skyes pa dang / dus ma yin par skyes pa dang / ro ma smin pa dang / skam po spang bar bya ba yin no/ / phal cher zhes smos pas ni 'bru gzhan dang 'dres pa dang rtsub mor g.yos pa la sogs pa dang / 'dir mi sbyar ba dang / rgun 'brum la sogs pas ni skam po yang sbyor ba dag la dgos shing skyon med par snang bas/ / de dag ma gtogs par shes par bya ba'i phyir phal cher smos pa yin no/ / de bzhin du shing tog thams cad kyang par snga ma bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ / zas kyi tshul shes par bya ba 'dir 'bru dang sha dang tshod ma dang shing tog 'bras bur grags pa dang / ma grags pa rnams kyi ming ma smras pa de dag ni yul mang po mthong zhing tha snyad la mkhas pa rnams las shes par bya'o/ / 'bras bu'i sde tshan no/ / / / da ni lan tshwa la sogs pa dag zas kyi g.yos la dgos pa dang / sman dang zas kyi sbyor ba la sogs pa gang yin pa de brjod par bya ste/ lan tshwa kun kyang bad kan skyed/ / phra zhing bshang gci 'byin la 'jam/ / rlung 'joms 'ju byed tsha zhing rno/ / yi ga 'byed cing bad mkhris skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ lan tshwa thams cad ni spyir bad kan skyed cing rtsa sbubs kyi rgyun las chu rnams 'dzag par byed pa yin pas/ kun kyang bad kan skyed pa yin no/ / de sman dpyad kyi rgyud las/ rang gi nus pa snying gar ni/ / song ste rnam par sdud byed cing / / rno bas rnam par gcod byed la/ / tsha bas myur du 'dzag par byed pa yin pas/ kun kyang bad kan skyed pa yin no/ / de sman gyi rgyud las zhes bshad pa yin no/ / phra ba ni rtsa sbubs phra mo la zhugs par byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / bshang gci 'byin pa ni dri ma sel zhing 'khru bar byed pa'o/ / 'jam pa ni rang bzhin mnyen pa'o/ / rlung 'joms pa ni rlung nad sel ba'o/ / 'ju bar byed pa ni zas la sogs pa smin par byed pa'o/ / tsha ba ni tsha ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'o/ / rno ba ni lus zungs 'bigs pa'o/ / yig 'bye ba ni zas len pa'o/ / bad kan / yid du 'ong zhing snying dga' bar byed pa dang / rlung la sogs pa gsum sel bar byed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin no/ /

tib: kha ru tsha nag po ni dri ma gtogs pa yon tan gzhan bi da kha ru tsha dang mtshungs shing mnyam ste/ 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni dri tsam du zad do/ / mtsho tsha yang ste/ zhes bya ba ni lan tshwa mtsho tsha zhes bya ba ni ro ma ka ste/ de ni yang ba'i yon tan dang ldan pas na yang ba yin no/ / sa skam tsha/
sa skam gyi tsha ni sa rul can gyi phyogs nas byung ba'i tsha ste/ de ni ba tsha bro zhing bad kan skyed par byed cing 'ju dka' ba dang / lci ba yin no/ /

lce myang tsha la sogs pa'i lan tshwa rnams kyi nang nas gcig gam gnyis sam mang po brngos pa'i phye ma dang / la du dang / sman mar dang / til mar la sogs pa'i sbyor ba de dang de la rgyam tsha la sogs pa rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ / des na 'di skad ston pa yin te/ gang du khyad par med par lan tshwa gcig smos pa de ni rgyam tsha'am lce myang tsha sbyar bar bya'o/ / gang du gnyis smos pa de ni rgyam tsha dang rtsal ru tsha'o/ / gang du gsum smos pa der ni/ rgyam tsha dang rtsal ru tsha dang / kha ru tsha nag po sbyar bar bya'o/ / gang du bzhi smos pa der ni/ lce myang tsha dang rtsal ru tsha dang / kha ru tsha dang kha ru tsha nag po'o/ / gong du lnga smos pa der ni/ lce myang tsha dang rtsal ru tsha dang / kha ru tsha dang kha ru tsha nag po dang / rgya mtsho'i tsha sbyar bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du bkod ma'i lan tshwa la sogs pa yang sbyar ro/ /

tib: a ru ra ni ro rab tu bska ba yin la/ zhu ba'i rjes mngar ba yin zhing / rtsub pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas rtsub pa yin la/ lan tshwa'i ro med pa ni lan tshwa'i ro dang bral ba ste/ ro lnga dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ / sngar bska ba zhes smos pa ni/ de shas che bar bstan pa'i phyir yin no/ / de ltar na a ru ra ni mngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / kha ba dang / tsha ba dang / bska ba ste/ ro lnga dang ldan pa yin par shes par bya'o/ / de yang ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin te/ na tshod la 'jog pa ni gzhon nu ma yin pa dag kyang rgas pa las bzlog nas mchog tu gzhon pa la 'jog pa yin pa dang / blo zhes bya ba 'phral gyi don 'dzin par nus pa dang / mig la sogs pa'i dbang po gsal bar byed cing / de rnams kyi stobs rang gi yul la 'jug par nus pa rab tu bskyed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du de ni mdze nas yi ga 'chus pa'i bar gyi nad dang / rlung dang bad kan las gyur pa'i nad gzhan gang dag yod pa de dang de thams cad sel bar byed pa yin no/ / rims rnying pa ni yun ring du lon pa'o/ / mi bzad pa'i rims ni rtag pa'i rims la sogs pa rnam pa bzhi'o/ /

tib: 'dir nus pa ni de dang mi mthun te/ de ni dro ba yin la/ skyu ru ra ni bsil ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa yin no/ / yon tan gzhan lan tshwa mi bro zhing zhu rjes mngar ba dang / ro lnga dang ldan pa la sogs pa dang / bad kan dang mkhris pa las byung ba'i nad de dang de 'joms par byed pa ni 'dra ba yin par shes la/

ba ru ra ni a ru ra ra'i yon tan de las cung zad cig dman zhing chung ba yin la/ de ni a ru ra dang yon tan las thun mong yin yang / ba ru ra nus pa bsil ba yin te/ de rtsom pa'i 'byung ba chen po de lta bu'i rnam par zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de ni zhu ba'i rjes tsha ba dang / ro mngar ba'i shas che ba dang / skra la phan pa dang / mig la phan pa yin no/ /

a ru ra dang skyu ru ra dang ba ru ra zhes bya ba dang gsum mo/ / 'bras bu gsum zhes legs bshad pa/ / 'bras bu gsum po de shes bya/ / zhes 'byung ba dang / gzhan dag las kyang / 'bras bu'i mchog ni rnam gsum mo/ / 'bras bu'i dam pa gsum zhes bshad pa yin no/ / 'bras bu gsum po de dag nyid ni bcud kyis len pa'i mchog ces bya ba ste/ bcud kyis len rnams kyi nang na dam pa yin pa'o/ / mig nad sel ba ni mig gi nad rnams 'joms pa'o/ / rma 'tsho ba ni rma 'byor cing slar 'tsho bar byed pa'o/ / lpags nad ni mdze nad med pa la dang / skran nad la sogs pa'o/ / rma red pa ni rma las khrag la sogs pa 'dzag pa'o/ / tshil ches pa ni lus zungs kyi tshil lhag pa'o/ / gcin snyi ba ni chu so'i nad do/ / bad kan dang khrag ni dngos su zad de/ de dag sel zhing 'joms par byed pa yin no/ / shing tsha sug smel b+ha dra gsum/ / ge sar bcas pa dri bzhi/ / zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bsdus pa'i tshig yin pa las ming tsam bstan pa'i phyir/ 'ga' zhig gis 'dir bcug pa yin te/
gsum po 'di rnams kyi steng du nA ga ge sar gyis bsnan pa ni dri bzhi zhes bya ba'o/ / 'di dag ni ming tsam bstan pa yin gyi/ yon tan ni 'dir ma bstan te gzhan las ni ming tsam btus par zad do/ /

tib: 'jag ma dang ku sha gnyis ka rigs gcig pa la sogs pa dang / phra ba'i khyad par gyis gnyis su bshad pa yin no/ / ku sha ni yang 'jag ma can gyi rtsa'i khyad par ro/ / 'bras ni gra ma can gyi sde tshan las bshad pa'i rak+ta sha li la sogs pa'o/ / bu ram shing dang 'dam bu ni grags par zad do/ / de rnams kyi rtsa ba ni rtsa ba lnga zhes bya ba'i rtsa ba lnga pa yin la/

skt: saṃgrati sukhaghrahadhāraṇāthe saṃprahaśchokamāda-śadhānyādibhivaigitidhargīṅkiterayamannasya keśaḥ ekadeśaḥ 7aikamātro niradiṣṭaḥ| kiṃbhūtaḥ nityopayogo vidyate sya̱ saṃ lilopayogikaḥ sadopayogavānivyathaiḥ | nrāyogakchiyaderakālādiviśaṣācyoktānāmapi vyāṇāmanyathāsvaṃ dṛṣṭam‌ | yathā-' tikado nipesāma viṣasapi saṃjāyate'gratasamānam‌ | malla kaḥ sah‌ tiaistatkāryapi kuṣṭhamupahanti \| saṃskā7 chaghubhyaḥ saktubhyaḥ siddhapiṇḍikā guravaḥ | sasa siṣvatisāsmyaṃ dadhipīddhudāmīkarīrāṇām‌ | ghṛtaśva hemante mandābhnikaphottaraṃ bhavesrāyaḥ | dadhi dhai vātaśca tadajāte vātachraddhavati | recanamapi ca ra, gavyaṃ saṃmrāhi kasyacidbhavati | tasmādevamāsvabuddhaivābhyūhayam‌ | śākhṭetā tu pndhagoravabhant‌ spaṣṭa katā noktamara. | pradeśāntareṣu yuktyaiva tepāditamiti
tib: bza' bar bya ba yin pas na zas te/ de ni gram can dang / gang bu can dang / g.yos su sbyar ba dang / sha dang / tshod ma dang / shing tog dang / sman sna tshogs dang / tshod ma sna tshogs tshod ma la dgos pa'i rdzas cung zad yod pa de dag kyang zas dang 'dra bar nad sel bar gnas pa dang / nad pa rnams khams snyoms par bya ba'i phyir sbyar bar bya ba yin zhing skyon med pa nyid la rtag tu dgos pas 'dir bshad cing smras pa yin no/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/

skt: annapānakhalpaṃ śasīrasadhāraṇārthaṃ prāguktam‌ | pathyamapi cānnapān‌ vipādyuhataṃ rogāya mṛtyave cā saṃpadyate | atastadraknaṇādhyāyo'yamārapyate | annasya rakṣājannarakṣā sopadekayā yatrādhyāye sau'pyupacārādannarakṣaḥ procyate | yathā ridupāṭavadhaḥ kānya miti | doṣaṃ vyākhyānamatra pṛthvana kāyam‌
tib: de nas zhes bya ba ni 'das ma thag pa ste/ zas dang skom phan pa dang / gnod pa'i dbye bas phye ste/ bshad pa de la yang dug la sogs pa dang 'bags pa'am/ mi mthun pa zos pa dag dgag par bya ba yin pas/ de'i rjes thogs la 'di brtsams pa yin no/ / de la bza' bar bya ba yin pas na zas so/ / de bsrung ba ni dug la sogs pa dang ma 'dres par yongs su bsrung zhing bsdam pa'o/ / de'i le'u gong du bstan pa'i le'u de yang nye bar gdags pas de skad ces bya'o/ / de ltar na zas dang skom la sogs pas sbags pa dang mi mthun pa'i kha zas le'u gang du dgag par byed pa'i le'u de brtsam par bya ste/ gang gi phyir yon tan dang ldan pa'i zas dang skom ni srog 'dzin par byed pa yin pas/ srog dang 'dra ba de nyid dug la sogs pa dang nye bar bcom pa dang / de bzhin du mi mthun par gyur pa ni gsod par gyur pa nyid yin te/ de bas na zas kyi tshul shes pa'i le'u rjes thogs la 'di brtsams pa yin la/

rgyal po ni sa bdag go/ / pho brang nye 'khor ni rgyal po'i bzhugs gnas dang / 'dab nye bar ro/ / srog 'tsho'i slob dpon ni sman pa ste/ sman pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa'o/ / de gzhag par bya zhes pa/ pho brang nye ba kho nar gzhag par bya zhing gnas par bya ba ste/ der de'i khang pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de ltar byas pas zhes pa de ltar nye bar bsten par gyur pas/ sman pa de thams cad du zhes pa dus thams cad du/ thams cad la zhes pa zas dang skom la sogs pa rnams la bsrung zhing sdom par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don no/ / khyad par du ni sa bdag gi /

skt: rājāṃ sapaḥ prāṇācāyaṃ veyaṃ rajagṛāsanne nivedāyedāvikṣayet‌) evaṃ sati ye gaṇāḥ 1 ^ skedhāvāre ca mahati rājagedādanantaram‌ | bhavepsanihito veyaḥ sarvopakaraṇānvitaḥ || tacrasthamene ṣvajavayaśaḥlyātisamucritam‌. | upamarṣanyamodena viṣaśalyāmayāraditāḥ || svatantrakuśaleo'nyeṣu śāgharthaṣvavadiṣtaḥ || cayo dhvaja ivā bhāti varṛṣatadbhiyapūnitaḥ '' | iti suścataḥ | myumtānāha~-savadaḥyārada | savadā savaka ditā sepabhavanasamīpe sthitaḥ saṃ vyaḥ savatrānnapātayāyalasāsyāha pratijāguvirdattāvadhāno mayati 2|| ssādrano vadyasanidhi vidhatta--prāṇācāya lam‌ pataṃ satnidhā satyāṃ sa vyaḥ savadā savekāṭhaṃ sveṣu yapu, pratijāgraviḥ--pratipad‌ādha jāgarū rātaṃ
tib: khyad par du zhes bya ba rab tu 'bad pas sa bdag ste/ rgyal po'i zas la sogs pa bsrung zhing bsdam par bya'o/ / zas dang skom zhes bya ba ni nye bar mtshon pa tsam du zad do/ / des na rgyal po'i longs spyod du dgos pa'i na bza' dang / gzims mal dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / rin po che la sogs pa dag kyang dug las bsrung bar bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos spyad pa dang / sogs pa zhes bya ba nor dang / 'dod pa dang thar pa rnams dang gang 'brel zhing rgyur gyur pa'i skye dgu dang / bdag nyid kyi 'byor pa dang / bde ba ni rgyal po de la rag las shing de'i kha na lus pa yin no/ / de la 'byor pa ni longs spyod ma thob pa rnams thob par byed pa'o/ / thob pa rnams yongs su bsrung ba ni bde ba ste/ de gnyi ga yang rgyal po de la rag lus pa yin no/ / de bas na de'i gnod pa bsrung bar bya dgos so/ / de dag kyang ji ltar shes shing bsrung bar bya zhe na/

'bras chan ni 'bras btsos pa'i chan te/ de dug dang bcas shing dug gis sbags par gyur na/ gsher bag dag kyang skam bag can 'dra bar 'gyur te/ rlan bag med cing bcang du mi 'dod par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du tshos dka' bar 'gyur te/ dus ring mos tshos par 'gyur ba dang / de tshos par gyur nas kyang 'phral du zhag lon pa lta bur 'gyur te/ nyin zhag gcig 'das pa ltar rlangs pa med cing bsdur mi 'dod par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du de'i rlangs pa rma bya'i mgrin pa 'dra bar kha dog sna tshogs par 'gyur bas na/ rlangs pa rma bya'i mgrin pa 'dra zhes bya'o/ / de zos par gyur nas kyang / khong myos pa dang / brgyal ba dang / lus rngul ba skyed par 'gyur te/ khong myos pa ni sems med pa'o/ / brgyal ba ni 'du shes nyams pa'o/ / lus rngul ba ni bad kan 'thon pa'o/ / yang 'bras chan de dri dang mdog sogs zhes pa'i dri dang / kha dog dang / ro dang / reg pa rang gi ji lta ba nyid nyams shing 'jig par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du rul cing zhes pa/ rab tu 'drul bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de bzhin du rma bya'i sgro ltar 'tsher ba zhes bya ste/ rma bya'i mjug sgro'i rtse mo lta bu'am/ chu nang du til mar gyi thigs pa bor ba ltar sngo dmar 'tsher bar 'gyur ro/ /

skt: saṃprati ciṣaduṣṭasya maktya chakṣaṇaga vidhevānodanaḥ sāndraḥ vidadhepyākāraḥ; naca dhiraḥ yituṃ śakyate | yataḥprathak‌ siktho na bhavet‌ | cireṇa pacyate, bahunā kina pākaṃ yāti | ra pakra nippannapākūḥ sadaya eva parathapitopamo sāntarito'tikāntāhorātraḥ | mathūrakaṣḍena ṭha upmāvāppasajinonāyaṇa yasya tathoktaḥ | pitīpasaṃ hṛti | yathā paryuṣitaṃ bhakta--nira ptadtha̭ca ` mavati vathā-viṣadūpitaṃ sadyo'vata tamapa tādarāmeva bhavati | sa copayukto bhe mṛṣṭārasaṃkān‌ karoti | moho-vaivityam‌ mūḍhā-saṃjātabharaśaṣaḥ | prasekaḥ-ścaṣmaniṣṭhīvataḥ hīyate gandhavaṇāyairiti | ādiśabdena rsaspaḥ | saṅikamadhyā sthānam‌] papara mla (191) terudhinḍusadṛraundarakaiśacaṃ pūṇā bhavati | edibhiḥ parīkṣā 1 4) hi 0--atha saviṣanipānaṭakṣaṇaṃ tatra odana ṭakṣayatisāndra ivāvikcāgyatāṃ yāti sadgabo'pyadraya hva khāvadhitu na śakyate; pakraḥ paruvitopamo bhavet‌ | syaskau'pyahorācauṣitavananirūṣmā stabdhaśca syāt‌ | mayūrakaṇṭhatuṭyauṣmā-nīkhvāpyaḥ, sodādikṛtvamūṣpasaṃvandhāt‌ sākṣātsaṃvandhadauprīṇā~ vadyasrāṇalvāt‌ ›, sīdau--vricārāyākteḥ) tasyāpi tasya mṛcchaviānaiḍayatuśtythaṃ prathagrahaṇam‌ | āśabdādrasādīnāṃ bhradaṇaṃ kiyate china niṣapadrate, sabhya cha śrapito'pi d‌ dhatte, caśdhikānvitaḥ jarakaṣipatatalabindusadyaḥ
tib: tshod ma zhes bya ba ni sran tshod la sogs pa ste/ de la dug yod na myur du skam par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du bskol ba ni mdog gnag cing dri ma can du 'gro ba dang / der zhes pa tshod ma bskol ba der rang gi gzugs kyi rang bzhin las chung zhing zhan pa'am/ che zhing lhag pa'am/ mi sdug pa ste/ rang bzhin gzhan du snang bar 'gyur ro/ / yang na der rang gi rnam pa nyid snang bar mi 'gyur ro/ / yang tshod ma bskol ba der sbu ba la sogs pa 'byung ba las kyang shes par bya ste/ de la sbu ba ni sbu ba'i rnam par 'bur du chas shing 'byung ste/ de'i nang na ri mo sna tshogs pa dag snang ba'am/ mtshams 'bye zhing 'chad pa lta bur snang ba dang / kha chu 'dra bar na la nal por 'byung ba dang / chu bur dag ji ltar chu'i nang na snang ba dang 'dra ste/ de dag der 'byung bar 'gyur te/ btung ba mngar

btung ba ni rgun 'brum la sogs pa la sngar sbyar ba phal cher mdog dmar por snang zhing mngar ba dang skyur ba ste/ yang btung ba'i bye brag bal po'i se'u la sogs pa las byas pa'i ro skyur ba dang / / tshod ma ste/ shu sha dang / pa tha la sogs pa dang / sha btsos pa dag ste/ btung ba mang po mdog can la sogs pa de thams cad dug dang bcas par gyur na/ mtshams 'bye ba dang / ro dang bral bar 'gyur te/ ro drug po dag mi snang zhing gsal bar mi rnyed par 'gyur te/ de ltar na ro dang bral ba ste ro mi zhim pa dang / phyin ci log gi ro dang ldan par 'gyur ba'i don no/ / sha khu ri mo sngor snang zhing / / 'o ma zangs mdog zho dri ma/ / dar ba la ni ser dang gnag /

sha khu ni sha las byas pa'i khu ba ste/ de dug gis sbags par gyur pa na/ dbus na ri mo sngon por snang bar 'gyur ro/ / 'o ma la dug gis sbags na/ nang na zangs kyi mdog lta bur snang bar 'gyur ro/ / zho la dug yod na ri mo dri ma can snang bar 'gyur ro/ / dar ba la dug yod na ni ri mo ser po dang nag po snang bar 'gyur ro/ / mar dug dang 'dres na ni ri mo chu dang 'dra bar snang bar 'gyur ro/ / chang dang chu la dug yod na gnag cing snag tsha ltar snang bar 'gyur ro/ / sbrang rtsi la dug yod na ni ljang gur snang zhing mdog sngo bsangs su snang bar 'gyur ro/ / til mar la dug yod na ni ri mo dmar zhing zangs ltar snang bar 'gyur ro/ /

shing tog ma smin pa la dug gis sbags pa ni/ smin pa lta bur snang bar 'gyur la/ shing tog smin pa rnams la dug gis sbags pa ni yongs su 'drul zhing rul bar 'gyur ro/ / kha zas rlon dang skam pa dag /

kha zas rlon pa ni dug gis sbags na ni rnyings par 'gyur la/ kha zas skam po dag la dug gis sbags na ni mdog nyams shing kha dog dang bral bar 'gyur te/ 'dir tshig gnyis bzhin sbyar bar bya'o/ / snyi ba dang ni sra ba dag /

skt: stehakhavaṇayogādapyabhirevaṃ sthāt‌ ataḥ pakcamūgairapi parīkṣābharakārāntaraṃ droyannāda-makṣikāḥ siṣeṇānanena bhriyante | nirīnāstu satho vipadyante | śeṣaṃ yuṃgasam‌ | evaṃ pūrvo tābhiḥ pasīkṣābhirannaṃ savipra saṣṭaṃ jñāsavā prayasnatasayajet‌ | tameva yāgaprayalnamāha-yathā tena sabiveṇānnena na viperan‌ na naśyeyuḥ śṣudrajantabo'pi, vipunama̭hānta iti sūcanārtho'piśābd‌ḥ | tiṣajuṣṭāaṣṭaṅhadayaṃ | hārāt‌ kākaḥ kṣāmasvaso bhavet‌ | utko uccaiḥ chośanti darīnadeva uukadāyuhasāsaṣi piṣadranamātrādeva ca hasaḥ svachatti | gḍa jīvajīvasya jāyate | upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam‌}maraṇa kasyacinna gchāniḥ evaṃ javijīvakasya | cakora kṣiviraktasavam‌ | dṛdraitaditi sarvatra yojanīyaḥ karaucvasya syānmadodayo madoppattiḥ ! kapotapara kṣacakravākāsyajantyasūm‌ prāṇān‌ vijahati cā maraṇaduḥkhābhyāhatāḥ | udṭijate'lthaṃ mājā bānarastu rākkṛt‌-purīṣa muccati | upalakṣaṇaṃ ce praṣṭhato sukho roditi ca | tathā hṛṣyenmayuḥ sta taditi sabiṣānnaparāmaścaḥ | dṛṣaityaluvataimāḥ pumaṣreti vacanaṃ sarvatra madhye saṃmrayayāthamānta garahītasvāt‌ | viṣa cāsya daśenādeva mandate bhavati | annaṃ bhaktādiviṣavat‌ jñātvā dayajede katha prayaltaḥ prayajñena | tameva prayna̭ṃ durayaḥ yathā yena prakāreṇa syajyamānena śudrajantavo ma kādyo'pi tena biṣeṇa na vipadayeran‌ mana; yustathā syajet‌ | kipunarbhahānta daya vdāthaiḥ
tib: rdzas snyi ba rnams dang / de bzhin du sra ba dag la dug gis sbags na/ reg pa go bzlog par 'gyur te/ snyi ba ni sra bar 'gyur/ sra ba ni snyi bar 'gyur te/

gal te me tog gi phreng ba la dug yod na ni de'i rtse mo gas shing zad pa dang / rnyid cing kun tu dengs par 'gyur ba dang / dri mi zhim pa ste dri zhim po dang bral nas/ dri mnam pa gzhan dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / gos la nag po tal til dang / / spu rnams 'thul zhing kha tshar 'chad/ / ces bya ba la/ steng nas bgo ba dang 'og tu gding ba la sogs pa'i gos rnams la dug gis bsgos pa na ni ri mo dri ma can tal til dag snang ba dang / gos kyi spu rnams rnam par 'thul zhing chad pa dang / kha tshar gcad cing lhung bar 'gyur ro/ /

gser dngul gyi khams kyi rang bzhin can gyi rin po che rnams te/ 'di dang gzhan yang bsdu'o/ / mu tig ni mu tig gi rdo gu'o/ / shing dang rdo ni dngos su zad do/ / rin chen ni bai DUr+ya dang / rdo rje la sogs pa ste/ gser dngul la sogs pa 'di rnams la dug gis sbags na dri ma chags pa ste/ / 'dam gyis bskus pa 'dra bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du gser dngul la sogs pa 'di rnams nyid kyi gzi mdangs dang / reg pa dang 'od nyams shing med par 'gyur ro/ / sa yi snod ni mdog bcas byed/ / ces bya ba la/ sa'i snod ces bya ba kham phor la sogs pa las byas pa'i snod rnams ni mdog med pa dag kyang /

skt: vakṣage sukhaprāpre rā bhavati | jiha eyojāuṃ mavati | uprādayaśca syuḥ | gasājñatvaṃ-jicchā rasaṃ na cetayata ivyatha̭ḥ| hanoḥ stambhaśca myāt‌] tatra senyaḥ pūvetirgaṇṭarūpā ditāḥ | sarva cānyadapi yadviṣaṃ jayati taddhitam‌
tib: dug ster zhing sbyin par byed pas na dug ster te/ dug sbyor ba'i mi'o/ / de'i kha ni sngo bskams la zhes bya ba/ de'i kha sngo zhing bskams par gyur pa dang / de bzhin du gnod bag gis zhes bya ba ngo tsha ba dang bcas pa lta bur g.yer bag med pa dang / phyogs kun tu blta zhing rtog par byed pa dang / de bzhin du lus tsha la rngul zhing 'dar bag dang ldan la/ rang gi nyes pa'i dogs pas skrag pa ste/ khong skyo ba dang / 'jigs pa ste bred pa dang bcas pa dang / 'gros 'khyor ba ste/ rdeg 'chos shing 'tsho ba dang / de bzhin du glal zhing kha gdangs par byed par 'gyur ro/ / dug ldan zas ni mes bsregs na/ / me lce gcig 'khyil me stag rgal/ / du ba rma bya'i mgrin 'drar 'gyur/ / me lce mi 'bar 'bar yang mnan/ / sbrang mas zos na 'chi bar 'gyur/ / bya rog gis zos skad zhan 'gyur/ / 'di ni ne tsho da ru ha/ / ri skegs kyis mthong ca co 'byin/ / ngang pas zos na rdeg 'chos la/ / shang shang te'u na bar 'gyur/ / sreg pa mig ni mi chags byed/ / khrung khrung dag ni 'dzur bar 'gyur/ / phug ron khu byug bya ga ga dang / / ngur pas zos na 'chi bar 'gyur/ / byi la skyo zhing 'dor bar 'gyur/ / spre'u mi gtsang 'dor bar byed/ / rma byas de mthong dga' bar byed/ / dug gi dpal ni nyams par 'gyur/ / de ltar zas ni dug ldan bar/ / shes shing lci nas de yis ni/ / srog chags phra mo yan chad la'ang / / gnod par 'gyur bar 'bad de dor/ / reg na g.ya' zhing tsha la na/ / rims 'debs 'brum 'byung tshor ba chung / / sen mo spu 'byung lus skrang ste/ / de la dug ni rnam 'jig pa'i/ / tsan+dan shug pa pu shel tse/ / so ma'i shun bcas bal bu'i 'dab/ / ru rta sle tres a ka ru'i/ / chus bkrus blugs shing bsku bar bya/ / khar chud nas ni mchil snabs mang / / lce mchu sbrid cing bem por

skt: viṣānna jamāṅayaṃ prāpe tandrādayaśca bhavari tayorāmapakrārāyayogetayodhiṣayorvatemānasya puṃ yathāyogaṃ vāntaviriktasya haridre kaṭabhītyādiḥ mauṣadhaṃ nāvanādiṣu yojayet‌! tatra madanalāla, kumīkorātakīphaṭaimedhuyuktaidhamanam‌ | tasya sne yighvā virecanam‌ | pakāśāyagate yamitasyeva nīi nīphaṭayuktena dhṛtena virecanameva
tib: de gnyis zhes pa ma zhu ba dang / zhu ba'i gnas dag slon dang khrus bya ba ste/ slon sman gyis ma zhu ba'i gnas nas slon can de drangs pa dang / 'khru sman gyis 'ju ba'i gnas nas khrus bya zhing bton nas/ de ltar legs par sbyang ba'i lus la ser po gnyis la sogs pa nas/ sna nas btang zhing mig sman khu ba dang / blud pa'i bar gyi sbyor ba dug zhi bar bya ba'i phyir sbyar bar bya'o/ / de la ser po gnyis zhes bya ba ni yung ba dang skyer pa ste/ ser po rnam pa gnyis so/ / bu ram ni bu ram shing las byung ba'i bu ram dkar po'o/ / gi ri kar ni ga ta bi'o/ / sen du bi ra ni shwe ta puSh+pe'o/ / nis pa ba ni gang bu can gyi 'bru'i khyad par zhig go/ / ba shis ka ni he gu ba tra'o/ / tan du li ya ni me gan+d+ha ste/ de'i rtsa ba'o/ / bya gag gi sgo nga ni khyim bya'i sgo nga'o/ / a bal gu za ni so ma ra dza ste/ rdzas de rnams cha snyoms la lde gur byas te sna nas gtang ba dang / mig sman du bsku ba dang / blud cing sbyin par bya ba dag dug zhi bar bya ba'i phyir bya'o/ /

skt: viṣasuktāya pula uradhvādhaśca śuddhāya kāṭhe seṣṣmamatiśṛkṣṇaṃ tāsracūṇe samākṣikaṃ dadyāt‌ | kiṃbhūtaṃ tat‌ hṛṣiśodhanaṃ hṛdayaṃ rodhayediyarthaḥ | viṣasuktayedayāhitāranyādiṣvāt‌ paro nipātaḥ| kāka isyupalakṣaṇam‌ | deśasāsmyāgnyādīn‌ vyapekṣeteythaḥ| ddhe hṛdi svaliṅge jñāte tato'nantara̭ṃdemacūṇa̭sya śāṇaṃ kcatuthīraṃ dāpayet‌
tib: dug 'thungs pa'i skyes bu de/ slon sman dang khrus sman gyis steng ste ro stod dang / 'og ste ro smad sbyangs shing dag par gyur nas/ rigs shing 'tsham pa'i gnas skabs kyi dus su zangs ma bzang po legs par bdar ba'i phye ma zhib mo sbrang rtsi dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gu de snying na yod pa'i nad sbyong bar byed pa la sbyin par bya'o/ /
de ltar zangs ma'i phye ma'i lde gu sbyin zhing / snying nad sbyangs par gyur nas/ de'i 'og tu gser gyi phye ma zhib mor byas pa srang gcig gi bzhi cha sbyin par bya'o/ /

skt: debhti datte sati yo guṇaḥ myānaḥ bāha-hema pivatīti hemapaptasyaṣdhe bidha na saḥ te | katham‌ paśmapatre jalamiva | namya ca damaya vistīṇemāyujīyate epa vidhirmare'pi smatau yo 1 uktaḥ| sajjata ityatrātmanepadaṃ cintyam‌
tib: gang gi phyir gser 'thungs par gyur pas dug zos pa'i yan lag rnams la dug de chags shing zhen par mi 'gyur te/ dper na pad+ma'i 'dab mar chu chags par mi 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ de la chags par mi 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du gser 'thungs par gyur pa dag ni tshe ring zhing 'phel bar 'gyur ba nyid kyang 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: viruddhaṃ cāhāraṃ garaviṣopamaṃ dhidā | vi gasvaddhirudhāsa api vyādhimūlyuhetava itya; tathācoktaṃ saṃmarahe-"visphodagutmamadanidradhimaṭayakya jobaṭhasmṛtimatīndariyacittanā śam‌ | kuyāriraṭamada uvaramakhapintamaṣṭau gadāśca manau viṣavara matyum‌
tib: bshad ma thag pa'i dug zhi bar bya ba'i cho ga 'di ni 'og nas bshad pa'i sbyar dug la bya bar drang srong gis bshad do/ / sbyar ba'i dug ni dug sbyar ma'o/ / sbyar dug dang ldan pa'i zas skom dag ni dus phyis zhig nas gsod par byed pa yin pas gtso bo ma yin la/ de ltar gtso bo ma yin pa nyid kyis na 'di'i cho ga'i dpyad du bya ba phyis bstan pa yin no/ / de bzhin du zas kyi phung po yon tan mchog dang ldan pa dag kyang g.yos su bya zhing sbyar ba dang / / tshad dang dus la sogs pa'i dbang gis kha zas mi 'phrod par gyur pa ni/ sdug bsngal skyed par byed pas sbyar ba'i dug dang 'dra ste/ 'phral dang dug phyi nas gsod par 'gyur ro/ / de bas na 'dir smras pa ni/ kha zas dag kyang mi mthun zos/ / sbyar dug 'dra bar shes par bya/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ kha zas kyang g.yos su byas kyang sbyar ba dang / tshad pa dang / yul dang / dus la sogs pas mi mthun par gyur pa zos pa ni/ sbyar ba'i dug dang 'dres par shes par bya zhing khong du chud par bya'o/ /

rlan can gyi sha ni chen po dang / chu la spyod pa dang / chu la gnas pa zhes bya ba'i sde tshan gsum du bstan pa ste/ de dang mon sran gre'u zhes bya ba/ sran ma dang / sbrang rtsi dang / 'o ma dang / myu gu can dang / pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang / de la sogs pa mi 'phrod pa'i zas gang yin pa des ni/ de'i gnod pa'i khyad par 'dir ma bstan kyang / drang srong tsa ra kas ji skad bstan pa'i ma ning la sogs pa'i 'gyur ba skyed cing / des 'phral tam/ dus phyis srog 'joms par byed pa yin no/ / mi 'phrod pa'i 'bras bu tsa ra kas bshad pa ni/ 'on pa dang / long ba dang / 'dar bag dang / rmongs bag dang / lkugs pa dang / dran pa med pa dang / rmugs pa rnams kyi rtsa ba yin pa'am/ yang na 'chi bar 'gyur ba nyid yin no/ / zhes bshad pa yin te/

skt: tadeva viruddhamojanamāha--āmiṣaṃ māṃsamanūpaṃ bhadāmagavāricasvāriśayākhyaṃ māṣādi bhiḥ sakṣābhaḥ saha virudhyate ānūpeṣvāpi madhye viśeṣādatiśayena payasā saha matsyā viruṣyante|yato masasyakṣīre svāurakhavipākisvānmahābhiṣyandinī cimāsyo madsya: payasā sahāvyantaviraddhaḥ | 2 punaḥ sakarurīye chohitāsyaḥ savato śehitarāji prāyo; bhūmau carati so'syabhiṣyanditimatvāu taraṃ biraṃddhaḥ| epa cāhāse'nirdiṃṣṭavikārakā yathoktān‌ visphoṭān‌ karoti | kāchāntareṇa vikaṣaitsāṃ vinā prāṇānapi harati | kaścicca vir‌ dvāhāse nirdiṣṭavikārakāsai | yathā upodikā tisārāyeti
tib: khyad par du zhes bya ba ni lhag par ro/ / nya ni ro hi ta la sogs pa ste/ rlan can gzhan dag na yod pa'ang rung ste/ de ni 'o ma dang lhan cig zos na mi 'phrod pa yin no/ / de bzhin du nya rnams kyi nang nas kyang / tsi li tsi ma zhes bya ba'i nya 'o ma dang lhan cig mi 'phrod pa yin te/ 'di gnyi ga yang ro mngar ba dang / / zhu ba'i rjes mngar ba dang / bad kan skyed la dro ba dang / bsil bar byed pa'i tshul gyis nus pa mi mthun pa yin la/ nus pa mi mthun pas na khrag 'khrug par byed pa yin la/ bad kan skyed par byed cing rgyu ba'i lam 'gag par byed pa yin no/ / de las kyang nya tsi li tsi ma ni cung zad zlum zhing mdog dmar por snang la/ phal cher sa la rgyu bas/ gal te 'o ma dang lhan cig zos na gdon mi za bar khrag las byung ba'am/ rtug 'gags las byung ba'i nad gang yang rung ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes drang srong tsa ra kas bshad do/ /

'o ma dang lhan cig skyur thams cad mi 'phrod do/ / 'dir kun gyi sgra smos pas skyur ba la sogs pa rdzas gsher ba thams cad bsdu ba dang / de bzhin du sman skyur ba dang / chu'i rtsa ba la sogs pa de thams cad 'o ma dang lhan cig mi 'phrod pa yin no zhes nges par shes par bya'o/ / 'dir lhan cig ces smos pa ni/ don lhag par bstan par bya ba'i phyir te/ 'o ma 'thungs na zas gzhan gyis bar bcad du zin cing / pho bar ji srid gnas par 'gyur ba de srid kyi bar du/ skyur po la sogs pa rdzas skyur ba gang yin bza' bar mi bya ste/ lhag pa'i don 'di lhan cig ces bya ba'i sgra las shes par bya'o/ / de yang bsdus pa las/ gsher ba dang bska ba'i rdzas thams cad ni 'o ma dang lhan cig gam/ de'i rjes la mi 'phrod pa yin no zhes bshad pa yin no/ / shing thog ni de bzhin no zhes bya bar 'dir 'o ma dang lhan cig mi 'phrod do zhes bya bar sbyar te/ skyur ba rnams 'o ma dang mi 'phrod pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad do/ / shing tog kyang mi 'phrod de/ don gyis na shing tog star ka'i 'bras bu la sogs pa skyur ba ma yin pa dag kyang / star ka'i 'bras bu la sogs pa phal cher lhan cig mi 'phrod do zhes bya ba ni de bzhin no zhes bya ba'i don yin no/ / de yang drang srong tsa ra kas a mra'i 'bras bu dang / a mra ta ka dang / ba lung dang / li ku rtse dang / ka ra mar ta dang / chu shing gi 'bras bu dang / skyur rtsi chen po dang / rgya shug gi 'bras bu dang / ko sha a mra dang / 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu dang / bil ba'i rkang dang / tig ti li ka dang / ku shu dang / star ka'i 'bras bu dang / pa na sa dang / rgya star gyi 'bras bu dang / bal po se'u dang / skyu ru ra la sogs pa de lta bu dang / gzhan dag dang / skyur ba'i rdzas skam po dang / gsher ba thams cad 'o ma dang lhan cig mi 'phrod pa yin no zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de bzhin rgya sran khre dag dang / / ba la ku mu ta mi 'phrod/ / ces bya ba la/ de bzhin du rgya sran ku la da tha la sogs pa yang 'o ma dang lhan cig mi 'phrod pa yin no/ /

la phug la sogs pa'i sngo rngad rjen pa zos nas 'o ma spang bar bya'o/ / la sogs pa'i sgras ni/ sku thi ra dang / shi kru dang / bye'u rug pa la sogs pa bsdu'o/ / de yang drang srong tsa ra kas/ mdze'i nad du 'gyur ba'i 'jigs pas/ la phug dang / yungs kar gyi lo ma dang / sgog skya dang / gri na gan+d+ha dang / zin thig le su mu kha dang / su ra la sogs pa'i sgras zos nas/ 'o ma btung bar mi bya'o zhes bshad pa yin no/ / sngo rngad ces smos pa ni la phug gi khyad par la bya bar bstan te/ 'di ltar smos pa las na 'di ni rjen par yang bzar rung bar bstan pa yin la/ sngar tshod ma'i sde tshan gyi nang du 'di smos pas ni/ tshod ma nyid du byar rung bar ston pa yin no/ / de ltar na rjen pa zos nas 'o ma mi btung ba yin gyi/ tshod mar byas pa ma yin te/ legs par btsos nas khu ba btsir ba dang / snum la sogs pas brngos te/ tshod mar g.yos su byas pa'i rjes la 'o ma mi btung ba ni ma yin no/ / phag rgod byi dur sha mi bza'/
phag rgod kyi sha dang / byi dur sha lhan cig mi bza' ba dang / de bzhin du khyim bya dang / bri sha ta'i sha zho dang lhan cig mi bza'o/ /

skt: tadaditi | phaṅvalchuratthādayaḥ payasā sahaṃ virudyāḥ | varako-trīhimedaḥ | caskodālaketi prāgukte: | bahamakuṣṭakau--rimbidhānyaviropī | upaḍakṣaṇaṃ cedam‌ | ¢ māṣaniṣpāvāvāpi hi vis‌. ddhau payasā sah‌ | ” iti saṃmrahe kathitam‌ |¡ 18 ||! de9-tadkulatthādyaḥ varko barīdibhedaḥ, kaṅguḥ pariyayuḥ, vahchaḥ niṣāvaḥ; makuṭa: kaḍāyabhedaḥ | cuścutaśāh‌-valkapharcchatākavakakarīrāmlaphlakvaṇakuktthapiṇyā kadadhiṃtelānūpaudakaviroṣidpkā kājādhekamāṃ samayajā-mbavaciḍhīcimagodhāmataṃsyavarāhamāpāśca naikadhyamaśnīyāt‌ parayaso'nte veti
tib: sha rlon pa mkhris pa dag dang lhan cig mi bza' ba dang / de bzhin du la phug ma sha'i tshod ma dang lhan cig mi bza'o/ /
le brgan rtsi'i tshod ma dang / lug sha lhan cig mi bza' ba dang / de bzhin du 'bru'i myu gu skyes pa'i tshod ma dang / pad+ma'i rtsa ba lhan cig bza' bar mi bya'o/ /

ma sha'i sran tshod dang / bur ma mam/ zho'am mar ram 'o ma'am/ li ku rtse'i 'bras bu lhan cig bza' bar mi bya'o/ / chu shing 'bras bu dar bar min/ / ta la'i 'bras bu zhor mi 'phrod/ / ces bya ba la/ chu shing gi 'bras bu dar bar mi bza' ba'am/ ta la'i 'bras bu zho dang lhan cig mi 'phrod pas mi bza'o/ /

skt: bhakṣayisveti | dāritakaṃ mūkaṃ ̱kuṭherādi bhuktvā payastyajenna punaḥ śākam‌ | mūkādipayasyajet‌ | snigdhacinnaṃ sākasādhanena sādhitaṃ uksavā kṣīra na syajet‌ 1 etasmādeva ca jñāpakānmūṭakādīnāsubhayarūpatvaṃ vedham‌ | haritakva, rākvaṃ ca | tathā mūkādīnāṃ yadi śākatvaprasiddhirebābhaviṣyat‌ tato haritakaṃ mūṭakādi. bhakṣayasveti tantkkannāvaṣyat‌ | tasmānmūkasya haritakaṃ ca jñeyam‌ | chadyunena saṭa kṣīrasya prayoga uktaḥ--“sādhayecchupa0-madhvādīni samāṃrāni tulyapramāṇāni mitho varidhyante | katham‌ | dve vā trīṇi caikatra vā sarvāṇi | yathā-madhusarpiṣī,madhuvase,māścikateṭe,mākṣikodake | trīṇi trīṇi yathā-madhusapirvasevyevamādi | natu yayevevidhau virodha ucyate tatkathamagastyalehe kuḍavaṃ ca prathagdhṛtāt‌ | tāt‌ sapippalīcūṇaivat‌ siddhadchīte ca mākṣikāditi tairadhṛtamadhūnāṃ tusyāṃśānāṃ prayogakramaḥ | kevakhānāṃ madhvādīnāṃ samāṃśānāsupayegi divasādavirodha ekhana tu dravyāntarasaṃyogena .| teṣāṃ saṃyogasaṃskārādivaśāddhiciṣṭayuṇāntasevpattidaṣṭā | tasmādagassyehādau dravyāntare saṃyogādivaśādavirodha eva
tib: ka ka ma tsi tsha ba gnyis po pi pi ling dang / na le sham dang / lhan cig sbrang rtsi'am bu ram dang ldan par mi bza'o/ /
ka ka ma tsi de ni nya btsos pa'i snod du g.yos su byas pa'ang mi bza'o/ /
ka ma ta ni/ ka ka ma tsi ste/ de snod gzhan dag tu btsos nas nyin mtshan lon zhing zhag 'das pa dag bza' bar mi bya'o/ / de la mi bza' zhes bya ba 'di ni/
nya brngos pa'i snum la brngos pa'i pi pi ling spang bar bya ste/
mar sar 'khar ba'i snod du zhag bcu lon pa spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du go bye'i 'bras bu la ta ka bza' ba dang / btung bar dro ba dag sman pas spang bar bya'o/ /

bas zhes bya ba'i sha sreg shar bya bar mi 'phrod pas bza' bar mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du kam bi la zhes bya ba ste/ ming gi rnam grangs yan lag dmar zhes bya ba de dar bar btsos te bza' ba mi 'phrod pa yin no/ /

skt: minnāṃre api madhvājye dinyavāryatupānena virudhyete | tṛtīyārthe tasiḥ | apirābdānna keva samārā ityatheḥ| madhu mākṣikam‌, puṣkaravījaṃ cekadhyaṃ virabhyate | tathā magha mākṣikaṃ bhereyam‌,kharjurasavam‌ , dākara śakaṃrayā kṛtaṃ mayamekataropayuktaṃ virudhyate | kṣereyaḥ pāyaso manthālupāno viruddhaḥ | mantho'nupāna ca yasya sa evam‌ | preya datiḥṣīrādūḍhan‌))] (204) aṣaṅgahadaye| [ śatra hākhadriḥ kuprasavaḥ śākaviśeṣaḥ sādhacchatrānukāse pītābhāstaḥ kaṭutevān‌ sapapatekhabhṛṣṭo viruddhaḥ 255|||
tib: 'o thug dang / kri sa ra dang / chang lhan cig mi 'phrod pas spang bar bya'o/ / de la 'o thug ni 'bras chan 'o ma'i nang du btsos te spod kyis btab pa ni 'o thug go/ / kri sa ra ni til dang / sran mung+ga dang / ma shal sogs pa g.yos pa'i thug pa'o/ / chang ni 'bras btags pa la sogs pa las mnan nas byas pa'o/ / de rnams lhan cig tu bza' zhing longs spyad par mi bya'o/ / sbrang rtsi mar sar zhag til mar/ / chu rnams gnyis gnyis gsum gsum mam/ / cha mnyam lhan cig zos pa dag /

sbrang rtsi la sogs pa'i rdzas lnga ni gnyis gnyis sam/ gsum du zhes bya ba gsum gsum mam/ cha mnyam zhes bya ba gcig tu cha mnyam par bya ste/ bza' ba ni phan tshun mi 'phrod pa yin no/ / de yang gnyis gnyis ni dper na/ mar sar dang sbrang rtsi'am/ mar sar dang zhag gam/ / mar sar dang til mar ram/ sbrang rtsi dang chu'o/ / gsum gsum ni dper na/ sbrang rtsi dang mar sar dang / til mar du bza' ba'o/ / cha mnyam pa ni sbrang rtsi dang / mar sar dang / zhag dang / til mar dang / chu rnams la bsres te lhan cig zos pa ste/ de dag ni mi 'phrod pa yin no/ / mar sbrang cha ni mi mnyam yang / / char pa'i chu ni 'thungs na gnod/ / ces bya ba la/ mar dang sbrang rtsi cha mi mnyam par gyur kyang / char pa'i chu dang lhan cig 'thungs na mi 'phrod par 'gyur ro/ / sbrang rtsi pad+ma'i sa bon dang / sbrang rtsi 'bru chang kha rar min/ /

sbrang rtsi dang pad+ma'i sa bon lhan cig sbyar te bza' ba yang mi 'phrod pa yin no/ / de bzhin du sbrang rtsi dang / 'bru chang zhes bya ba/ 'bru las mnan pa'i chang dang / sha khar las byas pa'i chang mi 'phrod cing gnod pa skyed pa yin pas/ rlung shin tu skyed par byed pa yin no/ / 'o thug rjes la skyo mar min/ / sha mo yungs mar brngos mi 'phrod/ / ces bya ba la/ 'o thug ni 'o ma la 'bras btsos pa'i thug pa'o/ / de ni skyo ma dang mi 'phrod pa yin te/ skyo ma de ni bad kan skyed par byed pa yin te/ skyo ma zhes bya ba la phye dang mar sbyar ba chu dang sbyar la ha cang sla ba'am/ ha cang ska bar ma gyur ba la bya'o/ / sha mo ni gdugs lta bur skyes ba'i tshod ma'i khyad par ro/ / de ni yungs mar brngos te bza' ba mi 'phrod pa yin te/

skt: upodakā-tikhkarkena sādhitā'tisārāya | tādarthye catuśyetra | artho nimittam‌ | tasme ida tadatha̭m‌, tadthameva tādarthyam‌ | tenātisārakaraṇamivyartho jāyate
tākā parakcijātirvāsaṇyā prasannayā yuktā vadhisadhyate | kṛtmāvairanātisvinnasudrādibhiśca saha vimadhyate | saiva vākā vasapahavasayā bhṛṣṭā sayastasraṇreva | prāṇām‌ mārayati
dārīlasya paścividyeṣasya māṃsaṃ hāridraśaṭaraprotapānite dasdribhinā sayo jīcitaṃ dhanti
tib: u po ta ka ni li sa zhes bya ba'i tshod ma ste/ de til gyi tshigs ma dang btsos shing g.yos pa ni 'khru bar byed pa ste/ tshad pas 'khru bar byed pa yin no/ / bya gag sha ni chang dngas dang / / ku la ma sha'i thug mi 'phrod/ / ces bya ba la/ bya gag ni bya ba la ga zhes bya ste/ de'i sha chang dngas ma ba ru ra zhes bya ba dang / ku la ma sha tha'i thug pa dang lhan cig mi 'phrod de/ ku la ma ni mon sran sde'u dang sran chung la sogs pa btsos nas/ shing kun la sogs pa'i spod btab pa'i thug pa'o/ / de nyid phag rgod tshil la brngos/ / srog ni 'phral du 'joms par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ bya gag gi sha de nyid phag rgod kyi tshil dang brngos pa ni/ srog 'phral du 'joms par byed pa yin te/ de'i mod la gsod par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i don to/ / de bzhin sreg pa rma bya dang / / la ba ka pin dza la sram/ / e raN+Da yi me la ni/ / e raN+Da'i mar brngos mi 'phrod/ / ces bya ba la/ de bzhin du sreg pa la sogs pa'i sha/ / e raN+Da'i me la btsos shing de bzhin du e raN+Da'i mar dang bsres shing brngos pa ni mi 'phrod de/ snga ma dang 'dra bar srog 'phral du 'joms par byed pa yin no/ / ha rid dra sha skyer pa yi/ / thur ma dag la bskyon nas ni/ / skyer pa'i me la bsregs gyur pa/ / 'phral du srog ni 'joms par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ de bzhin du bya ha rid dra'i sha skyer pa'i thur ma la bskyon zhing btsugs nas de bzhin du shing skyer pa bus pa'i me la bsregs shing tshos par byas pa ni 'phral du srog 'joms par byed de/ dug dang 'dra bar myur du srog 'phrog cing srog dang bral bar byed do zhes bya ba'i don to/ /

skt: tadeva hārītamāṃsaṃ masmapāṃśupariṣvasataṃ samākṣikaṃ viruddham‌ | masma ca pāṃḍuśca bhasmapāṃū tābhyāṃ paridhvastaṃ tābhyāṃ dhūritam‌ | siddhasa coktam‌na jātu kaṭuterena bhṛṣṭāmaghyādupodakām‌ | priya̭guḥ kalkasiddhāṅgaḥ pāyasaṃ na samācaret‌ ° iti 30 ha° -dārītamāṃsasya bhasmādisaṃyogādvirodhamāha~-masmanā, pā~ñcanā vā pariṣvastaṃ syo viditam‌ ,madhvaktaṃ hārītamasaṃ sago jīvitaṃ vyāpādayati
tib: bya ha ri ta'i sha de nyid thal ba dang rdul gyis gos shing nyams par gyur pa dang / sbrang rtsi dang bcas pa ni 'phrod pa ma yin te/ 'phral du gsod par byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du mi mthun pa gzhan dag ste/ grang ba dang / dro ba dang / sar pa dang / rnying pa dang / btsos pa dang / ma btsos pa dag ni rlung dang / bad kan dang mi mthun pa'i sman rnams ni/ bad kan gyi khams dang mi 'phrod par gyur pa yin no/ / la la ni phan tshun gcig la gcig mi 'phrod pa yin la/ kha cig ni sbyor ba'i dbang gis phrad pa las mi 'phrod pa yin zhing / gzhan dag ni g.yos su bya ba la sogs pa'i dbang gis mi 'phrod pa yin la/ yang gzhan dag ni dus dang yul dang tshad la sogs pas mi 'phrod pa yin pa dang / de bzhin du rang bzhin gyis mi 'phrod pa yang yod de/ gzhung rtsom par byed pas/ bsdus pa las bshad pa/ rdzas mthu dang ldan pa dag ni yon tan phan tshun mi mnyam pa nyid kyis g.yos su bya ba la sogs pa'i dbang gis mi 'phrod par 'gyur te/ 'o ma ni rgya sran ku lang+tha dang mi 'phrod la/ pa na sa ni nya dang mi 'phrod cing / mar dron po dang / sbrang rtsi dang / zho dron por mi 'phrod pa dang / tsha sgo can gyi chu dang phyer bsres te mtshan mo bza' ba mi 'phrod pa dang / de bzhin du chu gzhan dag dang nas 'dra mi 'phrod pa lta bu'o/ /

skt: drabhyāpasītaṃ tasratipadokṭyā'roṣaviruddhaḥ saṅgrahaḥ kalumaśākyaḥ iti tatsaṅyakṭāthai vyāpi chakṣaṇamādaha-yatkicvidannapānauṣadhaṃ, vā doṣaśacchedaya svasthānāt‌ saṃvāhya na haret‌ na̱ niṣkāsayet‌ tatsamāsataḥ saṃkepato viruddham‌ | śuddhisatraṣṭā | atra viraddhādāre chate vikāre śuddhivemanavirekādirūpā iṣṭā praṣṭhā | kupitadoṣasamūhasya vamanādibhirihairapāntirahīre cāsegyoḥpattiḥ| śamo veti | naṃ kevachaṃ ṭuddhiriṭā śamadhacaṣṭaḥ | kaiḥ || teṣāṃ vairodhikakopitadoṣāṇāṃ saccharatānāṃ vā visphoṭādīnāṃ vikārāṇāṃ virodhibhiḥ pratatipakcamūtairauṣadhaiḥ
tib: gang yang rung ba'i kha zas las byung ba'i nyes pa khrus dang / slon la sogs pas ma sbyangs par de ni mdor na zhes pa/

zas mi 'phrod pa las byung ba'i nyes pa 'dir ni sbyang ba zhes bya ba/ slon dang khrus la sogs pa'i tshul bya ba ni 'dod cing bsngags par bya ba yin no/ / yang na de dang mi mthun pa'i rdzas kyi sman gyis zhi bar bya ba 'dod pa yin te/ mi 'phrod pa'i kha zas de'i gnyen por gyur pa'i sman yon tan go bzlog pa des zhi bar bya ba ni/ yul dang dus la ltos nas bya ba nyid yin no/ / yang na gang phan par 'gyur ba'i sman dang / zas kyi rdzas de nyid kyis dang po kho nar lus mngon par sbyang zhing phan pa'i dpyad du bya ba ste/ mdor na dang po nyid nas zas phan pa nyid bza' bar bya zhing bsten par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de yang drang srong tsa ra kas/

tib: bstan bcos las bkag pa'i dus su bsten pa dang / de bzhin du ha cang thal ches par bsten pa dang / / kun nas kun tu bkag cing ma 'dres pas ni bde ba dang tshe nyams shing 'jig par byed par 'gyur ro/ / de la bde ba ni nad dang bral ba'i mtshan nyid can no/ / tshe ni 'tsho ba dang ldan pa ste/ de gnyis nyams shing 'jig par byed pa'o/ / de ni dper na dus mtshan zhes bya bas 'chi ba'i dus kyi mtshan mo la bab pa ni bde ba dang tshe nyams par byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du 'di ni dus mtshan sngon chad med pa gnyis pa lta bu yin te/ bde ba dang tshe nyams par byed pa 'di gnyis chos mthun pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / mtshan mo gnyid ni ma log rtsub/ / nyin mo gnyid log snum lcir 'gyur/ / tsog phur 'dug ste yur ba dag /

gang mtshan mo gnyid ma log pa de ni rtsub pa yin la/ gang nyin mo gnyid log pa de ni snum zhing lci bar gyur pa yin te/ gnyid kyis ma log pa'i dbang po thams cad ni bya ba la phyogs shing rtsol ba'i mtshan nyid can yin pas/ bya ba ma rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis na bad kan dang / tshil la sogs pa zhi zhing rang bzhin du gnas pa'i ngo bo 'grib pas rtsub pa'i yon tan 'byung bar mi rigs su zin kyang rtsub pa yin par sgro btags nas smras pa yin gyi/ yang dag par rtsub pa ni ma yin no/ / de yang dper na yur ba la sogs pa ni gnyid ma log pa'i sngon du/ bad kan dang tshil la sogs pa rang gi rgyu las byung ba yin du zin kyang / skyes bu gnyid kyis ma log pa la/ de'i bad kan dang tshil la sogs pa zad par snang gi 'phel bar mi 'gyur te/ de bas na gnyid kyis ma log pa la rtsub pa zhes bshad do/ / gnyid log pa la yang dbang po thams cad kyi bya ba 'gags pa ni mtshan nyid can/ bya ba zin pa lta bu 'di la snum pa'i yon tan dang 'brel pa med pa ma yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang snum pa lta bur sgro btags nas bshad pa yin te/ gang gi phyir de'i tshe rang bzhin zhi bar gyur pas/ bad kan dang tshil la sogs pa rang gi rgyu nyid kyis bshang gci la sogs pa mngon par 'phel bar byed de/ dbang po thams cad kyi bya ba las ldog pa yin pa'i phyir gnyid ma log pa ltar zad par byed pa ni ma yin gyi/ gnyid log pa'i sngar ni bad kan dang tshil la sogs pa'i tha mal par zhi bar gnas pa'i ngo bo rang gi lus la gnas par gtogs pa cung zad gnyid kyis log pa lta bur mi snang ste/ de bas na gnyid kyis log pa la snum par bshad pa yin gyi/ yang dag par ni ma yin te/ 'di'i bya ba'i mtshan nyid ni 'di tsam du zad pa'i phyir ro/ / tsog pur 'dug ste gang yur zhing cung zad gnyid log pa de ni rtsub pa dang / bad kan med par 'gyur ba yin te/ / shin tu gnyid med pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ rlung skyed cing 'khrugs pa yang ma yin no/ / bad kan yang skyed pa ma yin no/ / so ga rlung 'phel stobs 'phrog dus/ / rtsub cing mtshan mo thung bas na/ / nyin par gnyid phan/

skt: atha nidrāsuṇaprasaṅgena tasparatipakṣabhūtasya jāgaraṇasyāpi guṇamāha~-apiśabdāvatna sāmathyaṃ chabdhau boddhavyau | tenaṃ rātrāvapi jāgaraṇe rukṣaṃ divā khāpreyamatytha rūkṣaṃ kāṭhenāditabalasnāt‌ | tathā prasvapanaṃ divāpi rnigdhamityavatiṣṭhate | apirabdābhyāmantareṇa tu rātrāveva jāgaraṇaṃ rakṣa, divā tu snigdhamityartho jāyate vyavancheyaphartvādāsyānām‌ | evaṃ divasa eva snigdhaṃ svapanaṃ rātrau rūkṣabhiti | nacaitadyujyate | tato divā jāgaraṇa sad‌ā rūkṣa nābhaviṣyat‌ | tatkathamidasupapatsyate | “bahumedaḥkaphāḥ svapyuḥ snehanityāśca nāhāne | viṣāteṃ kaṇṭharogī ca naiva jātu nidyāsvapi || ?› itiṃ | | eṣāṃ hyapatapeṇameva hita yaccāpatapeṇaṃ tadavaya rūkṣam‌| tasmādapatarpaṇasvabhāvaṃ jāgasaṇameva sevyam‌ | tathā | dhrīṣme vātacayādānaraukyarācyasapabhāvataḥ | divā svapno hito'nyasmin‌ kaphapittakaro hi saḥ||suklvā tu māpyayānādhvamadyaslīmārakamabhiḥ | kaṛodhaśokabhaye; chantāñśadhāsahidhmātisāriṇaḥ | vraddhabāṭabakṣīṇāḥ śṣṛtataṭaśaṣīḍitān‌ | ajīṇyabhihatonmatatām‌ divāsvapnocitānapi || "” tadeteṣāṃ santapeṇatavāt‌ santapaṇameva hitam‌ | yacca santapeṇaṃ tad‌ vadya snigdham‌ | tasmādetaiḥ santapaṇasvabhāvameva sadāṃ prasvapanaṃ sevyam‌ | evaṃ ca pūraimeva vyākhyānaṃ yuktam‌ | prasyaprajāgaraṇakriyayoradranyayorapi rūkṣasnigdhvasupacārādupapannam‌ | yathā-rukṣa dravya gugṇusvādi-kaphamedaḥpramṛtīn‌ saumyān‌ bhāvān‌ kṣapayati tathaiva yadā jāgaraṇamapi tarakṣapayadṛdṛṣṭaṃ tadā trakṣakāakaraṇādarakṣamapi rūkṣamisyupacayete | tathā prasavaprādarvāk‌ kapamedaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ somyānāṃ bhāvānāṃ svahetoraspādastathā nopaṭamabhyate|yathā prakhaprādanantaram‌ tasmā" sasvapanamasnigdhamisyupacyaite | pracara ivācaratīti kayachantānaniṣṭhā | āsīnasyopaviṣṭasakha pracaṅāyitamāsīnapracalāyite, natu prasvapane svaisdhikayā | yena sadena hetu; syāt‌ | rukṣakāryākaraṇādarūkṣam‌ | anabhiṣyandi tu viśeṣeṇa | āsīnebhracahāyitaṃ puna sadgarūpamityathai;
tib: so ga'i dus su nyin par gnyid log pa phan no zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ / ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyu gsum smras pa yin te/ rlung 'phel ba'i dus yin te/ so ga bsags ba'i rlung dbyar gyi dus na ldang bar 'dod pa'i phyir dang / stobs 'phrog pa'i dus byung ba'i rtsub pa yin pas so ga rtsub pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin du de'i tshe mtshan mo thung bar gyur bas na/ nyin par gnyid log pa phan pa yin no/ / gzhan dag tu/ de ni bad kan mkhris pa skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ so ga las gzhan par dbyar la sogs pa'i dus su ni nyin mo'i gnyid de ni bad kan dang mkhris pa gnyis skyed pa yin no/ /

smra mang nas 'jigs pa'i bar du dub ba'i sgra so sor zhing sbyar bar bya ste/ de dag gis dub pa dang skyigs bu la sogs pas dub par sbyar ro/ / de la smra ba mang ba ni klog pa la sogs pa'o/ / bzhon pa ni rta la sogs pas bskyod pa'o/ / lam gyis dub pa ni lam du zhugs pa'o/ / ra ro ba ni ra ro bas nyen pas dub pa'o/ / bud med kyis dub pa ni 'khrig pas dub pa'o/ / khur gyis dub pa ni khur bas lus nyon mongs pas dub pa'o/ / las ni lus dub par byed pa'i rtsol ba rnams so/ / de ltar na smra ba mang ba la sogs pas dub pa dang / gzhan yang skyigs bu la sogs pas btab pa ma gtogs par gzhan dag nyin par gnyid log pa ni/ bad kan dang mkhris pa skyed par byed pa yin la/ tshul 'di dag dang ldan pa dag gis ni/ dus thams cad du nyin par gnyid log par mi bya'o/ / zas ma zhu ba ni rnam pa lnga ste/ ring du thogs pa dang / khong tsha ba dang / bshang ba 'gags pa dang / shin tu thogs pa dang / bcud kyi lhag ma lus pa'o/ / bcom pa ni ral gril sogs pa'i mtshon gyis lus bcom zhing btags pa'o/ / smyo ba ni gdon dang brjed byed la sogs pas khams mi mnyam par byas nas dran pa med pa'o/ / nyin par gnyid log par rigs pa ni/ sngar goms shing 'obs pa'i rang bzhin yod pa ste/ de dag thams cad ma gtogs par gzhan gyis dus thams

smra ba mang ba la sogs pas dub pa de dag gis sngar bshad pa'i tshul de bzhin du bsten par gyur na/ de lus zungs zhes bya ba dngas ma la sogs pa dang / bad kan la sogs pa lus 'dzin par byed pa snyoms pa ste/ lhag pa dang 'bri ba med par cha snyoms par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du bad kan dang / lag ngar dang / brla la sogs pa'i lus kyi yan lag rnams skyes shing brtas par 'gyur ba'o/ / tshil che bad kan mang dang snum/ / rtag za nyin par gnyid ma log / ces bya ba la/ mi gang tshil che zhing bad kan mang ba dang / de bzhin du snum bag rtag tu za ba dag ni/ nyin par gnyid ma log ces bya ba ste/ dus thams cad du yang nyin par gnyid log par mi bya'o/ / dug gis phog dang lkog nad can/ / mtshan mo nam yang gnyid ma log / ces bya ba la/ dug gis phog cing nyen pa'i nad pa dang / lkog ma'i nad yod pa'i lkog nad can de gnyi gas kyang mtshan mo'i dus su nam yang gnyid log par mi bya'o/ /

skt: yadi sigdhasvādabhiṣyandī divāsvapraḥ tatki kadācidapi na kārya ityāh-bharīṣmakāre divāsvapno hitaḥ | yatastākṣim‌ kāḍe pavanasya cayo bhavati | ādānasthaiva paripuṣṭavvādatiraukaṣaya bhavati! yatrayaśca nidrāsmāpsyayogyāḥ-asarapa bhavanti | divāsvapna saṃtapakaḥ | bhīṣmādaparasmina kāle kṛphāpittakaraḥ | so'cinsyatvādratuprabhāvasya bhāyādihaṭhāntādīn‌ suksavā vajayikhā | tenaitadu t‌ bhavati| mrīṣmāduparasminnapi kacha svapara eṣāṃ hita eva yānamaścādi)ṣataḥ khadgādibhiṣachinnaḥ) abhihato khśu ḍādinā|sakhaprocitāḥ sīritadivāsvaprāḥtatra bhāṣyā dikāntānāṃ pavanakopāt‌ khaparo'lajñātaḥ|śrāsadiṣmā dīnāṃ vegavismaraṇārtham‌ | vṛddhādīnāṃ yathāyathaṃ santa paṇā vegavismaraṇāthai ca | ajīṇināṃ divāsvapno citānāṃ ca dhātuvaiṣamyaparidārātha̱ṃdivāsvaparo'uma tastantrakrutā | tathācoktap‌-“8icito hi divāspara yeṣāṃ navyaṃ śarīriṇām‌|vātādayaḥ prakupyanti tepām‌ svapatāṃ divā?iti||nanvajīṇināṃ divāsvapno na yuktaṃ divā svaprasya kaphavṛddhikaratavāt‌| kaphavṛddhadhā cābhnimā nyam‌ | abhrimānyādajīṇānnasyāpākaḥ | ityayuttaḥ steṣāṃ divākhapraḥ | atrocyate | di vāsveranājīrṇi nāṃ dhātusāmyaṃ bhavatiaughātusāmye ca sthite svasthāna śyāmam‌ | dhatededhirsupahato vahiḥ pacanakṣamo bhavati | paphastu braddho'pi naiteṣāmabhanimānyaṃ vidhatte apitvanāṃ puṣṭimādadhāti | atapvānantarameṣovāca sakāraḥ “dhātusāmya tathceṣāṃ śaṣmā 1 ṅgāni puṣyati? iti
tib: dus ma yin par gnyid kyis log pa ni sngar bkag pa'i dus smos pa dag tu nyin mo gnyid log pa las ni rmongs bag la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de la rmongs bag ni gang byas pa rnams mi dran pa'o/ / rmugs pa ni sems mi gsal ba'o/ / sgyid skyur ba ni mer mer por byed pa'o/ / rtsa'i rgyun 'gags pa ni rtsa sbubs 'gags shing legs par mi rgyu ba'o/ /
dus ma yin par gnyid log pa nas byung ba'i rmongs bag la sogs pa la smyung ba nas sman sna nas gtong zhing sbyin par bya'o/ /

shin tu gnyid ches pa las gyur pa'i nad la skyug sman rnon po btang ba la sogs pa nas khros pa'i bar sbyar bar bya'o/ / de la skyug sman ni slon sman gtang ba'o/ / de yang sman rnon po sbyar te bya ba yin pas rnon po zhes bya'o/ / de bzhin du mig sman yang ro tsha ba dang / lan tshwa dang / skyur ba'i sman las sbyar ba'i rno ba nyid do/ / sna nas gtang ba'i sman ni sna sman no/ / smyung ba ni zas bcad pa'o/ / sems las ni dngos po rnams yid la dran pa'o/ / bud med bsten pa ni 'khrig pa'o/ / mya ngan ni sdug bsngal bar gnas pa'o/ / 'jigs pa ni skrag pa'o/ / khros pa ni 'khrugs pa'o/ / 'di dag nyid kyis gnyid drags pa/ / 'jig cing bad kan rab zad byed/ / ces bya ba la/ 'di dag nyid kyis zhes bya ba/ bshad ma thag pa'i skyug sman rnon po btang ba la sogs pas gnyid kyis drags pa yang zhing 'jig la/ de bzhin du bad kan rab tu zad par byed pas kyang gnyid med par 'gyur ro/ / gnyid yar ba yis yan lag snyom/ / lci zhing glal 'ong la/ / mi gsal na zhing mgo 'khor la/ / zas mi 'ju rmya rlung skyes nad/ / ces bya ba la/ gnyid yar ba zhes bya ba gnyid med par gyur pa las/ yan lag snyom pa la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de la yan lag snyom pa ni yan lag brdungs pa snyam sems pa'o/ / lci ba ni mgo lci ba'o/ / rlung skyes nad ni 'di dag dang / rjes su mthun pa'i nad mang po 'byung ba'o/ /

skt: akale śāyanaṃ svapra: akāraśāyanam‌| tasmādekāraśayanānmohādayaḥ syuḥ | samitya gatrāṇāṃ nirutsāhatvam‌
