yataśca samyaksevitāyā nidrāyā , asamya+ ato'smāddhetoḥ kālānatikrameṇa. sāsmyato _ yāmayaṃ traya vā niści nidrāṃ majeghr‌ | akṣāsyājāgasādarbhena svapna iṣyate | kiṃtā yo yāvantaṃ kāṅasūcitaṃ svapiti tasmāt‌ kāṭhādurathena prātaḥ svapyāt‌ | abha̱ktavān‌ asa̱kte sati | asāramyagrahaṇenatad‌ dyotayati | na svasya rātrāvaghuparasya jāgaraṇakāchādadhana , divāspapna iṣyate | kiṃ tarhiṃ yo yāvantaṃ kāramucite svapiti tasmāt‌ kālādyābantaṃ kā jāgayāttāvato'rthanāsau śpyāt‌ | keciddhi svaspa- . nidraḥ svabhāvato bhavanti|[ 49|| ` hai 0~asamyagyogaṃ niṣidhya -samyagyogaṃ vidhatte-nidra rāra seveta na divā | rātrāvapi yathākāṭe . pvṛttikālān‌~ tikrameṇa yasya̱ yadiman‌ rātrivibhāgeḥ nidrā pravartate sa tminnaiva seveta ityathaiḥ | sālyataḥ .yāmadrayayāmacayādi~ salmyānurodhena | rāāvaniddhitasya divā -svabhraṃ vidhatte prātaḥ pūrvā svapyāt‌ | ayuktavānakṛtabhojanaḥ, asāsyā+ drātrijāgaraṇakādādaddha̭kāṭhaṃ sātyaścadrānijāgarastadā prāta nava. svapyāt‌ | addhamilayayasātamyajāgarajanitadoṣanivataṃkadrāparyāttakāṇopalakṣaṇam‌ | atra evāha khāraṇādiḥ-“5asuptānāṃ tathā rāyau tanmātrasvapanaṃ divā | ?° dati | . bheḍā'pi--“ rācrau svapyānna yāmāṃsarīsatānsvapyāṣi* divā naraḥ} -etadapyāhurārogyaṃ nāca doṣo'sti.kaścan‌|| dati
tib: rgyu de bas na mtshan mo'i dus su dus bzhin du zhes bya'o/ / gnyid log pa'i dus ci tsam yin pa de tsam du ci bder zhes bya ba/ bde bar gyur pa nyid du gnyid log par bya zhing goms pas bsten par bya'o/ / ma goms gnyid kyis ma log na/ / nang par ma zos phyed gnyid log / ces bya ba la/ / ma goms shing gnyid kyis ma log par 'os pa ma yin pa dag gnyid ma log na/ nang par nyin mo'i dus su zan ma zos bar de'i phyed gnyid kyis log par bya'o/ / des ni 'di skad ston pa yin te/ ci srid gnyid log par rigs pa'i dus de srid du gnyid ma log na/ mtshan mo ci tsam gnyid ma log pa de tsam gnyid log pa ni ma yin mod kyi/ de'i phyed tsam gnyid log par bya ste/ gang mtshan mo thun gnyis gnyid ma log na/ de nyin mo nang par gyi dus su thun gcig gnyid log par bya'o/ /

skt: yo manadanidaraḥ sa kṣīrāvīn‌ śīkhyet‌ 1 | sānama pi ra -kāntāvāhukatāśreṣādayo nidrāsukhadetavaḥ | kāntā- | sevetadayathaḥ 1 tathā'nagam‌ ja janatana nanana bāhtaśeṣagrahaṇaṃ śeṣamātrameva sukhataḥ, na tu | sadāṃ jaghanakāthanivatanayosa-mṛvāikamuccata| dā prāmyadharmaseveti dīnām‌ | ata evānantaramād‌- | ṇāvyā hi suna kurvati tantya | divana ca “śdyacayeratenidrā svaṃ kāṃ nātivatete | ›? iti | | jat‌ | dine sate na vavatiḥ | mathī brahmacayairatasyānugato bhethunābhikhāpo nidrāṃ nāścaye- | dhyanait‌ | alvādinādḥ suṇna sayajanuḥ | anyā dityāha-prāmyaghukhe niḥpaha̭ṃcetau yasya sa tasya 8 \ avimanāḥ | andametānaḥ purītathā santoṣanaptasya 1 50 || | 04 ta | ghādivamāturaḥ | nanu śranā, bhaṇi 4 |
tib: gnyid yar ba'am/ shin tu sra bar gyur na/ 'o ma btung ba la sogs pa nas/ rna ba dang mig dag pa'i bar du ci rigs par bya'o/ / mgo bsku ba dang / rna ba dang / mig dag pa ni snum gyis bya'o/ / na chung lag dar gyis 'khyud dang / / sems bde bya ba zin pa dang / / yid dang rjes mthun yul ldan pa/ / ji 'dod gnyid 'ong bde bar skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ bud med na chung gzhon nus 'khyud pa la sogs pa dang / de bzhin du sems bde ba ste/ yid dga' ba dang ldan pa dang / bya ba zin te/ gang bya ba'i dngos po de byas zin par gyur ba dang / de bzhin du gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya yid dang rjes su mthun zhing yid du 'ong ba dang ldan par gyur pa ste/ / 'di dag gis ni ji ltar dga' ba bzhin du gnyid 'ong zhing des bde ba rab tu skyed par 'gyur ro/ / nyal po'i bde la sems ma chags/ / tshangs par spyod pa la dga' ba/ / chog shes pa yis mgu ba'i gnyid/ / rang gi dus las 'da' mi byed/ / ces bya ba la/ skyes bu gang grong yul gyi bde ba 'khrig pa la sogs pa la ma chags pa/ tshangs par spyod pa la dga' ba/ chog shes pas mgu bar gyur ba'i gnyid ni rang gi dus las ldog cing 'da' bar mi byed kyi/ rang gi dus nyid du 'ong ngo zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de la grong gi bde ba ni bud med la chags pa dang / zas skom zhim po la zhen pa ste/ de rnams la gang sems zhen par ma gyur pa'o/ / tshangs par spyod pa ni bud med dang 'dus pa med pa ste/ de la dga' ba dang / chog shes pa ni/ bya ba thams cad la re ba dang bcas pa med pa ste/ yon tan des mgu zhing tshim par gyur pa nyid ni rang gi dus mtshan mo ji tsam log par bya ba de las 'da' bar mi byed do/ / nyal po'i chos ni spang bya ba/ / bkan min zla mtshan ldan pa dang / / yid du mi 'ong mi sdug spyod/ / mngal ni skyon gyis khyab pa dang / / rab sbom skem dang bcas pa dang / / sbrum ma gzhan gyi bud med dang / / rigs gzhan skye gnas mi mthun dang / / bla ma lha dang rgyal po'i gnas/ / mchod rten dur khrod gsod gnas dang / / bsti sa lam gyi bzhi mdo chu/ / dus tshigs nyin mo yan lag min/ / snying ga mgo bor brdeg spang bya/ / zhes bya ba la/ / grong gi chos ni 'khrig pa'i chos te/ ming gi rnam grangs gzhan yang skyes pa dang / bud med kyi kun tu sbyor ba zhes bya ba yin no/ / de dag las spang bar bya ba 'di dag yod de/ bkan min zhes bya ba ni/ bkan pa ma yin pa spang ba ste/ don gyis na bkan te bsten par ston pa yin no/ / zla mtshan ldan pa zhes bya ba ni zla mtshan rgyu nas dang po'i zhag gsum spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du yid du mi 'ong ba ste/ snying du mi sdug pa yang spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du mi sdug spyod pa ste/ ngang tshul ngan cing mi rigs pa dang ldan pa spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du gang gi mngal skyon gyis khyab cing gnod pa de spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du rab tu sbom zhing sha che ba yang spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du shin tu skem zhing / sha dang tshil dang / khrag zad pa yang spang bar bya'o/ / btsas pa dang zhes btsas ma thag pa dang / bud med sbrum ma yang spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du gzhan gyis bdag gir bzung ba'i bud med kyang spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du rigs gzhan te/ rab tu byung ba'am/ rigs shin tu mtho ba dag kyang spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du skye gnas mi mthun pa ste/ rta la sogs pa skye gnas tha dad pa la spyad pa yang spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du grong gi chos la 'jug pa na/ bla ma dang / lha dang / rgyal po'i gnas spang bar bya ste/ gnas de dag tu 'khrig pa mi bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de bzhin du mchod rten la sogs pa'i gnas dag tu yang 'khrig pa'i bya ba spang bar bya ba ste/ de la mchod rten ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten no/ / 'jig rten pa dag ni grong gi phyi rol na yod pa'i shing chen po lha la sogs pas gnas bcas pa la bya bar 'dod do/ / dur khrod ni shi ba'i ro bsregs ba'i gnas so/ / gsod gnas ni rgyal po'i chad pas gcod cing gsod pa'i gnas so/ / bsti sa ni grong khyer gyi pha rol gyis phyogs kyi khyad par ro/ / bzhi mdo ni lam gyi bzhi mdo'o/ / chu ni chu'i nang ste/ de dag tu 'khrig pa spyad par mi bya'o/ / dus tshigs ni tshes bzhi dang / tshes drug dang / tshes brgyad dang / nya dang / dgu stong la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i chos lugs las bkag ba'i nyin zhag rnams te/

'khrig pa spyad pa'i yan lag dang / 'tsham pa ni mngal gyi sgo yin pa las/ de ma yin pa yan lag gi gnas su mi rung ba/ kha dang bshang ba'i lam la sogs par yang spyad par mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du snying ga dang / mgo bor brdeg par byas nas 'khrig pa bya ba yang spang bar bya'o/ /

'grangs ches shing gsud par zos pa dang ltogs shing bkres pas nyen pa dang / brtan zhing yid rton pa dang bral ba dang / yan lag mi bde bar gnas shing lus nyam nga bar gnas pa dang / skom pas nyen pa dang / byis pa ste lo bcu drug pa man chad dang / rgan po bdun cu yan chad lon pa dang / shugs gzhan gyis nyen pa ste/ bshang ba dang gci ba la sogs pa'i shugs kyis nyen cing gzir ba dang / nad pa ste rims la sogs pa'i nad kyis gtses pa ste/ de dag thams cad kyis kyang 'khrig pa spyad pa spang bar bya'o/ / de yang bsdus pa las/

skt: samparati ṛtuviśeveṣu nidhuvanaṃ nithamyatetapno-vājīkaraṇaiḥ sātasantapaṇaḥ san‌ kāmaḥ yathecchayā hime hemanta, diśaṣire ca kāmaṃ yathe seveta | vājīdkatāmitti ` sampadādisvāt‌ kip‌ tapra iti--“ ko'dhikaraṇe ca dhrauvya--”? davya dinā'dhikaraṇe ktaḥ | ^® adhikaraṇavācinaśca iti ṣaṣṭhī | vasante, śaradi ca bhyahat‌ ayaharmāḥ kramya ̱saithunam‌ | baghaubhrīṣmayoḥ pakṣāt‌ kā bhajet‌
tib: dgun dus zhes bya ba ni grang ba'i dus te/ dgun stod dang dgun smad do/ / de'i tshe skyes bu ro tsa ba'i cho ga byas shing drags pa bdo bar gyur pa'i tshe/ 'dod pas zhes pa ci dga' bar 'dod pa bsten par bya'o/ / de la ro tsa bar bya ba'i sbyor ba ni khu ba 'phel bar bya ste/ 'o ma dang / mar dang / sha khu la sogs pa 'og nas bshad pa bzhin du byas shing ngoms par gyur pa'o/ / de bzhin du dpyid dang son ni zhag gnyis gnyis nas ro tsa bar byas pas ngoms pa dang / 'dod pa bsten par bya'o/ / so ga dang dbyar gyi tshe ni/ ro tsa ba byas nas zla ba phyed cing 'dod pa bsten par bya'o/ /

gzhan du zhes bya ba ji skad du bshad pa las go bzlog pas bud med la zhugs shing 'dod pa spyod pa'i skyes bu de ni mgo 'khor ba la sogs pa'i nad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de la mgo 'khor ba ni mi bde bar gnas shing 'khor ba'o/ / ngal ba ni dub pa'o/ / bla'i mthu nyams ba ni mal du 'jug cing 'gro mi nus ba'am/ sha dang khrag zad pa'o/ / de bzhin du stobs nyams pa dang / lus zungs nyams pa dang / dbang po nyams par 'gyur ba dang / dus min 'chi bar byed pa ni shin tu bud med la bsten pas dus ma yin par 'chi bar yang 'gyur ba yin no/ /

bud med dag bsten pa legs par bsdams shing bsrung ba'i skyes bu ni/ dran pa la sogs pa 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / de la dran pa ni 'das pa'i don ma brjed pa'o/ / yid gzhungs pa ni rnam par dpyod nus pa'i shes rab bo/ / nad med pa ni bde bar gnas pa'o/ / tshe ni srog go/ / dbang po ni mig la sogs pa'o/ / brtas pa ni lus rgyas ba'o/ / grags pa ni snyan pa'o/ / stobs ni lus kyi nus pa ste/ de dag lhag par 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur pa dang / de bzhin du rgas sra bar 'gyur ba ste/

skt: anyathoktavidheranyena prakāreṇa ri gacchato śramādayaḥ syu; | aparvaṇyakali mara sthānam‌ | hai 0--uktavidhyatikrame dopasāha--ūṣdaurabalyaṃ-sakitha- | dīdhelyaṃ, bakhādīnāṃ kṣayaḥ, aparvamaraṇamakāsamarayuḥ, anyathā śiyaṃ gacchataḥ-uktamrakārādanyena prakariṇa semomaṃ majataḥ, rasāyurvede-“variparītarataprātthā dige dāhaḥ prajāyate | keṣyi ca savagātraśru tadpatīkāra ucyate || praghyaṇvasitiṃ nivadhyeva higanṣaraṇamāvadet‌ | kṣe tasya saṃjāte khapayecchītalunā || koranirthāsamādāya pāyayettaṃ sadarkaram‌| dāramakhīdūbayeomūlarasaṃ pāyasamāśayet‌ ? dāte
tib: sngar bstan pa'i bud med bsten pa'i rjes la chags pa dang bral ba'i skyes bus khrus la sogs pa bsten par bya'o/ / de la byug pa ni tsan+dan la sogs pa rdzas dri bzang pos lus byugs shing kha dog bsgyur ba'o/ / rlung bsil ba ni rlung grang mo'o/ / kha ra la sogs pa ni bza' ba'i khyad par te/ de dag bza' ba'o/ / chu bsil ba ni chu grang mo'o/ / sran tshod ni 'bru las byas pa'o/ / chang dngas ma ni chang gi snying po'o/ / de dag thams cad ni 'dod pa spyod pa'i dga' ba byas nas/ 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur pa'i rjes te/ 'og tu bsten cing longs spyad par bya'o/ / de ltar byas par gyur pas skyes bu de'i lus kyi mdangs dang stobs slar skye bar 'gyur ro/ / de yang bud med dang 'phrad pas 'phral du lus kyi stobs 'bri bar gyur kyang / 'di ltar brta zhing tshim par byas pas de'i khu ba dang stobs 'phel ba nyid du 'gyur ba'i don to/ / sman pa thos spyod phun tshogs ldan zhing las mkhas snying rje can/ / gags dang gnod med lus srung byed pa nye bar gzhag byas nas/ / rgyal po rang gi dge ba'i 'bras bu'i longs spyod ba der spyod cing / / nad med mthu dang gzi brjid grags pa yun ring 'phel bar 'gyur/ /

sman pa zhes bya ba ni sman dpyad kyi yan lag la mkhas pa ste/ de yang thos pa dang spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa ste/ rtog pa dang tshul phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ / las la mkhas ba ni gso ba la mkhas shing byang ba'o/ / snying rje can ni rjes su brtse ba dang ldan pa'o/ / gags dang gnod pa med pa ni mi mthun pa med cing bar chad kyis gnod par byed pa med pa'o/ / lus srung byed ba ni rgyal po'i sku 'tsho bar byed pa ste/ de lta bu nye bar gzhag cing / lus bsrung du bcug na/ rgyal po ste sa bdag grags pa 'phel ba'i bar du 'gyur ro/ / de yang rang gi dge ba'i bsod nams su bya ba'i las te/ de'i 'bras bu ni longs spyod chen po la sogs pa dang ldan pas bde bar nye bar longs spyod pa yin la/ de gang zhig spyod par byed pa de ni/ de skad bya ste/ de la yun ring du spyod par 'gyur ba dang / nad med cing lus bde bar gnas pa dang / mthu ste longs spyod kyi 'byor pa rnams dang / gzi brjid ces pa lus kyi gzi mdangs dang grags pa ste/ snyan pas khyab pa yun ring du rgya cher 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/

skt: ratasya suratakravāyā virata avasāne pamāna lānāādaka savata | anudṭapanamanurāgaśvandanādibhiḥ ya̱gandhadravyaḥ | hināniṭaḥ datavātaḥ | khaṇḍakhādayāḥ-bhakṣavidoṣāḥ | sītābhyu-rīvaṭaṃ seyama | raso māstarasaḥ | brā-vānyaḥ danaḥ | pasaknā--sarāpaṇa etatsavamanu pancān‌ savata } nadhāmarāyar‌ satata [narya | pusaḥ evaṃ krataṃ sati vapuṣaḥ dārorrāma dāda vahyaṃ | āganchāte | "śrosesagāchachi cadaya syān‌ vatā | vāchanāmapi | paṃ nvāpyāyatana satre tavāṃ yuka | dhāma ca: dṛti |“
tib: de nas zhes bya ba ni 'das ma thag pa ste/ sngar brtsams pa'i kha zas bsrungs pa'i rjes thogs la/ kha zas kyi tshod ran par bza' bar brtsams pa yin te/ gang gi phyir yon tan dang ldan pa'i zas kyang yin la/ dug la sogs pa dang 'dres par ma gyur du zin kyang tshad las lhag pa'o/ / tshad las shin tu chung bar zos na srog nye bar 'joms par 'gyur la/ de nyid ran par zos pa ni srog chags rnams kyi srog nyid yin no/ / kha zas ni bza' bar bya ba rnams so/ / tshod ran pa ni tshad dang ldan pa'o/ / tshod ran par bza' ba ni tshad dang ldan par bza' zhing spyad pa'o/ / de la phan zhing dgos pa byed pa'i gzhung la ni le'u zhes bya ste/

skyes bu nad med pa'am/ nad dang ldan pa yang rung ste/ des dus kun tu zhes pa dus thams cad du zas tshod zin cing / tshad dang ldan pa bza' bar bya'o/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang tshad dang ldan par za ba la 'jug pa de ni me'i drod skyed pa yin te/ rang gi bya ba smin pa'i las byed par nus pa yin no/ / de ni tshod ran par bza' zhing tshod zin par za ba dang / tshod zin par btung ba dang / tshod zin par bldag par bya'o/ / zhes blta bar bya'o/ / tshod ran pa'i mtshan nyid ni slob dpon gyis 'di ltar bshad de/ tshad kyang me'i drod kyi stobs dang / zas kyi dngos po la ltos par bya dgos te/ zas kyis lto bar gnod pa mi skyed pa dang / snying gar thogs par mi byed pa dang / rtsib logs gnyis su zug cing gnod par mi byed pa dang / pho ba shin tu mi lci ba dang / dbang po tshim zhing brtas par byed pa dang / bkres pa dang / skom pa dang bral ba dang / gnas dang / stan dang / mal dang / 'gro ba dang / dbugs 'byin pa dang / dbugs rngub pa dang / gtam zer ba na bde bar gnas pa dang / dgongs ka dang / nang par bde bar yongs su zhu ba dang / stobs dang kha dog nye bar 'phel bar byed pa ste/ 'di dag ni tshad dang ldan pa'i mtshan nyid yin no/ / 'di dag gis kyang tshad dang ldan zhing tshod zin pa gtso bo yin te/ se 'bru dang / / skyur po la sogs pa'i rdzas me'i drod skyed par byed pa'i rang bzhin can de tshad dang ldan par zos na me'i drod skyed par 'gyur gyi/ tshad dang mi ldan pas ni ma yin no/ / lci zhing rang bzhin g.yung ba'i rdzas 'o ma dang bu ram shing la sogs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de bas na/

rdzas lci ba ni bu ram shing dang / 'o ma dang / 'bru dang / mon sran gre'u dang / rlan can gyi sha rnams so/ / yang ba ni char gyi chu dang / rak+ta sha li zhes bya ba la 'bras rtsa snar dang / drug cu pa dang / mon sran sde'u dang / bya la wa'i sha rnams te/ de gnyi ga la yang tshad la ltos par bya ba yin te/ de rnams ni de la rag lus par gyur pa yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ / rdzas lci ba'am/ yang ba de dag za zhing spyad pa na/ zas kyi tshul la goms par bya ba cha 'dra bar rtag tu bza' bar bya ba'am/ yang na lci ba ni tshad las gzhan du bya la/ yang ba la ni tshad gzhan las zhes som nyir gyur pa de'i phyir smras pa ni/

skt: mātrārī primidārī naraḥ savakā kha. stho'pyāturo vā syāt‌ | yasmānmātrā copayuktā'naḥ gravarvikā svavyāpāre pacanakriyāyām‌ | tena mātrārī mānrākhādī, mātrāpāyī, mātrāṭihati draṣṭavyam‌| mātrāyā chakṣaṇamācyaṇoktaseva | mātrā punarnivakhāhāradranyādravyapekṣiṇī kukṣiratipīḍanamādāreṇa | hṛdayasyāsaṃsodhaḥ | pārśvayorapi pāṭavam‌ | anatigauravañudarasya | prīṇanamindiyāṇām‌ | ścutipāsoparatiḥ) sthānāśanarāyanagamamocchūvāsamraścāsakri yāsu dhukhena pravṛttiḥ | sukhena pariṇam‌ balava ṇapapacayaśceti mātrālakṣaṇamar‌ | itaśca mātrāyāḥ grāghānyam‌ | yānyapi raghūni dravyāṇi athavā gi-kṣareumīhimāpānūpāmiṣādīni | laghūni-dinyodakasartasādahiṣaṣṭikamaraṇalāvā dīni tānyubhayarūpāṇyāpi mācrāpramāṇamapekṣante| tadadhīlāni tāni bhavantīsythaḥ
tib: kha zas lci zhing 'ju dka' ba las ni phyed 'grangs tsam du bza' ba dang kha zas yang ba char chu dang / sA lu rtsa snar la sogs pa las ni/ rab tu 'grangs bar mi bza'i/ gzhan du na ran cing bde bar gnas pa tsam gyis 'grangs par bya dgos te/ gang gi phyir me dang rlung dag gis yon tan mang po yang ba la ni/ / cha mnyam par gnas pas me'i drod skyed par byed pa yin la/ tshod ma zin par nyes par zos su zin kyang nyes pa cung zad skyed pa yin no/ / rdzas lci ba la ni sla ba dang chu'i yon tan mang du gnas pas me'i mi mthun par gyur cing / thun mong gi yon tan gzhan yod pas me'i drod 'bri bar byed pa yin no/ /
tshad yongs su chad pa ste/ tshad ji tsam zas zos na bde blag tu gcod pa med par zhu zhing dengs par 'gyur ba de tsam gyi tshod la ni tshod zin pa yin no zhes bshad

skt: mojanamaśanaṃ hīnamātre svaspamramāṇa muktana baṅāya, nopcayāya nāpyojasa mavati } yathā savaṣā (222) ghātasegāṇāṃ māhatānāsāmayānā nakhamadādayayānāmachītevītarogāṇāṃ hetutāṃ kāraṇatāṃ prātatipadyata gaccha tātyaśraḥ
atimācraṃ prabhūtaṃ yuktamaśanaṃ sarvān‌ trīna. doṣān‌ , āḍu śīghraṃ prakopayet‌
tib: kha zas kyi tshod ma zin cing / tshad las chung zhing dman par gyur pa zos na stobs su yang mi 'gyur/ gzi mdangs su yang mi 'gyur/ lus 'phel zhing rgyas par mi 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du rlung las gyur pa'i nad ma lus pa thams cad kyi rgyu nyid de/ bskyed pa'i rgyur 'gyur zhing 'byin par byed do zhes bya ba'i don to/ / tshad las shin tu ches pa yang / / nyes pa thams cad myur du skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ tshad las shin tu ches pa ni zas lhag par mang po zos pa ste/ des ni nyes pa gsum po thams cad myur zhing rings par skyed par byed cing rab tu g.yo bar byed do/ / ma zhu'i zas ni mi bzad pa/ / de yis rlung sogs gzir gyur pas/ / cig car rnam par 'khrug 'gyur zhing / / de nyid du ni zhugs gyur nas/ / rtsa sgo 'gags shing be'u snabs skyed/ / steng dang 'og gi lam dag tu/ / bskyod pas gsud cing zug byed pa/ / brkam chags can la 'phral skyed byed/ / ces bya ba la/ zas ma zhu zhing lhag par zos pa mi bzad cing gnod par gyur pas des rlung sogs zhes pa/ rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan 'khrug cing g.yo bar gyur pas cig car de rnams dus gcig tu 'khrug cing ldang bar byed pas na/ rtsa sgo 'gags shing zhes pa/ rtsa sbubs 'gags par byas pas/ be'u snabs zhu ba zhes bya ba'i nad skyed par 'gyur ro/ / ci zhig byas nas de skyed ce na/ / de nyid du ni zhugs gyur nas/ / zhes pa ste/ zas ma zhu ba de nyid kyis nang du rlung la sogs pa zhugs shing de dang gcig tu gyur cing 'dres par gyur nas be'u snabs kyi nad skyed par byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du zas ma zhu zhing 'dug pa de nyid du zhugs nas/ steng dang 'og gi lam dag tu bskyod cing / bla 'og tu dri ma dang / zas la sogs pa phyi rol du 'dren cing 'pho bar byed pas na/ de nyid kyi rgyus gsud pa'i zug gzer drag po skyed par byed pa yin no/ / su zhig la zhe na/ brkam chags can la zhes bya ba ste/ bza' btung la chags shing lto 'dun can te/ sems ma bsdams pa dag la gnod pa 'di lta bu 'phral du skyed cing 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de yang /

skt: tenāmenānanenātibhuktena duṣṭena satā, vātādyā vātapintakaphāsakhcayaḥ prīḍayamānāḥ kopitā rkhamāgītvādyugapadekakāṃ te kupitā viṣṭambhayantaḥ viṣṭammaṃ kurvantaḥ, sarotāṃe randhānā arusakamasakhsākhyaṃ vyādhi kuvate | kiṃ karatvā, ` aṣṭāṅhadayaṃ | . śūbhramānādakampastambhādayo'nikhāt‌ 1 pintā'jaḥ tathā'dhasettaramāgīmyāṃ ` sahaṃsaivājucite dere tadevāmamannamāvisayāśya tena saha sambhūya ta̱thā sadeva duṣaṭamananamāḥ | cha vidya cyāvayantaḥ, uvamadhaśca niṣkaraṣayantaḥ aḥ settaramāgapabhyāṃ pracyāvayantaḥ annamalādikaṃ bahi prarayanto visūvacikāṃ kuvate | tasyājitāsanaḥ aranaṭupnasya chodupasyāsaṃyatacetasa iti yāvat‌yāḥ ṭacanaṃ cānna-prāyaḥ prajñāparādhena rogamrāmaśca jāyate nṛṇāmadānachdhānāṃ videṣeṇa visūcikāḥ ||| ^ rātisāsāntadīhatuṭprakhyādayaḥ| "ānāhaṃ udapūra kampo vepathu; | stambho'ṅgasya stabdhatā | ste barṣyamāṇaḥ | atisāre viṭūpravarattiḥ amlo'mḍodrāraḥ | dāho'bhidagdhavat‌ taṭ‌ pipāsā pānādiṣvamikhāpaṣaḥ | prakhyo modahaśanaḥ praveśaḥ ! charadirvamanam‌ ! aṅgagurutā śarīragauravam‌ cācaḥ saṅgo vākaṣūsaddho vāco'paravṛttiḥ | ṭhā> śepmanirasanam‌ | arusakasya visūcikāyāścā tharūpataya kṣaṇasuktaṃ samrahe || £ ||
tib: de la ma zhu ba la rlung la sogs pa'i nad gzhi zhes bya ba las nad 'di dag 'gyur te/ de las kyang rlung las gyur pa'i ma zhu ba'i khong pa gzer ba dang / mgo 'khor zhing lci ba dang / khong sbos pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ / mkhris pa dang 'dres pa'i ma zhu ba las ni 'khru ba la sogs pa'i nad skye bar 'gyur ro/ / bad kan gyi shas che ba las ni slon zhing sgyugs pa dang / yan lag lci ba dang / tshig thogs pa dang / tshig 'byin mi nus pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ / ma zhu ba be'u snabs can dang gsud cing gzer zug can gyi mtshan nyid bsdus ba las/ ming don dang ldan pa bshad pa ni/ zas ni 'ju bar ma gyur la/ / steng dang 'og tu mi 'gro bar/ / ma zhu'i gnas su be'u snabs 'gyur/ / des ni be'u snabs can zhes bshad/ / rlung la sogs pa rab 'khrugs pas/ / gzer zug sna tshogs kyis zug cing / / khab kyis lus ni 'bigs pa ltar/ / rno bar zug pas gsud gzer yin/ / zhes pa'o/ / khyad par du ni nyam chung zhing / / me drod zhan dang shugs bkag pa'i/ / zas ni rlung gis bkag pa dang / / bad kan gyis ni bar bkag pa'i/ / nyes pa be snabs dkrugs pas na/ / zug rngu zug pa lta bur gnas/ / 'khru dang slon par mi byed par/ / gzer la sogs pa mi bzad pa/ / be+e snabs de yin/

skt: vidoṣādyatha durbarasya dhusastathā'spahemandānerakhadūpmaṇo vegadhāriṇo vātamūtrapurīpavegarodhanaśaśīrasyāśnaṃ mārutena vāyunā pīḍitaṃ tathā śpmaṇāntā madhye pīḍitaṃ, vivaddhasattvādabahiulībhet‌ | apravṛttiḥ vaca̭saḥ sampādya doṣairarasaṃ khā kṣobhitamākukhacharata, daṣṭasasyasveneva saṃsthitaṃ baha cidhadudmahāṅgarjādidaḥkhasāmānyakasṇāt‌ = tavenara śūkhādīn‌ yathoktān‌ vātāduddhavāna , tītrān‌ sodusadakyān‌ , chakadyatisāsabhyāṃ vanitān‌ aśasībhūtaṃ karute sa vyādhirachsa iti bhaṇyate
tib: khyad par du zhes pa mchog tu yang skyes bu shin tu nyam chung zhing sbeg par gyur pa dang / de bzhin du me drod zhan pa ste/ bad kan mang pos pho ba'i me drod nyams par gyur pa dang / shugs bkag pas zhes bya ba/ 'phyen dang bshang ba dang / gci ba'i shugs bkag par gyur pa'i skyes bu'i zas ni rlung gi nad kyis lam nye bar bkag par byas pa dang / de bzhin du bad kan gyis bar du zhes pa dbus su lam bkag pa'i rgyus ni/ zas de be'u snabs su gyur cing / phyi rol du 'byung bar 'gyur la/ 'ju ba'i sgo med par gyur pa'i nyes pa be'u snabs su byas nas dkrugs shing rnam par bskyod pas ma zhu ba'i be'u snabs te/ zug rngu zug pa lta bu nyid du kun du gnas shing / gzer ba dang khong pa dang / yan lag snyom zhing zug pa la sogs pa'i nad rnam pa mang po'i spyi'i rgyur gyur pas zas de mar 'khru ba dang / yar slon par mi byed pas de ma gtogs par/ ji skad du bshad pa'i rlung la sogs pa'i nad mi bzad cing brnag par dka' ba gang yin pa ni be'u snabs su gyur nas skyed par byed pas na/ nad de la ma zhu ba be'u snabs zhes bya'o/ / nyes rab gdug / be snabs mi bzad kyis sbubs bkag / rtsib logs kun tu drang por 'gro/ / shing bzhin rengs par gyur na ni/ / ma zhu shing 'dra zhes bya ste/ / myur du gsod byed de spang bya/ / zhes bya ba la/ / rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa shin tu gdug pa ste/ shas cher gnod par gyur pa dang / be'u snabs mi bzad pa rnams kyis sbubs bkag pa ste/ ma zhu ba'i be'u snabs mi bzad cing gdug pas rtsa sbubs kyi khong stong par bkag cing go skabs kyi bar chad pas rlung la sogs pa rnams rtsib logs kun tu thad kar phan tshun 'gro zhing / drang por 'gro bas khyab par gyur pas na/ lan 'ga' skyes bu de'i lus shing bzhin du rengs shing dbyig pa bsgreng ba ltar gyur na/ lus g.yo bar ma nus par byed par gyur na ni/ de'i nad de'i ming ma zhu ba shing 'dra zhes bya ste/ des ni myur du gsod cing 'chi bar byed pas gsor mi rung ba ste/ de spang zhing dor bar bya ste/

skt: doṣā avyatha duṣṭā atimātraṃ gatāḥ, duṣṭā drāḥ praduṣṭāmabaddhakhāḥ vātādayastiyaik‌ yānto untaḥ, kadācittu dāsīramasya daṇḍavat‌ khaṇuḍastambhayanti stabdha tanuṃ kurvanti cedyadi tadā daṇḍaṭhasakaṃ nāmānaṃ vyādhimāḍyukāriṇaṃ rīghrakāriṇadhyaṃ yajet‌ pariharet‌ | khapriṃ karotīti śīghrakāradhraṃ vyāpādayati sa etaramucyate
ñabhami uṣṇā kriyā kāryā, viṣe sā tu saddhayate | rītasādhyaśvāddhiṣasya | viṣe tu śītā bhyā hitā, sā khāme viruddhā āmasyoṣṇakriyāprasādhyasvāt‌ | taspānmahāghoraṃ prakhya ritvāt‌
tib: mi 'phrod pa ni zas bsrung ba'i le'u'i skabs su bshad pa/ rlan can gyi sha la sogs pa dang / 'o ma la sogs pa lhan cig bza' ba ma 'phrod pa la sogs pa yin no/ / lhag par za ba ni zas kyis 'grangs pa'i steng du yang za ba'o/ / ma zhu bar za ba ni/ sngar de zhag gi zan ma zhu bar gang za bar byed pa'o/ / de ltar na mi 'phrod par za ba dang / lhag par za ba dang / ma zhu bar za ba'i skyes bu de ni dug gi mtshan nyid can te/ ma zhu ba'i nyes ba dug gi mtshan ma can gyi ma zhu ba dang / mi bzad pa shin tu gsor mi rung ba dug gi ming can te/ dug dang mtshan ma 'dra ba yin pa'i phyir dug gi tshul can te/ dug dang tshul 'dra ba dang / myur du gsod bar byed pa dang / gso zhing bcos par bya ba'i dpyad bya bar dka' bas spang zhing dor bar bya'o/ / de yang gang gi phyir ma zhu ba ni bya ba dro bas gso dgos na/ de dug gi dbang gis mi 'phrod/ dug ni bsil bas gso bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ dug la ni gso ba bsil ba phan la/ de ni ma zhu ba'i be'u snabs la mi 'phrod pa ste/ ma zhu ba ni dro ba'i bya ba'i rim pas gso dgos pa yin no/ / de bas na mtshan nyid gnyi ga dang ldan pa'i ma zhu ba'i dug gi ming can des ni gsod par byed pa yin pas spang zhing dor bar bya ba kho na yin no/ / de nas ma zhu'i be'u snabs 'gyur/ / gsor rung shu dag rgyam tsha dang / / po son cha bcug chu dron ni/ / 'thungs pas skyug bcug / ces bya ba la/ de nas zhes bya ba ni/ bkra shis pa'i don te/ ma zhu ba'i be'u snabs la sogs pa ni shin tu mi bzad cing / gsod par bya ba yin pa las/ ma zhu be'u snabs su gyur pa gang gsor rung zhing / bcos pa'i thabs yod pa'i ma zhu ba de ni myur du skyug tu gzhug cing slon par bya'o/ / ci zhig gis slon du gzhug ce na/ shu dag dang / rgyam tsha dang / po son cha bskol ba'i chu dron po 'thungs bas skyug tu gzhug go/ / de nas ni/ dugs dang mas gtong reng bu dag /

skt: athāttimaṅgaṭhe | arusakādīnāṃ mahāvyathikatvāt‌ | yadā sādhyatvaṃ sādhyaghvena nirdiṣṭam‌ | arūsībhūtaṃ tvarita śīghramevoṣṭhikhet‌ | kaṃ chatā | vārayaṣṇaṃ pītvā | tacca soprāpaṭuphalm‌ | ugrā vacā | paṭu biḍarūbaṇam‌ | phaṃ madanaphaṭham‌| ebhiḥ sametasuṣṇoka pītvā vamet‌ | tato vamanānantaramasyārusakātasya svedanaṃ yathāyogaṃ khedādhyāyoktaṃ yojayet‌|tathāphalavati madanaphalāṅgārabhūmarvṇagomūtrādibhiḥ kṛtāṃ, sthānam‌ ] sarippaṇadīkāmarathasaṃvalite a <. malvātānudachomanī mūtarapurīṣavātānā svamāgaisthāpanī, bahiḥpravatikāṃ ca yojayet‌ | rude'ḍagaṣṭhaparamāṇā praṇidheyā | yataḥ sadyaḥ samyagāiṅuddhasya dāsyanti padupadravāḥ | aṅgāni bāhvādīni nāmyamānāni kuṭikhaṣva̭ gatāni; bhṛśaṃ svinnāniṃ sṛdusvaṃ prāprāni; vadamairūṇodimathervaṣaṭayet‌
tib: de nas zhes bya ba skyug sman btang ste/ slon pa'i rjes nyid la ma zhu bas nyen pa la dugs bya ba ste/ ma zhu ba be'u snabs can gyis nyen pa la dugs kyi le'u las bshad pa'i dugs rnams ci rigs su bya ba dang / de bzhin du mas gtong ba'i reng bu ste/ po son cha dang / khang pa'i dud pa dang / lan tshwa la sogs pa las byas pa/ dri ma dang rlung dag legs par rgyu bar byed pa ste/ bshang ba dang gci ba dag phyir 'byung ba'i rlung rang gi gnas su 'jog par byed cing phyir 'byin par byed pa sbyar zhing gtong bar bya ste/ de yang gang gi phyir/
lag ngar la sogs pa'i yan lag 'jas pa 'dra bar gyur cing / yon por 'khums pa dag la/ shin tu dugs byas nas 'jam pa nyid du gyur pa dang / bal gos la sogs pas dkri bar bya'o/ /

ma zhu ba gzer thabs can shin tu 'phel zhing stobs can du gyur pa la/ rkang pa'i rgyab kyi cha long mo'i 'og / rting pa zhes bya ba de gnyis su lcags kyi thur ma la sogs pas me btsa' btab pa ni bsngags pa yin no/ / de ni de'i nyin smyung bar gzhag / khrus btang lta bur nye bar spyad/ / ces bya ba la/ ma zhu ba be'u snabs dang gsud pas nyen pa'i skyes bu de de ltar byas pas/ slon dang khrus kyis dag par gyur pa de'i rjes la de'i nyin par smyung bar bzhag cing zas bcad pa dang / khrus btang lta bur 'bras thug slan te dang / ska ba la sogs pa'i sbyor bas rim gyis gso bar bya'o/ / ci'i phyir ma zhu ba'i be'u snabs gsor rung ba la skyug sman la sogs pa bya ba bstan gyi/ gzer 'joms par byed pa'i sman shing kun la sogs pa ma bstan pa dang / gsud pa gsor rung ba la rting bar me btsa' bstan gyi/ slon dang khrus kyis gzer 'joms par byed pa dang / 'ju bar byed pa'i sman la sogs pa ma bstan zhes bya ba rtog par byed pa dag dgag pa'i phyir smras pa ni/ ma zhu mi bzad nyen gyur kyang / / gzer 'joms sman ni btung mi bya/

skt: ajīṇīṃ nauṣadhaṃ pibediśyaścasayojanā | ajī- | jamodapūtakivacādayṭhayabhidhānyakaiḥ| = savāskatha 94 masyāstīyajīṇīṃ apariṇatāhāraḥ, sa tatrāti dya śaḍhavānapi, śannamauṣadha di ṅga-catrikaṭudikaṃ na pibet‌ | thataṃ āmasanno'nalaḥ āmadodudhalo'bhniḥ, sa̱ aāmadoṣamoṣadhamāhārajātaṃ panta haṃ na samartho na śakta iti yāvat‌ | evaṃ dopauṣadhānānāṃ vibhramo vyapaṭikṣeṣa āturaḥ visacyakhsagaī sahasā śaṭyivauṣadhaṃ prayukta̭ṃnihanyādati{tayenmāsyet‌
tib: ma zhu bas ni sman btung bar mi bya'o/ / zhes tshig sbyar bar bya'o/ / zas zhu zhing smin par ma nus pas ma zhu ba ste/ zas zhum nus pa des mi bzad pas nyen par gyur cing / shin tu gzer zug pa dang ldan par gyur kyang / gzer 'joms pa'i sman shing kun can gsum pa la sogs par btung bar mi bya'o/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ be'u snabs ma zhu bas me drod nyams shing ma zhu ba'i nyes pas bcom pa'i me'i drod des ni ma zhu ba'i nad kyis/ sman dang zas kyi rigs 'ju zhing smin par bya bar mi nus so/ / des na sman dang zas dang nyes pa 'di dag gis ma zhu bas nyen pa'i nad pa 'phral du de'i mod la thu zhing gnod pa'i khyad par 'phel zhing sman gyi sbyor ba nyid kyis 'chi ba dag nyid du 'gyur ro/ /

skt: jauṇīśane standhurūdare stibhitaśurukodhe, peṣyamauṣadhaṃ doṣaśaṣapavanāyai, vaheḥ sandhukṣaṇāyai va yulñayāt‌ || 17 1. de0-avasthavireṣe oṣadhe bidhatte-āmadoṣiṇau padājīrṇāhārakhaṃ vadā dīpanapācanamoṣadhaṃ deyam‌ | saṃprahe (“tayaḥ samyaguvidcaddhasya dāmyati tadupadravāḥ | śare naraśrakoṣṭho'ddhiḥ koṣṇābhiscūṇitāḥ pavita || diguparati- | vepāvayoṣasīvarkavacābhayāḥ| athavā pipmūraṃ cidā erataindhavam‌. | saṃṭīsyuṅkṣīrakhvaṇapiṣyakhīmasvāni ce | bastasya mūtreṇa visūncikānī pralepadhūmāṃjananasvayogaiḥ || yaśanaścumidmyāṃ ca mojyabheṣajyayo; same | pāko'thau yuktayoḥ prāk‌ ṭha tīko saṃde punaścarāt‌ || sabhaktamauṣadhaṃ tasmānmedaghaneravacārathet‌ | pūni bhojanaṃ sātmyaṃ khdīpanakaṇam‌ || prātarāśe tvajīraṇe'pi sāyamāśaco na iṣyāti | aje sāyamaśce su prātarāśa di dupyati || divā rabudhyate'kaiṇa hadayaṃ puḍarokavat‌ | tariminvibuddhe khotāṃsi suratvaṃ yaṃti sarvaśaḥ || vyāyāmāca vihārāca vikṣapatvācaca vetasa; | na chaidayupacchaṃti divā tenāsya dhātavaḥ || aṅdhinaneṣvannamāsiktamanyateṣu na duṣyati | avidagdhevviva paya; svapnasaṃbhiśitaṃ payaḥ || ratrau ṭha hadaye mni saṃdateṣvayaneṣvatha } paridaṃ yāti koṣṭhe saṃte dedadhātava; || idhineṣvanyadapakareṣu teṣvārikta praduṣyati | pidadheṣu payaḥsanyatayayastatatedhivārapitas‌ ] naiśe tasmādajīga'te nānyadbhujīta bhojanam‌ | udvāraddhirussādye vegotsarago yathocitaḥ || lutā kcudhipāā ca jīrṇāhārasya ṭhakṣaṇam‌. | prāyaḥ prahāparāyena segagrāmaḥ prajāyate || mṛṇāmaśṣanadajānāṃ videreṇa vidhūnikā | dooṣopaṭīnaṃ yadi rīnamār pittokhaṇaṃ syādūṇuyānna vahvim‌ | jayeta du tu tato bubhukṣā sā ma̭danuddhīnviṣravanihaṃti "; drati
tib: skyes bu'i kha zas zhu zhing smin par gyur du zin kyang / lto ba rtsub cing sra bar gyur pa ste/ pho ba rem rem por gyur pa la/ / nyes pa'i lhag ma zhu zhing sbyang ba'i phyir dang / pho ba'i me drod bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ sman gtang bar bya zhing sbyang bar bya'o/ / ma zhu'i 'gyur ba zhi ba dag /

skt: āmadoṣajanitanyādhīnāmārasyajāḍayābhamāndhādīnāṃ dāntirupaśamo'patapaṇāhṛhvanapācanavamanavirecanarūpāddhavāti jāthate | taspunarapatapaiṇaṃ triṣidha triprakāra laṅganapācanavamanavirecanai ca triyidhe doṣe'spamadhyabhūyasi samīkṣyevamanena prakā. reṇa mūdhodiṣibhāgena doṣān‌ parīkṣya yojayet‌ 18||
tib: ma zhu ba'i 'gyur ba zhes pa zas ma zhu ba'i nyes pa las byung ba'i be'u snabs dang / snyom pa dang / gzer ba la sogs pa rnams la zhi ba dag ni nyams dmad pa/ smyung ba dang zhi bar byas pa dang / dugs dag byas pa las de nye bar zhi zhing nyams dmas pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /

nyams smad par bya ba de ni smyung ba dang / zhu bar byas pa dang / dugs bya ba rnam pa gsum yod pa de nyes pa rnam gsum ni zhes pa/ chung ngu dang / bar ma dang / chen po'i tshul brtags shing rim pa 'dis/ chung ngu la sogs pa'i nyes pa'i dbye bas so sor brtags shing dpyad nas rab tu sbyang bar bya'o/ /

skt: tatreti | tasmiśividhe dope chaṅghanamapatapaṇamaspe doṣe pathyaṃ hitam‌ | tena hyanirānakha vṛddhayā vātātaparīto bāspasarilāścayo' 1 dopaḥ roṣamāpadyate | madhye madhyavaṭhe dope ṭaṅghanayuevāsastathā pācana vacāprativipādipathyaṃ tābhyāṃ madhyavacho dopo vātātapābhyāṃ pābhasmāvakiraṇairiva cānatisamāt‌ saliṭāśayo madhyadoṣaḥ prayopamāpadyate | prabhūte bahudoṣe prave sodhanaṃ doṣāvasecanaṃ vamanabirecanādirūpamapatapaiṇaṃ pradhyam‌ | taddhi yasmādramanādiśodhane-makhān‌ kaphapittarāranmūtrādīyunmūlayati chinatti | nadyaviknāvite parabalayedakadhe śrāsyādiṣu puṣṭibhevati | tasmāschantarṣaṇanimittānāṃ nānāsopaṇatapaṇāsthiśñāntispatarṣaṇani" mintāntareṇa santarpaṇamiti
tib: de la zhes pa nyes pa rnam pa gsum po la/ chung ngu la ni smyung bar gnas pa nyams dmad pa phan zhing rjes su mthun pa yin te/ des kyang me dang rlung 'phel bar byas pas dper na rlung dang than pas chu'i tshogs nyung zhig gi gnas skems par byed pa bzhin du/ 'di la phan par 'gyur ba yin no/ / 'bring la zhes pa nyes pa'i stobs 'bring tsam du gyur pa la ni smyung ba zhes bya ba zas bcad pa dang / de bzhin du gzhu ba zhes bya ba shu dag dang / pu shel tse la sogs pas phan pa yin te/ de gnyis ni nyes pa 'bring po 'joms te/ dper na chu'i tshogs ha cang mi che ba la thal ba dang / sa rdul dag dang 'dres pa'i rlung dang than pas chu'i tshogs ha cang mi che ba skems par byed pa dang 'dra'o/ / che la zhes pa nyes pa mang po stobs dang ldan pa dag la ni sbyang ba ste/ khrus dang slon la sogs pa'i tshul gyis nyams smad par bya ba phan pa yin te/ gang gi phyir skyug sman la sogs pa sbyangs pas de yis dri ma zhes pa rlung dang / mkhris pa dang / bad kan dang / bshang ba dang / gci ba la sogs pa rtsa ba nas 'byin cing gcod par 'gyur te/ dper na 'dam bu'i zhing chu med pa dag tu ni 'bras la sogs pa skye bar mi 'gyur ba dang 'dra'o/ / de bas na nyams mthos pa'i ma zhu ba las byung ba la ni nyams dmad pa ma byas par zhi bar 'gyur ba ma yin la/ nyams dmad bar gyur ba las byung ba la yang nyams brta ba ma byas par zhi bar 'gyur ba ma yin no/ / de bzhin nad gzhan dag la yang / / rang nad gzhi las go bzlog pas/ / gso ba/

de bzhin du chung ngu la sogs pa'i rim pa 'dis/ rims la sogs pa'i nad gzhan dag la yang rang gi nad gzhi las go bzlog pa zhes pa/ rang gi nad kyi rgyu dang mi mthun pa'i sman gyis gso bar bya zhing bzlog par bya'o/ / de yang rang gi nad gzhi yin pas na/ rang gi nad gzhi ste/ rang gi rgyu gang yin pa'o/ / de las go bzlog pa ni de dang mi mthun pa ste/ dper na tshim zhing brtas par byas pa las byung ba'i nad la nyams dmad par bya ba dang / nyams dmad ba las byung ba'i nad de las bzlog pa ni brtan par bya ba yin pa dang / de bzhin du lci ba dang / snum pa dang / grang ba la sogs pa las byung ba'i nad la de dang mi mthun pa yang ba dang / rtsub pa dang / dro bar bya ba dang / yang ba dang / rtsub pa dang / dro ba las byung ba'i nad la de dang mi mthun pa lci ba dang / snum pa dang / bsil bar bya ba la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /

skt: tathā nidānaviparyatauṣadhena cikitsedupa" kramet‌ | svaṃ ca tannidānaṃ ca svanidānap‌ | yathāyathamuspattikāraṇam‌ | tasya vipathaiyo naiparītyaṃ dhanaṃ hitamitayāha } tadrīyādi | di yasmātataccho- yathā santarṇoccheyagyādhau viparyayo'patpaṇam‌) apa aṣṭaṅkhahṛdayaṃ | tapraṇosthe vyādhau vipathaḥ santapaṇam‌ || purabhtigdharītāvine vyādhau chaghurūkṣoṣṇādije detu. dhiparsataṃ gurubhnigdhakaśṣītādikriyamāṇe'pi deta̱dhipaśaye doṣasya . bahvadṭadāperanubandhe sthirasve sati tuvipathaiyaṃ nidyanavipasītamovadhaṃ layaktvā'pāsya yaśrāyathaṃ yathāyobhyaṃ vyādhaiviparsattamaupadhaṃ kuryat‌ prayojayet‌ ! yathā susatāparpa̭ṭakaṃ jvare yavāgvaḥ | pramehe rajanīyavānne ceti | raktapitte codhyaige visvanamadhoge vamanam‌ | tathā~myādhiviparītau dvau mūlagopaka pacca kamāṇi sdhūmadhūpākhajanādīni tathā dhipchāvanaupanādādīni | yathā pittatve sa̱stāparapaṭayoḥ, pittañvaropadāme śaktatā na tathā'nyathina pintakrūte vyādhau | yathā haradrāyāṃ mehaḥ | śeṣmakastve'pi pramehanivāraṇe rāktā na tathānyarimina. mehaśpmaprabhave vyādhau | pataccottaratanrāvasāne vistareṇa vakṣayatyācārthaḥ
tib: nad kyi rgyu las go bzlog pa'i sman byas su zin cing / nyes pa stobs dang ldan/ nad dang rjes su 'brel ba yod cing / shin tu zhen par gyur pa la ni rgyu las bzlog pa ste/ nad gzhi dang / rjes su mi mthun pa'i sman spangs shing dor/ sman pas ji ltar rigs shing 'os pa'i sman nad las go bzlog pa'i sman de sbyar bar bya zhing sbyin par bya ste/ dper na rims la gla sgang dang / par pa ta dang / nas thug sla ba sbyin pa dang / gcin nad la ser po rnam gnyis dang / nas zan la sogs pa sbyin pa dang / mkhris pa gyen du 'byung ba la khrus sman gyis 'og nas gdon par bya'o/ / de bzhin du nad las go bzlog pa'i gso dpyad kyi bcos pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo rnam pa gnyis dang / las rnam lnga du ba sna nas gtang ba dang / mig sman la sogs pa dang bcas pa la sogs pa bya ba ste/ dper na gla sgang dang par pa ta mkhris pa sel bar byed pa yin du zin kyang / rims 'joms par byed pa de ltar mkhris pa las byung ba'i nad gzhan la ni ma yin no/ / dper na skyer pa ni tshil dang / bad kan sel bar byed pa yin du zin kyang / gtso cher gcin nad 'joms par byed pa de ltar tshil dang bad kan las byung ba'i nad gzhan dag la ni de lta ma yin no/ / 'di dag kyang 'og nas slob dpon gyis rgya cher bstan pa yin no/ /

rgyu dang nad kyi go bzlog pa de'i don byed pa ste/ 'di ni rgyu dang nad kyi go bzlog pa'i don byed pa'i tshul can yod pas na don byed pa ste/ de'i don ni nad kyi gzhi las go bzlog pa dang / nad la go bzlog pa dag la/ go ma bzlog par gyur pa'i las de'i don byed pa sbyor bar bya ste/ dper na skyug bro ba la slon sman btang ba'am/ tshad pas 'khru ba la khrus bya ba'am/ chang nad la chang sbyin pa'am/ mes tshig pa la mes bsrod pa'am/ zhi ba dang / rgyas pa'i las bya ba ste/ 'di dag ni bsdus pa las rgyas par bshad do/ / don gnyis kas byed pa lha rnams la yang brten cing / sman gyi sbyor ba yang byed pa dang / skyug bro ba la slon sman dang / tshad pas 'khru ba la dri ma sbyang ba dang / chang gi nad la chang blud pa dang / mes tshig pa la me la bsrod pa dang / mkhris pa nang du zhen pa'am/ lam log par song ba la dugs bya ba dang / kha ba dang skyur ba dang bska ba'i ro la brten cing dro ba dang / grang ba'i spyod lam gyis gnas pas phyi rol du gdon cing / rang gi lam nas rgyu bar bya ba dang / bad kan nang du zhen cing rengs par gyur pa la/ phyi rol nas bsil ba'i nye bar spyod pa la gnas pas/ de'i gnod pa nang du zhugs nas/ bad kan gzhu bar bya ste/ de lta bu'i go bzlog pa'i don byed do/ / nyes

tib: phrum nas bu ram phra mo'i bar du bza' bar mi bya'o/ / bza' mi bya zhes bya ba 'dis ni 'di skad ston pa yin te/ phrum dang chang la sogs pa rtag tu goms par rgyun du bza' ba bkag pa yin gyi/ 'di dag lan 'ga' yang bzar mi rung bar bkag pa ni ma yin no/ / de la phrum ni ba'i 'o ma la sogs pa las byas pa'o/ / ba tsha ni ya bak+Shar la sogs pa'o/ / tsha ni chang thams cad shin tu skyur bar song ba'o/ / la phug rjen pa ni la phug rgan po'o/ / sha zhes bya ba ni rid pa la sogs pa kun dang sbyar ro/ / rid pa ni pags pa dang rus pa tsam lus pa'o/ / skam pa ni rlan med pa'o/ / nis pa ni gang bu can gyi 'bru'i bye brag gcig go/ / chu ldum ni ut+pal la sogs pa'i sdong bu'i tshod ma'o/ / 'bras khur ni sA lu la sogs pa btags pa las byas pa'i khur ba'o/ / myu gur gyur pa ni 'bras la sogs pa'i khyi so 'thon pa'o/ / ya ba ka ni gra ma can gyi 'bru'i bye brag go/ / bu ram phra mo ni bu ram gyi khyad par chung ngu zhig go/ /

skt: raktarālyādikaṃ śīlayet‌ satatamabhyaset‌ | dadaṃ māṃsamityatrādipadalopaḥ | pathyā-harītakī | lorī-paṭolasākam‌ | diyaudakamāntīrak toyam‌| paraśi gātrau mākṣikaśratābhyāṃ triphaḍāṃ rīṭayeeyucatete
tib: rak+ta sha li la sogs pa dang / sA lu'i 'bras chan la sogs pa dang / skam sa'i sha rtag tu bza' bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du mig la phan pa dang / lus kyi stobs bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ mtshan mo'i dus su 'bras bu gsum dang / sbrang rtsi dang mar sar du sbyar ba bza' bar bya'o/ / gzhan yang sman gyi rigs gang smos su zin kyang / smin par byed cing bde bar 'ju bar byed pa gang yin pa dang / sman gang nad sel zhing 'joms par byed pa de yang bsten cing bza' bar bya'o/ /

pad+ma'i rtsa ba la sogs pa ni zas kyi dang por thog ma nyid du bza' bar bya'o/ / tso tsa ni rgya star gyi 'bras bu'o/ / mo tsa ni chu shing gi 'bras bu'o/ / khur ba bu ram can ni bza' ba'i khyad par ro/ / 'ju dka' ba ni ro rtul ba'o/ / brtan pa ni brtan por gnas pa ste/

sngar bshad pa de las go bzlog pa ni/ yang ba dang / rtsub pa dang / tsha ba dang / rno ba dang / g.yo ba'i rang bzhin can gyi sman rnams kha ba dang / tsha ba dang / / bska ba'i mtshan nyid can zas kyi tha ma rdzogs pa'i dus su bza' bar bya'o/ / zas kyi bar du ni skyur ba dang / tsha ba dang / sngar lan tshwa can bza' bar bya'o/ / lto yi cha gnyis zas kyis te/ / cha gcig skom gyis dgang bar bya/ / rlung la sogs pa'i gnas su ni/ / cha bzhi bar ni lhag mar gzhag / ces bya ba la/ lto'i cha gnyis ni zas kyis dgang bar bya'o/ / lto'i cha gcig ni skom ste btung bas dgang bar bya'o/ / rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa rnams kyi gnas dang rten du ni lto'i bzhi pa lhag mar gzhag cing lus par bya'o/ / 'di ni rnam pa thams cad du bya ba ma yin te/ de yang gzhung las/ rlung me'i shas chung nad med dang / / rgyal po'i bde ba'i bdag nyid la/ / rim 'di rtag tu sbyar bya yi/ / gzhan dag la ni nges pa med/ / ces bshad pa yin no/ / de ltar zas zos zin nas/ de'i rjes la skom btung bar bya ba yin pas na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/

zas zos pa'i rjes la skom du btung ba ni chu nyid bzang ba yin te/ ro thams cad kyi skye gnas yin pa'i phyir dang / sems can thams cad kyi thun mong gi longs spyod yin pa'i phyir dang / 'tsho bar byed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ / de yang khyad par ni bsil zhing grang ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ / de yang gang dang rjes su mthun zhe na/ nas dang bag phye las g.yos su byas pa zos pa dang / zho dang / chang dang / dug dang / sbrang rtsi zos pa'i rjes la 'thungs na phan zhing bde bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /

gang zas mi 'ju ba dang / bshang gci 'gags pa la ni chu bskol dron mo btung bar bya ba la/ tshod ma dag dang / mung+ga zos pa las gnod par gyur pa'i nad la ni zho ga chu dang / / dar ba dang / 'bras khu mnan pa'i rang skyur gyi rtsab mo btung bar bya'o/ /

skt: yancācuktaṃ dravyajātaṃ svāsthyānugharantiḥ svāsthyaṃ nuvate | svādhyāyāsuvarvanaṃ karoti | svāsthyaṃ daḍhīkaseti | yaścāpi rogāṇāṃ chedakaraṃ vighrātatakāṣi parādhīnāṃ tadapi śasīṭyet‌
tib: mi skem zhing sha chung ba dag la/ lus rgyas shing lus zungs 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/
mi sbom zhing sha che ba dag skem por bya ba'i phyir/ skom du sbrang rtsi'i chu btung ba ste/
gcong zhes bya ba zad byed kyi glo gcong chen po na ba la sha khu btung bar bya'o/ /

skt: pūvemamre bisādikamadyāt‌-bhakṣayet‌ | cocaṃ tyakṣa nākikeraṃ mocantu kadalīphalam‌ | utkārikā-bhakyamedaḥ | svādu-maghuraṃ, mandmatīṣma, pthir‌-dāḍhayovaham‌ | ataḥ pūrvoktaviparītaṃ chthurukṣakadutīkṣaṇacachadranyaṃ kaṭutiktakaṣāyaṃ bhojama syānte bhakṣayet‌ | madhye bhojanasyāmchalayaṇotkaraṃ daravyamadyāt‌
tib: me drod chung zhing sha zos pas ni skom du chang btung bar bya'o/ /
nad pa la sogs pa nyam chung zhing rmya bar gyur pa'i mi dang / skem pa dang / byis pa dang / rgan po dag la skom du 'o ma btung ba ni bdud rtsi lta bur phan par byed pa yin no/ /

mdor bsdu na zas kyi rjes la skom du btung bar bya ba ni gang zhig zas dang mi 'dra zhing / de dang rang bzhin mi mthun par gyur pa de ni/ dus rnam pa kun tu bsngags shing phan par 'gyur ba yin la/ de yang mi 'phrod pa med par gyur pa'o/ / de yang dper na snum pa la rtsub pa dang / rtsub pa la snum pa dang / grang ba la dro ba dang / dro ba la grang ba dang / mngar ba la skyur ba dang / skyur ba la mngar ba dang / / mngar ba la kha ba dang / kha ba la mngar ba'o/ / de lta na ni 'o ma las g.yos byas pa'i zas dang / 'o ma las gyur pa rnams la skom du rang sgyur gyi rtsab mo la sogs pa btung bar bya dgos te/ zas kyi yon tan las yon tan mi mthun pa med pa yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ de'i phyir mi 'phrod pa med pa mi bya ba'i tshig smos pa yin te/ rtsab mo rang skyur la sogs pa skyur ba gang yin pa de ni 'o ma la sogs pa dang yon tan mi mthun par gyur pa yin du zin kyang / de ni mi 'phrod pa yin te/ 'o ma dang skyur lhan cig bza' ba ni mi 'phrod pa yin no/ / zhes sngar bstan pa'i phyir ro/ / de bas na gang zas dang skom yon tan mi mthun zhing / mtshan nyid tha dad kyang mi 'phrod pa med par gyur ba btung ba de mchog tu bsngags pa yin no/ / da ni skom 'thungs pa'i yon tan smras pa ni/

skt: annena bhojanenodarasaya dāsau dvau bhāgau prapūrayet‌ | panena pānīyādinā kukṣāveka bhargaṃ bhapūrayet‌ | pavranādīnāmāśrayaṃ sthānaṃ caturthaṃ kukṣā+ | sūtra mepayen‌ sthāpayan‌ | na savavipayoṃ'yaṃ niyam‌ pintaṃ keyucit‌ | tathāca bhndhaḥ-^mandābhivalayāmyeṣa sūpaśdharasukhātmayu || yyaḥ kramo'yaṃ satarta sa nānaddhavayepu ca ''
sāmpratamanupānaguṇānāha-anuparānamūjau kati | tadevānna cikḍedayati | jaraṇa̭ṃsukhapāramatāmupārjayāti
tib: zas kyi rjes skom 'thungs pa ni ngoms shing tshim par byed pa dang / lus khyab cing rdzogs par byed pa dang / gzi ma dngas 'phel zhing brtas par byed pa dang / de bzhin du lus brtan par byed pa dang / yan lag brtan zhing mkhregs par byed pa dang / de bzhin du zas kyi tshogs sdud cing gcig tu gnas bar byed la sgong bar byed do/ / snyi bar byed pa ni zas bsdus pa de lhod cing snyi bar byed pa dang / zas de nyid 'drul bar byed cing sla bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du rnam par 'ju zhing bde bar 'ju bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: tadanupānamūdhvajanruvikāgādariṣa ne hitam‌ | jatrorūrdhvaṃ ūtvaijahuḥ-vakco'sayoḥ sandhiḥ! tathā cāgamaḥ | śirodharā januḥ kandharā parikīrtitā | gītamāpyayoḥ prasaṅgaḥ | prratirabhyasanaṃ yatra tatra na ditam‌ | teṣāṃ hi pradṛpyāmāścayoraḥkaṇṭasthitamāhāraja̭̭stedamāsādyāmiṣyandābhisādacchayādīnāmayān‌ vidadhyāt‌
tib: skom 'thungs pa de ni/ / nam tshong yan chad kyi nad la gnod pa yin no/ / de la nam tshong ni mchan khung dang / dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi bar mtshams la nam tshong zhes bya ste/ de yang lung las/ nam tshong mgo dang ske ba'i rten/ / mgo 'dzin zhes kyang bshad pa yin/ / zhes 'byung ba yin no/ / de ltar na de yan chad kyi yan lag gi nad la gnod pa yin no/ / de bzhin du dbugs mi bde ba dang / lud pa mang ba dang / glo rdol ba dang / cham pas btab pa la yang gnod pa yin no/ / de bzhin du glu len pa dang / smra ba mang po la chags shing yang dang yang du slon pa dang / skad 'gags pa la yang gnod pa yin te/ de rnams kyis ma zhu ba'i gnas la gnod par gyur nas/ lkog mar gyur pa'i zas las byung ba'i snum dang 'dres te/ slon pa la sogs pa'i nad skyed par 'gyur ba yin no/ / lus las rnag 'dzag gcin nad mig / lkog nad rma yi nad kyis nyen/ / skom spang /

skt: sveśca puruṣaḥ svastha āturo vā pīvā paniṃ krutvā māpyādhvakṣayanai pāṭhamāgegamanasvapana tatkārameva syajet‌ | bhojane kṛsavā''tapādikaṃ tyajat‌ | jaātapakamai santāpa, vahimibhimaścādigamanay‌ } paravaraṃ kūpādhuhaivanam‌ | vāhanaṃ bhāyaderadekhādeśāntare nayanaṃ layajet‌ | sadraṇamapyamātraṃ mātropayuktamakaṣṭe śsīroḥ padhātāya yataḥ sampanyate
tib: gang gi lus la mdze la sogs pas nyen cing rnag 'dzag par gyur pa dang / de bzhin du gcin nad de/ lgang pa'i nad yod pa dang / mig na ba dang / lkog ma'i nad na ba dang / rma'i nad kyis nyen cing gnod par gyur pa ste/ /

kun gyis zhes bya ba nad med pa'am/ nad dang ldan pa'i mi thams cad kyis kyang skom 'thungs par gyur pa'i rjes thogs la mang du smra zhing 'don pa dang / lam du zhugs shing 'gro ba dang / nyal zhing gnyid log pa ste/ dus de'i tshe nyid 'phral du bya ba dag spang zhing dor bar bya'o/ /

skt: ahārakālamāha-prasaṣṭe tyakte viṇmūtre sati hṛdi suvimale viṣddhe, doṣe vātādike sapathe svasthānastha; kṣuṭupagamane jātāyāṃ buukṣāyāṃ, vāte'turati māraṃtasyāvuṭomye'prāvrikte urdaṇi, viśadakaraṇe svakāyaikaraṇapaṭābindriyātmake dehe śarīre sukhvau raghutāsamāyukte satyāhāraṃ bharayuśīta | vidhi vidhānaṃ tena niyamitaṃ niyamena proktaṃ, hi yasmādarthe yasmāt‌ sa kāra ācāryāṇāṃ mato'bhigreta iti bhadram‌
tib: zas zos pa'i rjes thogs nyid la nyi tshan la sogs pa spang bar bya ste/ nyi tshan ni nyi ma'i than pas gdungs pa'o/ / me ni me tsha ba la 'des par gyur pa'o/ / bzhon pa ni rta la sogs pas 'gro ba'o/ / rkyal ba ni mtsho la sogs bar rkyal ba'o/ / 'degs pa ni gur la sogs pa yul gzhan du bskyod pa ste de spang bar bya'o/ / zas dang skom yon tan dang ldan pa dang / tshod zin par byas su zin kyang dus ma yin par zos pa dang 'thungs pas lus la gnod par byed pa yin no/ / de bas na bshang ba dang / gci ba bsal zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pas de'i dus smras pa yin te/ bshang dang gci bsal snying la dri med nyes pa lam min par mi 'gro/ / sgregs pa dag cing bru ba tsha gyur thur gyi rlung ni tha mal rgyu/ / de bzhin me yi drod bdo dbang po gsal zhing lus kyang rab tu yang / / zas kyi tshod ran cho gar sbyar bzhin za ba de ni dus su 'dod/ / ces bya ba la/ bshang ba dang gci ba legs par bsal zhing btang ba dang / snying la dri ma med pa ste/ sems dngas shing nyam nga ba med pa dang / nyes pa ste rlung la sogs ba lam ma yin pa dag tu log par mi 'gro zhing / rang gi gnas na gnas pa dang / / sgregs pa dag cing dri ma mnam pa med pa dang / bru ba tsha bar gyur cing bkres pas za 'dod par gyur pa dang / thur gyi rlung tha mal par rgyu ba ste/ thur du 'byung ba'i rlung lugs bzhin 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du pho ba'i me drod bdo zhing shas che ba dang / dbang po gsal zhing rang gi bya ba rnams la 'jug pa gsal ba dang / de bzhin du rang gi lus kyang rab tu yang bar gyur cing bya ba la thogs pa med par gyur pa ni/ zas kyi tshod ran pa'i cho gar sbyar ba ji skad bshad pa de bzhin du za ba de ni zas la spyod pa'i dus yin par slob dpon dag 'dod cing bzhed pa yin no/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/
/ / de nas sman la sogs pa rnams kyi bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad bar bya'o/ /

skt: athetyānantarye|ata dtiprastutābhisasbandhai prastu tānmātrāritīyādanantaraṃ dragyādidhijñānīyamadhyāra vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | pravyamādiyeṣāṃ te, ādibhrahaṇeraṃ rasavīyevipākānāṃ grahaṇam‌ | teṣāṃ dhijñānamavanodhaḥ tasme dahito'dhyāyaḥ taṃ vaṇeyatti vyākhyāsyāmaḥ yasmadetadaśnapānaṃ dranyarasavāyāvapākādābhaḥ parīṣya 1 atra ^“ kāsāraci-" iti khapustake | sthana | ( 241 ) prayojanaṃ nānyatheti | tatraṃ drabhya̭ rasādibhyaḥ pūvam‌ | prādhānyādame nirdeśaḥ
tib: de nas zhes bya ba ni sngar bshad pa'i rjes thogs la ste/ zas kyi tshod zin par bza' ba'i rjes la/ sman la sogs pa rnams kyi bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ / de la sman la sogs pa zhes smos pa la sogs pa'i sgras ni nus pa dang 'ju ba la sogs pa bsdu'o/ / de rnams bye brag shes bar bya ba ni/ mtshan nyid khong du chud par bya ste/ de shes par 'gyur ba la phan pa'i le'u bshad par bya'o zhes pa'o/ / de gang gi phyir zas dang skom 'di dag ni zas dang / ro dang / nus pa dang / 'ju ba la sogs pa yongs su brtags nas sbyar bar bya'i gzhan du ni ma yin no/ / de la sman nam rdzas ni ro la sogs pa las mchog tu gyur pa yin pas dang por bstan pa yin te/ sman rnams nyid kyi ro la sogs/ / de ni de la brten pas mchog / ces bya ba la/ sman rnam gnyis ro dang nus pa la sogs pa rnams kyi nang na mchog yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ ro la sogs pa de rnams ni sman de la brten cing gnas pa yin gyi/ ro la sogs pa 'ba' zhig tshig skyar gnas pa ni ma yin te/

sman de yang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba la sogs pa'i tshul du gnas pa gang yin pa de ni 'byung ba lnga'i bdag nyid can te/ 'byung ba chen po rnam pa lnga las shes par bya ste/ nam mkha' la sogs pa rgyu'i rdzas rnams ni ma yin te/ / nam mkha' la sogs pa rgyu'i rdzas kyi 'byung ba chen po lnga'i bdag nyid can du gyur pa ni so sor rang nyid thob pa'i don du gnas pas 'di ni nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i 'byung ba chen po'o/ / 'di ni sa'i 'byung ba chen po zhes smra bar nus pa ma yin gyi/ sa la sogs pa 'byung ba rnams ni 'byung ba chen po lnga'i bdag nyid can yin pas na/ de'i sgras bstan pa yin no/ / de bas na 'byung ba lnga'i bdag nyid can dang gcig pa ma yin no/ / de nye bar dmigs pa rnam pa lngas zhes bya ste/ de la de'i dri'i shas che ba gang yin pa de ni sa'i yin la/ ro'i shas che ba gang yin pa de ni chu'i yin no/ / gzugs kyi yon tan shas che ba de ni me'i yon tan no/ / reg pa'i yon tan shas che ba gang yin pa de ni rlung gi yin no/ / sgra'i yon tan shas che ba gang yin pa de ni nam mkha' yin te/ gang dang de ni rtag tu 'brel ba yin pa'i phyir/ gang zhes bya ba'i tshig 'di ma smos su zin kyang / bstan pa nyid yin par shes par bya'o/ / gal te sman de 'byung ba chen po lngas skyed pa yin na/ de 'byung ba chen po gang gis ji ltar byas nas bskyed pa yin/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ sa la brten te skye ba yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ sa brten pa'i gnas su byas nas skye ba yin no/ / de ltar nas zhes bya ba'i 'byung ba chen pos rten du byas pa'i dgos pa byas pas na/ des bskyed cing bskrun pa yin no zhes bshad do/ / de bzhin du de ni me'i skye gnas zhes bya ba chu'i skye gnas su gyur cing / skyed par byed pa'i rgyu byed pas na/ sman gyi skye gnas ni chu'i yin te/ de ltar chu zhes bya ba'i 'byung ba chen pos ro dang ldan par skye gnas kyi dgos ba byas pas des de skyed pa zhes bya'o/ /

sman de skyes shing byung bar gyur pa dang / rdzogs par 'thon pa de ni me dang rlung dang nam mkha' rnams kyi tshogs pa las skyes par gyur pa yin te/ tshogs pas rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul gyis skyed de/ des na dper na me ni smin par byed pa nyid kyis dgos pa byed la/ / rlung ni g.yo 'gul gyis so/ / nam mkha' ni go 'byed pa'i tshul gyis so/ / de skyes par gyur ba me dang rlung dang nam mkha' rnams kyi tshogs pa las de skyes par gyur pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi gang khyad par du gzhan rnams tshul tha dad cing / rang bzhin du ma gyur pa'i bar de rnams kyang me dang rlung dang nam mkha' de rnams kyi tshogs pa las byung ba yin no/ / gal te de ltar sman thams cad dang 'byung ba chen po lnga char gyis bskyed pa yin na/ 'di ni sa'i 'o/ / 'di ni chu'i'o zhes ming ci'i phyir 'dogs she na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ ming ni shas che las gyur yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ rdzas gang la 'di dag thams cad rgyur gyur pa yin yang / gang gang gi shas che zhing mang bar gyur pa des/ de nyid kyi ming du btags pa yin te/ sa'i shas che ba las skyes pa ni sa'i ming can yin la/ chu'i shas che ba las skyes pa ni chu'i'o/ / de ltar na sman thams cad ni 'byung ba chen po lnga'i bdag nyid can yin no/ /

gang phyir 'byung ba chen po'i tshogs pa rnams las sman rnams 'byung zhing skye ba yin pa de bas na/ sman rnams ni ro gcig kho nar mi 'gyur te/ ro mang zhing tha dad pa yin no/ / zhes bya ba'i don to/ / 'dir 'di ltar gang ro'i rgyu ni 'byung ba chen po gcig po chu nyid yin no/ / 'byung ba chen po gzhan dag ni ma yin te/ de dag ni ro med pa yin no/ / 'bras bu ni rgyu dang cha 'dra bar 'byung ba yin pas/ gzhan las ro 'byung bar mi rigs so zhes brgal zhing brtag par mi bya ste/ gang gi phyir 'byung ba 'dus pa las 'byung zhes bya ba 'di skad ston pa yin te/ ci ltar sman 'byung ba chen po 'dus pa las sman 'byung ba de bzhin du/ sman la brten pa'i ro tha dad par gyur pa dag kyang / / 'byung ba 'dus pa nyid las skye ba yin gyi/ yon tan gzhan ltar sman la ltos pa ni ma yin no/ / de bas na 'byung ba chen po 'dus pa nyid ro 'byung bar byed pa yin gyi/ 'byung ba chen po kha dog la sogs pa lta bur rdzas gcig pu la rag lus pa ni ma yin no/ / de ltar na ro ni 'byung ba chen po 'dus pa las 'byung gi / gcig las ma yin te/ sman la brten pa'i ro rnams kyi rgyu rnams 'byung ba chen po 'dus pa yin no/ / la la ni yang 'byung ba gnyis shas che ba las sman mngar ba la sogs pa'i ro gsal bar 'gyur te/ de yang ro tha dad pa shes par bya ba'i le'u las/ mngar ba la sogs ro skye ba/ / sa chu me sa chu dang me/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'byung ba yin no/ / de ltar na ro thams cad ni 'byung ba 'dus pa las 'byung la/ de la mang zhing shas che ba las ni 'di ni sman mngar ba'o/ / 'di ni skyur ba la sogs pa'i sman rnams so zhes bya bar gnas kyi/ mngar ba'i sman de la skyur ba la sogs pa'i zhad du gyur pa med pa ni ma yin no/ / myangs par gyur pa dang nus pa'i dbang gis rdzas rnams la phan tshun du ro du ma snang la/ chu ni ro mi gsal ba yin te/ ro drug car dang ldan yang mi gsal zhing mi mngon pa yin no/ / de ltar na 'byung ba 'dus pa las sman 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pa de bzhin du mngar ba la sogs pa ro rnams kyi yang rgyu yin pas/ ro thams cad ni 'byung ba 'dus pa las byung ba yin zhing ro gsal ba mang po bshad pa yin no/ /

skt: doṣā vātādayaḥ | te ca rasāśrayāḥ | rasāśca dranyāśrayāḥ paccabhūtātmakatvāt‌ | anekarasadravyeṇa tadupayogācca prakupyanti taiḥ prakupite rogā bhavanti | tasmānnaikadopā rogā iti tridoṣa iyathaḥ | atrāpi mūyasā vyapadeśa ityadhyāhāryam‌ | athaṃ vātajvaro pittañcara ityevairūpam‌ | atha kau'yaṃ raso'nuraso vetyāda~tatra smarasyaṃ bhautike-sathairasādhāraravye yo raso madhuyadirvyakto nirdhāsitirūpa upaṅabhyate sa śasaḥ smṛtaḥ| madhura evāyamamḍa evāyabhiti | auraso'ñyaktaḥ | yo bhubhyamānaścāmalakādijivāyāṃ sphuṭatvena na ṭhabhyate so'nurasaḥ | ante cārāne kicvinmanāk‌ rasa iti vyakto'paṇyate
tib: gang gi phyir sman ro sna tshogs pa yin pa'i phyir nyid kyis na nad ni gcig pu ma yin no zhes bstan te/ de la nad ni nad kyi tshogs rnams so/ / nyes pa ni rlung la sogs pa'o/ / de yang ro la brten la ro yang sman la brten te/ sman ni 'byung ba chen bo'i bdag nyid can yin pas ro sna tshogs pa nyid la de dang phrad pa las rlung la sogs pa skyed par 'gyur ba yin la/ de rnams bskyed pa las ni nad du 'gyur ba yin te/ de'i phyir nad kyang nyes pa gcig dang ldan pa ma yin te/ nyes pa gsum car ldan pa ma yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ / 'dir yang mang po nyid yin no zhes shugs kyis sbyar bar bya ste/ 'di ni rlung gi rims so/ / 'di ni mkhris pa'i rims so/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa lta bu'o/ / de la 'dir ro ni gang / ro rjes ni gang zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ de la gsal bar ro zhes bshad/ / mi gsal ro rjes mtha' mar ni/ / cung zad gsal ba dag tu'ang 'dod/ / ces bya ba la/ 'byung ba chen po lnga las gyur pa'i sman/ ro thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pa de la/ mngar ba la sogs ba'i ro gang gsal zhing nges pa nyid kyi tshul du shes par 'gyur ba de la ni ro zhes bya bar bshad de/ 'di ni mngar ba nyid do/ / 'di ni skyur ba nyid do zhes bya'o/ / ro'i rjes ni mi gsal ba la bya ste/ skyu ru ra la sogs pa gang za ba na/ lces gsal ba nyid du ma rtogs pa de ni ro rjes zhes bya'o/ / de ni tha mar zhabs su cung zad ces nyung shas cig ro dang bcas pa gsal ba dag tu'ang 'dod pa yin no/ / dris pa/ mngar ba la sogs pa'i ro la lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par smra bar mi rigs te/ gang gi phyir mngar ba la sogs pa'i ro rnams ni yon tan nyid yin la/ lci ba la sogs pa yang de bzhin du yon tan yin te/ des na lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams kyi gnas mngar ba la sogs pa'i yon tan bshad par ni mi rigs te/ gang gi phyir bye brag pa dag gis yon tan la ni yon tan med pa zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/

skt: nanu kathaṃ madhurādayo rasā gurulāghavādiu, ṇayuktā vaktu yujyate | tasmānmadhurādayo rasā guṇā eva guvādyastathaiva guṇāḥ | naca guṇādīnāṃ śuḥ dīnāṃ maghurādayo yuṇā ārabdhatvena vaktu yuktāḥ | yasmānniyuṇā guṇā iti vairoṣikā ata ucyate-rasāśraye dravye prathivyādau paramārthato gukaudayo guṇā aśritāḥ punamaṃghuyadiraseṣu yadupadidayante madhurādayo gubīdiguṇayuktā dvati | kasmāt‌ sāhacyopacārataḥ | ko'thaḥ | yasminneva dravye madhuro rasa aāśritastasminnapi dravye gurūsapi guṇa āśrita iti kāyādanurmīyate | anyathāprāyo madhurarasaguruguṇayoḥ sahacaritatvam‌ | sahacaratīti sahacarastasya bhāvaṃḥ sāhacartham‌ḥ| upacaraṇasupacāro'nyadhamaprāpaṇam‌. 1 sāhacartheṇopacāsāt‌ ! gurvādayo guṇā ` sseṣu madhurādiṣu vyapadidayante na punaḥ paramārthataḥ teṣu | sseṣu gubaudayo guṇā vidante
tib: ro'i gnas la sogs pa la yang dag par na sman gyi yon tan lci ba la sogs pa yang gang yin par ni 'bras bu las dpag par bya'o/ / des na sman gyi yon tan lci ba yin la/ lci ba de bstan pa'i ro yang yon tan lci ba yin par mtshungs shing thun mong du spyod pa yin te/ lhan cig spyod pas na mtshungs par spyod pa zhes bya'o/ / nye bar gdags pa ni cha 'dra bar spyod pa ste/ gzhan gyi chos dang mtshungs par bsgre'o/ / de ltar na mtshungs par spyod pa'i nye bar gdags pas cha 'dra bas lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan ni/ ro la sogs pa la yon tan yod par btags pa yin gyi/ yang dag par rol sogs pa'i yon tan yod pa ni ma yin no/ / de bas na ro gtso bor gyur pa las ming du sgros btags pa yin no/ /

de la zhes pa de rnams kyi nang nas sa'i rang bzhin can gyi sman ni lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang dri zhes bya ba'i yon tan gyi shas rab tu che ba yin te/ sa'i rang bzhin can gyi sman de'i lus ni/ lus la sogs par byed pa yin no/ / de la lci ba ni 'ju dka' zhing lci bar gyur pa nyid do/ / brtan pa ni lus brtas par byed pa'o/ / 'dus pa ni yan lag mkhregs shing sra ba'o/ / nye bar 'phel ba ni lus zungs rnams rgyas par byed pa'o/ / chu yi gsher dang lci bsil snum/ / rtul zhing bska la ro shas che/ / 'jam zhing bad kan 'dra ba la/ / 'drul zhing tshim byed sdud bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ chu'i rang bzhin can gyi sman ni gsher ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / ro'i yon tan gyi shas che ba yin no/ / de lus la sbyar na lus 'jam zhing snum par byed pa dang / rtsa sbubs gsher zhing bad kan 'dra ba 'dzag pa dang / zas 'drul zhing myags pa dang / sems tshim zhing ngoms par byed pa dang / tshigs dang rkang lag sdud cing 'byor bar byed pa yin no/ /

me'i rang bzhin can gyi sman ni rtsub pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan zhing / de ni gzugs kyi yon tan gyi shas che ba yin no/ / de zos shing spyad na lus tsha bar byed pa dang / mdangs 'bar bar 'gyur ba dang / lus kyi mdog skyed pa dang / gsal zhing snang ba dang ldan pa dang / zas smin cing 'ju bar byed pa'i yon tan can yin no/ /

tib: rlung gi rang bzhin gyi sman ni/ rtsub pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / reg pa'i yon tan gyi shas che ba yin la/ de lus la brten na rtsub pa dang / / yang ba dang / dri ma sel ba la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi las byed pa yin no/ /

skt: evamanena mahābhūtāracdhena gubādiguṇayogena dhāṇāṃ jagati saṃsāre'smin‌ nānaupadhasambhūtaṃ ścidaṣravyuprakhabhyate| kiṃ tāha sarvamevaupadhaṃ, vakṣāpādhayogayoḥ athaḥ prayojanaṃ nimittaṃ, yogau yuktitanā nānāvidhaṃ karataivamevaṃ cāvayogau tau nānāgau tayeoretayorabhayogayodhadāt‌ sāmyāt‌ , phiśidṛdravyamaupadhaṃ vyādhigratīkāsasāt‌ | yathodhayordūpaharaṇaṃ bhāvaṃ kartumathaiḥ prayojanaṃ saṃpād‌[mūṣvedoṣaharaṇe svabhamipavanokaṭaṃ, yad‌ dravyaṃ tattatra ṇa samartham‌ | vāyoḥpravahanatvāt‌ | ūrva jvachanaca} abhrarevamūdhvado paharaṇavaśāt‌ yadabhmipavano‡ drya tavraupadham‌ | atho dopaharaṇasamthamaupadhaṃ sampādayituṃ prathivyudakabhūyiṣṭhama| evaṃ nibhiśāt‌. ghutracit‌ kiñavidaradramyamaupadhaṃ na sava savatra ¡ yogavakayāt‌ kiścidṛrabhyaṃ kutracidaupadhaṃ caikayā yā yojitaṃ dravyaṃ savatra tabharaivaupadham‌ | kiṃ tāha 1 yuktyā yojitaṃ kasmin‌. vikāre dranyamauṣadhaṃ pica kasminaiva | yathā madanadravyamanena nanādiṣiropeṇānyavikāramapanudasyanyenānyamiti | na saravai | tasmāgayogavarāssara dravyamauṣadham‌ 14|| 30dravyamātrasyīpadhaghatyamāha--evama̱ktaprakareṇa tasya drabhyasya tatatadaruṇayogājjagati na kiṃcidudranyam‌ ;anauvidyate, sarvameva dravyamauparadhaṃ ṅataḥ nānārthayogavaścāt‌ | ; prayojane, yogau yojanā, nānāpedhāvarbhayogau tayoḥ etaduktaṃ mavāte | yadekarimantha nopayuyate, tadevānyāktmaḥ nnupayujyate | yadekena yogena nopayujyate, tathebānthenopayucyate | yathā avyatā'nupayuktā āpaśca || śavāsakāsādau | yathā adyatāpathyo mapara dadu rīkrataḥ nīto'ditādau | jauṣadaiṣidhyam‌.
tib: nam mkha'i bdag nyid can gyi sman ni phra ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / / sgra'i yon tan shas che ba yin no/ / de lus kyis bsten na khong stong ste/ nang stong par byed pa dang / yang bar byed pa yin no/ / dris pa/ rlung dang nam mkha'i ni gzugs med pa yin pas de'i bdag nyid can gyi rdzas yod par ga la 'gyur zhes pa la/ nyes pa 'di yod pa ma yin te/ / sman gang la rtsub pa dang / khong stong gi las byed pa mang du snang la/ der ni rlung dang nam mkha'i bdag nyid can du nye bar gdags pas ming du btags pa yin te/ dper na dad pa dang / tshul khrims dang / thos pa dang / gtong ba la sogs pa'i las byed pa mthong nas/ skyes bu dam pa dag la 'di ni lha yin no zhes nye bar 'dogs par byed pa dang 'dra'o/ /

skt: tatra teṣu dravyeṣu madhye uradhvaigamabhūvagaṃ dravya vamanakāri | prāyeṇa bāhusyenābhipavaneātkaṭamabhimārutotkaṭam‌ | tayorhi khāṣavamūrvagativvāccaḥmaraighumārutasya | dravyamadhogāmyadhobhāgaṃ virecanarūpaṃ yattaddhamiguṇādhikam‌ 1 mūmyudakaguṇotkaṭam‌ | tayorhi prathinyā gurutvānnimnagatācca tīyasyeti

sambhāti vī vtanīyamārabhyate--vīyaisya strāpratihatagatitvāt‌ yasmārakicviūravye. guṇajāte varvte tassa vīryasaṃjñasucyate | anye kecidācāryā vīryamaṣṭadhā vadanti kathayanti | gārvādiguṇebhyo yadnyattasmādevamanena pakāreṇa kaurbhamaṣṭadhā'ṣaṭamiḥparakarirvocāyamāṇam‌ | anyena prakāreṇānyasaṃkhyāvacchinnam‌

carakamuniḥ punaḥ vīyasāha--paṭatiśma thaiḥ kāraṇatāpannena kariyate niṣpādyate | dhasujāte sasya vīyaṃvastujāte kto tattasya vīyaivastujātasya vīrya mevaṃ matai carakamunirāha | vīryaṃ tu kriyate yeḥ kriyā tate vākyadiva | prabhāvo vīrya drabhyasya viṣā ko vīryam‌ | raso vātha tathā yena kecidaṇā dravyā śritā gubaudayastsavai tasya vīrthasaṃjñā | atataḥ bhrabha| vamughya vīthemāṅavdhavān‌ bīm‌ 1 18|| ` he0-carakamataṃ darśayati-yena giyate taṣaṭa, drya katukaṃ kamaṇi karaṇabhūtamitythaṃḥ | katividhaṃ tadityekṣa| sthānam‌ ] sarippaṇaryīkāṣreyasaṃvarite a0 9 | (249 ) “ yāmāha~yā kriyeti|yā kriyā-yena kriyate tasyāṃ tadvīraḥ yāvatyaḥ triyāstāveti vīryāṇītythaḥ | kuta ivayāha-tāvīyamati | avī dravyaiḥ na ricilkurute vīryaṃ vinā. katutvaṃ ` nāstītyathaḥ. | ' kuta ityāhi yasmātsā kriyā sarvāpi vīaikṛtā
tib: de ltar 'byung ba chen po las byung ba 'dis na/ sman lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas/ 'gro ba ste 'khor ba'i gnas 'di/ sman ma yin par gyur pa'i rdzas ci yang yod pa ma yin te/ gzhan du na thams cad nad sel bar byed pa'i dgos pa byed pas sman nyid yin no/ / de yang ji ltar gyen du nyes pa sel bar byed nus pa'i dgos pa de'i don byed par nus pa dag gis stod du nyes pa sel te/ me dang rlung gi shas che ba'i sman gang yin pa dag phal cher de byed par nus pa yin te/ rlung ni 'phar bar byed pa dang / me ni ring du 'bar bar byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ de bas na ro stod kyi nad bsal ba'i don gyi dbang gis me dang rlung shas che ba'i sman gang yin pa de rnams de'i sman yin no/ / 'og gi nyes pa sel bar nus pa'i sman ni don de sgrub par byed nus pa dang / chu shas che ba'i sman gang yin pa dag phal cher ni de'i nus pa dang ldan pa yin te/ sa ni lci ba nyid dang / dri dang ro ni chu'i rang bzhin yin te/ de ltar na 'og gi nad sel ba'i rgyu'i dbang gis sa dang chu'i shas che ba'i rdzas gang yin pa de/ de'i sman gyi me dang rlung gi ma yin la/ stod kyi nyes pa sel ba ni sa dang chu'i shas che ba dag ma yin no/ / de ltar na rgyu'i don gyi dbang gis rdzas la 'ga' zhig sman du 'gyur ba yin gyi/ thams cad thams cad du ni ma yin no/ / de bzhin du sbyar ba'i dbang gis kyang rdzas la la dag la lar sman du 'gyur ba yin gyi/ sbyor ba gcig gis nad thams cad la sman du 'gyur ba ma yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang sbyor ba'i dbang kha cig gis nad kha cig la sman du 'gyur ba yin te/ 'di ltar po son cha la sogs pa'i sman sbyor ba'i khyad par gzhan dag gis snga ma las lhag par 'gyur ba yin la/ gzhan dag gis kyang gzhan du 'gyur gyi gcig gis thams cad byed pa ni ma yin no/ / de bas na sbyor ba'i dbang gis kyang rdzas thams cad sman yin no/ / de la sman gyi gyen du 'gro/ / phal cher me dang rlung shas che/ / zhes bya ba de la/ sman gyi rigs de rnams kyi nang nas/ gyen du 'gro zhing steng du rgyu ba'i sman slon par byed pa ni phal cher zhes pa mang du me dang rlung gi shas che ba ste/ / me dang rlung gi bdag nyid can yin te/ de yang gang gi phyir gyen du 'gro bas me yin pa dang / yang bas rlung yin par shes par bya'o/ /

skt: prayācāyāṃṇāṃ sayameke ācāryāḥ aṣṭau guṇān‌ śubīdīn‌ vīraya badanti | teṣāṃ viraśiṣaṭadāktitā vīryamityiparetenaḥ vīyamātrāśrayeṇa; na keva gubodaya evāṣṭau guṇā, vīyaṃ ` yāvat‌ yarikibhciḥ daṇajātaṃ dravyābhitaṃ tatsava ` vīryamiti `rāmaḥ | tasmāya ca viśiṣṭaśakiyuktā aṣṭau gurvādayo gaṇāste vīyasaṃjñāmāsādayanti | tasmādevamaṣṭadhā - bai dravyasya tat‌ jñeyam‌ | yadyogāt‌ kariyate kriyā . | evai carakamunimatena yadudravye guṇajātādiḥ varate tassave tasya vītham‌ | bīryarahitaṃ yadrastujātaṃ tanna kiccikurute kāmapi syāṃ na sampādayati ¦ ` hiḥ śabdo yasmāda ` | yasmāt‌ sanī kriyā vīthaṣutā vīryeṇa kriyate | yadyevaṃ sāṃ kriyā chatā tat‌ kima. thamaṣṭāveva guṇā gurvādayo ṣīyamiti, nānye guṇāṃ rasādayo vīyen‌ | tairapi hitāḥ. kriyāḥ kriyante ata āha tenācaryeṇaḥ carakasuāninā guravādiṣyevā. ṭasaṃ atipraṅṣṭadāktiyukteṣu aśeṣopraguṇamūteṣu vī yokhyā saṃjñā vīthasaṃjñā anvathau bhannugatātha sambaddhā lokaprasiddhā ityeva vaṇyaite kathyate | samamrāṇāṃ guṇānāṃ sāyā uṭṛṣṭāḥ samabhraruṇasārāḥ teṣu, rākteratkaṣaḥ rāktyādhikyaṃ prṣṭaśattitā, viśeveṇa varnaṃ vivartaḥ, dākyukaraṣasya vivarṣaiḥ śaklu tkarṣavivartaiḥ, sa vidyate yeṣāṃ te rākatyukrṣanivatiṃnasteṣu, vyavahāro chaukikaḥ ' samācāraḥ rāsīyaśca tatna mukhyatvameṣām‌ | tathā choka eve vadan‌ dṛyate ! idaṃ gurū, idaṃ raghu, idamervayuṇam‌ | tathā śāśca paṭo; kaṣāyastasmācca madhuraḥ parama̭ṃgurarivyevaṃ guvodīnāṃ vyavahārāya muṃkhyasvam‌ | anyacca | rasādibhyo guṇebhyasteḥ bahavo bahva teṣāṃ vidhate, na rasādīnāṃ tāstathā doṣāṇāṃ kaphādīnāṃ guṇanirūpaṇaṃ yathāyatha guvādayo guṇāsteṣaṃ nirdiṣṭāḥ | “snigdhaḥ śīto guraḥ kaphaḥ?” iti madhuro na nidṭhaḥ| "pittaṃ saste ha tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ chaghuḥḥ iti niradiṣṭhaṃ nāmḍamiti
tib: sman thur du 'gro zhing 'og tu rgyu bas 'khru bar byed pa'i ngang tshul can gang yin pa de ni/ sa dang chu'i shas che ba yin te/ de gnyis ni sa lci ba dang / chu gzhol phyogs su 'gro ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /

de ltar zhes bya ba'i sgra ni yongs su rdzogs pa la bya ste/ sman gyi phyir smra bar bya ba gang dag yod pa de thams cad rdzogs so zhes bya ba'i don to/ / cha 'dres pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sman dang / steng dang 'og gi nyes pa cha mnyam par sel ba'i sman ni/ sngar so sor bstan pa'i don gyi shugs kyis shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gzhung par 'gyur ba'i dogs pas/ / rgyud gzhan dag ltar 'dir ma bstan pa yin no/ / de ltar sman bstan nas de la brten pa'i ro mngar ba la sogs pa gang yin pa de dag re zhig bstan par bya ste/ de ni/ ro'i bye brag / 'di yi 'og nas ston pa yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ ro'i bye brag drug cu rtsa gsum gyi grangs su nges par chad par 'di'i 'og nas zhes pa/ ro tha dad pa zhes bya ba'i le'u las gzhung rtsom par byed pas ston cing 'chad par 'gyur te/ 'dir ni bshad par bya ba mang du yod pas ma smras pa yin no/ / da ni sman gyi nus pa bshad pa rtsom par byed de/ de ni/ sman mthu la las bshad pa ni/ / lci snum bsil dang 'jam pa dang / / yang rtsub tsha dang rno ba ste/ / de ltar rnam pa brgyad du 'dod/ / ces bya ba la/ sman gyi mthu ni thams cad du thogs pa dang / gtugs pa med par 'gro ba yin pas sman gang la yon tan gyi rigs gang cung zad yod pa de thams cad la mthu'am nus pa zhes bya'o/ / de la slob dpon gzhan dag gis bshad pa ni/ sman gyi mthu ni lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi dbye ba rnam pa brgyad du 'chad de/ de ltar rnam pa 'dis ni grangs kyi rnam pa brgyad yin par slob dpon dag 'dod cing 'chad kyi/ rnam pa gzhan gyis ni rnam grangs kyi nges pa gzhan du 'dod do/ / sman mthu tsa ra kas bshad pa/ / gang gis bya ba gang byed pa/ / mthu min ci yang mi byed kyi/ / de dag thams cad mthu yis byed/ / ces bya ba la/ drang srong tsa ra kas sman gyi mthu'am/ nus pa bshad cing bstan pa ni/ / dngos po gang gis byed pa/ gang la zhugs shing bya ba/ gang zhig byed cing rdzogs par gyur pa'i dngos po'i rang bzhin te/ de'i mthu yin no zhes mtho btsun drang srong tsa ra kas bshad do/ / mthu gang gis byas pa gang byed pa zhes bya ba'i tshig gis na/ nus pa ni mthu yin zhing ro yang mthu yin la/ de bzhin du sman la brten pa'i yon tan lci ba la sogs pa gang ci yang rung ba de thams cad ni/ sman de'i mthu zhes bya ste/ nus pa nyid las ma 'das pa mthu byung ba yin no/ / spyir ni sman de'i mthu la slob dpon rnams tha dad par 'dod de/ slob dpon la las ni lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan brgyad la mthu yin par 'dod de/ de rnams ni khyad par can nyid la mthur 'dod kyi/ nus pa phra mo tsam la ni mi 'dod do/ / gal te nus pa phra mo tsam la mthur 'dod na ni/ lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan brgyad po'i cha phra mo'i dngos po thams cad la yod par 'gyur bas mi rigs pa yin no/ / de'i khyad par can gyi nus pa dang ldan pa'i lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan brgyad la mthu zhes bya ba'i ming mthong ba yin no/ / des na yon tan ni brgyad po de dag yin no/ / de yang gang gi sbyor ba byed pas byed/ rdzas de'i nus pa yin zhes bya ba yin no/ / de ltar na drang srong tsa ra kas 'dod kyi sman gang la yon tan gyi rigs gang dag yod pa de thams cad sman de'i mthu dang bral zhing / mthu ma yin pas na dngos po'i rigs des bya ba ci yang mi byed de/ bya ba gang zhig kyang rdzogs par mi nus so/ / des na bya ba de dag thams cad mthus byed cing nus pa rdzogs par byed pa yin no/ / gal te de ltar bya ba thams cad mthu yin na/ ci'i phyir lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan brgyad po nyid la mthu zhes bya/ ro la sogs pa'i yon tan dag la mthu zhes ci'i phyir mi bya/ / de dag gis kyang bya ba de ni byed pa nyid yin no zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ des na lci la sogs pa nyid/ / nus pa'i khyad par ldan pa dang / / yon tan ma lus snying por ni/ / gyur pas mthu zhes bshad pa dag / don dang mthun par btags pa yin/ / zhes bya ba la/ / des na slob dpon drang srong tsa ra kas lci ba la sogs pa brgyad po nyid ni nus pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa yin zhing / yon tan ma lus pa'i snying por gyur pa yin pas/ mthu zhes bshad cing nus pa zhes ming du btags pa de ni gzhung dang don mthun zhing ldan par ming du btags pa yin no/ / de la nus pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa ni yon tan lhag pa nyid de phul du tib: gang 'di 'gro ba na sman rnams ni ngo bo nyid gcig kyang sna tshogs pa'i bdag nyid du snang la/ de yang nyi ma dang / zla ba nyid ni stobs che ba yin pas na/ de'i rang bzhin las 'da' bar mi byed do/ / de'i bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de la re zhig rdzas 'di dag sna tshogs dag kyang nyi ma dang zla ba'i rang bzhin las 'da' bar mi byed ce na/ de'i dpe bstan pa'i phyir 'og ma 'di smos ba yin te/ ci ltar 'gro ba 'di dag ni gsal ba dang mi gsal bar snang ba'i chos las nam yang 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i tshul gyis sna tshogs pa'i bdag nyid can du gnas ba dag kyang / zla ba dang nyi ma'i rang bzhin las 'da' bar mi byed de/ de ltar na sman la la ni nyi ma'i rang bzhin can yin la/ sman la la ni zla ba'i rang bzhin can yin no/ / de bas na la la ni tsha ba'i mthu yin la/ la la ni grang ba'i mthu can yin no/ / de la tsha ba mgo 'khor skom/ / rmya rngul tsha zhing myur 'ju byed/ / rlung dang bad kan zhi bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ de la zhes bya ba ni tsha ba dang bsil ba'i mthu gnyis kyi nang na/ sman tsha ba'i mthu can ni mgo 'khor ba la sogs pa byed do/ / myur 'ju byed ces bya ba ni zas myur ba nyid du 'ju bar byed do/ / rlung dang bad kan gnyis zhi bar byed pa ni/ rlung nad dang bad kan gyi nad sel bar byed pa'o/ / bsil ba dag ni tshim byed cing / / 'tsho dang rengs par byed pa dang / / khrag dang mkhris pa rab dang byed/ / ces bya ba la/ sman bsil zhing stobs grang ba dang ldan pa ni tshim par byed pa la sogs pa dang / khrag dang mkhris pa rab tu dang bar byed do/ / de la tshim pa ni bde ba skyed par byed pa'o/ / 'tsho ba ni gzi mdangs 'phel bar byed pa'o/ / rengs par byed pa ni lus shing bzhin rengs par byed pa'o/ / khrag dang mkhris pa rab tu dang ba ni de dag gsal zhing rnyog pa med par byed pa'o/ / da ni pho ba'i zhes bya ba la sogs pa tshigs su bcad pa'i rdzas 'ju ba smras pa yin te/
