skt: asau vidhākākhyo raso rasai ssanātraijahādiṣikemedhuyamchakaṭukachabhaṇaistusyapharustasyeti | {namāsvāyamānasva madhurasya rasasya dahāhādanādi matkāyaṃ phalopame tattasya madhureṇa rasena tusyameva | padhurāmlakaṭukānāṃ guṇāste vijñeyāḥ | ye madhaghurāchakaṭukānāṃ rasānāṃ sasamedīye'bhyāye procyante kicihuṇāntaryeṇa kurute | tacca sadparahaiḥ suvistaraṃ kusā vyākhyātam‌ | yathā madirā-maghuraṃ śepmāṇaṃ rāmayati tathā taiṃ kaṭupākatayaiva baddhaviṇmatram‌ | amchakāśjikai kapau janayati rūkṣopṇasvāt‌ | kapitthaṃ tu raukṣyāt‌ kapa jayatati, pittaṃ ca rītavīryasvāt‌ | āmalkaṃ-rītavīthetvāt‌ svādupākatayā pintaṃ jayati kapa rīkṣyāhyāghavācaca | kivyayaikaṣyalāghavaistu na vātam‌| chavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ svādupākatayā pintaṃ jayati khāghavāt‌) kaphaṃ kaṭukāt‌ | uṇṭī sneheṣṇā sāvupāṃkava cātaṃ payati | pippalī ca rno sanehīpṇyagīrapaiḥ, paṭhāṇḍśca stehagaurābhyāṃ jayati śeṣmāṇap‌ | kaṣāyatiktaṃ matcvamūṃ vātaṃ jayati,na tu pittuṣṇavīthaitvāt‌ | kaṣāyasya kuhṛthopṇapākatayocismena taniradeśadarīnamātramuktam‌
tib: mngar ba ni ro zhim pa'o/ / lan tshwa ni tshwa rnams te/ de gnyis ni zhu ba'i rjes mngar ba'o/ / ro skyur ba zos pa'i rjes kyang skyur ba nyid yin no/ / ro kha ba dang tsha ba dang bska ba rnams ni phal cher kha bar 'ju ba yin no/ / de la phal cher zhes smos pa ni/ kha cig tu 'dir smos pa dang mi mthun pa yod de/ 'bru la gnas pa'i ro mngar ba ni zhu ba'i rjes skyur bar 'gyur la/ des ni 'bru ni ro mngar yang zhu rjes skyur ba yin pas/ mkhris pa skyed cing lci ba yin no/ / de bzhin du a ru ra dang / bca' sga dang / / sge'u gsher dang / pi pi ling la sogs pa la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ / de yang bsdus ba las/ 'bru ni mngar dang skyur ba nyid/ / de bzhin se'u skyur yang mngar/ / til mar kha bar gyur pa dang / / pi pi ling yang bska bar 'gyur/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de ltar na 'bru ni mngar du zin kyang zhu ba'i rjes skyur bar 'gyur ba dang / se'u skyur yang mngar bar 'ju ba dang / til mar skyur du zin kyang kha bar 'ju ba dang / pi pi ling tsha yang zhu rjes bska bar 'gyur ba yin no/ / des na 'di ltar mi mthun pa dag kyang yod pas phal cher zhes smos pa yin no/ /

ro zhes pa lce'i yul du gyur ba mngar ba dang / skyur ba la sogs pa dang / zhu ba'i rjes 'di ni 'bras bu yin pas mnyam zhing mtshungs pa yin te/ 'di ni mngar ba'i ro myangs pa na lus tshim par byed pa la sogs pa gang byed pa de ni me tog lta bu yin te/ ro mngar ba de zhu ba dang / de mtshungs pa yin la/ gang gzhan ro zhim pa la sogs pa'i bya ba byed pa de ni/ ro mngar ba de'i 'bras bu yin pas thams cad du mthun pa yin no/ / ro mngar ba'i las ni 'ju ba rtul ba dang / lus zungs rgyas pa la sogs pa'i las byed pa yin no/ /

de la zhes bya ba ni nges par gzung ba ste/ sman dang / ro dang / nus pa dang / mthu stobs kyi nang nas/ sman bzang dang ngan zhes bya ba ni yod pa dang med pa'i las sman la ni ro yis byed pa dang / bska ba dang bcas pas bad kan zhi bar byed cing / nus ba bsil bar byed pas rlung skyed par byed do/ / rlan can gyi sha'i chu ni nus pa dro ba yin pas mkhris pa skyed par byed do/ / de bzhin du til mar ni zhu rjes kha ba nyid kyis bshang gci skyed la/ rang skyur yang rtsub cing dro ba yin pa dang bil ba'i rkang ni rtsub pas mkhris pa skyed pa dang / skyu ru ra ni nus pa bsil ba dang / zhu rjes mngar bas bad kan skyed pa dang / yang zhing rtsub kyang rlung mi skyed pa dang / lan tshwa lce myang tsha ni zhu rjes mngar bas mkhris pa sel zhing yang bad kan la phan pa dang / pu shel tse dang / bca' ska ni snum ba dang / dro ba dang / zhu rjes mngar bas rlung sel ba dang / pi pi ling yang de dang 'dra bas/ rlung sel ba dang / sgog skya dang kun dong dag ni snum pa dang / tsha ba dang / lci bas rlung sel bar byed la/ de dag ni snum pa dang / lci bas bad kan skyed par byed pa yin no/ / la phug sgong po yang zhu rjes mngar bas bad kan skyed do/ / bri ha ti dang / kaN+Da ka ri dang / byi sha la ni nus pa tsha bas mkhris pa skyed par byed pa dang / sha ni nus pa dro bas rlung sel zhing mkhris pa skyed pa dang / ku lang+tha ni ro bska yang zhu rjes bsil bas rlung sel zhing mkhris pa skyed pa yin no/ / de ltar na de dag ni phyogs gcig tsam gyi dper bstan pa yin no/ /

tib: sman gyi ris su gtogs pa'i ro dang / nus pa dang / 'ju ba dang mthu gang dang gang yin pa de dag gi nang nas/ stobs dang ldan pa nyid kyis sman la gnas par byed pa de ni/ sman gyi rigs de shin tu zil gyis mnan cing stobs chung ba gzhan dag pham par byas nas/ gnas pa de dang de ni bya ba gang sgrub par byed pa de dag ni/ rgyu nyid du gnas par 'gyur zhing / bsgrub par bya ba nyid sgrub par byed pa yin no/ / de yang ros ni 'di byas so/ / nus pas ni 'di byas so/ / stobs kyis ni 'di byas so/ / zhes bya ba lta bu'o/ / don 'di nyid kyis dper brjod pa/ bsdus pa las spros te bshad pa 'dir bstan pa yin la/ / gang 'di ltar ro la sogs pa'i rigs su gtogs pas ro gzhan dag la stobs dang ldan par gnas shing / / de dang de nyid du zil gyis mnan nas sgrub pa'i rgyu nyid du byed kyi/ rang dang gzhan gyi stobs la gnas pa dang / stobs dang ldan pa dang / stobs chung ba dang / gnyi ga'i tshul gyis rang rang gi las byed pa yin pas na/ de'i phyir 'di bstan par bya ba smras pa ni/ yon tan mi 'phrod sbyar ba ni/ / mang pos nyung ngu zil gyis gnon/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ gang gi phyir yon tan mi 'phrod pa dag sbyar zhing bsres pa ni/ mang po stobs dang ldan pas/ stobs chung ngu zil gyis gnon cing rgyal bar byed do/ / yon tan mi 'phrod ces bya ba 'dir ni/ rdzas mi 'phrod pa'i sbyor ba la bya'o/ / yon tan mi 'phrod pa nyid du ni smra bar rigs pa ma yin no/ / de yang drang srong tsa ra kas bshad pa/ sbyor ba ni rdzas gnyis sam rdzas mang po sbyar ba yin la/ de yang mi 'phrod pa ni gnyis te/ rang bzhin mi 'phrod pa dang / 'bras bu mi 'phrod pa'o/ / rang bzhin mi 'phrod pa ni/ dper na sman yang ba dang / lci ba sbyar ba dang / chab dang bsil ba sbyar ba la sogs pa'o/ / 'bras bu mi 'phrod pa ni/ dper na rlung gi nad bsal ba'i phyir/ / sman rtsub pa dang / ro lhan cig sbyar ba dang / de bzhin du bsil ba dang / / dro ba dang lhan cig sbyar ba la sogs pa'o/ / de ltar na rang bzhin gyis yon tan mi 'phrod pa'i sman gyi sbyor ba dang / de bzhin du 'bras bu mi 'phrod pa'i sman gyi sbyor ba phan tshun rigs mi mthun pa'i sbyor ba de ni/ gang zas kyi rigs nyung ngu rdzas kyi rigs mang pos zil gyis mnan nas/ de nyid du rgyu nyid du sgrub par byed par gnas par mthong ngo / / de yang dper na sbrang rtsi ni mngar du zin kyang bad kan zhi bar byed do/ / ro mngar ba ni bad kan skyed par byed pa yin yang / sbrang rtsi bad kan zhi bar byed pa ni mi mthun pa mi 'phrod pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar na rigs mthun pa'i mtshan nyid sbyor ba las kyang gang zhig gang gis zil gyis mnan nas/ rang rgyud du grub pa yin par som nyir gyur pa de dgag par bya ba'i phyir 'dir smras pa ni/ ro dang 'ju ba'i mthu dag ni/ / de yi stobs kyis zil gyis gnon/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ ro dang nus pa dang 'ju ba dang / stobs rnams ni ci ltar lhan cig sbyar zhing nus pa mnyam pa yin du zin kyang rang bzhin gyis 'ju bas ni ro zil gyis mnan te de'i nus pa med par byas nas/ rang gi bya ba bstan pa'i sgo nas/ de'i nus pa zil gyis mnan nas/ rang gi nus pa gsal bar ston to/ / de bzhin du ro dang 'ju ba de gnyis kyang mthus zil gyis gnon la/

ro dang 'ju ba dang mthu dang stobs rnams ni/ de ltar zhes pa rnam pa 'dis stobs mnyam zhing mtshungs pa yin la/ de'i stobs ni ro la sogs pa la dmigs nas ma bcos pa gang yin pa de ni stobs dang ldan par bshad de/ rdzas gang gi ro mngar ba de ji skad bshad pa bzhin du 'ju ba mngar ba dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin du nus pa bsil ba dang ldan pa ni stobs che ba yin la/ de bzhin du ro skyur ba ji skad bshad pa'i zhu rjes skyur ba dang ldan zhing / de bzhin du tsha ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin du ro tsha ba dang ji skad bshad pa'i 'ju ba'i tsha ba dang ldan zhing dro ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin du 'o ma dang chang dang / / na le sham la sogs pa las 'o ma ni ro mngar la 'ju ba dang nus pa bsil ba dang / chang ni skyur la 'ju ba dang nus pa dro ba dang / na le sham ni ro tsha la 'ju ba dang nus pa dro ba skyed pa dang / sman de dag ni ro dang 'ju ba dang nus pa dang stobs mnyam pas ma bcos pa'i stobs dang ldan pa zhes bya ba yin par shes par bya'o/ / kho bo cag gis ro dang 'ju ba dang nus pa'i rang bzhin ci lta bu yin pa des ni las la rjes su dpag pas shes pas ni/ mthu zhes bya ba ni rang bzhin shes par dka' bas de mi shes pas the tshom du gyur na mthu ni gang zhig yin/ gang las ni rjes su dpag par bya zhe na/ 'dir smras pa ni/ ro sogs mnyam pa'i las gang ni/ / khyad 'phags de ni mthu las skyes/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ ro la sogs pa mnyam zhing mtshungs pa nyid kyis las gang khyad par du 'phags pa sman gang la snang ba de ni mthu las skyes pa yin par shes par bya'o/ / rjes su dpag pa des na mthu zhes bya ba shes par bya ste/ 'di ni rdzas kyi mthu yin no/ / de yang sman gnyis ro mtshungs pa dang nus pa mnyam du zin kyang de la sman gcig las gzhan byed la cig shos kyang las gzhan byed pa nyid yin te/ des ni stobs kyis stobs yod pa nyid du shes par bya'o/ / de ltar na sman re re'i 'jug pa dang ldog pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi chos rang gi rang bzhin dngos po rkyen tshogs pa las byung ba nges par byed pa'i mtshan nyid can de ni mthu zhes bya ste/ dngos po gzhan gyi mthu ni ma yin no/ / dan ti dang ni tsi tra ka / ro sogs mtshungs kyang dan ti 'khru/ / shing mngar rgun 'brum 'dra yang 'khru/ / 'o ma mar 'dra mar drod skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ de ltar na sman dan ti dang / tsi tra ka ni ro dang nus pa'i zhu rjes mtshungs te/ tsi tra ka la ro dang nus pa dang 'ju ba'i rjes gang dag yod pa de dag dan ti la yod du zin kyang / dan ti ni dan ti rang nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyis 'khru bar byed pa yin gyi/ tsi tra ka ni ma yin te/ de lta bu'i khyad par gyi chos la mthu zhes bya'o/ / de bzhin du mngar ba dang / rgun 'brum ro mngar ba la sogs par mthun du zin kyang rgun 'brum 'khru bar byed kyi shing mngar ni ma yin no/ / de bzhin du 'o ma dang / mar la sogs pa mtshungs su zin kyang 'o ma ni 'o mar gyur pas drod mi skyed kyi/ mar gyis drod skyed do/ / de bzhin du thams cad kyang mthu las gyur pa yin no zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ / 'di ltar re zhig dngos po thams cad la yang spyi dang khyad par gyis khyab pa yin pas/ de'i phyir bstan bcos byed pas smas pa ni/ de ltar sman la sogs pa yi/ / spyi yi las te de yang ni/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ de ltar zhes bya ba'i sgra ni yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshig gam rnam pa'i don no/ / de yang sman la sogs pa'i ro dang 'ju ba dang nus pa dang mthu spyi'i las rdzogs pa yin gyi khyad par ni ma yin te/ de rtsom bar byed pa'i 'byung ba chen po spyi'i las byung ba na spyi'i rkyen spyi'i rgyu las byung ba zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ / yang na rnam pa'i don te/ rnam pa 'dis sman la sogs pa spyi'i las nyid bshad kyi khyad par gyi ni ma yin te/ 'byung ba chen po dag gi sman la brten pa'i ro dang mthu la sogs pa ji ltar bskyed pa spyi'i rgyu bstan pa de bzhin du de'i las kyang spyi tsam du bstan to/ / zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de la sman la sogs pa'i spyi'i las bshad nas khyad par gyi dbye bas sman de rnams re re zhing las gzhan dang gzhan byed pa'i tshul smras pa ni/

spyir bshad pa'i sman gyi ro dang 'ju ba dang nus pa la sogs pa'i las de yang tha dad par 'gyur ba yin zhing / / bye brag tu 'gyur ba yin no/ / gang gis tha dad par 'gyur zhe na/ sna tshogs pa'i rkyen gyi dbye ba tha dad par 'gyur ba yin te/ sna tshogs pa'i rkyen ni rnam pa tha dad pa'i tshul du gnas pa'i 'byung ba chen po rnams la bya la/ de yang sems can tha dad pa rnams kyis sngon dge ba dang mi dge ba byas pa'i las las byung ba'i 'byung ba chen po de rnams sna tshogs shing tha dad pa de lta bur yongs su 'gyur ba'i rkyen sna tshogs pa rnams kyis bskyed pa'i sman de rnams kyi dbye ba ni khyad par te/ khyad par gyi dbye ba des spyir bshad pa'i sman rnams las kyi dbye ba tha dad par 'gyur zhing du ma nyid du gnas pa yin la/ ro la sogs ba yang la brten pa yin pas de rnams kyi las kyang sman gyi dbye bas tha dad par 'gyur ba yin no/ / de ltar sman rnam pa gnyis po las/ la la ni rtsom par byed pa'i rkyen gyis mtshungs par skyed pa yin la/ la la ni nus pa skyed pa'i rkyen gyis mtshungs par skyed pa yin pas rkyen sna tshogs nyid du gnas pa yin te/ de dag gi phyogs gcig gi dpe bstan par bya ba'i phyir smras pa ni/ gro dang nas ni mngar ba dang / / lci las rlung 'joms skyed pa yin/ / nya dro 'o ma bsil ba dang / / seng ge kha yi phag ma

skt: dadaṃ nidarīnāthemāha-yasya dravyasya prabhā dyodvyaṃyo resavīyavipākānāṃ sāmye tataikaṃ draḥ manyat‌ kama karoti | taspunaranyadaiva | tenaṃ bhara | vasya prabhāṣataḥ | tena prabhāvatvaṃ jāyaṃte | evaṃ prā vastu yaḥ pravṛttinivṛttirudhcaṇo dharbhaṃ ātmarūpa bhāvaṃ pratyasādhyāsaṃmbhavaśūpa evātyabhigvārī prabhāvaḥ na padārthentaro bhāvaḥ ṣaṭpadāḥ tirataḥ
tib: gro dang nas dag ni ro mngar ba dang yon tan lci ba dang ldan pa yin du zin kyang / gro ni rlung 'joms par byed la/ nas ni rlung skyed par byed pa ni rkyen sna tshogs las byung ba nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du rkyen sna tshogs pa las byung bas/ nya ni ro mngar du zin kyang nus pa dro ba yin gyi grang ba ma yin la/ 'o ma ni mngar du zin kyang zhu rjes nus pa bsil ba yin gyi dro ba ma yin no/ / de bzhin du rkyen sna tshogs pa las byung ba'i phyir/ seng ge'i sha ni mngar du zin kyang zhu rjes la sogs pa kha ba yin la/ phag gi sha ni mngar ba yin pa las/ / zhu rjes la sogs pa yang mngar ba nyid yin no/ / de ltar na thams cad kyang rkyen sna tshogs las byung ba'i phyir/ ro dang / zhu rjes dang / nus pa tha dad yin par dpes rim pa bzhin du bstan pa yin no/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/

skt: daranyādivijñānīyādanantaraṃ rasamedīyādhyāya , ārabdhaḥ dravyāścitatvādrasādīnām‌ | tathā cāgamaḥ8 dravyameva rasādīnāṃ śaṣṭhaṃte hi tadāśrayāḥ 1. iti dravyaṃ vinā rasānāsupaṅambhābhāvaḥ | ataḥ pūrvai dravyasuktam‌, tadanu rasādīnāṃ nāmapeyādupadeśalaḥ katu- , mārabhyate | rasānāṃ bhado . rasabhedaḥ tasma hito rasa- , bhedīyaḥ ssabhedīyandhāsāvadhyāyastaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | , rasaḥ khalvādyaḥ prāk‌ vyaktaśca, ṣadrasatvātālasyaṃ tu madābhūtaguṇānāṃ tu nāpirekavireṣāt‌|saṃsṛṣṭo vipa , vidagdhaḥ ṣoḍhā prathag‌ vipariṇatimadhurādimedena | tade- , tadāpyamrahaṇaṃ kaina. jñāpayasyudakavikāraṃ eva rasaḥ ; prathivyādyastu tatsahakāriṇaḥ
tib: sman la sogs pa rnams kyi bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad pa'i 'og tu/ ro tha dad pa shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ ro rnams ni sman la brten pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de yang / sman rnams nyid kyi ro la sogs/ / de ni de la brten pas mchog / ces sngar bshad pa'i phyir te/ sman med par ro la sogs pa nye bar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ / de bas na dang por sman bshad nas de'i 'og tu brten pa po'i ro'i bye brag shes pa bstan pa brtsams pa yin no/ / de la ro rnams kyi tha dad pa ni ro'i khyad par te de shes par bya ba la phan pa'i le'u gang yin pa de bshad par bya zhing bstan par bya'o zhes pa'o/ / de la ro ni re zhig chu'i rang bzhin dang / dang po mi gsal ba yin pa la/ de ni dus rnam pa drug dang ldan pa yin pa'i phyir dang / 'byung ba chen po'i yon tan shas che chung gi dbang gis byung ba dang mi mnyam zhing / tshig pa las mngar ba la sogs pa'i dbye ba rnam pa drug tu 'gyur ro/ / de ltar chu smos pas ni/ / ro dag chu'i rnam par 'gyur ba yin par shes pas la sogs pa ni/ lhan cig byed pa'i tshul gyis dgos pa byed pa yin te/ de bas na tshogs pa ni yang dag par na ro'i byed pa po yin no/ / des na 'byung ba chen po shas che ba'i khyad par las ro 'byung ba'i tshul smras pa ni/

skt: rasasyopādānaṃ nidaśeyannāha-- madhurādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ rasānāyudbhabo janmaniṣraittibhevati | bhūtadṭaya musṇaṃ yeṣu bhūteṣu tāni mūtadmayolbaraṇāni teḥ kameṇa yathāsaṃryamilthaiḥ | katamatpunebhetadvayaṃ katamasmin‌ śse ārambhakaṃ bhavatīti. yathāsaṃkhyaṃ dadoyannāha~māmbha iti | bhūtadayokhbaṇaibhūtairmadhurasya rasasyoddhava dati | abhmakṣmā dati| abhibhumyutkaṭeramḍasya | amdhuteja iti | jaṭhatejo'dhikaiṃbaṇasya | khavāgviti | vāyvākārosvaṇaistiktasya | aganyanireti | vāyutejo'dhikaiḥ kaṭukasya go'nireti | bhūmivātocka kaṣāyasya | urbaṇagrahaṇālsarveṣāṃ savetra rasahaituḥvaṃ sūcayati | samudāyasya janakalvāt‌ khaṇḍaśaḥ nivṛttiriti | kintu yadyatra tatra viśiṣṭarasānaḥ rabhyate } patena vacosvaṇasvena vidhānānmadhugo saijanito'pi bhṛbhitoyokara isyucyate | repeṣvapi yojyam‌
tib: ro mngar ba dang skyur ba la sogs pa drug po rnams ni skye zhing 'byung ba ni 'byung ba gnyis gnyis shas che zhing lhag pa las ji lta ba bzhin du bstan pa dang bshad pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ste/ 'byung ba gnyis gnyis gang la shas che bar gyur pa de las 'byung ba'o/ / de las 'byung ba chen po gang dag ro gang zhig rtsom pa las lhag par gyur pa yin zhe na/ de dag grangs ji lta ba bzhin du smras pa ni/ sa chu zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ sa chu zhes pa sa dang chu'i 'byung ba shas che ba las ni/ ro mngar ba 'byung la me sa zhes bya ba me dang sa'i shas che ba las ni skyur ba 'byung ngo / / chu dang me zhes bya ba 'byung ba/ chu dang me'i shas che ba las ni lan tshwa'i ro 'byung ngo / / mkha' rlung zhes bya ba nam mkha' dang rlung shas che ba las ni ro kha ba 'byung ngo / / me rlung zhes bya ba me dang rlung shas che ba las ni ro tsha ba 'byung ngo / / sa rlung zhes bya ba 'byung ba sa dang rlung gi shas che ba las ni ro bska ba 'byung ngo / / de lta na gnyis gnyis las 'byung ba yin no/ / shas che zhes smos pas na ro thams cad kyang 'byung ba las gyur pa yin par ston to/ / des na tshogs pa las byung ba yin yang shas che ba'i shas rdzogs par byas pa yin te/ gang du gang zhig shas che ba ste der ro'i khyad par gzhan bskyed pa yin no/ / de ltar na shas che ba'i dbang gis na ro mngar ba ni 'byung ba thams cad kyis bskyed du zin kyang / sa dang chu las byung ba yin zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de bzhin du lhag ma rnams la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ / da ni mngar ba la sogs pa 'byung ba rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang las bstan pa'i phyir smras pa ni/ de las ro ni mngar ba dag / gang zhig

skt: idānīṃ svāhādīnāmupatti pratipādya kabha ca cidirānnāha-teṣāṃ paṇṇāṃ ssānāṃ madhye madhuraṃ rase vidyān‌ | ya āsādyamānau jihāḥ nīyamāno vakrasupakdhimpati | bhasyopadaihar‌ yati 1; śarīrasyāhādanaḥ sukhāvahaḥ | bhakṣā ndriyāṇāṃ prasādanaḥ 1 pipīlikādīnāṃ bhriyaḥ chikāpadpadādīnāmiṣaenamaḥ | > || he4~-atha ramalakṣaṇamū | nna madura upāṭapatiṃ picṭhinṭaguṇādisāhacayān‌ |; dadya priyatamalvāssavadayāyā rāya) yakṣaprasādranapiyamarapata ārdibdātyaṭarapadayādayaḥ
tib: ro drug po de dag gi nang nas ro mngar ba dag tu shes par bya ba ni gang zhig myangs shing lce dang phrad par gyur pa na/ kha la chags shing 'byar bag can du gyur pa dang / de bzhin du lus kyang tshim zhing bde bar byed pa dang / dbang po rnams rab tu dang zhing dga' bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du grog ma la sogs srog chags phra mo rnams kyang dga' zhing sred par byed pa yin no/ / skyur ba kha nas chu 'dzag cing / / so brtse spu ni ldang ba dang / / mig dang smin ma 'dzum par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ ro skur ba ni myangs pa'i tshe kha nas chu 'dzag cing / gsher ba 'du ba dang / de bzhin du so brtse ba dang / spu ldang bar byed pa dang / mig gnyis dang smin ma gnyis 'dzum zhing sdud par byed pa yin no/ / lan tshwa khar ni mchil ma 'du/ / mkhur ba gre ba tsha bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ ro lan tshwa ni lces myangs pa na khar mchil ma 'du zhing 'dzag pa dang mkhur ba dang gre ba tsha bar byed pa yin no/ /

skt: chavaṇo rasa āsādyamānaḥ sukhaṃ syandayati | kapokhagaṃ vidahati kapokhgaradāṣakarat‌
tib: ro kha ba ni myangs par gyur pa na/ kha'i dri ma sbyong zhing dag par byed de/ ljan ljin sel ba yin zhing lce 'joms te/ ro gzhan 'dzin par byed pa'i nus pa 'jig par byed pa ste/ rang gi las kyi nus pa nye bar 'joms par byed do zhes bya ba'i don to/ /

skt: kaṭuko rasa āsvācamāno jihmaṃ daḥ yati | cimacimāṃ spapakalkaṅipramiva ubananaśi sāsyaṃ netrrāṇamukhaṃ sāvayati | kapola gaṇḍau tīva ca
kaṣāyo rasa āsvādyamāno jihāṃ jaḍa jaḍāṃ kuyīt‌ | jāḍathamayathāvadrasanñānasaṃvedanaṃ bharara kṇṭhasroto vivadhnātīti vivandhakrat‌ || 8 1
tib: ro tsha ba ni lce la myangs pa'i lce'i rtse mo skyo bar byed cing na bar byed pa ste/ lce bem bem por byed do zhes bya ba'i don to/ / tsag tsag byed par 'gyur zhes bya ba ni/ / me lce la reg pa ltar lam lam por byed pa'am/ ske tsho'i lde gus bskus pa ltar tsha ba tsag tsag por byed par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du kha dang mig dang sna las chu 'dzag par byed pa dang / mkhur ba me lces phog pa ltar sreg par byed pa yin no/ / bska bas lce ni bem por byed/ / gre ba rtsa sbubs 'gags par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ ro bska ba ni lces myangs pa na lce bem bem por byed do/ / ro ji lta ba bzhin du tshor bar gyur pa las nyams par byed pa dang / de bzhin du gre ba dang rtsa'i sbubs 'gags par byed par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: rasānāṃ kṣaṇamuktvopasaṃdarati-rasānāṃ nenairavaprakārāṇe rūpāṇi rakṣaṇāni jñeyāni vakṣyamāṇāni karmāṇīti

abhkho rasa upayukto'bhidīścikt‌ snigdhaśca | hṛyo-haṭadayapriyaḥ | pācayattīti pācanaḥ uṣṇavīya; | himaspaśeḥ spyo śītaḥ | prīṇayatīti prīṇanaḥ | chedayatīti kledanaḥ | raghuḥ pittakaphāsraṃ karoti | mūṃ baddhamāgaṃ vātamanulomayati mūḍhavātādkhomanaḥ abhyastaḥ sevitaḥ | tanordahasya rodhisyaṃ jasa yatti | kaṇḍūvādīśca gadān‌ kuyaut‌
tib: ro rnams kyi mtshan nyid bshad nas de dag gi rang bzhin nyid kyi don gyi mjug bsdu ba'i tshig tu slob dpon gyis smras pa yin te/ mngar ba la sogs pa'i ro'i tshul ni sngar bshad pa'i rnam pa de lta bu'i mtshan nyid can yin par shes par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ / las ni ro mngar ba dag gis/ / skyes nas 'phrod par byed pa dang / / lus zungs mthu stobs rab skyed cing / / byis pa rgan po glo rdol skem/ / mdog mdangs skra dang dbang po bzang / / lus brtas skad 'gags phan zhing lci/ / nu zho skyed cing rma 'byor byed/ / tshe ring 'tsho byed snum pa dang / / rlung dang mkhris pa dug rnams sel/ / ha cang drags na tshil bcas dang / / bad kan las byung nad skyed cing / / lus sbom drod 'bri chang nad dang / / gcin nad lba ba rmen sogs skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ ro mngar ba bsten cing spyad na las 'di dag byed do/ / de yang skyes nas 'phrod par byed pa ste/ skyes pa nas brtsams te 'phrod cing rjes su mthun pa yin pa'i phyir/ bcud kyi dngas ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs rnams kyi mthu stobs rab tu skyed par byed pa ste/ nus pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i stobs bskyed par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de bzhin du rtag tu byis pa dang rgan po glo rdol ba dang skem ba dang mdog mdangs dang / skra dang dbang po rnams la bzang zhing bsngags par byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du lus brtas par byed pa dang skad 'gags pa'i lkog ma la phan pa dang bud med kyi nu zho skyed pa dang / rma dang rus pa chag pa 'byor zhing 'tsho bar byed pa dang / tshe ring bar byed pa dang / 'tsho bar byed cing mdangs skyed pa dang / snum pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin du rlung dang mkhris pa'i nad dang dug las gyur pa'i nad rnams sel bar byed pa yin no/ / yang ro mngar ba de ha cang drags shing shas cher bsten par gyur na/ tshil dang bad kan las byung ba'i nad rnams skyed cing 'phel bar byed pa dang / lus sbom ba la sogs par byed pa dang / chang nad ni 'og nas bshad do/ / de la sogs pa skyed par 'gyur ro/ / skyur ba me drod skyed byed snum/ / zhim zhing 'ju byed yi ga 'byed/ / dro ba'i nus skyed reg pa bsil/ / tshim byed 'drul byed yang ba ste/ / bad kan khrag mkhris rgyas par byed/ / rlung 'gags rgyu bar byed pa yin/ / de ni shin tu bsten drags na/ / lus lhod rab rib mgo 'khor dang / / g.yan pa skya rbab me dbal dang / / 'or nad thor bu skom rims skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ ro skyur ba bsten cing spyad na/ khong ba'i me drod skyed cing 'phel bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du snum pa dang / zhim zhing sems dga' bar byed pa dang / kha zas 'ju zhing smin par byed pa dang / yi ga 'byed cing zas len pa dang / de bzhin du dro ba'i nus pa skyed pa dang / bskus na reg pa kha ba ltar bsil ba dang / tshim par byed pa dang / kha zas 'drul zhing sla bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du yang ba dang / bad kan dang mkhris pa dang / khrag rgyas par byed pa dang / / de bzhin du rlung lam 'gags shing 'khyil ba dag bde bar rgyu bar byed cing 'byung bar byed pa yin no/ / ro skyur ba de ni shin tu bsten drags shing shas cher zos na lus lhod cing mi mkhregs par byed pa dang / de bzhin du rab rib la sogs pa'i nad skyed par 'gyur ro/ / lan tshwa sra dang 'khyil ba dang / / 'gags pa 'byin cing drod skyed byed/ / snum dang dugs kyis rdul zhing rno/ / yi ga 'byed cing gcod 'byed byed/ / de ni drags pas rlung khrag dang / / skra 'byi skra dkar gnyer ma dang / / skom mdze dug dang me dbal rnams/ / skyed cing stobs ni 'bri bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ ro lan tshwa can bsten cing longs spyad na/ sra ba 'byin par byed pa dang / 'khyil ba 'byin par byed pa dang / 'gags pa 'byin par byed pa yin no/ / de la sra ba ni rengs shing 'gyur mi shes pa'o/ / 'khyil ba ni bshang ba la sogs pa'i tshogs pa 'khyil zhing 'byung du mi btub pa'o/ / 'gags pa ni rtsa sbubs rnams 'gags pa ste/ de dag 'byin cing sel bar byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du drod skyed de me'i shas 'phel bar byed pa dang / snum pa dang / dugs kyis rdul 'byin par byed pa dang / rno zhing 'jug pa myur ba dang / yi ga 'byed cing zas 'dod pa dang / gcod cing kha gnyis su byed pa dang / 'byed par byed pa yin no/ / lan tshwa'i ro de drags shing shas cher bsten pas rlung dang khrag gi nad dang / de bzhin du skra 'byi zhing spyi ther du 'gyur ba dang / rgas sra ba'i mtshan ma skra dkar ba dang / gnyer ma zhes pa pags pa 'dus pa dag byed pa dang / de bzhin du skom dad la sogs pa skyed par byed cing / stobs 'bri zhing 'jig par byed pa yin no/ / kha ba rang nyid zhim min zhing / / yi ga 'chus dang srin skom dug / / mdze dang brgyal dang rims slon bro/ / tsha dang mkhris pa bad kan 'joms/ / 'drul dang tshil dang zhag dang rkang / / bshang dang gci ba skems pa dang / / yang zhing yid gzhungs bsil zhing rtsub/ / nu ma'i nad dang skad 'gags sel/ / de ni shin tu drags gyur nas/ / lus zungs zad cing rlung nad skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ ro kha ba ni rang nyid zhim pa ma yin zhing yi ga 'byed par byed pa yin la/ rang nyid yi gar mi 'ong ba yin no/ / de bzhin yi ga 'chus pa nas bad kan gyi bar du 'joms par byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin 'drul ba la sogs pa zhu zhing gsher ba'i tshul can dag skem par byed pa dang / de bzhin du bzhin yang ba dang / yid gzhungs shing shes rab 'phel ba dang / bsil zhing grang ba'i nus pa skyed pa dang / de bzhin du rtsub pa dang / bud med kyi nu ma'i nad dang / skad 'gags pa'i lkog ma'i nad sel zhing 'joms pa yin no/ / ro kha ba de shin tu drags par bsten cing goms par gyur na/ lus zungs dngas ma la sogs pa zad cing 'bye ba dang / rlung las gyur pa'i nad rnams skyed cing 'byin pa yin no/ / tsha bas lkog nad 'gags pa dang / / mdze dang ma zhu 'or nad sel/ / rma 'jig byed cing snum pa dang / / tshil dang 'drul bag skems par byed/ / drod skyed 'ju zhing yi ga 'byed/ / sbyong zhing zas ni 'jig par byed/ / 'ching ba gcod cing rtsa sbubs dag / rnam par 'byed cing bad kan sel/ / de ni shin tu drags gyur pas/ / skom skyed khu ba stobs zad cing / / brgyal zhing lus 'khums 'dar ba dang / / rked pa rgyab sogs na bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ ro tsha bas ni lkog ma'i nad la sogs pa sel bar byed de/ lkog nad ni lkog ma'i phyogs su byung ba'i nad do/ / 'gags pa ni brang 'gags shing bad kan gyis rgyas pa las byung ba'i nad la bya'o/ / la la ni grang ba'i 'dar nad la u dar du zhes bya'o zhes zer ro/ / gzhan dag ni grang ba'i dus su khyad par du/ grang ba chu yi reg pa las/ / lkog mar skrangs par gyur pa'i nad/ / gag pa zhes bya bad kan 'byung / / zhes bshad do/ / ma zhu ba ni ma zhu ba be'u snabs can no/ / rma 'jig par byed pa ni/ rma shin tu mtho ba'i skrangs bag can 'dzum zhing 'bri bar byed pa'o/ / yang rma 'byor ba dag gi gags byed pa'o/ / de bzhin du snum pa dang / tshil la sogs pa skems shing 'bri bar byed pa dang / me'i drod skyed cing 'phel ba dang / ma zhu ba zhu bar byed pa dang / kha zas yi ga 'byed par byed pa dang / rtsa sbubs sbyong ba dang / zas 'jig par byed pa dang / 'ching ba gcod pa ste/ rno bas lhu tshigs kyi 'ching ba dam po lhod par byed pa dang / rtsa sbubs kyi kha rnam par 'byed pa dang / / bad kan sel zhing 'joms pa yin no/ / tsha ba de shin tu drags par bsten cing zos pas ni skom dad skyed pa la sogs pa byed pa yin no/ / brgyal ba ni rmongs par gyur pa'o/ / lus 'khums ba ni yan lag 'jas pa ltar gyur pa'o/ / de bzhin du 'dar ba dang / rked pa dang rgyab na ba ste/ de dag tu gzer ba la sogs pa mi bzad pas 'debs pa dang / sogs pa'i sgras ni rkang pa dang / rtsib logs na bar byed pa yin no/ / bska bas mkhris pa bad kan sel/ / lci zhing khrag nad rnam par sbyong / / skem zhing rma 'tsho bsil ba dang / / 'drul dang tshil ni rnam par skems/ / be'u snabs 'khyil cing sri bar byed/ / rtsub cing pags mdog rab dang byed/ / de ni shin tu bsten drags na/ / bshang 'gags lto sbos snying nad dang / / skom dang skem zhing skyes mthu nyams/ / rtsa sgo 'gags shing dri ma sri/ / zhes bya ba/ ro bska ba bsten cing spyad pas ni/ mkhris pa bad kan sel zhing 'joms par byed pa dang / lci ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / khrag gi nad rnam par sbyong ba la sogs pa byed pa dang / be'u snabs 'khyil zhing thogs pa dang / bshang bsri bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du shin tu rtsub pa dang / pags pa'i mdog rab tu dngas zhing mdog gsal bar byed pa yin no/ / ro bska ba de bsten pa drags shing shas cher zos na bshang ba 'gag pa la sogs pa skyed par byed pa dang / skyes bu'i mthu nyams shing khu ba zad par 'gyur ba dang / dri ma sri ba ste/ gcin dang phyi sa 'gags par 'gyur ba yin no/ / mngar ba la sogs pa'i rdzas kyi sde tshan smras pa ni/

tib: a ru ra nas ut+pa la'i bar gyi sde tshan 'di ni ro bska ba'i sman gyi tshogs so/ / an tsan ni lig bu mig dang dngul rdo'o/ / btsag ni su bar na gi ri ste/ btsag yug snam mo/ / ka pid tha gzhon zhes bya ba ni ba li ka pid tha gzhon nu'o/ / khar dzu ra zhes bya ba ni ka pid tha rlon pa dang / khar dzu ra ma smin pa'o/ / 'bras rnying nas rnying gro rnying dang / / mung+ga sbrang rtsi sha kha ra/ / skam sa'i sha rnams ma gtogs pa'i/ / mngar ba phal cher bad kan skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ mar la sogs pa'i sman ro mngar ba phal mo che de dag ni/ bad kan skyed cing 'phel bar byed pa yin mod kyi/ 'bras rnying pa dang / nas rnying pa dang / gro rnying pa dang / sran mung+ga ste/ mon sran sde'u dang / sbrang rtsi dang / sha kha ra dang / skam sa'i sha rnams ni ma gtogs te/ 'di dag mngar yang bad kan mi skyed kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i mngar ba phal cher bad kan skyed pa yin no/ / skyu ru se 'bru ma gtogs ba'i/ / skyur ba phal cher mkhris pa skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ gang skyur ba'i sman phal cher zhes pa mang du ste/ ma du lung ga la sogs pa gang yin pa de thams cad mkhris pa skyed cing 'phel bar byed pa yin mod kyi/ rgyam tsha lce myang tsha ma gtogs/ / lan tshwa phal cher mig la gnod/ / ces bya ba la/ rgyam tsha dang / lce myang tsha ni mig la phan no zhes don gyi shugs kyis ston pa yin no/ /

skt: tiktaṃ dravyaṃ tathā kaṭukaṃ ca sarvaṃ bhūyi cāhulyena udya na śakkara | vātakopanaṃ vāḥ kopi ṛte'nyatrāmṛtāpaṭolībhyām‌ | tadrāttichāḥ dravyāṇāṃ madhye dravyadvaye varjayitvā, kaṭukaṃ pura duṇṭīkṛṣṇārasonataḥ ṛte tāni trīṇi dravyarṇa vajayivā, anyad‌ dravyamaparathyaṃ vātakopanam‌ | te paccasu na dṛṣyatvaṃ vātaghnatvaṃ nāsti | amṛtā-gadacī kṛṣṇā-pipyalī | rasono-khuhunaḥ
tib: sman kha ba dang tsha ba thams cad las phal cher te ro tsa zhing khu ba 'phel ba la gnod cing 'bri bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du rlung skyed par byed pa yin mod kyi/ gzhan du na sman kha ba'i nang na sle tres dang / pa to la ma gtogs pa/ sman tsha ba rnams kyi nang na bca' sga dang / sgog skya dang / pi pi ling ste/ gsum ma gtogs pa sman kha ba dang / tsha ba gzhan dag ni ro tsa ba 'bri zhing rlung skyed pa yin zhing / lnga po de dag ni ro tsa bar byed ba yin la/ rlung 'joms pa yin no/ / bska las a ru ra ma gtogs/ / phal cher bsil zhing sri bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ sman bska ba shi ri sha la sogs pa thams cad las phal cher te/ mang du bsil ba'i nus pa dang ldan zhing / bshang ba la sogs pa sri bar byed ba yin mod kyi/ a ru ra ma gtogs te/

tib: ro gnyis sbyar ba ni gnyis pa ste/ ro'i gzhi sman dang 'brel pa'i sbyar ba gnyis pa de la ro lnga po de dag gi sbyor ba byas pa las 'gyur te/ ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ re re phri ba las gyur te/ mngar ba phri ba'i skyur ba la sogs pa dang / skyur ba phri ba'i lan tshwa la sogs pa dang / kha ba phri ba'i tsha ba dang bska ba gnyis dang / tsha ba phri ba'i bska ba'o/ / de ltar na mngar ba la sogs pa'i ro re re phul ba'i ro lnga ni sbyor ba'i don du 'gro bar byed pa yin no/ / skyur ba la sogs pa ni sbyor bar byed pa yin te/ de yang 'di lta ste/ mngar ba dang skyur bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang lan tshwa sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang kha ba sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang tsha ba sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang bska ba sbyar bar bya ste/ de ltar na mngar ba dbye ba rnam pa lngar 'gyur ro/ / skyur ba'i gnyis pa ni mngar ba la ltos nas re re phri bar gyur na/ dbye ba rnam pa gsum du 'gyur ba ni 'di lta ste/ lan tshwa dang kha bar sbyar ba dang / lan tshwa dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / lan tshwa dang bska bar sbyar ba ste/ de ltar na lan tshwa'i gsum par 'gyur ro/ / kha ba'i gnyis pa ni lan tshwa la ltos nas/ re re phri bar gyur na dbye ba rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ba ni 'di lta ste/ kha ba dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / kha ba dang bska bar sbyar bar bya'o/ / tsha ba dang kha ba la ltos nas gcig phri bar gyur na/ dbye ba rnam pa gcig tu 'gyur te/ tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar bar bya'o/ / de ltar na gnyis pa de dag dbye ba rnam pa bco lngar 'gyur ro/ / gsum pa mngar bcu skyur drug ste/ / lan tshwa gsum ste kha ba gcig / bzhi pa la ni mngar po bcu/ / skyur pa bzhi po lan tshwa gcig / ces bya ba la/

sman gyi ro gsum pa la/ ro mngar ba dbye ba rnam pa bcur 'gyur te/ de yang 'di ltar mngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan tshwar sbyar ba dang / / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang kha bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang lan tshwa dang kha bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang lan tshwa dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang lan tshwa dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / / mngar ba dang kha ba dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang kha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba ste/ de ltar na bcu'o/ / skyur drug ste zhes bya ba ni/ ro skyur ba gsum pa'i dbye ba drug tu 'gyur ba ni 'di lta ste/ skyur ba dang lan tshwa dang kha bar sbyar ba dang / skyur ba dang lan tshwa dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / skyur ba dang lan tshwa dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / skyur ba dang kha ba dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / skyur ba dang kha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / skyur ba dang tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba ste/ de ltar na drug go/ / lan tshwa gsum zhes bya ba ni/ lan tshwa'i gsum pa ni dbye ba rnam pa gsum du gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ lan tshwa dang kha ba dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / lan tshwa dang kha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / lan tshwa dang tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba ste/ de ltar na dbye ba rnam pa gsum du 'gyur ro/ / kha ba gcig pu nyid ces bya ba ni ro kha ba ni kha ba dang tsha ba dang / bska bar sbyar ba ste/ dbye ba gcig pu nyid du 'gyur ro/ / de ltar na gsum pa nyi shur 'gyur ro/ / bzhi pa la ni mngar po bcu zhes bya ba ni/ bzhi pa la ni zhes bya ba dbye ba bzhi pa can la ro mngar ba dbye ba bcur 'gyur ro/ / de yang 'di lta ste/ mngar ba dang skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang kha bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang kha ba dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang kha ba dang lan tshwar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang kha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang kha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang lan tshwa dang tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang lan tshwa dang kha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba ste/ de ltar na dbye ba rnam par bcur 'gyur ro/ / skyur ba bzhi po zhes bya ba ni/ skyur ba bzhi po dbye ba bzhir 'gyur ba ni 'di lta ste/ skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang kha ba dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / skyur ba dang lan tshwa dang kha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / skyur ba dang lan tshwa dang tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / skyur ba dang kha ba dang tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba ste de ltar na dbye ba rnam pa bzhir 'gyur ro/ / lan tshwa sna gcig ces bya ba ni/ ro lan tshwa'i bzhi pa ni/ dbye ba gcig tu 'gyur te/ lan tshwa dang tsha ba dang kha ba dang bska bar sbyar ro/ /

dbye ba rnam pa lnga ni/ ro skyur ba'i dbye ba gcig pu bsten pa ni 'di lta ste/ skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang / kha ba dang / tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar bar bya'o/ / lnga pa la ro mngar ba ni dbye ba lnga bsten cing gnas pa yin te/ 'di ltar mngar ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa dang kha ba dang tsha bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa dang kha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang lan tshwa dang kha ba dang tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang kha ba dang tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba dang / mngar ba dang skyur ba dang lan tshwa dang tsha ba dang bska bar sbyar ba ste/ de ltar rnam pa lnga dang / snga ma dang bcas pa lnga pa dbye ba drug tu 'gyur ro/ /

skt: medānā susassaraṇāyai rchokamāha-yaśvakara- | tathā ca muniḥ | vajideko ssa: karthaḥ sutaśa tānāṃ kiyantaḥ saṃyogā iti ṣaṭ‌ paścake'pyekasevā- | rasāḥ kacit‌ 1 doṣauṣadhādīn‌ secitya bhiṣajā sidimo madhuraḥ paścakamaiva | evaṃ ṣadpaścakāḥ saṃyogāḥ | micchateti } doṣabheṣajavaśādiṣyupalakṣaṇādham‌ | deśābhedataḥ ṣaṭ‌ prathabhasāḥ sthuḥ | asaṃyuktāḥ samāvata | divarādapi deśādīnvīṣya rasamedā upayojyaḥ | yathā eva madhurāmṭakhbaṇātiktakaṭukakapāyā iyeva ṣaḍbhedāḥ | pavane jatavye madhurāmḍau savaṇa iti | svāgatā snabhaveyuḥ | caturikau paccadakaprakāsai catupkabhedaḥ bhaurakātā iti
tib: sman ni ro drug ces bya ba gcig pur 'gyur ba yin te/ mngar ba dang skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang / kha ba dang / tsha ba dang / bska ba ste/ spyir gcig pu kho nar 'dus shing gcig tu 'gyur ba yin no/ / de ltar na sbyor ba ni lnga bcu rtsa bdun du 'gyur ba yin no/ /

ma 'dres pa ni gcig dang gnyis la sogs pa'i sbyor ba dang 'brel te/ gcig pu nyid du ni ro drug tu 'gyur te/ / mngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang / kha ba dang / tsha ba dang / bska ba'o/ / de rnams bye brag gi cho gas nye bar sbyar ba yin la/ bye brag de ni snum gyi cho ga la drug cu rtsa gsum du 'gyur te/ de yang ro dbye ba de gnyis gcig pu gnyis/ drug cu rtsa gsum dag tu brtag / snum gyis gzhan dag zil mnan cing / / nyung ba nyid kyi rim las bshad/ / ces 'byung ba yin no/ / dbye ba de dag bye brag dran par bya ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad par bsdus te smras pa ni/ lnga pa drug dang ro ni tha dad drug /

ro lnga'i sbyor ba du yod ce na/ drug ces bya ba ste/ lnga pa la ni skyur gcig pu/ / mngar ba lnga ni bstan pa yin/ / zhes bshad pas ni/ de ltar lnga pa la ni sbyor ba'i dbye ba drug yin no/ / ro tha dad drug ces bya ba ni ma 'dres pa'i ngo bo nyid las ni mngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang / tsha ba dang / bska ba ste/

bzhi pa dang gnyis pa'i dbye ba ni rnam pa bco lnga ste/ de ltar na bzhi pa dang / gnyis pa'i rnam pas phye ba'i ro ni dbye ba rnam pa sum cur 'gyur ro/ / de yang / bzhi pa la ni mngar bo bcu/ / skyur ba bzhi po lan tsha gcig / ces smos pa'i phyir bco lnga yin no/ / dbye ba gsum pa nyi shu zhes bya ba ni/ dbye ba rnam pa gsum gyis phye ba'i ro rnams ni/ dbye ba ni rnam pa nyi shur 'gyur te/ gsum pa mngar bcu skyur drug ste/ / lan tshwa gsum ste kha ba gcig / ces bya ba yin pas na nyi shu'o/ / gcig nyid de/ sman ni ro drug ces bya ba ni/ sman ni ro drug gcig pu yin/ / zhes bya ba'o/ / de ltar drug cu rtsa gsum zhes bya ba ni ro rnams kyi dbye ba drug cu rtsa gsum yod pa'o/ / de dag kyang gong du grangs lnga bcu rtsa bdun du chad pa'i bcos mar yongs su dbye ba'i sbyor ba dang bcas par bshad pa dang / ma bcos pa'i ro drug ste/ ro drug cur ro rnams dbye bar bshad pa gang yin pa de ni dgos pa'i dbang du byas pa las/ mtshon cing lus la dgos pa'i yul du rigs pa nyid las/ rags rim ji lta ba bzhin du phye zhing bshad pa yin gyi/ phra ba rnams kyi sbyor ba brtsis pa'i tshul 'di tsam du zad pa yang ma yin la/ dbye ba yang drug cu rtsa gsum du zad pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir phra zhing rab tu phra bar brtag pa dang / de bzhin du rab dang mchog tu brtag pa'i dbang dang / de bzhin ro dang ro rjes kyi dgos pa'i dbang las ni/ 'di rnams kyi dbye ba grangs med pa yin pas na/ 'di dag bstan par bya ba'i phyir smras pa ni/ de rnams ro dang ro rjes ro'i dbye ba/ / rab dang rab mchog dag tu brtags pa las/ / rtsis las 'das par byung bar gyur pa ni/ / nad dang sman gyi dbang las nye bar sbyar/ / zhes bya ba la/ / drug cu rtsa gsum gyi grangs kyi dbye bas phye ba de rnams ni rtsis las 'das pa yin te/ shin tu mang ba'i phyir brtsi bar mi nus par 'gyur zhing skyes par gyur pa yin no/ / de ci lta zhe na/ ro dang rjes kyi dbye ba las te/ de bas 'byung ba 'dus pa las/ / byung bas sman rnams ro gcig min/ / zhes bya ba smos pa yin te/ ro dang rjes de gnyis kyang 'di ltar mngar ba'i rjes ni skyur ba la sogs pa yin la/ skyur ba'i rjes ni mngar ba la sogs pa yin pa dang / de bzhin du skyur ba ni lan tshwa'i la sogs pa'o/ / lan tshwa ni kha ba la sogs pa ste/ de rnams zhes bya ba'i tshig gis thams cad la snyegs su zin kyang / lnga bcu rtsa bdun po nyid la ci rigs par ro dang ro rjes kyi dbye ba byas na grangs med par 'gyur la/ ro drug po 'ba' zhig la rab dang rab mchog la sogs pa'i brtag pa las grangs med par 'gyur ba lta su zhig 'gog / de gnyis kyis na rab dang / rab mchog dag tu brtag pa las zhes smos pa yin te/ ro sbyar ba dang / ma sbyar ba'i dbye ba mchog dang / rab mchog dag tu brtag pa ni 'di ltar mngar ba dang / / rab tu mngar ba dang / rab mchog tu mngar ba dang / cung zad mngar ba dang / cung zad rab tu mngar ba dang / cung zad rab mchog tu mngar ba ste/ de bzhin du gzhan dag la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ / yang ro'i dbye ba de rnams nad kyi sman gyi dbang gis nye bar sbyar bar bya ste/ / de la nad ni rlung la sogs pa'o/ / sman ni a ru ra la sogs pa'o/ / nad dang sman gyi mngar ba ni de'i ched dam/ dbang du byas pa'am/ de la ltos pa ste/ de'i dbang du byas pa las yongs su brtags te sbyar bar bya'o/ / bab bab tu 'chol bar bya ba ni ma yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ / nad dang sman zhes smos pa ni nye bar mtshon pa tsam yin par shes par bya'o/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/

/ / de nas nad la sogs pa'i tshul shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o zhes bya ba ni/ de'i rjes thogs la nad la sogs pa shes par bya ba brtsam par bya'o/ / gang gi phyir ro rnams kyi dbye ba drug cu rtsa gsum gyis phye ba de dag kyang nad kyi sman gyi dbang du sbyar bar bya ba yin par bshad la/ de lta bas na nad las rjes su dpags te sbyar bar bya'i/ bab bab tu 'chol bar bya ba ni ma yin no/ / de bas na nad de rnams ni rang gi las kyi mtshan nyid ji lta ba nyid las rjes su dpags te shes par bya dgos te/ de shes par bya ba'i phyir na le'u 'di brtsams pa yin no/ / 'dir nad rnams gzhi med par ni ji ltar yang shes par mi nus la/ de bas na nad de rnams kyi gzhir gyur pa/ lus zungs dang dri ma rnams gang yin pa de shes par bya dgos pas na/ nad shes par bya ba 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi zhes bya bar nges par gnas so/ / de ltar na nad la sogs pa shes par bya ba de la phan pa'i le'u bshad par bya zhing bstan par bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /

skt: dopāśca dhātavaśca makhāśca tai doṣadhātupralāḥ | sadā sarvakāraṃ dasya mūramiva mūlaṃ pradhānaṃ kāraṇamiyaśaraḥ | taṃ deṣa calo vāyuratugarahātyacichataḥ samavasthitaḥ sannutsāhādbhiḥ 1 utsāha udyogaḥ | sabhracṭāmu ucchasa urvaṃdhasanaṃ) śvāsaḥ muktiḥ 1 niḥśvāsaḥ śvāsasya nirodho'ntaḥgravedānama ceṣṭanaṃ ceṣṭā kāyavādmanovyāpāraḥ) negānāṃ pravatainaṃ vātavipmūtrādīnāṃ badiḥ pravatainaṃ, nirasanam‌ | samyaggatyā ca dhātūnāṃ dhāturabdaina rasādidhātavī gṛhyante | pintaśchepmāṇau ca teṣāṃ sāmyenāvasthānāṃ saṃmyargatiḥ | tatra sābhyāvasthāne teṣāṃ vāyukhavāvirutaḥ kāraṇaṃ yasmāssa vikṣipasaṃhyaskaṃ iti | akṣāṇābhindriyāṇāṃ cakṣusādrīnāṃ pāṭavena svaviṣayagrahaṇaruṭasvena taṃ dehaṃ pintamavikrataṃ pakṭyādibhiramugarahāti upakāraṃ karoti | paktiḥ pākaḥ) uṣmā tejaḥ) daśanaṃ rūpagmahaṇaśaktiḥ | kṣudadhoktabhicchā | dad‌ pipāsā | racirannāmirapaḥ sarippaṇadīkabhrayasevalite aḥ 11. ` priyopabhogataktā | prabhā prasādaḥ kāntimatvam‌ | medhā dhāraṇāvatī parñāṃ | vīrudadhiḥ 1 saudhe cataso'vaṣṭambhaḥ | dhṛtim‌ | tanoḥ śarīra sya mādava mṛdutvam‌ | śepmā'cikretaḥ rthiratvādiḥ mistaṃ dehamayugṛhāti | sthirasavaṃ daḍhatā | sigdhatva sasehatā | aṅgasya sandhāna, bandhaḥ pavasaṃeṣaḥ | kṣamā śāntiḥ
tib: nad dang lus zungs dang dri ma rnams ni/ nad dang lus zungs dang dri ma rnams te/ de ni rtag par dus thams cad du lus kyi rtsa bar gyur pa yin te/ lus ni de las byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba dang 'dra bas na rtsa ba ste/ rgyu'i gtso bo zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de rlung dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub dang / / bskyod dang las spyod shugs 'byin dang / / lus zungs legs par rgyu ba dang / / dbang po rnams ni gsal ba dag /

lus de ni rlung mi gnod cing / dbugs 'byung ba la sogs pas mnyam par gnas na lus rjes su 'dzin cing rten par byed pa yin no/ / de la dbugs 'byung ba ni gyen du dbugs 'byin cing gtong ba'o/ / dbugs rngub ba ni dbugs sdud cing thur du 'jug pa'o/ / bskyod pa ni dbugs su bya ba thams cad la brtson zhing rtsol ba'o/ / las la spyod pa ni lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las la spyod cing 'jug pa'o/ / shugs 'byin pa ni bshang ba dang / gci ba dang rlung phyi rol tu 'byin pa'o/ / lus zungs legs par rgyu ba zhes pa ni/ lus zungs kyi sgras ni dngas ma la sogs pa dang / mkhris pa dang bad kan dag gzung ngo / / de rnams legs par rgyu ba ni mnyam par gnas shing 'jug pa'o/ / de la mnyam par rgyu ba'i gnas skabs nyid kyis de rnams rlung nyid mi gnod par 'gyur ba'i rgyu nyid yin te/ gang gi phyir rnam par 'thor zhing 'khrugs pa sdud cing zhi bar byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du dbang po rnams gsal ba ste/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po yul 'dzin pa la gsal bar gnas pa ste/ yon tan de dag dang ldan na mi gnod cing rjes su 'dzin pa yin no/ / mkhris pa 'ju drod mthong byed dang / bkres skom zas len mdangs yid gzhungs/ /

de mkhris par 'gyur ba med cing 'ju ba la sogs pas rjes su 'dzin cing rten par byed pa yin no/ / de la 'ju ba ni zas smin cing 'ju ba'o/ / drod ni me'i shas so/ / mthong ba ni gzugs 'dzin par nus pa'o/ / bkres pa ni zas 'dod pa'o/ / skom pa ni 'thung 'dod pa'o/ / zas len pa ni yi ga 'byed cing nye bar longs spyod par 'dod pa'o/ / mdangs ni bzhin mdog gsal zhing gzi mdangs che ba'o/ / yid gzhungs pa ni shes rab dang ldan pa'o/ / blo dang ldan pa ni blo gros dang ldan pa'o/ / dpa' snying ni sems kyis rtul phod pa yin te/ brtan zhing mi g.yo ba'o/ / lus 'jam pa ni lus kyi sha mdangs 'jam zhing mnyen pa ste/

skt: avaṣṭambhaḥ śarīrasya dhāraṇaṃ pradhānaṃ kame purīṣasya kataḥ} chedavāhanamannachedasya bahiḥ kṣepaṇaṃ pradhānaṃ kamaṃ mūtrasya | kedāvidharṛtī romadhāraṇaṃ śreṣṭha kamaṃ svedraya
tib: de la bad kan ni mi 'gyur zhing brtan pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa/ lus rjes su 'dzin par byed do/ / brtan pa ni mi g.yo ba nyid do/ / snum pa nyid ni lus snum par gyur pa nyid do/ / tshigs 'brel pa ni lhu tshigs kyi bar de rnam par 'brel zhing dam du gnas pa'o/ / bzod pa ni gnod pa la mi 'khrugs pa ste/ de dag la sogs pas phan pa'i las byed pa yin no/ / lus zungs las gtso bzhin/ / tshim byed 'tsho byed g.yogs pa dang / / snum dang brtan dang 'gengs pa dang / / mngal ni skyed byed yin par bshad/ / ces bya ba la/ bcud kyi dngas ma la sogs pa/ lus zungs bdun po rnams kyi mchog dang / gtso bo bdun ni ji lta ba bzhin du tshim par byed pa la sogs pa yin par slob dpon dag gis bshad cing bstan to/ / de la tshim par byed pa ni lus zungs tshim zhing sems dga' bar byed pa ni dngas ma'i bcud kyi las kyi mchog yin no/ / 'tsho bar byed cing srog 'dzin par byed pa ni khrag gi las so/ / lus kyi rus pa g.yogs shing khebs par byed pa ni sha'i las so/ / lus snum zhing bcud can du byed pa ni tshil gyi las so/ / lus brtan zhing mkhrang por bsgreng ba ni rus pa'i las yin te/ gzhan du na lus la rus pa med na sha'i gong bu nyid du 'gyur ro/ / rus pa'i rkang sbubs 'gengs pa ni rkang gi las so/ / mngal skyed cing 'byung bar byed pa ni khu ba'i las kyi mchog yin par bshad do/ /

lus brtan cing 'byin par byed pa ni/ / bshang ba'i las kyi gtso bo yin no/ / zas 'drul zhing myags pa dang / phyi rol du 'byin zhing 'don pa ni/ gcin gyi las kyi gtso bo yin no/ / skra dang ba spu brtan par 'dzin par byed pa ni/ rngul gyi las kyi gtso bo yin no/ / rlung ni 'phel bar gyur pa yis/ / skem dang mdog gnag drod bag dga'/ / 'dar dang lto sbos bshang ba sri/ / stobs dang gnyid dang dbang po nyams/ / smra mang mgo 'khor zhum par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ rlung gi nad 'phel zhing skyes par gyur pas skem pa la sogs pa skyed par byed do/ / de la skem pa ni khrag la sogs pa zad pas skem zhing nyam chung ba'o/ / mdog nag pa ni kha dog nyams pa'o/ / drod bag la dga' ba ni dro ba mngon par 'dod pa'o/ / 'dar ba ni g.yo zhing 'gul ba'o/ / lto sbos pa ni gsud pa rgyas pa'o/ / bshang ba sri ba ni bshang gci 'gags pa'o/ / stobs la sogs pa nyams pa ni de dag dang bral ba'o/ / smra mang ba ni ma 'brel bar mang du smra ba'o/ / mgo 'khor ba ni lus mal na mi gnas shing 'khor ba'o/ / zhum pa ni sems mi dga' zhing gdung bar byed pa'o/ / mkhris pa bshang gci pags mig ser/ / bkres skom lus tsha gnyid chung byed/ / ces bya ba la/ mkhris pa 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur na/ bshang ba la sogs pa ser por byed pa ste/ bshang ba dang gci ba sri ba dang / pags pa dang / mig gi mdog kha dog ser por 'gyur bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du bkres pa dang / skom pa dang / lus tsha ba dang gnyid chung ba nyid du byed par

skt: pittaṃ vṛddhaṃ pītaṃ rādādikaṃ kareti | pītāḥ pītavarṇā; śaṅkanamūtracakṣutvacaḥ| buuścāṣipāsādāhamandānadratāścaṃ kurute
tib: bad kan 'phel bas me drod nyams pa la sogs pa byed do/ / de la drod nyams pa ni pho ba'i me drod nyams pa'o/ / mchil ma mang ba ni mchil ma lhag par 'byung ba'o/ / khong snyom pa ni spro ba chung zhing sgyid lug pa'o/ / lci ba ni lus kyi yan lag lci ba nyid do/ / sha mdog dkar ba ni lus kyi mdog dkar zhing skya ba nyid do/ / de bzhin du lus grang ba nas gnyid che ba'i bar yang skyed pa yin no/ /
bcud kyi dngas ma 'phel bar gyur na/ drod nyams pa nas gnyid che ba'i bar bad kan dang 'dra bar skyed par byed pa'o/ / khrag 'phel me dbal khong 'bras mcher/ / mdze dang rlung khrag mkhris pa khrag /

skt: ramo bdaḥ śapmavat‌ śaṣmaṇaḥ -tulyamabhnisārraninidravāntam‌ | raktaṃ vṛddhaṃ visarpartīna rogān‌ saste | vātāsaṃ vātaśoṇite, pittāscaṃ ` raktapintam‌ | upaku māma yo -dantamāṃseṣu raktapittamāṃsaṃ bhavet‌ kāmāśca | vyaṅgha rayāmamaṇḍalaṃ samoho - caicityam‌ | raktāni vvadnetramūtrāṇi kurate
tib: khrag 'phel ba las ni me dbal la sogs nad skyed par 'gyur ro/ / rlung khrag ni rlung dang khrag 'dres pa las gyur pa'i nad do/ / mkhris pa dang khrag ni mkhris pa dang khrag 'dres pa'o/ / rnyil nad ni so'i sha las khrag las gyur pa'i sha lhag skye ba'am skrang ba'o/ / bskyod dka' ba ni rkang lag lci ba la bya'o/ / yang na byang gya zhes pa gdong la dmar po tal til byung ba'i pags nad la bya'o/ /

skt: medo vṛddha tadranmāṃsavṛddhivat‌ gaṇr̤ādīn‌ kurata tathā śramam‌ | aspe'pi ceṣṭite jayāsaṃ śāsa sphicchastanodarāṇāṃ ca chambanaṃ sthūhasavāhdhambamānasvam‌

skt: mañjāvṛddhau netrāṅgagaupavaṃ -rocanasrīragauravaṃ kuyot‌ | pasu psthāneṣu sthūlamūkhāni kuryāt‌ | chṛdraṇyarūṣi ca | sthūra̭ṃvṛhadadhidntānbhūḍhe yepāṃ tānyapi gaṇḍādīn‌

tib: rngul chen nang du 'phel bas rngul rab tu che bar 'gyur ba dang / lus dri mi zhim pa nyid du byed do/ / g.yan pa nyid kyang skyed cing 'byung bar byed pa yin par shes par bya'o/ / mig rdul la sogs dri ma rnams/ / mang bas lci la sogs par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ mig rdul ni mig gi dri ma'o/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni rna ba la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams kyang bsdu bar bya'o/ / de ltar na mig rdul la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams mang zhing 'phel bas lci zhing mang du 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du sogs pa zhes smos pas g.ya' ba dang / 'drul ba la sogs par byed pa bsdu'o/ / de dag kyang zad cing 'bri bar 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid ni/

skt: kṣīṇānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha -kṣaṇi vāyau 1 cihvamidaṃ rakṣayet‌] adgasyāvasādrau dahasyānutsa aspa bhāpitte svaspavacanatā, dehitamapi ce kāyikaṃ kma tadṛpyasparam‌ saṃjñāmohaḥ saṃvidbhā tathā śpmavṛddhayaktāmayasambhavaḥ-abhanisada nādan‌ maryānāṃ vyādhīnāmuddhavaḥ
tib: rlung zad cing 'bri bar 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma ni lus mi bde zhing sgyid snyom pa dang / smra ba nyung zhing gcom chung ba dang / rtsol zhing lus kyi las su byed pa dag kyang chung zhing zhan pa dang / / dran pa mi gsal ba ste/ rig cing tshor ba chung ba dang de bzhin du bad kan 'phel bar gyur pa'i skabs su sngar bshad pa'i nad drod nyams pa dang / mchil ma mang ba la sogs pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /
mkhris pa zad pa'i mtshan ma ni me'i drod nyams shing rtul ba dang / lus grang zhing bsil bag tu 'gyur ba dang / mdog mdangs nyams par byed par 'gyur ro/ /

tib: sha zad pa'i mtshan ma ni dbang po nyams shing rang gi yul 'dzin par mi nus pa dang / mig dang mkhur ba'i rus pa skams shing sha zad pa dang / lhu tshigs rnams na zhing bcag pa snyam sems par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: ṭukraṃ retadhirādrahukāṭhena sicyata | śoṇita rtabheva vā prasicyeta | atyaśamatirayena todo vyathā phaelkośayemedaraṃ chigaṃ dhūmāyati dhūmabhiva mubhvāti
tib: khu ba zad pa'i mtshan ma ni/ khu ba ring zhing 'gor nas 'byung ba dang / yang na khu ba khrag nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / rlig pa de 'bras bu sbubs can shin tu na zhing 'jug pa dang / pho mtshan tshig cing du ba 'thul ba snyam du sems par 'gyur ro/ /

tib: bshang ba zad pa'i mtshan ma ni rlung rgyu ma'i nang na rgyu ba sgra dang bcas shing 'khyil ba lta bur yan man du rgyu ba dang de bzhin du lto bar gyen du rgyu zhing 'gro bas na bar byed pa/ snying ga dang rtsib logs gnyis su mi bzad par na zhing gzer bar byed pa yin no/ / gcin zad gcin ni nyung sri dang / / mdog 'gyur ba'am khrag bcas nyid/ / ces bya ba la/ gcin zad pa'i mtshan ma ni gcin zad cing cung zad 'byung ba dang / sri zhi ngan par 'byung ba dang / mdog 'gyur ba dang / khrag dang bcas pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /
rngul zad pa'i mtshan ma ni spu 'byi zhing lhung ba dang / ba spu'i bu ga 'dzums shing 'grengs pa dang / /

mig rdul la sogs pa'i dri ma shin tu phra ba rnams zad pa'i mtshan ma ni brtag par dka' ste/ de bas na dri ma rnams kyi rang gi gnas skabs la sogs pa las shes shing rtogs par bya'o/ / dri ma rnams kyi rang gi gnas yin pas na dri ma'i rang gnas te/ mig la sogs pa de rnams bskams pa dang / na ba dang stong pa dang / / yang ba las zad pa brtag par dka' ba'i dri ma de rnams kyi zad pa shes par bya'o/ / de ltar nad dang lus zungs dang / dri ma rnams kyi zad pa dang 'phel ba rgya cher bshad nas/ mdor bsdus nas smras pa ni/ nad sogs rang nyid ji lta ba'i/ / yon tan 'di ni bzlog pa dag / zad

skt: evaṃ vistarato dopadhātumatyāyā vṛdadhiśaṣayaṃ vyāsyāya samāsata āh‌-dāpāparīnāṃ dopadhātumalānāṃ vaddhikṣayau vidyāt‌ jāsīyāt‌ | kathaṃ vidhasavānāṃ raṇānāṃ yathāsvaṃ śrayeṇa barada jānīyān‌ } 965}. tathā vipvaitānāṃ guṇānāṃ yathāsvaṃ vardhanena kṣayaṃ jānīyāc‌ | doṣādiguṇebhyau ye viparītayuṇā yathā vātasya stiśdhādayo viparsatāḥ, pintasya rītādayaḥ; ṣmaṇo śakṣādayaḥ | teṣāṃ viparītānāṃ guṇānāṃ kṣayeṇopacaye vṛddhi kṣayet‌ | teṣāmeva viparītānāṃ guṇānāṃ vardhanenādhikyena kṣayamapacayaṃ rakṣayet‌ gānāṃ mūtarapusaṣādīnāṃ saṅgādpravatenāṛdadhi rakṣapet‌ | ativisagīdatipravatenāt‌ kṣaya jānīyāt‌ | na kevalaṃ pūrvoktarakṣaṇana?yāvadamunāpyubhāvapi makhā tā śadikṣayau pīḍākarau | tatrāpi ya eṣāṃ kṣayaḥ ta vṛddhito'ṣyatiśaśayena pīḍākarataraḥ
tib: ji ltar shes par bya zhe na/ rang nyid kyi mtshan nyid ji lta ba'i go bzlog pa zad pa las ni 'phel bar shes par bya la/ rang nyid kyi yon tan go bzlog pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba las ni 'bri bar shes par bya ste/ / nad la sogs pa'i nam mtshan nyid las go bzlog par 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid do/ / de ji ltar rlung gi nad kyi yon tan las go bzlog pa ni snum pa la sogs pa'o/ / mkhris pa'i ni bsil ba la sogs pa'o/ / bad kan gyi ni rtsub pa la sogs pa'o/ / de rnams las go bzlog pa zad cing / bri ba las ni nad 'phel bar shes par bya la/ de rnams kyi las kyang go bzlog pa'i mtshan nyid 'phel zhing lhag par gyur pa las ni/

bshang ba dang gci ba la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams thogs shing 'byung bar mi byed pa las ni 'phel bar shes par bya la/ shin tu 'byung zhing lhag par phyir 'byung ba las ni zad par shes par bya ste/ sngar bshad pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ tshul 'dis kyang shes par bya'o/ / dri ma rnams 'phel ba dang / zad pa gnyi ga yang nad skyed par byed pa yin la/ de la yang gang zhig zad par 'gyur ba de 'phel ba bas ches lhag par 'phel te gnod pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin te/ de bas na/

lus te phung po 'di ni dri mas brten cing grogs su byas pa yin pas dri ma rnams 'phel zhing lhag par gyur pas zad cing 'grib par gyur pas ches lhag par gnod par byed pa yin no/ / nad la sogs pa'i dngos po de rnams las gang zhig gzhi gang la brten zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ de la rlung ni rus par gnas/ / mkhris pa rngul dang khrag la gnas/ / bad kan lhag ma gnas/

skt: ke doṣāḥ kasminnādhare arṇratā darayāha~ tatra teṣu vātādiṣu madhye'sthani vāyuḥ sthitaḥ āśritaḥ svedaraktayoḥ pittaṃ sthitam‌ ! śaṣmā reṣeṣu rasamedomajjaśukpurīṣamūtrādiṣu sthitā ñāśretāḥ | yenaiva speṇa te āśrayāśrayibhāvena doṣadhātūnāṃ tena tena dahetuneṣāmāśrayāśrayiṇāṃ mithaḥ paraspara yadekasya vardhana tadanyasyāpi vardhana, yadekasya kṣupaṇaṃ tadanyasyāpi kṣapaṇamauṣadham‌ | yadāśrayasya vadhanaṃ tadāśrayiṇo'pi vardhanam‌ | yad‌āśrayasya kṣapaṇaṃ tadāśrayiṇo'pi kṣapaṇam‌ | evaṃ cedasthno vātāśrayasya varbhanamauṣadhaṃ tadāśrayiṇo'pi vātasya vadnaṃ yadasthna; kṣapaṇaṃ tadpi vātasya kṣapaṇaṃ prāpnoti | tatredamāha hirāṣdo yasmāda | yasmāt‌ prāyo yā ṛddhivedhenaṃ doṣadhātūlāmeṣāṃ sā tṇād‌ vuṃhaṇājjāyate | sā ca śepmaṇātugatā | prāyograhaṇamatra vyabhicāradadcanārtham‌ | yata evaṃ yā vṛddhiḥ sā tapeṇāt‌ tasmāddhetoḥ saṃkṣayaḥ eṣāṃ doṣadhātūnāmāśrayāśrayihūpāṇāṃ sa prāyo'patapeṇāhṅkanāparapayoyanāmno jāyate] evaṃ yadastho vardhalamaupadhaṃ tat‌ snigdhamadhurādiṃ ghṛhaṇarūpaṃ vātasya kṣapaṇam‌ | yadvātasya vadhainamauṣadhaṃ śṛkṣatiktāyapatapaṇaṃ chaṅghanarūpamasthnaḥ kṣepaṇaṃ tada~ dhemetaduktamasthimāratayonaiveti bāhusyaṃ cāṅgīkya śādñakāra idamāh‌--yata evaṃrūpatā bṛddhestapaṇaśūpavvamapatapeṇarūpatvaṃ ca saṃkṣayasyāto vabṛddhikṣayasamudarabān‌ vikārān‌ doṣadhātūnāṃ sambandhinaḥ kramāchaṅaghanabaṃhaṇeḥ sādhayet‌ cikitset‌ ! vyādhyusthān‌ vikārān‌ khaṅghanairapatapeṇeḥ, kyotthān‌ baṃhaṇaḥsantapaṇaiḥ
tib: de la rlung la sogs pa de rnams kyi nang nas rlung ni rus pa la brten zhing gnas la/ mkhris pa ni rngul dang khrag la gnas so/ / bad kan ni lhag ma la gnas pa ste/ rus pa dang / rngul dang / khrag ni gnas pa po dang ldan pas/ de ma gtogs pa lhag ma dngas ma dang / sha dang / tshil dang / rkang dang / khu chu dang / bshang ba dang gci ba la sogs pa gzhan dag la gnas te/ /
dngas ma la sogs pa lhag ma de rnams la bad kan brten zhing gnas pa yin no/ /

gang tshul de lta bu des na nad dri ma rnams gnas dang gnas pa po 'phel bar byed pa yin la/ gang brten cing zad par byed pa na brten pa po'i yang zad par byed pa yin pas na gcig gi sman gang yin pa gzhan gyi yang de nyid yin no/ / de lta na ni gang rlung gi gnas rus pa 'phel ba'i sman des ni/ dang po rlung yang 'phel bar byed la/ rus pa zad par byed pa'i sman des ni rlung yang zad par byed par 'gyur ro zhe na/ rus pa rlung gnyis la 'di min/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ rus pa dang rlung gnyis ma 'phel ba dang / zad par byed pa'i sman 'di ltar mi sbyor ro zhes shugs kyis sbyar bar bya'o/ / phal cher brtas pas 'phel bar 'gyur/ / bad kan rjes mthun de yi phyir/ / de las bzlog pas zad pa yin/

skt: eva sati bāyereva̭rūpatopakrabhya prāpnoti | vātabaddhavatthān‌ vikārān‌ raṅyaneḥ kṣayovthān‌ baihaṇairityārāṅkyāha~vāyaṃ bajeyipvā tajjān‌ puna vikārān‌ taireva laṅghanavaṃhaṇairaskamayojitaithikitset‌ udkamya yathānidiṣaṭakramasuhgaya anyathācharatvā vātayṛddhavutthān‌ māmayān‌ bahaṇaiḥ santarpaṇa bhakṣaṇorthāśca kaṅghamairapatapaṇaiḥ
tib: gang gi phyir nad dang lus zungs 'di rnams ni phal cher brtas par byas shing tshim par byas pas 'phel zhing skye bar 'gyur la/ 'phel ba de yang bad kan dang rjes su mthun pa yin no/ / phal cher zhes smos pa ni gzhan dag tu ni kha cig 'di ltar ma yin pa yang yod do zhes ston pa yin no/ / de ltar brtas pa las 'phel bar 'gyur pa'i rgyu de'i phyir brten pa po'i tshul can dang nad dang lus zungs 'di dag zad par bya ba ni de las bzlog pa ste/ nyams smad pa ming gi rnam grangs su smyung bar bya ba zhes bya bas zad par 'gyur ba yin no/ / de ltar na/ gang yang rus pa 'phel bar byed pa'i sman snum pa dang mngar ba la sogs pa de ni rlung zad par byed pa yin no/ / gang rlung 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i sman rtsub pa dang / kha ba la sogs pa de ni nyams smad par byed pa/ smyung ba'i rjes su mthun pas ni rus pa zad par byed pa yin no/ / de bas na rus pa rlung gnyis la 'di yin zhes smos te/ bstan bcos byed pas phal mo che'i dbang du mdzad nas smras pa ni/ 'phel dang zad pa 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ / smyung dang brta bar bya ba yis/ / nad ni rim gyis gso bar bya/ / rlung ma gtogs te/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ gang gi phyir de ltar blta ba'i tshul las ni 'phel bar 'gyur la/ nyams smad pa'i tshul las ni zad par 'gyur ba des na nad kyi 'phel ba dang zad pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i smyung ba dang brta bar bya ba dag gis nad kyi rnam pa rim gyis gso bar bya zhing bsgrub par bya'o/ / de yang 'phel ba las gyur pa'i nad la smyung ba dang nyams smad pas gso bar bya la/ zad pa las gyur pa'i nad la ni brta zhing tshim par bya bas bsgrub par bya'o/ / de lta na ni rlung gso bar bya ba dag la rlung 'phel ba las gyur pa'i nad la ni smyung bar bya bas gso dgos la/ rlung zad pa las byung ba'i nad la brta bar bya dgos par 'gyur ro zhes rtogs par gyur pas/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ rlung ma gtogs te zhes bya ba yin te/ gso ba'i rim pa de la rlung ni ma gtogs te/ 'di las gzhan du bya ba yin no/ / de skyes la/ / de nyid bzlog thabs sbyar bar bya/

rlung de las skyes pa'i nad rnams la ni de nyid ces bya ba smyung ba dang / brta bar bya ba dag gi bzlog pa'i thabs kyis gso bar bya ba ste/ 'phel ba ni brta bar bya ba dang / zad pa la ni smyung bar bya bas gso bar bya'o/ /
nad kyi gso ba la yang khyad par du bya ba ni khrag skyes shing 'phel ba las nad du gyur pa las/

skt: pūrvau rsakhyo dhātuḥ cṛddho bhūtvā aparaṃ skākhyaṃ ghātu baddha kuyaut‌ | pūrvaśca kṣīṇo dhāt‌rasākhyaḥ para̭ raktākhyaṃ dhāṭhu kṣīṇametaddhidhameva kuyīt‌
tib: sha cher skyes shing sbom pa las byung ba'i nad la ni gtar ga bya ba dang me btsa' gdab pa dang / thal sman rnon po sbyar ba la sogs pas

tshil ches shing 'phel ba las byung ba'i nad la ni/ sbom pa gso ba'i cho ga rnam pa gnyis bshad pa'i tshul gyis gso bar bya la/ tshil zad pa las byung ba'i nad la ni skem po gso ba'i cho ga rnam pa gnyis kyis gso bar bya'o/ /

skt: jaojaḥ kopādibhiḥ kṣīyata | koṣaḥ krodhaḥ | udatīva bubhukṣā | dhyānamanekavidhe cintanam‌ | rokathittaduḥkham‌ | śramaḥ dārīgāyāsaḥ | vādaviprahaṇāddhayatrāsādīnāṃ mahaṇam‌ | takre ojameḥ kṣayaṃ sati naro vibheti akammātsamayaḥ syāt‌ | tathā dudhalo'spasāmardhyaḥ | abhīṣaṇamasyathai dhyāyani cintāparaḥ syāt‌ | vyathitendriyaḥ vyadhathināni duḥkhitāni aśaktāni svāṇīndriyāṇi yamya | durchāyo duṣṭakāntiḥ | durmanāḥ duḥcitacaitāḥ | rūkṣastvagādiṣu sanaiharahitaḥ | krāmaḥ śṣīṇadhaghātuprāyaḥ | tatraujaḥkṣaye mepajarmāpadhaṃ jīvantīkākosyādīni jīvanīyānyaupadhāni | tathā pram‌ , raso māṃsarasaḥ | ādighrahaṇādanyānyayi vṛhaṇīyāni rakṣāpramṛtīni sadhuragaṇanidiṣṭāni tānyapi bhaṣa. jam‌ | knīrasyāpi jīvanīyatvāñjīvanīyoṣadhanata siddham‌ | tasya prathakpāṭo'tiśāyajñāpanātham‌, | bhatidayena kṣīraṃ tatra bheṣajam‌
tib: rus pa zad pa las byung ba'i nad la ni/ sman ro kha ba dang sbyar ba'i 'o ma la sogs pas gso ba dang / de bzhin du 'jam rtsi mas gtong bas gso bar bya'o/ /
bshang ba 'phel ba las byung ba'i nad la ni drag tu 'khru ba'i cho gas gso'o/ /

bshang ba zad pa las byung ba'i nad la ni/ ra dang lug gi nang khrol rgyu ma la sogs pa g.yos su byas pa dang / zan dron dang / sbyor thug dang / ma sha gnyis po ste mon sran sde'u dang / mon sran dkar po gnyis sbyin pa dang / sogs pa'i sgras rgya sne'u'i tshod ma dang / zho ga chu dang / rtsab mo rang skyur la sogs pa sbyin pa bsdu'o/ /

skt: vṛddhikṣayayo; saṃkṣepata mauṣadhamāda-yavannamabhyavahāye purūṣo hoṣi nābhikhaṣatti, yadpyanna prāthayetā. mikhyattadannaṃ prathitaṃ samaśran‌ jalāno yau yīṃ vṛddhikṣayau tau tau jayet‌ | yadi tattadennamavirodhi mavet‌ na viruddha syāt‌ yajana samarya
tib: gcin mang ba las byung ba'i nad la ni/ gcin 'bri ba'i gso ba'i cho gas gso bar bya'o/ / gcin zad pa las byung ba'i nad la ni/
rngul zad pa las byung ba'i nad la ni/ rtsol ba la sogs pas rngul dbyung ba'i cho gas gso bar bya'o/ / lus kyi me drod rang gnas 'dug /

lus kyi me drod ces bya ba/ pho ba'i me drod yin la/ rang gnas su 'dug ces bya ba/ rang gi gnas zhu ba'i gnas kyi bar na 'dug pa de'i cha shas gang yin pa rnams lus zungs la brten cing gnas pa'i cha de rnams 'bri zhing nyams dmas pas dngas ma la sogs pa'i lus zungs rnams 'phel bar 'gyur la/ cha shas de rnams nyid rab tu 'bar zhing stobs che bar gyur pas ni lus zungs rnams zad par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: dirabdo yasmādarthe ] yasmādoṣā cātādayaṃ ruci viparītasamānayoḥ kuvate | kiṃbhūtā; santo vṛddhāḥ, kṣīṇāśca 1 yathākramaṃ vṛddhāḥ santaḥ svaguṇebhyo | yadviparītayuṇamanne taṣṭhiṣayāṃ ruci prītimulādayanti | bāhasyena kṣīṇāḥ santo yatsamānaruṇamāhārajātaṃ tadvivayamabhikhāṣaṃ janayanti | yathā vāto baddhaḥ prīti kurute | pittaṃ vṛdha 91.815. | sītamadhurādikeṣu | keṣmā vṛddho kakṣakaṭakādipu | cāyuḥ ścīṇaḥ snigdhalbaṇādiṣu | pitta kṣīṇamamkādiṣu| mmā kṣīṇaḥ snigdhamadhurādiṣapvāhārajatipu prītiṃ kurute mudhā asapaprajñā miṣajo na lakṣayanti tadṭipayaṃ tepāṃ jñānaṃ na jāyata dayaḥ
tib: lus zungs kyi dang po dngas ma zhes bya ba rgyas par gyur na de'i phyi ma khrag ces bya ba'i lus zungs rgyas par byed la/ lus zungs kyi dngas ma zad na phyi ma khrag kyang de bzhin du zad par 'gyur ro/ / nad dang / lus zungs dang / dri ma dang / dri ma rnams kyi gnas la gnod pa'i rim pa dang / nad 'byung ba'i rim pa smras pa ni/

nyes pa ni rlung la sogs pa ste/ de rnams 'khrugs pa ni rang gi rgyu rnams kyis ldang zhing g.yos so/ / des na lus zungs bya ba dngas ma la sogs pa la nyen cing gnod par 'gyur ro/ / nyes pa dang lus zungs de gnyis ka 'khrugs shing g.yos pas ni dri ma la gnod par byed la/ gnod pa dang ldan pa ni dri ma des ni dri ma'i gnas la gnod pa skyed par 'gyur na/ dri ma'i gnas de dag gang yin zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ 'og na gnyis te bshang ba'i lam dang gci ba'i lam mo/ / mgo bor ni dri ma'i gnas bdun te/ mig gnyis dang rna ba'i bu ga gnyis dang / sna'i bu ga gnyis dang / lkog ma'i bu ga gcig ste/ bu ga ni bu ga'i khung bu rnams dang / de bzhin du rngul 'byung bar byed pa ste/ lus thams cad du gtogs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga rnams te/ de thams cad kyang dri ma'i gnas yin la/ de rnams ni gnod pa can gyi dri mas gnod pa skyed do/ / de bas na lus zungs dang dri ma'i gnas de rnams su rang rang gi gnas pa de rnams su rang gi nad skyed cing 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de yang lus zungs rnams la nyes bas gnod pa skyed la/ dri ma'i gnas rnams su ni dri mas gnod pa bskyed nas rang rang ji lta ba'i nad rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de ltar nyes pa dang lus zungs dang dri ma rnams rang gi las nyid la sogs pa'i khyad par gyis bshad nas/ da ni nyes pa dang lus zungs dang dri ma rnams kyi rtsa ba/ lus 'di'i nyes pa dang lus zungs dang dri ma rnams zad dam ma zad par gyur kyang srog dang bcas par zad par gyur la/ de 'phel bas srog dang bcas pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i lus gnas pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo de smras pa ni/

lus zungs dngas ma nas khu ba'i mthar thug pa rnams kyi nang na gzi can mdangs ni mchog yin te/ shin tu snying por gyur pa yin la/ de ni mdangs zhes bya bar slob dpon gyis bshad do/ / de bzhin du snying ga la gnas su zin kyang lus ma lus par khyab pa yin no/ / de yang rnam pa gnyis su bshad de/ thig le drug pa'i tshad dang khyab par byed de/ / de ni lus thams cad la khyab par byed cing thig le drug pa kha dog dkar po dang / dmar po lta bu dang / cung zad ser por snang ba khyad par du snying la gnas pa yin no/ / de yang lus ni brtan par gnas pa yin zhes bya ba ste/ de ni lus brtan par gnas pa dang / de bsrung zhing gnas par byed pa yin te/ de lus gnas shing 'jog par byed pa yin no/ / gzhan yang gang zhig 'jig cing med par gyur na/ nges par gdon mi za bar 'jig par 'gyur la/ de bzhin du mdangs gang zhig gnas shing yod par gyur na/ skyes bu de gnas shing 'tsho bar 'gyur ba dang / / de bzhin du mdangs gang las dngos po'i ngo bo rnams rnam pa du mar 'byung zhing snang bar 'gyur la/ lus la sogs pa sna tshogs par 'byung bar 'gyur zhing brten pa de ni mdangs zhes bya'o/ / de yang bsdus pa las/ 'byung ba kun gyi mdangs gang yin/ / gzi can de ni mchog tu bshad/ / de ni zla ba'i rang bzhin dag / dmar zhing cung zhig ser dang bcas/ / dang po mngal gyi snying po gang / / gang de mngal gyi dngas mar gnas/ / snying ni chags par gyur pa na/ / gang zhig sngon chad brten gyur cing / / lus kyi dngas ma snum dag dang / / srog ni gang la brten gyur la/ / gang zhig 'jigs pas 'jig 'gyur zhing / / gang gis lus can 'tsho byed la/ / snying la gnas kyang khyab gyur gang / / de ni srog gi gnas mchog yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / mdangs ni sems 'khrugs bkres sems las/ / mya ngan ngal la sogs pas zad/ / ces bya ba la/ mdangs de ni sems byung 'khrugs pa la sogs pas zad par 'gyur te sems 'khrugs pa ni khros pa'o/ /

skt: anyassaśepato lakṣaṇāntarmāha--yathābalaṃ balānatikrameṇokhṣṭamadhyāspatayā yathāsvaṃ yathayadāḥ sāṭappaṇaṭaṃkārayasaṃvarite aṇa 11. | vastusvābhāvyāt‌| etacca dopasvarūpa- | samīya dhāttasya raukṣyādikam‌ , pittasyeṣaṇyārikam‌ gchappaṇaḥ svegdhyādikaṃ yadapa ṭaśca yathāntara tāmi śraṇāni vrāḥ santo dapā vindhate ciśtār‌| yanti prathayanti| tapara kṣaṇā canaṃ dhcasyālpa| madhyabhūyastvana yathāsvaṃ ca ṭhapananamdhāmibhā| vana tāni spāṇi cihkādvita vā sna | janti | yadāsa | svapramāmasthāstadā śana sada santaḥ svekama yadhā padhaṃ ssādānchaṭāsapakayṛpmansiyani janayanti | taddhaknabhāni namaḥ 5 kṣīṇā ye doṣāste dedya ma a | yanti, bhaśradāratatana , ¦ tkaratyācca
tib: mdangs de zad cing nyams par gyur na mi sngangs pa ste/ glo bur du skrag pa dang bcas par 'gyur/ de bzhin du lus rid cing me stobs chung ba dang / yang dang yang du sems shing dpyod pa la brtson par gyur pa dang / dbang po thams cad nyams shing sdug bsngal la/ myo myo por nus pa chung bar 'gyur ba dang / gzi byin nyams shing skya bo 'od 'od por 'gyur ba dang / rtsub pa ste pags pa la sogs pa snum med pa dang / yid mi dga' zhing sems kyi mdud pa'i shas che bar 'gyur ba dang / nyam chung ba ste lus zungs rnams zad cing 'bri bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /

mdangs zad pa de'i sman ni dzi ban ti dang / nye'u shing la sogs pa 'tsho byed kyi sman rnams dang / de bzhin du 'o ma dang / sha'i khu ba dang / sogs pa'i sgras brtas par byed pa'i sman rgun 'brum la sogs pa'i sman mngar ba'i sde tshan las bstan pa rnams bsdus te/ de dag kyang de'i sman yin no/ / 'o ma yang 'tsho byed yin pas/ 'tsho byed kyi sman gyi sde tshan gyi nang du gtogs na/ ci'i phyir logs shig tu smos she na/ 'o ma ni der sman gyi mchog yin pas khyad par du smos pa yin no/ / zad pa dang 'phel ba dag ni sman mdor bsdus te smras pa ni/ zas gang mi 'dod gang zhig slong / / de la mi 'phrod 'phrod pa ni/ / spang dang sbyin par bya ba dag /

skt: ityeva̭ṃ manasi chasva bhiṣajaḥ kṣīṇadopanāyai kadācidanne nātisprahayantīvyetadāśaṅkya khakāra idamāh‌-ya eva doṣāḥ samāḥ santo hasya śārīrasya bhivṛddhathai vivṛddhayai sampadyante, te vapramāṇasthā dehavadhanahetavo bhavanti 1 eta ṇava ṣā viṣamāḥ khpramāṇādadhikā hīnāvā vadhāya maranājñāya dehasya rāsīrasya sampadyante | yata eva samā geṣā dehavadhanahetavo viṣamā dehanādānahetavo jānte ataste doṣā hitacathayatheva dīnatvādapi rakṣaṇīyāḥ 1ranīyāḥ|kuta iva vibraddhoreva|yathā civṛddhaste rakṣaṇī 1: kathaṃ sā bhavasyeṣā vivṛddhirvairopeṇa vardhanaṃ prako taṃ tathā kṣayato'pi te rakṣaṇīyā iti bhadram‌ 1 46|| dati candranandanaviracitāyāṃ padābha̭candrikāyāmaṣṭāṅgadadayaṭīkāyāṃ sūtrasthāne doṣacijñānīyo'dhyāya ekādaśaḥ
tib: bza' bar bya ba'i zas gang skyes bu mi 'dod cing 'grangs pa dang / yang zas gang zhig slong zhing 'dod par byed pa de dang de la zas mi 'phrod pa dang zhe 'grangs pa ni/ spang zhing mi bza' ba dang / 'phrod pa dang yid la 'dod pa ni sbyin zhing bza' bar bya ba gang yin pa de dang de ni nad 'phel ba dang nad zad par 'gyur ro/ / de yang 'dod cing slong ba'i zas de mi 'phrod pa med par gyur na bza' bar bya'i gzhan du ni ma yin no/ / nyes pa phyin ci log pa dang / / mthun pas sred pa skyed byed de/ / phal cher 'phel dang zad pa dag /

gang gi phyir rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa dag ni phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i zas kyis yul de la sred cing dga' ba skyed par byed la/ de yang phal cher te thams cad du ma yin no/ / zad pa ni zas kyi ris su gtogs pa dang cha 'dra zhing mthun pa'i yon tan gyis yul de sred pa skyed par byed de/ ji srid rlung 'phel ba ni/ zas snum pa dang / skyur ba dang / mngar ba la dga' ba skyed par byed pa'o/ / mkhris pa 'phel bas grang ba dang bsil ba'o/ / bad kan 'phel ba ni kha ba dang rtsub pa la sred pa skyed par byed do/ / de la zad pa la rlung zad pas snum pa dang lan tshwa'o/ / mkhris pa zad pas ni skyur ba la sogs pa'o/ / bad kan zad pas ni zas snum pa dang / mngar ba la sogs pa la dga' ba skyed par byed pa ni dngos po'i rang bzhin nam chos nyid yin no/ / de lta bu'i nyes pa'i rang bzhin ni sman pa mi mkhas shing / shes rab chung bas mi shes shing yul de'i rang bzhin shes pa de la mi skye'o/ / zhes bya ba'i don to/ / yang mtshan nyid gzhan dag mdor bsdus te smras pa ni/ ci bzhin stobs dang rang ji bzhin/ / 'phel na nyes pa rgyas par 'gyur/ / zad pas rang bzhin 'dor bar 'gyur/ / mnyam na rang gi las rnams byed/ / ces bya ba la/ nad dang nyes pa rnams kyi stobs ci lta ba dang / rang gi rang bzhin ci lta ba las tshad las 'phel bar gyur na ni/ nyes pa rgyas shing skye bar 'gyur la/ de bzhin du zad pa ste rang gi stobs ji lta ba dang / rang gi mtshan nyid chen po dang 'bring dang chung ngu ci lta ba dang / rang gi rang bzhin rtsub pa dang / dro ba dang snum pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin ci lta ba zad pa las ni nad de rnams rang gi mtshan nyid 'dor zhing spong bar 'gyur ro/ / gang gi tshe nyes pa de rnams mnyam pa ste 'phel ba yang med la zad pa yang med pa de'i tshe ni rang gi tshad dang ldan par gnas pa yin te/ de'i tshe na ni mnyam zhing mi 'gyur bar gnas pa nyid kyis na/ rang gi las nad la sogs pa'i tshul shes par bya ba las bshad pa/ dbugs rngub pa dang dbugs dbyung ba la sogs pa'i las de rnams byed cing skyed pa yin no/ / mtshan nyid des na de rnams mnyam zhing 'gyur ba med par shes par bya'o/ / nyes pa zad pa rnams ni lus la nyes pa ci yang skyed par mi byed de/ mi ldang ba'i phyir dang / nus pa zad pa'i phyir dang / ci yang mi byed pa yin pa'i phyir nyes pa ci yang skyed par mi byed do snyam du sems nas/ sman pa dag nyes pa zad pa 'phel ba'i phyir/ / bza' ba dag ster bar byed pa la sbyor bar byed pa ni nam yang ma gyur cig snyam nas smras pa ni/

nyes pa gang zhig mnyam zhing snyoms par gyur pas lus 'phel bar byed pa'i don du 'gyur te rang gi tshad dang ldan par gnas pa ni lus mnyam pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ / nyes pa de nyid mi mnyam zhing rang gi tshad las lhag pa'am chad par gyur na lus gsod par 'gyur ro/ / gang gi phyir nyes pa mnyam pa ni lus 'phel ba'i rgyu yin la/ mi mnyam pa ni lus gsod pa'i rgyu yin pa de bas na/ nyes pa rnams zad kyang 'phel ba bzhin du phan pa'i spyod pas bsrung bar bya ste/ ji ltar 'di rnams 'phel nas nad ldang zhing gnod par 'gyur bas na/ khyad par du mi 'phel ba'i phyir srung bar byed pa bzhin du zad pa las kyang rjes su mthun zhing phan pa'i spyod pa nyid kyis kyang bsrung zhing bskyang bar bya'o/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel ba tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/

skt: tacra tāvancharīre sthānavibhāgagaṃ vātādrīnāṃ nirūpayannāha---pakādāyaprabhṛi vātaśdhānam‌ | tatra pakāśayo nābheradhaḥ | kaṭi; śroṇiḥ | savathyūraḥ | bhatraṃ karṇaḥ | sparakhānendiyaṃ tvak‌ | tatrāpi tepvapi sthāneṣu virepeṇa pakādhānaṃ sthānaṃ vānasya | pakmādhīyate'smibhiti rasvā
tib: sngar nad la sogs pa'i tshul shes par bya ba bshad mod kyi/ nad rnams ni tha dad par 'byung ba yin pas/ de'i phyir nad kyi dbye ba shes par bya ba med par nad ma lus pa'i tshul shes par 'gyur ba bshad pa ma yin pas de'i phyir nad la sogs pa'i tshul shes par bya ba'i 'og tu nad kyi dbye ba shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad pa yin no/ / de la nad rnams kyi dbye ba ni nad kyi dbye ba ste/ gnas dang ming dang / dbye ba la sogs pa'i rab tu dbye bas shes par bya zhing rtogs par bya ba ste/ / de la phan pa'i gzhung ni nad kyi dbye ba shes par bya ste/ de'i le'u bshad cing bstan par bya'o zhes pa'o/ / de la re zhig rlung la sogs pa lus la gnas pa'i dbye ba'i nges par brtag pa smras pa ni/

skt: kaphasyāraḥtrabhṛtinpānay‌ ¦ sannāma vakṣa | nāmeradhaḥ paktānnasya sthāna kaṭiśrogisakṣayarvakṣaṇādi, māśyā nabherūdhvam‌ 1. dharāṃ tānikrā | jiha aguṣaṭhātam‌ | śaredriyaṃ karṇaḥ | saśaraṃ vad‌ | rasanendariyam‌ | atroye vakṣaḥ sunarāmaniśayena taca teṣu sthāniṣu mabhye pakvādhānaṃ pakvādarayo virepata | dhyānaṃ kaphasya || ‰ || dati
tib: rlung gi gnas ni zhu ba'i gnas la sogs pa yin te/ lte ba'i 'og nas rked pa dang / dpyi dang / rna ba dang / rus pa dang / reg pa'i dbang po ste/ pags pa rnams yin la/ de rnams kyi nang nas kyang zhu ba'i gnas ni rlung gi khyad par gyi gnas yin te/ zas 'ju ba rnams gang na gnas shing brten pa de ni lhag par rlung gi gnas yin no/ / mkhris gnas lte ba pho ba rngul/ / chu ser dngas ma khrag dang ni/ / mig dang pags pa dag yin te/ / de las lte ba khyad par gnas/ / zhes bya ba la/ / mkhris pa'i gnas ni lte ba la sogs pa yin te/ pho ba ni lte ba yan chad kyi ma zhu ba'i gnas spyi la bya'o/ / chu ser ni pags pa'i sha mdangs na chur gnas te 'dug pa la bya ste/ pags pa phrugs pa las chu'i rnam par byung bar snang ba'o/ / dngas ma dang khrag ni lus zungs dang po dang gnyis pa'o/ / mig ni mig gi dbang po'o/ / pags pa ni reg pa'i dbang po ste/ de ni rlung gnas yin par bstan mod kyi/ mkhris pa'i yang de nyid yin te/ rlung gi grogs yin pa'i phyir ro/ / 'dir gnas de dag las kyang lte ba ni khyad par gyi gnas yin no/ /

tib: bad kan gyi gnas ni brang la sogs pa yin no/ / de la brang ni thong kha'i gnas so/ / mgul pa ni lkog ma'o/ / mgo bo ni spyi bo'o/ / glo ba ni khong pa'i nang cha ste/ lus kyi yan lag gi dbye ba las 'og nas bshad do/ / rus tshigs ni tshigs kyi mdud pa'o/ / pho ba'i gnas ni lte ba yan chad do/ / dngas ma la sogs pa ni go bar zad do/ / 'dir gnas 'di rnams kyi nang na brang ni bad kan gyi khyad par gyi gnas so/ / rlung ni srog sogs dbye ba yis/ / lnga yi bdag nyid/ ces bya ba la/ rlung gcig pu g.yo ba'i bdag nyid can/ gcig pu ni srog dang / stod du rgyu ba dang / khyab byed dang / me dang mnyam du gnas pa dang / thur du sel ba zhes bya ba rnam pa lnga'i bdag nyid can du gnas pa la sogs pa'i dbye bas 'gyur ro/ / 'dir srog ni/ spyir gnas brang dang gre bar rgyu/ / blo dang dbang po sems 'dzin byed/ / mchil 'dor sbrid 'byung sgregs pa 'don/ / dbugs rngub zas ni mid par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ 'dir lnga po 'di dag gi nang nas srog ces bya ba'i rlung ni spyi bor gnas shing mgo la brten pa dang / brang dang gre bar rgyu zhing 'gro ba dang / blo dang dbang po dang sems 'dzin par byed pa dang / mchil ma la sogs pa 'dor zhing 'byin par byed do/ / mchil ma ni kha nas bad kan 'byung ba'o/ / dbugs rngub pa ni dbugs nang du sdud pa'o/ / gyen rgyu'i gnas ni brang yin te/ / sna dang lce dang lkog mar rgyu/ / tshig 'byin 'bad rtsol mdangs dang ni/ / stobs dang kha dog dran las byed/ / ces bya ba la/ rlung gyen du rgyu ba'i gnas ni brang yin te/ der brten nas sna la sogs pa gsum du rgyu bar byed do/ / de'i dbye ba ni tshig 'byin pa la sogs pa yin te/
