tib: rlung khyab byed ces bya ba ni snying la gnas te/ lus kun ma lus par khyab cing rgyu ba yin la/ rab tu mgyogs pa ste myur du 'gro zhing shas cher mgyogs pa yin no/ / de'i las ni 'gro ba la sogs pa'i lus can te/ sems can gyi bya ba thams cad las phal cher te/ mang du rlung de las rag las shing ltos pa yin no/ / de yang 'gro ba ni yul nas yul gzhan du 'gro ba la sogs pa'o/ / 'degs pa ni gyen du 'dren pa'o/ / 'jog pa ni yan lag smad de 'jog pa'o/ / mig 'byed pa ni mig gi rdzi ma gnyis 'byed pa'o/ / 'dzums pa ni de nyid 'dzums pa'o/ / mnyam gnas me drod nye bar gnas/ / nang khrol kun tu rgyu ba yin/ / bya ba zas len 'ju ba dang / / dngas snyigs 'byed cing 'dor bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ rlung me dang mnyam du gnas pa zhes bya ba ni/ pho ba'i me drod dang nye bar gnas te/ nang grol gyi nang na ma zhu ba'i gnas zhes bya ba der brten nas nang grol du rgyu zhing spyod pa yin la/ de'i las kyi bye brag ni zas len cing 'dzin pa dang de bzhin du 'ju zhing smin par byed pa dang dngas snyigs 'byed cing bye brag 'byed pa dang phyi rol du 'dor zhing 'byin par byed pa yin no/ / thur sel gzhang gnas 'dong mo dang / / lgang pa pho mtshan brla nang rgyu/ / bya ba khu ba zla mtshan dang / / bshang gci mngal nas 'byin par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ rlung thur du sel ba zhes bya ba ni gzhang na gnas pa ste/ rked pa'i 'og na 'dug pa dang / de bzhin du 'dong mo zhes bya ba mjug to'i nang la sogs pa'i gnas na rgyu ba dang / lgang pa dang pho mtshan dang brla'i nang na rgyu ba yin no/ / bya ba'i las ni khu ba dang zla mtshan 'byin pa la sogs pa yin no/ / mkhris pa'i rang bzhin lnga/

tib: bad kan brtas byed ni mgo bor gnas nas/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rnams tshim par byed cing brtas par byed pas na/ ming brtas byed ces bya'o/ / 'byor byed ni/ tshigs la gnas nas 'byor par byed/ / brten pas ni zhi bar gyur pa yin na/ 'dir gzhan dag la ltos shing rag las pa ni cung zad kyang med de/ thams cad kyang yon tan mnyam pas ni 'phel bar 'gyur la/ mi mthun pas ni zhi bar byed pa yin no snyam du sems pa la/ de'i phyir gzhung rtsom par byed pas 'di skad ces smras pa ni/ rtsub sogs dro bar ldan pa ni/ / rlung ni sogs par 'gyur ba yin/ / grang bas ldang byed snum la sogs/ / yon tan dro ldan zhi byed 'gyur/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ rtsub pa la sogs pa'i yon tan ni rtsub pa dang / bsil bar byed pa dang / phra ba dang g.yo ba dag ni yon tan dro ba dang ldan zhing / / rlung gi gnyen por gyur cing de dang mi mthun pa'i yon tan dang ldan na rlung nad sogs shing 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin te/ rlung gi yon tan gyi spyi'i mtshan nyid tsam dang ldan pa'i rtsub pa la sogs pa dag ni/ rlung sogs de/ snum pa dang / lci ba dang / phra ba dang / sbom pa dang / brtan pa dag dro ba'i yon tan dang ldan na rlung rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /

tib: snum pa'i yon tan ni lci ba dang / rtul ba dang / 'jam pa dang / brtan pa ste/ bad kan gyi yon tan dang cha mnyam pa dag / grang dang ldan pa yis/ zhes bya ba bad kan gyi yon tan grang ba dang tib: de bzhin du phyin ci log pa'i yon tan 'dod/ ces bya bas ni rgyu bstan pa yin no/ / de ltar na gang gi tshe rlung la sogs par 'gyur ba de'i tshe rtsub pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang cha mthun pa rnams/ dkyel du gyur pa'i rgyu las 'khrugs par 'gyur la/ de dang mi mthun pa'i yon tan snum pa la sogs pa 'dod cing / mngon par dga' ba las 'di'i rjes su dpag par bya'o/ / des na 'di skad ston par 'gyur te/ rang gi gnas te nad rang nyid kyi gnas su gang 'phel bar gyur pa de ni sogs pa yin la/ nad rnams sogs par gyur nas dkyel du gyur pa'i rgyu las ni 'khrugs shing g.yos par gyur pa dang / de dang mi mthun pa'i yon tan snum pa la sogs pa 'dod pa skyes par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: kopaḥ punaḥ vṛddhirevādhikyāt‌| doṣasya sva nāt‌ sthānāntaragamane svadhāmaparilayāga krā māga ntaragābhitā | kopastṛnmārmagābhanitesyanena kopaḥ ṣā māghyate | anyathā vṛddhimātrasāmānyāñcayakaropayoreḥ rūpatevāpayate | cayaḥ svadhābhnyeva doṣasya yā vṛddhi vṛddhiṣiroṣaścayahetuḥ | sāmaprī tatsāmabhrayantaraḥ svadhāmaparityāgaṃ karatā doṣāṇāṃ māgantiragābhitā kopa ityucyate | tathāca pūvameva prātipāditasuṣṇe yuktā rūkṣāthā ityanena | asyaiva cayadeturanya e kopadaiturakampyametaṭiṣgānāṃ dadanam‌ | kheṣāṃ yatha yatha doṣalakṣaṇānāmuddhavaratathā svāsthyamuṣpisuyo cchāyāsāmānyena dehamanobhūtatvam‌. | tathā sagara smava inena taskāyamuktaṃ tatsattālumāpakam‌ | e nakekasmādapi keṣalānnidhacitaṃ dopakopa unmā, śakyate, yato vyabhicārānna sarvo doṣaḥ khapramāṇā 1 kontato'bāparikaḥ pāṭha upalankato } dhyānam‌ ] pathikasya unmārgagāmirogaścorapādako yena segasabhavena tasya doṣasya kopa unmīyate yataḥ svapramāgādvīno'pi doṣo bakhvatā janyeta doṣeṇābhimūtaḥ vamāra parityajyonmāgagābhetvasāmānyaṃ yathākhaṃ gagamapi kurute | tasmāhakṣaṇatrayametadoṣakopaparitānāṃ boddhanyamivyarūmadhikākṣeṣeṇa 1 svasthānasthasya pamatāvikārāṇāmasambhavaḥ sa śama iti saṅprahokto'tra pāṭho vijñeyaḥ | svasthānasthasya samatā sāmyaṃ para rāmaḥ| tathā vikāsaṇāṃ vyādhīnāmasambhavo vyādhayo na prādurbhavanti tena chakṣuṇena śamo'numīyate
tib: yang ldang ba ni 'phel zhing lhag par gyur ba las/ nad rnams rang gi gnas las gnas gzhan du 'gro ba ste/ rang gi gnas spangs nas/ log pa'i lam gzhan du zhugs par 'gyur te/ ldang ba log pa'i lam zhugs nyid/ / ces bya ba 'dis ni nad ldang ba ston pa yin no/ / gzhan du na 'phel ba tsam gyi rang bzhin du mthun pas na tshul gcig pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ / des na sogs pa ni rang gi gnas nyid du nad gang 'phel bar ma gyur pa la bya la/ ldang ba'i khyad par ni sogs pa'i rgyu'i tshogs las gzhan du gyur ba ste/ rang gi gnas yongs su spangs nas nad rnams lam gzhan du zhugs pa gang yin pa de la ldang ba zhes bya'o/ / de bas na/ rtsub sogs dro bar ldan pas ni/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pas sngar bstan pa nyid kyis sogs pa'i rgyu ni gzhan yin la/ ldang ba'i rgyu yang gzhan yin par bshad pa 'di ni nges pa yin no/ / de bzhin du/ rang gi rtags ni ston pa dang / / zhes bya ba ste/ nad kyi mtshan nyid ji lta ji lta bar byung ba de lta de ltar nad rnams 'byung zhing ldang bar 'dod la/ spyir lus dang sems zil gyis gnon par byed pa nyid la/ bde ba med pa zhes bya'o/ / de bzhin du nad ni 'byung 'gyur ba'o zhes bya ba 'dis ni rjes su dpog par byed pa'i rgyu ston par byed pa'o/ / de ltar na rgyu la sogs pa re re 'ba' zhig las nad rnams ldang bar rjes su dpag par nus pa ma yin te/ mi mthun zhing cha mi 'dra ba nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ / yang nyes pa thams cad ni rang gi tshad las lhag kyang lam de nyid na gnas nas nad skyed par byed par ma zad pas/ nad gang 'byung ba las de'i rjes su dpag par bya'o/ / de yang gang gi phyir nad rang gi tshad las chung bar gyur kyang / nad stobs can gzhan zil gyis gnon pa dang / rang gi gnas spangs te log pa'i lam du gyur nas/ rang gi nad ji lta ba nyid shas cher skyed par byed do/ / de bas na mtshan nyid gsum po 'di dag ni/ nad rnams yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir smras pa yin gyi lhag par smras pas ci zhig bya/

'dir tshig 'di ni bsdus pa las byung ba yin par shes par bya'o/ / de la nad rnams rang gi gnas na gnas pa mnyam pa nyid gang yin pa de ni zhi ba yin no/ / de bzhin du nad rnams kyi rnam par gyur ba ma byung zhing ma skyes pa'i mtshan nyid des kyang zhi bar rjes su dpag par bya'o/ / nad rnams sogs pa dang ldang ba dang / zhi ba'i mtshan nyid bshad nas/ / da ni rlung la sogs pa dus gang dang gang gi tshe na sogs pa dang ldang ba dang / zhi bar 'gyur ba bstan pa'i phyir smras pa ni/ sogs dang ldang dang rab zhi ba/ / rlung ni so ga sogs gsum tshe/ / mkhris pa dbyar la sogs par to/ / bad kan dgun smad sogs par re/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ / gong du bstan pa'i nad sogs pa dang ldang ba dang / rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba dag rlung la sogs pa re re dang sbyar ba las/

skt: dopasaścayadopakopayoṅakṣaṇamabhidhāyedānīṃ vātādīnāṃ yasmin‌ kāle cayaprakopopadayamā mada nti taṃ kāṃ dadaiyitumāh‌-krāṅeṣu yathākrama cayana prakopopaḍāmā bhavanti | tatra mrīpme vāyoścayaḥ | saṭipyaṇaṭīkāmathasaṃvaṣite a0 11. ( 597 \ vapā prakopaḥ| śaradi praśamaḥ | varṣādiṣu tri kāleṣu pittasya cayaghrakopopadayamā bhavanti | varpīra cayaḥ | rārāde prakopaḥ | hemante praśamaḥ | śiśa rādiṣu triṣu kareṣu ṣmaṇaścayaprakopoparāmā bha banti | tatra̱ śikere śeṣmaṇancayaḥ | vasanaḥ prakopaḥ | rīpame pradmamaḥ
tib: so ga'i dus su sogs par 'gyur la/ dbyar gyi tshe ldang bar 'gyur zhing / stan ni rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ / mkhris pa ni dbyar la sogs pa'i dus gsum du sogs pa dang ldang ba dang zhi bar 'gyur te/ dbyar ni sogs par 'gyur ro/ / ston ni ldang ngo / / dgun ni zhi bar 'gyur ro/ / bad kan ni dgun smad la sogs pa'i dus gsum du sogs pa dang ldang ba dang / rab tu zhi bar 'gyur te/ de la dgun smad ni sogs par 'gyur ro/ / dpyid ni ldang bar 'gyur ro/ / so ga ni rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa rlung 'di ni so ga sogs par mi 'thad kyi/ / ldang ba'i dus yin no/ / de yang ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i tshe yang zhing rtsub pa'i dus yin pas/ sman phal cher yang de dang rjes su mthun pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du dbyar yang mkhris pa sogs par mi 'thad de/ chu rnams skyur ba nyid du zhu bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du sman rnams kyang skyur ba smin pas mkhris pa ldang ba'i dus yin no/ / de bzhin du bad kan yang dgun sogs par mi 'thad de/ chu rnams snum pa dang / sman rnams kyang snum pa nyid yin la/ dus kyang grang ba nyid kyis na/ de'i tshe ldang bar 'gyur gyi/ sogs par mi 'gyur ro zhe na de'i phyir smras pa ni/ yang dang rtsub pa la sogs pa'i/ / sman dang lus kyang de mtshungs pas/ / so ga rlung ni sogs 'gyur gyi/ / dro ba'i dus kyis ldang mi 'gyur/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ sogs pa ste so ga'i dus su yang ba dang / rtsub pa la sogs pa'i sman rnams dang / lus kyang de bzhin du yang ba dang / rtsub pa la sogs pa yin pa dang / dus kyang yang ba dang rtsub pa yin pas/ rlung yang dus kyi rang bzhin gyis yang ba dang rtsub pa nyid yin te/ de bas na yon tan cha mtshungs pa nyid kyis rlung ldang bar rigs mod kyi/ so ga'i tshe rlung sogs par 'gyur gyi/ ldang bar mi 'gyur/ de gang gis she na/ dro ba'i dus kyis ldang mi 'gyur/ / zhes bya ba 'dis bkag par gyur pa yin te/ dro ba nyid kyis na rgyu snga ma nyam chung bar byas pa yin pa'i phyir ldang bar mi 'gyur gyi sogs pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /

dbyar chu rnams kyis 'ju ba skyur bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du sman yang de dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba'i rnam pa yin pas/ mkhris pa de yang de dang 'dra bar sogs par 'gyur gyi/ ldang bar ni mi 'gyur te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ / dbyar smad kyi tshe grang ba yin pas na ldang bar mi 'gyur te/ grang ba ni dro ba'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs yin pas grang ba 'dis ldang ba'i gnas byed pa yin no/ /

dgun smad ni chu dang sman bsil ba dang / snum pa dang / dus kyang bsil ba dang snum pa yin pa'i phyir/ bad kan dang dus la sogs pa mtshungs shing 'dra ba yin du zin kyang / dus kyi rang bzhin gyis ldang bar mi 'gyur gyi/ sogs pa kho nar 'gyur ro/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ grang bas bsgongs shing mar 'khyags pa ltar gyur pas ldang bar mi 'gyur te/

skt: vaṇyaṃta iti vākyaśeṣaḥ | ya ete cayā[yo mīpsādivṛktāste kāṭhasvabhāvamābhitya vi7: | tathā coktam‌ “samayoge'pi dharmādyā vātādibayahetavaḥ ” kiṃ kāla eva doṣāṇāṃ cayādihetuḥ | pato'nye'pi vidyante
tib: gang bsags pa la sogs pa so ga la sogs pa'i tshe 'byung ba bshad pa de ni dus kyi rang bzhin la brten nas bshad pa yin te/ de yang / so ga la sogs sbyor mtshungs kyang / / zhes bya ste/ rlung la sogs pa'i rgyu bshad pa yin no/ / ci nad rnams sogs pa la/ sogs pa'i rgyu dus 'ba' zhig tu zad dam/ gzhan dag kyang yod ce na/ / de'i phyir smras pa ni/

skt: ata prāha-āhārādivaśādannapānasāmathyauḥ dādigrahaṇādramanāṣisvanādāśthāpanāibhramādaḍhayāpatsāmarthyādoṣā vātādyaścayaprakopapraśamān‌ yānti sadyo tarakṣaṇādeva cayādikālamanepekyeva tasmādeva cāhārādivaśādyathāsvaṃ cayādidoṣakāṭhe cavā | nanu doṣacayādīn‌ yānti tasmākārato dyāhārādī nāṃ prādhānyāt‌
tib: zas la sogs pa'i dbang gis te/ zas dang skom la sogs pa'i nus pa dang / sogs pa zhes bya ba slon sman dang / / 'khru sman dang / 'jam rtsi mas gtong ba dang / dub pa la sogs pa'i dbang gis kyang rlung la sogs pa'i nad sogs pa dang / ldang ba dang / rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ / de yang rgyu de dag gis dus de dag la phyin cing skabs la bab par ma gyur kyang / de dag la ltos pa med par 'phral du ste/ de'i mod la sogs pa'i dus la sdod pa med par zas la sogs pa de'i dbang gis sogs pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ / yang na sogs pa'i dus su nad la sogs par mi 'gyur gyi zas la sogs pa nyid las 'gyur ro/ /

skt: mado vātakaphākhyo makhinīkaraṇānmarusaṃjñaḥ prakupitaḥ praduṣṭo deha śarīram‌ āpādataramastakaṃ karasnaṃ sahasā śaṭiti vyāpnoti ākramati | sa eva̱ makhaḥ punastasmāt‌ śārīrānnivavete cikitsayā śama̭ yāti | alpāspaṃ rānaiḥ damaiḥ karatvā | ka iva yathā jarasyau- , ghaḥ samūhaḥ setu bhittvā sahasā vyāpnoti! sa caughaḥ punaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ tasmāt‌ sthānānnivaṣete niyati | tadoṣā api _| evamavadayaṃ doṣāḥ kupitāḥ savai vikāraṃ kuaite
tib: nad ni lus nyon mongs par byed pa ste/ rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan la sogs pa'o/ / de ldang bar gyur pa ni 'khrugs par gyur ba ste/ de'i tshe ni 'phral du zhes pa mod la lus kyi mgo nas rkang gi bar du ma lus par khyab cing gnod par 'gyur ro/ / nad de nyid lus las ldog par gyur cing / gso bas zhi bar byas pa na/ cung zhig cung zhig gis zhi bar 'gyur te/ de yang / dper na chu yi rgyun bzhin du/ / zhes bya ba ste/ dper na chu'i rgyun skye ba dang / de'i tshogs kyis zam pa yang khyer nas/ mod la kun tu khyab cing 'gro bar byed la/ chu'i rgyun de 'bri ba na/ gnas de las rim gyis cung zad cung zad kyis ldog cing 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du nad rnams kyang ldang bar gyur na/ nyes pa thams cad skyed par 'gyur gyi/ 'bri ba'i tshe na ni de lta ma yin no/ / nad thams cad la rnam par 'gyur ba re re zhing nad gzhi dang gso ba'i mtshan nyid mtha' yas bstan par mi nus pas de'i phyir de bsal ba la yang 'bad par mi byed do snyam du dogs pa'i phyir 'dir smras pa ni/ nad 'khrugs sna tshogs tshul can ni/ / grangs med par ni gyur pa'i lus/ / thams cad nye bar gzir gyur pa/ / de rgyu tshul dang bsgrub pa dag/ / re re nas ni bstan mi nus/ / de bas spyi yi brjod pa yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ rlung la sogs pa'i nad 'khrugs par gyur cing / rnam par ldang bar gyur na sna tshogs pa'i tshul can du 'byung ba'i nad rnam pa tha dad pa'i mtshan nyid can grangs med cing / brtsi ba las 'das pas lus thams cad nye bar gzir zhing gdungs par gyur te/ lus sdug bsngal bar byed do zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de bas na de dag gi rgyu'i tshul gyis 'byin par byed pa dag gi mtshan nyid dang / bsgrub cing gso bar bya ba dag gi re re nas zhes pa/ nad kyi tshul so so nas ming gis bstan par mi nus te/ nad 'di'i rgyu ni 'di yin no/ / 'di'i mtshan nyid ni 'di yin no/ / gso ba ni 'di ltar bya'o zhes bstan par shin tu dka' ste/ de bas na spyi'i brjod pa yin te/ spyir khyab pa'i tshig gang yin pa de nyid bshad cing brjod pa yin no/ / de nyid kyang gang zhe na/ nad rnams dag ni thams cad kyi/ / nyes pa'i rgyu ni gcig pu nyid/ / ces bya ba yin te/ 'di ltar nad thams cad kyi rgyu ni nyes pa nyid gcig pu rgyur gyur pa yin te/ rgyu yang yin la gcig pu nyid kyang yin te/ gtso bo'i rgyur gyur pa'am/ yang na thams cad kyi spyi'i mtshungs pa'i rgyu yin pas na rgyu gcig pu ste/ thun mong gi rgyu zhes bya ba'i don to/ / nyid ces bya ba ni nges par gzung ba'i phyir smos pa yin te/ nad kyi rgyu ni gcig pu nyid yin gyi/ dngos po'i rigs gzhan dag ni ma yin te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ / don 'di'i dpe bstan par bya ba'i phyir tshig tu smras pa ni/ dper na bya ni lding gyur pa/ / nyin rangs kun tu song gyur kyang / / rang gi grib ma dang mi 'bral/ / 'gro kun de dang 'dra ba yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ dper na khra la sogs pa'i bya rnams lding bar gyur pa na nyin rangs te/ nyin thog thag kun song zhing lding bar gyur kyang / rang gi grib ma dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur zhing / grib ma de dang bral bar skad cig kyang mi snang ste/ 'gro ba'i nad kyi tshul yang de dang 'dra'o/ / yang don 'di'i dpe gzhan dag bstan pa'i phyir/ smras pa ni/ yang na ji ltar ma lus pa'i/ / 'gro ba mi 'dra sna tshogs 'di/ / yon tan gsum dang mi 'bral lo/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ dpe'i rnam pa gzhan yang ma lus pa'i 'gro ba rang bzhin mi 'dra ba/ mngal nas skyes pa la sogs pa'i dbye bas tha dad pa'am/ rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba la sogs pa'i dbye bas phye ba sna tshogs shing rigs tha dad pa 'di dag kyang / yon tan gsum po snying stobs dang / rdul dang mun pa'i tshul dang mi 'bral zhing de las mi 'da' ste/ yon tan gsum po 'di dag dang nam yang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /

skt: sāmānyaṃ yadvāpi yadvacanaṃ tadevāsyāyatesarveṣāṃ rogāṇāmekaṃ ca turyaṃ kāraṇamekakāraṇam‌ | samācakārṇabhirayathaḥ | pvakāsvavāramāai; | ta evaṃ sogactāraṇaṃ nānyat‌ kicvidrastutāvam‌ | bhāṃ sannasvāt‌ | asyāthesyodādaraṇaṃ pradoyitumāda-yathā pakṣī yenādiḥ svetaḥ paripatan‌ samantāḥ daracchan‌ sarvabhapyahuḥ sakaṭa dinamāsmīyāṃ chāyaṃ nāyeti nātikrāmati | tayā bhinā kruṇamapyasau na dṛśayate | kiṃcānyadpyamukhyārthasya niddanamapyāhū-yathā vā kṛtsnamapyad‌ḥ sakalametajjayadvikāḥ \rajātaṃ jarāyujadidimedabhinnaṃ sthāvasjaṅgamādibhed‌ aṣṭāṅkadadaya | 8 bhana bhinnamapi talyuna sidhā bhidyate hīm‌ bhibhyātiyogeneyeḥ | tadeva triprakāraṃ bhūyo' bhidyate
tib: dpe de bzhin du rang khams ma snyoms pa'i rgyu yang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du nad kyi rigs su bshad pa/ nyes pa gsum po dang nam yang mi 'bral lo/ / de yang rlung la sogs pa'i khams 'di rnams ni lus 'dzin par byed pa yin du zin kyang gal te khams ma snyoms par gyur na de yang nad kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ / nad dang dri ma'i tshul gyis ma snyoms pa med par yang / nad kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dir yang zhes bya ba'i sgra khyad par du smras pa yin no/ / de rnams kyis ni ldang ba'i rgyu/ / dbang don mi 'tsham phrad pa dang / / dus dang nyes pa'i las rnams so/ / zhes bya ba la/ / rlung la sogs pa de rnams kyi ldang zhing 'khrugs par byed pa'i rgyu ni/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po'i don mi mthun zhing 'tsham pa ma yin pa dang / phrad cing 'brel pa dang / dus mi 'dra ba ste/ grang ba dang / dro ba dang / char la sogs pa dang / de bzhin du las nyes par spyad pa tshe snga ma'am/ 'dir lus dang ngag dang / yid rnam pa gsum gyi las mi dge ba byas pa de thams cad ni rlung la sogs pa 'khrugs shing ldang ba'i rgyu yin no/ /

gang rlung la sogs pa 'di dag gi rgyu'i tshul sngar rnam par dbye ba byas su zin kyang / yang de dman pa dang / lhag pa dang / log pa'i sbyor bas dbye ba rnam pa gsum du 'gyur te/ snga ma de dag re re zhing yang gsum du 'gyur ba yin no/ / dbang don rang yul chung ngu'am/ / mi sbyor ba

gang mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rnams gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams la rang gi yul chung ngu la sbyor ba'am/ rang gi yul la mi sbyor zhing ma tshang ba de ni dman pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ / yang rang gi yul shas cher gtad cing bsten drags pa ni lhag pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ / rab phra'i 'od dang 'jigs pa dang / / shin tu nye dang shin tu ring / / yid du mi 'ong mi sdug pa'i/ / gzugs la mig ni lta byed pa/ / log sbyor de ni mi zad yin/ / zhes bya ba la/ / log pa'i sbyor ba ni rang rang gi dbang po'i yul rab tu phra ba'i 'od mig gi dbang pos lta zhing brtag par byed pa de ni rang gi yul la log par sbyor ba yin no/ / de bzhin du shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs la lta ba la sogs pa rjes su mi mthun zhing gnod pa skyed par byed pa dag kyang log pa'i sbyor ba yin te/

skt: rāgdehikaṃ karamahikaṃ ca yadaṅubha̭carividhaṃ kāyavāṅmanobhedena chate tatsava vātādīnāṃ praduṣṭau nimittam‌ | yadetadvātādīnāṃ trividhena rūpeṇa kāraṇaṃ ` dhyānam‌ | ravyaniviṣṭo yo sso ssanedriyeṇa gṛhate sa tasya rasanaidriyaspa sena rasāsyenā'thana midhyāyogaḥ
tib: phyogs 'dir bsdu ba ni dbang po'i don rab tu mthong ba dang / rul ba la sogs pa yang log pa'i sbyor ba'i rang bzhin can yin par ji lta ba bzhin du shes par bya'o/ / de yang ji ltar mya ngan skyed pa la sogs pa'i sgra mi sdug pa drag po rna ba'i dbang pos thos pa ni log pa'i sbyor bar 'gyur ro/ / gang gi tshe rul zhing zhigs par gyur cing / mi gtsang ba myags pa la sogs pa'i dri mi sdug pa sna'i dbang pos tshor ba na/ rang gi yul dri zhes bya ba 'di sna'i dbang po'i log pa'i sbyor ba yin no/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni/ lce'i yul lan tshwa shas cher bro ba la sogs pa dang / de bzhin du reg bya'i yul shin tu tsha ba dang / shin tu grang ba la sogs pa ni rang gi yul log pa'i sbyor ba yin par bstan te/ de dag ni nad rnams ldang ba'i rgyu yin par bshad do/ / de dag thams cad ni drang srong tsa ra kas gsal ba kho nar bshad de/ / de yang rang gi nus pas shas cher lta ba ni lhag par sbyor ba'o/ / phyis mi mthong bar gyur pa ni dman pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / phra ba dang / shin tu thag nye ba dang / shin tu thag ring ba dang / drag cing mi bzad pa dang / 'jigs pa dang / zhe 'gras pa dang / mi sdug pa dang / skrag par byed pa la sogs pa'i gzugs mthong ba ni log pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / de bzhin du rnga bo che drag tu brdungs pa la sogs pa'i sgra gsang mtho ba la lhag par gtad de mnyan pa ni lhag pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / thams cad du mi thos pa ni dman pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / sgra rtsub pa dang / sdug pa dang bral ba dang / 'dar ba'i sgra dang 'jigs pa'i sgra thos pa ni log pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / de bzhin du 'dzag cing rul ba'i dri shin tu rno zhing drag pa shas cher bsnoms pa ni log pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / rnam pa thams cad du ma bsnoms pa ni dman pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / rul ba la snom pa la sogs pa 'di ni log pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / yang khrus la sogs pa'i tsha ba dang / grang ches pa bsten pa dang / / 'chol bar bsten pa dang / gnod pa dang mi gtsang ba la sogs pa ni log pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / dus kyang grang dang tsha ba dang / / char dus dbye bas gsum du 'dod/ / ces bya ba la/ de bzhin du dus kyang grang ba dang / tsha ba la sogs pa'i dbye bas rnam pa gsum yin te/ de la grang ba ni dgun stong dang / dgun smad ces bya ba'o/ / tsha ba ni so ga'o/ / dbyar ni char gyi dus so/ / de'i dman pa'i sbyor ba dang / lhag pa'i sbyor ba dang / log pa'i sbyor ba bstan pa'i phyir/ de dman grang sogs chung ba dang / / lhag sbyor shin tu che mtshan nyid/ / rang gi mtshan nyid phyin ci log / log pa'i sbyor ba yin par bshad/ / ces bya ba la/ de bzhin du grang ba dang / tsha ba dang / char gyi dus dang / dgun dang / so ga dang / dbyar zhes bya ba'i mtshan nyid can/ sngar ji tsam gyi tshad du bstan pa de las gang cung zhig shin tu dman par snang ba de nyid ni dus dang mi sbyor ba yin pas na/ chung ba'am/ dman pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ / lhag pa'i sbyor ba ni gang gsum po de dag rang gi tshad las kyang ches lhag par ston pa/ de ni lhag pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ / log pa'i sbyor ba ni rang gi mtshan nyid las phyin ci log pa ste/ ji ltar dgun gyi dus su dro ba dang / so ga'i dus su grang ba dang / dbyar gyi dus su char mi 'bab pa'o/ / las kyang dbye ba rnam pa gsum du bshad de/ smras pa ni/ lus ngag yid kyi dbye ba yis/ / las kyang rnam pa gsum du bshad/ / ces bya ba la/ las zhes bya ba ni sbyor ba'i rgyu yang lus dang ngag dang yid kyi dbye bas rnam pa gsum du bshad do/ /
lus kyi las dang / ngag gi las dang / de bzhin du yid kyi las rnams kyang / rang gi yul dag la gang dman par 'jug pa de ni dman pa'i sbyor ba yin no/ /
lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las rnams la gang rung brtan ngas shing drag tu sbyor ba de ni lhag pa'i sbyor ba yin no/ /

log pa'i sbyor ba ni shugs bkag pa nas brtsams te/ rdeg 'chos shing gom pa 'khyor ba la sogs pa'i bar gyis las gang yin pa de lta bu la 'jug pa gang yin pa de ni lus kyi log pa'i sbyor ba'o/ / de la shugs bkag pa ni rgyu ba brnags pa'o/ / shugs btsir ba ni kha nang du bltas par gyur pa phyir phyogs par byas pa'o/ /

skt: tathā kāḥ rītoṣṇādibhedena tridhā triprakāraḥ | tatra śīto hemantaririsakhyaḥ | uṣṇo bhrīṣmākhyaḥ | vaṣāṃlakṣaṇo varaṣāṃkhyaḥ | tasya yogātiyogamidhyāyogān‌ daśeyitumāha-evaṃ rīto pṇavarṣādihemantamrīṣmavarṣākhyānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ yāvanmātra purā dṛṣṭaṃ tato hīnataraṃ dṛśyate sa̱ eṣa kārasya yogo'hpo yoga̱ ityucyate | atiyogo'tiṅa' kṣaṇaḥ | āti yadasya trividhasya rakcaṇamasya sato'timātrupakabhyate so'tiyogaḥ | mithyā yogaḥ punaḥ svalakṣaṇaviparsataḥ | yathā hebhate uṣṇo, prīpme datam‌ | varaṣīsvavadhaṇam‌ | atrāpi carakamuniḥ paṭhati | śītopṇavapaurakṣaṇaḥ (2020 aṣṭaṅkahurdayaṃ | | sūlapunapanspīpmavapāḥ saṃvatsarasya kaṣṭiḥ | tetrādimā naranadaśṇakāṭāṅasayāyā) dānasvaṭaṣṇaḥ kālau 'yogoyayāgyadakṣanavipaṃ ratidaśraṇastu kālā sabhyā. yogaḥ kaṣṭaḥ
tib: 'dir mi bzad pa'i sgra ni tshig kun dang sbyar bar bya'o/ / sogs pa'i sgra ni 'gro ba la sogs pa bsdu'o/ / ldad bzhin smra bar byed pa ni gang phyed mid tsam na smra ba ste/ 'di dag ni ngag gi las te/ rab tu drag pa la bya'i ngal ba la ni ma yin no/ / 'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs pa gang yin pa de dag ni yid kyi las yin te/ gang yul de lta bu la 'jug pa de ni yid kyi log par sbyor ba'o/ / de dag thams cad kyang tshe 'dir byas shing spyad pa'am/ skye ba gzhan dag tu byas kyang rung ste/ / de rnams thams cad log pa'i sbyor ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /
gsum gsum du brtags pa ni nad kyi rgyu las ldang bar byed pa'i gzhi yin no/ /

nad kyi gzhi de dag las nad de rnams ldang zhing 'khrugs par gyur pa de ni gang zhig mtha' yas pa yin te/ rnam pa tha dad pa'i tshul gyi nad kyis 'debs shing skyes pa yin no/ / gang du skye zhe na/ yan lag rnams dang / de bzhin du nang grol dang / lhu tshigs dang / gnad rnams su skye'o/ /
de la yan lag ni khrag la sogs pa'i lus zungs pags pa'i mthar thug pa la bya'o/ /

skt: tanra yāyā sadāya dhātavasvakūpayantā yante | tatha vāhānāṃ rogāṇāmayanaṃ sthānam‌ | radāṭaṭa cammādayaṃ | yasmādrāhyānāṃ rogāṇāṃ sākhā sādyā dhātavaḥ ayaṃ sthānamatastadāśrayā maṣavyaṅgādayo sagā bhavnti | tathā bahirbhāgā duna mārayaḥ sākhāsu jāyante |} 40 || ha~-tanra yāṇāṃ vyāc-raktādayo dhātavastyak‌ ca sāsrā | sā ca brāhmarogāyanai, brahmagā rogāṇāṃ te ca rogā mamādayaḥ | sapavyaṃgau ṣudrarogeṣu, geḍālajīmukharogeṣu vahibhāgā dani | dunīmādanāṃ viepaṇamaṃtarmāganinarasyadham‌
tib: de dag ni phyi rol gyi nad rnams kyi gnas dang rten yin par bshad do/ /

gang gi phyi rol gyi nad yan lag khrag la sogs pa'i lus zungs kyi gnas su gyur pa yin la/ de bas na de la brten te ma zhu ba dang / yan lag na ba la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du phyi rol gyi nad gzhang 'brum la sogs pa'i nad rnams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /
yang na nang gi nad ces bya ba ni lto ba dang de bzhin du rtsa sbubs chen po rnams dang / ma zhu ba dang zhu ba'i gnas la brten pa rnams so/ /

skt: mamāṇi sarvāṇyucyante | tāni siroṣṭadaya bastiprabhṛtīni 1 sandhayo'sthnāṃ sambandhinaḥ nāna sandhayaḥ | yato bahavaḥ sandhayo viśyante | māṃsāsi snāyudhamanīrirāsāndhisamāgamaḥ | iyato mantha jjāyante | teṣu nibaddhāstannibaddhāḥ | teṣu marma̭: tathāsthisandhiṣu śirādhā nibaddhā āśitā. iti sa ca mamausthisanyākhyo madhyamo rogamārgo vipaghareya tatra teṣu mamausthisandhiṣu madhyamarogamārmasaṃkite yakmādayo rogāḥ sthitāḥ | tathā mūrghādiroga sandhyasthitrikaśaṭagrahādayaśca
tib: nang grol gyi gnas de la ni skyug pa dang / tshad pas 'khru ba la sogs pa'i nad rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du nang gi cha'i gzhang 'brum dang / skran la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ltar na gzhang 'brum la sogs pa ni phyi dang nang gi cha'i dbye bas rnam pa gnyis yin no/ /

'di dag ni gnad ces bya ste/ mgo bo dang / snying dang / chu so la sogs pa'i nad dang / rus pa'i tshigs te/ 'dir tshigs ni rus pa'i tshigs la bya'o/ / sha dang rgyus pa dang / rtsa la sogs pa gnyis 'dus pa'i tshigs gzhan dag la ni mi bya'o/ / de bas na 'dir rus pa'i tshigs nges par gzung ba yin no/ / de 'brel rtsa dang chu ba dang / chu ba che sogs bar ma yin/ /

de rnams dang 'brel pa yin pas na/ de 'brel te/ gnad de rnams dang / de bzhin du rus pa'i tshigs rnams dang 'brel pa'i lam bar ma zhes bya ba de la/ nad gcong chen po la sogs pa gnas pa yin no/ / de bzhin du glad nad la sogs pa'i nad dang / tshigs pa dang / rus pa dang dpyi'i gzer dang / gnod nad la sogs pa yang der gnas so/ / 'byin khyab zug dang snyom pa dang / / lus tsha nad gzer bye ba dang / / 'byar zhing chag snyam rkang lag 'khums/ / bsgongs dang brtse dang skom byed dang / / 'dar dang rtsub dang khong stong dang / / skem dang 'gul dang dkris snyam dang / / rengs dang ro bska bro ba'o/ / mdog ni gnag gam dmar ba dag / rlung gi las yin/

skt: vāyo; prakupitasya srasādīni karmāṇi pavanti | tatra saso'dhaghaḥpatanamiva netrādeṣastunaḥ | yāso virepeṇāsanaṃ kṣepaṇam‌ 1 vyadhaḥ vidāraṇaparavāṅgasya tāḍanamiva yudrarādinā bā| svāpo vicenatvamaṅgasya | sādo'dgāvasādau nirsāhato 1tinirodha evāṅgādaiḥ | saka-pradhandhapravṛddhamadhyāḥ) ṭhenaṃ śūlam‌ 1 sodo vyucchinnadūṭaprādurabhāvaḥ ) madane vidārgasamivāṅgasya | saṅgaḥ śaṣarato niścasvam‌ | adghānāṃ bhaṅga ivāṅgamaṅgaḥ| saṅkobaro'rpīkaraṇama. | ghaiyatīti vartā'ṇuśo bhinnā7 piṇḍīkaraṇamiva | haṇaṃ semṇāma, dantānāṅgānāṃ ca | taparṇ‌ dṛṣṇā | kampaścanamaṃgasya | rpya kharasparotā | saupiryabhantaḥdyūyam‌ | gaṣo'ṅgasya śoṣaṇam‌ | sanda kiñiccaṅanam‌ | enaṃ anthanamivāṅgasya | sambhaḥ standhatāṅgāvapvānāp‌ | kapāyassatā kaṣātharasavvam‌ | rasātare'pi kapāyagrahaḥ | ṛyāvo iyāmalo malino ṇaiḥ | tathā'ruṇo sehitapāyo varṇaḥ
tib: rlung 'khrugs par gyur pa las 'byin pa snyam byed pa'i las byed par 'gyur ro/ / de la 'byin pa ni mig la sogs pa'i yan lag thur du lhung ba snyam sems par byed pa'o/ / lus kun tu khyab cing 'dren par byed pa'o/ / zug pa ni yan lag rdeg pa snyam sems pa'o/ / snyom pa ni lus kun dkris pa snyam sems pa'o/ / lus tsha ba ni lus bsregs pa snyam sems pa'o/ / nad ni tshor ba drag po'o/ / gzer ba ni khab kyis phug pa bzhin du byed pa'o/ / bye ba ni 'gyes pa snyam sems pa'o/ / 'byar ba ni bshang ba la sogs pa gnas las mi 'gul bar byed pa'o/ / chag pa snyam sems pa ni yan lag chag pa ltar zug cing na ba'o/ / yan lag 'khums pa ni yan lag 'ja' zhing 'khums par byed pa'o/ / bsgongs pa ni tha dad par 'dug pa gcig tu bsdus pa'o/ / brtse ba ni lus dang spu'i tshogs rnams brtse ba'o/ / skom par byed pa ni skom gyis gdungs pa'o/ / 'dar ba ni yan lag g.yo zhing 'gul ba'o/ / rtsub pa ni reg na mi bde bar rtsub pa'o/ / khong stong pa ni nang stong pa'o/ / skems pa ni lus skems bag tu gyur pa'o/ / 'gul ba ni cung zad g.yo ba'o/ / dkris pa snyam byed pa ni yan lag bcings pa snyam sems pa'o/ / rengs pa ni lus dang yan lag rnams shing ltar rengs pa'o/ / ro bska ba ni ro gzhan dag kyang bska ba'i ror tshor ba'o/ / mdog gnag pa ni phal cher lus dri ma can du 'dug pa'am/ de bzhin du phal cher dmar bag tu snang ba ste/ 'di dag ni rlung gi las yin no/ / mkhris pa'i las/ lus tsha mdog dmar dro smin byed/ / rngul dang rnag dang 'dzag rma red/ / 'drul dang brgyal zhing myos pa dag /

mkhris pa ldang bar gyur na de'i las ni lus tsha ba la sogs pa byed par 'gyur ro/ / de la lus tsha ba ni gang lus thams cad la shin tu mi bzad pa'i tsha ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba de la tsha ba ni sgrar bshad do/ / mdog dmar ba ni lus dang yan lag shas cher dmar ba'o/ / dro ba ni lus dang yan lag tsha ba'o/ / smin par byed pa ni lus kyi yan lag gi phyogs gcig 'drul zhing smin pa'o/ / rngul ba ni rlan dang ldan pa nyid do/ / rnags pa ni lus 'drul zhing smin pa'o/ / 'dzag pa ni rnag la sogs pa 'dzag pa'o/ / rma red pa ni rma zhig cing mnam pa'o/ / 'drul ba ni lus dang yan lag 'drul zhing myags pa'o/ / brgyal ba ni sems med cing mi dran pa'o/ / myos pa ni chang gis myos pa'i nad lta bu'o/ / kha'i ro ni kha ba dang skyur ba dag tu tshor bar 'gyur ro/ / lus kyi mdog ni skya zhing rtsa dmar ba ma yin pa ste/ gzhan du na sngo ba dang / ser ba la sogs pa'i dbye bas phye bar snang ngo / /

bad kan ldang bar 'gyur ba'i las ni mkhrang ba dang snum pa la sogs pa byed bar 'gyur ro/ / de la mkhrang ba ni lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag rnams sra ba nyid do/ / snum pa ni pags pa la sogs pa snum bag tu gnas pa'o/ / g.ya' ba ni lus kyi pags pa g.ya' ba'o/ / khong grang ba ni lus kyi yan lag rnams bsil bag tu gnas pa'o/ / lci ba ni lus zungs rnams lci ba nyid do/ / tshigs dam pa ni rtsa sbubs rnams 'gags pa'o/ / sha rgyas pa ni lus kyi sha che ba ste/ bad kan can dag gi kha dang lkog ma la sogs pa'i lus kyi sha rgyas pa'am 'gags pa'o/ / rmongs bag ni yul rnams la dbang po mi gsal ba nyid do/ / gzhan dag ni yur ba nyid do/ / zhes zer ro/ / skrang ba ni 'or bag tu 'dug pa'o/ / gnyid che ba ni gnyid stug pa'o/ / zas mi 'ju ba ni pho ba'i me drod mi snyoms shing 'ju bar mi nus pa'o/ / lus kyi mdog ni dkar zhing skya rbab rbab por snang ba'o/ / kha'i ro ni lan tshwa dang / mngar bag tu bro bar 'gyur ro/ / las kyi mtha' la 'dam zhing ring ba ni nad yun ring bo nas 'byang ba'am/ yun ring zhig nas 'chi bar byed do/ / de ltar ji skad bshad pa yi/ / mtshan nyid kyis ni nad kun khyab/ / ces bya ba la/ de ltar zhes bya ba ni yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshig gam/ de lta bu'i rnam pa'i don yin te/ rdzogs pa ni nad rnams kyi mtshan nyid gang gis/ nad gang yin par shes par 'gyur ba'o/ / ji lta bu zhe na/ nad kun khyab byed ces bya ba ste/ nad ma lus pa khyab pa'i ngang tshul gang yin pa nad kun

skt: tasya karmaṇyabhyāso jāyate jāyata eva tamāha-abhyāsāt‌ punaḥ punaḥ cikirsākarmanivaratanāt‌ dṛṣṭiḥ dadanaṃ cikitsāvijñānaṃ jāyate na kevachācikitsāśāścāvavodhāt‌ kiṃbhūtā dṛṣṭiḥ karma̭siddhiprakārinī | karmaṇaḥ siddhistasyā dīpikā prakārinī | tathā cidaronam‌ | ralanādīnāṃ marakataprabhūtīnāṃ yadetat‌ sadasañjñānamidaṃ dobhana̭rnabhidaṃ netyasyāthasya yo'vabodhastasyābhyāsaḥ pranodhanakāraṇamū|yadyapyatra parīkṣārāsa vidhate tathāpi na tadakavo dhamātrāt‌ kevakhād‌bhyāsaṃ vinā bahaśo ratnadadīnaṃ vinaiva niścaya utpadyate | idaṃ raḥnamidaṃ neti | evaṃ yaḥ cikitsāśāsmavanudhyate tasyābhyastakamī veyaḥ sa vyādhighraśamān‌ kurvan‌ prāṇināṃ prāṇānāṃ dātā na kevalāt‌ rāsakhāvabodhotkarṣāt‌ abhyāsaradahitānnāpi kevarādbhyāsāt‌ rākhrāvabodharahitāt‌ | ata evakāro'vadhāraṇārtho na dākhladeva jñāyata iti kūtam‌
tib: de ltar nad kyi mtshan nyid kun la khyab pa ji skad bshad pa'i nad kyi mtshan nyid de ni ma yengs pa ste/ / 'bad pa dang ldan zhing sems gzhan du ma yengs pa'i sman pa la sogs pa brtson pa dang ldan pas/ blta ba la sogs pas zhes pa blta ba dang / myang ba dang dris pas yang dag par shes par bya zhing rtogs par bya'o/ / de la blta ba'i mdog dang / gnas dang / tshad dang / mchil snabs dang / bshang gci dang / skyugs pa la sogs pa la blta ba ste/ sogs pa'i sgras ni rna ba'i sgra dang / rgyu ma krug krug zer ba dang / sor tshigs la sogs pa gcog pa thos pa las shes par bya'o/ / snum pa ni lus dang bshang ba dang rma la sogs pa'i dri brtag par bya'o/ / reg pa ni grang ba dang / dro ba dang 'jam pa dang rtsub pa dang / 'gul pa'i reg bya shes par bya'o/ / kha'i ro ni dris pa las shes par bya'o/ / de bzhin du skyug sla ba dang / skyug dka' ba dang / lto ba sra ba dang / snyi ba dang / rmi lam du ci mthong ba dang / gang la mngon par dga' ba dang / nad gang gi tshe nas zhugs pa dang / skyes pa'i skar ma dang / mdza' ba dang / mi mdza' ba dang / bde ba dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa dri bar bya'o/ / 'di dag ni phyogs gcig tsam bstan pa yin par shes par bya'o/ / de bzhin du rjes su dpag pa las kyang shes par bya'o/ / re zhig phyir 'byung zhing rgyu ba las lus kyi bcud dang / ro nyams pa shes par bya'o/ / sbrang bu 'du ba las ni mngar bar ro/ / de bzhin du pho ba'i drod ni 'ju ba las so/ / stobs ni rtsol ba'i nus pa las shes par bya'o/ / nad kyi mtshan ma mngon pa dag ni bsal ba'i sred pa dang mi sred pa las so/ / nad kyi tshad ni spyod pa'i khyad par las so/ / tshe zad pa ni 'chi ltas las so/ / rang bzhin dang / snying stobs dang / spro ba dang / goms pa ni rtag tu 'grogs pa las shes par bya'o/ / de yang tsa ra kas/ shes pa'i sgron ma'i snang ba yis/ / nad pa'i nad kyi bdag nyid ni/ / ma shes bar du sbyor shes gang / / de ni nad rnams gso mi byed/ / ces bshad pa yin no/ / ci sman gang la la zhig ci ltar rung ba tsam zhig de'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin nam zhe na/ de thams cad ma yin te/ gzhan du na nad kyi gnas skabs kyi dbye ba shes pa dang / de bzhin du nad la skad cig re re zhing lta ba dag sman pa yin te/ skad cig skad cig cing gnas skabs thams cad du yang dang yang du rgyun mi 'chad par lta zhing / rtogs par byed pa'i sman pa de lta bu ni nad kyi gnas skabs kyi dbye ba shes pa yin te/ de ltar na nad pa skad cig re re yang bltas pas de rnams skye bar 'gyur ba yin no/ / de bas na de ni/ goms pas nges par tho ba 'gyur te/ / las rnams 'grub pa gsal byed yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin te/ goms pa ni gso ba'i las la yang dang yang du 'jug par nges par shes par gso ba shes pa'i nges pa rnyed par 'gyur gyi/ gso ba'i bstan bcos khong du chud pa 'ba' zhig tsam gyis ni ma yin te/ ji lta bu'i nges pa zhe na/ las rnams 'grub pa gsal byed yin/ / zhes bya ba tib: nad kyi dbye ba 'di dag dang / dngas ma la sogs pa 'dres shing 'dus pa dang / de bzhin du zad pa dang / mnyam pa dang / rnam par 'phel ba'i dbye bas rab dang rab mchog tu sbyar ba las mtha' yas pa nyid du 'gyur ba nyid/ rang bzhin ci 'dra ba yin pa sman pas ma yengs shing gzhan du g.yeng ba med par sems der gtod pas shes shing rtogs par gyis shig pa'o/ / de la dngas ma la rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan re re zhing 'khrugs pa las dbye ba gsum du 'gyur te/ tha dad pa las gsum shes bya/ / zhes bya ba'i tshul gyis so/ / dngas ma ldan pa byung na/ rlung la sogs pa 'phel ba las der cha mnyam pa'am/ lhag pa las snga ma bzhin du dgur shes par bya ste/ de ltar thams cad snga ma las rjes su dpag par bya'o/ / 'dir 'di ltar rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan gyi nus pa mi mthun pa yod du zin kyang / sems can gyi nang gi mi dge ba la sogs pa'i dbang gis gnod pa skyed cing 'dus pa'i nad byed cing / gcig la gcig nye bar zhi ba ci'i phyir mi byed ces brtag par mi bya ste 'di dag gi rang bzhin nyid yin pa'i phyir dang / 'byung ba chen po ltar gcig gis gcig zil gyis gnon pa yin yang / rdzas dang ro sogs pa'i bya ba lhag cing rtsom pa dang 'dra'o/ / de bas na 'di dag gi rang bzhin ni mi 'gyur ba nyid yin no/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/

skt: medejñānasyaitāvatphaṭam‌ | yattadadhidajñānaṃ doṣāṇāṃ cikitsā | tat‌ jñāne samyak‌ śakyate katum‌ | atastato'nantaraṃ dopopakramaṇīyo'dhiktaḥ ādhikyena smaryate | asminnathīnāṃ dopopaśamopayogināṃ patehādīnaṃ nāma drasyadhyāyaḥ| taṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ)
tib: de la re zhig dbye ba de dag shes pa'i 'bras bu ni gang sman rnams dang nad rnams gso ba de shes pas nad gsal bar dag par nus pa nyid yin pas/ de'i 'og tu nad gso ba'i thabs kyi le'u'i dbang du byas nas/ de dran par bya ba'i phyir/ 'dir nad gso ba'i thabs la dgos pa'i snum la sogs pa'i ming gang yin pa ston pa de bshad par bya'o/ / de la rlung ni thams cad kyi gtso bo yin pas/ rlung nad gso ba snum dang ni/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyis/ rlung nad gso ba'i thabs smras pa yin te/ rlung 'khrugs shing ldang bar gyur na/ snum nas 'jam rtsi btang ba'i bar gso ba'i thabs yin te/ rlung de la gso ba thams cad kyi nang na gso ba'i mchog ni snum yin la/ de yang rnam pa du ma yod do/ / de'i 'og tu dugs bya'o/ / de yang gang gi phyir rlung ni zas dang skom dang sman rtsub pa dang / grang bas ci ltar myur du 'khrugs par 'gyur ba de ltar yang ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'am/ yon tan mnyam pas 'khrugs par mi 'gyur ro/ / de bas na rlung 'khrugs par gyur pa la ni gso ba'i thabs gzhan dag las dang por snum pa dang / dugs kyi rnam pa du mas de zhi bar bya ba'i don du bya'i/

de la rlung nad gso ba la ni snum chos dang / dugs byas nas sbyang ba bya la/ de yang 'jam pas bya'i/ rno zhing drag pas ni mi bya ste/ rno ba ni rlung skyed par byed pa yin pas bkag pa yin no/ / de bzhin du bza' bar bya ba'i zas kyang mngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang / rno bas bya'i/ ro gzhan bza' bar mi bya'o/ / bsku zhing mnye ba zhes bya ba ni bsku ba sngon du byas pa mnye bar bya dgos pas na bsku zhing mnye ba'o/ / dkri ba ni yan lag ras la sogs pas dkri ba'o/ / snum 'jam pa'i rtsa la sogs pa brdeg pa ste/ gso ba'i thabs 'di ni rlung nad can kha yo ba la sogs pa la bya'i/ gzhogs phyed na ba la sogs pa'i rlung nad la ni mi bya'o/ / sman chu blugs pa ni rlung sel ba'i sman bskol ba dang / snum dang 'o ma la sogs pa'i chus blugs pa'o/ / gro dang 'bras las byas pa'i chang ni gro dang 'bras chang ngo / / bu ram chang ni bu ram chang las byas pa ste sbyar ba'i chang ngo / / snum dro 'jam rtsi gtang ba ni/ / 'jam rtsi nges pa bde dga' dang / / zhes pa la/ rtsub pa dang grang ba bkag pa yin no/ / 'jam rtsi smos pa ni nges par 'jam rtsi bya dgos pa'o/ / 'jam rtsi nges pa zhes bya ba ni/ las dang dus dang sbyor ba las 'jam rtsi lnga bcu rtsa gsum bya ba ni 'jam rtsi nges pa'o/ / bde dga' ni mya ngan la sogs pa blo 'khrugs par byed pa'i dngos po spangs la yid du 'ong ba'i yul bsten pa'i bde bas gnas pa'o/ /

skt: pittasya prakupitasya sarpiṣaḥ pānamira pakramaḥ 1 tathāṃ sthāduśītaibhedhuraśītavīrayairauparadha | namadhedopaharaṇamupakramaḥ | tathā bhojanānyare hāsaṇi khādutiktakaṣāyāṇyupakramaḥ | sthau ni svādutiktakaṣāyāṇyavopakrasaḥ | tathā suga rītaṭṭyānāṃ śṛdughurathirītalachānāṃ gandhānāṃ gara vyāṇāṃ candanādīnāñupasevanaṃ pittarayopakrama tathā kaṇṭhe guṇānāṃ hāsaṇāmābharaṇadravyabhrakāra hāṭakādimayānāsassā dhṛtidhīraṇam‌ | teṣāṃ mauḥ kānāṃ hārāṇāsarasā dhṛtiḥ} tathā maṇīnāṃ vaiḥ padyarāgacandrakāntānāmurasā dhṛtiḥ pittasyopakkara tathā kpūracandnauṣadheḥ kṣaṇe kṣuṇe'nuṅepanaṃ pintara pema; | tathā pradoṣaḥ rātniprāgbhāgaḥ; | candara sthānam‌ ] sarippaṇadīkāñcayaṃsaṃvaṭite a° 13. 519. somaḥ | sudhayā niṣpāditaṃ gṛham‌ | hāri manori, sabhyaṃ gītaṃ, himo'niraḥ rīto vāyuḥ pittasyopakramaḥ | tathā bhitramayantraṇasukhaṃ hṛdayāhādakāri samānavepacaritam‌ | patraḥ sandigdhamugdhavāc‌ sandigdhayugdhānabhispaṣṭā'praudā vāk‌ yasya sa tathrāvidhaḥ| tathā dāsa pṛiṇyaśchandācavatinyaḥ | cittājukalayaḥ priyā vahvabhāḥ pittasyopakramaḥ | garahyaṇi śītāsyudhāragarmāṇi, udyānāni dīdhikā; puṣkariṇyaḥ pitta. dhyopakramaḥ | tathā kāyamāna treṇvāditippāditaṃ gṛhaṃ viśaṣadarūmākarukasutīaivipurukhanchasaṭilāśayasekate sāmbhojajalatīrānte sthāne karate pittasyopakramaḥ| tathā bhojanānyabhyavahāyoṇi ! sopānapaṅaktistīthaśabdena aṇyate | sobhanāni ca tīthauni vipu ca tat‌ dhyacche catat‌ sadiṃ tasyākṣayaṃ sthāta tasya sekataṃ taṭa tatra kāyamānaṃ drubhairākuṃ rumākuraṃ sahāsbhojevatete yañjaraṃ tīrāntaṃ yarbhmistattayāedhaṃ sakate tathā sasyā māvadihamanasorāhādyaiḥsayakariṇaśte'pi tasyopakramaḥ 1 vidoṣataḥ payaḥsapirdhirekaḥ sarvabhya upakramebhyaḥ pradhānatama rapkaramaḥ
tib: sman drod che zhing 'ju bar byed pa dang / lhan cig btsos shing g.yos su sbyar ba'o/ / yang rlung de 'khrugs par gyur pa la gso ba thams cad kyi nang na/ khyad par mchog tu gyur pa ni/ sha tshon po'i khu ba stobs skyed par byed nus pa ste sha khu dang / de bzhin du til mar dang sbyar ba'i 'jam rtsi gtang ba gso ba'i thabs ni mchog yin no/ /

sogs pa'i sgras tshigs su bcad pa drug gis ni mkhris pa 'khrugs par gyur na mar sar blud pa la sogs pas gso bar bya ba dang / de bzhin du mngar ba dang / bsil ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i sman gyi bkru sman btang bas nad thur du dbyung ba ni gso ba'i thabs yin no/ / de bzhin du kha zas kyang mngar ba dang kha ba dang bska ba'i bza' ba dang / sman yang mngar ba dang kha ba dang bska ba nyid kyis sbyin par bya'o/ / de bzhin du dri bzang zhing bsil ba dang / yid du 'ong ba'i tsan+dan la sogs pa'i dri nye bar bsten pas gso ba dang / de bzhin du mgul du rgyan gyi rnam pa gser la sogs pa las byas pa'i do shal se mo do gdags pa dang / de bzhin du mu tig gi do shal brang du 'phyang bar gdags par bya ba dang / de bzhin du nor bu ste bai DUr+ya dang / pad+ma rA ga dang / chu shel dang / tshon shel la sogs pa'i chun 'phyang brang du gdags pa ni mkhris pa gso ba'i thabs yin no/ / de bzhin du ga bur dang tsan+dan dang / u shi ra'i byug pas/ skad cig ma re re zhing bsku ba ni mkhris pa gso ba'i thabs yin no/ / de bzhin du srod la ste/ mtshan mo'i dang po'i cha la rdo thal can te/ rdo thal dkar pos byugs pa'i khyim du 'dug ste/ zla ba'i 'od zer bsten cing yid du 'ong zhing rnar snyan pa'i glu dang / ser bu bsil ba bsten pa yang mkhris pa gso ba'i thabs yin no/ / de bzhin du bag phebs shing nyams rangs su gnas pa'i mdza' bo'i bde ba cha lugs dang spyod pa mthun pa yid tshim par byed pa dang de bzhin du/ bu la gzhon skad nyams rangs smra/ / chung ma yid mthun las byed cing / / sdug cing yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ / khang pa nyis rim chu bsil blugs/ / skyed mos tshal rdzing bzang po ni/ / rgya che dang ni stegs bcas pa/ / chus brlan bye ma bsil ba dang / / spyil bu lus tshad shing khebs dang / / chu 'gram pad+mar bcas pa ni/ / bder gnas khyad par 'o ma dang / / mar sar bza' dang bkru sman bya/ / zhes pa gang bu chung ba dang / / mi gsal zhing gsang dma' bar smra zhing dga' bas gnas pa dang / de bzhin du chung ma yid dang mthun pa'i las byed pa dang / sdug cing yid du 'ong ba dang / yon tan gyi ngang tshul bzang po'i spyod pas brgyan pa dang / 'grogs pa ni mkhris pa gso ba'i thabs yin no/ / khang pa yang nyis rim du byas shing bsil ba dang / chu rgyun bsil ba'i rgyun 'bab pa blugs pa dang / skyed mos tshal rdzing bu bzang po dang ldan par gnas pa yang mkhris pa la phan no/ / de bzhin du rgya che zhing yangs pa'i stegs dang bcas pa chu dngas bas brlan zhing gsher ba'i bye ma bsil bar byed par gnas pas mkhris pa la phan no/ / yang chu 'gram der spyil bu lus kyi tshad tsam 'od ma la sogs pa las byas pa dang / shing bzang po skye ba dang / chu'i 'gram na pad+ma dang bcas pa gang yin pa de lta bur gnas pa dang / de bzhin du bde bar gnas pa ste/ lus dang sems dga' bar byed pa de dag ni mkhris pa gso ba'i thabs yin no/ / khyad par du ni 'o ma dang mar gsar bza' ba dang / bkru sman btang ba ni mchog thams cad kyi nang nas gso ba'i mchog yin no/ / bad kan cho gar ldan pa yi/ / skyugs sman bkru sman rnon po btang / / zas ni rtsub chung rno zhing dro/ / tsha zhing kha dang bska ba bza'/ / chang ni yun ring lon pa btung / / rtse dga' dang ni gnyid mi log / rtsol ba'i tshul ni sna tshogs dang / / sems las rtsub pas mnye ba dang / / khyad par sman khu skyugs sman btang / / sbrang rtsi tshil 'joms sman bsten bya/ / smyung ba dud bdug mkhur bkang dbo/ / bde ba med gnyid bde phyir bya/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyis bad kan gyi rgyu sogs pa dang / de bzhin du 'phel bas nad skyed par nus pa dag la skyugs sman la sogs pas gso bar bya'o/ / de la skyugs sman ni nad gyen du drang ba'o/ / de yang cho ga dang ldan par bya ba ste/ gso dpyad kyi bstan bcos las ji skad bshad pa'i cho gas gtang bar bya zhing sbyar bar bya la/ de yang rno bas bya dgos te/ sman rno ba las sbyar ba btang ngo / / de bzhin du bkru sman yang rnon pos bkru ba ni bad kan gso ba'i thabs yin no/ / de bzhin du zas te 'bras chan la sogs pa rtsub pa dang / chung ba dang / rno ba dang / dro ba dang / ro tsha ba dang / kha ba dang / bska ba bza' bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du chang dus yun ring por lon pa btung ba yang bad kan la phan no/ / de bzhin du rtse ba dang dga' ba ste yid la 'dod pa'i dga' ba la brten cing bud med la brten pa dang / gnyid mi log pa ste/ mel tse'i tshul du gnas pa yang bad kan gso ba'i thabs yin no/ / de bzhin du rtsol ba'i tshul sna tshogs shing rnam pa tha dad du lus dub par byed pa lag stobs 'gyed pa dang / rta 'dul ba la sogs pa yang bad kan gso ba'i thabs yin no/ / de bzhin du sems las te dngos po rjes su dran zhing dpyod pa dang / de bzhin du rtsub pa dang / phal cher rdzas rtsub pas mnye ba yang bad kan gso ba'i thabs yin no/ / de la bad kan gyi gso ba thams cad las khyad par du phan pa'i thabs ni sman khu dang skyugs sman gtang ba yin no/ / sman khu ni 'bru'i khu ba las byas pa'o/ / tshil 'joms pa'i sman ni gu gul la sogs pa'o/ / smyung ba ni zas bcad pa'o/ / dud pa ni 'og nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can no/ / mkhur ba dgang zhing dbo ba ni sman khus ba bkang zhing dbo ba'o/ / bde ba med pa ni bde ba nyid 'gegs pa ste/ bde ba dang mi ldan pa'am/ sdug bsngal ba'i tshul can gyis lus dang sems kyi las shin tu bsten pas gang sdug bsngal skye bar 'gyur ba de ni bde ba med pa ste/ de ni bad kan gyi bde ba skyed par byed pa'i phyir bde ba'i don rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ / nad rnams so sor gso ba dag / nad las dpags te bshad pa yin/ / ldan pa dang ni 'dus pa dag / de ni so so'i tshul gyis brtag / ces bya ba la/ gang gis gso ba gang yin pa nad rnams so so'i mtshan nyid las dpags te bshad pa de nyid ni/ rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du bya la/ ldan pa dang 'dus pa'i nad dag la ni so so'i tshul ji lta ba las brtag par bya ste/ dper na rlung dang mkhris pa'i nad ldan pa la/ rlung dang mkhris pa gso ba'i thabs 'dren ma brtag par bya la/ de bzhin du rlung dang bad kan gyi ldan pa yang rlung dang bad kan 'dren ma'i gso ba'i thabs brtag par bya'o/ / mkhris pa dang bad kan gyi ldan pa yang mkhris pa dang bad kan gyi gso ba'i thabs 'dren ma brtag par bya'o/ / de bzhin du 'dus pa la yang gso ba gsum ci rigs par dus gcig tu brtag par bya'o/ / yang ldan pa gsum po 'di dag la sgo gzhan dag nas gso ba'i thabs bsgre ba gsal bar bya ba'i phyir smras pa ni/

skt: punarasmiṣsividhisaṃsarge sakhenopakra ārthamiti nidadoyannāha--paruṣipitte - vārtā saṃsarga bhreṣmo vidhiḥ mareṣmavacayodhyāyoktaḥ . rītaḥ prayo'yaḥ } tathā kaphamārute saṃsabha va vasantacaryokto cidhī rukaṣopṇaprāyo yauḥ nanu bhrīṣme rasītaprātho vidhiratta vasante rūkṣuprāyaḥ tatkathaṃ vāyoḥ samānaguṇa kramo yujyate rītarūkṣavvāhātasya tata̱ āha ruto yogavāhitvā diti | yasmādrāyuryogavaṣahī saṃyuyate tecaivaikasogakṣamo bhavartīyarbhaḥ | ṭha granthaḥ-““yogavāhaḥ paraṃ vātaḥ saṃyogādubhayā dādacharattejasā yuktaḥ śītakarat‌ sobharasaṃśrayāt‌ evaṃ yathosvarakṣaṇaviṣaye yogavāitva̭ daṣaṃ cikitvāyāmapi yogasamānarsvaṃ yujyate tena pittena sah‌ sthitasya pittacikitsā prayoñyā yaṃ hiṣvāddhetoḥ | tathā kaphena sah‌ sthitasya ka kissā śāradaḥ śāra śvaryāvihito vidhiḥ kapha sarge yojyaḥ! & ||! | dai0-taṃsmamedānāmauṣadhāṃtaramāha--maraṣitate ` preṇa upacāraḥ kāryaḥ | kaphamārate vāsaṃtaḥ śāradasya kaphapitatannatvācukto'tideśaḥ, bhaṣmaśya tvādavāsetasya kaphapintaghanatvādayuktaratāha--maruto 2 hitvādipate yogaṃ saṃbadhe vahāte nirvahati davitīyasyān‌ neti yogavāhī | tena pittayuktasya vāyoḥ | nopaśāṃtiḥ, kapaphayuktasya kaphena | prāyomhaṇādanu damyāgo'pi
tib: rlung dang mkhris pa'i tshul la ni phal cher so ga'i cho ga bya ste/ so ga'i dus kyi cho ga dus su spyad pa'i le'u las bshad pa'i snum pa dang / bsil ba'i cho ga sbyar bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du bad kan dang / rlung gi ldan pa la ni dpyid kyi zhes bya ba/ dpyid kyi spyod pa'i cho ga dro ba dang / rtsub pa zhes bya ba'i cho ga sbyar bar bya'o/ / dris pa so ga'i tshe ni phal cher bsil ba'i cho ga bshad la/ dpyid kyi dus su spyad pa'i le'u las bshad pa'i snum pa dang / rlung skye ba ches mthun pa ste/ gso bar ji ltar rigs te/ rlung gi rang gi mtshan nyid ni grang ba dang rtsub pa yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ rlung ni zung du 'jug pas na zhes smos pa yin no/ / gang gi phyir rlung ni zung du 'jug pa yin pas/ gang gis 'dres shing ldan par gyur pa de nyid kyi sbyor ba'i 'jug pa gcig pa nyid kyis na/ bad kan dang mkhris pa cha 'dres pas gso ba de la phan pa yin no/ / zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de yang gzhung las/ zung du 'jug pa rlung gi mchog / yang dag 'dres pas gnyis bdag can/ / me dang ldan pas sreg par byed/ / zla ba ldan pas bsil bar byed/ / ces bshad pa yin no/ / de ltar na rang gi mtshan nyid kyi gnas skabs na zung du 'jug pa nyid du bya bar rigs so/ / de bas na rlung mkhris pa dang lhan cig gnas su zin kyang / mkhris pa'i gso ba byar rung ste/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du bad kan dang lhan cig gnas pa yang bad kan gyi gso bas gso bar byar rung ngo / / bad kan dang mkhris par ldan pa'i ldan pa la ni ston gyi zhes bya ba ston gyi dus su bya ba'i spyod pa bshad pa dag gis gso bar bya'o/ / da ni gso ba'i thabs kyi dus smras pa ni/

skt: sābhpratamupakramakāramāha~-dauove vātapittakaphākhye caya eva cayāvasthāyāmeva jayet‌ cikistet‌ na prakopakāṭhaṃ pratīkṣeta yadā cayakāra upekṣitaḥ saṃstadā te doṣaṃ kupitamakupitenācisodhayam‌ cikisset‌ | tenaitaduktaṃ bhavati ! kupitastathā jetavyo yathā tadviparītairāhārādisadṛśasvhoṣāntaraṃ na kupyatīti | yadā sarve doṣā yugapchupitāstadā garīyāṃ samādhikabakaṃ kupitavaraṃ doṣaṃ jayet‌ | repayoḥ svahpakrupitayoradhirodhena sāmyena kupitānāṃ tu varīyān‌ vāyurasāmye punaryo yasmādadhikaḥ radubuddhayā vddhaste balīyāṃsaṃ roṣadoprādhirodhenaiva jayet‌ | etalapaśvasaṅprahe ranthakāreṇoktam‌-“kramātmarusittakaphā; sarvatra sadṛśe vake | vātādīnayathā1 su0~caya evā'viśodhayanyā | pra. ṭī.-athavā caye cayaka evopcīyamānaṃ pathyā''hārādibhirapakrameta| yathā-grīṣme kaṭūvaslalavaṇāni vajayet‌, labhuligdhamadhurāṇe havyāṇi rītaṃ davaśca seveta | yathā-prāṭṣi vātaprakoye na bhamavehiti | varṣā jīraṇa̭dhānyasadhuralaghuligdhāni ca dravyāṇi,śaratarīta jalaṃ ca seveta | yathā--pittasaṃcayo na bhavedrātaprakoṣo'pi na bhavet‌ | evaṃ hemante'pyavirodhayan‌. śaṇṭhayādesaṃuktāni dranyāṇyupaseveta | yena ca prakopa eva na bhavediti || ` “6 | sa̱0-khaṃdagekhannipātiṣu ca balavattaram‌ 1 ` pra. rī.- sase dvidoṣvaye sannipāte tridoṣacaye ca iṣretopakarasaḥ sammilitacikilsayā upakrameta - | athavā valbataraṃ doṣa pūrvaṃ jayet‌ | yathā vātakaphasaṃsarage vātakaphopa- | kramaḥ | vātapittasasarage vātapittopakramaḥ | pittakaphasasaga pittakaphopakramaḥ | evaṃ vātāpitte bheṣmiko vidhiḥ prayojyaḥ | vātakaphe vasantoktaḥ | kaphapitte śāradrīyaḥ | evaṃ bharma, sannipāte ca vā balavattaraṃ pūraisupakrameta || ( 325 ) pūrya yataḥ svābhāvikaṃ bam‌ | uce parāśaro rtha. mamumeva pramāṇayan‌ ] yathopanyāsataḥ prāpramādau doṣa bhiṣagjitam‌ || netrabhaṅgena dṛṣṭo hi samaṃ sainyaparājayaḥ! sthānataḥ kecidicchanti prāktāvacchaṣeṣmaṇo vadham‌ || śirasyurasi kaṇḍe ca praliprina ruciḥ kutaḥ| tadabhāve kathaṃ bhojyamānadravyāvadhāraṇam‌]| asatyabhyavahāre ca kuto dopavinirahuḥ | tasmādādau kapho ghāsyaḥ kāyadrārāgato hi saḥ || madhyasthāyi yataḥ pittamāṣukāri cicintyate | ato vātasasakhasyāsya kuryāttada niparadam‌ | ataeva ca pittādikaphānto'nyaḥ kutaḥ sparataḥ 1 suśavutasya na sarvatra matametadbhavīmi tu || jayeñjvarātisāre ca phachamāt‌ pittakaphānidān‌ | prāyeṇa tāpātmatayā jvaratejo vidipyate|| vidaśca saratā pittāttathā ca mṛdukoṣṭhatā | tasya cānuvachaṃ śepmā gauravāpaktijāḍayadrat‌ || vāyuśca vadhete'vadyaṃ yaskhadasedayoḥ kṣaye | uvarātisāryostasmādeṣa doṣajaye ṛmaḥ|kapittānikhānanye kamādādstayorapi|yasmādāmārāyokeśā bhūyiṣṭhaṃ tassamudravaḥ || krameṇādhena tatrāpi prabṛddhān‌ khādaya dhthitān‌ | svāśyeṣu duṣṭānāṃ sthitaiva hyāśukāritā || vijñāya karmabhiḥ saiḥ sairadoṣedrekā yathābalam‌ | bheṣajaṃ yojayettatra tra kuyaunna tu kramam‌
tib: rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan zhes bya ba'i nad ni dkyel sogs pa'i dus nyid kyi gnas skabs na bsal zhing gso bar bya'i/ ldang bar gyur pa'i dus kyi bar du bsdang bar mi bya'o/ / gang gi tshe sogs pa'i dus su btang snyoms su byas pas ldang bar gyur pa de'i tshe nad de ldang bas na nad gzhan la gnod cing ldang bar 'gyur ba med pa'i tshul gyis gso bar bya'o/ / de ni 'di skad ston pa ste/ nad de ldang ba na de dang mi mthun pa'i kha zas la sogs pa dang / de dang cha 'dra bas na nad gzhan dag ci nas slong bar mi 'gyur ba de lta bur gso bar bya'o/ / yang gang gi tshe nad thams cad dus gcig tu langs na de'i tshe tshabs che ba'i nad stobs dang ldan pa ldang bar 'gyur ba ste/ dang por gso bar bya la/ de yang nad gzhan la gnod pa med par gso ba ste/ cung zad ldang ba'i nad dag la mi gnod cing mi mthun pa med pa'i tshul gyis gso bar bya la/ gal te mnyam par 'khrus na/ rlung stobs dang ldan pa ma yin la cha mnyam par gyur pa las gang gang zhig las rang bzhin gyis 'phel bar 'gyur ba de tshabs che ba yin pas/ nad gzhan dag la gnod pa med pa'i tshul nyid kyis gso bar bya'o/ / nad ni sbyong bas zhi bya ba/ / gang gzhan ldang bar byed pa dag /

skt: evaṃ bhatāntarāṇyupamatānyācāryeṇa-oauṣadhāhaesādiyolanāṣūpo yaḥ prayoga ekaṃ vyādhiṃ dāmayedanya dvitīyasudīsyet‌ | viddho naṃ śreṣṭho yastaṃ hamayednyaṃ na ca kopayet‌ | sa śuddhaḥ śobhanakāraṇatvāt‌ ||} 8 || . hai 0~-tacnādyuddhaprayāyā hayaḥ; cha. uprādya; tasmāttayākṣaṇramāha---dopraṇāṃ parasparaṃ ma rāma ityuktaṃ saṃprahe-“śuddhaṃ marmara jedu nādakhapabhāṃvāhbhāvapi | doṣādoṣāsmakatvācca na sāsye'pi parasparam‌] sītasigdhāmkalvaṇakaṭūvādeguṇaṃṭhalyatā | duṣṭā mithaśca doṣu nāto'nyonyaṃ jayaṃti te| āmaka virodho'pi mitho yadaduṇatrayam‌, | vidhasya daṣa yugapad‌ vyāgherdopatrathaṃ tathā ?› iti || 8 atha kathaṃ doṣāḥ yāṃtīvyāhataprāyāmādṛṣpaṇasvekṣaṇyādāhū tīcaraṇād‌pi) asau prayogo na kauṣṭhācchalāsthimamasu kāha cchasāsthamamāṇa dratavvānpārutasya daṣa yāte
tib: nad zhi bar bya ba'i sbyor ba sman dang kha zas la sogs pa sbyor ba'i tshul gang gis nad gcig zhi bar byas nas gzhan gnyis pa ldang bar byed pa'i sbyor ba de ni rnam par dag pa ma yin te/ bzang po ma yin la/ gang gcig zhi bar byas nas gzhan dag ldang bar mi byed pa de ni dag pa dam pa yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/

skt: koṣṭhādāmapaktāṅnayāparapayīyācchāsāri māṇi vyāyāmādibhiḥ doṣā yānti | dhā raktādayo dhātavaḥ vavak‌ jakhīnyasisandhayaḥ mama riroṣṭadayaprabhatīni | śarīrāyāsajananaṃ vyāra ucyate | chapmaṇo'takṣaṇyāt‌ bharavaṅasvāt‌ a tācaraṇādpathyasevanāttathā sādatasya vātasya } svāt‌ prakopācchākhādīni doṣā yānti
tatrasthāḥ koṣṭhasthānasthā doṣā viṣamberan‌ na segān‌ kurvīran‌ | sadahakāraṇavaikasyāyadā rogospādanakṣamā na bhavanti vikārakāraṇakaraṇānta pekṣiṇo bhūyo bahunimintamapeścante tacchīkhāḥ 11||

te doṣāḥ; kākhdṛṣyadeśrakaratīnāṃ baṃ sāmadhya ṅacdhvā prāpya kupyanti | anyāśrayeṣvapi parāśrayeṣvapi || 12.|| de0--ghaśāne parakhani vā viṃmānādaraupāḥ khaiḥ saiḥ prakopaṇaiḥ yrahṣyaṃtīvyāha-te kālādivaṭe sandhayā kuyatya, nyārameṣvapīti
tib: yan lag dang rus pa dang gnad du rlung la sogs pa'i nad myur du 'jug par 'gyur ro/ / de la yan lag ni khrag la sogs pa'i lus zungs rnams dang pags pa'o/ / rus pa ni rus pa'i tshigs rnams so/ / gnad ni snying dang mgo bo la sogs pa ste/ de dag tu rlung myur ba'i bdag can yin pas na nad 'jug cing ldang bar byed do/ / de bzhin du yan lag dang rus pa dang / gnad rnams la yang khong pa'i nang du zhugs par 'gyur te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ rtsa rnams kyi sgo gang yin pa de rnam par sbyangs pas rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ de khong par 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / dkyel sogs shing 'phel bas 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du 'dzags shing zhu ba ste/ lan tshwa dang 'o ma la sogs pa 'dzag par 'gyur ba'i zas zos pas 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du smin pa ste/ smin par bya ba la sogs pa ste/ ma zhu ba med par byas pas khong pa'i nang du zhugs par 'gyur ro/ / zhes bya bar sbyar ba dang / de bzhin du rlung 'thor ba dang / sdud par byed pa tshar bcad cing zhu bar byed pa khong pa'i nang du nad de 'du zhing 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin no/ / der gnas nas kyang rgyu dag la/ / sdod cing ring du thogs pa yin/ / de ni dus sogs stobs thob nas/ / gzhan la brten kyang ldang bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ khong pa'i nang der gnas nas nad de lhan cig byed pa'i rgyu dag dang ma phrad na sdod cing ring du thogs te/ rang gi shugs 'byin par byed de/ de ldang ba'i rgyu gang yin tshe ma tshang bas nad skyed pa'i nus pa dang mi ldan pa tshe 'gyur ba'i rgyu gzhan dag la sdod cing rgyu mang po la bzhes pas na de ldang bas na 'gor ba yin no/ / de nas de dus dang gnod bya dang / yul dang rang bzhin gyis stobs kyi nus pa thob cing skyes nas ldan par byed do/ /

skt: isyata āha-svāmiva balenānyāmibhāviṣu svāmevātmīyāmevānyasthānasaṃstheṣu cikitsāṃ kuyonna tadīyamanyasthānasambandhinīm‌ | kibhūteṣu bena svaśāktayānyadoṣamabhibhavituṃ śīṃ yeṣāṃ te'nyābhibhāvino doṣā anyasthānasaṃsthānepvanyābhebhavanarīleṇviti

kimeṣa eva niyamo'tha pakṣāntaraṃ dnyamanra vidyata ilayāha-sthānino doṣān‌ : yathāyathaṃ doṣopakramaṇīyoktirupakramaivā''gara rāmayet‌ | abarūvantamapi tasyāvarvata doṣasya cikitsā kāryeti avalvadāgantu paya evaṃ vikaṭpavatāgantuṣu yataḥ svāmeva kuryādiyevaṃniyamastasmādanyasthānasaṃsepvabaṭe yānyasthānadoṣacikissā kāyā | anyara doṣān‌ pratidkalāgantudoṣadhikittā kāyaṃ vatya punadiṣu anyasthānasaṃstheṣu saiva cikitsā kāya | baruvassu punadeṣiṣu a nasaṃstheṣu sadātmīyaiva cikitsā kāryeti, iyatnāpi yadruhuvacanaṃ tasparyāyatta eva doṣā vadrayākhyā tadā
tib: pha rol po dag la brten kyang gnas kyang rgyu'i tshogs pa rnyed na ldang bar 'gyur ro/ / de la gnas gzhan gnas pa ni/ / de nyid stobs ni med nyid la/ / gso bar bya ba rang gi ni/ / stobs kyis gzhan zil gnon byed na'o/ / zhes bya ba la de la nad rnams langs nas gzhan dag na gnas pa'i tshe de nyid gso bar bya'o/ / zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ / de la zhes bya ba ni/ nges par bzung ba ste/ nad de rnams kyi nang na gzhan na gnas pa de nyid ces pa de dang 'brel ba'i bla thabs su zhugs pa dang / 'brel pa de ni gzhan gyi gnas na gnas pa'o/ / de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ stobs ni med ces bya ba ste/ snga na yod pa'i nad stobs chung ba gzhan dag la gnas pa'i bla brnan la gso ba bya'i/ nad snga ma stobs dang ldan pa la/ bla thabs su byung ba la bla brnan dang po gso ba ni nges par bzung ba ste/ gnas gzhan dang 'brel pa de nyid bla brnan du gyur pa yin no/ / yang na snga ma stobs chung ba gzhan dag la gnas pa dang ldan pa la gnas na ci zhig bya zhe na/ rang gi ni/ stobs kyis gzhan zil gnon byed na'o/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ rang nyid gzhan gyi gnas na gnas pa na gso ba bya'i/ gzhan gyi gnas dang 'brel ba'i ni ma yin te/ ji lta bu zhe na/ stobs kyi rang gi nus pas nad gzhan zil gyis gnon cing rgyal bar nus pa de gso bar bya ste/ gang stobs dang ldan pa gso ba'i don no/ / ci gso ba'i nges par 'dir zad dam/ rnam pa gzhan dag kyang 'di la yod ce na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ bla brnan nad ni zhi byas na/ / rang gnas gnas pa gso mi dgos/ / zhes bya ba ste/ nad bsal ba'i cho ga ji skad bshad pas bla brnan nad stobs chung ba yin no/ / zhi bar bya zhing rnam par bsal na rang gi gnas na gnas pa yang gso mi dgos te/ bla brnan stobs can la ni rang gi gso ba dang 'dra bar gso dgos so/ / des na gzhan gyi gnas su song ba'i nad ni stobs chung ba yin yang de nyid gso bar bya'o/ / yang na rang gi gnas na gnas pa'i nad gsos nas/ de'i 'og tu bla brnan gsor yang rung ngo / / stobs dang ldan pa'i nad gzhan gyi gnas na gnas pa la ni rang gi dang 'dra bar gso bar bya'o/ / da ni gzhan gyi rtsib logs su 'gro ba'i nad rnams la mchog tu gso bar bya ba bstan pa'i phyir smras pa ni/ phal cher rtsib logs 'gro ba'i nad/ / nad pa yun ring nyon mongs byed/ / lus me'i stobs ni shes pa yis/ / de la thabs dag mi bya/ / de ni sbyor bas zhi ba'am/ / khong du bde bar bsdu bar bya/ / khong du 'dus par shes nas ni/ / ji ltar nye ba bzhin du bsal/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ phal cher zhes pa mang du rtsib logs su 'gro zhing rtsib logs g.yas g.yon na rgyu ba'i nad rlung la sogs pa ni nad pa sdug bsngal ba dang ldan pa yun ring zhing dus ring du nyon mongs shing sdug bsngal bar byed do/ / nad rtsib logs su 'gro ba de rnams la de ni lus kyi me stobs shes shing rtogs pa'i sman pas nad de las myur ba thabs su de'i gso ba dag mi bya'o/ / 'o na ci zhig bya zhe na/ nad sbyor bar shes pa rigs pa dang ldan pas zhi bar bya ba'am/ khong pa'i nang du bde bar bsdu zhing nang du chud par byas la/ de'i 'og tu gzod gso'o/ / de yang nad de khong du 'dus shing chud par shes nas rtsib logs su 'gro ba'i nad de nang du bsdus nas/ sna'am kha'am bshang ba'i sgo la sogs pa nad gang dang nye ba'i lam de nas skyug sman la sogs pas bsal bar bya zhing phyir gdon par bya'o/ / rlung la sogs pa'i dri ma rtse ma zhil zhing me zhu ba'i bu ga 'gags pa la sogs pa'i spyi'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i phyir smras pa ni/ /

skt: dadānīṃ tiyaigagateṣu dopepvapaśa ri kaṭapaṃ daśayannāha-prāyo bāhyena tirygaḥ gvibhibhitā doṣā vātādayaḥ kṭherāyanti nyāturān‌ rogiṇaḥ ciraṃ ṣahūkāṭai te tiryaggateṣu svarayā dehābhacibachaviddhaiyaḥ ` cikissāṃ kuyīt‌ |} 16 || ` he0-tiryamātāḥ śodhanamāragaṃ parityajya ritha vahiravā odhayitumadākyatvāścaraṃ leśyati | a savarathā cikisā kuryāt‌ | dehamamivaraṃ vicārya i dtyathaṃḥ | tān‌ tirthaggatān‌ āmayet‌
tib: bu ga 'byung ba 'gags pa ni/ / nad gyen du mi 'byung ba'o/ / stobs nyams pa ni stobs bcom pa'o/ / lci ba ni lus dang yan lag lci ba'o/ / rlung khung du 'khrul ba ni rlung gsal bar mi rgyu ba'o/ / khong snyom pa ni spro ba chung ba'o/ / mi 'ju ba ni zas 'ju bar mi byed pa'o/ / mchil ma mang ba ni mchil snabs 'dzag pa'o/ / bshang gci sri ba ni bshang ba la sogs pa 'gags pa'o/ / dub pa ni nyams bri ba'o/ / zas 'bri ba ni zas la sred pa med pa'o/ / de lta bu'i rtags rnams ni/ nad rtse ma zhi la zhing gting ma phyin pa'i spyi'i rtags yin no/ /

skt: jñāsvā vuddhvā } koṣṭhaprapannām‌ śarīre samya bhgatān‌ doṣāṃstiganyathāsannaṃ yo ya āsanno mārgo prāṇañulādistena mārgeṇa vamanādibhiviniret‌ vahi niṣkāsayet‌

setoedhādiṣaṭhigaṃ śakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | tatra srotaso rodhaḥ udhvaudho doṣāpvṛttiḥ | barupya bharaṃso vighātaḥ| gauravarbhagasya | anirasya mūḍhatā sapaṣṭatā'gatiḥ | āṅasyamanusāhaḥ | apaktirapacanamāhārasya | niṣṭhīvaḥ śepmaṇo nirasanam‌ | malanāṃ mūtrapūrṣādīnāṃ saṃgo'prahattiḥ| arucirannavidveṣaḥ| kṭamo'pacayaḥ | etassartha̭ṣigaṃ maṅānāmāmānāṃ vidhyāt‌ | nirāmānāṃ pularvipyaiyo'nyathābhāvaḥ 1 rakrṛtādanantaroktāhakṣaṇāttena = sarotaḥśuddhibekhaprādubhavo śukhaṃ mārutasyānuromyamannapākaḥ | kaphapyānudvisṇam‌ | maṭagravrattirāhārābhirāṣa utsāha śeti
tib: rtse bcil zhing nad zhi ba'i rtags ni bshad ma thag pa'i las go bzlog pa ste/ de yang rtsa sbubs dag pa dang stobs skye ba dang / yang ba nyid dang / rlung lugs su 'byung ba dang / khong snyom pa med pa dang / zas 'ju ba dang mchil ma nyung ba dang / dri ma rnams bde bar 'byung ba dang / zas yi gar 'ong ba dang / spro ba dang ldan pa ste/ 'di dag ni nad med pa'i mtshan nyid yin no/ / yang ma zhu ba'i mtshan nyid ci zhig dang ldan na/ rlung la sogs pa la ma zhu ba'am/ nad kyi lhag ma dang bcas pa zhes bya zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ khong pa'i drod stobs chung nyid kyis/ / lus zungs/ dang po mi 'ju ba/ / nad ni pho bar zhugs pa dag / dngas ma ma zhu yin par bshad/ / ces bya ba la sogs pa yin te/ lus zungs kyi dang po dang / dngas ma chen po zhes bya ba ste khong pa'i drod chung ba nyid kyis 'ju zhing smin par ma gyur pa rlung la sogs pa'i nad dang 'dres pa rang gi gnas pho bar zhugs pa gnod par 'gyur pa de ni dngas ma ma smin cing ma zhu ba yin no/ / zhes la la dag 'dod do/ / gzhan dag nad nyid rab 'khrugs pa/ / rab gdug phan tshun 'dom las byung / / ko dra ba yi dug bzhin du/ / nad tshabs chen po 'byung bar bshad/ / ces bya ba la/ / slob dpon gzhan dag ni ma zhu ba'i 'byung ba'i tshul du 'dod de/ rlung la sogs pa'i nad nyid rab tu 'khrugs shing shin tu sogs pa las dus phyis zhig na kha zas mang ba rab tu gdug pa phan tshun gcig la gcig 'dom zhing 'dres par gyur pa nyid las ma zhu ba 'byung bar 'dod de/ de yang dper na ko dra zhes bya ba'i 'bru las dus dang yul gyi rgyu la ltos na dug tu 'gyur bar bshad do/ / des na 'di skad ston par 'gyur te/ dper na ko dra ba nyid dug tu 'gyur ba bzhin du nad rnams kyang tshabs chen por 'khrugs pa las rang nyid cha las ma zhu ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de bas na lus la sogs pa las ma zhu ba'i don gzhan dag yin par shes par de la rgyas par bya ba ni lus kyi sha 'phel zhing rgyas par bya ba'i don byed pa ste/ dper na sha dang 'o ma la sogs pa lta bu'o/ / gang lus kyi yang zhing srab pa nyid du gang gis byed pa de ni smyung bar bya ba zhes bya ba'o/ / de dag kyang ci lta bu'i bdag nyid can yin zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ de ni phal cher sa chu dang / / cig shos las ni gyur pa yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ rgyas par bya ba dang smyung ba de gnyis ni/ sa dang chu dang cig shos las ni gyur pa yin te/ de yang sa dang bcas pa'i chu yin na sa chu'o/ / des ni 'di skad ston te/ sa dang chu'i rang bzhin can gyi rdzas ni rgyas par byed pa yin te/ de gnyis kyi ngo bo nyid de yin pa'i phyir ro/ / smyung ba ni de las gzhan pa cig shos te/ gang cig shos she na/ 'dir de'i skabs yin pas/ sa dang chu las cig shos me dang rlung dang nam mkha'i bdag nyid can yin no/ / phal cher zhes smos pas ni shin tu rgyas par byed pa ni sa dang chu yin la/ shin tu smyung bar byed pa ni cig shos me dang rlung dang nam mkha' yin pas na de skad ces bya'o/ / me dang rlung dang nam mkha' la rgyas shing 'phel bar 'gyur ba ye med pa ma yin la/ sa dang chu la yang smyung ba ye med pa ma yin te/ sman rnams ni 'byung ba lnga'i bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /

skt: bahūpakramavādina pratīdamucyate | anayoyoḥ snehanādi yadetacatuvidhaṃ tadanayoḥ kamaṃ 1 salu santarṣaṇāpatarpaṇavatte snehādayaścatvāro'rathāntaram‌ | etaccaturvidhaṃ yatkama̭ṃtadpi hitayasantaṣaiṇāpatapeṇarūpaṃ nātivatete nātikrāmati | bhūtānāṃ santarpaṇāpataṣaṇasvabhāvadavaividhyāt‌ ddhirakāratvāt‌ 1 tathāmnīṣomātmakarūpadaraividhyāduddhitayaṃ vahaṇaḍhadganākhyaṃ nātivatete na snehanastambhane | saumyatvād‌ paraidaṇavaragai. tib: gso ba'i thabs med du smras pa dag yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir smras pa yin te/ 'di nyid kyis las snum bag la sogs pa bzhi po bshad pa gang yin pa/ 'di'i las yin gyi/ brta bar bya ba dang nyams smad par bya ba ltar snum la sogs pa bzhi po 'di dag don tha dad pa ma yin no/ / 'byung ba'i las bzhi po de dag kyang brta ba dang nyams smad pa gnyis kyi tshul can yin pa'i phyir gnyis po de las 'da' bar mi byed do/ 'byung ba rnams brta ba dang nyams smad pa'i rang bzhin gnyis kyis rnam pa gnyis yin pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin du me dang zla ba'i rang bzhin rnam pa gnyis dang ldan pa yin pas/ de las rgyas pa'am/ 'phel ba dang / smyung ba gnyis las 'da' bar mi byed do/ / de yang snum dang bsdam par bya ba'i zla ba'i rang bzhin pas brta ba'i sde tshoms su gtogs la/ rtsub pa dang dugs bya ba ni me'i rang bzhin can yin pas smyung bar gtogs te/ des nas la sogs pa'i 'byung ba rnams brta ba dang nyams smad pa'i tshul can yin no/ / da ni de gnyis kyi so so'i dbye ba smras pa ni/

skt: idānīṃ prayekaṃ tayorbhadānāha-tatreti nidhāraṇe | tatra tayoḥ santṣeṇāpatarpeṇayoḥ vṛṃhaṇaraṅghanāparanābhnothedetahṅghanamapatarpaṇaṃ tadṭidhā-śodhanarāmanabhedena | itiśabdaḥ samāprau | nāte vikalpanamastītiprakāse vānena prakāreṇa dvādadayadhā chadghanadodhanasya svarūpakathanāthem‌ || & || hai0-raṃṣanabhedānāh‌-ślodhanamiti
tib: de la zhes bya ba ni nges par gzung ba ste/ nyams brta ba dang nyams smad pa zhes bya ba ming gi rnam grangs rnam pa gzhan du na/ rgyas par bya ba dang / smyung ba zhes bya ba la gang 'di smyung ba'am/ nyams smad pa zhes bya ba de ni rnam pa gnyis te/ sbyang ba dang zhi ba zhes bya ba yin te/ de las lhag pa'i smyung ba yod pa ma yin no/ / yang na rnam pa 'di lta bu'i tshul gyis rnam pa gnyis pa ni smyung ba yin te/ gzhan du na 'og nas bshad pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa bcu gnyis su 'gyur ro/ / de las rang gi mtshan nyid dang de bzhin du de'i dbye ba bstan pa'i phyir smras pa ni/ / gang zhig nad ni phyir 'byin pa/ / sbyang yin de ni rnam lnga ste/ / mas gtong skyug sman lus nad bkru/ / mgo yi nad bkru gtar gas dbyung / / zhes bya ba yin te/

sbyang ba de yang mas gtong ba la sogs pa'i dbye ba rnam pa lnga yin no/ / de la mas gtong ba ni bshang ba'i sgo nas/ sman dang mar la sogs pa bskol te gtong ba'o/ / skyug sman ni nad rnams gyen du drang ba'o/ / lus kyi nad bkru ba ni nad thur du dbyung ba'o/ / mgo bo'i nad bkru ba ni lus kyi phyogs gcig mgo bo zhes bya ba gcig pu'i nad sman sna nas btang bas gyen du drang ba ni mgo bo'i nad bkru ba'o/ / gtar gas dbyung ba ni khrag rtsa'i sgo la sogs pa las phyir gdon pa'o/ / de ni zhi ba'i mtshan nyid dang / de bzhin du dbye ba bshad pa'i phyir 'di smras pa yin te/ gang zhig nad ni mi sbyong dang / / snyoms gnas glongs pa ma yin dang / / ma snyoms snyoms par byed pa dag /

skt: dadānīṃ dāmanasya svalakṣaṇaṃ tathā bhedaṃ vyākhyā* tubhidamāha-yadadrabhya̭ṃvātādīn‌ rasodhayayantaḥ sthi tān‌ nahi varhiiṣipati tathā samānasvapramāṇasthitān‌ nodīsyati nokkleśyati na sakhasathānāta syāvayati tathā viṣamān‌ svabhramāṇāddhīnādhi kabhāvena sthitān‌ samīkeyoti sakhapramāṇa sthān‌ sampādayati tadravyaṃ ramanabha sayucyate | damanaṃ saptā saprabhiḥ prakāre; pācara savādibhedeneti | tatre pācayatīti pācanam‌. | pra (340) to'na: pākakriyāmabhiniṣadhateyataḥ pacanaśtimasyādhikāṃ tasya̱ yadusādayati ranyanariyāvat‌ | pācanaṃ yathā kirātātiktakādikhvanaṃ vā | dīpyate<raineti dīpanam‌ | yathā trikaṭukapaccakolādi yade bhivardhanatvādantaḥpaktimayeḥ kuvetastasya raksyupavehakaṃ sampadyate tadīpanamityucyate | kṣārapāṇināyuktam‌ | “pācanaṃ pācayedahoṣān‌ śamācchamanameva tu) dāpanaṃ hyabhciratvā'maṃ kadācitpācayenna vā? |} 9 || hai0-śamanasya lakṣaṇamedāṃśvāda--na dodhayatīti | yaddopān‌ na vlodhayati varahiniṣkāsayati, samānauiktāpnodīrayati na cikratiṃ nayati, viṣamān‌ vidratān‌ samīkaroti praṣatiṃ nayati tacchamanam‌ | tacca̱pācanādaibhadātsaptadhā | pācanamiti | kṣudannavajane; tarad‌ udakavajanam‌,
tib: sman gang zhig gis rlung la sogs pa'i nad mi sbyong zhing / nang na gnas pa phyi rol tu ma bton pa dang / de bzhin du snyoms par gnas shing cha mnyam par rang gi tshad du gnas la glongs pa ma yin zhing rang gi gnas nas mi bsgul ba dang / de bzhin du ma snyoms pa ste/ rang gi tshad las lhag pa'am/ ma tshang ba'i tshul du gnas pa dag snyoms par byed cing / rang gi tshad dang ldan par byed pa'i sman de ni zhi ba zhes bya ba yin la/ zhi ba de ni smin pa nyid la sogs pa'i dbye bas rnam pa bdun yin no/ / de la smin pa ni smin par byed pas na smin pa ste/ pho ba'i me drod kyis 'ju ba'i bya ba rdzogs par byed cing / de smin cing 'ju ba'i nus pa lhag par skyed par byed pa'i sman gang yin pa'am/ bya ba gang yin pa la smin pa zhes bya ba ste/ dper na tig ta la sogs pa lta bu'am/ smyung ba bya'o/ / drod skyed ces bya ba 'dis drod skyed par byed pa ste/ dper na tsha ba gsum dang / tsha ba lnga la sogs pa'i sman gang gis me'i drod shin tu 'phel bar byed pas/ zas 'ju bar byed pa de'i nus pa lhag par nye bar 'phel bar byed pa de la drod skyed ces bya'o/ / de yang legs thos kyis/ ma smin pa ni smin byed cing / / mnyam gnas de ni zhi ba yin/ / drod skyed me drod shin tu skyed/ / ched 'ga' smin byed yang na min/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / gzhan dag ni go bar zad do/ / da ni rgyas pa'am brta bar bya ba bshad de/

skt: dadānīṃ bṛhaṇasacyate-turaṣdo ciśeṣe | vireṣe ṭhaṃghanapakṣayā ṃghanādanena tu rābdena dhiśepyata }! vehaṇamapi śodhanaṃ mavati | kṣīyāddravyasādhanasya cāpatapaṇāsmakaṣvāt‌ | tataḥ kevarasya cāyā; pittasahitasya vā kopaḥ prāpro yathā ṭhaghanācchodhan‌ādudravyeṇa pathyādinā daṃhaṇasya tuśabdo aṣṭāddaye | | sadhra~ viśeṣaṇārthaṃ upāttaḥ | dahaṇaṃ yanacchodhanaṃ śamaṃ tadrāyoḥ kevarasya tathā pittasaditasya rāmanemava ṭhaṃghanakodhanavamanasevaṃ ṭhaghanād‌ bṛhaṇaṃ viśoṣitaṃ bha ti| eva bahaṇameva śamanameva savedā vāyoḥ keva tathā pittasadahitsya | evakāso'vadhāraṇātheḥ | vāḥ reva kevachasya tathā pittasahitasyāsyaive natu ve ṭhasya pintasya sāpi kevaṅasya vatasyāpari pira vātasahitasya vātapittasannipātasya vṛdaṇaṃ śa bhavati
tib: ni zhes bya ba ni khyad par byed pa yin pa'i don te/ brta ba ni smyung ba las tshul 'dis khyad par du bya ba yin te/ brta bar byed pa 'o ma la sogs pa yang sbyor zhing 'khru bar byed mod kyi/ sbyor ba ni nyams dmod pa'i bdag nyid can yin pas de las kyang rlung 'ba' zhig gam/ mkhris pa dang bcas pa ldang bar byed de/ dper na smyung ba las a ru ra la sogs pa'i sbyor ba byed pa'i sman gyis ldang bar byed pa yin pas/ de'i phyir brta ba'i khyad par ston te/ brta ba'i rdzas 'o ma la sogs pa'i sbyor ba'am zhi ba ni/ rlung 'ba' zhig gam mkhris pa dang bcas pa zhi bar byed kyi/ smyung ba'i sbyor ba ltar nad skyed par ni mi byed do/ / de ltar na smyung ba las brta ba'am/ / rgyas par bya ba khyad par du 'phags pa yin/ des na brta ba dag ni rlung dag ste/ mkhris pa dang bcas pa zhi bar byed pa yin gyi/ ldang bar byed pa nyid ma yin no/ / nyid ces bya ba ni nges pa'i don te/ rlung 'ba' zhig dang / de bzhin du de nyid mkhris pa dang bcas pa dag gi yin gyi/ mkhris pa 'ba' zhig gam/ bad kan mkhris pa dang bcas pa'am/ 'dus pa'i nad dag la brten pa de zhi bar byed pa ma yin no/ / de ltar na brta ba'i nyes pa'i yul des zhi ba yin par nges pa yin no/ / da ni brta bar bya ba'i dngos po gang dang gang yin pa brta bar bya ba'i phyir 'di smra ba yin te/ brta bya nad dang sman dang chang / / bud med mya ngan gyis nyam chung / / khur dang lam gyis glo rdol dang / / lus rtsub nyams dma' rlung shas che/ / sbrum ma bu btsas byis pa rgan/ / so ga'i dus dang gzhan yang brta/ / zhes bya ba la/ / 'di dag la nyam chung ba zhes bya ba'i sgra kun la sbyar bar bya ste/ des na nad kyis nyam chung ba dang / sman 'thungs pas nyam chung ba dang / bud med la brten pas nyam chung ba dang / mya ngan gyis nyam chung ba ste/ de dag brta bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du rtag tu khur gyis dub pa dang / rtag tu lam gyis dub pa dang / glo rdol ba dang / gcang chen po dang / lus rtsub pa dang / nyams dma' ba dang / rlung gi shas che ba dang / sbrum ma dang / bu btsas pa dang / byis pa dang / rgan po dag kyang rtag tu brta ba'i cho ga dag kyang bya'o/ / de bzhin du so ga'i dus dang / gzhan yang zhes pa 'dir ma bstan pa'i gso bar 'os pa nad pa'am/ tha mal pa'i gnas skabs thams cad brta bar bya ba dang / yang de bzhin du so ga'i dus de'i tshe/ nad kyis nyam chung ba la sogs pa lhag par yang gso bar bya'o/ / de la gang gis brta zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ sha dang 'o ma kha ra dkar/ / mar sar mngar bag mas gtong dang / / gnyid log nyal bde bsku byug dang / / khrus dang bder gnas nyams dga' brta/ / zhes bya ba smras pa yin te/ de la sha ni sngar bshad pa rnam pa brgyad do/ / 'o ma yang de bzhin no/ / kha ra dkar po ni sha kha ra dag go/ / mar sar ni mar ro/ / mngar bag kyang yin la mas gtong ba yang yin pas na mngar bag mas gtong ste des brta ba'o/ / gnyid log pa'i bde ba ni nyal ba'i bde ba ste/ gnyi ga la yang bde ba'i sgra sbyar ro/ / bsku byug ni lus til mar la sogs pas bsku ba'o/ / khrus ni lus chu dron pos bkru ba'o/ / bde bar gnas pa ni sems dga' ba'o/ / nyams dga' ba ni mgu ba nas dga' ba ste yid dga' ba'o/ / da ni smyung ba ston te/

skt: daisyevaṃ baṃhaṇasya yo doṣo viṣayasta dvāreṇa śamanasapi tadviṣayamevāsya niyamyedāḥ ya bṛhyāstān‌ sūcayannāha-kaṣitaśabd‌; saṃsāyaṃ; | tena vyādhikarṣatān‌ bhaṣañyakāḥ sadyakāgha̭tān‌ rokakāṣaitān‌ salīkāpirtauśca tra tathā bhāranityānuraḥkṣatān‌ kṣīṇān‌ rūṣyāna chān‌ tathā gabhiṇīsūtikāḥ prasūtā; bāḍhān‌ bṛhayat‌ | nityaṃ grīṣme parānapyanyānarni| svasthānāturāśca sarvām‌ vṛhayet‌ } tathā'rmin‌ atidāyena vyādhikadhitādīn‌ vyat‌ || 11
tib: gcin snyi ba dang / ma zhu ba la sogs pa'i nad yod pa la rtag tu smyung ba bya'o/ / de bzhin du dgun dang / gzhan ma bstan pa nad kyi 'gyur ba gzhan dag la yang bya ste/ stobs rdzogs pa yin pa dang / bad kan la sogs pa'i 'jigs pas smyung ba bya ste/ gzhan dag kyang zhes bya ba 'dis nad pa la bya ba yin gyi/ gzhan du na bde bar gnas pa'i tshe ni dgun stod dang / / dgun sman brta ba'i cho ga khyad par dang bcas pa smras pa yin no/ / da ni sbyang ba'i yul las brtsams te smras pa ni/ de la sbyang bya shas che sbom/ / stobs ldan mkhris pa bad kan rgyas/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ de la sbyang bar bya ba ni shas che zhing sbom pa dang / stobs dang ldan pa dang / mkhris pa dang / bad kan rgyas pa ste/ nyams smad par bya ba de rnams kyi nang nas/ mtshan nyid gsum po 'di dag dang ldan pa'i mi/ sbyang ba rnam pa lnga po skyug sman la sogs pas ci rigs par sbyang zhing nyams smad par bya'o/ / ma zhu'i nad dang rims dang skyug /

skt: rodhanīyān‌ dadīyannāha--tanra ṭhadhanī madhyāt‌ sthausyavarapittakaphavikārānnarāt‌ saṃ dhataidhamanādibhi; paccamiravanaprakararyathāyobhyaṃ i yet‌! āturān‌ narān‌ madhyasthausyādikān‌ 2 prāyo bāhusyena pūrvasādau dīpanapācanairṭhaghanapara rekheghayet‌ 1 ādigrahaṇāt‌ | atra carupittakapa praṇam‌ | pūraya pratham‌ dīpanapācaneyaidhāreṇa da prāyograhaṇaṃ doṣavalāyapekṣayā niyamasyāsarvapa nārtham‌ | ebhirevānantayektesamadeṣañvarādibhirā rātān‌ pīḍitān‌ hīnādikāñnarān‌ sthausyakaphā vachānna̱ sataḥ śaṣantapṇānigrahaiḥ bubhukṣāpipāsāve raṇaiṭaighanaprakāraikeṣayeditythaiḥ | hīnāḥ sa sthaulyavarūpittakapā yeṣāṃ te tathā doṣavā bhirmadhyabaṭhainedkaṣṭavaṃcherāton‌ pīḍitānārtan‌ ` samarthān‌ nādaktān‌ samīraparātapāyāsai$gha dayeva sthito niyamaḥ | amīyate bṛhyā; se (342 ) aṣṭaṅkahṛdaya | | sapra te punara$ghyāḥ | vyeṣu ṭhevanamupakramaḥ | ṭhaṃṣyeṣu na | ṛhaṇīyatvāt‌ | vraṇaṃ tatamdha jbarādiśogāṇāsupadāmaṃ ki bṛhaṇīyasya paso raghanasādhyāmayātasya kaghanamupakramaḥ bhravatyasatvatha bṛhaṇoyatasvāt‌ 1 14 ||
tib: ma zhu ba dang / rims la sogs pa'i nad kyis nyen pa'i nad pa sha 'bring tsam du sbom par gyur pa dag la phal cher zhes pa ming du smin pa dang / drod skyed pa ni smyung ba'i rnam pas smyung bar bya'o/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni 'dir stobs dang mkhris pa dang bad kan dag bsdu'o/ / dang por ni thog mar te/ sngar smin pa dang / drod bskyed bskyed pas smyung ba bya la/ de'i 'og tu ci rigs pa'i smyung ba bya'o/ / phal cher zhes smos pa ni/ nad dang lus kyi nyams stobs la sogs pa rnams las brta'i thams cad du 'di ltar bya ba ma yin no zhes ston/ nad ni 'di dag gis nyam thag /

sngar bshad ma thag pa'i nad rims la sogs pa 'di dag nyid kyis nyam thag cing gnod par 'gyur ba'i mi sha'i sbom tshad dang / stobs la sogs pa chung ba ste/ sha che ba'i shas chung zhing stobs zhan pa bad kan mkhris pa dang ldan pa dag la ni/ bkres pa dang skom pas tshar bcad pa ste/ ltogs pa dang skom pas nyen par bya ba'i shugs kyi smyung ba'i rnam pas nyams smad par bya'o/ / zhes bya ba'i don to/ / nad kyis nyam thag stobs 'bring brtan/ / ser bu tsha rtsol gyis smad na/ / nyam chung mi brta smos ci

ba'i don du sbyar bar bya'o/ /
