skt: tasya kīṭaśāmoṣadhamityāha-tatra charaśe puṃsi | māṃsādamaṃsaṃ dehasya vṛṇalakt‌ | kata ityāha | pānānnabhaiṣajaṃ śākhiṣaṣṭikamāṃsarṣareṣyurasajīvanīya- | māsena samatatāt‌ | puṣṭalāt‌
tib: gang gi lus brtas shing tsho bar byed pa 'di la zas gang zhig zos shing longs spyad pa na/ sha dang 'dra bar lus brtas shing tsho bar byed pa'i kha zas kyi rigs gang yang yod pa ma yin no/ / de las khyad par du sha za rnams kyi sha ni shas skyed cing 'phel bar byed pa yin bas/ shin tu yang lus brtas shing 'phel bar byed pa yin no/ / sbom po dang skem po de gnyis kyi gso ba'i thabs mdor bstan pa'i phyir smras pa ni/ sbom la nyams smad lci bas bya/ / de las bzlog pa skem la phan/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ mi sbom po la ni nyams smad pa'i lcibs bya ste/ dper na sbrang rtsi dang sring ga ta zhes bya ba'i 'bras bu dang / pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang sdong bu la sogs pa ste/ de dag ni rtsub pa yin pa'i phyir tshil za bar byed pa dang / lci bas myur du mi 'ju ba'i phyir ro/ / sbom po la ni yang ba'i nyams smad pas yang sbom po phan te/ dper na rgya sran ku lad tha dang / khre rgod la sogs pa phan pa lta bu'o/ /

gang snga ma de las bzlog pa'i yang ba dang / de bzhin du brta ba de ni skem po la phan te/ dper na 'bras drug cu pa'i chan dang / sha bkra dang / ri bong la sogs pa'i sha lta bu ste/ de yang gang gi phyir shin tu skem pa la ni zas dang skom dang sman gcig pa dag gis me drod 'bri bar byed pas de brtas par byed pa'i rdzas yin du zin kyang de mi 'ju bas slar nyams smod cing skem po nyid du byed par 'gyur ro/ / nas dang gro ni gnyi ga la/ / de la 'os par byed pas brtag / ces bya ba la/ sbom po dang skem po de gnyis ka la 'os shing 'tsham par bya zhing sbyar ba dang / g.yos su byas pa'i nye bar brtag par byas ba gang yin pa de ni/ de la 'os pas brtag ces bya'o/ / de ni 'di skad ston pa yin te/ gang gi phyir sbom po la nas dang gro ster ba na/ de'i tshe sbom bo la 'os shing 'tsham ba'i nyams smad pa'i bya bas bya la/ gang gi tshe nas dang gro de nyid skem bo la ster na de'i tshe skem po la 'os shing 'tsham pa'i brta ba bya ba'i tshul gyis brtag par bya'o/ / 'di ni 'di ltar dogs ba skyed par mi bya'o/ / ji ltar nyes pa rnams kyi nad kyi rgyu mtha' las ba las nad kyang mtha' yas pa ji lta ba bzhin du gso ba yang mtha' yas/ / nyams brta ba dang nyams smad pa'i gso ba'i thabs kyang sbyor ba rab dang rab mchog gi dbye bas mtha' yas par rigs na/ ci'i phyir gso ba'i thabs gnyis kho nar zad ces phyir rgol ba dag yod pas/ de'i phyir gzhung rtsom par byed pas 'dir smras pa ni/ nad kyi dbye ba tha dad kyi/ / gcod 'khru la sogs dbye ba yis/ / nad ltar tha dad gyur kyang ni/ / gso ba gnyis las yod ma yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ nad rnams zad pa dang / gnas pa dang / steng dang 'og dang rtsib logs la sogs par thad kar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyis rnam par dbye na/ mtha' yas pa yod du zin kyang / gso ba ni rnam pa gnyis las lhag par dbye ba med do/ / de bzhin du gcad par bya ba la sogs pa'i dbye bar phye ba las kyang tha dad par 'gyur te/ 'di ni gcad pa'i gso ba'o/ / 'di ni rab tu gcad pa'o/ / 'di ni rab mchog tu gcad pa'o/ / 'di ni rab tu 'khru ba'o/ / 'di ni rab mchog tu 'khru ba'o/ / sogs pas ni snum dang rtsub pa la sogs pa yin na/ ji ltar na de mtha' yas pa yin du zin kyang / de rnams dbye ba med pa yin zhe na/ nang ltar tha dad gyur kyang ni/ zhes bya ba ste/ dper na nad gzhi la sogs pa'i dbang gis kyang / rims la sogs pa'i nad rnams tha dad par 'gyur ba yin kyang gso ba ni/ brta ba dang nyams smad pa'i tshul gnyis kyis bsgrub par bya ba yin pas na/ mtshan nyid de gnyis las dbye ba yod pa ma yin te/ lan 'ga' de rnams brta bar bya bas gso dgos par 'gyur ro/ / la la ni nyams 'bri bas gso bar bya dgos kyi de ma gtogs pa gso ba'i phung po gsum pa ni yod pa ma yin no/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gyi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/
/ / de nas sbyang ba la sogs pa'i sman gyi sde tshan sna tshogs 'dus pa'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /

skt: dodhanapaścakarmākhyasya vamanādimedabhinnapayottarottakhadhānasya prādhānyādayre vamanasya tābadauparadhagaṇaṃ pradhānaṃ vyākhyātubhidamādaha--madanādīni ravyāṇi chardatānai bamanopayogītti | madanaṃ madanafarūp‌ ! madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭikā | mbā kaṭukā nimbaḥ, bimbī gohā skaphaḍaparapayāyā | trapusaṃ kaṭukam‌ | kuṭajaḥ vatsakaḥ | mūrvā madhurasā | devadārī jīmūtakaḥ | kṛmi vidaṅgap‌ | nidulo vetasaḥ | | dṛhanadhitrakaḥ | citrā dravantau | korāvatyā de rājakorātakī ekā, kaṭakokhātakī ditīyā | karaja; pūtikarakaḥ | kaṇā pippalī | pṛṣameṭā sarṣapāḥ śretasapa̭pāḥ
tib: ji ltar 'dir gso ba sna tshogs yod du zin kyang / tshul gnyis las lhag par med pa de bzhin du/ sman rnams tshul tha dad pa yod du zin kyang / sbyang ba dang zhi ba'i tshul gnyis las 'da' bar mi byed do/ / de bas na gso ba'i tshul rnam pa gnyis kyi 'og tu sbyang ba la sogs pa ni sman gyi sde tshan gyi le'u brtsams pa yin no/ / sbyang ba la sogs pa'i tshul can gyi sman du bstan pa'i sde tshan gang yin pa de ni sbyang ba la sogs pa'i sman gyi sde tshan no/ / sde tshan sna tshogs pa 'dus pa ni dngos po phan tshun 'thor ba gcig tu bsdus pa de'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ / zhes pa'o/ / sbyong ba'i skyug sman la sogs pa'i dbye ba phyi ma mchog tu gyur pa'i las rnam pa lnga yod pa las/ dang por re zhig skyug sman gyi sde tshan gyi gtso bo bshad par bya ba'i phyir 'di smras pa yin te/ po son cha dang shing mngar dang / / ku ba kha bo nim pa dang / / bim pa ga gon bi sha la/ / dug mo nyung dang mur ba dang / / de ba da li byi dang ga /

skt: nikrambhādīni dravyāṇi virecanāni | nikumbho dantī } ūusbhacidat‌, | gavākṣī viśākhā | sluk‌ khadhā|śaṃkhinī rdhakuumā | nīlinī nīṭapuṣpā| | dadhā | yavaḥ-tīkṣṇaśūkakaḥ, mieḥ-dātapuṣapā, kṛte dharana tisvako yodhaḥ | śamyāka āragvadhaḥ | kampi- | kaḍkolātarakī, ḍukhtthaḥ~-divīdhānyavidopaḥ, = madhu chako rajanakaḥ | demaduḥdhā sṇekīrī | duḥdhaṃ kṣīra | māṣikam‌ | samaha tadhikaṃ varitaṣu tapu tepvavasthāte m‌| gomūtraṃ gojaram‌
tib: po son cha la sogs pa'i sman ni slon zhing skyug pa la dgos pa yin no/ / de la po son cha ni ma na pha la'o/ / shing mngar ni ma du yang shi'o/ / ku ba kha bo ni ka tu ka a ba bu'o/ / nim pa ni a ri stag ka'o/ / bim pa ni dza mu ta ka'o/ / byi tang ga ni ming gi rnam grangs gzhan yang 'bras bu mang po zhes bya'o/ / ga gon ni tri du su kha ba'o/ / bi la sha ni go ba a k+Sha ste/ ba lang gi mig lta bu'o/ / dug mo nyung ni pad tsa ka'o/ / mur ba ni ma dur sa ste/ khu ba mngar ba zhig go/ / de ba da li ni dzi mur ka'o/ / byi dang ga ni srin bu gsod ba'o/ / lcam pa ni bi tang so'o/ / tsi tra ni tra ba na tri'o/ / kru trug tres ni tsi tra ka'o/ / ko sha ba ni gnyis te/ gcig ni ra tsa ko sha ba ti'o/ / gnyis pa ni ka du ka ko sha ta ki'o/ / ka rany+dza ni pu ti kar ny+dza 'o/ / pi pi ling ni ka ra na'o/ / yungs kar ni yungs kar dkar bo'o/ / dan ti dang ni ti pid ta/ / 'bras bu gsum dang bi sha la/ / shang ki ni dang snu ha dang / / seng phrom dong ga ni li ni/ / khron bu dang ni kam pi l+ya/ / 'o ma ba gcin 'khru bar byed/ / ces bya ba la sogs pa'i sman rnams ni 'khru ba'i sde tshan yin no/ / de la dan ti ni kum ba'o/ / tri bi da ta ni kum ba'o/ / bi sha la ni go bA k+Shi'o/ / shing khi ni shing kha pus pa'o/ / snu ha ni bu ta'o/ / ni li ni nI la pus pa ste/ me tog sngon po can no/ / seng phrom ni dro tra'o/ / dong ga ni sham mya ka'o/ / khron bu ni su bar nak+shi ra'o/ / ka ma bi l+ya ni ra dza na ga ste/

po son cha la sogs pa ni mas gtong ba'i bkru sman gyi sde tshan yin no/ / de ba da li ni dzi mu dka'o/ / gzhan ni go bar zad do/ / rtsa ba bcu ni rtsa ba lnga pa che chung gnyis so/ / sha ta pu Sh+pa ni mi bi'o/ / a pa ma rga byi dang ga / tsha ba gsum dang skyer ba'i rtsa/ / su ral dang shi ri sha / bri hang shi kru'i sa bon dang / / seng ldeng ma du ka'i snying po/ / rgyam tsha dngul rdo pha bong dreg /

tib: dzi ban ni dzi ba'o/ / ram nye ba ni gnyis te/ ka ko li dang / k+Shir ka ko la'o/ / me da dang ma hA me da ni me da gnyis so/ / mung+ga dang ma sha par+Ni ni mung+ga par+Ni dang / ma sha par+Ni'o/ / zangs rtsib ni ri sha pa'o/ / dzi ba ka ni sman 'tsho byed kur rtsa shi sha'o zhes bya ba'o/ /

tib: thal tres la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'dis ni tshad pa la sogs pa sel zhing 'joms par byed pa yin no/ / tang ba la ni kasma ri'o/ / ma du ka ni ma du ka puSh+pa'o/ / pa ru sha ka ni mri du pa ba ste/ 'bras bu chung ngu 'jam pa zhig go/ / shug pa buN+Da rI ka dang / / br-it+ti r-it+ti cu gang dang / / sring gi sle tres 'tsho byed bcu/ / nu zho skyed byed rlung mkhris sel/ / nyam chung tshim byed brtas byed la/ / 'tsho byed ro tsa nyid du byed/ / ces bya ba la/ shug pa la sogs pa'i sman gyi sde tshan no/ / nu zho skyed pa la sogs pa byed do/ / nu zho ni bud med 'phel bar byed pa'o/ / de bzhin du rlung dang mkhris pa'i nad sel ba dang / nyam chung ba rnams tshim par byed pas na tshim byed do/ / mdangs skyed pa ni/ 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa ste/ nyams stobs skyed pa'o/ / 'tsho bar byed pas na 'tsho byed do/ / ro tsa bar byed pa ni khu ba 'phel bar byed pa'o/ / shug pa ni pad+ma ka ste/ ming gi rnam grangs gzhan du na he ma pad+ma zhes bya ba'o/ /

/ nim pa 'u su'i 'bras bu dang / / tsan+dan dmar po zhes bya rnams/ / mkhris pa dang ni bad kan dang / / rims nad skyug bro lus tsha dang / / skom dad che sel me drod skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ sle tres la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni mkhris pa dang bad kan la sogs pa rnams sel bar byed la/ me'i drod skyed par byed do/ / dong ga la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni/ slon bro ba la sogs pa nas gcin nad rma red pa'i bar du sbyong zhing sel bar byed do/ / dang ga dang ni dug mo nyung / / ka ka ti ga ta pa ta li/ / nim ba sle tres dUr ba dang / / mur ba be+e dang ka ta dang / / pa tha ci skrigs she rgya ka / ka rany+dza gnyis pa to la/ / lo ma bdun pa kru trug tres/ / su Sha byi ta po son cha/ / sa ha ra dza zhes bya dang / / rgya shug gi ni 'bras bu rnams/ / de ni slon bro mdze nad dang / / dug dang rims dang bad kan dang / / g.yan pa dang ni gcin snyi dang / / rma red pa rnams sbyong bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ dong ga la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni slon bro ba la sogs pa nas/ gcin dang rma red pa'i / shing lo ma can zhig go / ci skrigs ni ki ri tig ta ste/ bu nim pa'o/ / shergya ka ni ha sa ka ra'o/ / ka rany+dza gnyis las gcig ni pu ti na ka rany+dza ste/ ming gi rnam grangs gzhan yang tsi ri bil pa zhes bya ba'o/ / ka rany+dza gnyis pa ni ming gi rnam grangs su nan ta ma la zhes bya'o/ / lo ma bdun pa ni sa b+ha par+Ni'o/ / kru trug tres ni tsi tra ka'o/ / su sha byi si ti ya ba li zhes bya'o/ / po son cha ni ma dang na la la'o/ / sa ha ra dza ni nI la bus pa ste/ me tog sngon po can zhig go/ rgya shug pa'i 'bras bu ni kun ta zhes bya'o/ / a sa na dang ti ni sha/ / stag pa shwe ta ba ha dang / / ka ta ra dang seng ldeng dang / / ban da dang ni shing sha pa/ / a dza sring ga tsan+dan na gsum/ / ta la a kar pa la sha / sa la khar ba tra dang / / d+ha ba ka ling ka spro tog / tsha ga kar+Na bad tsha ka / tha ram zhes ni bya ba ste/ / a sa na sogs de rnams kyis/ / sha bkra mdze nad bad kan dang / / srin nad skya rbab gcin snyi dang / / tsho ches nad ni sel bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ a sa na la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni tshad pa la sogs pa sel zhing 'joms pa yin no/ / de la a sa ni ba ta sa la'o/ / ti ni sha ni shing yan da na'o/ / shwe ta ba ha ni a dzu na'o/ / ka ta ra ni seng ldeng dang 'dra ba la sngon po can zhig go/ / ban da ni shi ri sha'o/ / shing sha pa ni kris snar ra'o/ / a dza sring ga ni mi shi sring ga ste/ ra thug gi rwa 'dra ba'o/ / tsan+dan gsum ni dkar po dang / dmar po dang / ser po'o/ / ta la ni shing gi khyad par te dwa tra dza zhes bya ba'o/ / a gar dza ni dzong ga ga'o/ / pa la sha ni shing sha ka'o/ / sa la ni shing mthon po zhig go/ / kha ra pa tra ni sha ka zhes bya ba'i shing gi khyad par zhig go/ / d+ha ba ni dzre had ta ru zhes bya ba/ shing chen po zhig go/ / ka ling ka ni in tra ya ba'o/ / spro tog ni bu ga'o/ / tsha ga kar+Na ni ra skyes kyi rna ba 'dra ba zhig go/ /

skt: varaṇādisyaṃ varbhaḥ kaphādīnantavidradhipaḥ ntānniyacchati nivāsayati | āḍhayabātā bhadra varato vāyuḥ | baraṇastamālaḥ | sayakaradya saha darasa pītaraktamedabhinnam‌. | dahandhitrakaḥ | māra kṣīsmorṭaḥ | bisaḥ rakhāṭabrakṣaḥ | dhiṣrābhiḥ ajarāṅgī ! ha vṛhatyau kaṇṭakrārikā vahatī ca karachanadrayamekaḥ pūtikarakho tīyo naktā: [ satra yaṃ takāya | vraṭakhapahataḥ siśruśaṣobhā- | moraṭaḥ śṣīramoṭaḥ | karaṭa; sitivārakaḥ | ka tāpasyaḥ | damaiḥ kṛśaḥ | rajaka | uttamāraṇiḥ | pāthā suvaca | vasaṃtatihachakācarm‌ | ratātamanaḥ
tib: bar na la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni bad kan la sogs pa nas khong 'bras kyi bar du 'joms shing sel bar byed pa yin no/ / rlung nad 'khyims pa ni/ tshil gyis g.yogs pa'i rlung ngo / / ba ra ni ni shing ta ma la'o/ / she rgya ka gnyis ni ser po dang dmar po'o/ / mdog gis phye ba'i su ha ra tsa gnyis so/ / ma ra ta ni k+Shi ra mo ra ta'o/ / bil ba ni shing pha la'o/ / bri ha ti rnam pa gnyis ni bri ha ti dang kaN+Da ka ri'o ka rany+dza gnyis ni bu ti ka rany+dza dang / nag ma ba'o/ /

ru sha kar la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni/ gcin sri ba dang / rde'us 'gags pa la sogs pa sel ba yin no/ / ru sha ka shi ni bri ka ka'o/ / spangs ma ni rnam pa gnyis te/ ka ra ka ram du rma bya'i mgrin pa 'dra ba ma yUr gr-i ba'o/ / rgyam tsha ni tsha mchog go/ / brag zhun ni shel dza du'o/ / nag tshur gnyis las gcig ni ban su ka si zhes bya ba sa rul dang 'dra ba'o/ /

skt: ayaṃ suramādvigaṃṇaḥ neṣye yati } tathā pratirayāyādidraḥ apnaḥ yodhana surasayugaṃ murasadramaṃ naura: phaṇiñjako māscikaḥ | kāṭamālā viḍaṅgaṃ karamighrama | sasmukhā sasayakraḥ sarathaḥ vṛṣapaṇīṃ ākhupabhī|kāsamado rājakaḥ pidā) kṣavakaḥ kuṣṭhivodhanaḥ| sarasī kapisdhapatyarā | kāyu nadīkāntī'tiyuktakaḥ | kakamācā kākayānayā kukhdaṇo'khavusā bhūkampaḥ | tiparasaṣaṭaḥ tarāsu; bhūsvṛṇo gudyavrījakaḥ | mūlakedī putrāsa || 14 pra5-arkādiko'dhatha varmaḥ kaphamedoviṣaghnaḥ | karabhikuṣṭhāni ca praśamayati | ṣidoṣādatiśayena traṇānāṃ sodhanaḥ śuddhikaraḥ | akaḥ sadāpuppī rūṣikāparparyāyaḥ | arko cikchiraṇaḥ śvatapuṣpaḥ nāgadantī ścataghaṇṭā | viśalyā khāṅgakhī | bhāṅgā bhṛṅgā | vṛśikāsyuṣaṭūbhūmikā saradaṃṣṭikāparapayāyā | parakīyā karala; | prasyakpuppā'pāmāgeḥ | pītate(360 )
tib: be lan tar la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni rlung las gyur cing / rlung las skyes pa'i nad rnams 'joms pa dang / chu so'i rde'u la sogs pa sel zhing 'joms so/ / de la rde'u phre'u ni rlung gis khrag bskams pa las dum bu byas pa las rde'u phre'u zhes bya'o/ / gcin srib ni gcin nad kyi nad gzhi las bshad do/ / be lan ta ra ni bi ra ta ra'o/ / a ra ni an mtha'o/ / spra tog ni i sha ram li ki'am/ bu ga na zhes bya ba me tog sbom bo can no/ / bri sha ni ba sha ka'o/ / sru su'i rtsa ba ni e ma de ba'o/ / a ga ta ni smyug pa tra'o/ / sa ha ra dza ni ser po'o/ / ka sha ni she ta tsa ma ra ste/ me tog rnga yab lta bu yod pa'i 'jag ma ser po'i rigs so/ / brik+Sha da ni ni bad kan zhes bya ba shing las shing gi nad kyi shing lo phre'u gzhan skyes pa'o/ / 'dam bu ni na la ste nang khong stong ngo / / ku sha rnam pa gnyis ni 'jag ma'i sbom po dang / phra mo rnam pa'i dbye bas phye ba'o/ / kun tha ni rtsa ba bca' sga 'dra ba yod pa'o/ / kha sral ni kun tu sri ste ka pi ka chu'o/ / bal bu ka ni so na ka'o/ / mo ra ta ni shing ti par go'o/ / ka ram pa ni ag ni ma pa'i mchog go/ / lcam pa ni par tha'o/ / seng phrom sha ba ra ro tra/ / pa la sha dang dz+hin dzi ni/ / thang shing kad pa la ra sna/ / ka dam pa dang chu shing dang / / e la ba lu a sho ka / pa ri be+e la mo tsa ka /

seng phrom la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni/ tshil ches pa dang / bad kan gyi nad sel ba dang / mngal nad 'joms shing 'khru ba gcod pa'i tshul can dang / / mdog bzang zhing gsal bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du dug sel bar byed pa yin no/ / de la seng phrom zhes bya ba ri dra ba rnam pa gnyis yod de/ gcig ni pa ti ka ri tra'o/ / gnyis pa sha ba ra ri tra'o/ / pa la sha ni keng su ka'o/ / dz+hin dzin gri ta many+dza ri ste/ yar kha mar zhig go/ / thang shing ni sar la te shing drang po tsi tra zhes bya'o/ / ra sna ni pa ni am ba ngan pa'o/ / chu shing ni ram pa ste nang stong pa'o/ / e la ba lu ka ni ha ri ba lu ka ste/ ming gzhan yang e le ya'o/ / a sho ka ni ming mya ngan med pa'o/ / pa ri be+e la ni ku ta nan da'o/ / mo tsa ni sa la ka'o/ / ar ka dang ni a ral ga /

skt: yuṣkakādigaṇo'ya gusmādīm‌ śukrapathatāyati | yupkako mokṣaḥ | khuk‌ sudhā | vasa nari phalā | drīpiśinnarakaḥ | paṭhāśa vrahmatar‌ḥ | dhavo dṛḍhatasaḥ | śiṣaśāpā maṇḍalapatrā

cassakādigaṇaḥ paṭhitaḥ cakhakaphādīn‌ duna. mapayentān‌ hanti | vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ | ghuṇapriyā ativiṣā | gaṇḍīra kaṇḍīraḥ | kaṭavaṅgo'ruka; | | para̭ṃcakokaṃ prāguktam‌ } batsakādayaścalādīn‌ gharati } āryā
tib: arka la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni bad kan dang / tshil ches pa dang / dug rnams sel bar byed pa dang / srin bu dang mdze nad 'joms par byed pa dang / khyad par mchog tu rma rnams la phan zhing sbyong bar byed pa yin no/ / ar ka ni rtag tu me tog 'byung ba ste ming gi rnam grangs su ru pi ka zhes bya'o/ / a ral ka ni shwe ta ku su ma ste me tog dkar po yod pa'o/ / nA ga dan ti ni sha ta gan d+ha ste me tog dkar po dril bu lta bu yod ba'o/ / bi sha l+ye ni lag la bshol lta bu'o/ / ga bra ni ga bar gyi'o/ / bi sha la ni a sta du ma'o/ / ming gzhan ni sar ba ta shi ka zhes bya'o/ / a ba marga ni pra dug pus pa'o/ / ka rany+dza ni pra gri rgya'o/ / ka ka da ri ni po ta te la'o/ / ka rany+dza ni gnyis/ ka rany+dza kar po ste/ ming gi rnam grangs gzhan yang na ga ta ma la zhes bya'o/ / gi ri kar ni gnyis las gcig ni ki ni hi gi ri kar ni zhes bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni ta ka byi zhes bya ba'i gir gi gar gi dkar po che ba'o/ / slob dpon gzhan dag ni kar ni gnyis pa ku ma ri zhes bya ba yin no zer ro/ / ing gu ta ni dka' thub pa'i shing ngo / / byi rug rnam gnyis ku the ra/ / ka la ma la byi dang ga / kha ra pa tra kad pa la/ / bri sha kar+Ni sha kun ti/ / ske tshe ka pid tha'i lo ma/ / ga bra mon sne'u ka mu ka /

skt: dvāvimo gaṇo bhriyadvabhbaṣṭhādī pakrātīsāranāranau 1 tathā sandhānīyau baṇānāmatisārasya ca tathā pathye hitau pathyau | tathā jraṇānāmapi ropaṇe ropaṇāciṣaye hitaiī)bhriyaṃgugendhagriyaṃgustasyāḥpuṣpam‌ | janlamayugmamajanaṭvayam‌. | soto'khanasauvīramedāminnam‌ | padmā padmacāriṇī | padyādrajaḥ padya kiśalkaḥ | yojanabahṭī makhiṣṭhā | anantā dīdhaimūradhca | samudrānto yavāsakaḥ | mānaharūmaḥ dālmaṭī | mocarasaḥ sāsmalyā niryāsaḥ| “niyāṃso yastu lālmadyāḥ samocarasasaṃjñakaḥ?› iyāmnāyāt‌ 1 samaṅgā namaskārī rtamūā ca | punnāgo raktakesaraḥ) sītaṃ cadanam‌ ,madahetudhītakī | ambaṣṭhā bahumūlikā | namaskārī samajñā 1 nandīvṛkṣo jayavṛkṣaḥ |. kacchura phaṇihārī ca | sṛṣmapatrā maruddhaghā | bisvapedikā visvamañajā | kaṭvaṅgo'rakaḥ | kamalodbhava rajaḥ paṣkesaraḥ
tib: byi'u rug pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni bad kan tshil ches pa dang / srin nad 'joms par byed pa dang / de bzhin du cham pa la sogs pa 'joms pa dang / rma red pa sbyong zhing dag par byed pa yin no/ / bye'u rug pa rnam pa gnyis ni ser po dang nag po'i dbye bas phye ba'o/ / ku the ra ni ka ka ma tsi ta'o/ / ka mu ga ni ni di kan da ste/ ming gi rnam grangs gzhan a ti mug ta ka zhes bya'o/ / rkang mar ni a lam bu sa'o/ / bag sha mug ti ni ke sha muSh+Thi sti'o/ / bu srin ni gu ha bi na dza ga ste sa bon mi mngon pa'o/ / 'bam po ni 'bu ta ge shi'o/ / mu ska ka dang snu ha dang / / 'bras bu gsum dang tsi tra ka / pa la sha dang d+ha ba dang / / shing sha pa zhes bya ba rnams/ / skran dang gcin nad rde'u chags/ / skya rbab dang ni tshil ches nad/ / bad kan rgyas dang khu ba yi/ / nad rnams sel bar byed pa yin/ / zhes bya ba la/ / mu ska ka la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni/ skran la sogs pa nas khu ba'i nad kyi bar du sel zhing 'joms bar byed pa yin no/ / de la mu ska ka ni shing mong sha ka zhes bya ba'o/ / snu ha ni sud+ha ste shrI khaN+Da'i shing ngo / / ba la sha ni bra ma ta ru'o/ / d+ha ba ni shing sha pa'i ming gi rnam grangs mal da la pa ha zhes bya ba zlum pa zhig go/ / dug mo nyung dang mur ba dang / / bar gi dang ni bu tse shel/ / na le sham dang bong nga dkar/ / chu sgog sug smel pa tha dang / / yungs kar zir u ra lu/ / a za mo dang po son cha/ / shu dag zi ra nag po dang / / shing kun dang ni byi dang ga /

dug mo nyung la sogs pa'i sde tshan du gtogs pa'i sde 'di ni rlung nad dang / bad kan la sogs pa nas gzhang 'brum gyi bar 'joms shing sel bar byed pa yin no/ / dug mo nyung ni rnam grangs pa bad ka zhes pa'o/ / chu sgog ni gan di ri'o/ / u ra lu ni ga ka tang ka ste ma hA ni ma ba'o/ / shu dag ni tshigs drug pa'o/ / ba shu gan d+ha ni sra ti mi ru ra'o/ / tsha ba lnga ni pi pi ling dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / dbyi mong dang / tsi tra ka dang / / bca' sga'o/ / shu dag gla sgang thang shing dang / / dong gra bong nga a ru ra/ / ser po gnyis dang shing mngar dang / / kr-iSh+Na par+Ni dug mo yungs/ / shu dag yung ba la sogs sde/ / be'u snabs tshad pas 'khru smin gcod/ / tshil ches bad kan rgyas rlung 'khyil/ / nu ma'i nad rnams sel bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ shu dag la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni/ be snabs tshad bas 'khru ba smin par byed do/ / tshil ches pa dang bad kan rgyas pa la sogs pa sel bar byed do/ / sman rnams ni go bar zad do/ / pri yang ku dang ra gan dud/ / lig pu mig dang stang zil dang / / lcim rtsa pad+ma ge sar dang / / btsod dang ya ba sha ka dang / / shal ma li dang de'i khu ba/ / sa mang ga dang bu na ma/ / tsan+dan da ta ka'i me tog /

skt: mustāyā varīkkitāstanyāmayannāḥ khīkṣīravyādhināśanāḥ | makhādīnāṃ vātādīnāṃ rkṛdādīnāṃ ca sāmānāṃ pācanāḥ | apridhitrakaḥ | ṭa niśe hari drādayam‌ | ḍhe kaṭuke ekā kaṭukā dvitīyā kākatiktā 1 haimavatī ca
tib: pri yang ku dang / am sha'i sde tshan 'di gnyis ni/ zhu ba'i tshad bas 'khru ba sel ba ste/ ma zhu ba'i be+e snabs med pa'i 'khru ba 'joms par byed pa dang / de bzhin du 'byor bar byed de/ rma 'tsho ba'i tshad pas 'khru ba gcod pa dang mkhris pa la phan zhing bde bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du rma yang 'tsho zhing 'byor pa la phan par byed pa yin no/ / de yang pri yang ku ni gan d+ha pri yang ku ste/ de'i me tog go/ / lcim rtsa ni pad+ma rtsa ra'o/ / pad+ma ge sar ni pad+ma'i ki na dza ga'o/ / btsod ni man dzi sh+tha'o/ / yab sha ka ni a nan ta'o/ / shal ma li ni man du ma'o/ / de'i khu ba ni shal ma'i khu ba ste/

rtsa ba dmar ba'o/ / bu na ma ni rak+ta ge sar ro/ / da ta ki ni ma da he tu ste tshang rtsi'o/ / am ba sha ni ba hu mU la ka ste/ rtsa ba mang po'o/ / na ma ka ra ni sa mang ga'o/ / tu ni shing ni nan ti br-i k+Sha'o/ / kad tshu ra ni ha ri zhes bya ba 'dab ma phra ba zhig go /

skt: gaṇo'tha syamamodhādirabaṇyo braṇāya hitaḥ saṃgrahaṇa sīraḥ seṅparāhī bhagrān‌ sandhayati bhabhrasādhanaḥ medaḥpintādinibarhaṇaḥ | nyagrodho vaṭaḥ | pippaṭo'śvasthaḥ sadāphala udumbaraḥ | jambūdrayamekā rājajamūhatkalā, dvitīyā kākajambūḥ hasvaphalā | ajanaḥ kakubhaḥ | kapītano bānīraḥ kāpicūḍaḥ | saumavaskaḥ kaṭū falaḥ| pakṣau gadabhāṇḍaḥ | cañjukho vetasaḥ | priyāḥ ladiraskandhaḥ | parāścaḥ kiśyuko vātapodaḥ| nandīkṣo rājagṛkṣaḥ | kolī badarī } virā dīṣainakhī tindukīvyapare | madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī | madhūkaṃ madhūka puṣpam‌
tib: gla sgang la sogs pa'i sde tshan du byas pa ni/ nu zho'i nad bud med kyi nu zho'i skyon dang de bzhin du mngal gyi nad rnams dang dri ma ste/ 'phyen dang bshang gci la sogs pa'i nad smin cing sel bar byed pa yin no/ / kha ba gnyis las gcig ni pu tse shel lo/ / gnyis pa ka ka tig ta'o/ / gzhan ni go bar zad do/ / n+ya gro d+ha dang a shwad+tha/ / u dum+bA ra seng phrom gnyis/ / 'dzam bu gnyis dang a rdzu na/ / ka pi ta dang kad pa la/ / p+lak+sha a mra lcang ma dang / / pi la ya dang pa la sha/ / nan te rgya shug ka dam pa/ / bi da shing mngar ma du ka / n+ya gro d+ha sogs sde tshan 'di/ / rma 'tsho 'khru gcod chag grugs 'byor/ / tshil ches khrag mkhris skom dad che/ / mngal gyi nad rnams sel bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ n+ya gro d+ha la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni/ rma 'tsho zhing 'byor bar byed pa dang / 'khru ba gcod pa dang / rkang lag gi chag grugs 'byor bar byed pa dang / tshil ches pa dang khrag mkhris la sogs pa'i nad sel bar byed pa yin no/ / n+ya gro d+ha ni ba shi ba da'o/ / a shwang+tha ni pi pa la'o/ / u dum+bAr ni sa dang pha rol la'o/ / 'dzam bu gnyis las gcig ni ra dza 'dzam bu ste/ 'bras bu che ba zhig go/ / gnyis pa ni ka 'dzam bu'o/ / ardzu na ni ku ku ba'o/ / ka pi ta ni ba ra da'o/ / kang pa la ni so ma ba la ka'o/ / blag sha ni gar sha gan da'o/ / a mra ni tsu ta'o/ / lcang ma ni ban dzu la'o/ / pi ya la ni kha ra kan da'o/ / de bzhin du pa la sha ni king shu ka'o/ / shing nan ti ni du ni shing ngo / / rgya shug ni ba di ra'o/ / bi da ra la ni tin du khi'o/ / gzhan dag na re dirga na kha yin no zhes zer ro/ / ma du ka ni ma du puSh+pa'o/ / e la gnyis dang tu ru ka / ru rta gan+d+ha pri yang ku/ / spang spos pa la bya ma ka / spri ka tso ra tso tsa dang / / shing tsha gan+d+ha b+ha dra dang / / rgya spos po la s+the ne ya/ / rgya mtsho sbu ba chu srin sen/ / thang shing dang ni a ka ru/ / gur gum shi ri ba sa ka / tsan+dan gu gul lce bog dkar/ / bu na ma dang kun du ru/ / nA ga ge sar zhes bya'o/ / e la sogs sde rlung bad kan/ / dug rnams sel zhing mdog gsal byed/ / g.yan pa thor bu'i nad rnams dang / / sha bkra bas ldag sel bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ e la la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni/ rlung dang bad kan dang dug rnams sel bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du mdog gsal zhing dang bar byed pa dang / g.yan pa la sogs pa sel bar byed pa yin no/ / e la gnyis ni sug smel zhes bya ba/ e la phra mo dang / e la sbom pa'o/ / tu ru ka ni si la ra sa'o/ / gan+d+ha bri yang ku ni pha ni'o/ / bya ma ka ni de ba da d+ha'o/ / spri ka ni da ba li ste/ 'bu sug hang ngo / / tso ra ka ni ban d+ha thig kha na ste tsa ro'o/ / tso tsa ni sa ni ta ka ru ste/ ming gi rnam grangs na ta zhes bya'o/ / bo la ni dza ki ba ka'o/ / rgya mtsho sbu ba ni bya gra na ga ste/ / sa mun tra na dza la zhes bya'o/ / thang shing ni thang shing ring po'i thang chu'o/ / tsan+dan ni pu shu na'o/ / gu gul ni ma hi sha g+ha'o/ / pog dkar po ni sardza ra sa ste/ lha'i spos zhes kyang bya'o/ / bu na ma ni rak+ta ke sa ra'o/ / kun du ru ni kha bur ra'o/ / sha ma dan ti dra ban ti/ / ku ta ra na kra mu ka /

skt: elādiko'ya vargo vātakaphaviṣān‌ vininti | tathā vraṇasya prasādanaḥ kaṇḍvādin‌śanaśca | aśaṭaṅgṛdeyaṃ | [ cla elāyugmaṃ sṛṣṣamaikhā, sthūaikhā ca | turuṣkaḥ kṛtrima piṇyākāparaparthāyaḥ | phalinī gandhabhiyaṃguḥ | jaṭaṃ vāṭhakam‌ | dhyāmakaṃ devadagdhakam‌ | sprakā devī chatā satī | caurako garathivaṇeḥ | cocaṃ svaka | patanaṃ candanaṃ gandhapatrāparaparyāyam‌ | tagaraṃ cakram‌ | sthau ṇeyaṃ tailapītakam‌ | jātīraso rasovakhaḥ| śuktiḥ kara“ ruhaḥ | vyāghra nakhaḥ samudrajaḥ | amarāho devadāraḥ | śrīvāsaḥ śraveṣṭakaḥ | kuṃkumaṃ bāhīkam‌ | caṇa piṣyunā } gugyudhaḥ mahiṣāsyaḥ | devadhūpaḥ sajaṃrasaḥ| khapuraḥ kundaraḥ | punnāgo raktakesaraḥ | nāgā nāgakesaram‌
tib: sham la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni skran la sogs pa'i nad rnams 'joms shing sel bar byed pa yin no/ / de la sha ma ni dur byid kyi bye brag ste/ ba li na ti zhes bya'o/ / dan ti ni mu ka la'o/ / dra ban ti ni mu sha ka ra ni'o/ / ku ta ra ni bod stang ste/ dur byid ces so/ / kra mu ka ni gla gor zho sha'o/ / shang gi ni ni ya ba tig ta'o/ / sa ta la ni tsar mas dang zhes bya'o/ / khron bu ni tig ta dug d+ha ga ste/ 'o ma kha bro ba yod pa'o/ / ga bak+sha ni bi sha la'o/ / su d+ha k+Shi ra ni su da'o/ / kam bi l+ya ni ra dza na kho'o/ / ka rany+dza ni pu ti ka rany+dza'o/ / baSh+Ta an tra ni bi sha gan+d+hi'o/ / shi kru ni ba ha la'o/ / shing ro tsha ni pi lu ste de'i 'bras bu'o/ / de ltar sum cu rtsa gsum bshad/ / sde tshan de dag ma rnyed na/ / de dang cha mtshungs gzhan yang sbyar/ / mi 'dra'i sbyor ba spang bar bya/ / de ltar zhes bya ba'i sgra ni rdzogs pa'i don nam rnam pa'i don no/ / de la rdzogs pa ni sde tshan sum cu rtsa gsum rdzogs pa'o/ / rnam pa'i don ni rnam pa 'dis sde tshan sum cu rtsa gsum yin gyi/ yang rnam pa gzhan du na sman gyi dbye ba la ltos na/ sde tshan mtha' yas pa yin no/ / de dag las sbyor ba dang rjes su mthun pa gang yin pa gzhan de dang de dag gi ma smos su zin kyang gzhug par bya la/ gang gzhan sbyor ba dang mi mthun pa de dag ni smos su zin kyang gdon par bya'o/ / de bzhin du sde tshan yang gzhan dag de dang mtshungs pa ste/ ro dang nus pa dang / / 'ju ba'i tshul de dag mnyam pa'i sman gzhan dag sbyar zhing bsre bar bya'o/ / ci mdor bya ba bstan pa ni 'di tsam kho nar zad dam/ 'on te der bya ba gzhan 'ga' zhig kyang yod ce na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ mi 'dra ba'i sbyor ba spang bar bya ba yin te/ rdzas gang sbyor ba dang mi mthun zhing cha mi 'dra ba ste/

skt: itiśabḍaḥ parisamāptyathaḥ prakārārtho vā| parisamāāsarthasaśgāḥ |adhānena prakriṇa trayaridaragona yena prakārantareṇa punarānantya vagoṇāṃ dopabhedādīn‌ samīkṣya yadayadacaugikara manye tattaduktamapi raṇamadhye vidadhyāt‌ | yadyadayaugikaṃ manye vatatadktamapyap‌karṣeṇa tathā gaṇamapyanyena gagenaikena ghā paramparaṃ bhiśrayitvā yuññyādevaṃ bagāṇāmānantyam‌ | ravaṃ trayasiśyat‌ ye vagau nirdharṭāstapu varnapvalābhato yuñjyāt‌ | tadvidhamanyanca ko'thaḥ | ukta vyāchāme yathālābhamanyadudranyaṃ taddhidhapranāvai varja yisavā rasavīyavipākaistusya prakṣipet‌ | kimetāvadevātra kartavyatayā nirdiṣṭamutānyadapi kiñcittatra kataivyamato'nantaramidamāha-jyādayaugikaṃ dravyaṃ yogāīai na bhavati jaghyān‌ tyajet‌ | ada yaugikam‌| yogā doṣādyekyā sambhāvyate tadṭidaghyān‌ | sthite doṣādyapekṣayā samastavagastatmādhyavyāyiprmanāya deyaḥ | kadācit‌ samastadravyaṅāme na deyaḥ | kadācidekaṃ dravyaṃ dvedhā vahūni vā yāvanti sambhavanti dvitrāṇi paccapāṇi bā tāni dātu yujyanta na samastavardravyapikṣā'tra kāryeti | alābhe satīti saptama tas‌
tib: don gyi shugs kyis na nad la sogs pa la ltos pa ste/ sbyor ba dang rjes su mthun zhing cha 'dra ba ni gzhug par bya'o/ / zhes ston pa yin no/ / de bas na nad la sogs pa la ltos bas sde tshan ma lus pa gso bar gtogs pa'i nad rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i phyir sman sbyin par bya la/ gal te sde tshan gyi sman ma lus pa rnyed na kun sbyin par bya'o/ / gal te ma rnyed na de las sman gcig gam gnyis sam gsum ma ma bzhi'am lnga'am mang po'am/ ji tsam 'byor pa sbyin par bya'i 'dir sde tshan las smos pa'i sman ma lus pa med du mi rung ba ni ma yin no/ / de yang sman dpyad kyi gzhung gzhan las/ don gyi dbye ba la ltos na/ / phan pa'i sde tshan sbyar bya la/ / re re'am bsres pa ma lus pa/ / sde tshan so sor bsdu bar bya/ / zhes smos pa yin no/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/

skt: vikatiḥ patitāsya tantāntare'dhyuktam‌| “samīkṣya raṣabheda dha gaṇāniṣṭān‌ prayojayet‌ | parathadmiśrān‌ mastā tha nāntvyastānna saṃhitān‌|| iti bhadram‌daṣ iti śrīcandranandanavirācitāyāṃ padārbhavandarikāyāmaṣṭāṅgahadayaṭīkāyāṃ sūtrasthāne rodhanādigaṇasaṃgrahādhyāyaḥ paccadaśacaḥ
tib: / / de nas snum gyi cho ga dpyad par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /

skt: rodhanādigaṇasaṅpahādhyāyādanantaramayaṃ snehanādhyāya ārabdhaḥ | yataḥ sodhanavamanādikamantarā snehasvedau na katavya | pratayapāyabhayāditi | snehaḥ sarvimañjādi tasya̱ vidhirvidhāna katpanā yasminnadhyāye vihitaḥ sa snedavidhistaṃ nyā khyāsyāmaḥ
tib: sbyar ba la sogs pa'i sman gyi sde tshan gyi rjes la/ snum gyi cho ga bya ba'i le'u brtsams pa ni gang gi phyir skyug sman la sogs pas sbyor ba na/ snum dang dugs byas na slar gnod par 'gyur bas/ de'i 'og tu 'di bshad pa yin no/ / de la snum ni zhun mar dang / til mar dang / tshil dang rkang la sogs pa'o/ / de'i cho ga ni bya ba'i las kyi cho ga ste/ de'i le'u gang du bshad/ de'i sman gyi cho gar bya ba'i le'u ste/ de bshad par bya'o zhes bya ba'o/ / snum byed sman rnams phal cher ni/ / lci zhing bsil la khong 'khru snum/ / rngul dang bral la mnyen zhing brlan/ / de las bzlog pa rtsub byed yin/ / zhes bya ba'i phyir bstan pa 'di ni gzhung rtsom par byed pa dang / rtsub par byed pa'i sman rnams kyi mtshan nyid mdor bsdus nas bshad pa yin no/ / sman gang ci yang rung ba lci ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa de dag ni snum par byed pa dang ldan pa de ni yin la/ yon tan de las go bzlog pa yang ba dang / dro ba dang / bshang ba sri ba dang / rtsub pa dang / rno ba dang / sbom pa dang / sra ba dang / bska ba dang / mang ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa de ni rtsub par byed pa yin no/ / phal cher zhes smos pa ni snum par byed pa dang / rtsub par byed pa gnyis ka la yang sbyar bar bya ste/ de la 'chol ba dag kyang yod par bstan pa'i phyir ro/ / de yang dper na ra'i 'o ma ni yang nas yang du snum par byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du til mar ni snum par byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du mon sran dkar po ni/ lci ba'i yon tan dang ldan yang yang bar byed pa yin no/ / zhun mar rkang dang tshil til mar/ / snum rnams kyi ni mchog rab 'dod/ / ces bya ba la/ zhun mar la sogs pa bzhi po ni/ snum thams cad kyi nang nas mchog rab bam/ gtso bo yin par sman pa mkhas pa rnams 'dod do/ / rang gi las myur du sgrub bar byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /

bzhi po de dag gi nang nas kyang zhun mar ni mchog yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ sbyor rjes 'jug pa zhes bya ba ste/ sman dang sbyar ba de'i rjes su 'jug cing mthun pas de'i phyir zhun mar ni snum thams cad kyi mchog yin gyi til mar ni ma yin no/ / de yang rgyu mnyam du zin kyang zhun mar ni bu ram la sogs pa rdzas kyi yon tan dro ba yod pa dang sbyar du zin kyang / rang gi mtshan nyid kyis bsil ba mdor bstan pas sbyor ba'i sman gyi rjes su mthun par 'jug gi / til mar ni de lta ma yin no/ / de ni tsan+dan la sogs pa sman gyi nus mthu bsil ba dang ldan par sbyar na yang / rang gi yon tan dro ba de rnams thams cad du 'dor bar mi 'gyur la/ de mi 'dor bas na khrag dang mkhris pa dang / me dbal la sogs pa la yang gnod par byed pa yin no/ /
snum snga ma gang yin pa ni/

phyi ma la ltos pa ni snga ma yin no/ / snga ma la ltos pa ni phyi ma yin no/ / de bas na 'di skad du/ bstan pa'i zhun mar la sogs pa'i snum bzhi po de dag las/ tshil dang rkang mar zhun mar zhes bya ba ni sngon bzhin til mar zhes bya ba'i snum ni ma yin te/ de las gong mar gyur pa med pa'i phyir dang / 'di gang zhig la ltos nas snga mas bdag nyid sgrub pa'i phyir phyi ma yang yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du snum bzhi po de dag las rkang dang tshil dang til mar zhes bya ba la snum gsum po kho na phyi ma bzhi dang sbyor te/ zhun mar zhes bya ba'i snum la phyi ma yod pa ma yin no/ / de bas na snga ma bzhin du mkhris pa sel ba yin pas tshil dang rkang dang zhun mar ni mkhris pa sel bar byed pa yin no/ / de las kyang tshil ni mkhris pa sel bar byed pa yin no/ / rkang ni rab tu mkhris pa sel bar byed pa'o/ / zhun mar ni rab mchog mkhris pa sel bar byed pa'o/ / phyi ma bzhin du cig shos sel/ / zhes bya ba nas/ cig shos ni rlung dang bad kan gnyis te/ de dag snum gsum po rkang dang tshil dang til mar gyis rim bzhin sel bar byed pa yin te/ rkang ni rlung dang bad kan sel bar byed pa yin no/ / tshil gyis rlung dang bad kan rab tu sel ba'o/ / til mar gyis rlung

skt: dhṛtātteṭaṃ gurutaraṃ bhavati | tekhādrasā yuvī | dhakhāthā api mañjā guruḥ

sveyādayaḥ stedyāḥ svedalārhāḥ | svedyāḥ sīḥ nārhaḥ saṃyodhyāḥ| tathā sathaśrīnyāyamepnāsaktāḥ tathā cintakāḥ | kṣīṇasasca saktaṃ retaḥ śukra yeṣāṃ tathā vātāta vātapīḍitāḥ | tathā syandati raneśrasegadāraṇaghratibodhinaḥ snedyāḥ | dāraṇaḥ prari nodhaḥ śrancharadunmeṣaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te dāraṇapratidhīdhinaḥ7 ṭi 0~-snnīyānāha- seḥ kartavyasvedaḥ, saṃśo | kartavyadayodhanaḥ, madyādi taripvātaktaḥ, nitakaḥ citāparara syado necakovaḥ, dāraṇaprativodhaḥ kṛccharatmīṭaḥ || 7 vatirmadā'bhitīṣṇābhiśyukhdubasaḥ urustabhā'tisārā''magacharagamarād‌r‌; || mūchācchadairuciṣcheṣmataṣṇāpśca pīḍitāḥ 1 apūtā yuktai ca nasye dhastau piredhane ||8
tib: 'di dag 'ju dka' ba'i rim pa yin te/ de yang mtho btsun dpal 'phel gyis byas pa'i gces pa btus pa las/ zhun mar bas ni til mar lci ba yin la/ til bas ni tshil lci zhing 'ju dka' ba yin no/ / tshil bas ni rkang 'ju dka' ba yin no zhes bshad pa yin no/ / snum rnams kyi ming dang ming can gyi 'brel pa bstan par bya ba'i phyir smras pa ni/ de las gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi/ / zung dang gsum pa che zhes bya/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ snum gnyis po mar dang til mar ni zung zhes bya ba'i snum yin no/ / zhun mar dang til mar dang / tshil gsum gsum pa zhes bya'o/ / de gsum rkang dang bcas pa bzhi po zhes bya'o/ / dugs bya sbyang bya chang bud med/ / rtsol chags sems las che ba dang / / rgan po byis pa stobs chung sbeg /

skt: atimandāgnyādayo natu snehyā iti sambandhaḥ | tīkṣṇāḥ snedanādatyabhibaraddhiḥ | sthṛṭasyādhcimedaso vṛddhiḥ | durbarasyājaraṇaśaktiḥ | ū‌stambhādīnāṃ pīḍitaśabdena sambandhaḥ | tenorustasbhapīḍitaḥ atistāreṇa pīḍitaḥ āmapīḍito yāvanmadyapīḍita iti | atra rodhanagrasadge'pyamneharanaṃ vidhinā na rodhanamiti yāvat‌. | apaprasṛtā na ranehayeti vipariṇāmaḥ | apagrasūtā akāṭaprasṛtā | aparipūīmāsamrasateti yāvat‌ | tathā nasyādikarmatritaye yukte sayadoṣasāmye sneho na yojyaḥ | 8 \
tib: dugs bya bar 'os pa ni dugs bya ba'o/ / legs par sbyang bar 'os pa ni sbyang bar bya'o/ / chang dang bud med dang rtsol ba rnams la chags pa dang / de bzhin du sems las che ba dang / rgan po dang byis pa dang / stobs chung ba dang sbeg pa dang / rtsub pa dang / gang khrag dang khu ba zad pa dang / de bzhin du rlung nad kyis rab tu nyen zhing gdungs pa dang / de bzhin du yang rlung las rab rib dang / mig nad shin tu dbye dka' zhing / mig dka' bas dbye dgos pa gang yin pa ste/

shin tu drod chung ba la sogs pa la snum gyi cho ga mi bya'o/ / zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ / de drod shin tu che ba la snum gyi cho ga byas na me drod shin tu 'phel drags par 'gyur ro/ / shin tu sbom pa la yang me drod dang tshil cher 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / rid pas ni 'ju mi nus par 'gyur ro/ / brla rengs la sogs pas nyen pa zhes bya bar sbyar te/ dus ma yin bar bu skyes pa yang snum gyi cho ga mi bya ste/ / zla ba ma tshang bar bu skyes na 'dir sbyor ba'i stobs yin du zin kyang / snum gyi cho ga ma byas par sbyar ba'i cho ga bya'o/ / zhes ston pa yin no/ / dus ma yin par bu skyes pa yang snum gyi cho ga mi bya ste/ zla ba ma tshang bar du skyes pa yang snum gyi cho ga mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du sna sman la sogs pa las gsum po byas pa'i skabs su yang snum bcos kyi cho ga mi bya'o/ /

skt: tatra teṣu sneheṣu madhye dhīprabhatikāṃkṣiṇāmabhilāṣiṇāṃ ghusā snedaprasaṅge sati dhṛtaṃ snehaḥ śasyate| tasya tathā rāktatvāt‌ | dhīvuddhiḥ | medhā prajñā | mahaṇena svarāyuvaraṇādipārimarahaḥ
tib: de la snum rnams kyi nang nas blo gros la sogs pa 'dod cing don du gnyer ba'i skyes bus snum bsten pa'i skabs la bab pas na/ zhun mar btung ba bsngags shing 'dod par bya ba yin te/ de'i nus pa de yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de la blo ni blo gros so/ / dran pa ni sngon nyams su myong ba dran pa'o/ / yid gzhungs pa ni shes pa ste/

rtsa nad la sogs pa'i nad rnams dang / de bzhin du bad kan dang / / tshil ches pa dang / rlung nad can gyi skyes bu dang / de bzhin du lus yang bar 'dod pa dang / mkhrang bar 'dod pa dang / de bzhin du srab pa'i lus can rnams la til mar phan no/ /

skt: vātātapādibhiḥ krīṇā bhātavā yapāṃ tepu nareṣu yaśā rūśnādiṣu ca ropī sha vasa ujānau rāsyeta | kṭeyaknamayāravyena kledaka sardhisaiṭaṃ prayojayan‌ | alyabhniratitīkṣṇāpniḥ raḥ pratiṣedha vasāmañjatvāpavādvākyam‌ | vātātrṛtapa vātaśaddhasarotaḥsu majjā
vasāṃ punaḥ sandhyasthirujāsvapīṣṭā | tathā dagdhādiṣu raṃjāsu vasā śāsyate iti sambandhaḥ
tib: rlung dang nyi tshan la sogs pas lus zungs zad par 'gyur ba'i skyes bu gang yin pa dang / de bzhin du lus rtsub pa la sogs pa la/ snum lhag ma rkang dang tshil bu gnyis phan zhing bsngags pa yin no/ / nyon mongs bzod ces bya ba'i sgras/ nyon mongs shing dka' ba bsten mi bzod pas ni zhun mar dang til mar bsten par mi bya'o/ / zhes bkar ba yin no/ / me drod ni rno ba'i snum snga ma dag gis/ rkang dang tshil sbyin pa dang / dgar ba'i tshig yin no/ / rlung gis rtsa sgo kun 'gags shing chod pa 'di lta bu la tshil zos na phan no/ / de la tshil ni lhag par rus pa'i tshigs kha bye ba dang / rus pa chag pa dang / gnod snad pa dang / lto ba'i nang grol na ba dang / mes tshig pa dang / lus smas te rma byung ba dang / rkang lag gi tshigs bur ba dang / mo mtshan na ba dang / rna ba na ba dang / klad pa na ba dang / 'di lta bu la yang tshil phan no/ / zhes bya bar sbyar na yang tshil mchog tu yang phan pa yin no/ / da ni dus gang zhig btang ba bsngags pa bstan pa'i phyir smras pa ni/

skt: pāvṛṣi yadetat‌ taila tathā varṣante sardhivaisāmañjānau mādhava pveyevairūpo niyamaḥ sa kiñci dapekṣyata tadathemidamāh‌-katau sādhā nādhyupṇasīte madhyāvasye tato yathāyathaṃ tekhādayaḥ saṃdodhanāt‌ pū snehayamupayobhyāḥ | tathā'hi divase na nidyāyāṃ tathā vima ravau nimaṭe bhākhati nātra saṃkṭhādite | evameteṣu kaṭeṣu prāvṛḍādipvātevadoṣasaścayasya niha sarvo vidhinidiṣṭaḥ | parāvṛḍādivarjaye punaralanyasmin‌ kāle vyādhivarātvaroyāmupajāte saṃśodhanasya karaivyatve prāpi'pyakatevyatvaṃ rām‌ | yataḥ mūtrarodhanāsūr sahanā snedaniyamānna kathissaneha upayoktuṃ śakyate
tib: 'dir dbyar zhes smos kyang dbyar smos pa'i dus tshigs thog ma la bya ste/ de nas dbyar zla 'bring po'o zhes bya ba'i skabs su sbyong ba byed na/ til mar bsngags pa yin no/ / dbyar mtha' zhes smos kyang / char 'bab pa'i mtha' rdzogs pa ston zla tha la/ de'i tshe snum bya ba'i don du zhun mar bsngags pa yin no/ / gzhan zhes bya ba rkang dang tshil zhes bya ba'i snum ni dpyid zla 'bring po'i skabs su sbyong bar byed pa na snum gyi sbyor ba bsngags pa yin no/ / 'di dag ni nad med pa'am/ nad pa gang yang rung ba sbyong ba byed pa'i gnas skabs bya ba'i phyir gzhung 'di brtsams pa yin no/ / nad med cing tha mal par gnas pa dag gis ji skad bshad pa'i dus tshigs kyi cho ga rjes su dpyad zin kyang dus las byung ba'i nad bsags pa dag yod srid par de'i 'og tu de las nad bsags pa gzhi 'khrugs par 'gyur la/ nad 'khrugs pas nad 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin te/ de bas na tshe'i rig byed kyi de kho na shes pa'i drang srong rnams kyis rang bzhin gyis byas pa'i rgyud so sor bde bar gnas pa dag gis sbyang ba dag bya ba nyid du bstan pa yin no/ / de bzhin du grang ba las byung ba'i nad bsags pa ni dpyid kyi tshe sbyang ba bshad pa 'dis cho ga lhag ma yod pa'i gzhung gis sbyar ba yin no/ / bkru sman la sogs pa'i sbyong ba rnams kyang snum dang dugs kyi cho ga bya ba sngon du 'gro bas bya ba yin gyi gzhan du ma yin no/ / de'i phyir grang ba las byung ba'i nad bsags pa ni dpyid kyi dus su gdon cing / grang ba na snum dang dugs bya ba dang / de'i tshe til mar bkag pa yin no/ / de bzhin du dbyar 'das pa na/ dbyar bsags pa'i nad 'byin pa nad dang por snum dang dugs nges par bya dgos la/ der yang snum thams cad kyis snum gyi cho ga byed de/ de yin pa'i phyir kun gyi byed pa dag srid mod kyi/ der gnas mod kyis mi bya'o/ / zhun mar gyi snum gyi cho ga bya ste/ 'di ni nad med pa'i yul la byas pa'i nges ba yin no/ / nad pa'i gnas skabs sbyang bar byas pa gso ba'i nad kyis nyen pa la til mar gyis gso dgos pa'i nad yin te/ de dang mi 'tsham du zin kyang / dbyar sbyang ba'i las byed pa na/ til mar nyid kyis snum gyi cho ga bya'o/ / snum gzhan gyis ni ma yin no/ / de bzhin du gzhan dag kyang nad kyi tshul dang sbyar te/ rang nyid kyi rjes su dpag par bya'o/ / 'dir 'di ltar dbyar til mar gtang ngo / / dbyar gyi mtha' ni zhag dang tshil bu gtang ngo / / zhes bya ba'i tshul gyis nges pa bzhag pa ni gzhan la yang cung zad ltos pa yin pas/ nad de'i phyir smras pa ni/ thun mong dus la snum rnams ni/ / nyin mo nyi ma gsal tshe bsngags/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ thun mong du shin tu tshab ma yin te/ / grang ba ma yin pa'i gnas skabs bar mar snum gyi cho ga byed pa na/ de'i tshe sbyang ba'i sngon du til mar la sogs pa snum gyi cho ga 'di'i don du sbyong ba de yang nyin par bya'o/ / mtshan mo ni ma yin no/ / de bzhin du nyi ma gsal ba ste/ nam mkha' ltar dri ma med cing sprin gyis nyi ma'i zer ma bsgribs pa'i tshe na bya ba yin no/ / de ltar na dus de rnams su nad bsags pa nges par 'joms pa'i cho ga bshad pa yin no/ / dbyar la sogs pa ma gtogs pa dus gzhan dag tu nad kyi dbang gis bsgyur te/ bya dgos pa'i sbyang bas bya ba yin du zin kyang bya ba'i mtshan nyid du 'gyur te de bzhin du nyi ma gsal ba ste/ nam mkha' ltar gang gi phyir de sbyong ba'i 'og tu snum gyi cho ga bya tib: snum 'thungs pa'i skyes bu des kha zas bza' bar bya ba la/ de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ phal cher gsher zhing rlan bag yod pa dang / dro ba'i bad kan mi skye ba dang / shin tu snum pa ma yin pa ste/ cung zad snum pa dang 'dres pa ma yin pa ste/ zas gnod pa dang 'dren mar ma yin pa bza' bar bya'o/ / de yang ci zhig byed pa'i tshe zhe na nang par te/ phyed de nyin na 'thung bar rtog pa'am/ yang de bzhin du nyin zhag de nyid kyis 'thung ba dang / de bzhin du dang por gang gis snum 'thungs pa de'i tshe/ kha zas 'di ltar bza' ba'o/ / kha lag chu tshan gyis bkru zhing / / bud med mi bsten mtshan mo nyal/ / shugs dgag drag shul las rnams dang / / khro dang mya ngan nyi tshan grang / / ser bu'i khar 'dug rta zhon 'gro/ / mang smra rab mtho'i stan la 'dug /

snum 'thungs pa'i skyes bus kha lag bkru ba la sogs pa/ chu'i bya ba chu dron pos bya ba dang / bud med bsten cing nyal po spang bar bya ba dang / de bzhin du mtshan mo nyal zhing bde bar gnyid log par bya ba dang / de bzhin du bshang gci la sogs pa shugs mi dgag pa dang / de bzhin du drag shul gyi las rnams dang khro ba nas dud pa dang rdul gyi nang du 'dug pa'i bar du spang bar bya'o/ / de la drag shul gyi las ni dus nub par byed pa'i du ma'o/ / rab mtho stan gcig mthon po la gcig pu yun ring du mi 'dug pa'o/ / mal dang mgo bo'i rten du gyur pa ni sngas zhes bya ba ste/ de yang rab tu mtho ba dang rab tu dma' ba spang bar bya'o/ / nyin par nyal ba ni nyin mo gnyid log pa ste/ de yang spang bar bya'o/ / dud pa ni grags par zad do/ / rdul ni rdul khrod de/ der gnas par mi bya'o/ / de bas na snum gyi cho ga byed pa na/ de thams cad spang bar bya'o/ / de yang sang gi nyin mo ste/ nyin zhag gang la skyes bu snum 'thungs par gyur pa des/ de srid kyi nyin zhag gzhan la'ang gong du smos pa'i thams cad spang bar bya'o/ /

bshad ma thag pa'i chu tshan btung ba la sogs pa'i las kyi rim pa bzhin 'di ni snum gyi cho ga dang / dugs dang snod la sogs pa nas me btsa' dang / thal sman rnon po gtang ba'i bar du/ de bzhin du nad kyis nyam chung bar gyur pa la yang bya ste/ snum gyi cho ga 'ba' zhig la 'di bya bar ma zad do/ /

skt: śamane sneyukte upacāro bhojanādikramī vi ktasyaiva kāryaḥ| viraktasyaiva yadattaṃ peyādikaṃ tatsaṃ svaṃ cāmane stehe kriyamāṇe jīrṇasnedasya puṃsaḥ kāyaḥ!
tib: zhi bar bya ba'i snum btang ba'i nye bar spyad pa zas la sogs pa'i rim pa ni bkru sman btang ba lta bu ste/ bkru sman btang ba na thug pa la sogs pa bya ba gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i snum byas pa'i snum de zhu ba'i skyes bu la yang bya'o/ /

skt: mūṛdī koṣṭhe naraḥ stehamacchaṃ vyahaṃ trīṇi dina ni. ṣibet‌| kūre koṣṭhe sedamacchaṃ sapradinaṃ saptarātraṃ ' bet‌! adhavā naiṣa niyamaratayo; kiṃtā samyacchāsni lthānam‌ | saraṭippaṇadīkātrayasaṃvarite a0 16. yāvat‌ pumān‌ bhavet‌ tāvat‌ pivet‌ | samyaksnigdhasya chakṣaṇokhattireva niyamaḥ | yāvatā kāṭhena samyak‌ rinigdhatvakhakṣaṇāni jāyante tāvata phāchaṃ pibedisyatheḥ| ataḥ paraṃ samyakūninigdhalakṣaṇo sapatterayantaramacchaṃ snehaḥ prayuktaḥ sārmībhavenna rodhanakāryaṃ karotīsyarthaḥ

tib: skyes bu lto snyi bas zhun mar dngas ma zhag gsum btung bar bya la/ mi lto sra bas ni zhag bdun gyis btung ngo / / yang na gnyis po 'di dag kho na nges pa med de/ skyes bu khong snum par gyur pa nyid 'di'i tshad nges pa yin no/ / des na dus ji srid kyis legs par khong snum pa'i skyes bur gyur pa de srid par btung bar bya'o/ / zhes bya ba'i don no/ / de ltar legs par snum pa'i mtshan nyid du gyur phan chad snum dngas ma btung ba ni goms par 'gyur gyi/ sbyor ba'i bya ba mi byed do zhes bya ba'i don no/ / rlung ni bder rgyu me drod 'bar/ / bshang ba snum zhing mi sri la/ / snum mi 'dod cing snyom 'gyur la/ / snum legs yin te rtsub go bzlog / ces bya ba la/ skyes bu legs par snum gyis zhen par gyur pa ni rlung rgyu zhing lugs bzhin 'byung ba dang / pho ba'i me drod 'bar zhing bde ba dang / bshang ba snum par 'gyur gyi rtsub pa ma yin pa la/ de bzhin du mi sri ba ste/ phal cher snyi zhing brlan par gyur pa dang / de bzhin du snum sten par byed pa'i skyes bu/ snum mi 'dod cing snum la zhen par mi dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du snyi zhing snyi bag tu gyur pa ste/ de dag thams cad ni snum gyis legs par zhen pa'i mtshan nyid yin no/ / skyes bu snum med cing rtsub bar gyur pa ni de las go bzlog pa ste/ ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid las bzlog par 'gyur ro/ / de yang rlung mi bde bar rgyu ba dang / me drod chung ba dang / bshang ba rtsub pa dang / bsgongs pa dang / snum la 'dod pa skye bar 'gyur zhing /

skt: sśca sneho'mātrayā'hitā yamyā; patha stathā'kāraprayuktastathā bhiśyāhāraviddhārābhyāṃ varana payuktaḥ sa dophādīn‌ karoti | sātrāstiraḥ hyenamadhyottamāḥ ¡ tābhirvoṣidaṣyāśyayaknayetare prayuktaḥ so'mātrāyukto'hitaḥ | yathā ṛpmadhikrāra ghṛta pathaya vikare taima | akri prayogasya | sathā hemante nidhi bharīpyaṃ divā telamādār‌ mālyājcap‌ | mātrayāsyamilayatenoktaḥ| tasyā mibhyāviparīnyana cadā payoga karoti upṇodakaupacārī syādiyādivihārastasya mibhyākaraṇamanyathāsevā
tib: skyes bu snum ha cang drags par gyur pa ni/ skya bo bseng bseng por 'gyur ba dang / sna nas 'dzag pa dang / rkub nas 'dzag par 'gyur ro/ /

snum thams cad tshad dang mi ldan par zos pa dang / de bzhin du dus ma yin par zos pa dang / gnod pa ste gang zhig la gnod par 'gyur ba de zos pa dang / de bzhin du zas dang spyod lam log pa dang ldan pas spyad na skrang ba la sogs pa'i nad skye bar 'gyur ro/ / de yang tshad ni chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po ste/ gsum po de dag nad lus zungs la ltos te gtong bar mi byed pa de ni tshad dang mi ldan pa'o/ / dus ma yin par gtong ba de ni dper na dgun gyi tshe mar gtong ba dang / mtshan mo gtong ba dang / so ga til mar gtong ba dang / nyin par gtong ba lta bu'o/ / gnod pa ni dper na bad kan gyi nad la mar gtong ba dang / mkhris pa'i nad la til mar gtong ba dang / zas ni kha zas tshad dang mi ldan par gang bshang ba de log par 'gyur zhing / phyin ci log gis tshe spyod par byed pa de'i tshe skyon du 'gyur ro/ / spyod lam ni chu'i bya ba chu tshan gyi bya ba la sogs pa bshad pa ste/ de log par spyod pa de dang mi mthun par spyod pa ste/ de dag gis skrang pa la sogs pa'i nad skyed par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: sedaghyāpadi satyaṃ samavi rogodrūtau chtatapṇādisādhanaṃ cikitsitam‌ | atra kṣud‌ bubhu | bhaujananivṛttiḥ | pupṇā piṣāsā pānanigrahaḥ | udanaṃ vamanaṃ, ruṣaṃ pānai, rūkṣamannaṃḥ rūkṣa bheṣajaṃ ca | takaramudadhit‌ | ari macavikaṣeṣaḥ | mūlaḥ phaśca krato vyajlanavireṣaḥ | kharu dālaḥ rāivipaḥ | śyāmākastṛṇadhānyaviraśeṣaḥ | kodravāḥ koradṛpyāḥ | piṣpalyādīni dravyaviroṣāṇi thak‌ prayoktavyāni | rogaṃ sega̭prati pratirogaṃ yathāsve bheṣajaṃ rogasyātmīyaṃ tattatra deyam‌
tib: snum gyi cho ga las gyur cing / snum gyi cho ga las nyams pas nad du gyur pa de la dpyad du bya ba ni bkres skom la sogs pas gso zhing bcos par bya'o/ / de la bkres pa ni ltogs par bya ste/ zas za ba la sogs pa'o/ / skom pa ni skom gyis gdungs pa ste/ tshar bcad pa'o/ / skyug sman ni slon btang ba'o/ / dugs ni 'og nas bshad pa'o/ / de bzhin du kha zas rtsub mo za ba dang / skom rtsub pa btung ba dang / sman rtsub pa bsten pa dang / dar ba rab tu ska ba dang / / dar ba rnying pa dang / chang rnying pa dang / tshod ma ste/ rtsa ba dang 'bras bu las byas pa'i tshod ma'i rnam pa dang / 'bru rgod dang / 'bras bu'i bye brag ut+pal zhes bya ba dang / ci tse ste/ rtsa 'bru'i bye brag dang / khre rgod ste ga tra pa zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin du sbrang la sogs pa'i sman rnams nad dmigs so so ji lta ba bzhin nad gang gi sman gang yin pa de de la sbyin par bya'o/ /

skt: stigdhcāsauḥ dravopṇo dhanbosthau rasastaṃ snigdhadraboṣṇajāṅgakhadeśamāṃsasamadbhataṃ rasaṃ yo bhuṅkte sa̱ snigdhadraboṣṇadhanvottharasasuk‌ svedamācaranaṃ ekāhaṃ sthita āsīnaḥ ayaṃ jarīṇi dināni sti| gdhasamanantaraṃ caturthe'hi vamane virekaṃ ca kuryāt‌ ācaret‌ | pūrvai snigdho'nantara sinigdhadravoṣṇadhanvottharasamuk‌,. svedemācarat‌ ekāḥ sthito'nyasca dina dvitīyamahaḥ kaphamukheya' bharacyāvyaḥ kaphasya samucchrayaṃ kṛkhā | kena tatkaraiḥ tatapharaṃ kubaintīti takara; kaphakaraiḥ kṣīramāṃsamarasyādimi;
tib: legs par rtsub par gyur pa dang / lhag par rtsub par gyur pa dag ni smyung ba drags pa'i mtshan nyid dang 'dra bar shes par bya ste/ ji ltar legs par smyung bar byas pa'i mtshan nyid gang yin pa de ni legs par rtsub chos byas pa'i mtshan nyid dang 'dra bar shes par bya/ de bzhin du shin tu smyung bar byas pa'i mtshan nyid dang 'dra bar shes par bya ba ste/ slon dro skom sa las byung snum/ / sha khu btung zhing dugs spyad bya/ / khrus byed pa 'am skyug sman gtang / / snum byas zhag gsum gnas par bya/ / nyin zhag gzhan pa gcig cig ni/ / de bskyed pa yis bad kan skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ slon zhing dro ba dang skams las byung ba yang yin/ snum pa yang yin pas/ slon dro skam sa las byung snum/ / zhes bya ba ste/ slon zhing dro ba dang / skam sa'i srog chags kyi sha las g.yos pa'i sha khu btung ba dang / dugs kyi bya ba kun tu spyad cing gnas par byed pa dang / snum gyi cho ga byas pas zhag gsum gnas par byas nas/ de'i 'og tu nyi ma bzhi pa la khrus bya'o/ / skyug sman yang nyin re bzhin du bya ste/ dang por snum gyi cho ga byas la/ de'i 'og tu skam sa'i sha rlon zhing dro ba las byung ba'i snum gyi sha khu 'thungs nas/ dugs byed cing zhag gcig gnas par byas la/ nyin de las gzhan pa nyin zhag gnyis pa las bad kan skyed cing 'phel bar bya ba'o/ / gang gis she na/ de skyed pa yis zhes bya ba ste/ bad kan de skyed par byed pa'o/ / 'o ma dang nya la sogs pas bad kan bskyed la/

skt: māṃsakhāḥ pīvaraḥ | meduraḥ medasā pāragraṣṭāḥ | mūriśepmāṇo bahukaphāḥ | viṣamāgrayaḥ viṣamānaṭāḥ | stedocitāḥ stehābhyāsanilayāḥ | ye ca snedyāḥ stedanīyāsatān‌ snedanīyān‌ pūva prathamamāda śakṣaṇadramye sakṣayet‌. | tato'nantara śakṣayitvā paścāt‌ saṃsnehya śodhayet‌ | evaṃ sayeṣāṃ māsachādīnāṃ stehavyāpanna jāyate
tib: sha che ba ni mi sha rgyas shing sbom pa'o/ / tshil che ba ni tshil gyis rgyas shing tsho ba'o/ / bad kan che ba ni bad kan mang ba'o/ / me'i 'ju drod mi snyoms pa ni pho ba'i me drod kyis 'ju ba mi snyoms pa'o/ / snum la sogs pa ni rtag tu snum za ba ste/ de lta bu'i snum chos gtang bar bya ba gang yin pa de ni sngon du ste/ thog mar rtsub pa ni zas dang sman gyis rtsub chos bya la/ de nas de ltar rtsub chos byas pa'i 'og tu/ snum chos byas la sbyangs par gyur na/ sha che ba la sogs pa de la snum mi 'byung ngo / / de bzhin du sha che ba la sogs pa rtsub chos byas la/

snum chos byas pa'i byis pa dang / rgan po la sogs pa sngar snum chos kyi chogs brta bar bya bar bshad pa rnams snum chos spang bar mi nus pa de lta bu la snum gyi cho ga bya ba'i phyir/ de skye zhing bsnan par mi 'gyur ba'i sbyor ba 'dis 'phral du de la snum gyi cho ga sbyar bar bya'o/ / de yang gang yin zhe na/ de la mar brngos sha khu dang / / mar brngos pa yi thug pa dang / / til phye snum

byis pa dang rgan po la sogs pa rnams la mar brngos pa'i sha khu la sogs pa'i sbyor ba bdun po 'di dag ni 'phral gyi snum gyi cho gar 'gyur ro/ / de la sha mang po mar dang brngos pa de'i khu ba ni sbyor bag yin no/ / yang mar mang po dang brngos shing btsos pa'i thug pa byas pa ni sbyor ba gnyis pa yin no/ / de bzhin du til gyi phye ma snum dang bcas pa dang / bu ram chu dang bcas par sbyar ba ni gsum pa yin no/ / 'dir snum ni mar la sogs pa'o/ / bu ram chung ngu ni bu ram phra mo'o/ / de bzhin du kri sa ra zhes bya ba ni til dang 'bras la sogs pa las byas pa'i thug pa gar thug 'dra ba la snum gyi bu ram chung ngu btab pa ni bzhi pa'o/ / yang na 'o ma ni thug pa ste/ 'o ma dang btsos pa'i thug pa zhun mar mang po bcug pa dro ba ste lnga pa'o/ / yang bu ram zho dang bcas pa'i rin ni drug pa'o/ / yang na thug sna lnga pa zhes bya ba snum bzhi po zhun mar dang til mar dang rkang dang tshil dang / srang gnyis dang ldan pa yin pas na de'i thug pa ni bdun pa'o/ / sbyor ba 'di dag ni 'phral du snum gyi bya ba byed cing skyo ba dang sun par mi byed pa yin no/ / snum rnams lan tshwa cher btab pa/ / de ni bad kan skyed rtsub min/ / phra zhing dro la lus khyab byed/ / ces bya ba la/ / de bzhin du snum bzhi po zhun mar dang til mar dang rkang dang tshil zhes bya ba lan tshwa cher btab pa ni/ 'phral du snum par byed pa yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ lan tshwa btab pa de ni bad kan skye zhing 'dzag pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa dang / de rtsub pa ma yin zhing snum pa dang phra ba ste/ / phra mo rnams la 'jug cing khyab par byed pa dang / dro zhing tsha ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa dang / lus khyab par byed pa ste/ lus ma lus par khyab nas smin cing 'ju ba'i don byed pa yin pas/ lan tshwa cher btab pa'i snum ni 'phral du snum chos su 'gyur ro/ / mdze dang skran

tib: mdze nad la sogs pa yod pa la snum gyi cho gar bza' ba bu ram dang bcas pa 'di dag btang zhing sbyin par mi bya'o/ / de ltar snum gyi chogs ci zhig bya zhe na/

skt: dīpraḥ sabhiddho'bhraiḥ jaṭhasānalo yasya sa dīprāntarābhniḥ | paridayuddho nirdoṣaḥ koṣṭha udaraṃ yasya sa pariṣuddhakoṣṭhaḥ | pratyarā jabhinavārataraṇā dhātavo rasādayā yasya saṃ prasyraghātuḥ | balavarṇābhyāṃ yukte balavarṇayuktaḥ | dṛḍhāni svakāyakaraṇakṣamāṇi indriyāṇi yasya ca | mandā svaspājayāṃ paṇitāni yasya sa. mandaraḥ | rātamāyuyaisya sa dātāyuḥ sa tathāvidhaḥ puruṣaḥ sneopasevī munibhiḥ kathitaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ
tib: gong du smos pa'i mdze nad la sogs pa de dag la snum 'bras bu gsum dang / pi pi ling dang / gu gul dang / a ru ra la sogs pa nad dang ji ltar 'tsham pa bzhin du gnod pa med cing mi 'phrod pa med par legs par sbyar zhing gtang bar bya'o/ /

nad kyis nyam chung zhing sbeg pa'i mi la/ snum gyi cho ga lus kyi me drod skyed par nus pa'i sman gtang bar bya'o/ / de yang lus me drod ni lus dro ba ste/ de gnyis skyed par nus pa'i snum de gtang ba ste/ lus kyi stobs skyed par nus pa ni rgyas shing 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / drod kyi stobs skyed par nus pa ni pho ba'i me drod skyed par byed pa'o/ /

lus kyi stobs dang pho ba'i me drod skyed par byed pa'i snum la brtan pa'i skyes bu dag gi lus la 'byung ba'i yon tan ni/ nang gi me drod kyis lus thams cad la khyab par 'bar ba dang / khong pa'i nang gi nad skyed par byed pa'i snyigs ma sogs dag par 'gyur ba dang / lus kyi zungs dang stobs gsar du rgyas shing 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / kha dog bzang zhing yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ba dang / dbang po brtan pa ste/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rang gi bya ba byed par nus shing / gsal bar 'gyur ba dang / rgas sra zhing skra dkar med par 'gyur ba dang / lo brgya 'tsho zhing gnas pas na/ lo brgya thub pa ste/ snum la brten pa'i skyes bu la yon tan 'byung bar drang srong rnams kyis bshad cing bstan pa'o/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/

skt: paṇaiyiṣyāmaḥ prāyeṇa stedapūrvaḥ svedo vidhātavyaḥ | tathāca muniḥ ^“ svedasādhyāḥ prayāsyanti tadā vātakaphātmakāḥ› | svedapṛvai payuktaḥ sveneti svedasya vidhirdhidhānamitikalaivyatārūpo'dhyāyaḥ|\1||
tib: dugs ni phal cher dang por snum chos byas nas 'dir bya dgos pas na/ de'i phyir snum gyi cho ga'i 'og tu dugs kyi cho ga'i le'u bshad cing bstan pa yin no/ / de yang drang srong tsa ra kas/ / dugs kyis gso bar bya ba'i nad/ / rlung dang bad kan bdag nyid can/ / snum gyi dngos su 'gro ba yi/ / dugs kyis rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / dugs kyi cho ga ni las su bya ba nyid de/ de'i tshul gyi le'u yin pas na dugs kyi le'u'o/ / de la dugs kyi cho ga ni dbye ba'i dbang du byas nas smras pa ni/ dugs bsro bcing dang tha mal pa/ / chu dugs dbye bas rnam pa bzhi/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ bsro ba dang / bcing ba dang / tha mal pa ste/ chu dugs zhes bya bar mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / des na dugs ni bsro ba la sogs pa'i dbye bas me'i lums rnam pa bzhir 'gyur ro/ /

bsro ba'i dugs ni gos la sogs pa me la bsros pas bsro bar bya ste/ gos ni bgo ba'i gos bal la sogs pa la bya'o/ / lcags ni lcags kyi spyad thong lcags lta bu la sogs pa'o/ / lag mthil ni lag pa'i mthil lo/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni bum pa dang / khar ba'i snod la sogs pa bsdu'o/ / bcing ba shu dag sbang ma dang / / thang shing sha ta puSh+Tha dang / / 'bru kun dri rnams ra sna dang / / e raN+Da'i rtsa sha dag dang / / snum bag tsha dang dar ba dang / / 'o mas sbrus shing tsha cher btab/ / rlung las byung ba 'ba' zhig sel/ / bad kan 'dres la bye'u rug sogs/ / mkhris pa 'dres la shug sogs kyis/ / glan pa zhes bya yang dang yang / / dkri ba snum zhing nus pa dro/ / spu

bcing ba'i dugs ni shu dag dang / sbang ma la sogs pa snum la sogs pa dang sbrus shing bsres pa dang / de bzhin du lan tshwa cher btab cing lan tshwa lhag par mang du btab pa dag rlung las byung ba'i nad 'ba' zhig ste/ nad gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i rlung nad sel lo/ / bad kan dang 'dres pa'i rlung la ni bye'u rug pa la sogs pa phu ras rnam gnyis dang / ku the ra la sogs pa'i sde tshan du bshad pa dag gis bya'o/ /

skt: chaupvākhyaḥ svedaḥ utkārikādibhiḥ prayobhyaḥ | yavamaviraṇḍatirādibhiḥ | svinnaḥ pūpṛrikkati| bhiryaiḥ svedanopāyaḥ sa ukkarikāsedo bhaṇyate | | choṣṭhakapārapāṣāṇānabhnivarṇāna. ivā'mbhamyamle varā nimañjayet‌ | terādraunvitavaśeṇa veṣṭhitaiḥ sved‌yet‌ | pāṃśunā patrabhaddhena dhānyena ca tathā gavāṃ karīṣaiḥ sikatādibhiḥ sueṣvamḍeḥ kathitaiṣvaṣeṣitaiḥ svedayet‌ | anekopāyasantapairiti kumbhīnār̤naṭādyādibhirapāyeḥ santaurkārikāvibhirūpmāsyaḥ svedo deśataḥ kālaśa yocyaḥ | dadāta daragīra. deśo bhūmideśaśca | kālau mahutādilṣaṇa ; ālugaḥ vasthārakṣaṇaśca | tadśāntassāmadhyādmya sveda prayogaḥ kāryaḥ | śarīradeśato yathā-bhāsāyagaḥ vāyācisyādi | tathā'spavaṅkṣaṇayoriti | bhūmiḥ deśato yathā-ānūpaṃ svedasya yogyaṃ na tathā jāṅgama kārato yathā--hemante'nyonyamveda yāsyatā na tatha āopme | vyavasthātau yathā-- | pitta saṃkhe vāyau kathidayogaḥ kaścit‌ śapmasaṃsaṭe kiḥ dbe bāte patrabhaṅga dhānyeneti patrāṇāmaṅgabhajana kṣādnamāmardanamaṅgamaṅgo yasya dhānyasya taspannabhaṅgadhānyam‌ | karīpo gavāṃ rt‌ | sikatā vādu || £ || hai0--uṇāsedasya sakṣaṇamāha----utkārikādibhiḥ soṣmanabhi; kaṃvalādiveṣaṭiairya; khedaḥ kriyate sa ūṣmasvedaḥ| utkārikā roṭikā, prabhagena khaṃḍalḥ etaiḥ patraiḥ dhānyena godhrūmādinā | saṃgrahe tu ūpmamedaḥ punaraṣṭadhā bhidyate piṇḍaḥ, saṃstaro, nāḍī, ghanāśmā, chaṃmī, kūpaḥ, kuṭī jyatākaśca | tatra karapākhpāpāṇoṣaṭalohapiṃḍānadhivarṇān‌ sedaṃdhena gdīvāmasvagṭhe vā nimajjayet‌ | tairādrīvivaḥvacreṇa veṣṭitaḥ pmamedomūyiṣṭhaṃ sarajaṃ praṃdhimṭhā sveda yet‌ | pāṃcasikatagavādikarīpatuṣadhānyucāpukhākapalaṭeravā'mḍoctathitaiḥ pūrvavadaraṣaṭitairmavādiśakṛtāreṇa piṃḍīkratenopanādravyokkarārikādrarāpāyasapiairvā vātasegiṣviti piṃḍasvedaḥ | saeva ca sakarāsyaḥ | yathārsvedadravyāṇi piditayukhāyāmūpāyāṃ samyagupasedya nivātaścaraṇaśayanasthe kaṭhine prastāryāvikarakauśeyavātaharapatānyatamottarapraccheda rīravājinaprāārādiṣyavacchananaṃ svedayedi ti saṃstarasvedaḥ | pūrvavadebopasvenrolāmukhenāgrukhāṃ nāḍīmūchacchidrapramā ṇapāścaicchivrāmabhisaṃdhāyopadipya ca pāśvacchidrasthayā nāḍyā śarīreparīkāvaśṣadaka lijakaraṃjapacrācyatamakratayathā gajāgrahastasaṃsthāna. yā vyāmadīṣadhayā'dhyadadhanyāmadīaiyā vā svāyāmacturmāgā. chaebhāgapariṇāhamṛdakhayallotasā sarvatovātaderapatramasaṃvṛttacchidrayā dvinbhirvā vinamitayā sukhopaviṣṭasa svabhyaktaprāvrata'me cādhyamupahret‌ | bāṣpa hanrajñagāmī vihetavvaṃḍapegastvantamavidan‌ sukhaṃ svedayatīti nāḍīsvedaḥ | purupāyāmamācamadhikaraṃ | yāghanaṃ sama̭ sukhaṃ ca śiātaṭaṃ bhupradeṃ vātaharadārudīpatenādhinā savaratastāpayitvā abhimapodyoṣṇodakarāgyādibhirabhayu vadharaktapracchade saṃstaravasasvedayediti ghanāśmakhedaḥ | pūvavsavedadravyāṇi dabhyaṃ stadūṣmāṇaṃ gṛhayāt‌ | bhūmau vā tāṃ nikhāya taduṣva̭māsanaṃ dyaya̱naṃ yā nātaghnapracchad‌ pārataḥ prambamānakuthakamasbalagoṇakarānanidhāya tacacasthasyopmāṇaṃ gahataḥ syāhayāmivaṇānayogudānupalaṃśca inairnimajjayediti kumbhīsvedaḥ dāyanasyādhau vistāradviguṇakhāte karūpe vātaharadākhkarīpānyataraparṇadarakhya viratadhrame svāstīgirāyanasthaṃ svede diti kṛpasvedaḥ | surī nācyuścavistāsaṃ vṛttāmacchidāmupanādadravyakarekaṣanapradigdhakukhyāṃ aṣaṭaṅgahedayaṃ | | _ samasutchādhyāṣyopaviṣ. | savetā |vadhumapradapta- | nekhavrācchanna snigdha khadirāṃgāpaparṇahasaṃtikāsamūhaparitapatāṃ vidhāya tanmadhye dyāṃ tatrastha svedayediti kṛśasvedaḥ | jayaṃtākasvedaḥ adākyatvānna ḍikhyate
tib: pad+ma dang phra phran ka la sogs pa'i sde tshan du bshad pas so/ / snum bag tsha dang dar ba dang / / 'o mas sbrus shing tsha ches btab/ / ces bya ba ni/ gsum char dang sbyar bar bya ste/ dkri ba gsum po de dag rim pa bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ / de ni glan pa zhes kyang bya ste/ des yang dang yang du dugs bya'o/ / gzhan dag las kyang / nyams re ba sogs rlung 'joms bcas/ / sgyur dang gsher ba'i rdzas kun ldan/ / rlan can sha dang legs par btsos/ / snum kun dang ni yang dag ldan/ / dro 'jam lan tshwa shas cher dro/ / glan pa zhes ni bshad pa yin/ / zhes bya ba 'byung ba yin no/ / dkri ba dang ni dkris shing bcings pa na dkris pa zhes bya ste/ bcings pa la zhes bya ba'i don to/ / de bas na mang du byugs la snum pa dang nus pa dro ba dang / spu 'jam pa'i pags pa rul pa ma yin pas dkri bar bya'o/ / de ma rnyed cing med par gyur na/ rlung 'joms shing nus pa dang ldan pa'i rtswa shing gso ma la sogs pa'i lo mas bcings shing yan lag dkri ba ste/ mtshan mo dkris na nyin par 'grol bar bya ste/ de ni tsha ba med pa'i phyir bya'o/ / nyin mo dkri zhing bcing byas pa ni mtshan mo 'grol bar bya'o/ / la lar ni yul dang nad kyi dbang gis yan lag chag pa la sogs pa nyin zhag gnyis sam/ gsum gzhag par bya ba yang yod de/ sbang ma ni chang gi snyigs ma'o/ / 'bru kun ni gra ma dang / gang bu can gyi sde tshan las bshad pa'o/ / dri rnams ni spang spos dang / ru rta dang a ru ra la sogs pa'o/ /

tha mal pa zhes bya ba'i dugs ni/ bal dang khur ba la sogs pas bya ste/ de yang nas dang mon sran gre'u dang / til la sogs pa btab nas sbrus te btsos nas khur ba lta bur byas nas/ dugs su bya ba'i thabs la sbyar ba gang yin pa de ni khur ba'i dugs zhes bya'o/ / bong ba dang gyo mo dang / rdob mer bsregs pa la me'i mdog can du byas la/ chu'am sham po'i nang du nub par byas la rlon pa de gos rim gcig gis dkris pas dugs bya'o/ / gso ma'i lo ma dang 'bru rnams pa lang la sogs pa'i lci ba dang / ril ma dang phye ma dang / phub ma rnams chu skyor mo dang bskol la/

rdza ma dang sbu gu dang rdza skyogs dang / sla nga la sogs pa'i thabs kyis legs par bsros pa'i khu ba la sogs pa'i dugs rnams yul dang dus las dpags nas sbyar bar bya ste/ yul ni sa'i yul phyogs dang / lus kyi yan lag gi tshogs so/ / dus ni skad cig la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang / nad pa'i gnas skabs kyi mtshan nyid do/ / de las dpags pa ni de'i dbang du byas te/ dugs kyi sbyor ba 'di bya'o/ / de yang lus kyi yul ni dper na/ rlung ni ma zhu'i gnas zhugs dang / / zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ / sa'i yul las dpags pa ni/ yul rlan can du dugs bya dgos pa de ltar skam sar yin no/ / dus las ni dper na dgun gyi dugs gzhan dag bya dgos la/ so gar gzhan dag bya'o/ / nad pa las ni dper na dugs la la ni mkhris pa dang 'dres pa'i rlung la sogs pa'o/ / la la ni bad kan dang 'dres pa'i rlung la dgos la/ la la ni rlung 'ba' zhig la dgos pa'o/ / 'bru rnams ni 'bru'i rigs lo ma dkrugs shing bcom pa'o/ / chu dugs shi kru ba ra na/ / e raN+Da dang ka rany+dza/ / bye'u rug pa dang ardza ka / shi ri sha dang ba sha ka / 'od ma arga ma la ti/ / ya ba sha ka'i lo ma bkru /

skt: rimarorārabhya yāvahīrghavṛntamauṣadhag‌ | ta smādauṣadhagaṇāt‌ prabhaṅga patrakṣodaiḥ patrāṇāṃ bhaṅgāḥ patrabhaṅgāḥ | saṃuṇṇāni patrāṇi taiśtathā vacācraiḥ pūravoktirapanāhasvedapaṣaṭitaiḥ vacākiṇvasitatāhmādibhistathā sāṃsaiśvānūpavārijaiḥ | rohītapārīnakūrmaghabhūtibhimessyestathā daśamūṣena yathādopaṃ prathakasahitair prathakvyasataivāṃ sahitaiḥ samastaiḥ miśraivī yathāmada malānatikrameṇa doṣānukṣāreṇeti yāvat‌ | snehavaḥ dvividyamānasteho'trāpi yathāmaramiṃti yojyam‌ yogyaḥ snedo yogyasteho vutādyanyatamastena yukta stathā yathāmaṭaṃ surādibhiḥ sādhitaistatkathitairetaiḥ s‌ḥ kumbhīsthārīgerantīgegarikā vā ̱dhānyāparapayauyāḥ | nāḍī udvatāriṣṭaḥ bhaṇḍu pararayitvā sujāte śūlādayākrāntaṃ gātramaṅkhaṃ vāsasācchāditaṃ vātahararnigdhasiddhastedā. sthānam‌ | bhyaktaṃ siśtapariṣecayet‌ | yathāghukha yathāghulasapada kadācidīṣaduṣṇaṃ kadāciduṣṇataraṃ jalādhāravireṣā garantyo yā anavarataṃ dhāryā jādi khavanti tā gaḍhansyo bhaṇyante | dravasvedastu hiidhaḥ| pariṣiko'vagāhaśca tatra paṇivika untaḥ

avagāhastu kathyate taireva pūvektadaraiveḥ parivekakṣāyaiḥ pūṇa kuṇḍamavagāhyānupraviśyāturaṃ hadayādīn‌ rṣa̭tiṭhet‌ | savaujgage'nile iti | sakaṅūśarīragyāpini sati kuṇḍamarahaṇamupaṅaṣchaṇamātram‌ | tena kaṭāhe droṇyāṃ dravapūṇāyāmapyavagāh‌yettathakāgegeṣvaśaḥkṛkrādiruṣca ca doṣādhavekṣayā'bagāhayet‌
tib: shi kru nas brtsams te/ ya ba sha ka'i bar gyi sde tshan de rnams las/ lo ma rnams bkru zhing mnyes la/ de rnams dang de bzhin du shu dag la sogs pa'i sman sngar bshad pa rnams dang / de bzhin du gsher sa dang chu na gnas pa'i ro hi ta pa thi na la sogs pa'i nya dang / de bzhin du rtsa ba bcu pa zhes nad kyi dmigs ji lta ba bzhin du so so'am lhan cig btang ba ste/ so so re re nas gtang ba'am/ ma lus pa lhan cig sbyar zhing bsres nas nad dmigs ji lta ba bzhin du/ de dang rjes su mthun par sbyar bar bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ / de bzhin du snum dang ldan pa ste snum yod pa'o/ / 'di yang nad las dpags pa dang sbyar bar bya ste/ mar la sogs pa nad gang dang gang la phan pa'i snum de dang de dag dang ldan par bya ba dang / de bzhin du de dang mnyam pa'i chang la sogs pa dang btsos pa nad dmigs ji lta bu las dpags te/ blugs pa'i chu de bum pa mchu phra mo btod pa'i mchus blugs par bya ste/ sbu gu ni ring po kha gyen du bltas pa'i nang du bcug ste/ bkang la nad kyis nyam thag pa ste/ gzer la sogs pas nyon mongs par gyur pa'i lus gos kyis dkris la/ snum zhing rlung 'joms pa'i sman bskol ba blugs par bya ste/ de yang bde ba ste/ ci bde ba la reg par gyur pa'i tshul du bya ste/ 'dir lan 'ga' cung zad dro bas bya'o/ / lan 'ga' ni shin tu dro bas bya'o/ / de blugs pa ni chu'i rgyun gyi khyad par gang zhig gis rgyun mi 'chad par blugs shing chu la sogs pa'i gsher rdzas 'dzag par 'gyur bas na blugs pa zhes bya'o/ / chu'i dugs ni rnam pa gnyis te/ rgyun blugs pa dang chu la bcing ba'o/ / de ltar blugs pa bshad zin nas/ da ni chu la bcing ba bshad pa'i phyir/ lus la zhes bya ba la sogs pa bshad pa yin te/ nad pa lus kyi yan lag thams cad la rlung nad zhugs shing rlung gi bdag / / de nyid kyis zhes bya ba sngar bshad pa'i sman tsho snod chen po bkang la/ bkang ba'i snod der nad pa bcug ste/ snying ga la sogs pa bsrung bzhin gnas par bya'o/ / snod ces smos pa ni spyi ming tsam du nye bar mtshon pa tsam ste/ zangs chen po'am/ gzhong pa ring po chen po sman chus bkang ba'i nang du 'jug cing bcings te gnas par bya'o/ / de bzhin du gzhang 'brum dang / gcin sri ba la sogs pa lus kyi phyogs gcig na bar gyur pa la ni nad la sogs tshul las dpags te sbyar bar bya'o/ /

skt: nivāte pradeśe'ntabaidiḥ snigdhaḥ puma jīrṇānnaḥ pariṇatabhojanaḥ sam‌ svedamācaḥ kuryāt‌
tib: rlung med pa'i sa phyogs su skyes bu'i lus phyi nang snum dang bcas par byas la/ kha zas sman dang zhu zin par gyur pa'i dus su dugs dpyad par bya la/ dugs de yang nad la sogs pa'i dbang gis chung ngu la sogs pa'i tshad gsum du 'gyur ro/ / de yang chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po gsum du 'gyur la/ de bzhin du nad pa yang stobs la sogs pa la chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po yod de/ yul rlan can dang / skam sa 'dren ma gsum yod do/ / lus kyi gnas mgo dang phrag pa dang / lto ba dang / byin pa la sogs pa'i dbye bas phye ba yin no/ / dus ni dro ba dang / grang ba dang / 'dres ma'i dbye bas phye ba yin no/ / dbang las zhes bya ba ni de dag gtso bor byas pa yin no/ /

skt: kaphārtaḥ kaphamastaḥ puruṣo śakaṣasnedamācaret‌ na snigdham‌ | tathā rukṣaḥ punana punaranyasved‌vatpūvaṃ snehanaḥ | snigdhakaphānire rūkṣasnigdhaṃ sādhāraṇarūpaṃ svedamācaret‌
tib: bad kan gyis nyen cing bad kan shas che ba'i skyes bus dugs rtsub mo bya'o/ / de bzhin du skyes bu rlung las gyur cing bad kan yang yod pa dag gis dugs gzhan ltar dang por snum chos bya zhing / bad kan dang rlung yod pas rtsub pa dang / snum pa 'dren ma'i dugs sbyar bar bya'o/ /

skt: tathā kaphe parakārāyasthite stedapūai svedmācaret‌
tib: rlung ma zhu'i gnas su zhugs la gnas pa'i nad la ni rtsub pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dugs spyad par bya'o/ / de bzhin du bad kan zhu ba'i gnas la gnas shing brten pa la ni snum sngon du 'gro ba'i dugs bya ste/ de dag ni gnas kyi dbang gis tshul de ltar bya dgos pa yin no/ /

skt: vaṅkṣaṇayoḥ śarīrekadeśayoḥ rukṣamūlāśrayayoraspaṃ stokaṃ svedamācaret‌ | ṭaḍmupaṣkahad ye ccutuṃṣaṇahadaye svaspamasyantātpataraṃ svedamācaret‌ | na vāḥ taiva tasmin‌ sthāne svedaṃ yojayet‌ 1 13||
tib: sta zur zhes bya ba lus kyi phyogs gcig brla dang / dpyi la brten pa'i nad la dugs nyung ngu bya'o/ / de bzhin du mig dang snying ga dang rlig par ni shin tu chung ba'i dugs bya'o/ / yang na bya ba min zhes bya ba ste/

dugs kyis skyes bu'i grang ba dang / zug gzer bral bas skyes bu'i lus legs par brlan zhing mnyen par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du yan lag mnyen zhing 'jam par 'gyur ba dang / dal gyis dang por mnyes la de'i 'og tu khrus bya ba de dang po lag pas yan lag mnyes la chu dron pos khrus byas nas/ de'i 'og tu snum chos kyi skabs nas bshad pa'i cho ga bsten cing spyad par bya ba dang / / spang bar bya ba rnams dor bar bya'o/ / de dag kyang snum gyi cho ga'i skabs su zas dang spyod lam bstan pa bzhin du bya ba dang / thal sman rnon po dang / me btsa' btang ba dang / mes tshig pa la tsha ba zhi bar bya ba dang / tshad pas 'khru ba dang / slon pa la de bcad pa dang / mi dran cing myos pa la slar dran par bya ba'i cho ga bya'o/ / de bzhin du chu tshan gyi nye bar spyod pa la sogs pa spang bar bya'o/ /

skt: śavedasyātiyogāt‌ atintevanān‌, pittā. kopādayo jāyanta | suṃ bhoṭaḥ | svarasya ddhasya ca sadanamavasād‌ḥ | śramaḥ'7dasyānam‌ | sa~ ndhīnāṃ pīḍā sandhipīḍā | pavarujā | dayāvartāḥ¶ ca maṇḍalānāṃ ca dadonamudramaḥ | sadiva; satra sva dātatiyogajānaiteṣu stapittaprakopādipu stanbhagani (388 ) kapaṇamopadhaṃ cikitsitaṃ yojyama. tamra yuktimabhitya viṣādiṣu stambhanabhoṣadhaṃ yathāsvaṃ cipa vipastambhanaṃ jvare uvarastammanamamrāyannidāhānidarīpaṇamatīsari pakṣastambhana chadī chardighre mode sajñāpradam‌
tib: dugs drags shing shas cher bsten pas khrag mkhris 'khrugs pa la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / brgyal ba ni dran pa'o/ / skad dang yan lag 'jums pa ni/ skad gdangs dma' zhing rmya ba'o/ / mgo 'khor ba ni lam mi gnas pa'o/ / lhu tshigs na ba ni lhu tshigs na ba'o/ / tshi gu dmar po tal til snang bar gyur pa ni/ de lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur ba ste/

dugs drags pa las byung ba'i nad khrag dang mkhris pa 'khrugs pa la sogs pa zhi bar bya zhing rtse gzhil ba'i sman bya ba dang bcos sbyar bar bya'o/ / dugs zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'di'i skabs su zhar la bshad pa yin te/ de dag kyang tshul 'di nyid la brten nas dugs gzhil ba la sogs pa'i sman bya ste/ dugs gzhil ba'i sman bya ba dang / thal sman rnon po btab pa la de'i tsha ba zhi bar bya ba'i phyir sman gtang ba dang / me btsa' la de'i tsha ba zhi bar bya ba'i phyir sman gtang ba dang / tshad pas 'khru ba la tshad pas 'khru ba gcod cing smin pa'i sman gtang ba dang / skyug bro ba la de zhi ba'i sman dang / brgyal ba la 'du shes rnyed bar bya ba'i thabs kyis gso'o/ / dugs ni phal cher lci dro rno/ / de las gzhan pa'i zhi byed yin/ / gsher zhing brtan 'khru snum pa dang / / rtsub cing sra ba dugs sman yin/ / 'jam dang rtsub dang zhi 'byar bag /

skt: svedanastambhanayoḥ svedānyana lakṣaṇaṃ karoti | yadra tīkṣṇasupṇaṃ ca tatsata svedanadravam‌ | prāyobhrahaṇaṃ kacidayamicāradarcanārtham‌. | ato'nyathā viparyayeṇa raghu mandaiḥ dītaṃ ca stambhanam‌} 16 ||

tib: 'dis dugs de zhi bar bya ba'i cho ga spyir bshad pa yin te/ sman gang lci ba dro ba dang rno ba de thams cad ni dugs kyi sman yin la/ phal cher zhes smos pa ni/ la la rnam par 'gyur ba dag kyang yod par bstan pa yin no/ / de las gzhan pa go bzlog pa dang / yang ba dang / bsil ba dang / rtul ba ni zhi zhing rtse 'jil bar byed pa'i sman yin no/ / de bzhin du gsher ba la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i sman rnams ni dugs kyi sman yin la 'jam pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i sman ni zhi bar byed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du mdor bsdu na sman gang cung zad kha ba dang bska ba dang / mngar ba rnams ni de rtse gzhil bar byed cing zhi bar byed pa'i sman yin no/ / 'di gnyis kyi mtshan nyid drang srong tsa ra kas bshad pa de ni/ zhi byed lci zhing dro ba 'joms/ / lums phyed rngul ni 'byin byed cing / / gso ba'i rdzas dag gang yin pa/ / rtse 'jil zhi bar byed pa yin/ / zhes 'byung ba yin no/ / zhi zhing rtse bcil stobs thob gyur/ / ji skad bshad pa'i nad rnams zad/ / ces bya ba ste/ skyes bu nad zhi zhing rtse bcil bas/ stobs thob par gyur na/ nad de rtse zhil zhing dugs drags pa'i skyon med par 'gyur ba yin la/ de bzhin du dugs drags pa las byung ba'i nad khrag dang mkhris pa 'khrugs pa la sogs pa ji skad bshad pa'i nad rnams zad na/ nad zhi ba bcos pa legs pa yin par shes par bya'o/ / bcil drags pags pa rtsa 'khums shing / / 'dar snying kha 'gram nad du 'gyur/ / rkang mchu lag pa pags nag 'gyur/ / bcil drags pa yin nad du bshad/ / ces bya ba yin te/ dugs pa'i nad ha cang bcos drags te thal ches pa las nad du 'gyur ba ni pags pa dang rtsa 'khums pa la sogs pa yin par bshad do/ / de yang bcing zhing bcos drags pa pags pa dang rtsa 'khums shing lus po nyid 'dar zhing g.yo ba dang / snying ga dang / kha dang 'gram pa rnams 'gags shing rengs pa'i nad du 'gyur te/ tshig mi thon pa dang / rkang pa dang / mchu dang / lag pa dang / pags pa'i mdog nag por 'gyur ba ste/ de lta bu ni shin tu rtse bcil zhing drags pa'i nad yin par shes par bya'o/ /

tib: shin tu sbom pa dang / rtsub pa dang / bu btsas pa'i bar du dugs bya bar mi rung ngo / / de la nyam chung ba ni stobs chung ba'o/ / dugs drags te bcos dgos pa ni rtse bcil bar 'os pa'o/ / chang nad kyis btab pa ni chang drags pa'i nad na ba'o/ / rlung mkhris ni rlung dang mkhris pa'i ldan pa ste/ de dag la dugs mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du 'o ma la sogs pa 'thungs pa la yang dugs mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du bkru sman 'thungs pa la yang dugs mi bya'o/ / gzhang nad yod pa ni gzhang nad la sogs pa la yang mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du khro bas nyen pa dang / mya ngan gyis nyen pa dang / 'jigs pas nyen pa de dag la yang dugs byar mi rung ngo / / de bzhin du gcin nad dang mkhris pa'i nad dang / zla mtshan 'dzag ba dang / sbrum ma dang / bu skyes pa la sogs pa la yang dugs byar mi rung ngo / / gal te de dag la gsung pa la sogs pa'i nad tshabs che ba byung ste/ mi byar mi rung na/ 'jam por sbyar ba'i dugs dang lums mi drag pa 'jam po bya'o/ / lud pa cham pa dbugs
