tib: lud pa dang cham pa dang rlung 'khyims ba'i bar la/ de'i sman ji lta bas legs par dugs bya ste/ la lar ni spro bas so/ / la lar ni bcings pas so/ / la lar ni tha mal pa zhes bya bas so/ / la lar ni chu'i dugs bya ba dang / de bzhin du de la phan pa'i rang gi sman gyi dbye ba'i cha so so gang la phan pa'i dbye ba 'og nas rang rang gi nad kyi gnas skabs su bshad pa'i sman gyi dugs so sor bya'o/ / de'i ni 'di skad ston pa yin te/ gang gi tshe lud pa la dugs bya dgos pa de'i tshe/ lud pa'i sman du bshad pas dugs bya'o/ / de bzhin du cham pa dang / dbugs mi bde ba la sogs pa la yang rang rang gi sman gyis dugs bya'o/ / zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ / da rgan dang / rtsol ba dang / rlung nad kyis zug pa ni 'og nas bshad pa'i rlung nad kyi nad gzhi las mtshan nyid ston to/ / khu ba 'gags pa ni khu chu bkag pa'o/ / rlung 'khyims pa ni tshil gyis bar bkag pa'o/ / dugs phan me yis bsro min pa/ / rlung nad tshil dang bad kan can/ / rlung med khang par rtsol ba dang / / gos lci ba dang 'jigs pa dang / / dkri dang stobs 'gyed khro ba dang / / chang mang bkres dang nyi tshan gzhag / ces bya ba la/ tshil dang bad kan gyis g.yogs pa'i rlung la ni mes mi bsro bar bya ba phan pa yin te/ de'i thabs ni rlung med pa'i khang par 'dug la/ rtsol ba de lus dub par bya ba dang / gos lci ba khur du longs pa bgo ba dang / de bzhin du 'jigs pa dang / de bzhin du sngar bshad pa'i dkri ba dang / stobs 'gyed pa ste lag par stobs 'gyed pa la sogs pa dang / khros 'khrugs pa dang / chang mang po btung ba dang / bkres shing ltogs pas nyen pa dang / de bzhin du nyi ma tsha ba la gzhag pa ste/

skt: ye doṣā vātādayaḥ koṣṭhe mahāsrotasi sthatāḥ dhātuṣu bātapktādipu gadāstibhyaḥ sthāne dhāye srotaḥsu ṭīnāstathā ye sākhādhthiṣu dahvādinakhakāyu sthitāste sarve'nantayektadhakāravidatena sehena chinnāḥ śruviyeḥgyasvamāpā ritāstato dhoktaiḥ svedaisyatuiryayāythaṃ pravīṣaratya dākhādibhyaḥ ṣṭha nītāḥ tataḥ koṣṭādkyamāṇādibhiḥ śadhi prannidhiyante bahinipkāsyante 1 sākhāsthigrahaṇaṃ ssaṣu doṣu lakkhā svedayogyatāgratipalabhai‌ | dhavā ghātugā ye ca dṛddhāḥ koṣṭhāddhātuṣu gatāḥ khāsthigā; ghātupvavarithatāḥ ccho yātāḥ | jatrā, prasthimaraharaṇaṃ prādhānyābham‌ | tassadadanyena svedasya vāṇāṃ dravīdsyaṃ koṣṭhāvayṃ prayojanabhiti dram‌
tib: rlung la sogs pa khong par gnas shing nang khrol na 'dug pa'am/ khrag la sogs pa lus zungs la gnas pa rnams dang de bzhin gang rtsa rnams su khyab cing zhen pa dang / de bzhin du rkang lag gi nang du song ba ste/ lag pa la sogs pa'i rus pa la zhen pa'i nad de dag thams cad gnas de dag las bshad ma thag pa'i snum dang dugs kyis bsrung bar byas shing / / 'dzag tu rung ba lta bu byas la/ de nas ji skad bshad pa'i dugs bzhi pos ji lta ji lta ba bzhin du bsrung zhing bzhu nas/ rkang lag la sogs pa nas khong pa'i nang du bsdus la/ de'i 'og tu 'og nas bshad pa'i bkru sman gyis dpyis dbyung zhing bton nas/ gdon pas phyir dbyung bar bya'o/ / rkang lag gi nang du song zhes bya ba ni de gnas pa'i nad ni shin tu dugs bya bar 'os pa yin no/ / zhes bstan pa yin no/ / yang na lus zungs su gtogs pa'i nad gang 'phel nas/ khong pa nas lus zungs su song ba dang rkang lag la gnas na ldang bar gyur pa yin pas na/ 'dir rkang lag dang rus par gnas pa ni gtso bor bzung ba'i don smos pa yin no/ / de bas na dugs kyis nad rnams bsrung ba byas la/ khong pa'i nang du bsdu dgos pa yin no/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/

tib: bad kan 'ba' zhig gi nad la skyug sman gtang bar bya'o/ / yang na ldan pa ste/ 'dres par gyur pa'i bad kan la rgyas par zhes bya ba bad kan gyi shas che ba'i nad dang mkhris pa 'dres pa'i nad ldan pa'am/ bad kan dang rlung 'dres pa'i ldan pa bad kan shas che ba la skyug sman gtang bar bya'o/ /

de dang 'dra bas na de bzhin te/ bad kan de dag tshul mthun par bya'o/ / de yang ji ltar bad kan 'ba' zhig la skyug sman bya ba yin pa'am/ bad kan shas che ba'i ldan pa'i nad la skyug sman bya ba de bzhin du mkhris pa 'ba' zhig la bkru sman gtang ba'am/ 'dres pa'i nad mkhris pa shas che ba/ mkhris pa dang bad kan 'dres pa'i nad dam/ mkhris pa dang rlung 'dres pa'i nad la bkru sman bya'o/ / rgyas pa zhes smos pas ni de 'ba' zhig bod pa'am/ rang gi gnas sam gnas gzhan du zhugs pa'i bad kan ni skyug sman bya la/ mkhris pa la ni bkru sman bya'o/ / rims sar tshad 'khru thur du ni/ / mkhris pa khrag 'khru glo gcong dang / / mdze dang gcin nad 'brum thor bu/ / rkang bam mi dran lud pa can/ / dbugs mi bde snying 'phar 'bras

tib: sbrum ma la sogs pa nas rlung nad can gyi bar dag la skyug sman mi gtang ngo / / de la khong rtsub pa la skyug sman btang na/ rlung gis yan lag la gnod par 'gyur te/ phal cher kha zas la sogs pa rtsub mo bsten pas rlung nad skyed pa'i phyir stobs zad par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du bkres pa dag la skyug sman btang na me'i stobs kyis stobs zad par 'gyur ro/ / rtag tu sdug bsngal ba ni/ khur dang rtag tu sdug byed pa'i dub pas stobs zad par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du bzhon pas dub cing nyam chung ba dag la yang stobs phrin shin tu khrag skye bar 'gyur ro/ / byis pa la sogs pas ni sman gyi stobs mi bzod pa'i phyir/ lus kyi stobs zad pas nang gi khong pa skem zhing gcong du 'gyur ba'i skyon yod pa yin no/ / na ba ni snying nad kyis nyen pa la byas na snying nad la gnod par 'gyur ro/ / rtag tu slon pa ni stod du rgyu ba'i rlung gis gyen du bteg pas de drags na srog zad par 'gyur ro/ / lto na srin bu yod pa ni sngar bkru ba ma byas na/ srin bu shin tu mang ba'i phyir ma lus pa 'byung bas/ snying shin tu gtses pas slon pa drags par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / rlung la sogs pa gyen du 'byung ba ni 'og tu gsal bar gyur pas gyen du drangs pas skyon du 'gyur ro/ / slon dka' ba ni khong pa 'gags shing slon dka' ba las shas cher drangs na khong pa'i nad thams cad slongs shing dkrugs pas/ me dbal dang rmongs bag dang / mi dran pa la sogs pa'i nad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / rtug skam la sogs pas nyen pa rnams dang / rtsib logs zug pa la sogs pa ni rang rang gi nad 'phel ba dang / 'chi ba dag tu'ang 'gyur ro/ / ci rnam pa thams cad du sbrum ma la sogs pa la skyug sman gtang bar mi bya'am/ 'on te gnas skabs la lar skyug sman bya zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ de dag dug 'thungs ma zhu dang / / mi 'phrod zas zos ma gtogs so/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ sbrum ma la sogs pa de dag gis gal te dug dang sbyar ba'i dug 'thungs sam/ zas ma zhu ba ste gsud dam/ mi 'phrod pa'i zas zos bar gyur na ni ma gtogs te/ 'di dag ni myur du gsod par byed pa yin pas na/ dug 'thungs pa la sogs pa'i gnas skabs 'di lta bu ma gtogs pa gnas skabs gzhan du skyug sman mi gtang gi/ rkyen 'di dag byung na der skyug sman 'jam po gtang bar bya'o/ /

skt: atra prasaktavamathoḥ prasaktacchardiṣaḥ paso ye pūrve āturā avamyatvena nirdiṣṭāḥ gabhiṇyādyo dudhailapayaintāste sarvakarmabhidhūāntaivekṣyamānarvyāḥ pariharmyāḥ |` na kevalametedhūmāntevaijyāḥ yāvat‌ uvaro'pi ca dhūmāntaiḥ karmabhiḥ vavyaiḥ | navañvarasyāmadauṣaḥ stambhabhayāditi| ajīrṇinaḥ punaḥ svaireva kmabhitirekabastinasyadhūmagaṇṭūṣāñaootanāṣlanatarpaṇapuṭapākāntaiṣaimanavarairbisyā āma" doṣabhayāt‌ | & || de 0~parasaṃgādvarabhiṇyādiṣkādaśa navambara ca virecanavabaritanasyadhṛmānnibedhati~prasaktavamathopiti | amīināṃ sarvāṇi kamaṇi nitaridhati--svairvisevanāvairgaḍaraṣātaiśca vamanaṃ ṭha vireṣato vidhānātkartavyaṃ, saṃmrahe ṭha bhajīṇīṃ tu svaireva vamanavarajairāmadoṣamayānavacvaraśca doṣastambhabhayāditi
tib: 'dir rtag tu slon zhing rgyun du skyugs pa'i skyes bu dang / gang sngar skyug sman gtang du mi rung bar bstan pa sbrum ma nas/ nyam chung ba'i bar de thams cad spang zhing dor bar bya'o/ / 'di dag dud pas bdug pa'i bar gyi \u0f85las kun spang bar bya bar ma zad kyi/ ma zhu ba'i rims kyi bar dag la'ang spang bar bya ste/ rims sar pa la ni nad 'khyims par 'gyur ba'i nyes pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du ma zhu ba'i nad thams cad la yang sgyug sman gyi rjes la las kun te/ bkru sman dang / mas gtong ba dang / sna nas gtang ba dang / dud pas bdugs pa dang / mkhur ba bkang zhing dbo ba dang / mig sman dang / smin par bya ba'i bar gyi las spang bar bya ste/ ma zhu ba'i be'u snabs kyi 'jigs pa nyid kyis so/ / bkru sman gyis gso skran gzhang 'brum/ / 'brum bu mig ser gzhogs phyed lci/ / rims rnying dmu rdzing dbyig dug dang / / skyug dang mcher nad skya rbab dang / / long nad rab rib sngon por gyur/ / mchi 'dzag zhu ba'i gnas na zug /

skran la sogs pa nas rtug pa 'gags pa'i bar gyi nad rnams dang / de bzhin du slon par bya ba'i nad las/ mdze nad dang gcin nad nas ro stod kyi nad rnams kyi bar bkru sman gyis gso zhing sbyang bar bya ba yin te/ 'di dag la bkru sman byas pas mchog tu 'byang zhing 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: navaśañvasadvaḥ śoṣapadharantā avirecyāḥ | dopro'śra -sajayakṣmā | ` tacca. navañcarasyāpakrān‌ dāṣān‌ nanahast‌ vāpatatamava prakāpayatt‌ | atāsāyadhoāgaskapintānatiprabṛyā hanyāt‌ | śvatagudasya | gude'pānopasedhakarī raje . janayet‌ | raṅitādathau bhepaṣarajavegaṃ na saheran‌ | rājayakmātesya kṣīṇadhātu- | tayā svarpavrṛvveca ` tadamāvādhanādcaḥ syat‌ | madātyayātesya adyakṣāṇe dad‌ vāyuprāṇāparādhā ya bhāsmā tasya puraṣādayaye nācanatā vāyuḥ vasana sahasā 'tamratassādhsāna saraṇa. cā janayet‌ | saścasyābhihatayoḥ śyate vāyusāśitaḥ jīvitaṃ rdisyāt‌| | atisnigdhasyātiyogo bhavet‌ | karakoṣachaṭhasyāpadhoddhatā doṣā hpravaramānādāhaśaparbhabhedānādacchādi- | ditena kramaṇa kistilamatura śanyanātā sāṭeppaṇadīkāñrayasaṃvarite a0 18. -vira bhayamāha-cirekasādhyā , dati | saṃgrahe ta̱ bhagandarākṣipāvakṣārābhanidagdhiraḥgase- | mṛpbahmān‌. janayitvā prāṇāntidanyuḥ | gi ṇyādanāṃ pūrvokta dapaḥ svān‌
tib: rims sar pa nas skem ches pa'i bar la ni khrus byar mi rung ngo / / de la rims sar pa yin du zin kyang / nad ma smin pa la khrus mi bya ste/ des nad slar skyed pa'i phyir ro/ / gzhang nad pa ni bshang sgo sogs la gnod pa'i nad skyed par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / tshad pas 'khru ba dang khrag mkhris thur du dbyung ba gnyis la khrus byas shin tu 'khru drags pas ma rungs par 'gyur ro/ / drod chung ba la sogs pa ni sman gyi shugs mi bzod cing bsten mi nus pa yin no/ / chang nad kyis nyen pa la khrus mi bya ste/ des rlung gis srog la gcod par byed pa'i phyir ro/ / long kha'i gnas su rlung bsags pas phan tshun rgyu ba na nang du lto sbos pa skyed par byed do/ / khong du mtshon lus pa yang der rlung brten pas srog la gnod par 'gyur ro/ / lto sra ba ni sman bdo bas nad phyir phyin par ma nus pa dang / snying gar gzer ba dang / rtsib logs su zug pa dang / spo ba dang / / slon pa dang / brgyal ba dang / rmya ba skyed de/ srog ma rungs par byed do/ / snum ches pa la khrus byas na yang ha cang drags par 'gyur ro/ / skem ches ba 'dir nad gcong chen po la bya ste/ gcong chen pos nyen pa ni lus zungs zad pas dri ma'i stobs kyis gnas pa yin pa las/ de phyung nas lus kyang 'jig par 'gyur ro/ / sbrum ma la sogs pa la khrus byas na yang nyes pa sngar bshad pa ltar 'gyur ro/ / de nas thun mong dus su ni/ / cho ga bzhin du snum gyis nyen/ / nya dang ma sha til sogs kyis/ / nang par slon bya'i bad kan skyed/ / mtshan mo gnyid log zas legs zhu/ / snga dro'i dang por bkra shis byas/ / zas ma zos pa'am cung zad snum/ / thug pa zhun mar ldan pa btung / / byis pa rgan po nyams stobs chung / / sman stobs chung ba nad dbang las/ / chang 'o bu ram shing sha khu/ / nad dmigs ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ / sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha dang ldan pa/ / sman tshad lto ba las dpags te/ / sman la sngags ni mngon bzlas la/ / lkog mar phyin pa'i bar du blud/ / tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag dang tha skar bu/ / drag po dbang po nyi zla sa me rlung / / drang srong rnams kyi tshogs dang bcas pa dang / / 'byung po'i tshogs kyis khyod ni bsrung bar shog / drang srong rnams kyi bcud kyis len pa dang / / lha rnams kyi ni bdud rtsi lta bu dang / / klu mchog rnams kyi bdud rtsi lta bur ni/ / khyod la sman 'di nye bar gnas gyur cig / / oM na mo b+ha ga ba te/ b+hai Sha dz+ya gu ru bai DUr+ya pra b+ha rA dzA ya/ ta thA ga tA ya/ aR+ha te/ saM myaka sam bud d+hA ya/ tar+ya thA/ oM b+hai Sha dz+ye b+hai Sha dz+ye ma hA b+hai Sha dz+ye/ rA dza sa mung+ga te swA hA/ shar du kha bltas 'thung du gzhug / ces bya ba la/ de nas zhes bya ba ni bkra shis pa'i don du smos pa yin no/ / thun mong gi dus su ni dbyar zla tha dang / dpyid zla 'bring po'o/ / cho ga bzhin du bya ba ni bya ba'i rim pa dang mthun par snum gyis zhen cing brlan par byas la/ nang par te de las gzhan pa'i nyi ma la/ skyug sman gtang bar bya ba'i skyes bu nub gcig snum gyi cho ga spyad la/ tshad dang ldan pa'i sman de btung ba ni sman pa nub tu kha bltas la nad pa shar du kha bstan te/ sngags ni mngon par bzlas la 'thung du gzhug go ces bya bar sbyar ro/ / skyug par bya ba ji lta bu la blud ce na/ bad kan glongs pa ste/ bad kan skyed pa de rang gi gnas nas gso bar bya'o/ / gang gis she na/ mon sran gre'u dang til la sogs pas so/ / sogs pa smos pa ni 'o ma dang / zho dang / til gyi 'ba' cha la sogs pa'i kha zas kyi bye brag rnams kyis so/ / mtshan mo gnyid log pa ni mtshan mo bde bar gnyid log pas gnas pa'o/ / rang gi zas legs par zhu ba ni kha zas bde mor zhu bar gyur pa'o/ / snga dro ni nyi ma'i cha dang po'o/ / bkra shis bya ba ni byin rlob cing dge ba ston par byed pa'o/ / de bzhin du zas ma zos pa ni kha zas longs spyad pa ma byas pa'o/ / yang cung zad snum pa ni snum gyi bya ba cung zad byas pa'o/ / thug pa ni nas thug go/ / de zhun mar cung zad btab la btung bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du byis pa dang rgan po la sogs pa rnams ni nad kyi dbang las chang la sogs pa lkog mar phyin gyi bar du 'thung du bcug la/ nad dmigs ji skad bshad cing gang la ji ltar 'os pa bzhin du sbrang rtsi dang rgyam tsha dag dang ldan zhing bsres la/ sman gyi tshan lto sra snyi rab 'bring tha ma'i tshad las dpags te/ lto snyi ba la sman 'jam po'am tshad chung ba'i sman sbyin no/ / 'bring la 'bring ngo / / sra ba ni che ba dang che ba'o/ / sman la sngags kyis mngon par bzla ba ni/ dge slong bram ze rnams kyi shis par brjod par bya ba'i tshig rnams dang / de bzhin du tshangs pa ste skye dgu'i bdag dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / sngags bzla bar bya'o/ / de la tshangs pa dang skye dgu'i bdag po myur du zhes bya ba dang / tha skar gyi bu gnyis dang / drag po lha chen po dang / dbang po ste brgya byin dang / sa'i lha dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / me lha dang / / rlung lha ste tshangs pa la sogs pa de dag gis khyed la bsrung zhing skyob par shog shig pa'o/ / 'di dag 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi drang srong zhes bya ba rgyun shes la sogs pa sman gyi tshogs dang bcas pa ste/ sman gyi gnas yul lam sman gyi tshogs du ma dang bcas pa rnams dang / de bzhin du 'byung po'i tshogs te lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci la sogs pa 'byung po mthu bo che rnams kyis bsrung bar shog shig pa'o/ / yang khyed la sman 'di lta bur nye bar gnas par gyur cig pa ste/ drang srong rnams kyi bcud len dang / zhes bya ba drang srong 'pho ba zhes bya ba la sogs pas bcud kyis len du byas pa'i sman gyi tshogs lta bu dang / brgya byin la sogs pa lha rnams kyi bdud rtsi lta bu dang / klu yang yin la mchog kyang yin pas na/ klu mchog ste mtha' yas dang nor rgyas dang rigs ldan la sogs pa rnams kyi ste/ klu rnams kyi bdud rtsi rnyed par sla ba ma yin pas klu mchog ces smos pa yin te/ klu rnams kyi bdud rtsi ni lha'i bas cung zad dman pa yin te/ de dang khyed kyi sman 'di 'dra ba nyid du gnas par gyur cig pa'o/ / 'thungs nas de la sems dmigs te/ / yud tsam bsdad la dang gar 'khyil/ / mchil ma de las slon du gzhug /

skt: athetati maḍagakhārthe | sādhāraṇe kāḍe śrāvaṇe kar{take caitre māsi samyakrinagdhākhinnaṃ puruṣaṃ yathāvidhyanatikrameṇa śo'nyasminnahani avaśyaṃ chardayivavyamekarātrastehaduparataṃ bheṣajyamātrāṃ parāṅmumāturamudaṅyakhaṃ vā caidya ivyevamabhimanñya pāyayedivyakṣarayojanā | kīdṛśaṃ śovamyamukakikhuṣṭakapham‌ | utchiṣṭaḥ kapho yasya | svasthānāt‌ paracyāvitipmā kaiḥ māṃsamāṣatilādibhiḥ } ādigrahaṇāt‌ kṣīradadhitiruparuraśākibhirbhojyaviraśeṣaiḥ | niśāpup rātrau sukhasuptaṃ sujīṇīnna suṣaṭupariṇatāhāram‌ | pūauhe śubhasūcakaṃ yasya | yathā nirannamakratāhāra snigdhaṃ vā kiccitasnehitaṃ peyayā vā | piṣa ghṛtamātrā pītavantaṃ tathāca bālādain‌ nurodhena kaṇṭhaṃ yāvat‌ sauhisyaṃ katavā maḥ pāyitān‌ | tathā vikāravihitāṃ yathā dipitāṃ madhusaindhavābhyāṃ mibhitāṃ saṃyutāṃ vibhajya mṛdumadhyakarūramedena mradukoe mṛdvī ra mātrāṃ madhye madhyāṃ kre tīkṣṇāṃ mahatīṃ mara rakṣitāṃ ta mantritāṃ tathā : kaṣaśinyādibhirnatraḥ | jahā ca dakṣaścā ca radrendraśaca bhūcandrabhārkaścānikhadhānala tarahmāyanirāntāḥ pāntu rakṣantu | tathā na ke yāvadṛṣayo sunayaḥ sauṣadhavrāmāḥ sahauṣadhirbhi dharatanteye tathāmūtasakṣaḥ ajuragandharvakinnaraparabhū da̭ ca bhaiṣabhyamastu bhavatu te tava kica yanamiva ṛṣīṇāṃ yatharṣīṇāṃ cyavanaprabhṛtīnāṃ yanam‌ | tathā'marāṇāṃ devānāṃ yathāmṛtam‌ | māśca nāgānāmanantavāsukikulikamrabhratayaḥ | sarveṣāṃ nāgānāṃ sudhā sukhabhā } sudhā amūḥ prāṅmukhamāturaṃ pāyayet‌
tib: sman 'thungs zin nas/ de la sems shing zhes pa slon bro ba'i sems bskyed la/ yud tsam zhes pa chu tshod gnyis kyi bar du bsdad cing 'dug la dang gar 'khyil ba dang / rngul 'byung bas nad zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / ba spu ldang bas gnas las bskyod par 'gyur ba dang / khong pa cung zad spo zhing 'khrugs pas ltor rgyu ba dang / rim gyis snying gar zug cing dang ga 'khyil ba dang / snying 'phar ba dang / mchil ma mang po khar 'byung ba dag gis nad de gyen du mngon par shes pa'i bar du yud tsam bsdad nas slon du gzhug go/ / gang la dang ga 'khyil ba dang mchil ma mang ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba de ni dang gar 'khyil ba dang / mchil ma mang ba zhes bya la/ de ltar gyur nas de slon du gzhug go/ / ji ltar slon par bya zhe na/ ma gnod par sor mo gnyis kyis slon zhing drang ba ste/ shin tu rtsol ba drag pos mi bya'o/ / yang na chu ba 'jam pos bya ste/ ut+pal sngon po la sogs pa'i chu sdong zlum pa 'jam zhing mnyen pas bya'o/ /

de dag la gnod pa med par ro/ / de bzhin du skyug mi bro zhing 'byung bar mi ldog pa'i tshe drang zhing slon par mi bya'o/ / skyug bro zhing 'byung bar ldog pa na slon zhing skyug par bya'o/ / skyes bu slon zhing skyug bro ba'i tshe/ pus mo dang mnyam pa'i stan mthon po la gnas par gyur pas skyug tu gzhug go/ /

skt: jātaṣṭalāsaḥ sana. svedaprādubhāvina doṣa pravilyamāpāyamānaṃ yomaṣpaiṇana yataḥ sthānebhyaḥ pravivalitebhyaḥ pravicitaṃ kuśṣyādhmānena bukṣimanuvṛte kamād‌ hvadayopasodhaṃ ` hṛlāsaprasekenodhvaim‌bhisulīkataṃ budaṣvā tate yuhūramanupāranādṛṣyai chara yet‌ | jātau haklāsaprasakau yasya sa prasaktaṃ niṣṭīvanaṃ prasekakathanaṃ chaiyet‌ | aṅgulibhyāṃ hābhyāmanāyasto nātistatatanyāyāmo nārena nīrolarādiprabhavena gaṅatāsvarujan‌ acimṛdayanna bādhayet‌ | tathā vegānnāpraṣṛntānanāgatāsudīrayan‌ pravṛttānāgatān‌ pravyan‌ puruṣo jāyutusyāsane sthitaḥ san‌ camet‌
asyāturasya bamata ubhe pāśca lchādeṃ dhārayet‌ | tathā nābhiṃ prapīḍayet‌ pratilomasvāca prṭhamanumadaiyet‌ | udhvaimukhaiḥ karaiḥ

tib: mi de slon zhing skyugs par gyur pa na/ glo gnyis te rtsib logs gnyis dang / de bzhin du dpung pa nas gzung zhing brten par bya'o/ / de bzhin lte ba btsir bar bya ba dang rgyab nas gyen du btsir thabs kyis phul zhing lag pa gyen du bltas pas mnye bar bya'o/ / de ltar bad kan rno drod kha/ / mkhris pa mngar dang bsil bas slon/ / rlung 'dres bad kan snum pa dang / / skyur dang lan tshwa dag gis slon/ / ji srid bad kan rgyun chad pa'am/ / mkhris pa snang gi bar du skyug / ces bya ba la/ tshul de ltar bad kan ni sman rno ba dang dro ba dang kha bas slon zhing skyug tu gzhug go/ / de bzhin du mkhris pa dang bad kan rgyas pa 'dres pa'i nad la/ sman mngar ba dang bsil ba'i nus pa dang ldan pas slon du gzhug go/ / de bzhin du rlung nad 'dres shing 'dus pa'i bad kan rgyas pa la ni sman snum pa dang / skyur ba dang / lan tshwa'i shas che ba dag gis slon du gzhug go/ / de slon pa ni ji srid bad kan zad cing rgyun chad pa'am/ mkhris pa snang gi bar du skyug cing drang bar bya'o/ / shugs dal pi pi ling skyu ru/ / yungs kar rgyam tsha'i chu dag gis/ / yang dang yang ni slon du gzhug / ces bya ba la/ skyes bu slon pa'i shugs dal zhing / babs chung bar gyur na/ pi pi ling dang yungs kar btags pa'i lde gu dang / rgyam tsha'i chu dag blud la/

skt: hīnavego'dpavegaḥ pumāna. pippalyāmakhakasapakarkarabaṇodakaiḥ punaḥ punabhūyo mūyo vanate chadaiyet‌
tib: skyug pa'i gnas skabs der slon pa'i shugs ci'ang 'byung bar ma gyur pa'am/ yang na sdod pa'i gags dang bcas par slon pa'am/ sman 'ba' zhig byung bar gyur zhing nad ma phyin pa sman nyi tshe skyugs par gyur na/ 'di ni skyug sman gyi sbyor ba nyes shing ma rungs pa yin te/ sbyor ba nyes pa des mchil ma mang ba la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / mchil ma ni bad kan mchil snabs mang du 'dzag pa'o/ / sogs pa zhes smos pa ni yi gar mi 'ong ba dang / lus lci ba dang tshigs na ba dang / rmya zhing snyom pa dang zug cing gzer ba dang / spu langs pa la sogs pa 'byung ba bsdu'o/ /

skt: samyagyogalakṣaṇaṃ punanidhivandhaṃ niḥsaṅga ḍerā pravasante kaphādyaḥ } kamāt‌ vūrkapho ninivandhena pravatete | tataḥ pittaṃ tato vāyuḥ kameṇa | tathā nātimahatī vyadhā manaḥprasādādayo jāthante 16
tib: skyug sman gyi sbyor ba legs pa'i mtshan ma yang bde bar skyug cing gzer ba dang / bad kan la sogs pa rim gyis 'byung bar 'gyur ba ste/ bad kan slon pa med par 'byung ba dang / de'i 'og tu mkhris pa/ de'i 'og tu rlung rim bzhin du 'byung ba dang / / de bzhin du zug gzer chen po med pa dang / yid dga' zhing gsang bag la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /

skyug sman gyi sbyor ba drags par gyur pa yang / slon pa'i skyugs pa lbu ba dang / mdog tshon can rma bya'i mjug sgro ltar kha dog sna tshogs pa snang ba dang / khrag lta bur skyug par 'gyur bas na/ lbu ba tshon can khrag 'drar snang / / zhes bya'o/ / de bzhin du slon nas khong rmya zhing shin du nyam chung ba dang / de bzhin du yan lag thams cad tsha ba 'ur 'ur por gyur pa dang / lkog ma skam zhing gre ba zhum pa dang / mgo 'khor ba dang / mig gis mi mthong zhing mun pa lta bur snang ba dang / rlung nad mi bzad pa ste/ kha yo ba dang / rna ba gzer ba dang / tshig thogs pa dang / lce 'khums pa dang / mig 'gyur ba dang / 'gram pa 'thams pa dang / dran pa med pa dang / gnyid yar ba la sogs pa'i nad mi bzad pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ / yang na srog ces bya ba'i khrag 'og nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can/

skyes bu sbyor ba legs pas slon par gyur na rkang pa dang lag pa dang gdong dang mig legs par dag par byas shing phyis la/ yud tsam zhig la ngal gso zhing dub pa bsal la/ rdza yang la sogs pas dbugs byung zhing sems gso ba byas nas/ de'i 'og tu gso ba bdug pa gsum po bdug pa'i cho ga las 'og nas bshad pa rnon po dang bar ma dang / 'jam pa'i dbye bas phye ba'i gang yang rung ba de'i nus pa dang sbyar te/ ci rigs par rno ba dang bar ma dang 'jam pa dang gsum las gcig gis bdug par bya'o/ / de nas de'i 'og tu snum gyi cho ga'i spyod pa'i/ kha lag chu dron gyis bkru zhing /

skt: tato'nantaraṃ tavamanaḥ san‌ sāthadivasapāriṇāse'thavā ditīye'hana prabhāte prasyuṣasi vamanena svasthānadhracyutadopasya dhvasthānaśthāpanā chayudāna. dhapyannabubhukṣaḥ snāttaḥ sakhodakaparipikto

śudadhatvaṃ peyādi; kai kameṇosathayate ta yamāha-bāhyo'bhirnirandhanaḥ saṇuḥ sṛkṣmaḥ sakhaspaḥ s‌ traṇagomayādaiḥ sandhuścamāṇaḥ udahīpyamānaḥ kame na sahasā mahān‌ mavāti| tathā sthiraḥ sthāṇuḥ sa dyate | tathā sarvaṃ eva sarva ca rurvāyannajātaṃ paḥ rāknoti | tathā śuddhasyāntarajāṭhayakniḥ śodhaḥ nāṇuḥ sampannaḥ krameṇa peyādibhiḥ sandhukumāpa mahān‌ pacaḥ sthiraśca sampadyate 1 21 ||
tib: de nas slon zin pa dang / dgongs ka ste nyi ma nub nas sam/ yang na de phyi de zhag gi nang par tho rangs kyi slon gyis glongs pa'i lus zungs rnams rang gi gnas su legs par gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ sngar slon pas bkres shing bru ba tsha bar gyur na chu dron pos khrus byas shing gtsang sbra byas la/ sA lu rtsa snar gyi 'bras kyi thug pa la sogs pa 'og nas bshad pa'i rim pa 'di bsten cing spyad par bya'o/ / de la thug pa la sogs pa'i rim pa la bsten pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ 'bras rak+ta sha li zhes bya ba la sogs pa btsos pa'i 'bras chan snum dang lan tshwa dang kha ba shas chung ba dang / de'i 'tshal nan phal cher de dang rjes su mthun pa btung bar bya ste/ me'i drod kyi stobs las dpags te/ dgongs ka'am nang par ltogs par gyur pa'i dus su cho ga 'di spyad par bya'o/ / thug pa gar po g.yos su ma byas pa'i/ / yu sha sha khu gsum dang gnyis dang gcig / mchog dang bar ma tha ma'i sbyang bas sbyangs/ / mi yis zas kyi dus su rim bzhin spyad/ / ces bya ba la/ thug pa ni 'bras thug rkyang pa la cung zad ska ba'o/ / de bas kyang ska zhing thur ma la chags pa ni thug pa gar po'o/ / g.yos su byas pa'i yu sha ni bca' sga dang pi pi ling dang / se 'bru dang go snyod dang shing kun la sogs pa ma btab par mon sran sde'u mung+ga zhes bya ba la sogs pa la bskol ba'i khu ba'o/ / sran mung+ga la sogs pa de nyid bskol ba'i khu ba la bca' sga la sogs pa btab pa ni g.yos su byas pa'i khu ba'o/ / sha khu ni sha dag gi khu ba g.yos su byas pa'o/ / 'dir byas pa ni/ der ni sha las khu ba ste/ 'bru las khu ba 'bras bu las/ / kha lo rtsa ba til tshigs skyur/ / phal cher skam pa la zhes bya/ / de dag snum sogs ldan dang med/ / g.yos byas ma byas yin zhes bya/ / zhes 'byung ba yin no/ / thug pa rkyang rkyang po la sogs pa rnam pa lnga po de dag rim bzhin du grangs ji lta ba bzhin du ma 'chol bar gsum dang gnyis dang gcig tu byas nas/ zas kyi dus su mchog dang bar ma dang tha ma'i sbyang bas sbyang bar mi bya ste/ skyes bus spyad cing bsten par bya'o/ / mchog dang bar ma dang tha ma'i sbyang ba de dag gis sbyangs shing nad bsal ba'i mis zas kyi dus gsum por thug pa rkyang rkyang po nas sha khu ba'i rim pa bzhin du so sor spyad par bya'o/ / de yang thug pa gsum po nam sha khu'i bar du tshe tshad de/ mchog tu sbyang ba byas pa la gsum ste/ zas kyi dus su gsum bsten pa dang / sbyang ba 'bring gis sbyong ba la gnyis te/ zas kyi dus gnyis gnyis te bsten pa dang / de bzhin du sbyang ba thams sbyang ba la gcig ste/ zas kyi dus thug pa nas sha khu'i bar du re re spyad pas bsten par bya'o/ / de la nyi ma dang po'i dgongs ka thug pa btung bar bya'o/ / nyi ma gnyis pa la zas kyi dus gnyis su thug pa nyid btung bar byas te/ de ltar zas kyi dus gsum du thug pa spyad pa yin no/ / nyi ma gsum pa la zas kyi dus gnyis su thug pa gar po spyad par bya'o/ / de yang sla ba ma yin pa thur ma la bde blag tu chags pa bza' bar bya ste/ de ltar na zas kyi dus gsum du thug pa gar po longs spyod pa yin no/ / nyi ma bzhi pa'i dgongs ka'i zas kyi dus gcig tu g.yos su ma byas pa'i khu ba longs sbyad par bya'o/ / de yang nyi ma lnga pa'i zas kyi dus gnyis su g.yos su ma byas pa'i khu ba nyid btung bar bya ste/ de ltar na g.yos su ma byas pa'i khu ba zas kyi dus gsum du spyad pa yin no/ / zhag drug pa la zas kyi dus gnyis su g.yos su byas pa'i khu ba bsten par bya'o/ / nyi ma bdun pa'i nang par gyi zas gcig la g.yos su byas pa'i khu ba zas kyi dus gsum du spyad par bya'o/ / zhag bdun pa'i dgongs ka zas kyi dus gcig tu sha khu dang nye bar longs spyad par bya'o/ / zhag brgyad pa'i zas kyi bar dus gnyis su sha khu dang bsten par bya ste/ de ltar sha khu zas kyi dus gsum du bstan pa yin no/ / 'di ni sbyang bar gyi thug pa rkyang rkyang po nas sha khu'i bar spyad pa'i rim pa yin no/ / de bzhin du sbyang ba che bas sbyangs pas zas kyi dus gnyis su thug pa la sogs pa spyad par bya'o/ / nyi ma bzhi pa'i nang par yang g.yos su ma byas pa nyid do/ / de'i dgongs ka ni g.yos su byas pa'i khu ba ste/ lnga pa'i nang par yang g.yos su byas pa dang spyad par bya'o/ / de'i dgongs ka ni sha khu ste/ nyi ma drug pa'i nang par yang sha khu dang spyad par bya'o/ / de'i dgongs ka phan chad ni zas nar mar bza' bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du sbyang ba tha mas sbyangs pas zas kyi dus gcig tu thug pa rkyang rkyang po la sogs pa spyad par bya ste/ nyin zhag dang po'i dgongs ka thug pa rkyang rkyang po spyad par bya'o/ / nyi ma gnyis pa'i nang par thug pa gar po dgongs ka g.yos su ma byas pa'i sha nyi ma gsum pa'i nang par g.yos su bya ba'i khu ba/ dgongs ka sha khu de phan chad ni zas nar ma thams cad spyad la rag go/ / thug pa rkyang rkyang po la sogs pa'i rim pas ci zhig byed ce na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ / dper na me chung rtswa dang lci sogs kyis/ / rnam par sbar nas rim gyis mched pa na/ / che zhing brtan la thams cad mched par nus/ / sbyangs pa'i nad med thug sogs kyis de bzhin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ dper na me shing med cing phra ba cung zad cig gnas par gyur pa ni/ rtswa dang lci ba la sogs pa phra zhing zhib mor rnam par sbar zhing 'bud pa na/ rim gyis mched par gyur pa na chen por 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du brtan zhing mi sod par 'gyur ba dang / thams cad mched par nus pa ste/ dngos po sra zhing lci ba'i zas kyi rigs rnams kyang smin pa dang tshos par nus par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du sbyangs par gyur pa'i pho ba'i nang gi me sbyangs pas nyam chung zhing stobs zhan pa thug pa rkyang rkyang po la sogs pas gsos par gyur pa ni rim gyis che ba dang brtan pa dang / 'ju zhing smin par byed nus par 'gyur ro/ / de la sbyang ba gsum po de gang zhig yin pa mi shes so zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/ slon tshad chung dang 'bring dang chen po ni/ / bzhi dang drug dang lan brgyad slon par 'dod/ / de gnyis bcu dang nyis ldab sum ldab 'khru/ / bre gang de bzhin nyis ldab bzhi ldab 'gyur/ / skyug sman mthar mkhris bkru sman las byed dang / / bad kan mthar byung 'khru ba mchog tu bshad/ / ces bya ba la sogs pa'i tshad chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po ji lta ba bzhin du slon shugs bzhi dang / drug dang brgyad slon pa dag tshe'i rig byed dran par byed pa dag mngon par 'dod cing ston pa yin no/ / de la slon pa chung tshad ni lan bzhi slon pa yin par 'dod do/ / slon tshad 'bring ni lan drug slon pa'o/ / slon pa che tshad ni lan brgyad slon pa'o/ / 'byung ba'i shugs de nyid bcu dang nyis ldab dang / sum ldab ni 'khru ba'i tshad chung ngu dang / 'bring dang chen po yin par drang srong de nyid 'dod do/ / de la 'khru ba chung ba'i tshad ni lan bcu 'khru ba'o/ / 'khru ba'i 'bring tshad ni/ bcu gnyis ldab ste lan nyi shu 'khru bar 'dod do/ / 'khru ba che tshad ni bcu'i sum ldab sum cu yin par 'dod do/ / de ltar na skyug sman dang bkru sman gnyis kyi 'byung ba'i grangs kyi tshad chung ngu dang chen po bshad pa yin no/ / bre la sogs pa'i tshad kyis gzhal ba'i tshad chung ngu dang / 'bring dang / chen po smras pa ni bre gang la sogs pa yin te/ 'khru ba'i tshad chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po ni rim bzhin du bre gang dang / de nyid kyis nyis ldab dang / de nyid kyis bzhi ldab yin no/ / zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ / des na 'khru ba chung tshad ni bre gang ngo / / 'bring ni bre do'o/ / chen po ni bre bzhi yin no/ / slob dpon gzhan dag ni/ skyug sman gyi mchog ni mkhris pa 'byung ba'i mthar thug pa yin par 'dod do/ / skyug sman gang gi mthar mkhris pa 'byung ba de ni/ skyug sman mthar ni mkhris pa'o/ / zhes bya'o/ / bkru sman gyi tshad bre gang du yongs su chung ba las phyed do/ / des na slon pa'i chung tshad ni bre phyed do/ / 'bring ni bre gang ngo / / che tshad ni bre do'o/ / de bzhin du bad kan mtha' mar byung ba'i 'khru ba'i tshad ni mchog yin no/ /

skt: anye punasācāthīḥ pittāvasānamurkaraṣṭaṃ vamanamāhuḥ | pintaṃ vamanānte yasya tat‌ pittāvasānaṃ vamane cirekāt‌ prasthādukhannaparicchinanāhmanamadhemāhuḥ | tena jaghanye vamane prasthasyāthai sadhye praḥ pravare ddhau prasthāciti | tathā kaphāntavirekamāhuḥ kaphaparthante pradhānaṃ virekamāhusācāryāḥ
tib: de bshang ba dang bcas par 'byung bas na/ bshang bcas te 'khru ba de gtogs shing tshad du bgrang bar mi rtsi zhing 'khru ba'i tshad la la gzhal zhing brtsis la 'khru ba'i grangs su bstan pa gang yin pa las de mi rtsi ste/ de'i 'og tu dngos po'i rigs gzhan de med pa 'khru ba'i shugs kyi dbang gis bshang ba'i sgo nas 'byung ba de nyid de'i 'og tu bre la sogs pa'i tshad kyis gzhal bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du slon zhing skyugs pa'i lus la slon pa'i phyir/ skyug sman chu la sogs pa rdzas gsher ba dang bsres te 'thungs pa gang yin pa kha nas slon te byung ba de skad du bshad pa'i grangs su mi rtsi'o/ / de'i 'og tu dngos po gzhan dag slon pa'i shugs kyis kha'i sgo nas byung ba de nyid phan chad gzhal zhing brtsi bar bya'o/ /

skt: atra vahupitto mṛdukoṣṭhaḥ sa viracyate karāraṇāpi | kṣīraṃ croṣarakṣaṇamānnam‌ | tenaiṣa rabhavanramanmuyuḍkarṛgāsārpinavamayopṇodakapīṭudrāśāpṛgaphādibhiviscyate
tib: de nas zhes bya ba ni/ bkra shis pa'i don nam/ de ma thag pa'i don te/ de nas de'i 'og tu slon pa'i skyes bu de slar yang zhes bya ba phyis yang snum dang dugs byas shing bde bar gnas pa sngar bshad pa'i chogs byas la/ bad kan gyi dus 'das pa dang lto na kha zas med par shes shing rtogs nas sman gyi tshad ji ltar 'os pa las legs par bkru sman btang zhing 'thung du bcug la/

de la mkhris pa mang zhing lto snyi ba gang yin pa de ni 'o mas kyang 'khru bar byed do/ / 'dir 'o ma smos pa ni nye bar mtshon pa tsam du zad do/ / des na bu ram shing gi khu ba dang dar ba skyur po dang / zho ga chu dang / bu ram dang / kri sar dang / / zhun mar dang / chang dang / chu tshan dang / pi lu dang / rgun 'brum dang / gla gor zho sha la sogs pas kyang 'khru bar byed do/ / de la rlung shas che zhing lto sra la 'khru bar dka' ba ni dur byid dang 'bras bu gsum dang / nim pa dang / ni li ni dang / dan da'i 'bras bu la sogs pas kyang 'khru bar dka' zhing rtsol ba chen pos gdong 'khru ba yin no/ /

skt: śodhanayoramarabṛttau saṭāṃ bheṣajottejanārbhara pṇodakaṃ pāyayet‌. | tathāsya pasaḥ pāṇitāgaiścaṃ | draṃ jaṭharaṃ svedayet‌
tib: mkhris pa'i nad kyi yul la ni bkru sman mngar ba dang / bska ba btang na bkru ba la bsngags so zhes bya ba ni tshig gi lhag ma'o/ / de bzhin du bad kan zhes bya ba la mkhris pa rgyas pa dang 'dres pa'i bad kan la ni sman kha bas bkru ba bsngags pa yin no/ / rlung dang mkhris pa 'dres pa la ni sman snum pa dang / dro ba dang / lan tshwa can gyi bkru sman gyis bkru ba bsngags pa yin no/ /

sbyang ba'i sman gyis 'khru bar ma gyur na/ sman gyi nus pa bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ chu tshan blud pa dang / de bzhin du skyes bu lag pa bsros pas de'i lto ba legs par dugs bya zhing bsro bar bya'o/ /

sman des cung zhig 'khru ba'i nad bde mor ma phyin na mal nas langs la/ phyi rol gyi sar dri ma gdon pa'i phyir 'gro bar byas la/ de nas de zhag gcig zan zos la/ nyi ma gnyis pa zhes bya ba phyi de nyin yang 'khru bar bya ba'i phyir yang sman btung bar bya'o/ /

skt: virevanasyapyogadakṣaṇamasamyagyogahakṣaṇaṃ dad‌yasya tathā vuaisuddhiranirmarukham‌ | jarucirananāśraddhā | tathā śepmapittayorakhakṅeḥ macyāvaḥ | vidāho vidhidhasantāpaḥ | piṭikā aṅgāvṛyavadhu | pīnasaḥ pravidyāyaḥ | tathā bātanigraho vātapurīṣayoḥ saṅgaḥ
tib: gang gi snum gyis zhen par ma gyur cing ma bslan bas rab tu sra ba zhig na/ zhag bcu'i bar du slar yang snum gyi cho ga byas la/ lus nye bar sbyang zhing snum gyi dugs kyis btsos nas bkru sman gyi sbyor ba nad la sogs pa'i tshul la legs par brtags te bya ba dang / de bzhin du sngar gyi nyes pa ci yang dran zhing ngos zin par byas la/ ma yengs par bkru sman btung bar bya'o/ / bkru sman gyi sbyor ba nyes pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ snying dang lto na yi ga 'chus/ / bad kan mkhris pa glongs pa dang / / g.yan pa lus tsha thor bu dang / / cham pas 'debs shing bshang rlung 'gags/ / sbyor ba nyes pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ / zhes bya ba yin te/ bkru sman btang ba ma legs na/ snying dang lto ba na zhing mi dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa ste zas la 'dod pa med pa dang / de bzhin du bad kan dang mkhris pa glongs shing bskyod par 'gyur ba dang / lus g.ya' zhing lus tsha ba sna tshogs kyis 'debs pa dang / yan lag dang nying lag tu thor bu 'byung ba dang / cham pas 'debs pa dang / de bzhin du bshang ba thur du 'byung ba'i rlung 'gags par 'gyur ba ni sbyor ba nyes pa'i mtshan nyid yin par bshad do/ / sbyor legs ji skad bshad go bzlog / ces bya ba la/ bkru sman gyi sbyor ba legs na ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid snying dang lto ba na ba la sogs pa las go bzlog pa ste/ snying dang lto ba dag cing sang bag tu 'gyur ba dang / zas yi gar 'ong ba la sogs

skyes bu shin tu 'khru drags pa la/ gnod pa 'di dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ bshang ba la sogs pa 'byung ba na/ bad kan dang mkhris pa ni med pa'i dri ma'i chu 'ba' zhig 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du skya zhing dkar ba dang / gnag cing snag tsha 'dra ba dang / khrag dang bcas pa ste/ yang na sha bkrus pa lta bu ste/ bkrus pa'i sha 'dra ba dang / de bzhin du tshil gyi dum bu dang 'dra zhing mtshungs pa dang / de bzhin du gzhang 'byung zhing 'thon pa dang / de bzhin du skom dad che zhing skom pas gdungs pa dang / mgo 'khor ba dang / de bzhin du mig phugs su bros shing rkongs su zhugs pa ste/ 'di dag ni shin tu 'khru drags pa las 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du skyug sman drags pa'i nad kyi tshul sngar bshad pa ltar yang 'byung bar 'gyur te/ lus skem zhing rmya ba dang / lus kyi khong tsha ba dang / lkog ma bskams pa dang / mig gis mi mthong nas 'chi ba'i bar du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / legs par 'khrus pa de la ni/ / dud pas bdug pa ma gtogs pa'i/ / cho ga skyug sman dang mtshungs pas/ / de nas slon dang 'dra bar bya/ / zas la rim gyis spyad nas ni/ / de 'og nar ma'i kha zas bsten/ / zhes bya ba la/ / legs par 'khru zhing khrus kyi sbyor ba ji skad du bshad pa ltar 'khru ba'i skyes bu de la dud pas bdug pa'i cho ga ma gtogs pa/ cho ga gzhan skyug sman gyi skabs su bshad pa dang mtshungs shing 'dra bar nye bar sbyar bar bya ste/ 'dir khyad par ni dud pas bdug pa 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa sngar bshad pa thams cad bya'o/ / de nas de'i 'og tu slon dang 'dra bar bya ba ste/ ji ltar slon pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin du rim pa nyid kyis khrus btang ba'i 'og tu thug pa rkyang rkyang po la sogs pa sbyin pa'i kha zas kyi cho ga rim gyis spyad cing bsten nas/ de'i 'og tu nar ma'i kha zas min pa'i dbang du byas nas bshad pa'i zas kyi cho ga bsten par spyad par bya'o/ /

skt: etāvatā hi sedyādibhiralakheroḥ pracyuti doṣāṇāṃ tathā khedanokredstadauṣadherarakcheśaḥ } eṣāsukhṭheśānāṃ saṅgena pravṛttibhistaiḥ sanana ghādhyate| chaṅkane te sati

saṃśodhanādibhirmandatāṃ sāyamaniyīti | tasmāt‌ peyādikaṃ kaṛmamācaret‌ seveta | saṃśodhane vamanavirecavane | akhasya visakhāvo raktaniṣṭaraṇam‌ | snehayojanā stehaathuktiḥ | ṭaṣvanamupavāsaḥ | tathā cāgame “laṅghanasya miśeṣoktāupavāso vidhīyate", iti
tato'nantare vabhamitavāniva yathā cāntasatadrateneva rameṇa paripāṭathā'nnāni muśānaḥ parāt‌ [katibhojanaṃ khasthādhikravidahite bhojayet‌
tib: skyes bu sman 'thungs shing spyad nas/ me'i drod chung zhing me'i stobs chung ba dang / ma dag pa ste/ nad ma phyin la legs par sbyangs pa'i mtshan nyid ma skyes pa dang / nad kyis rmya ba ste/ nad kyi dugs sman rnams kyis nyam chung ba dang / zhu ba'i mtshan ma mthong ste/ sman legs par zhu ba'i rtags mi snang na/ snum dang dugs la sogs pas glongs pa'i nad kyis gnod par mi 'gyur te/ de yang nad gang snum gyis glongs shing bskyod pa dang dugs kyis glongs shing bskyod pa dang / sman gyis glongs pa'i dbang gis nad bskyod pa de smyung ba byas nas des nyen zhing gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ / sbyangs dang khrag ni dbyung ba dang / / snum chog la sbyar smyung ba yis/ / me drod zhen pa nyid 'gyur te/ / de bas thug sogs rim gyis spyad/ / ces bya ba la/ slon dang khrus la sogs pas sbyangs pa la sogs pas pho ba'i me drod zhen zhing stobs chung bar 'gyur ba yin te/ de bas na thug pa la sogs pa rim gyis spyod cing bstan par bya'o/ / de la sbyangs pa ni skyug sman btang ba dang / bkru sman btang bas nad phyin par byas pa'o/ / khrag dbyung ba ni gtar ga la sogs pas khrag dbyung ngo / / snum gyi cho ga la sbyar ba ni snum gyi cho ga bstan pa'o/ / smyung ba ni zas bcad pa'o/ / de yang sman dpyad kyi lung las smyung ba khyad par med pas bshad par zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /

skt: pitte ca śeṣmā ca pittkeṣmāṇau | to niaitāvaspau pittakeṣmāṇau yasya tam‌ sutāspapintaśeṣmāṇam‌ | tathā madyaṃ pibati yo'tiśyena te madyapam‌ | tathā vātapittaṃ pradākavyā tān‌ peyāṃ na pāyayet‌ | teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ tpa̭ṇādikramo hitaḥ | prathamamannakāle tarṇaṃ ṭhājasakṛbhiḥ kṛtaṃ yojyam‌ | peyāsthāne tarpaṇā itythaḥ40|| dai0-śatādiṣu peyāṃ niṣedhati--tāspapitateti | neṣiddhapeyānāṃ peyāsthāne mandho yojya ityāha--teṣāmeti
tib: gang gi bad kan dang mkhris pa chung zhing phri bas chung bar gyur pa de ni bad kan mkhris pa bri zhing chung ba zhes bya'o/ / de bzhin du gang chang 'thung ba la goms pa de ni chang 'thungs pa'o/ / de bzhin du rang bzhin gyis rlung dang mkhris pa'i shas che ba de la thug pa mi drud kyi/ gsum po de dag la brta ba la sogs pa'i rim pa phan te/ zas kyi dang por brta ba'i cho ga 'bras bu'i yos kyi phye las byas pa'i skyo ma sbyin par bya ste/ thug pa'i skabs su brta bar byed pa'i 'bras kyi skyo ma sbyar bar bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ / skyug sman ma zhu bar nad 'byin/ / bkru sman zhu nas 'byin pa yin/ / de yi phyir na skyug sman dag /

skt: camanaṃ prayuktamapakṣaṃ sat‌ doṣāirediti andhaḥ | virecanaṃ punaradaitaṃ pacyamānaṃ pākādīn‌ cchan‌ doṣān‌ nirairet‌ | ataḥ kāraṇādahamanasya ṅa na pravīkṣeta | suhūtaimātre yadi nāgacchedā kṣimrataramānayet‌ | udhvaudhorecanaṃ prayuktaṃ parītyena jāyate | “yadā tadā chardyataḥ siśveṣṇena vāriṇā | pādau śītena codhvīṅgaṃ vipata̭ viparyaye ? uradhvarevanaṃ bamanagrayukta̭ṃ yadā sacit‌ kāraṇena caraiparīlyena pirecanatayā jāyate dā'ghovirecanaṃ yadā kutaśinnipittadvipayeyena paranasvena jāyatate tadā virecanaiparītyācchardayata ṇena vāriṇā pādau siccat‌ | śītena cordhvāḍgaṃ ścet‌ | yadā bamanaviparītyacirekasatadā viri rate | ataḥ pūvaiviparītaṃ kāyam‌ ! pādau śītophena sibhveduṣṇodakenodhvāṅgamitythaṃ iti saccha-matrānītaṃ kecit‌
tib: skyug sman btang na ni ma zhu ba'i nad 'byin par byed do/ / bkru sman zhu zhing smin nas nad 'byin cing sel bar byed de/ de'i phyir skyug sman dag btang nas zhu ba la bsdad mi dgos te gang yud tsam bsdad pa ma byung na yang myur ba nyid du slon zhing drang bar bya'o/ / steng dang 'og tu 'byung rigs pas/ / gang tshe phyin ci log gyur na/ / de tshe skyugs la rkang par ni/ / chu dron dag gis blugs par bya/ / lus kyi stod ni chu grang blugs/ / 'khru ba la ni de las bzlog / ces bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ yan lag brgyad pa bsdus pa las/ la la zhig gis 'dir bcug pa yin no/ / de'i don ni 'di yin te/ skyug sman gyis steng du 'byung ba dang / bkru sman gyis 'og tu 'byung ba'i rigs pa las/ gang gi tshe rgyu 'ga' zhig gis phyin ci log tu gyur te/ rkyen des skyug sman btang ba na/ 'khru bar gyur pa dang / bkru sman btang ba na slon par gyur pa de'i tshe/ 'khru ba las phyin ci log tu gyur te/ slon par gyur pa ni/ chu dron po rkang par blugs la/ chu grang mo ro stod du blugs par bya'o/ / gang gi tshe 'khru sman phyin ci log tu gyur pa las go bzlog pa'i dpyad bya ste/ rkang par chu grang mo blugs par bya la/ ro stod du chu dron mo blugs par bya'o/ / gang zhig nyam chung nad mang dang / / nad smin pa yis rang nyid ni/ / 'khru bar byed la 'khru ba ni/ / kha zas byin la der 'khrur gzhug / ces bya ba la/ gang zhig nyam chung ba la sogs pa dang / nad smin te rang nyid 'khru ba de la ni kha zas kyis 'khrur gzhug gi /

skt: dauvasyādiyukto doṣapākena yaḥ khayaṃ viricyate na tasme birecanamīpadhaṃ deyam‌

dubailaḥ san‌ pūva śodhitaḥ tathā'spadoṣastathā karāstathā mudvādibhedenāpārijñātakoṣṭhaḥ sa madvaspamoṣadhaṃ yojayet‌ | nāpekṣayā naikavāraṃ pītaṃ natvanyathā saṅkatsaṃśāyāvahe pīte varamatiyogamayāt‌ | dubailasya ca tān‌ doṣān‌ bahūn‌ prabhūtān‌ aspamaspaṃ stokaṃ stokaṃ kṛtvā bhṛdudravyaret‌
tib: slar sbyang ba byas pa lus nyam chung bar gyur pa dang / de bzhin du nad kyi dkyel chung ba dang / lus kyi sha zad cing sbeg pa dang / de bzhin du lto sra snyi'i bye brag mi shes pa dag la/ sman 'jam zhing chung ba blud par bya ste/ gang gi phyir sman de dgos pa la ltos nas lan mang du 'thungs pa ni mchog yin gyi gzhan du na lan cig mang du blud pa dgos pa dang bcas pas ni mi rung ste/ sbyor ba nyes pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir ro/ / nyam chung ba ni nad mang po/ / g.yos gyur cung zad cung zad cig / sman ni 'jam pos lan mang zhig /

skt: hakghādiyuktānāṃ pasaṃ tathā dīptāprīnāṃ | sepajaṃ virecanamauvadhamaviricyaiva virecanamakrasavaiva atastebhyo narebhyaḥ purā vakṣi daśvā . tato'nantara nīdinīdharṛtādikaṃ - dadyāt‌ | athavā tīkṣṇābhiḥ phalavtibhiḥ śakṛt‌ purīṣaṃ stokaṃ niṣatya virecanaṃ dadyāt‌ | yasmāt‌ pharavatibhirvirecayet‌
tib: skyes bu nyam chung ba'i nad mang po g.yos par gyur ba ni/ cung zad cung zad cig sman 'jam pos yang dang yang du bsal bar byas nas/ nyam chung ba'i nad g.yos par gyur pa de nyung ngur gyur pas ma bton par zhi bar byas pas zhi bar bya ste/ gang gi phyir zhe na/ mang po de dag g.yos pa nyung ngu nas bsal zhing zhi bar byas na/ nad de yun ring du nyon mongs shing / sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba'am/ gsod cing 'joms pa

de bzhin du skyes bu me drod chung bar gyur pa sbyang ba'i skabs la bab na thal sman rnon po dang bcas pa'i mar ji skad bshad pas pho ba'i me drod bskyed nas sbyang ba bya'o/ / de bzhin du sra ba la rgyam tsha dang mar dang bcas pas rlung dang bad kan bsal la sbyang bar bya'o/ /

skt: bastinā vā avṛttaṃ nigate malaṃ pusapādikaṃ snigdho virekaḥ sukhaṃ viharet‌
tib: skyes bu rtsub pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin du me drod rab tu che zhing sman de 'khru ba'i sman mi 'khru ba'i bya ba mi byed pa nyid du zhu zhing dengs par 'gyur ro/ / de bas de'i 'og tu snum pa'i bkru sman ni/ ni li ni'i mar la sogs pa las btang ba sbyin par bya'o/ / yang na mi de lta bu de la sman rnon po'i reng bu byas pas bshang ba cung zad ces pa nyung shas cig phyung la/ de'i 'og tu bkru sman gtang ngo / / de yang gang gi phyir reng bu mas gtong bas/ sman gyis bshang ba la sogs pa phyung ba'i 'og tu bkru sman snum po btang na 'khru ba bde bar 'gyur ro/ /

skt: viṣāmidhātādibhimehānteratīnāturān‌ nātisnigdhān‌ sāmarthyādīpatinigān‌ chratvā yathāprayeṇa rūkṣaidhido| dai0-viṣādiṣu naba īṣalligdhasya śodhanamitthāha--viṣāmidhātati | amiṣātaḥ rnayātādiḥ
yaḥ snehasvedau prathamamanabhyasyakṛtvā saṃrodha vamanavirekādikaṃ kuyīt‌ tasya jantoḥ śarīra daita ! yathā śyaṣkaṃ dārukāṣṭhamānāme kunjatābhāvakaraṇe bhañyate

tib: gong du smos pa lta bu'i lgang pa med na rkyal pa'i dpung pa bcad pa'am/ byin pa'i pags pa legs par mnyes pa de la bcing zhing gdags par bya'o/ / yang na ras stug cing bzang la bu ga med pa spra tshil la sogs pas bskus la/ chu thub pa las sman blugs pa'i snod bya'o/ / ni ru ha tshad dang po ni/ / lo gcig pa la srang gcig mchog / ji srid srang ni bcu gnyis bar/ / lo re srang res bskyed par bya/ / bcu gnyis pa nas brgyad bar/ / de yang bdun cu'i bar tshad 'di/ / de phan srang tshad nyi shu nyid/ / ces bya ba la/ ni ru ha ste bkru sman drag po mas gtod ba'i tshad ni lo gcig lon pa la srang gcig mchog ste/ che tshad yin no/ / lo gcig ma lon pa srang gcig tu cung zad ma longs pa tshad yin no/ / de phan chad lo re re zhing srang re res bskyed de/ lo bcu gnyis pa'i bar la srang bcu gnyis gtang ba'i bar du bskyed par bya'o/ / ni ru ha srang bcu gnyis byas pa de phan chad kyi lo re bzhin srang gnyis bskyed par bya'o/ / lo bcu gnyis lon pa nas/ bcu bdun lon pa'i bar la bya'o/ / brgyad pa ni srang nyi shu rtsa bzhi che tshad yin te/ de yang ni ru ha tshad 'di ni lo bcu bdun lon pa'i bar gyi tshad yin no/ / lo bdun cu lon pa phan chad kyi ni srang nyi shu nyid che tshad yin no/ / zhes bya ba ni 'dir nges par bzung ba'i don no/ / che tshad srang nyi shu kho na yin gyi de las lhag pa mi bya'o/ / zhes bya ba'i don no/ / bkru sman drag tshad ji lta ba/ / de yi bzhi cha 'jam rtsi'i tshad/ / ces bya ba la/ bkru sman drag po ni ru ha'i tshad ni tshod gang dang gang las ji ltar yin pa de dang de'i bzhi cha 'jam rtsi zhes bya ba/ snum gyi cho ga mas gtong ba'i tshad yin no/ / de yang lo dang po la ni ru ha'i tshad srang gcig yin la/ tshad de'i bzhi cha zho gnyis la ni 'jam rtsi lo gcig pa la gtang ba'i tshad yin no/ / de bzhin du bcu gnyis pa la srang bcu gnyis ni ru ha'i tshad yin pa las/ de'i bzhi cha srang gsum 'jam rtsi'i tshad do/ / de bzhin du lo brgyad lon pa'i tshad nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin la/ de'i bzhi cha ni srang drug ste/

skt: āsthāpanīya āsthāpyaḥ āsthāpanayogyaḥ| tamāsthāpyaṃ sehitaṃ svinnamādau snehitaṃ paścārasatehitaṃ pañcāttathā śuddha vamanavirecanābhyāṃ chavdhavale prāpravaramanvāsanayogya puraṣaṃ vijñāya tataḥ pūaimeba chatāsthāpanamanubāsyet‌ | śīte ke śītasāmānyāddhemante śirire tayo stathā vasante divā'nuvāsayet‌ | tato'nyadā'nyasmin‌ kāle vaṣāśaraduprīṣamākhye rātrāvalubāsayet‌ | iti kecidācāyau; | ādāvabhyaktaṃ paścāt‌ snātamātusyucitādabhyastāspādadīnaṃ catubhauganyūnamasinigdharūkṣasādhāraṇam‌ | aśita auktabantaṃ sāsupāna tathā pravādi dravapūṣai tathā kṛtacaḍaṅkramaṇe yuktaviṣūtramutsṛṣṭaśaknmaṭaṃ nivāte vedamani śayane nāvyuccharite nacocchīṣa daiṣaṭuncatapādaroṣe vā vāmapārvaina saṃniviṣṭaṃ ruktaprākūrirasaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ savitha saṅkocya paraṃ vāmaṃ sakthi prasā~bevidhaṃ saṃsthāpyāsthāpya
tib: ni ru ha zhes bya ba bkru sman drag po gtang bar bya zhing 'os pa ste/ snum dang dugs bya ba ste/ dang po snum gyi cho ga byas la/ de'i 'og tu dugs bya'o/ / de bzhin du sbyang bar bya ba ste/ bkru sman dang / / skyug sman byas nas kyang slar stobs thob cing / nyams stobs brtags pa dag 'jam rtsi gtang bar 'os shing rigs par shes nas/ dang po thog ma kho nar bkru sman drag po mas gtong ba'i 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya'o/ / dgun dpyid nyin par btang de las/ / gzhan du mtshan btang la la 'dod/ / ces bya ba la/ dgun zhes bya ba grang ba'i dus spyir grang ba ste/ dgun stod dang dgun smad kyi dus su 'jam rtsi nyin par gtang bar bya'o/ / de las gzhan du zhes pa gong ma las gzhan pa'i dus so ga dang / dbyar dang ston ka mtshan mo'i dus su 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya'o/ /

dang po bsku byug byas la/ de'i 'og tu khrus bya ba yin pas na/ nad pa de bsku byug dang khrus bya'o/ / de nas sngon bsten zhing goms pa'i tha ma la bzhi cha gsum ste/ nar mar bza' ba'i thang las bzhi cha phri la/ bza' ba ni yang ba dang / ha cang rtsub ches pa dang / / snum ches pa ma yin pa/ snum rtsub ran pa phan zhing gnod pa med pa'i zas bza' bar bya'o/ / de'i 'og tu 'tshal nan btung ba ni mung+ga'i khu ba la sogs pa gnod pa med cing rjes su mthun pa btung bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du bcags pa ste/ cung zad cig phan tshun bcags pa dang / bshang ba dang / gci ba legs par bsil zhing dor ba dang / de bzhin du rlung med pa'i khang pa'i nang du mal bde ba shin tu mtho ba dang / shin tu dma' ba ma yin pa mgo smad pa ste/ rkang pa'i phyogs cung mtho bar glo g.yon pa legs par phab la/ rkang pa g.yas pa bkug nas rkang pa g.yon pa legs par brkyang ba'i tshul de ltar gnas par byas la/ de nas de la gce'u gzhag par bya'o/ / de yang ji lta zhe na/

tib: de nas de'i 'og tu skyes bu de la gce'u gzhug pa'i thabs ni/ gce'u kha ste rtse mo snum gyis bsku ba dang / gzhang zhes bya ba bshang ba'i lam yang snum gyis bskus te/ dbugs bton zhes pa lgang pa'i nang gi dbugs bton la/ gce'u'i kha bcings shing bsdams nas/ lag pa mi 'dar zhing brdabs bag tu ma gyur pas rgyab kyi phyogs nas de la mngon par phyogs par 'dug ste gtang bar bya'o/ / de'i 'og tu shin tu myur ba dang / shin tu bul ba dang / dam pa ma yin pa dang / ha cang shugs drag pa dang / ha cang dal bar ma yin par lan cig kho nar btsir bar bya'o/ / yang nas yang du ni ma yin no/ / de yang lgang pa de'i zhabs na sman gyi lhag ma cung zad lus par bya'i/ rnam pa thams cad nas thams cad du btsir bar mi bya'o/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sman gyi lhag mar rlung yod pa'i phyir ro/ / de yang / lgang pa de'i zhabs sman gyi lhag / ma lus par ni blugs pa yis/ / rlung zhugs nas ni rnam 'khrugs pas/ / gzer dang nad rnams skyed par 'gyur/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / btang nas lus ni gan rkyal gzhag / rkub tsos lag pas brdab par bya/ / rting pas mjug tsos brdung bya zhing / / rting pa bteg la lan gsum gsig / ces bya ba la/ 'jam rtsi btang nas de'i lus gan rkyal du bzhag la/ 'jam rtsi btang ba de'i rkub tsos lag pas brdab par bya zhing bsnun par bya'o/ / de bzhin du nad pa'i rting pa gnyis kyis mjug tsos brdung zhing brdeg par bya'o/ / de bzhin du mal nas rting pa yar bteg ste/

tib: de ltar 'jam rtsi btang nas mi de nyi ma gsum mam/ / nyi ma lnga nas slar yang 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya'o/ / yang na dus ji srid cig gis snum de bde bar 'ju bar 'gyur ba de'i tshad kyis btang ngo / / yang nyin re yang btang du rung ste/ de nyid kyis na rlung shas che ba la sogs pa yin te/ rlung gi shas che zhing rlung nad bdo ba dang / de bzhin du rtag tu rtsol ba byed pa ste/ rgyun mi 'chad par las su bya ba'i rtsol ba drag pa byed pa dang / de bzhin du me drod che ba dang / skyes bu khong shin tu rtsub pa la nyin re ste zhag re rgyun mi 'chad par gtang bar bya'o/ /

de ltar rim pa 'dis nad la sogs tshul la dpags te/ 'jam rtsi'i snum gsum mam bzhis skyes bu'i lus kyi snum gyur nas rtsa sgo sbyang ba'i phyir zhes pa rtsa snum gyi rgyu ba rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir/ ni ru ha ste bkru sman drag po dang / sbyang zhing zhi bar bya ba dang / rlung shas che bas lus snum med par gyur pa'i lus la snum par bya zhing khong brta bar bya ba'i phyir snum gyi cho ga gtang bar bya'o/ /

skt: atha stehavasteranantaraṃ paccame divase tūḥ vā divasaṃ sādhake raratatithikaraṇamuhūtaina| dame puṇye'hani kicvidāvṛtte saparivṛte madha dinamadhyase bho dhrayukte karūtabalimaṅgare upaḥ māṅgasye svastyayana dike sati pnarūhavāsta ? spayet‌ | tadidyaivāstividhānāviddhiḥ vahābhi taiḥ sahāṭocya tatha puruṣamavekṣaya jñātvā | vaṃ tam‌ ! abhyaktvedi topsuṣṭasarapamabhyaktasveditaṃ ¦ rānmūtram‌ | nātivusukṣitaṃ nātiṣṭhudhākrāntaga nātidoṣabheṣajādīni cādarāt‌ āteyāt‌ praya nādyabasti prakaspayett‌
tib: de nas 'jam rtsi mas gtong ba'i nyi ma gsum mam nyi ma lnga na bya ba bsgrub cing bsngags pa'i tshes grangs dang / byed pa dang / thang cig dang / rgyu skar bzang po dang / nyin dge ba la nyi ma'i phyed cung zad yol zhing 'das pa'i tshe gtor ma dang bkra shis kyi cho ga dag ji lta ba bzhin du byas shing shis pa brjod pa dang / bde legs la sogs pa dge sbyong dang bram zes byas nas/ sman bkru sman drag po mas gtong zhing brtsam par bya ste/ de yang de la mkhas shing mas gtong ba'i cho ga'i sbyor ba la mkhas pa'i sman pa mang po dang lhan cig gros bya ba dang / skyes bu nad pa'i nad kyi dmigs la sogs pa yang shes par byas la/ lus snum gyis bsku bar bya ba dang / de bzhin du dugs bya ba dang / bshang ba dang gci ba bsal zhing dor ba dang / shin tu bkres pas ma yin zhing ltogs pas nyen pa ma yin pa dang / de bzhin du nad dmigs dang sman la sogs pa 'bad cing btsal bas shes shing rtogs par byas nas sman pas mas gtong ba'i cho ga la sbyar zhing brtag par bya'o/ /

rtsa ba bcu pa la sogs pa'i sman srang nyi shu 'og nas mas gtong ba'i cho ga'i skabs nas smos pa bskol ba dang / de bzhin du po son cha'i 'bras bu brgyad lhan cig bskol bar bya ste/ po son cha brgyad la ni srang gcig tsam yod do/ / de ltar na sman srang nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / sman gyi bcu drug 'gyur gyi chu dang sbyangs la de legs par bskol bar bya'o/ / de nas cha lugs dang bskol ba'i sman chu de/ brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / bskol ba de yi bzhi cha yi/ / sman mar rlung la rjes su sbyar/ / mkhris pa bde bar gnas drug cha/ / bad kan shas cher brgyad cha gcig / ces bya ba la/ de ltar bskol ba de las snum gyi mar bzhi cha gcig rlung gi nad la rjes su sbyar zhing gtang bar bya'o/ / mkhris pa'i nad la ni bskol ba de las snga ma'i tshad las drug cha ste/ srang bcu bzhi gtang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du bde bar gnas shing tha mal par 'dug pa la yang drug cha nyid gtang bar bya'o/ / bad kan shas che zhing rgyas pa'i nad la ni de'i brgyad cha ste/ srang bcu gtang bar bya'o/ / yang na kun la sman gyi ni/ / brgyad cha gcig gam/

skt: tatastasmātkāthāt‌ stehacaturīyela yāta viṣaye'tu paścākalpyat‌ | pitte yittavipayara tataḥ kvādhāt‌ prāḍniradiṣṭaparimāṇāt‌ paṣṭhaśaramnahe catudeśapadakhāni kalpayan‌ | tathā khasthe svamthaviṣaye paṣaṣṭharameva kalpayet‌ | kaphe; kaphathipaye vataḥ kvāthādaṣṭāṃśaṃ snedasādhani dyapaṭāni kalyayan‌ 69 ha °-kādhātmakānanirdāt‌ hādarāparamū pa~ tatrayasaṃbhitaṃ snehe kalpayet‌ ! saṃtaḥ 8 panīya ^: ṭayanchoḥ? pacamī
tib: sbyar bar bya'o zhes bya ba 'dir yang sbyar bar bya ste/ kun la zhes bya ba rlung dang mkhris pa dang / de bzhin du bad kan te bde bar gnas pa la sman gyi brgyad cha gcig ste/ bskol ba'i gang brgyad cha gcig tu gyur pa srang bcu thams cad la sbyin par bya'o/ /

yang na thams cad du sman bskol ba'i brgyad cha gcig sbyin pa yin no/ / gzhan du sman gyi phye ma'am/ lde gu'i cha las mas gtong ba'i sman shin tu ska zhing 'byar ba yang ma yin la/ shin tu sla zhing 'dzag ches par yang mi 'gyur ba de ltar sbyar bar bya'o/ /

rlung dang mkhris pa dang / bad kan dang / bde bar gnas pa'i mas gtong ba thams cad la/ bu ram srang gcig gzhug par bya ste smos pa ni/ de las yid ches pa'am/ chung ba yang rung ba'i don no/ / rigs pas sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha sogs/ / lhag ma/

tib: rjes sbyar ba dang kun la zhes bya ba la 'dir yang sbyar bar bya ste/ de la rigs pa ni sbyor ba ste/ bya ba'i thabs yin no/ / de lta bu'i rigs pa dang ldan pas sbrang rtsi dang rgyam tsha'am/ lce myang tsha la sogs pa lhag ma gang yin pa bkru sman drag pa'i yan lag tu gyur pa tshad ma bstan pa de thams cad la sbyar zhing gtang bar bya'o/ / sogs pa'i sgras ni sbrang rtsi dang rgyam tsha las gzhan pa zho ga chu dang / rang skyur gyi rtsab mo dang / 'o ma dang / ba gcin la sogs pa bkru sman drag po mas gtong ba'i sde tshan du gtogs pa gzhan dag kyang bsdu'o/ / de kun snod gcig blugs/

gong du smos pa de thams cad ma lus pa snod gcig tu blugs la/ bum par bskol ba'i rlangs pas bsro zhing tsha bar bya ba dang / de bzhin du gzar bu'am skyabs kun dkrugs shing bskyos par lug dang / ma he la sogs pa'i lgang pa las byas pa'i rkyal bu'i nang du blugs la sman de mas gtong ba'i don du mjug ma nas gtong zhing 'jud par byed pa'i tshe/ shin tu tsha ba ma yin pa dang / shin tu grang pa ma yin pa dang / de bzhin du shin tu rtsub pa ma yin pa dang / de bzhin du ba gcin dang / yungs kar la sogs pa shas che ba shin tu rno ba ma yin pa dang / 'o ma mang po gtong bas shin tu 'jam pa ma yin pa dang / de bzhin du shin tu ska ba ma yin pa dang / shin tu sla ba ma yin pa dang / shin tu mang ba ma yin pa dang / tshad las shin tu nyung ba ma yin pa dang / de bzhin du shin tu tsha med pa'am/ che bar yang mi bya ba dang / de bzhin du kan dzi rang skyur la sogs pa skyur ba med pa'am/ de shas che ba'am/ de dang 'dra ste/

mas gtong ba'i cho ga la mkhas pa'i sman pa gzhan dag gis ni/ mas gtong ba'i cho ga gzhan dag 'chad cing ston te/ til mar la sogs pa'i snum dang / de bzhin du sbrang rtsi dag ni tshad srang gsum gsum du so sor bya ba ste/ snum srang gsum dang de bzhin du sbrang rtsi srang gsum dang / de bzhin du rgyam tsha zho gnyis sbyar ba 'di ni nad med pa ste/ bde bar gnas pa la gtang ba yin no/ / zhes smras so/ / de bzhin du sman srang gnyis dang / ku ba bskol ba'i sman lhag ma srang bcur yongs su sbyar bar bya'o/ / de ltar na spyir srang brgyad mas gtong ba'i tshad yin par 'dod do/ / sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha snum rnams dang / / sman phye khu ba'i rim pa ni/ / mas gtong rkyal par bcug byas te/ / 'di ni sbyor ba'i cho gar bshad/ / ces bya ba la sogs pa'i sman gyi khu ba rim gyis bcos shing sbyang ste/ dang po sbrang rtsi sbyar zhing gzhug par bya'o/ / de nas ni rgyam tsha'o/ / de nas ni snum mo/ / de nas ni sman gyi phye ma'o/ / de nas ni sman gyi khu ba gzhug par bya ste/ gang gi phyir sman drag po mas gtong ba'i sbyor ba 'di ni sbyor ba'i cho ga gcig tu bsres pa yin no zhes drang srong dag gis bshad do/ / gan rkyal bzhag nas btang ma thag /

tib: bkru sman drag po mas gtong ba de phyir 'ong bar gyur ba la bcos shing gso ba'i thabs ni myur zhing rings par mas gtong ba snga ma las gzhan pa snum pa dang rno ba dang / dro ba'i mtshan nyid can dang / de bzhin du thur du 'byin par byed pa'i snum dang / thal sman rnon po dang / ba gcin la sogs pa dang sbyar ba dag kyang gtang bar bya'o/ / yang na de myur du 'khru ba'i phyir sman gyi reng bu myur du gzhug par bya'o/ / de la sman gyi reng bu ni po son cha'i 'bras bu las byas pa'o/ / de bzhin du sngangs shing skrag par bya ba dang / dugs la sogs pa'i rnam pa yang myur du dbyung bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ /

tib: de ltar na ni ru ha ste bkru sman drag po mas gtong ba'i thog mar 'jam rtsi bya la/ de'i 'og tu bkru sman drag po mas gtang bar bya la/ de'i 'og tu 'jam rtsi'i rgyun mi 'chad par ni ru ha gcig pu bsten par mi bya zhing / 'jam rtsi 'ba' zhig rgyun mi 'chad par ha cang drags par mi bya zhing / bsten par mi bya ste/ gang gi phyir 'jam rtsi rgyun du bsten drags pas ni/ nad glongs pas khams 'khrugs par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du me'i drod 'joms pas pho ba'i me drod kyis zas 'ju mi nus par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du ni ru ha bsten drags pas rlung nad skyed par byed do/ / rlung gi nad ldang ba'i 'jigs pa yod do zhes bya ba'i don no/ / de bas na bkru sman drag po mas gtong bar bya ba'i skyes bu la ni/ 'jam rtsi gsum gyi sbyor ba mas gtong bar bya la/ gang 'jam rtsi bya ba de la ni bkru sman drag po gtang bar bya dgos te/ nad glongs pa dang me drod 'joms pa des bsal bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ / de ltar na rigs pa 'di'i rim pas snum gyi mas gtang ba byas pa dang / de'i 'og tu ni ru ha bya la/ de lta bu'i sbyang ba byas nas/ mas gtong ba'i las des nad gzhi gsum gyi nyes pa sel bar 'gyur ro/ / snum gyi tshad ni chung ngu yi/ / tshad dang de ni mnyam byas pa'i/ / snum tshad 'jam rtsi'i tshad du bshad/ / de ni byis rgan lam dang khur/ / bud med rtsol zhen pas du ba dang / / rlung

skt: sa ca mātnābasitiḥ sadā svakāṃ nirana chakha śīranīyo'bhyasanīyau bākhavṛddhādibhiḥ ca śitaḥ sukhadetusvādāsogyaṃ kuyaudathavā bāra dīnāmapi dātuṃ yubhyate | tato'sau saṃlasta doṣaghno vātadāmano vātādhikau pittaraṣeṣmāṇāva hanti vināścayatīti doṣannaḥ | tathāsau niṣpā hāraḥ uṣṇodakopacārī syādiyādimanthaniṃṭa yantraṇayā raṣito'taeva bāḍādīnāṃ pukhastathā bara bāya hitaḥ | tathā sṛṣṭamachaḥ khaṣaṭo malaḥ purīṣārū yena praṇītena sampadyate ityasau khaṣṭamaraḥ || 60
tib: snum las zhun mar 'ba' zhig btung ba'i chung ngu thun gnyis kyis 'ju bar 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi tshad dang mnyam par byas pa'i snum gyi tshad/ 'jam rtsi'i tshad du bshad de/ de ni 'jam rtsi'i chung tshad ces bya ba la tshad de ni byis pa dang rgan po la sogs pas dus rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsten cing goms par bya'o/ / de bsten cing goms par byed pa ni nad med par byed pa dang / bde ba yin pas byis pa la sogs pa la yang gtong du rung bas goms par spyad par bya'o/ / de bzhin du nad 'joms pa ste/ rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan yang 'joms shing sel bar byed do/ / de bzhin du yang 'di ni yang ba med par byed pa dang / kha lag chu dron gyis bkru zhing / / zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gzhung gis sngar bshad pa'i 'dam ga mi dgos pa yin la/ de nyid kyis na byis pa la sogs pa la bde ba'i bdag nyid can yin no/ / de bzhin du stobs skyed par byed pa yin te/ nus pa skyed pa yin no/ / de bzhin du bshang ba bde bar 'byung bar byed pa yin no/ / gang zhig btang bas bshang ba bde blag tu 'byung bar byed pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ / mas gtong bud med ro smad kyi/ / mngal dang mo mtshan nad rnams la/ / bkrus drags gnyis gsum gyis dag par/ / mas gtong gong mas gtong bar bya/ / zhes bya ba la/ / 'dir mas gtong ba'i lus kyi yan lag gi phyogs gcig 'bab pa'i phyogs nas gtang ba ste/ de ni gcin sri ba la sogs pa'i nad gang dag yod pa'i skyes pa dang / bud med dang ma ning gi mtshan nas gtang ba gong ma gtang bar bya'o/ / de dag thams cad kyang lan gnyis sam lan gsum du bkru sman drag po mas gtong bas dag cing skyon bsal ba la/ mas gtong ba gong ma gtang bar bya'o/ / de yi gce'u nad pa yi/ / sor tshad bcu gnyis tshad du bya/ / snum zhing ba lang mjug ma 'dra/ / rtsa ba dbus su gag pa gdags/ / rtse mo yungs kar shong

de'i zhes bya ba ni/ 'das ma thag pa'i mas gtong ba gong ma la snyegs te/ de'i gce'u ni nad pa gang yin pa'i tshad kyis gzhal la/ de yang sor bcu gnyis su bya'o/ / de bzhin du zlum pa dang / ba lang gi mjug ma ltar rtse mo rim gyis phra ba dang / de bzhin du rtsa ba dang / dbus te bar du gag pa gdags par bya ste/ 'dir gag pa gcig ni dbus su bya/ de yang tshad nang du nub pa'i tshad las thal bar gags byed nus pa tsam la/ / gnyis pa rtsa bar gnas par bya ba ni rkyal bu la gdags pa la sogs pa yin no/ / yang de bzhin du de'i rtse mo'i bu ga'i tshad yungs kar shong ba tsam la bya'o/ / 'jam bag ni rtsub bag med pa'o/ / gser la sogs pa las byas pa ni mas gtong ba dag gi tshe rgyu dang mtshungs par bya'o/ / de bzhin du me tog kun da la sogs pa'i rtse mo kha ma phye ba ltar byin gyis phra zhing zlum pa'o/ / gang la me tog dang 'bras bu chags pa'i de'i rtsa ba phra mo ste de la bya'o/ /
mas gtong ba gong ma de'i rkyal bu ni/ ra skyes la sogs pa'i lgang pa 'jam zhing mnyen la yang zhing chung ngu gdags par bya'o/ /

skt: uttaravabastimāha--stimūtrādhāraḥ śarīrāvaya vastatra ye rogā mūtrakaccharaprabhṛtayasteṣu sasu sarveṣa khīpunapuṃsakānāmṛttaravasiṃ cidadhyāt‌ praṇayet‌ nārīṇāṃ punana kaivaṃ bastāveva rogepūttaravarasiḥ vidadhyāt‌ | yacchabdādyāvadyonigbhārāyasteṣu dhikā reṣṛttarabasti vidadhyāt‌
tib: 'jam rtsi gong ma de'i tshad ni snum gtong ba na srang phyed bya ba'am gang rigs par bya ba ste/ nad la sogs pa'i tshad las dpags nas ji ltar 'os pa bya ba ste/ / des na nad kyi tshod las dpags te/

de nas de'i 'og tu legs par khrus byas shing zan ran par zos pa'i skyes bu de'i pho mtshan du dang por thur ma phra mo bcug la/ de'i 'og tu gce'u gzhug par bya'o/ / 'jam rtsi gtong ba'i chogs bya ba ste/ sngar bshad pa'i mas gtong ba'i chogs bya ba'o/ / de bzhin du khri'i stegs pus mo dang dpangs mnyam zhing 'jam pa'i steng du/ drang zhing lus ma yo bar bde bar 'dug pa de bzhin du pho mtshan dga' bas bteg cing ldang bar byas la/ drang zhing ma yo bar byas nas gci ba'i lam gyi sbubs dag par bya ba'i phyir thur ma 'jam po rim gyis dal bar gzhug par bya'i/ / cig car gzhug par mi bya'o/ / de nas thur ma des pho mtshan gyi sbubs dag par byas pa'i rjes la/ pho mtshan dang 'tsham pa'i gce'u 'bras bu'i mthar thug pa'i bar du gtang bar bya la/ de yang lag pa mi 'dar bar mjug mar 'jam rtsi gtong ba dang tshul 'dra bar byas la btsir ba dang / btang ba dang snum gyi rjes la bya ba dag ni/ 'jam rtsi'i rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du bya ba 'di la phan pa yin no/ / de yi rim pa 'di yin te/ / btang nas lus ni gan rkyal gzhag /

skt: anena yathodiṣṭena vidhinottaravastīślīśavaturo vā dadyāt‌ yojayet‌ | anuvāsanena tusyaṃ sarvameva samyagyogahānātiyogādi tathānyadapi yatkiccinmeyāmedhyaṃ tadlyāpadauṣadhaṃ cāsya cintayehaśṣayet‌ 1 jānīyāt‌

skt: khrīṇāmātevakāle untaravarsi viṣa prāyeṇātevadśanāt‌ prabhṛti yāvat‌ dvāda stāvadtukāraḥ | takāṭamadhye tāsāṃ parti yet‌. kuryāt‌ | tatastasmin‌. kāre śnīṇāṃ seha untaravastinā dīyate taṃ yoniragātyāī kuto'pāghraterhetoḥ | yasmāntammin‌ kāṭhe yaṃ sā śuktaṃ nāntaḥ prayacchati | anṛtācapi cā tatsādhyāmaye cāyatatau vikāraprāṭubhāvi sati tāvanāteve kāṭe bartimuttaraṃ vidadhīta | ye| viraśādike yoniviśradāḥ sthānāsatanaṃ tasami tathā yoneḥ sthṛkhe tathā yonicyāpari yo vyāpattasyāmanekavidhāyāṃ yonicyāpadi tthā gade yoniroge yonito nānāprakārasutiḥ | dara kālānuṣaṅgava tīnāṃ khīṇāṃ paravarmate sa asṛgdraḥ||6 de -khīṇayṛttara btikālamāda-salīṇamiti ] ga sayaupadhamiti doṣaḥ | apāvuteritapāt‌ | āāsayani vyādhābadatācapi vidadhīta | srīṇāṃ sagamadūna yannaḥ mbhabhedaṃ cāha-yonivibhrceti | yānivibhraśādiṣu . athāñtra netrasya pramāṇamāha na daśāṃgaṃ sudaramavaśaṃ caturaṃṛṭam‌ | apatyama yājyaṃ syāda dayuṭaṃ mūñaravatmani bhūnaṅacchaṣikāraṇu bālānāṃ vakaramaguṭam‌ 67 sa °~daśāṃgurapramādha debhaṇa tattathā mudraḥ pri rapyarmibhiti sudarapraveśa tadivāpraṃ pramaraśāprbhi sthānam‌ | pavetimanara vedham‌ | puṣpadṛtopamasva khatra na yuvyate | yato mūnrasotaḥpariṇāha̭ṃyattaddhighātavyaṃ pure śiyā śrevaprakāram‌ | yaduktaṃ suninā | puṣpetaraparamāṇa tu pramadānāṃ darśāyukham‌ | mūtrasotaḥparīṇāhamiti | tatra caturaguṃ yāvat‌ pravedyam‌ | caturaṃgukā codhvaikaṇikā kāyau| adhikapraveranivāraṇātha natu mehananetra iva madhyamaviketi | ayamaratho'ra sākṣānanopātto gamyamānalāt‌| ata̱ etatpveśapramāṇamāha 6 caturagurumapalyamāṃ moñya syāditi apyamara isyanena llī garmaprahaṇaprasavādisamatho sūcyate | eve vidhāyāḥ ciyāścaturagaṅ‌ praveśayitavyamiti | mūtravatmeni dyaṃguṃ yoñyam‌| tha chalī suratavyavhāragarbhagrahaṇāyogyā athavā bālā yā aprauḍhā tasyā yonimūtrasathaiva kevara mārstasyā netre gura praveśyam‌ | bhata ūrdhvaṃ tu praveśāttāsāṃ māṃsa kṣatiḥ syāt‌ ) keṣu rogeṣu 1 mūtkṛcchvikāreṣu | bāṅānāṃ ṭhu ghrīṇāmekameguṅ‌ praveśyam‌
tib: bud med zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i dus su 'jam rtsi gong ma gtang bar bya'o/ / zla mtshan dang po 'dzag pa nas zhag bcu gnyis kyi bar du bud med kyi zla mtshan gyi dus yin te/ dus de'i bar du de'i mas gtong ba'i las bya'o/ / ci'i phyir zhe na/ dus de'i tshe mas gtong ba gong ma nas snum gtang ba gang yin pa de mngal bye bas der chags par 'gyur zhing len par 'gyur te/ de'i tshe bud med gyi mngal gyi kha bye nas gnas pa yin no/ / de ji ltar de'i tshe mngal chags par 'gyur ba de bzhin du mas gtong ba yang de'i tshe chags kyi gzhan gyi tshe ni ma yin no/ / de yang gzhung las dper na nyi ma nub gyur na dus ma yin te/ zla mtshan rgyu ba'i dus ma yin yang mas gtong ba gong ma gtang bar bya'o/ / mo mtshan nyams par gyur pa la sogs pa la yang gtang bar bya ste/ mo mtshan nyams pa las ni gnas de las 'chugs shing zhig pa'o/ / de bzhin du mngal na ba ste/ mngal gyi nad rnams mang po 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du mo mtshan gzer zhing zug pa dang / de bzhin du mngal nas rtag tu khrag 'dzag cing / kha dog sna tshogs pa'i khrag dus ring por 'dzag pa'i nad ni/ mngal khrag rtag tu 'byung ba ste/

skt: sarvāsāṃ klīṇāṃ gbha̭prahaṇayogyānāṃ bāchānāṃ ca netraṃ sāmānyena daśāṅgaṃ kāmityadhyāhāyam‌ | yathā sudra: praviśyati bahatyasubharasyagrasrotasi yasya tanyudrabhavedyaṃ tacca netra caturaḍgukham‌ | apatyamāge garbhaniṣkamaṇavarmani prayojyaṃ syāt‌ | mūtrakhalotasyato nādhikaḥ | tathā vyaṅgaṃ mūtra tmani mūtramārge prayojyaṃ syāt‌ ityatrāpyamuvasainīyama. | ka prayobhyam‌ } mūtrahṛccharavyādhipva" balānāṃ sīṇāmatisūkṣmāṇām‌ | tato netrā daśāṅguraṃ mūtaracacharavikāreṣu mūravatmeni prayojyaṃ syāt‌ | tatra srotasi taspraveśayet‌
tib: mngal chags su rung ba'i bud med thams cad dang / chags su mi rung ba'i bu mo gzhon nu'i mas gtong ba'i gong ma'i gce'u tshad ni spyir sor bcu bya'o/ / gcin 'gags pa'i nad yod pa'i bu mo shin tu chung ngu rnams la gcin 'bab pa'i lam du sor gcig gtang bar bya zhing gzhug par bya'o/ / 'bring tshad srang ni gcig pa ste/ / bu mo rnams la srang phyed nyid/ / ces bya ba la/ bud med rnams kyi mas gtong gong ma'i 'bring tshad ni srang phyed bya'o/ / bu mo rnams te bu mo chung ngu rnams kyi 'bring tshad ni srang phyed nyid yin no/ / mal du gan rkyal 'dug nas ni/ / brla ni legs

skt: tasyāḥ siyā uttānāyā uttānaṃ dalā sthitāyāstathā samyaṅ‌ kuravā sakthinī saddhocyādhastasyā ahorātreṇa trecaturāvṛttaḥ untaravastīn‌ yojayet‌ dadhāt‌ | evai ditīyavṛtīyayoḥ kameṇa yathāha prayadameva mātrāṃ vivadhaiyet‌
tib: bud med de mal du gan rkyal du byas te/ 'dug cing gnas pa dang / de bzhin du brla legs par bskum pa dang / pus mo legs par brtod de/ de la nyin zhag gcig la lan gsum mam lan bzhi'i bar du mas gtong ba gong ma bya'o/ / de bzhin du zhag gnyis sam gsum gyi rim gyis ci rigs par nyin re zhing snum chad bskyed par bya'o/ / de nas zhag gsum ngal bso zhing 'phro bcad la/ slar yang cho ga 'di nyid kyis zhag gsum gtong bar bya'o/ / skyug sman byas zla phyed bkru sman/ / de nas zla phyed nas bkru drag /

sngon du skyug sman byas nas zla ba phyed 'das pa dang / bkru sman bya'o/ / de nas bkru sman btang ba'i zla ba phyed nas bkru sman drag po gtang bar bya'o/ / bkru sman drag po mas gtong ba bya ste/ 'phral de ring por mi thogs par 'jam rtsi btang ngo / / bkru sman btang nas zhag bdun lon nas 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya ste/ de ltar na bkru sman btang ba dang / ni ru ha gtong ba'i bar du 'jim rtsi gtang ngo / /

dper na le brgan rtsi la sogs pa dang bsres pa'i chu la sogs der ras tshos len par byed cing chu 'dor bar byed pa de bzhin du lus snum la sogs pas bangs par byas pa las mas gtong bas na nad kyi gnod pa rnams sel zhing 'byin par byed cing lus gnod pa med pa la sbyor bar byed do/ / lus kyi yan lag nang grol dag tu song nad dang / / gnad dang lus stod yan lag kun khyab nas/ / gang zhig

skt: tatakṣayahaṃ viścamya punaranena vidhānena bhyaṃ ddayat‌

rākhāraktādayo dhātavastavakparthantāḥ | taḥ bāhādayaḥ darīrāvayavāḥ | urva ca savayaḥ uvaisavauīvayavāḥ | rdhvasarvābayavāśyāṅgāti udhyaisarvāvayavāṅgāni marmāṇi codhva̭sbāvayavāṅkha niteṣu jātā mmodhvasavāvayavāṅgajā ye roga santi teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ rogāṇāṃ samusattau vāyospa vajayisavā ` ditīyo nāntho'pi teṣāṃ heturari nānyatkāraṇaṃ vidyate ilatheḥ
tib: lus kyi yan lag ni khrag la sogs pa'i lus zungs rnams nas/ pags pa'i bar dang / de bzhin du lag ngar la sogs pa'i lus kyi yan lag nang grol ma gtogs pa kun la bya'o/ / de bzhin du nang grol gyi phyogs thams cad du khyab cing song ba'i nad dag dang / de bzhin du gnad dang lus kyi stod na gnas pa'i nad pa'i yan lag dngos su na lus kyi stod yan lag gi gnad thams cad la khyab cing gnas pa'i nad gang dag yod pa'i nad de rnams skye ba'i rgyu'am/ 'byung ba'i rlung ma gtogs pa gzhan gang yod pa ma yin te/ nad kyi rgyu gnyis pa med do zhes bya ba'i don no/ / ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i phyir smras pa ni/

skt: karuta patattadathemāha-- vid‌ ca epmā ca pittaṃ ca tānyādiryeṣāṃ te viḍādayaḥ | rārīragatā bhāgā rasādayaḥ | te eva śarīramadinīkarṇānmalakhāḥ teṣāṃ mūtaradūṣikāprabhṛtīnāsuccayāḥ ye sacvayāḥ teṣāṃ vikṣepakaraḥ sahārakasdha | vividhaṃ kṣepaṇa vikṣepaḥ presaṇama | rāśisthitānāmitagcetaśca karaṇaṃ sahāraḥ | itaścetaśca gatānāmikatra rāīkaraṇaṃ karotīti vikṣepasaṃhāskaraḥ sa yaramādrāyustasya teṣāṃ vikṣepe vāyuriti drasyāvyathaṃ kupitasya damāya rāntaye vastedhinā bheṣajamauṣadhamaparaṃ na kiciṣaṭhidyate | snedasvedādikamanyaddhiyamānamasasartha syāt‌54| hai0-sarveṣāṃ rogāṇāṃ vāyureva kāraṇaṃ yasāpittaśachepmaṇorāpi itaramalbatsa eva kṣobhakaḥ

yata eveguṇo castistasmāntena prakāreṇa bastiśikitsāyai sādhana siti pradiṣṭamidyaktam‌ | karasnā cikitsā'pi ca vabhvirephe | yattaḥ sa pittakaṇaphamūtrādikaṃ savasava vikare bhatamaduddharati tasmāttamadhikrya dṛrastā'pi thikinasā astinā sādhyata ivyarthaḥ | ateeḍapara ānāyā bhyū dvid‌ḥ charasnā sakalāpi cikṣitasaḥ baritanā sābhyata ivythaḥ| tathā vasitiśikatitsārdhamiti kecit‌! ratipannāḥ nijāścāgantavaśceti vikārā nijāgagantuvikāsāstānkayetīti tacchīṭaṃ raktaṃ | nijāgantuvikārakāriraktaṃ tasyaupadhatvan‌ bhayama tasya bhāvau nijāgantuvikārakāriramaṃṣadhatva̭na śiṇajyadhaśca cikissādhai chasstā vā cikitsā | (430 ) aṣṭāṅgahadaye | || apidābdaḥ samuccayārthaḥ) na kevakaṃ vastithikitsārdhai- | vacanāditareṣyapi saṃmarahai chu nāsayā praṇīyama| mathavā sakalāpi cikitseti bhadram‌
tib: bshang ba dang bad kan mkhris pa la sogs pa gang yin pa de ni/ bshang ba dang bad kan mkhris pa la sogs te/ sogs pa smos pa ni/ lus kyi tshad gtogs pa dngas ma la sogs pa'o/ / de dag nyid kyis ni lus dri ma can du byed pas na nad do/ / de rnams la sogs pa ni bshang ba la sogs pa 'phel bar byed pa yin te/ gang gi phyir 'thor zhing rgyas par byed la/ nad rnying pa'i tshigs su gnas pa phan tshun 'thor zhing 'byed par byed pa dang / sdud par yang byed de/ phan tshun 'thor te gnas pa rnams phung po gcig tu byed pa'o/ / de lta bu'i rlung de rab tu 'phel zhing rnam par 'khrugs pa ldang bar gyur pa zhi zhing bsal bar bya ba'i phyir dpyad bya na/ 'jam rtsi la sogs pa mas gtong ba ma gtogs pa'i sman gzhan dag yod pa ma yin no/ / snum dang dugs gzhan dag yod na yang nus pa chung ba yin no/ / gang gi phyir 'jam rtsi yon tan de lta bu yod pa de bas na/ rgyu de'i phyir gso ba ma lus shing mtha' dag las mas gtong ba ni gso ba'am nad bcos pa'i thabs kyi phyed yin no zhes bshad de/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ bshang ba dang / gci ba dang / bad kan dang / mkhris pa dag gtar ga bya ba'i nad rnams kyang rtsa ba nas 'byin to/ / de bas na de las brtsams te/ nad ma lus pa dang rlung gi nad rnams thams cad mas gtong bas gso zhing bcos par bya'o/ / zhes bya ba'i don no/ / de'i phyir tshe'i rig byed shes pa'i srog 'tsho ba'i slob dpon gzhan dag ni gso ba'i thabs ma lus pa mas gtong bar 'dug pas khas 'che'o/ / la la dag ni mas gtong ba'i gso ba'i phyir yin no/ / zhes zer ro/ / de bzhin du gtar gas khrag dbyung ba yang / nad rnying pa dang glo bur bas btab pa'i nad rnams la gtar gas dbyung ba'i gso ba'i phyed dam/ / gso ba ma lus par gyur pa yin no/ / zhes zer ro/ / de bzhin du rnying gzhi gnas pa dang / glo bur ba gsar du byung ba dag la ni nad rnying glo bur ba zhes bya ste/ de dag skyed par byed pa yin pas na skyed byed de/ khrag la bya la de rab tu zhi zhing bsal ba la ni gtar gas khrag dbyung zhing khrag 'don pa nyid sman du 'gyur ba yin pas na khrag las gyur pa'i nad kyi gso ba'i phyed dam/ gso ba rangs pa ni gtar gas khrag dbyung ba yin no/ / zhes bya ba ni sdud par byed pa ste/ mas gtong ba 'ba' zhig gso ba yin par ma zad de/ gtar gas khrag dbyung ba yang gso ba phyed dam/ sna nas btang ba'i sman brta bar bya ba gang yin pa ni/ rlung las byung ba'i mgo bo'i gzer nad rnams dang / de bzhin du nyi ma phyed kyi bar du na ba dang / skad 'gags shing nyams pa dang / de bzhin du kha dang sna skam pa dang / tshig mi thon zhing skad brda sprod mi nus pa dang / mig dbye bar dka' ba'i mig nad dang / de bzhin du rlung gi nad dpung pa bskyod par dka' ba dag la btang zhing sbyar bar bya'o/ /

skt: vṛhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ vātaje śare tathā sūyava | vikāraṅamidirarogāśṣaspanda nanama tathā svarakṣaye tathā nāsāyāmāsye ca roṣe vāk‌- śa saṅge vākmavṛttau karaccharabodhe cakṣuroge'pabāhake vāta- | kāriṇi ca caraṇaḥ | sa̱ ṭi nāsādhāmatakanā tada vyādhau yojyam‌
tib: sna nas gtang ba zhi bar byed pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'og nas rgyud phyi ma las bshad pa'i mig gi nad sngon por gyur pa la sogs pa'i nad la yang gtang bar bya'o/ /

sna nas gtang bar bshad pa'i sman dang po ni rang gi sbyor ba ji lta ba gang dang 'phrod cing 'tsham pa'i snum rnon po yungs mar la sogs pa dang ci rigs par bskol zhing mgo bo'i bkru sman rnams dang ci rigs par bskol ba dang / de bzhin du sman phye dang sman khu la sogs pa mgo bo'i bkru sman las 'brel pa las ci rigs par sla ba dang zhib pa dang / lde gur bsres shing sbyar ba dang / de bzhin du shing mngar dang rgyam tshwa dang / chang rnying la sogs pa dang sbyar te/

lde gu dang sman bskol ba'i khu ba la sogs pa sbyar ba'i sman ras bal gyi ye'u la sogs pas gtong ba de ni btsir ba zhes bya'o/ / gzhan dag na re lde gur byas pa'i sman btsos pa las khu ba btsir te/ 'dzag par byas pa las bya'o/ / zhes zer ro/ / btsir ba de sman rnon po'i lde gu bskol ba la sogs pas btang ba ni spyi bo'i bkru sman zhes bya'o/ / phye ma bud pa'i bkru sman te/ / sbu gu sor drug kha gnyis pa/ / nang na sman dang bcas pa dag / kha yi dbugs kyis bus te gtang / / des ni mgo nad mang po yang / / phye ma yin bas 'byin par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ 'khru bar 'gyur ba'i sman las sbyar ba'i phye ma ni bud par bya ba yin pas na bud pa'i bkru sman zhes bya ste/ phye ma de kha'i rlung gis bus la sna nas gtang bar bya'o/ / gang gis btang zhe na/ sbu gu sor drug yod pa kha gnyis yod pa dang / de bzhin du nang na sman dang bcas shing sman phye ma blugs pa de kha'i dbugs kyis bus te gtang ngo / / bud pa'i bkru sman des ni mgo bo'i bad kan las byung ba mang po yang phyi nas 'byin cing / nang nas phyir 'don par byed do/ / mdzub mo'i tshigs ni gnyis pa'i bar/ / smyugs pa phyir phyung gyur pa las/ / thigs pa bcu 'am brgyad dam drug / ji srid 'dzag par gyur pa dag /

mdzub mo ni mthe bong la nye ba'i sor mo ste/ de'i tshigs gnyis kyi bar du/ dang po smyugs shing spyings la phyir phyung ste/ bteg par gyur pa las thigs pa'i tshad ji tsam zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ba de la thigs pa zhes bya la/ thigs pa de las snum gyi tshad che chung du bya ba ni thigs pa bcu ni che tshad yin la/ thigs pa brgyad ni 'bring tshad la/ thigs pa drug ni chung tshad do/ / tshad 'di dag nyid las che dang 'bring dang chung ngu ni rim gyis thigs pa gnyis kyis chung zhing phra ba'i lde gu la sogs pa'i sman gyi khu ba snar blugs pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /
