skt: sa dhūma; pittaraktātiviriktādipu na dharaya; | pintaratābhyāmātiḥ pīḍā yasya | visiktaḥ karatavirvanaḥ | uvānira ūdhvaivātogī sehiṇī gaṅaregaḥ | massyādīnyaditāni yena | tathā śirasyabhihate tathā pāṇḍuroge tathā niśi satrī jāgarite sati dhūmo na yojyaḥ
tib: dud pa de ni mkhris pa dang khrag gi nad kyis nyen pa dang / bkru sman btang ba la sogs pa la gtang bar mi bya'o/ / stod kyi rlung nad ni ro stod kyi rlung nad do/ / lkog nad ni lkog ma 'gags pa la sogs pa'o/ / nya dang chang 'thungs pa la sogs pa mtshan mo gnyid kyis ma log pa la du ba'i sman gtang bar mi bya'o/ /

skt: tanra̱raktapintādipu samupajāteṣu nidhiḥ kapāyanasyamukhaṭhepā śane paspikaṃ diko ditaḥ \) 5||
tib: dud pa gsum po dus ma yin par brngubs pa dang / bkag pa'i gnas la brngubs pa dang / sbyor ba nongs pas brngubs pa dang / / cher brngubs shing lhag par brngubs pa ni/ khrag dang mkhris pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du 'on ba ste rna ba'i dbang po la gnod par 'gyur ba dang / mig long zhing mthong ba nyams pa dang / skom pa dang / de bzhin du brgyal zhing 'bog pa dang / rmongs shing myos par byed do/ / khrag dang mkhris pa 'phel ba la sogs pa der ni bsil ba'i cho ga ste/ sman kha nas btang ba dang / mig bsku ba dang / mig sman dang / chus gtor ba dang / zas dang skom pa'i cho ga thams cad bsil bar byas pas phan no/ / bkres sbrid glal dang bshang gci bsal/ / bud med bsten dang gtar ga btab/ / dgod dang so shing bcas pa yi/ / mthar ni dud pa 'jam po gtang / / zhes bya ba la sogs pa brgyad kyi mthar/ dud pa 'jam po rngub cing gtang bar bya'o/ / dus 'di dag nas mtshan zas zos/ / sna sman rjes la bar ma brngub/ / ces bya ba la/ dus brgyad po 'di dag nyid kyi tshe dang mtshan mo'i mtha' dang zas zos pa'i mtha' dang / sna sman btang ba'i rjes la dud pa bar ma brngub tu rung ste/ dud pa 'jam po gtang ba'i dus brgyad dang mtshan mo'i mtha' la sogs par du ba brngub par bya'o/ /

skt: śṣutādīnāmante mūḍha snigdhaṃ dhūmaṃ pivet‌ | antaśabdaḥ prayekamabhisambadhyate | eṣu kaceṣu prāgukteṣu ścutādiṣu śallakarmāvasāneṣu madudhūkhrapā. nanidiṣaṭeu madhyamaṃ dhūmaṃ pivat‌ | tathāṃ niranta jaāhārānte nāvanānte ca madhyabha dhūmaṃ pivet‌ | nidrā dikānāṃ pañcānāmante cirecana̭ṃ tīkṣṇaṃ dhūme pivet‌ || & || de°~-kigdhadhūmasyāau kālānāha-śutajubhiteti | madhyadharūmasyaikādadākālānāha-kāṅeṣvitti | tīkṣṇadhūmasya ` paścakālanāda-nidrīta
tib: gnyid log pa la sogs pa'i rjes la sman rnon pos mgo bo bkrus pa'i dud pa brngub par bya'o/ /

du ba brngub ba'i gce'u ni/ mas gtong ba'i gce'u'i rgyu dang 'dra bar bya la/ de bzhin du sbubs gsum po ste/ nang gi khong sbubs dang kha gsum par bya ba dang / drang zhing ya yo med par bya ba dang / de bzhin du rtsa ba'i sbom mthe bo shong ba tsam bya ba dang / rtse mo'i bu ga rgya shug gi 'bras bu shong bar bya'o/ /

rnon po la sogs pa'i du ba gsum la/ de'i gce'u'i tshad ni rim pa bzhin/ du ba rnon po gtong ba la rngub par byed pa'i nad pa'i sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi bya'o/ / bar ma la sogs sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ / 'jam po la ni rim bzhin bya/ de ltar gce'u ring pos ni thag ring po nas 'jug pa'i gce'u'i sbubs nas/ phra mo rim gyis gzhug pas khyab cing bde bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: nāsayā pīte dhūmaṃ tathā sukhena pīta yamapi sa̱khenaivodramet‌, na nāsayā daṇḍi tabhayāt‌
tib: dud pa gtong ba'i tshe drang por 'dug cing / ma yo bar gnas par bya ba dang / de bzhin du de la sems pa ste/ dud pa brngub pa la sogs pa la ma yengs pa dang / de bzhin du kha gdangs shing mchu dang so phye nas du ba lan gsum brngub cing btang la/ sna khung ya gcig bkag nas sna khung gcig nas dud pa brngub pa'o/ / de bzhin du sna khung gnyis re re nas bkag cing lan gsum brngub par bya'o/ / mgo dang snar gtogs nad bskyod pa/ / dang por sna nas brngub par bya/ / bskyod pa'i don du kha nas brngub/ / gre bar gtogs pa de las bzlog / ces bya ba la/ mgo dang snar gtogs pa'i nad bskyod cing bsdus la/ rang nyid bskyod pa'i nad la ni/ dang por te thog mar sna nas brngubs la/ phyis kha nas brngub par bya'o/ / gre ba'i nad la ni de las bzlog pa'i tshul gyis brngub par bya ste/ gre ba'i nad bskyod cing glongs pa la ni dang por kha nas dud pa brngubs la/ phyis sna nas brngub par bya'o/ / gre ba'i nad ma bskyod cing ma bsdus pa ni/ de bskyod par bya ba'i phyir dang po sna nas dud pa brngubs la/ phyis kha nas brngub par bya'o/ / du ba kha nyid nas slon gyi/ / snar slon mig la gnod par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ sna nas brngub pa'i dud pa dang / kha nas brngub pa'i dud pa ni gnyi ga yang kha nyid nas slon phyir gdon par bya'i mig la 'jigs pa yod pa'i phyir sna

skt: tarīn‌ vārān‌ chatva trimikhibhirakṣepama sampadyate iti
tib: du ba brngub pa ni lan gsum gsum brngub pa dang / 'byin pa'i tshul gyis brngub par bya'o/ /

skt: snigdha dhūmamahaḥ sakalasya divasasya ' svoktaviṣaye sakredekavāraṃ pibet‌ | tathā madhyaṃ sakarasya divasasya tathā svoktaviṣaye di vārau pivet‌ | tathā tīkṣṇai dhūme yathāsve viṣaye'haḥ sakarasya trīn‌. vārān‌ caturo vārān‌ pibet‌
tib: du ba 'jam po ni nyi ma rangs pa la rang gi gtang bar bya ba'i nad rnams la lan cig gtang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du sbyor ba'i dud ba rnon po ni nyin gcig la rang gi gtang bar bya ba'i nad rnams la lan gsum mam bzhi gtang bar bya'o/ / der sman gu gul a ka ru/ / gla sgrang rdo dreg s+tho ne ya/ / spang spos u shir ba la ka / shing tsha ko na ti shing mngar dang / / bil rkang e la ba lu ka / pog dkar shi ri pe sta ka /

de la sman gyi du ba gsum po de dag gi nang nas du ba 'jam po'i sman 'phrod ni/ gu gul nas mar gyi bar yin no/ / rdo dreg ni shel la yang ste/ pha bong gi drag pa'o/ / yang na brag zhun la bya'o/ / s+tho ne ya ni te la pa to ka'o/ / spang spos ni na la ka'o/ / kon ti ni ta re nu ka'o/ / bil ba'i rkang ni bil ba'i nang ngo / / e la ba lu ka ni hi ri ba lu ka'o/ / shi ri be+e tsusta ka ni shi ri be+e sta ka ste/ thang shing gi thang chu'o/ / pog dkar po ni sardza ra sa'o/ / bya ma ka ni da ba d+hag d+ha'o/ / gla ba ni man bya ma'o/ / pog nag po ni sa la ki'o/ / ma sha ni mon sran gre'u'o/ / snum dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu ni star ga'i 'bras bu la sogs pa'o/ / de bzhin du snying po ni shing sA la dang / a ka ru dang / thang shing dang / shing sha pa la sogs pa'i snying po'i khu ba'i snum mo/ / yang de bzhin du tshil dang rkang dang zhag dang mar dang sbyar ba las dud pa'i sman bya'o/ /

skt: kasane dhūṣane śaṅakīrāścādīni dravyāṇi | sākī surabhī, kamaṭasutpala̭ṃranakotpalam‌ | nyama dhādīnāṃ paccānāṃ kṣāṇaṃ svak‌ | sitā śakā | yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī | savaṇe nāgakesaram‌ | pañcaka hamapadyakam‌ | skatayaṣṭikā malaṣṭhā | kuṣaṭhatagaravjitā gandhāḥ na cidante kuṣṭhatagasa yeṣāṃ gandhānā tajakuṣṭhatagarāstadrahitāḥ sarve gandhāḥ
tib: zhi bar byed pa'i du ba'i sman ni pog nag po dang / rgya skyegs la sogs pa la bya ste/ n+ya gro d+ha la sogs pa shing lnga'i shun lpags las sbyar ro/ / klu shing gi shun lpags ni nA ga ge sar gyi shing gi shun pa'o/ / shug pa ni he ma pad+ma kha'o/ / btsod ni man dzi ta'o/ / dri'i rdzas rnams las rgya spos dang / ru rta bskol ba ma gtogs par byas pa'i dri'i rdzas thams cad do/ /

skt: tīṣṣṇe dhūme dravyāṇi uyānipmanīdrabhataḥḥ 'yotipmatī kaḍagunikā parāpanādarapayā naḥ nidā piṇḍaharidrā | ddāmare paccasṛl ¦ 5 hvā manaḥśiṭā | alaṃ daritādaṭama | :na phaṭtrayaṃ triphalā | sarvāṇi gandhadravyāni mayā kuṣṭhādīne | tathā gaṇe madhavirecaneā vararāpāsāḥ' vyoṣādigaṇaḥ saṃmrahoktaḥ
tib: du ba'i sman rnon po la/ dzo ti la sogs pa'i sman rnams yin te/ dzo ti sma ti ni grang gu ni ka'o/ / rtsa ba bcu ni rtsa ba lnga pa che chung gnyis so/ / dri'i sman ro rno ba ni ru rta la sogs pa'i dri rno ba'i rdzas so/ / mgo bo'i bkru sman gyi sde ni u shi ra dang / a pa marga dang / tsha ba gsum la sogs pa'i sman sngar sman gyi sde tshan du bshad pa'o/ /

skt: drapīkāṃ damamaṭaṃ jale'dāgātra mthitaṃ kratva dvādāśa dradadādguṭadīghā piṣaṭabhūmāpadhaḥ pūvektiḥ pvakratvaḥ akṣamātreṇa kalkena piṣṭaṃ chāyā rupkāṃ charasvā praṭepayat‌ | bātiraṅgukasbharalā yavamadhyā bhavet‌ | yathā yavamadhyā yavākāramanyā yathā syāt‌ | pvaṃmūtāṃ pātu pānāya prayojayan‌.
tib: sman de dag sbyar ba ni/ de dag nyid zhag gcig chur bcug ste sbangs la/ du ba'i sman rnams chu thags su legs par btags la 'dam bu la sogs pa'i thur ma sor bcu gnyis pa la zho gnyis gnyis tsam gyi lde gus lan lnga'i bar du byug par bya ste/ de yang grib ma la skam zhing lan lnga'i bar du byugs la/ gdar bu de sbom mthe bo tsam du gyur gyi bar du bsnan cing /
gdar bu de ltar grib ma la bskams pa ste khong stong med par byas la/ snum gang ji ltar 'phrod pa mar la sogs pas ji lta ba bzhin du bskus la/ dud pa brngub pa'i phyir mes bsregs la/

skt: darāvayoḥ sampuṭa saṃśchepeṇāvanaddhaṃ rāsāvahaya tabhya chidraṃ rāvasampuranacchidraṃ tasmina chidre nāḍīṃ nyasya daśādgukhāmāṅguṭāṃ cā veṇvādimayīṃ vaktreṇa sukhena kāsavān‌ nase dhūmamāpivet‌ | tena kāsaghraṃ cṛṇaṃ kaḍguṇikādyāne dhṛmadravyāṇi naiṣāṃ cūṇa prasthirāṅgāsapūrṇaṃ sukhasthite darāve prakṣipyānyana tu pravarṛttacchidreṇa dāraveṇa pidhāya ca urākaṣi netrasukhenaiva dhūmaṃ pivet‌ | udaraparāpraṃ te ca yukheyaicoṣramet‌ | prānte ca dhūme puna; kṣipet‌ piva | dopaścaddheśrāṅgaṭāghavāca
tib: kham phor sbyar ma ni/ kham phor gnyis kha sbyar ba ste/ de la bu ga der 'od ma la sogs pa'i gce'u sor brgyad pa'am/ sor bcu pa bcug la lud pa can gyi skyes bus brngub par bya'o/ / 'di skad ston te/ lud pa 'joms par byed pa'i sman gyi phye ma'am/ ri lu me mdag du ba med pa rgyun ring ba 'bar bzhin pa lta bur kham phor legs par bzhag pa bkang la/ kham phor gnyis pa zhabs su bu ga zlum po btod pas bkab la/ der gce'u btsugs te/ kha nyid du du ba brngub par bya la/ de brang du phyin pa dang / kha nas slar bton cing slon par bya'o/ / du ba zhi na yang / sman bcug cing brdungs la/ nad de byang ba la lus yang bar 'gyur gyi bar du gtang ngo / /

skyes bu dud pa brngub pa'i cho ga la brten par byed pa la/ lud pa dang dbugs mi bde ba la sogs pa'i nad rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / rnag ni sna nas 'dzag pa'o/ / dri mi zhim pa ni kha nas so/ / skya ba ni gdong skya zhing khye ma chags pa'o/ / skra'i skyon ni spyi ther dang / mdog 'gyur ba la sogs pa'o/ / 'dzag pa ni gsum char dang sbyar bar bya ste/ rna ba nas 'dzag pa dang / / mig nas 'dzag pa dang / kha nas 'dzag pa'o/ / snyom pa ni gnyid kyis myos pa ltar yul 'dzin mi nus pa'o/ / gzhan dag ni grags par zad do/ / nad de dag 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba'o/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/
/ / de nas sman gyi khu bas mkhur ba dgang ba la sogs pa'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /

steṣaiḥ kvathitaiḥ yo'ya;
tib: 'di brtsams pa'i dgos pa ni sna nas btang ba'i rjes la/ thog mar dud pa brngub par bya la/ de'i 'og tu chu dron gyis mkhur ba bkang bar bya'o zhes bshad pa yin pas na/ de gnyis kyi 'og tu 'di brtsams pa yin no/ / sman gyi khu bas mkhur ba bkang ba ni kha bkang ba ste/ de la sogs pa gang yin pa ni/ mkhur ba bkang ba la sogs pa zhes sman mur ba dang / gdong bkru ba dang / spyi bor snum gyis byug pa dang / rna ba bkang ba bsdu'o/ / de rnams kyi cho ga ni 'di ltar bya'o zhes bya ba'i tshul te/ de la le'u bshad par bya'o zhes pa'o/ / mkhur bkang rnam pa bzhi yin te/ / snum dang zhi byed sbyong rma 'tsho ba/ / ces bya ba la/ sman gyi khu bas mkhur ba bkang ba ni rnam pa bzhi yin te/ snum zhing 'jam pa dang / zhi bar byed pa dang / sbyong zhing 'khru bar byed pa dang / rma 'tshob par byed pa'o/ / de dag gi ming ni rnam grangs gzhan du na 'joms par byed pa dang / rtse 'jil bar byed pa dang / dag cing gsal bar byed pa dang / 'byor par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /

skt: saṃśamano gaṇḍuṣastittakapaṣāyamadhurauṣadhai krāthate; kaskitaivā yojyaḥ
tib: mkhur ba bkang ba bzhin nang nas dang po'i mkhur ba bkang ba gsum ni rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan gyi nad la rim bzhin du gtang bar bya ste/ snum gyi sman gyi khu bas mkhur ba bkang ba ni/ rlung la gtang bar bya'o/ / zhi bar byed pa'i sman gyi khu ba ni mkhris pa la gtang bar bya'o/ / sbyong bar byed pa'i sman gyi khu ba ni bad kan la gtang bar bya'o/ / tha ma'i sman khus kha bkang la/ rma 'tsho ba zhes bya ba'i rma la phan pa yin te/

skt: dodhano gaṇduṣasittakaṭumchakhvaṇeoṣṇerauṣadhaiḥ kaskitaiḥ kvāthīktaṣā yodhyaḥ
ropaṇo gaṇḍūṣaḥ kaṣāyatiktairaṣadheḥ kalkitaipa0-tanna teṣu catudhu gaṇḍūṣaṃṣu madhyāt‌ aya bau yobhyaḥ | 7 ādā gaṇḍaṣāḥ vātapittakaphāmayeṣu karameṇa yojyāḥ
tib: 'dir mkhur ba bkang ba ni/ sman mngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / lan tsha dang / tsha ba rnams snum dang bskol zhing btsos pa'o/ / zhi bar byed pa'i mkhur ba bkang ba ni sman kha ba dang / bska ba dang / mngar ba bskol ba'i khu ba'am lde gu gtang bar bya'o/ / sbyong ba'i mkhur ba bkang ba ni/ sman kha ba dang / tsha ba dang skyur ba bskol ba'am/ lde gu gtang bar bya'o/ / rma 'tsho ba'i mkhur ba bkang ba ni sman kha ba dang bska ba rnams bskol ba'am/

skt: tilakaskena mibhritamudakaṃ tiṭakaskodakam‌ | tacca yathāsaṃ sukhopṇamathavā śītaṃ himaṃ dantaharbhe dantacāṅe dantaroge vakṣyamāṇe hitam‌ | tathā mukharoge vaktrasege vātike bāto dbe hitam‌
tib: 'di dag ni sman khus mkhur ba bkang ba spyi'i cho ga yin te/ de las kyang snum zhes bya ba sha khu dang til gyi lde gu'i chu dang 'o ma ni snum gyis mkhur ba bkang ba yin no/ / sbrang rtsi dang chu dang 'o ma dang mar ni zhi bar byed pa'i mkhur ba bkang ba yin no/ / tshwa dang chang dang 'bru'i khu ba skyur po ni/ sbyong ba'i mkhur ba bkang ba yin no/ / sbrang rtsi'i chu dang 'o ma ni rma 'tshob ba'i mkhur ba bkang ba yin no/ / ji lta ji lta ba zhes bya ba ni/ sngar bshad pa'i sman gyi lde gu dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na bskol ba'am/ ci tsam bzod pa rnam par sbyar bar bya ste/

til gyi lde gu dang bsres pa'i chu ni til gyi lde gu'i chu ste/ de dro 'jam tsam mam bsil bas mkhur ba bkang ba ni/ so brtse ba dang so 'gul ba'i nad 'og nas bshad pa dag dang / kha'i nad rlung las gyur cing rlung shas che ba la phan pa yin no/ / rtag tu mkhur ba bkang ste 'jog /

skt: sañparadoktiḥ | nilayaṃ sarvadā svasthaḥ gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇe gaṇḍūṣāthaṃ hitaṃ tela māṃsara 'thavā hitaḥ
tib: 'di ni bsdus pa las byung ba yin te/ rtag tu zhes bya ba dus thams cad du nad med par gnas pa'i skabs su mkhur ba bkang ste 'jog pa'i sman du til mar sha khu bsngags shing phan pa yin no/ /

skt: pāke mukhasyoṣadāhānvite tābhyāṃ yukte kṣate yukhatraṇe āgantusabhbhave tathā ciṣe dhiṣa sakhe tathā kṣārābhibhyāṃ dagdhe gaṇḍūṣārthaṃ sāpaḥ vā dhāryam‌

madhu mākṣikaṃ gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇādāsye mukhaḥ nemesyaṃ janayati | tathā mukhe sthitān‌ i sandadhāti saṃśeṣe janayati tathā mukhe dāhaṃ ca nādayatīti dāhatṛṣṇāpraśabhanaṣ‌ || 12 hai0-rakhayaicchityādau gadpamāha-vaiśayabhitiḥ\|| dhānyāmmāsyavairasyamaradaudhyanāranam‌ ghānyāmḍaṃ gahū upaduktaṃ badanavairasyaṃ tathā dauradhyaṃ cā'panayati
tib: kha'i nad smin cing tshos pa la drod che zhing tsha ba dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin du kha'i rma 'phral du byung zhing glo bur gyis thebs pa dang / de bzhin du khar dug gis phog pa dang / de bzhin du thal sman rnon po dang / me de dag gis tshig par gyur pa la/ zhun mar ram 'o mas mkhur ba bkang la gzhag par bya'o/ / sbrang rtsi mkhur bkang byas pas ni/ / kha yi dri ma sbyong byed cing / / kha yi rma ni 'tsho ba byed yin/ / kha tsha skom dad rab zhi byed/ / ces bya ba la/ sbrang rtsis mkhur ba bkang bas ni/ kha'i dri ma sbyong zhing dag par byed pa dang / de bzhin du kha'i nang gi rma 'tshob par byed cing 'byor bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du kha tsha ba dang skom dad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'o/ /

thal sman rnon po'i chu ni thal sman rnon po sbangs pa'i dngas ma ste/ / des kha bkang nas 'jog pas ni/ bad kan sogs shing sdud pa myur zhing rings par sel bar byed do/ / chu tshan dro 'jam mkhur bkang bas/ / kha ni yang zhing bde bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ chu tshan dro 'jam ran pa tsam gyis mkhur ba bkang ba 'jog pas ni/ / kha yang zhing bde bar byed de/ rlung dang bad kan sel zhing sbyor bar byed do zhes bya ba'i don no/ / rlung med nyi tshan bcas par ni/ / phrag pa mjing par dugs byas mnye/ / mkhur ba bkang nas gdong pa ni/ / cung zad bteg ste ji srid na/ / bad kan gyis ni kha gang ba'ang / / sna mig 'dzag pa'i bar du gzhag / ces bya ba la/ mkhur ba bkang ba gtang ba na/ rlung med cing ser bus ma phog pa nyi tshan nam me dang bcas pa'i gnas su 'dug la/ phrag pa dang mjing pa mnyes shing dugs byas la/ mkhur ba bkang nas gdong pa cung zad bteg ste/ ji srid cig na bad kan gyi mchil snabs kyis gang bar gyur pa'am/ sna nas snabs 'dzag par gyur gyi bar du gzhag par bya ste/ don de ni ji srid mkhur ba bkang ba legs pa'i mtshan ma du ba brngubs pa dang 'dra ba 'byung bar gyur gyi bar du lan lnga'am bdun gyi bar bya'o/ / de'i mtshan nyid ni bsdus pa las rang gi don gyi bya ba byed pa dang / mi byed pa las shes par bya ba ston to/ / ro mi tshor ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mchil snabs mang ba dang / khar chags pa las ni sbyor ba nyes par bya'o/ / kha skam pa dang kha'i nang tshos shing smin pa dang / rmya ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / snying 'dzag pa dang / skad gdangs nyams pa las ni mkhur ba'i sbyor ba drags par bya'o/ / zhes bshad do/ / de rnams kyi gso ba yang rang rang gi ji lta ba bzhin du bya'o/ /

tib: mur bar bya ba ni gsum ste/ lde gu dang sman khu dang phye ma'o/ / de la lde gu ni sman rlon pa btags pa'i zhib mo byas pa la bya'o/ / sman khu ni lde gu'i sman rlon pa de dag rtsom pa dang lde gu ska mo byas pa bldag par bya ba lta bu'i khu ba'i sbyor ba la bya'o/ / phye ma ni skam po nyid btags pa'o/ / de gsum char yang bad kan gyi nad mchil ma mang ba dang / skyug ldang byed pa dang / lkog ma'i nad la sogs pa la ci rigs par gtang bar bya'o/ / gang gis shes she na mkhur ba bkang ba bshad pa'i sman las de dag sbyar bar bya'o/ /

tib: mig na zhing 'dzums mi shes pa dag la mig brta ba'i sman blugs par bya'o/ / rengs bag ni bskyod cing 'gul mi shes pa'o/ / skam pa ni yongs su bskams pa'o/ / rtsub pa ni snum pa'i mdangs kyi yon tan dang bral ba'o/ / snang ba ni 'bras bu mngon par snang ba'o/ / rlung dang mkhris pa'i nad ni de gnyis las gyur pa'i nad kyis nyen pa'o/ / zhum bag ni rlung gi dbang gis mig yon por gyur pa'o/ / rdzi ma byi ba ni mig gong gi rdzi ma rnams nad kyis byi bar gyur pa dang / de bzhin du g.yogs par mthong ba ni/ sprin gyis g.yogs pa dang 'dra bar mi gsal bar mthong ba'am/ yang na sngon dmar du mar mthong ba ste/ de la brta ba'i sman gtang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin dbye dka' ba la sogs pas nyen cing na ba la sogs pa mig nad rnams dang yang mig nad la sogs pa rtse zhil zhing cung zad bri ba dang / yang dus gang thun mong du gyur cing / grang dro ran pa dang / / dpyid dang ston gyi dus de'i tshe na yang nang par ta nam langs pa dang / dgongs ka ste nyi ma nub pa'i dus su skyes bu gan rkyal du nyal nas sngar lus dang mgo bo sbyangs shing bkru sman btang zhing sbyar ba la/ rlung med pa'i gnas su brta ba'i mig /

nas kyi rjen phye sbrus pa las/ sman mi 'pho ba'i rten byas la/ zhun mar mig tu blugs par bya'o/ / bskor ba de yang mig sbubs kyi phyi rol nas bskor bar byas/ de yang mnyam zhing snyoms par bya'i/ mi mnyam par ni mi bya ba dang / dpangs kyi tshad sor gnyis su bya ba dang / de bzhin du brtan pa ste gas med par byas la/ de'i 'og tu bskor ba der nad dmigs ji bzhin zhes bya ba rlung la sogs pa'i nad gang las gyur pa sel ba'i sman dang bskol zhing btsos pa'i zhun mar chu tsha ba la bsros shing bzhus te dro grang ran par byas pa'i zhun mar de mig btsums par blugs par bya'o/ / mtshan mo mi mthong rlung rab rib/ / dbye dka' sogs la tshil zhun blugs/ / rdzi ma'i rtse nub par bkang la/ / de nas bskyod cing dbye ba ni/ / de ni dal gyis byed du gzhug /

mtshan mo mi mthong ba la sogs pa'i mig nad kyis btab pa la rang rang gi sman gang yin pa dang / btsos pa'i tshul gyi zhun mar snga ma ltar bsro ba blugs par bya'o/ / de la rdzi ma'i rtse mo nub par gyur kyi bar dang / smin ma'i spur phyin gyi bar du dgang bar bya'o/ / de nas blugs zin pa'i rjes la/ mig bskyod cing dbye ba skyes bu de dal gyis bags kyis byed du gzhug la/ de'i grangs kyi tshad bgrang zhing gzung bar bya'o/ / de la ni/ mig mchu mig 'gram dkar nag nad/ / grangs brgya sum brgya lnga brgya dang / / brgya phrag bdun dang brgyad rim bzhin/ / dkrugs dang rlung la grangs stong ste/ / mkhris pa nad med la drug brgya/ / bad kan la ni lnga brgya gzhag / ces bya ba la/ de la grangs bgrang ba'i tshul ni/ mig mchu'i nad la grangs brgya'i tshad kyi bar du gzhag par bya'o/ / mig 'gram gyi nad la ni grangs sum brgya'i bar du gzhag go / mig gi 'bras bu dkar po'i cha la nad yod pa la ni grangs bdun brgya'i bar du gzhag par bya'o/ / nag po mthong ba'i cha la nad yod pa la grangs brgyad brgya'i bar du gzhag par bya/ de bzhin du mig dkrugs pa snyam sems pa dang rlung gi nad la ni grangs stong gi bar du gzhag go / mkhris pa'i nad dang nad med cing tha mal par gnas pa'i skabs su btang ba la ni grangs drug brgya'i bar du gzhag par bya'o/ / bad kan gyi nad la ni grangs lnga brgya'i bar du gzhag par bya'o/ /

tib: tshim par byas pa'i mig ni mthong ba'i stobs zhan par 'gyur te/ dper na lus kyi khong du snum 'thungs pa na/ nyam chung zhing cung zad brgyal/ stobs chung ba dang 'dra bar mig sman 'thungs pas kyang stobs chung zhing mi gsal bar 'gyur ro/ / de bas na mig brta tshim par byas pa'i rjes la mthong ba'i stobs gsal bar byed pa dang / skyed par nus pa'i mig sman phur ma btsos pa'i khu ba mig gnyis su blugs par bya zhing sbyar bar bya'o/ / de yang sngar bshad pa'i mig nad mig dbye bar dka' ba la sogs pa la phur ma btsos pa'i khu ba gtang bar bya'o/ / de ni rlung la snum can te/ / bad kan bcas te phyi ba phan/ / mthong nyams rlung dang mkhris bcas dang / / khrag mkhris bder gnas la gsal byed/ / ces bya ba la/ mig sman btsos pa'i khu ba de ni rlung las gyur pa'i mig nad la snum can gtang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du bad kan dang bcas pa'i rlung la ni phyi ba'i mig sman phan pa yin no/ / mthong ba nyams shing mig mi gsal ba dang / rlung dang mkhris par bcas pa dang / khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad dang / bde bar gnas shing nad med pa'i skabs la ni gsal bar byed pa'i mig sman gyi phur ma btsos pa'i thigs pa mig tu blugs par bya'o/ /

khung na gnas pa ni sa la brten cing phug na gnas pa ste/ sram dang phyi ba la sogs pa'o/ / mthus tshol ba ni bya rgod dang / khra la sogs pa'o/ / rlan can la gnas pa ni ngang pa dang chu skyar la sogs pa ste/ de rnams kyi tshil dang / de bzhin du rkang dang zhag dang / de bzhin du sha rlon pa rnams 'o ma dang lhan cig tu btags pa dang / de bzhin du sman 'tsho byed la sogs pa dag 'o ma dang btags shing sbyar ba'i snum gyi khu ba rnams mig tu blugs pa'i sman khu'i thigs pa'i don du brtag par bya'o/ / bya yi mcher pa sha / mu tig lcags zangs rgyam tsha dung / / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba lig bu mig /

ni sha bkra la sogs pa'o/ / bya ni la ba la sogs pa ste/ de rnams kyi mcher pa dang / sha rlon pa dang / de bzhin du mu tig dang / lcags kyi phye ma dang / zangs kyi phye ma dang / rgyam tsha dang / lce myang tsha dang / dung dang / lig bu mig ste/ so tan dza na dang / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dang / ba bla ste/ 'di rnams zho ga chu dang btags la blugs pa'i mig sman phyi zhing bsal ba'i don du brtag par bya'o/ /

de bzhin du gsal bar byed pa'i sman gyi phur ma ni pad+ma'i lo mas dkri bar bya'o/ / de ltar dkris pa'i 'og tu 'jim pas byugs te/ shing da ba dang / dgon pa'i lci ba'i me gang rnyed pa sbar bas ji dang mon sran gre'u'i rjen zan gyis bskor nas ldugs pa de bzhin du sman gyi phur ma btsos shing bsregs pa'i khu ba blugs nas mig dal bus bskyod par bya'o/ / phyi dang snum dang bsal ba la/ / brgya phrag gcig gnyis gsum car gzhag / dang po dro 'jam phyi bsil blugs/ / de gnyis rjes la dud pa brngub/ / des ni sbyar ba brta dang mtshungs/ zhes bya ba la/ / phyi ba'i sman gyi thigs pa mig tu blugs du gzhag par bya'o/ / dang po zhes bya ba sngar bstan pa'i phyi ba dang / snum par bya ba gnyis la ni dro 'jam zhes bya ba/ cung zad tsam dro ba mig tu blugs par bya ste/ phyi ma ste tha ma bsal bar pa'i sman blugs pa la ni ma yin no/ / yang sman gyi phur ma btsos pa'i thigs pa mig tu blugs pa gsum po'i skabs der sbyor ba ste/ legs pa dang ma legs pa dang drags pa'i sbyor ba gsum ni brta ba'i tib: kun tu'am/ rnam pa thams cad du mig gi mthu skyed cing mig bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir/ 'bad cing brtson par bya'o/ / gang gis she na sna sman la sogs pa ste/ sman sna nas gtang ba dang / mig sman bsku ba dang / brta ba dang / sman gyi phur ma bsregs pa'i khu ba mig tu blugs pa la sogs pas mthu bskyed par bya'o/ / ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mthong ba nyams shing gsal bar lta ba dang bral na/ 'gro ba sna tshogs pa tshul tha dad pa 'di dag kyang mun pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pas tshul gcig pa nyid du 'gyur ba ste/ mun nag gi rang bzhin du tha dad cing rab rib kyi mun pas khebs pas snang ba'i tshul dang bral zhing bye brag tu shes pa med par 'gyur ro/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa/ tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/

skt: āharaṇāyai ca yadupayuyate tajnānāṃvidhamadhyāya vyākhyātukāma idamāha-ataḥ śarīravādhakāni śasyāni caiṣāṃ nānābidhānāmanekaprakāgaṇāṃ śalyānāṃ nānāsaṃsthānāṃ tathā nānadidapradedoṣu vyādhīnāṃ vinidiṣṭānāmanekaprakāsāṇāṃ deṣ‌doṣopaghātakāriṇāṃ ya ādatumākaṣaṭuṃ dededaśāntaḥ sthitānāṃ bāhmaniṣkramaṇopāyastayansucyate | na kevarametadyāvacchalyasya dne'valokane cāryo bhagandraprabhṛtīnāṃ vikārāṇām‌ | tathā dākhakṣārapriyojane śasarādikarmeṇi tathā ropāṅgarpāsagaścayāmarobhigandasabhṛtivikārāṇāṃ kāntaṃ śṣaknāyadikme yoñyaṃ vajayitvā yadnyadadāṃ nikārajaṭa tasya rakṣārthaṃ tathā vasitidānādau kamaṃṇiṃ yan‌ sādhane tathā vadaṭikārābuśaṅgaṃ tathā jābhvavauṣṭhakādikāni ca vastujātāni tsyai yantraṃ jāmbavoghcare dravakaḥ yamyate vadhyate'baṣṭabhyate ādata śatyādi tena yadantaram‌
tib: 'di brtsams pa'i dgos pa ni 'di yin te/ sman mas gtong ba nas/ mig sman gyi bar gyi rang rang gi cha spyad gang dag yin pa bshad nas/ de'i 'og tu zug rngu dbyung ba la sogs pa'i cha spyad sna tshogs pa gang dag dgos pa de bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ de'i 'og tu 'di brtsams pa yin la/ de'i cho ga gang dag yin pa bstan pa sman pa ni/

skyes bu'i lus la gnod par byed pa'i zug rngu ni/ mtshon gyi dum bu nang du lus pa rnam pa sna tshogs shing dbyibs dang las du mar gyur pa dang / de bzhin du lus kyi phyogs rnam pa sna tshogs pa rnams su gnod par byed cing khong du zug pas lus kyi phyogs du ma dang / nad rnam pa sna tshogs skyes pas gnod par byed cing / nye bar 'joms par byed pa rnams 'dzin cing lus kyi phyogs kyi nang na gnas pa rnams 'dren par byed pa'i thabs su gyur pa gang yin pa de la ni cha spyad ces bya la/ de 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi gzhang 'brum dang / mtshan par rdol ba la sogs pa'i nad tshol zhing rtogs par byed pa dang / mtshon du de bzhin du gtsags bu dang / thal sman rnon po dang / me btsa' gdab par bya ba'i nad de gzhang 'brum dang mtshan par rdol ba'i nad kyis nyen pa blta ba'i spyad dang / gtsags bu dang thal sman rnon po dang me gdab par bya ba'i rigs par gtogs pa yan lag lhag ma nad kyi gnod pas nyen pa de bsrung zhing bskyang bar bya ba'i phyir dang / de bzhin du mas gtong ba la sogs pa'i las rnams kyi spyad ma gtogs pa gnas skabs gzhan dag tu dgos pa'i cha spyad bum bu dang ku ba dang / / rngabs rwa dang / 'dzam bu'i mchu 'dra ba la sogs pa'i cha spyad kyi dngos po thams cad ni cha spyad ces bya ba yin no/ / 'dzam bu'i mchu ni thal sman 'ju bar byed pa'o/ / spyad de dag ni 'dzin cing sdud pas zug rngu la sogs pa gang gis 'byin par byed pa de la cha spyad ces bya'o/ /

skt: anekāni ūpakāryāṇi yeṣāṃ tāni nānācharutīni tāni kamauṇi ca svasthāturopakaraṇāni tathāṃ vitidhānyanekaprakāraṇi kamevadāttadnuddhadhā vikasya khabuddhayokhekya nirūpitāni kalpayan‌ kuyaut‌ \ 2 || ha° -ytravireṣāṇāmanantatvādūcudyā kaṭa pvamāanekarūpakāryāṇīti | nidardanābha kāṃśidyannavidaṣānvakumāda--yathāsthūramiti | svasitakasedatālanādīklakāsuyanbhedāyoḍhā yaṃtrāṇi

tib: gang gi phyir zug rngu 'byin pa la sogs pa'i cha spyad/ lus kyi cho ga gang ji ltar dgos pa bzhin du sna tshogs pa'i tshul dbyibs du mar na ba dang / mi'i lus la phan par byed nus pa'i tshul sna tshogs par brdung bar byas la/ de yang lus kyi tshul las blos rnam par dpyad la brtags nas ci rigs par brdung bar bya ba yin la/ de dag las kho bos ni rags rim tsam zhig ste/ mdo tsam zhig bstan pa yin gyi/ de dag ni grangs 'di tsam zhig bya'o zhes tshad nges par bstan pa ma yin no/ / seng ge kang ka dom bya rog/ / bya sogs kha 'dra ba'i/ / mchu can cha spyad byas nas ni/

skt: kākasihādīnāṃ saagapaściṇāṃ sambāśvābheaseṣaikaraiyakhāni tulyāni sadṛśāni yantrāṇāṃ kuyaut‌ | tāni tatsaṃjñakāni tannāmadheyāni vijñeyāni yādṛśa senñayā bhavati | tathā kaṅkamukhaṃ kākamukham‌| tāni caṣṭādaśaṅgurudīghāṇi bhūyasā bāhulyenāyasāti śakhamayāni | masurākāsayā masarasaṭarāḥ paryantāḥ yeṣāṃ testathābhūtaiḥ kīlaiḥ kaṇṭhe sukhād‌dhaḥpradero baddhāni tāni svastikasaṃjñāni yantrāṇe vidyāt‌ jānīyāt‌ | tathā mūle bhūlaviṣaye hastaoṃ ṅgahdya | pamaṇa neṣavavotarapadaṣamaṇāmū
tib: seng ge dang dom la sogs pa dang bya rnams kyi mchu dang 'dra zhing mtshungs pa'i cha byad byas la cha spyad de dag kyang de'i ming gdags par bya ste/ gang gi mchu dang gang 'dra ba de la de'i ming gdags par bya ste/ dper na kang ka'i mchu dang / bya rog gi mchu lta bu zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ / de dag kyang phal cher ram mang lcags kyi rgyu las bya la/ tshad ni phal cher sor bco brgyad par bya'o/ / skam pa de dag gi sbrel ba'i mtshams kha'i 'og tu sran chung lta bu ste/ rtse mo sran chung ltar zlum po'i gzer bu legs par btab la/ de bzhin du rtsa ba de lag pas gzung ba'i phyogs su lcags kyu lta bur bkug cing 'khyog par bya ba'i cha spyad de ni ming bde legs zhes bya ba yin te/

bde legs zhes bya ba'i cha spyad brtan zhing mi 'jigs pas rus par zug rngu gang yin pa de 'byin cing dbyung ba la sbyar bar bya'o/ / gzer btab rtse mo gyes pa dang / / skam pa yin te sor bcu drug / de ni pags pa rtsa rgyus shar/ / zhen pa'i zug rngu 'byin la sbyar/ / zhes bya ba la/ / skam pa ni gnyis bya ste/ de las gcig ni rtse mo'i phyogs su gzer bu btab cing bsdam pa dang bcas pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni rtse mo gyes shing rtse mo gzer bus ma btab la/ kham bsdams pa'o/ / skam pa de gnyi ga yang srid sor bcu drug bya'o/ / de gnyis ni pags pa la sogs par nub cing zhen pa'i zug rngu de dbyung zhing 'dren pa la sbyar zhing gtang bar bstan no/ /

skt: anyo'paraḥ saṃdairāḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ darthaḥ citha ktā eva | saṃ ca sṛkṣmaralyānāmakṣipraṇayagatāna tathopapakṣmaṇāṃ haraṇa ādatumiṣyate | pṣmasamīḥ janmottarajātāni romāṇyupapakcmarabdenocyante
tib: skam pa de las gzhan pa srid sor drug yod pa kha gyes pa nyid du bya la/ des na zug rngu phra ba ste/ mig gi rma la sogs par gtogs pa dang / de bzhin du rdzi ma ma rung ba ste/

cha spyad gang so phra mo btod pa byas pa de yang drang zhing rtse mo gnyis drang por bya'o/ / de'i tshad ma smos pas 'das ma thag pa'i sor drug nyid yin par shes par bya'o/ / de'i rtsa ba ni lag pas gzung ba'i phyogs der gdu bus brgyan pa zhes bya ba dam du bsdam pa'i phyir lcags kyi khyud mos gdu bu lta bur brgyan pa zhes bya'o/ / de'i ming ni mu tsa ti zhes bya la/ des rma gting du zug pa dang de bzhin du mig mdzer gting du lus te gdon pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ / bzhi po de dag ni cha spyad skam pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /

drang srong gi cha spyad nya mgo lta bu ni gnyis yod par bshad de/ de gnyi ga yang nya mgo dang 'dra zhing sor bcu gnyis pa yin la/ de yang nya mgo'i lkog ma 'dra bas na/ nya mgo'i mgul pa lta bu zhes bya ba'i don no/ / de la nya mgo gnyis 'dra ba yod pa dang / gcig 'dra ba yod pa ste/ des na gcig ni rta'i mgul pa lta bu gnyis dang ldan pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni nya'i mgul pa lta bu gcig dang ldan pa'o/ / de gnyi gas kyang rna khung na gnas pa'i zug rngu 'byin pa'i las la sbyar bar bya ste/ de na gnas pa'i zug rngu de gnyis kyis dbyung bar bya'o/ / cha spyad sbu gu can smras pa ni/

skt: tatrasthaṃ dāsya tābhyāṃ nāḍīyantrāṇyād‌eka cānekaṃ ca ekanikam‌| ekāneka sukhaṃ yamāṃ tāni nāḍīyantrāṇi śuṣirāṇyantaḥśacūlyāni anekaprayojanāni | srotogatānaṃ kaṇṭaprabhṛtisakharotaḥsithitānāmāmayānāṃ vyādhīnāṃ ca dīne darīnāratha tathādaraṇātha ca | tathā kriyāṇāṃ śasyāharaṇayaklakṣāragnyādīnāṃ sukarasāya saukayīthe tathā duṣṭavaktrāṇāmā. karṣaṇā ca | vistāraśca parīṇāhaṃ daiṣyai ca teṣāṃ samāhāraḥ vistārapariṇādaiṣya̭loto'turodhavarāt‌ | saroto'nurodhena yathāyogaṃ kuyat‌ | pāśvāparapārdharābhyāṃ parimāṇena cistāse jñeyaḥ } parasi niṣṭhapramāṇaparicchedaḥ pariṇāhaḥ pūrvoktām‌ yadai. dhyaimuccaistvam‌

tib: cha spyad sbu gu can ni nang khong stong du byas la rtse mo kha gcig pa'am/ kha mang po ba dgos pa du ma'i dbang las byas la/ des ni gre ba la sogs pa bu ga na gnas pa'i zug rngu rnams dang / de na gnas pa'i nad yod pa dag blta bar bya ba'i phyir dang / de bzhin du bya ba ste/ zug rngu dbyung ba dang gtsags bu gdab pa dang / thal sman dang me btsa' gdab pa la sogs pa'i las kyi bya ba bla bar bya ba'i phyir dang / de bzhin du dgang bar bya ba'i phyir bya ste/ de'i zheng ste sbom dang / srid de dpangs kyi tshad ni bu ga'i tshad las/

skt: anyā nāḍī paccamukhe chidrāṇi yasyā; sā tathāvidhā kāyā | catuṣkarṇasya vāranasya saṅprahanimittaṃ kaṇṭhādīnāṃ daṇḍādāvantaḥbhaveśādham‌ | kīṭhakadarikhākāse cāraṅgaḥ | tathā ṣaṭikarṇasya vāraṅgasya sacṛmrahārthe tricchidramakhā nāḍī karavavyā | tasmamāṇato vāraṅgakarṇapramāṇena
tib: gang gi bu ga gang du btod pa de'i tshad las dpags nas ci rigs par bya'o/

logs gcig nas gcig tu phyin pa'i tshad la bya la/ sbom ni 'khyud pa'i tshad yongs su chad pa la bya'o/ / srid ni dpangs te/ sngar bshad pa'i cha spyad las ring bar bya'o/ / srid du sor bcu sbom sor lnga/ / gre ba'i zug rngu rtog byed yin/ / rtse mo lnga pa bu ga can/ / rtse mo bzhi la spyi mdud bya/ / cha spyad thur ma gnyis pa ni/ / bu ga gsum pa de'i tshad bya/ / cha spyad bya ba rang gi dbyibs/ / sbom dang mchu yi tshad mnyam pa'i/ / sbu gu de 'dra gzhan dag kyang / / cha spyad shes par byed du gzhug / ces bya ba la/ cha spyad sbu gu can bya'o/ / zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ / de'i tshad dang srid du sor bcu bya la/ de nyid kyis na de'i sbom gyi tshad sor lnga par bya'o/ / 'dis rtog cing blta bar byed pa yin pas na rtog par byed pa ste/ gre ba'i nang du zug rngu blta bar bya ba'i don du bya'o/ / yang na sbu gu gzhan rtse mo lnga pa'i sbu gu la yang de lta bu ni rtse mo bzhi pa'i spyir bsdu bar bya ste/ mda' la sogs pa nang du zhugs pa brtag pa'i phyir thur ma rtse mo can btod pa ni thur ma zhes bya'o/ / de bzhin du cha spyad thur ma rtse mo gnyis pa ni sbu gu can bu ga gsum pa can bya ste/ / de yang snga ma'i tshad du bya'o/ / cha spyad pa rang gi de'i dbyibs dang sbom pa dang mchu'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i sbu gu bya la/ yang sbu gu de dang 'dra ba na/ stong pa rtse mo gnyis pa dang / rtse mo mang po yod pa gzhan dag kyang zug rngu blta zhing brtag par bya ba'i phyir cha spyad la mkhas pa gzhan dag byed du gzhug go/ / rtse mo pad+ma'i snying po 'dra/ / srid du sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ / bzhi cha khong stong byas sbu gu/ / zug rngu 'byin pa yin par bshad/ / ces bya ba la/ zug rngu 'byin pa'i cha byad mi 'gul ba'i zug rngu dbyung bar bya ba'i phyir/ / rtse mo mgo bo'i phyogs pad+ma'i snying po kar ni ka'i dbyibs 'dra zhing mtshungs pa tshad srid du sor bcu gnyis yod pa bzhi cha khong stong yod pa ste/ sor gsum gyi bar khong stong du byas pa de ni zug rngu 'byin pa yin par 'dod do/ /

skt: gostanākāraṃ gostanasadṛśṃ saṃsthānaṃ yatta dudīsāṃ kāryam‌ | tacca yantrakaṃ caturaṅgaṃ caturaṅguāyataṃ taśca pañvāṅrurānāhama. pasām‌ | tathā paḍakhagulapariṇāhaṃ pramadānāṃ khīṇāṃ dahicchidraṃ rīna dīnāthamakṣodhyādhī tathaikacchidraṃ tadevaikapāśaunvitam‌ | aradauvyādhau karmaṇi rakhakṣārāganyādiyojane tathā dvimukha dadanaṃ chidreṇa śakhakṣāsamnyanatikramabhraikanidreṇa | asya yantrasya madhye chidra bhyaṣgulāyatamaṅgṛṣṭhodaravistāraṃ daiyā cyaṅguraṃ viśtarato'ṣagaṣṭhodrāvisvarataṃ tasya chidrasyodhyai tadva tasmādṛdhvāttadurapariṣṭāttyantramadhāṅgukhocchrateodarattakaṇikaḥ kāryam‌ | tathādguḍhamavaściṣṭa tasyādāvadhaugulaṃ varjyamupari tathārdhāḍaguṅamevaṃ cāvasthitaḥ adhāṅgulocchṛtotodūtā̱parivatekā kaṇikā kāyāṃ ||| {5 ||)
tib: gzhang 'brum 'chos pa'i cha spyad ni/ ba'i nu sor dang dbyibs 'dra ba byas la/ srid sor bzhi yod pa/ skyes pa la stong pa'i sbom sor lngas 'khyud pa byas la/ bud med kyi gzhang 'brum gso ba'i cha spyad ni sor drug gis 'khyud pa'i sbom yod par bya'o/ / nad blta ba ni gzhang 'brum gyi nad rtog pa'o/ / bu ga gnyis ni ngos gnyi ga la bu ga yod par byas pa'o/ / de bzhin du gzhang 'brum dang bcas pa dang / thal sman rnon po gtong ba'i las rnams kyi cha spyad ni/ snga ma lta bu la bu ga gcig par bya'o/ / de lta na mngon du blta ba'i phyir ni bu ga gnyis pas bya/ gtsags pa dang / thal sman dang / me btsa' gdab par mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir ni bu ga gcig par bya'o/ / cha spyad 'di'i dbus kyi bu ga ni srid du sor gsum par bya'o/ / mthe bo'i lto shong ba ste/ rgyar mthe bo'i lto dang zheng mnyam par bya'o/ / yang bu ga de'i rtse'am steng ma ni dbyibs 'dra ba la/ dpangs sor phyed yod pa/ sor tshad du bstan pa de'i steng du lhag ma sor phyed yod par lte ba zlum po sor phyed bya ba'i don no/ /

khar dkrol lta bu zhes bya ba'i cha spyad ni bu ga'i rnam pa bshad ma thag pa'i gzhang 'brum gyi rnam pa 'dra ba la/ bu ga med pa ste/ ngos gnyis su bu ga btod pa med pa'o/ / de lta bu'i cha spyad ni gzhang 'brum gyi nad btsir ba'i don du bya'o/ /

skt: sarvathā svaiparakāreṇa śachidrādṛdhvamoṣṭhaṃ kārṇakāmupanayetat‌ | tayā cinā tadanta .kuyīt‌ | bhagandare bhagandranimitte takmaṇi etavān‌ viśe po'ryoyantrakāddhagandarayantrake takakakaṇikāpanayatam‌
tib: mtshan par rdol ba'i nad gso ba'i cha spyad ni rnam pa thams cad nas thams cad du bu ga yan chad kyi lte ba de bsal zhing med par bya ste/ cha spyad 'di las ni dbus ma'i lte ba med par bya ba'i don no/ /

skt: anyā nāḍī ekacchidrā tathāṅgukhudrayapramāṇā tathā pradeśinī tajanī tatsamānaparīṇāhā ghrāṇādharudānāṃ prāṇārkhasāṃ viṣaye kāryāṃ | bhagandara yantravat‌

aṅgulyāścāṇakaṃ rakṣakaṃ dāntaṃ daśanāda bhyo'ṅguritrāṇakam‌ | dantasyadaṃ dāntaṃ dntamayam‌. ṛkasayede vām‌ | taccaturaṅguruaighyaṃ dvicchiḥ ramūdhvīṣaśchidrayuktam‌ | tathā gostanākkati tadra vanravidṛtau sukhavikāse yukhaṃ dṛḍhena sūtreṇa maṇi bandhaṃ pratibandhaṃ yuhañyāt‌
tib: sna'i nang gi 'brum pa bsal zhing gcad pa'i cha spyad ni/ bu ga gcig pa bya la/ dpangs su sor gnyis pa/ zheng gi tshad mdzub mo tsam la mtshan mar rdol gyi cha spyad dang 'dra bar dbus ma'i lte ba med par bya'o/ / de stong par byed pa na sman pa'i sor mo bskum zhing gnod pa med par bya ba'i phyir ba so las byas pa'am/ shing las byas pa'i shubs dpangs su sor bzhi yod pa/ bu ga gnyis pa yod par byas la/ cha spyad de'i rnam pa ni ba'i nu ma 'dra bar bya'o/ / yang cha spyad de'i kha bye zhing gyes par byas la/ mkhrig mar srad bus dam du bcing bar bya'o/ / mo mtshan rma brtag dbus su ni/ / khong stong sor ni bcu drug pa/ / phyogs bzhir gdu bus bcing bar bya/ / rtse mo pad+ma kha zlum 'dra/ / thur ma bzhi ni mnan pa yi/ / rtsa ba bsdams na kha dbye bya/ / zhes bya ba la/ / mo mtshan nam mngal du rma byung ba brtag cing blta ba'i cha spyad ni dbus khong stong du byas pa srid sor bcu drug yod par gdu bu 'dra ba'i khyud kyis bcings pa'i phyogs bzhir thur ma bzhi yod par bya zhing / sprul pa'i 'dra bas bcings pa dang / de bzhin du pad+ma kha zlum pa'am ma phye ba 'dra ba'i rtse mo yod pa thur ma bzhi yod pa'i lag pas gzung ba'i phyogs su bsdams shing btsir na kha 'bye zhing gyes par 'gyur bar bya'o/

tib: cha spyad srid du sor drug yod pa gnyis bya ste/ bu ga can gyi rtsa bsku ba'i phyir dang / bkru ba'i phyir dgos so/ / ji lta bu zhe na/ 'jam rtsi'i sbu gu 'dra ba ste/ 'jam rtsi'i sbu gu dang cha 'dra zhing mtshungs pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'jam rtsi'i sbu gu 'dra ba'o/ / de'i bu ga ni rtsa ba mthe bo shong ba tsam la rtse mo sran ma shong ba tsam rtse mo'i cha la gag pa med pa byas la/ rtsa ba'i gnas su pags pa 'jam po'i rkyal bu snum dang 'khrud pa'i sman gyi snod kyi rkyal bu bcings pa de lta bu'i cha spyad dag gis rma'i phug 'chas pa dang / rma bkru ba la sbyar zhing dpyad du bya'o/ / 'od ma'i sbu gu'am sgro rtsa ni/ / 'dra ba kha gnyis dmu rdzing spyad/ / ces bya ba la/ dmu rdzing gi nad gso ba'i sbu gu kha gnyis pa 'od ma la sogs pa las bya ba'am/ sgro rtsa ste rma bya la sogs pa'i sgro'i rtsa ba las sbu gu chu gzags pa'i don du kha gnyis pa bya'o/ /

tib: rngabs rwa'i tshad ni kha zheng du sor gsum pa ste/ sor mo gsum gshibs pa'o/ / de yang nu zho'i nad la sogs pa gzhib pa'i phyir bya ste/ de'i dpangs kyi tshad ni sor brgyad pa'am/ / sor bcu pa byas la/ rtse mo ste rwa'i rtse phyogs kyi bu ga ni yungs kar shong ba tsam du bya la/ de bzhin du gnas de legs par g.yogs pa ste/ pags pa srab mo la sogs pas kha bkag cing g.yogs pa'o/ / de bzhin du dbyibs ni nu sor gyi tshul du byin gyis phra bar bya'o/ / ku ba srid du sor bcu gnyis/ / khyung khor sor ni bco brgyad pa/ / kha zlum sor ni gsum mam bzhi/ / nang 'bar bad kan khrag 'dren byed/ / ces bya ba la/ ku ba ni srid dam dpangs su sor bcu gnyis yod pa la/ khyud 'khor gyi kha zheng zlum por bskor ba ni sor bco brgyad kyis 'khor bar bya la/ de bzhin du bde phyogs kyi kha ni zlum po la sor gsum mam bzhi pa bya ste/ de ltar na kha zlum po la sor gsum pa'am sor bzhi pa zlum po kha phyogs su bya ba dang / de bzhin du nang na 'bar ba ste/ de'i nang du gro ga'am 'jag ma'am/ rtsa bal ba dza'am/ / ras bal 'bar ba bcug pa glan pa bcug pa ni bad kan 'khrugs pa'am/ khrag nad can 'dren cing 'byin par byed pa yin pas na/ de'i phyir bad kan 'dren byed ces bya'o/ / de bzhin bum pa de 'dra ba/ / glan pas skran yang 'ju bar byed/ / ces bya ba la/ bum pas sngags 'debs pa yang ku ba dang 'dra bar bya ba ste/ srid sor bcu gnyis la/ khyud 'khor sor brgyad pa kha zlum zhing / sor gsum pa'am sor bzhi yod pa nang na gro ga'am/ rtsa 'jag gam sog ma'i me 'bar ba dang bcas pa de glan pa ni/ skran 'ju bar byed cing 'bri bar byed pa yin no/ / yang zhes bya ba'i sgras ni sngar bshad pa'i ku ba dang 'dra bas bad kan dang khrag 'dren par byed do zhes bya ba'i don no/ / thur ma zhes bya'i cha spyad ni/ / las dang dbyibs ni sna tshogs pa/ / ci rigs pa yi tshad ldan bya/ / zhes bya ba la/ / cha spyad kyi rnam pa thur ma zhes bya ba ni las sna tshogs byed pa dang / de bzhin du dbyibs kyi khyad par ring thung la sogs pa sna tshogs par gnas pa ni ci rigs pa'i tshad dang ldan par bya ste/ sbom dang ring thung gang du gtong ba de yang 'tsham par bya'o/ /

skt: yantrasaṭaśakāyasampādanān‌ = ayantrāḥ nyapi tāni ayaskāntaprañtoni anaruyantrāṇa cyante | ayaskānto maṇidhidapaḥ | raṇjuḥ mura ktā | vastra vāsaḥ | asmā pātrāṇaḥ | sthūkhaṣṭasvaṃ kām‌ | vadhaśyamasayam‌. | aḥ prāṇināṃ sambandhīni | lajihlā gsanā | 4 karāḥ| aśrasturadgaḥ| chāyayā braknasya | nakhaḥ caḥ mukhamāsyam‌ | dvijā dantāḥ | krā mutāḥ kṣitaḥ | pākaḥ pakvatvam‌ | karaḥ hastaḥ| pa raṇaḥ | bhayaṃ sādhvasam‌ | darpā manasuṣiḥ taciyāḥ teṣāṃ kiyākamaṇi syāpāranidhira stāstaskiyā bhajediti samrandhaḥ | yantra sampādayyupāyavidū vaidyaḥ | vibhajana. † nayet‌ | tānyanuyantrāṇi yasya yatra yogyatā tatra yojayet‌ | dhiyā buddhayā nipuṇaṃ śniḥ chokya vīkṣya vimadya yojayet‌. | tathāca sa 'pyuktamācāyeṇa | “tāni de savasminda vayave'pi cā ! sandhāṃ kaṃ dhamanyo nara yadha prayojayetaḥḥ
tib: cha spyad dang 'dra zhing de'i bya ba rdzogs par byed nus pa/ rdo khab len la sogs pa nye ba'i cha spyad ces bya'o/ / khab len ni nor bu'i bye brag go/ / thag pa ni muny+dza la sogs pa las byas pa'o/ / gos ni ras kyi rnam pa'o/ / tho ba ni shing las byas pa'i sbom po'am thung ba'o/ / 'breng bu ni pags pa las byas pa'o/ / rgyu ma dang lce ni dngos su zad do/ / rta rnga ni rta'i rnga ma'am rngog ma'o/ / yal ga ni shing gi'o/ / dus ni skad cig ma la sogs pa nye bar mtshon pa'o/ / smin pa ni tshos pa'o/ / dga' ba ni sems rangs pa ste/ / dbye ba ni de'i las la nye bar sbyor ba yin la/ bya ba'i thabs des cha spyad kyi las rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs shes shing sbyor ba'i bye brag la mkhas pa'i sman pas cha spyad gang la 'os pa de la sbyar bar bya zhing / des blos legs par brtags shing dpyad la sbyar ba'o/ / de yang slob dpon gyis bsdus pa las/

skt: nighātanaṃ sidhāṃtaḥ āhananam‌ | yatyamenati nighātanamara | -unmadhyaratañnanalaya namū. |. pūyate'neneti pūraṇam‌ | māgāṇāṃ d‌ vyṛhunaṃ svanāvireṣaḥ | kṣāradīnāmāharṇamākarṣaṇaṃ śasyādīnām‌ | badhyate bhamrāyaneneti bandhanaṃ pīḍayate'neneti pīḍanam‌ | ācṛṣyate'nenetyācūṣaṇaṃ viṣasktādīnām‌ | unnamyate urakipyate'nenetyunnamanamanāmyate barāṅgāneneti nāmanam‌| caranaṃ cālaḥ nigdhakhaśca kamparepādaḥ | bhaṅga ekasya vastuno'parasya vastuna utpādanaṃ tadajkaraṇabheti
tib: brdung ba la sogs pa ni cha spyad kyi las yin te/ brdung ba ni bsnun cing brdeg pa'o/ / bsrub pa ni mdas btsugs shing dkrugs pas bsrub pa zhes bya'o/ / dgang ba ni 'dis dgang bar byas pa'o/ / rgyun srang dag par bya ba ni bu ga rnams dang gre ba la sogs pa'i sbubs rnams ma dag pa dag par byed cing brdeg pa'o/ / gdab pa ni thal sman rnon po la sogs pa bsku ba'i khyad par ro/ / mtshon dbyung ba ni zug rngu la sogs pa 'byin cing 'dren pa'o/ / bcing ba ni chag grugs la sogs pa 'dis sdom par byed pa'o/ / btsir ba ni 'dis rnag la sogs pa 'byin par byed pa'o/ / gzhib pa ni cha spyad gang gis khrag dang chu ser la sogs pa brngub pa'o/ / smad pa ni cha spyad gang gis yan lag la sogs pa'i phyogs smod pa'o/ / bstod pa ni cha spyad gang gis 'debs shing mtho bar byed pa'o/ / bskyod pa ni g.yo bar byed pa ste/ mi 'gul ba g.yo zhing 'gul bar byed pa'o/ / bcag pa ni dngos po gcig du mar byed pa'o/ / bzlog pa ni cha spyad gang gis gzhan du bzlog cing bsgyur ba'o/ / drang por bya ba ni yon por gnas pa'i dngos po bsal zhing rnal du gnas par byed pa'o/ / de ltar na brdung ba la sogs par bstan pa gang yin pa de dag ni mdor na/ cha spyad kyi las rnams yin par shes par bya ste/ legs par zug cing 'byin par byed pa dang / / gzung bya blangs nas 'byin par byed phyir dang / yan lag kun la gnod pa med pas na/ /

gong du smos pa ni cha spyad thams cad kyi nang na/ kang ka'i mchu lta bu'i cha spyad ni/ / gtso bo yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ de legs par zug cing kun du bskor du 'dod pa dang / de bzhin du gzung bar bya ba'i zug rngu bde blag tu zin cing blangs nas kyang zug rngu 'byin cing 'don par byed pa'i phyir dang / zug tu dbyung bar bya ba'i lus kyi yan lag kun la gnod pa med cing las de bde blag tu sgrub par byed pa yin pas na/ de'i phyir cha spyad thams cad kyi mchog ni kang ka'i mchu lta bu yin no/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa/ tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas nges par sbyar ba las/ /

skt: sarvayantrāṇā karma yantrepvataḥ kahkamukhaṃ pradhānaṃ sthānaṃ sthāneṣu sarvaiṣvadhikāri tacca -yasmāttadinete paribhramati tathā grāhyam‌ | rāvya sādhu tā'bagāhate gṛhaṇāti grahītvā ca taccharyamuddharati 1 utpārayati sthāneṣu sarveṣu svairārīramareṣu rarīrāvayaveṣu śāsyāharaṇādivyāpāreṣvādhikāra rāsyāharaṇaviṣaye sukhakāri | ataḥ kāraṇāt‌ eteṣu pūrvokeṣu madhye kaṅkamukhaṃ nāma yathantare śreṣṭhatamam‌ | anyāni yantarāṇyekadeśaviṣayāṇi svahpakarmakarāṇi asukhakarābhi
tib: 'di brtsams pa'i dgos pa ni 'di yin te/ cha spyad phal cher ni lcags las byed pa yin la/ / 'di phal cher lcags las byed pa'am/ las kyi rnam pa ris mthun pa'i phyir te/ de'i 'og tu 'di brtsams pa yin no/ / mgar ba mkhas pas cho ga bzhin/ / brdungs pa'i gtar spyad nyi shu drug / spu ni chod par nus pa dag /

gtsags bu nyi shu rtsa drug bya ba yin la/ de yang gang gis bya zhe na/ mgar ba mkhas pas/ zhes bya ba ste/ bya ba la mkhas shing byang bar gyur pa'i lcags mgar gyis brdungs shing rdzogs par bya'o/ / ci ltar bya zhe na/ cho ga bzhin te/ tshad la sogs pa'i rnam pa ji skad bshad pa bzhin du brdung ba'o/ / rno tshad ji tsam zhe na/ spu ni chod par nus pa dag / ces bya ba ste/ gang gis spu chod pa'i las byed nus pa tsam du bya ba'o/ / tshad ci tsam du bya zhe na/ phal cher zhes pa mang du srid sor drug phar byas pa dang / gzugs legs shing ji skad bshad pa'i rnam par dbyibs dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin du so legs pa ste/ rno zhing snyoms pa dang / de bzhin du gzung bar bya ba bde ba nyid de bzung ba'i phyogs bde blag tu gzung bar bya ba dang / de bzhin du ya yo med pa ste/ so snyoms shing rnga rngo med pa dang / de bzhin mthar legs shing brdung ba zhag pa dang / shin tu rno ba'i lcags las byas pa gang yin pa de las brdungs pa dang / de bzhin du rtse mo shin tu legs par brdungs pa ste/ lcags legs par bskol ba tho bas ma gas par brdung zhing khyad par du rtse mo'i gnas brdung zhag par byas pa dang / de bzhin du ut+pal sngon po'i mdog 'dra zhing 'jam pa dang / de bzhin du rang gi ming dang rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs sam/ dbyibs yod pa gtsags bu'i kha 'bras 'dra bar byas pa la ni/ gtsags bu 'bras kyi kha'am/ 'bras kyi rtse mo zhes btags pa lta ba la sogs pa'o/ / de bzhin du rtag tu ste/ dus thams cad du cha spyad dang gtsags bu de dag nye bar gzhag par bya zhing sta gon du bya ba dang / de bzhin du rang gi tshad de/ gtsags bu de'i srid kyi tshad las rtse mo'am/ kha cha phyed kyi tshad dang / la la bzhi tshad du bya ba dang / de dag kyang phal cher grangs gnyis dang gsum du bya ba la yang gtsags bu de dag gnas kyi khyad par dang / nad kyi khyad par la sbyar bar bya'o/ /

gtsags bu de rnams kyi nang nas gtsags bu dkyil 'khor 'dra zhes bya ba'i rtse mo kha'i dbyibs mdzub mo'i nang gi dbyibs dang 'dra bar bya ba la/ de ni rnyil gyi lhag ma skyes pa la sogs pa phyi zhing bzhar ba dang / sha lhag bcad pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /

tib: srin bu pad pa chu nang las byung ba dang / nya dang sbal pa la sogs pa dang / mi ro dang dri ma rnams las byung ba/ kha dog dmar ba dang / shin tu gnag pa dang / mi srun zhing rang bzhin g.yo ba dang / / sbom zhing lus che ba dang / bsil ba dang / 'ja' tshon dang 'dra bar kha dog sna tshogs yod pa dang / ro stod bkra zhing ra ris 'dug pa dang / spu yod pa de thams cad dug can yin pas spang bar bya'i/ gtar ga gdab pa'i don du mi sbyar ro/ / ci'i phyir zhe na/ des khrag gzhibs nas g.ya' ba la sogs pa skye bar 'gyur la/ g.ya' ba la sogs pa skyes pa de la ni/

skt: unāḥ ṣoḍa janabdā varṣā yeṣāmūnaṣoḍaraḥ | atītāḥ saptasyabdā yeṣāṃ te'rtātasaprayavdāḥ | sutamasak‌ pūṣai śasrābhidhātādinā yeṣāṃ te khutāddhajaḥ | teṣāṃ śirāṃ na vidhyet‌ | tathā'snigdhānāmasveditānāmatyathai sveditānāmanirayegiṇāṃ tathā garbhiṇyāḥ sutikāyāḥ ajauīraṇino raktapittināṃ śvāsināṃ kāsināṃ ca tathātīsāriṇāmdariṇāṃ charditānāṃ pāṇḍurogiṇāṃ savoṅgaśophināṃ ca snehaḥ pīto yane tasmin‌ puṃsi tathā pacca karmasa̱ tatkārabhaṇīteṣu vamanavirecananirūdaṇānubāsanaśirocirecanākhyeṣu ayantrayitarā śirāṃ na vidhyet‌ | tathā tiryak‌ ktā tathā'tucchitāṃ no śirāṃ vidhyet‌ | tathā'tiśītoṣṇavātāraṣu dineṣu ātyayikaṃ dirāvyadhasādhyaṃ nyāṃ baja yitvā | naiṣa virodhaḥ ādayayike vyādhau

tib: sna'i nad rnams la ni sna'i rtse mo'i cha la gnas pa'i rtsa la gdab par bya'o/ / cham pa sna dang dpral rtsar gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ cham pa'i nad la lan 'ga' ni sna rtsar gdab na phan no/ / lan 'ga' ni dpral rtsa'o/ / lan 'ga' ni gnyi ga gdab par bya'o/ / kha nad rnams la lce dang ni/ / mchu dang rkan gyi rtsar gdab po/ / ces bya ba la/ kha'i nad rnams la ni lce la brten pa'i rtsa dang / de bzhin du mchu dang rkan gyi rtsa la gdab na phan no/ / nam tshong yan chad rtsa mdud 'gul/ / rna ba mur 'gram spyir gnas gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ nam tshong yan chad kyi nad rtsa mdud dang / rmen bu la sogs pa'i nad la rna ba la brten pa'i rtsa dang / mur 'gram dang spyi bor gnas pa'i rtsa la gdab par bya'o/ /

skt: gṛrasyā vātavyādhau jānunoḥ jālandhara radhastāt‌ adha adhvasupari vā caturadgule ciraṃ vyadhayet‌
tib: smyo byed kyi nad la ni mig 'gram rtsa dang / brang gi rtsa dang / dpral ba'i rtsa la gtar ga bya'o/ / brjed byed 'gram pa'i mtshams su gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ brjed byed kyi nad la 'gram pa gnyis kyi mtshams na yod pa'i rtsa la gdab po/ / yang na kun la smin mtshams gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ sngar bshad pa'i nad mgo dang mig la sogs pa'i nad ma lus pa kun la/ smin mtshams kyi bar na yod pa'i rtsa gang yin pa de la gdab par bya'o/ / 'bras dang rtsib logs zug pa la/ / rtsib logs nu ma'i bar rtsa gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ 'bras mched pa'i nad dang / rtsib logs gnyis su zug cing gzer ba'i nad la rtsib logs dang / nu ma'i bar na yod pa'i rtsar gdab par bya'o/ / nyin gsum pa la phrag mtshams gdab/ / nyin bzhi pa la ltag pa'i 'og / ces bya ba la/ rims nyin gsum pa la phrag pa gnyis kyi bar mtshams kyi nang gi rtsar gdab par bya'o/ / rims nyin bzhi pa la ni ltag pa'i 'og na gnas pa'i rtsa gang rung bar gdab par bya'o/ /

skt: apacyāṃ gaṇḍamārāyāmiṃdarabastevaikakṣaṇādhastāt‌ dathaṅguṭe śirāṃ mokṣayet‌
tib: tshad pas 'khru bas nye bar gtses shing gzer dang ldan pa dag la mjug to'i rtsa mjug ma sor gnyis gong du gzhal bar gdab par bya'o/ /

skt: śukāmaye śukaravyāpadi bhedrāmaye nivṛtopadadādike bheda liṅge sthitāṃ śirāṃ vyadhayet‌
tib: khu ba 'gags pa la sogs pa'i nad dang pho mtshan nyid kyi nad la ni/

lkog mar lba ba skye ba'i nad la brla'i rtsa bar gnas pa'i rtsa la gtar ga bya'o/ / gzugs 'khums pus mthil 'og gam ni/ / gong gi sor bzhi pa la gdab/ / ces bya ba rlung gi nad gzugs 'khums shing 'jas pa la ni/ pus mo'i mthil gyi 'og dang / gong du sor bzhi gzhal bar gdab par bya'o/ /

skt: gaṅaṇḍayorasapanne vyādhau 'ramūrasaṃsthitāṃ ścisaṃ nidhyet‌
tib: 'bras kyi phreng ba'i nad la ni/ byin ba'i nya gnad ces bya ba'i 'og sor gnyis gzhal bar gtar ga gdab po/ /

skt: pādadāhe vātanyādhau suḍe vātakṣoṇite bāte vipāṃ vipādikāyāṃ bātakaṇṭake bātavyādhau niṣpe'ṅīkaroge kṣatarogāparapayoye eteṣu pādrogeṣu śṣipramamīṇi upāraṣṭāda dthaṅgula śirāṃ vidhyet‌
tib: rkub tshos kyi rlung nad dam/ pus mo'i lhang steng gi nad la long mo ltag tu sor bzhi bcal bar gtar ga bya'o/ / rkang tsha 'theng dang sbrid pa dang / / rting rdol rlung nad mdzer pa dang / / rkang sor snags su chad pa la/ / rgya tshigs las gong sor gnyis gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ rlung gi nad rkang pa tsha ba zhes bya ba dang / rkang pa sbrid pa dang / rting pa rdol ba rlung nad kyi mdzer pa dang / rkang pa'i sor mo snags su chad pa zhes bya ba'i khrag las gyur pa'i sor mo'i nad rnams la/ rgya tshigs las gong du sor gnyis gzhal bar gdab par bya'o/ / 'khums la rkang 'khums lta bur gdab/ / ces bya ba la/

pus mo'i gong sor bzhi par gdab par bya'o/ / ji skad bshad pa ma mngon na/ / gnad ma gtogs par gar nye ba'i/ / phyogs gzhan dag tu gtar ga gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ gong du ji skad bshad pa'i rtsa rnams mngon par ma gyur na/ nad 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i dbang gis nad pa la gtar ga rings par bya dgos na/ gnad ma gtogs shing gnad la ma phog par/ nad gang dang gdab pa nye zhing 'brel ba'i phyogs gzhan dag gi rtsa bshad pa dag kyang mngon na gdab par bya'o/ / de nas lus snum gtar ga yi/ / yo byad kun bsags stobs dang ldan/ / bkra shis byas shing kha zas ni/ / snum zos khu ba 'thungs pa dang / / me dang nyi tshan gyis dugs byas/ / pus mnyam mtho ba'i stan la 'dug /

de nas zhes bya ba'i don ni/ bkra shis pa'i don yin par shes par bya'o/ / gtar ga bya ba'i skyes bu snum gyis zhen par bya ba dang / sman pas gtar ba la dgos pa'i yo byad kun bsag cing nyer bsdogs su bya ba dang / de bzhin du stobs dang ldan zhing nyam chung ba la ma yin pa dang / dge slong dang bram ze bkra shis dang bde legs brjod pa dang / de bzhin du kha zas snum zhing sha khu la sogs pa dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du me tshan dang / nyi tshan gyis dugs bya ba dang / pus mo dang mnyam pa tsam gyi mtho ba'i stan la 'dug pa dang de bzhin du skra'i rtsa ba ras kyi tshal pa 'jam pos bcings shing bsdams pa dang / de bzhin du pus mo gnyis kyi lha ngar gru mo brtan po btsugs nas/ rang gi khu tshur nang du gos kyi glod bcug pas/ mgul pa'i ngos gnyis nas dam du btsir bar bya ba dang / de bzhin du so bsdams shing btsir la mkhur ba gnyis su de gnas par bya'o/ /

skt: rirāṃ biyet‌ gṛbhasyābhiva jānuno'dhtā- | hitāni sarvāṇi samastāni rirānyadhavikīṣākācvaturaṅgure
tib: nad pa de la skyes bu gzhan gyis rgyab nas btsir zhing bsdams pa dang / gos kyis dkris pa ltag par bcug nas/ lkog ma dang gos kyi bar du lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub mo bcug nas dbugs dgag pa la mi gnod pas de bsdam par bya'o/ /

skt: abhamigukhenonnamitasupāra tādeśe vitataṃ daṣaṃ viśeṣeṇa daṣṭa dantairṃ jihyāyā yena tasyā- : nnamitavideṣṭajihāprasyādho jihṭhāyāstadāśrayāṃ jahyā- ` śrayāṃ śiraṃ dhidhyat‌
tib: bsdam pa'i cho gar bshad pa gang yin pa de ni rtsa kha phyi rol du bltas pa bsdam pa'i cho ga yin gyi/ kha nang du bltas pa'i rtsa bsdam pa'i cho gar bshad pa ni ma yin no/ /

de ltar byas pa'i 'og tu sman pas mthe bo'i sor mo las gung mo btang bar gyur bas rtsa la gdab par bya'o/ / rtsa de byung zhing g.yo bar gyur pa reg pas shes par bya ba'am/ mthe bos mnan pas shes par bya'o/ / de'i 'og tu gtsags bu sta re lta bus rtsa'i dbus mtshan ma btab la/ lag pa g.yon pas gzung ba'i gtsags bu sta re ltar yu ba gyen du bstan te/ lag pa 'dar ba med bar byas la/ snga ma bzhin du mthe bo las gung mo btong ba'i bem rtol brdabs pas khrag dbyung bar bya ba'am/ /
sna dang nye ba na gnas pa'i rtsar gdab pa na/ sna'i rtse mo mthe bos bteg nas gtsags bu rtse mo 'bras 'dra bas gdab par bya'o/ /

skt: yantrayediti | stanayo rūvasupari nara yantrayan‌ vasmeṇa veṣṭayet‌ garīvādhritadiṣya vidhyet‌
tib: lce bteg cing bzlog pa'i ste/ rkan gyi thog tu bsdus la/ sos rnam par mnan nas/

skt: grīvārisam‌ vyaghananimite pāpāṇagabhahastasya pāṣrāṇagarbhā hasno yasya tathācidhasya jānusdha dhāhau prahata prasārite anākruścite śirāṃ dhidhyena | tathā karakṣesaramya mṛdite maditi tasmin‌ bhuje caraṃ ūdhvaṃ paṭako yasya tasmina tathāvidhe śirāṃ vidhyet‌
tib: nu ma yan chad ras kyis legs par bsdams nas mgul par gnas pa'i rtsar gdab cing gtar ga bya'o/ / lag pa gnyis su rdo bcangs te/ / lag pa pus mor brten te bcangs/ / mchan khung man chad mnyes nas ni/ / gong du bcings la lto rtsar gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ lag pa gnyis kyi nang du rdo ba bcangs pa de lta bu'i lag pa pus mor brten te brkyang ba dang / de bzhin du mchan khung man chad legs par mnyes te/
lag ngar gnyis kyi rtsar gdab pa ni/ dang po bde bar 'dug ste/ gar gdab pa'i sa sor bzhi'i gong du ras kyis dam por bcings la/ mthe bo chang par bcug nas sor mo rnams kyis bsdams te/

rtsib logs gnyis su gtar ga gdab pa/ dang por nad pa'i dpung pa gnyis thur du dpyangs la gdab par bya'o/ / pho mtshan rtsa ni bteg ste gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ pho mtshan gyi rtsa ni bteg cing las su rud bar byas nas

skt: pādrirāṃ vidhyet‌ | pāde sthite sthāpite sati jāgha̱sandheradhastāt‌ karābhyāṃ gāḍhamyartha chatavānipīḍite caraṇe pāde'ṅgukhyāṃ yāvat‌ tasya pādasyopari praṣaṭhe dvitīye caraṇe pāde kuccite kithvitasaṅkonite phiñvidārūḍhe daiṣassthāpite hasta. badavadūṣvā vedhyapradeśasyopari caturaṅgule pūvaibat‌ paṣṭikāṃ baddhvā diśaṃ nidhyet‌
davthamasena prakāreṇa bhaandhāsukateṣvapi teṣu deśeṣu tattadachuktamapi buddhā kaspayet‌ yantrasupāyavidraiyaḥ
tib: byin pa'i rtsa ni pus mo ma bkug par brkyang ste gdab par bya'o/ / rkang pa legs bzhag pus mo la/ / 'og tu lag pa gnyis kyis ni/ / long mo'i bar du dam btsir la/ / rkang pa de steng gnyis pa ni/ / cung zad bkug ste bzhag pa yis/ / mnan la de nas lag pa ltar/ / rtsar gdab/ ces bya ba la/ rkang pa'i rtsar gdab pa'i thabs ni/ de yang rkang pa legs par bzhag la/ bus mo'i tshigs kyi 'og tu/ lag pa gnyis kyis dam du long mo'i bar du btsir la/ rkang pa de'i steng du rkang pa gnyis cung zad bkug ste bzhag la/ cung zad tsam mnan nas sngar lag pa'i rtsar 'debs pa bzhin du gtar ga gdab pa'i 'og tu sor bzhi tsam gyi ras la sogs pas dam du bsdams la rtsar gdab par bya'o/ / de ltar ma smos pa'i/ gzhan dgal yang gdab bya la/ / thabs shes gtsags spyad de dang des/ / phyogs ni de dang de ru gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ de ltar rnam pa de dag gis rtsar gdab pa'i gnas ma smos pa'i phyogs gzhan dag la yang gdab par bya ba yin pas na/ thabs shes shing rtogs pa'i sman pas/ gtsags spyad de dang de rang gi blos legs par dpags la gnas kyi phyogs de dang der gdab par bya'o/ /

skt: māṃsacha bīhyavakāre trīhayāsyaṃ śakhaṃ brīhimātrakaṃ brīhipramāṇaṃ śiyaṃ vidhyan‌ ryo niśṣivet‌ | asthnāsupari yavā yathābhramāṇaṃ ści vidhyan‌ śakhamādyu pātayet‌ 11 42 ||
tib: sha che ba'i phyogs su 'bras 'dra ba'i gtsags bus 'debs par byed na/ gtsags bu dbyibs 'bras 'dra zhing 'bras kyi tshad tsam gdab par bya'o/ / rus pa'i steng rtsa la 'debs na sta re 'dra ba'i gtsags bus nang du nas kyi phyed tsam nub par gdab par bya'o/ / gtar ga gdab pa thams cad la yang kha sbub pas shin tu gting ring bar mi bya ba dang / drang zhing ma 'chol ba dang / snyoms shing gnod pa med par rtsa dbus su gtsags bus myur du gdab par bya'o/ / legs par btab nas

skt: sabhyagaviddhe vedhe chate sati dhārāṃ saran‌ tathā yantrai mukte sati na sakhapet‌ raktya vyadha dāyam‌ | tathāca sañprahe ekaprakābhidatā dhāraḥ: savedekayuhūte ruddhvā tiṣṭhecca sā samyak‌ bhida vriṭuḥ
tib: de ltar gtar legs par btab nas khrag gi rgyun gzags par bya'i/ / chings ma bkrol nas ni khrag gi rgyun yang gzags par mi bya'o/ / de yang bsdus pa las/ lan cig btab pas khrag gi rgyun/ / gang zhig 'dzag par gyur pa na/ / yud tsam bsdams pa byas pa ni/ / de ni legs par btab ces bya/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / btab ma legs pas dus cung zad/ / nyung zad 'byung ba til phye gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ gtar ga btab pa ma legs te/ nyes par gyur pas dus cung zad cig khrag gi rgyun nyung zad 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de la til zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma rtsa'i sgor gdab par bya'o/ /

gtar ga btab pa med pa'am/ drags pa'i khrag gi rgyun sgra dang bcas par 'gyur la/ rgyun 'byung ba de gcad cing dgag pa yang shin tu dka' bar 'gyur ro/ / dngang dang 'bog par 'gyur ba dang / chings lhod mtshon rtul 'grangs drags dang / nyam chung shugs nyen dugs ma byas/ /

skt: samyraparadatta rateḥ sati piramukhe koṣṇābhyāṃ | sapupajātāthāṃ tasya vimucya yantaraṃ vyajaknairbījite vaṇābhyāṃ didyapayet‌
tib: legs par btab tu zin kyang / dngang ba dang 'bog cing brgyal bar 'gyur ba ni/ khrag gi rgyun mi 'byung ba'i rgyu yin no/ / de la dngang ba ni skrag pa'o/ / 'bog pa ni brgyal zhing mun par zhugs pa lta bur gyur pa'o/ /
khrag legs par ma byung zhing gtar ga nyes par gyur na/ byi dang ga dang tsha ba gsum la sogs pa btags pas rtsa'i sgo bsku bar bya ste/

skt: vātācchayāvāraṇādiyuktaṃ sasbhavati | śyāvaṃ | cyāvavaṇaim‌ | araṇaṃ ṭhohitavarṇam‌ | rukṣamabhnigdham‌ | vegaścāti canena niryāti | acchaṃ tasu pheniram‌
tib: khrag legs par 'byung zhing rgyu bar gyur na/ bad kan dang rlung nye bar zhi zhing khrag gcad par bya ba'i phyir til mar dang rgyam tshar sbyar la/

gtar ga btab ba ni khrag bzang ngan 'dres pa la/ dang por nad dang bcas pa'i khrag dbyung zhing 'bab par gyur te/ dper na leb rgan rtsi'i tshon ser po dang dmar po 'dres par gyur pa la/ gos 'tshod pa na dang po ser po 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang 'dra'o/ /

legs par btab ste 'byung ba rang nyid 'chad par 'gyur la de ltar rang chad nas dbyung bar mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du khrag bzang po nad med par gyur nas kyang dbyung bar mi bya ste/ khrag ni srog gi rten yin ba'i phyir ro/ / brgyal gyur na ni chings ma dgrol/ / rlung yab kyis g.yab slar khrag dbyung / / slar 'bog gyur na nyi ma ni/ / gnyis pa'am gsum pa dag la gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ gang zhig khrag gzags nas brgyal bar gyur na/ gtar ga'i chings ma de bkrol la/ rlung yab kyis rlung g.yabs te/ brgyal ba de bsangs te/ de'i 'og tu slar khrag dbyung bar bya'o/ / de ltar byas kyang slar 'bog par gyur na/ de tshe bcad la nyi ma gnyis pa'am/

skt: kaphādasak‌ snigdhapāṇḍu pāṇḍuvarṇītantumat‌ | = pa0~yasmādatikhutau atyathanidairaṇena raktasya tantuyuktam‌ | picchiraṃ viśadviparītam‌ | dhane | mṛlyumaraṇaṃ syādbhavet‌| athavā dārūṇaṅccharā jasādhyāsram‌
tib: de la rlung gi nad las ni khrag mdog gnag pa la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ gnag pa ni nag nog can la cung zad tsam sngo ba'o/ / dmar ba ni rtsa dmar zhing 'tsher ba'o/ / rtsub pa ni snum bag med pa'o/ / shugs drag po ni shugs kyis 'byung ba'o/ / mdog gsal ba ni gsal ba'o/ / lbu ba can ni lbu ba dang bcas pa'o/ / de bzhin du mkhris pa las gyur pa'i khrag ni mdog ser ba dang / gnag par gyur pa dang / mnam zhing dri nga ba dang / spyi bag ste tsha bas 'thas shing mkhrang bag tu 'gas pa dang / dro zhing tsha ba 'ur 'ur por 'dug pa dang / tshon can te rma bya'i mjug sgro ltar snang ba yin no/ / bad kan las gyur pa'i nad khrag la ni 'jam zhing snum pa dang / mdog skya ba dang / rgyun can nal nal po kha 'dra bar snang ba dang / 'byar zhing sla bag med pa dang / ska zhing 'dril ba yin no/ / 'dres pa ni nad gzhi gnyis kyi ldan pa las gyur pa'i khrag ste/ de ni 'dren ma ste/ gang dang gang 'dres pa de gnyi ga'i mtshan ma dang 'dres pa zhes bya'o/ / nad gzhi'i nyes pa gsum char 'dus pa'i khrag gang yin pa de ni dri ma can te/ dang bag med pa dang / rnyog pa dang ldan zhing nag nog gi shas che ba yin no/ /

skyes bu nyams che ba zhig yin na yang / khrag ngan pa'am/ nad khrag tshad de srang bcu drug pas dbyung bar mi bya ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ khrag dbyung zhing gzags pa drags na myur du 'chi bar 'gyur ba'am/ yang na rlung nad shin tu gso dka' ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /

skt: saṃsargādoṣahayāt‌ saṃsaṣṭaliṅgaṃ bhiścarakṣaṇa- sakṣīrapānaṃ tathā hariṇājosbhrādīnāṃ risaṃ badṛdhvā madak‌ bhavati | dvidopalikgabhiti yāvat‌
tib: khrag bton drags pa de la sman ni/ bsku byug bya ba dang / 'o ma dang sha khu blud pa dang / dang ra lug la sogs pa'i khrag bton te blud par bya'o/ / khrag phyung nas ni chings ma dag /

skt: doṣatrayasaṃsaṣṭa̱ṃyadrakata̭ṃtanmaṭhinamaniramaṃ | pa0-khute rakte nigaite śoṇite śanamandaṃ vā tathā''vilaṃ kaddha bhadhati
tib: khrag dbyung zhing gzags nas chings ma dal gyis klod de bkrol la/ chu bsil bas khrag rjes bkrus la/ / rtsa'i sgo til mar gyis byugs pa'i gos 'jam pos rma kha g.yogs la/

skt: aśrudadhau sapyāṃ raktasya bhūyaḥ punarapi sāyamaparahe srāvayet‌ | apare vāhi dvitīyasmin‌, divase sāvayet‌
nehenoparcharṛtasya dehasya saṃśkarutaśasarasya puraḥ bhaśadūpitamatythaṃ duṣṭaṃ raktaṃ pakādudhvamanantaraṃ punaḥ srāvayet‌
tib: khrag ma dag cing nad yod par gyur na/ phyi 'phred kyis slar yang dbyung bar bya'o/ / yang na phyi de nyin de/ nyi ma gnyis par bskyar bar bya'o/ / shin tu gnod pa'i khrag yod na zla ba phyed nas snum gyis brta zhing zhen par bya ba'i lus las dbyung bar bya'o/ /

skt: hi yasmāda | yasmāt‌ kiśviccheṣe duṣṭāraṃ neva rogo duṣṭartodadhavo syādhirativaraite | pariyā pathamatikramya mārgāntaramasau nāsādayatyato du mapi raktaṃ sajañeṣe na syāt‌ khatimācaret‌ | tenaiḥ tadapi ghata ne kuyaut‌ | prāṇāthatanaghvāt‌ | tathā suśrata “ktaṃ saśeṣadoṣa tu buyaudapi vicakṣaṇaḥ nacātiprañacate kuyaccheṣaṃ saṃdāmanaijaṃyet‌||| saśeṣaduṣṭasa dhire na vyādhirabhivatete | tasmātsaśeṣaṃ sthātavyaṃ ; hi kuyādatikriyām‌?
tib: gang gi phyir khrag nad can ngan pa cung zad lus par gyur kyang / de las byung ba'i nad lhag par mi bskyed cing bya ba la rgal te/ gnas gzhan du mi 'gro bas de'i phyir lhag ma cung zad yod du zin kyang shas cher mi 'byung gi / lhag ma dang bcas par gzhag ste/ / khrag ni srog gi rten yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de yang drang srong legs mthong gis/ / mkhas pas nad bcas khrag kyang ni/ / lhag ma cung zad yod bya yi/ / lhag par dbyung bar mi bya ste/ / lhag ma zhi bas bsal bar bya/ / nad khrag lhag ma cung zad lus/ / nad ni shas cher mi skyed de/ de bas lhag mar bcas gzhag gi /

nad khrag lhag ma lus pa de/ rngabs rwa gdab pa la sogs pas bsal bar bya ba'am/ yang na spyod lam bsil ba ste/ chu bsil ba blugs pa la sogs pas khrag dang mkhris pa bsal zhing gso ba'i thabs dang zas dang sman snum pa dang / mngar ba bsten pa dang sbyang ba ste/ slon dang khrus kyi tshul dang / skam pa ste/ smyung bar gnas pa la sogs pa'i bye brag gi gso bas dang bar bya zhing bsal bar bya'o/ /

nad khrag shin tu rgyas shing rab tu gyur pa la'ang / spyod lam bsil bar bya ba la sogs pa de dag gis gso bar bya zhing dang bar bya'o/ / nad khrag rgyas par gyur pa la ni gtar ga gdab pa la sogs pa khrag dbyung ba'i thabs kyis dbyung bar bya'o/ /

skt: sutaśeṣaṃ duṣṭaṃ rudhiraṃ haret‌ khāvayet‌ | śaṅgādibhiḥ śaṅgatumbajarakambhratibhiḥ

tib: khrag gi rgyun byung ba ma chod cing bde bar gnas par ma gyur na/ gcad pa'i sbyor ba myur zhing rings par bya'o/ / seng phrom rma shing pri yang ku/ / ma sha shing mngar yug snam btsag / gyo du ma zar ma snag tsha dang / / 'o ma can shing shun lo ma/ / btags pa'i phye ma rma khar gdab/ / shug sogs chu grang sbyar la blud/ / ces bya ba la/ de ltar khrag gcad par bya ba'i phyir/ seng phrom la sogs pa'i phye ma rma'i sgor gdab pa dang / shug pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan dang sbyar ba'i chu grang blud par bya'o/ / 'o ma can gyi shing ni n+ya gro d+ha dang / / a shwad+tha la sogs pa'i shun pa dang lo ma'o/ / gzhan ni go bar zad do/ / yang na rtsa btab de gong gi /

skt: roghrādimiścūrṇaukataiḥ vraṇamukhaṃ vicūṇayet‌| padyakādigaṇadime śītaṃ kaṣāyaṃ pibet‌ | stambhanāya| sedhraḥ parakiyeraḥ | riyaṃgugaindhagriyaṃguḥ | pataṅgaḥ padraraṅgaḥ | māṣā; dibhvidhānyam‌ | yaṣṭayāhaṃ madhuyaṣṭā | akhane rasā lanam‌ | dhīsvukṣāṇāṃ vaṭānāṃ saco'kurādiṃśca | kisayukhaṃ vā tvaritaṃ det‌ | tacchalākayā tāmeva yā śirāṃ prāgviddhauṃ tasmātta bharakūvyadhādanantasmanyavahitaṃ vidhyet‌ | sarvathānrāva tiṣṭhamāne śigadvāra svaritaṃ ktvā adhadhitā pratra yā śalākayā dahet‌ saṃkocayituṃ kirama
tib: gcad pa'i sbyor ba gzhan yang sngar bcad pa'i rtsa de nyid kyi gong rol du gtar ga gdab par bya'o/ / yang rnam pa thams cad du khrag chod par ma gyur na/

gtar ga'i bcing ba nyes shing ma legs pa rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan gyi nad gang rang gi gnas nas rgal te/ lam log par gnas pas na khrag tu gyur pa de rang gi gnas su phyin par ma gyur cing / rang gi lam gnas par ma gyur pa de srid kyi bar du zas dang spyod lam la sogs pa phan zhing gnod pa med pa la brten par bya'o/ / lus dang ngag dang yid kyi spyod pa la 'dir spyod lam zhes bya'o/ /

khrag dbyung zhing gzags nas zas dang skom shin tu tsha ba dang / shin tu grang ba na gnod pa yin te/ shin tu tsha na ni slar khrag bskyed par 'gyur la/ shin tu grang ba ni me drod nyams par byed pa yin te/ de bas na gnyi ga ma yin pa bsten pa dang / de bzhin du rang bzhin gyis g.yos su byas pa'i bza' btung dang / pho ba'i me'i drod bskyed pa'i zas skom yang sbyin par bya ste/ gang gi phyir de'i tshe lus la bde bar mi gnas pas yang de ni mkhris pa'i gnas yin la/ mkhris pa ni mes bskyed de/ de'i phyir khyad par du me las bsrung bar bya zhing rnam pa du mas bskyang bar bya'o/ / mdog dang dbang po gsal zhing dbang po yul/ / 'dod cing zas 'ju shugs kyang bde bar 'ju/ / bde dang ldan zhing stobs rgyas phun sum tshogs/ / mi yi nad khrag dag pa yin par bshad/ / ces bya ba la/ skyes bu 'di lta bu nad khrag med pa yin par drang srong rnams kyis bshad cing bstan to/ / de yang skyes bu de'i lus kyi mdog dang / dbang po rnams gsal zhing dang ba'i bdag nyid can yin pa dang / de nyid ni dbang po'i yul 'dod cing yul la dga' ba dang / zas 'ju ba ni pho ba'i me drod la bya la/ de'i shugs ni nus pa la bya ste/ zas 'ju ba de thogs pa med pa dang / zil gyis mi non par bde bar 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du bde ba dang ldan pa ste/ nad med pa dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin du stobs dang lus rgyas pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i mi ni nad khrag yongs su dag pa yin no zhes bshad do/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa/ tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas nye bar sbyar ba las/

tib: pags pa la sogs pa nas gnas kyi nang du mtshon gyi dum bu lus pa dag sngar bstan pa'i mtshan nyid de dag las shes par bya ba 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi rang rang gi gnas las ji ltar 'dzag pa las kyang zug rngu yod par shes par bya'o/ / skyon med lus kyi rma 'tsho ste/ / de ni gnod pa med par gnas/ / nad 'khrugs snad pa la sogs kyis/ / gongs nas slar yang gnod pa skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ skyes bu lus la nad kyi skyon med pa'i zug rngu de rjes mthun par gnas pa dag gi rma yang 'tsho bar byed cing gnod pa med par 'gyur mod kyi/ rma 'tsho zin nas kyang nad gzhi 'khrugs pa dang / snad pa dang / rtsol bas bskyod pa la sogs pa'i dbang gis glongs pa dang / slar yang lus la gnod pa skyed cing nad du 'gyur ba yin no/ / gang yang rung bar pags pa nyams/ / bsku dang mnye dang dugs byas nas/ / mdog dmar na zhing tsha la 'khrug /

skt: vvaci śalye naṣa'varayanaṃ prapra yatra sayarīrapradaśe'bhyajgādibhisatvaci prayuktaiḥ rāgaraṇdādasaṃrammohivayavedanādādakṣomāḥ syuḥ bhaveyuḥ | tatsthānaṃ sasyavajjānīyāt‌ | tatra̱ cājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ syānaṃ sītaṃ nihitaṃ vidīyate yatra vā cheṣapa āśru gupyati tatra śaralyamādirot‌
tib: zug rngu pags pa'i nang du zug cing mi mngon par 'gyur ba ni lus kyi phyogs gang du zug par pags pa nyams pa dang / bsku ba la sogs pa byas pas ni mdog dmar ba dang / na zhing zug pa dang / tsha ba dang 'khrug cing bskyod pa na na bar 'gyur te/ de lta bu'i gnas de ni/ zug rngu dang bcas pa yin par shes par bya'o/ / yang na pags pa'i phyogs gang du na sar mar bzhag na myur du 'ju bar 'gyur pa'am/ lde gus byugs pa myur du bskams par gyur na/

zug rngu sha'i nang du lus pa mi snang bar gyur pa ni sbyang ba bya ba ste/ slon sman dang bkru sman la sogs pa byas pas lus bskam zhing sbeg par byas la/ skems par byas pa des lhongs shing yang bag tu gyur pa dang bskul ba dang / btsan dmar po yod pa dang / na ba la sogs pa'i zug rngu yod par shes par bya'o/ /

de lta na yang zug rngu dbyung bar ma nus na/ mde'u'i rtsa ba dam du bkug la/ gzhu rgyud kyi phyogs gcig la dam du btags shing bcings te/ gzhu rgyud kyi phyogs gcig rta srab kyi kha lcags kyi yang mig la sman pas gzhan du ma yengs par dam du btags te/ rta'i yan lag lnga po legs par bsdams shing dul bar byas shing de'i 'og tu rta lcag gis gzhus na/ ci nas kyang mgo drag tu bteg pa'i shugs kyis zug rngu 'byin par nus pa de ltar bya'o/ /

tib: zug rngu rgya skyegs can dag gre ba'i sbubs las gdon pa'i thabs ni/ cha spyad sbubs can gre bar bcug la/ gre ba'i tshigs pa bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir/ chu bsil mo lcags bsregs pa'i thur ma la blugs pas de gdon par bya'o/ / rgya skyegs med pa'i zug rngu yang lcags bsregs pa'i thur ma'i rtse rgya skyegs kyis bsgos pa'i smyig ma'am/

skra'i tshogs bsdus pa'i gong bu ni skra shad 'dzings pa zhes bya la de 'thungs pa dang / gsher ba'i rtswas chu la sogs pa'i tsher ma ste/ nya rus sam/ gzhan yang de lta bu'i rus pa'i zug rngu dbyung zhing gdon par bya'o/ / de yang 'phral du ste/ de'i mod srad bu la zug rngu thogs par gyur pas de slon par bya zhing / srad bu'i phyogs gcig tu zug rngu 'byar ba de drang bar bya'o/ / yang tsher ma des ni cig shos te/ skra shad de drang bar bya ste/ / srad bu btags shing gsher bag 'thungs pas slon par bya'o/ / kha snar drang bar ma nus na/

gal te kha snar gyen du zug rngu drang bar ma nus na/ gzhan du na thur du mid cing nang du drang bar bya'o/ / zhes bya ba'i don to/ / zas kyis brnangs pa'i zug rngu ni/ / chu btung phrag par brdegs pas gzhug / ces bya ba la/ zas kyis brnangs shing lkog mar chags pa'i kha zas nyid ni zug rngu 'byed bsad pas zug rngu zhes bya la/ de ni chu btung bar phrag par khu tshur brdeg pas nang du zhugs par bya'o/ / mig gi rma yi zug rngu phra/
