skt: śasyāni dhātuviṣāṇaveṣvādijāni | rāstaḍmāṃsādayaḥ| yaṃtrāṇi chastikādīni | teṣāṃ rūpatāmavekṣya nānākāratāṃ jñātā taisterūpāyarupa toikañānasādhanai; kārautimān‌ bhiṣadarū jārya rādyaṃ tathā''kardhaditi | saṃgrahe coktam‌ | caraṇe pratiṣa nātikhaśausadiṣṇuṣ | jasye śoke ca tāpe niḥrālyamiti nirdiroditi rālyāhaṇabhidhiḥ || 6 iti śrīgaragāṃkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitābhā maṣṭāgahṛdayadīkāyāṃ sarvāgasuṃdaraśyāyāmaṣṭāviro'dhyāyaḥ
tib: sa la sogs pa'i zug rngu dag kyang lus kyi me drod kyis 'ju bar nus pa yin no/ / rwa dang 'od tshal lcags ta la/ / shing tshal zug rngu ring pos kyang / / phal cher de dag tshos 'gyur la/ / khrag dang sha yis tshos par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ rwa'i zug rngu dang 'od ma'i zug rngu dang shing gi zug rngu phal che ba dag kyang lus kyi mes tshos shing 'drul bar 'gyur ro/ / de dag kyang sha dang khrag gis tshos shing 'ju bar byed do/ / zug rngu sha yi gting du zug /

zug rngu'i rnam pa sha'i gting du zug cing nang du zug pa ni lus kyi yan lag gi phyogs de tsha zhing tshos par 'gyur te/ der gnas pa'i zug rngu ste mnye ba la sogs pa'i thabs kyis smin par byas nas dbyung bar mi bya'o/ / mnye ba ni lag pas mnye ba'o/ / bkru snan dang slon sman la sogs pas sbyang ba dang / smyung ba la sogs pas sha dbri ba dang / sha dbri thabs la sogs pas brta ba dang / sman tsha zhing rno bas bcing ba dang / zas skom rnon po sbyin pa dang / mtshon gyis btab cing gtsags pas snang bar byas nas dang po thabs de bzhin du de dag gis smin par byas la/ de'i 'og tu rma 'dral ba dang / chu tshol gyis btsal ba dang / dbye zhing gshags pas zug rngu de dbyung bar bya'o/ /

skt: śalyāni viṣāṇakhaṇḍādīni | pradeśāḥ ṅmāṃsādyaḥ | yantrāṇi svastikayantrādīni ` baḍrūpatāmaveṣya jñātvā taistairapāyaśaktānutau ja sādhanahaitubhimaṃtimān‌ buddhimān‌ śya vidyā' nāyāt‌ | tathā''haredākarpataistairapāyauśete bhadrama iti śrīcandranandananirsacatāyāṃ padāthacandrikāyāmaṣṭāṅgahṭadayadīkāyāṃ sutrasthāne rāsyāderṇāvedhareṭāviro'dhyāyaḥ
tib: zug rngu de rwa dang 'od ma la sogs pa gnas te/ zug pa'i gnas pags pa dang / sha la sogs pa dang cha spyad ces cha spyad bkra shis la sogs pa de rnams kyi tshul mang po'am/ rnam pa sna tshogs pas legs par brtags te shes par byas la blo dang ldan pa'i mkhas pas 'dir bshad pa dang / ma bshad pa'i thabs dang de'i bye brag shes par byas la/ zug rngu'i rnam pa yang ji ltar gnas pa shes par bya ba dang / de bzhin du de dang de nyid kyis dbyung zhing gdon par bya'o/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa/ tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas rnam par sbyar ba las/ /
/ / de nas gtar ga gdab pa'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /

'dir bshad pa ni 'di yin te/ zug rngu la la ni dbral nas dbyung bar bya'o/ / zhes gong du bshad pas de'i phyir de'i 'og tu 'di brtsams pa yin no/ / gtsags spyad kyis gtar ga gdab cing rma'i las su bya ba byed pas na gtar ga gdab pa'i las te/

rma'i mtshan nyid phal cher mang du dang po skrangs shing smin pa las rma 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de bas na skrangs pa de nyid gso zhing zhi bar bya ba dang / smin par 'gyur ba las bsrung bar bya ste/ ci nas kyang skrangs pa de smin cing rnags par mi 'gyur ba de ltar 'bad pa dang ldan pas bsrung bar bya'o/ / de ji ltar bsrung bar bya zhe na/ de ni bsil dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ skrangs pa de tsan+dan gyi lde gu la sogs pa bsil sman gyis byug pa dang / bsil sman la sogs pa'i chu'i rgyun blugs pa dang / de bzhin du gtar ga gdab cing khrag dbyung ba dang / skyugs sman dang bkru sman la sogs pa btang bas legs par sbyang bar byas la/ rlung la sogs pa'i nad dmigs ji lta ba dang mthun pa'i gso dpyad kyis smin cing rnags par gyur pa las bsrung bar bya'o/ /

skt: pakte tasmin‌ śvayathāvalpavegitā vabhi saṃ mmādadaunam‌ | tathā schāniḥ pramḍānatā | ta pāṇḍutā pāṇḍuvṇetvam‌ | bisambhavau bayi tathā nāmo'nteṣu payainteṣu' nāmo ninnasvama madhye madhyapradeśe unnatirannatatā uśairatvam‌ | ta kaṇḍūrophādīnāṃ mādaivamaspatā | rṇe preyaḥ saścāro bhavedrastāvivāmmasa udakasya bhavati |'
tib: thor bu'am skrangs pa'i tshabs chung ba dang / drod dam tsha bar shas chung ba dang / de bzhin mdog ni 'dra ba ste/ pags pa'i mdog ma nyams shing mnyam pa dang / sra zhing mnyen bag med pa dang / brtan zhing mi yo bar gnas pa yin no/ / smin tshe mdog ni 'gyur ba dang / / dmar zhing rkyal bu'i dbyibs ltar 'dug /

skrangs par gyur pa de smin par byed pa'i tshe ni/ mdog 'gyur zhing pags pa'i mdog dang mi 'dra ba dang / de bzhin du mdog rtsa dmar dang / rkyal bu'i dbyibs ltar 'dug ste/ rlung gis khengs shing mi 'gyur bar gnas pas na rkyal pa bus pa lta bur 'dug pa dang de bzhin du gas pa lta bu ste/ bcag pa'am bkas pa lta bu'i tshul dang ldan pa dang / nad dang bcas pa de khab kyis gtsags pa snyam du sems pa dang / de bzhin du yan lag thams cad glal 'byung ba dang bcas par gnas pas lus grugs shing dkrum pa lta bur sems pa dang de bzhin du lus 'khrugs pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa ste/ 'khrugs pa ni tshig brjod par mi nus pa'i nad kyi tshor ba rang gi nyams kyis myong ba'i tshul du ma dang ldan pa'i khams 'khrugs pa'i nad 'byung ba'o/ / tsha ba ni lus dang yan lag thams cad mi bzad par tsha ba'o/ / yi ga 'chus pa ni zas la 'dod pa med cing / mngon par mi dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / rims kyis 'debs pa dang / skom dad kyis gdungs pa dang / gnyid med cing yer ba ste/ de dag dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du mar 'khyags shing 'thas par gyur pa de'i steng du bzhag na 'ju bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du rma byung ba ltar skrangs pa smin par byed pa de'i tshe/ reg na mi bzod pa yin no/ / smin gyur na ba'i shugs chung zhing / / rnyid cing skya la

skrangs pa de smin cing rnags par gyur na na ba'i shugs chung ba ste/ nad kyi rtsom pa shas chung ba dang / de bzhin du rnyid cing snyi ba dang / mdog skya zhing dkar ba dang / gnyer ma'i tshogs 'du ba dang / de bzhin du mtha' ma thog thag 'jum zhing dma' la dbus ma'i phyogs mtho zhing 'phags par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du g.ya' ba dang / skrangs pa la sogs pa chung zhing zhi ba dang / rkyal pa'i nang du chu blugs pa ltar gnas shing / reg cing mnan na rnag gi tshogs phan tshun rgyu zhing 'khrugs pa yin no/ /

skt: anikhādṛte vātaṃ vinā tasmin‌ pāke śrasyoyadṭhiḥ | pittāhate pittaṃ vinā na daṣṭaḥ janma | kaphodyādṛte kaphodyaṃ vinā śāpasya prādubhāvaḥ | raktādūte raktaṃ cinā rāgaḥ līdilayyāsambhavaḥ | ato'smāddhatododhaivautapiśepmartaśoṇitasahitaiḥ śvayathuḥ syāt‌ | 6 de0--raktadopatrayakāryatavaṃ pākasyād‌ -śūramiti ||2 pake'tidṛte suṣirastanukhagdoṣapabhakṣittaḥ | varīmirācitaḥ syāvaḥ prīthaimāṇatanūruhaḥ ||7 se °--prāveo cātatiṣṛtta'tikrāttie subhirai'tadhtha dopadeśaḥ saṃpayate | tathā tanupvagasmin‌ sa tanuvan‌ tathā doṣamakṣitaḥ ¦ doṣarabdeneha paya ucyate | tena bhadvitatavātyuṣiravaṃ tanukhakva cā' | tathā vaṭī. bhirācito vyāptaḥ | tathā dyāmavaṇaḥ | tathā rīaimāṇatanūruhaḥ patadromā
tib: smin cing rnags pa de la rlung ma yin zhing / rlung nad med pa ni/ na zhing zug par mi 'gyur la/ mkhris pa ma yin par ni tsha zhing drod bag mi 'byung zhing / bad kan med pas ni skrangs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ khrag med dmar bar ni mi 'gyur te/ de bas na rgyu de'i phyir na zhes pa rlung dang mkhris pa dang / bad kan dang khrag dang bcas na/

skrangs smin zin nas thal drags shing dus shin tu 'das pa ni/ skrangs pa'i gnas na khong stong du 'gyur ba nad las byung ba'i rnag gis zos shing zad par byas pa dang / pags pa srab cing rdol bar nye ba dang / gnyer ma 'jum zhing pags pa 'dus pa dang / mdog gnag cing dri ma can du gnas pa dang / ba spu rnams kyi tshogs 'byi zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba yin no/ / bad kan shas che'i skrangs pa ni/ / smin

yang bad kan las byung ba'i skrangs pa la ni/ smin pa gting ring zhing zab pas brtag par dka' ba dang / khrag gis gang bar gyur pa yin te/ de bas na de'i smin pa'i rtags sam/ mtshan ma ni gsal ba ma yin te/ shes par dka' ba yin no/ / yang skrangs pa'i rnam pa gang du skrangs bag bsil zhing reg na grang bar gyur la/ pags pa'i mdog kyang gzhan du ma 'gyur te/ cha 'dra ba dang / nad tshabs chung ba dang / rdo ltar reg na sra zhing mkhrang bag tu gnas pa gang yin pa de ni mkhas pas the tshom dang dogs pa med pa nyid du khrag las gyur pa'i rma smin no zhes bshad cing the tshom med pa nyid du bya'o/ /

skt: aspasatve sokacitte nare sati tathā'vale dudhaile cacakhākṣame dīnavale puṃsi tathā vāṭe oṃn‌ṣoḍarayape pākāṣrāyaimuddhate'tikānte tathā mamesandhyādisthiteśaca yathā tīkṣṇoṣṇadravayaidīraṇaṃ kurvīta| tathācottaratantre nirdiṣṭam‌-“ gugyusvatasigod‌ntasvaraṇakṣīrīkapotaviṭ‌ | kṣārauṣadhāni kṣārāśca pakṣarophavidāraṇam‌ ? iti | anyatretarasmin‌ pāṭa. namatha śadeṇa kāryamiti vākyaśeṣaḥ
tib: snying stobs chung zhing phog snya zhan pa dang / de bzhin du nyam chung ba dang / byis pa lta bu mtshon gdab mi bzod pa dang / smin pa'i tshabs che zhing thal drags pa dang / de bzhin du gnad dang rus tshigs la gnas pa'i skrangs pa la ni/ rno ba dang tsha ba'i sman gyis brtol zhing dral bar bya'o/ / de yang 'di nyid kyi rgyud phyi ma las/ gu gul zar ma ba las so/ / khron bu dang ni phug ron rtug / thal sman 'phrod dang thal sman rno/ / skrangs pa smin gyur brtol bar bya/ / zhes bya ba bshad pa yin no/ / gzhan zhes bya ba skrangs pa'i rnam pa gong du smos pa ma gtogs pa gzhan dag ni gtsags bus dral ba nyid du bya'o/ /

skrangs pa ma smin pa brtol zhing dral na/ / rtsa dang rgyus pa la gnod cing ma rungs par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du khrag gi tshogs mang du 'byung zhing 'bab pa dang / de bzhin du nad tshabs rab tu 'phel zhing tshor bar 'gyur ba dang / rma'i kha gyes shing bye bar 'gyur ba ba'am/ yang na rma rdol ba las byung ba'i thor bu'am/

skrangs pa de smin pa thal drags kyang / dral zhing brtol ba ma byas par nang du gnas par gyur pa rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur bas rtsa la sogs pa bsreg cing za bar byed de/ dper na me mched pas rtswa'i tshogs bsregs pa dang 'dra'o/ / gang zhig ma smin brtol ba dang / / gang zhig smin kyang btang snyoms 'jog /

tib: de nas zhes bya ba ni/ bkra shis pa'i don du smos pa yin te/ yo byad kun bsags te zhes bya ba ni/ de'i tshe dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad bsags pa ste/ cha spyad rnams dang / gtsags spyad rnams dang / thal sman dang / 'dzum bu'i ma mchu dang / ras bal dang / chu'am ras bal sbangs pa'i gos kyi dum bu dang / lo ma dang / srad bu dang / bags pa dang / sbrang rtsi dang / snum dang / ska ba'i lde gu dang / til gyi lde gu dang / ldugs pa'i sman dang / chu'i bum pa dang / chu tshan dang / chu dron dang / zas dang / bsil yab la sogs pa rma la dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad bsag cing nyer bsdogs su bya'o/ / de nas nad pa kha shar du bstan te/ sman pa de la mngon par phyogs shing bltas nas/ legs par bsdams te/ gtsags bu myur du gdab par bya'o/ / de yang nad la sogs par gdab pa ste/ gnad dang / rtsa dang / chu ba dang / rus pa'i tshigs dang / rtsa bo che rnams spang bar bya'o/ / de yang sha shugs dang rjes su mthun par byas la/ shin tu rno ba'i gtsags bu gdab pa ni/ rnag phyin zhing snang bar gyur gyi bar du btang la/ de yang cig car te/ lan cig kho na gdab par bya'o/ / smin pa chen po yod kyang ni/ / rma zheng sor gnyis dral ba'am/ / sor gnyis pa'i zabs sor gsum gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ smin pa shin tu che ba la ni/ rma zhing sor gnyis gdab par bya ba'am/ sor gnyis pa'i bar ram zabs brtags la sor gsum par gdab par bya'o/ /

rma tshol gyis kun tu legs par btsal zhing brtags la bya ba'am/ mdzub mo la sogs pas gnas dang phyogs gang na ji ltar yod pa legs par brtag cing btsal bar bya ste/ rma'i kha bye zhing gyes pa'i phyogs su mdzub mo g.yon pas brtag par byas la/ kha shin tu bye ba ni ma yin la/ sha'i gting zab pa dag ni/ rma tshol gyi thur mas legs par btsal bar bya la/ gzhan dag la ni smyug ma'i sbu gu'am/ pad+ma'i chu ba la sogs pas brtag par bya la/ kha shin tu zlum pa la ni phag gi sbus brtag cing btsal nas rma btod par bya'o/ /

skt: yumahaspāke vavaṅguṭaṃ śakhapadamuktaṃ uya chāntaraṃ catiṃsamīkṣaya ayaṅmagukhaṃ pārayet‌ | ḍaguṃ parimāṇapramāṇaṃ kuyot‌ | hathaṅgukhaṃ khava cyaṅguraṃ bā punaranyanraṇaṃ kuyaut‌ | eṣiṇyārpāḥ samyageṣisvā sunirūpitaṃ sunidhitaṃ charā | aḥ aṅgulyādiiraṣitvā yathādeśaṃ śarīradeśāna tikra tathā yathādāyamārāyānatikrameṇa vivṛte pradero va mradeśinyoṣitvā nāiṣivṛte gambharimāṃsale caiṣi viparīte dhirīṣādināchenātisavṛtayukarabāire svā vraṇaṃ kachuyautata|yato yasmāt‌ kharīrapradeātayā rārīrapradeṇe gatāṃ dūrayātāṃ gati nāḍīṃ vidhāḥ mīyāt‌ tasan‌ padeśo jaṇaṃ kuyaut‌ | yatra yaḥ (520) aṣāṅahadaye | śathadhupradeye utsanna unnidyate tatra tanna gararapradeyo taṇa kuyāt‌ | yuvibhaktaḥ pāścādadhivimāgā yasya samyaka jāyate'sau śuvibhaktaḥ ta̱ tathābhūne tathā niya na ciśrata ādāyaḥ pṛyādadarapisya sthānaṃ yasya tam‌ | tathā''yataṃ dī ciścāṭaṃ vimtīpamevaṃlakṣaṇe vraṇe sati dopaḥ pṛthāsyo na niṣrati na sthitiṃ vaśrāti
tib: lus kyi phyogs gang du rma tshol 'gro bar 'gyur ba'i lus kyi phyogs der rma btod par bya'o/ / yang na gang du skrang ba'i phyogs mtho bar snang bas shes par byas la/ phyogs de dang der rma btod par bya'o/ / de yang legs par phye ba ste/ logs phan tshun gyi bye brag legs par shes shing / phyed par 'gyur bar btod pa dang / de bzhin du phugs 'chas pa ste/ rnag la sogs pa brten pa'i gnas med par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du chu ste srid dang / zheng ste rgyar ci nas kyang rnag la sogs pa'i nad gnas par mi 'gyur zhing / chags par mi 'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ste de ltar bya'o/ / sman pa dpa' brtan las la myur/ / mtshon rno mi rtul mi 'dar la/ / kun tu rmongs par ma gyur pa/ / gtsags bus

sman pa dpa' ba la sogs pa dang ldan pa ni/ sman dpyad kyi mtshon gyi las byed pa la bsngags shing 'dod par bya ba yin no/ / de la dpa' ba ni rtul phod pa'o/ / brtan pa ni bag tsha ba med cing mi 'gyur ba'o/ / las la myur ba ni lag bzo bas gtsags bu'i las myur du byed pa'o/ / mtshon rno ba ni legs par bdar ba dang / kha snyoms shing legs pa'o/ /
dpral ba la sogs pa'i rtsa ni gtsags bu kha drang por bstan te gyen du gdab par bya'o/ /

skt: tato'nantaraṃ vraṇe vṛttidhikerikāparasajñā sṛkmāṃ kārpīsādivakhmayīṃ traṇāntaḥraneyobhyā dadhyāt‌ | digdhāmalukiptāṃ yathādoṣasīauṣaghakatkena tathā vikalkājyamadharubhistaireva tikukaskādibhistāṃ vārta raṇāntaḥpraviṣṭaṃ chādayet‌ pūryeta. 1 na kevalaṃ tastaṃ chādayeāvat‌

gtsags bu btab zin kyang de'i 'og tu nad pa la de'i tshe smra bar 'os pa'i tshig snyan pa brjod pa dang / de bzhin du chu bsil ba gtor ba la sogs pas dbugs phyung nas/ de'i 'og tu rnag la sogs pa'i skyon bsal bar bya ba'i phyir rma de sor mos kun nas bcing bar bya'o/ / de'i 'og tu nad dmigs ji ltar 'tsham pa'i sman chu ska ba la sogs pas legs par bkru zhing sbyangs nas/ de'i rjes la ras la sogs pa'i gos kyis chu legs par bsal zhing / de nas rma de gu gul nas nim pa'i lo ma'i bar gyi sman mar dang sbrus shing sbyar ba'i bdug pas bdug par bya'o/ / til gyi lde gu mar sbrang rtsi/ / rang gi sman ni ji lta bas/ / byugs shing de nas rma tshangs gzhug /

tib: de nas de'i 'og tu rma'i nang du gro mde'u tshul du ras gtsang ma'i rma tshangs su byas pa dang / ras bal la sogs pa'i sdong bu rma'i nang du gzhug tu rung ba bcug la/ de'i 'og tu nad dmigs ji lta ba'i sman gyi lde gu byug cing bsku bar bya ba dang / de bzhin du til gyi lde gu dang / mar dang / sbrang rtsi bsku zhing til gyi lde gu dang mar dang sbrang rtsi de nyid kyis/ rma'i nang na gnas pa'i rma tshangs rmar bcug pa'i ras dum la sogs pa de nyid kyis g.yogs par bya'o/ / de 'ba' zhig gis de g.yogs par ma zad kyi/ snod kyi nang du phye dang mar dang chur sbrus shing lag pa'i rtse mos mnyes pa'i zan gyis kyang g.yogs par bya'o/ / de'i 'og rma'i tho skor gyi steng du gos rim pa mang po las byas pa mthug po gzhag pa/ shin tu ma yengs pas gos kyi dum bus legs par bcing zhing dkri bar bya la/ de yang glo g.yas sam g.yon du ma 'phyugs par bya ba dang / rma'i steng ngam dbus su ma song bar drang zhing ya yo med par rma dkri zhing bcing bar bya'o/ / rma tshangs kog tse dkris mar bcas/ / phra zhing sra la gtsang ba la/ / spos kyis bdugs shing 'jam la mnyen/ / kham khum med cing rma la phan/ / zhes bya ba la/ / gong du smos pa'i rma tshangs nang du gzhug pa'i ras dang / kog tse dang / dkri ba'i ras ni sra zhing mi 'chad pa dang / gtsang zhing bkrus pa las byas la/ de yang gu gul la sogs pa'i spos kyis bdug pa dang / 'jam zhing reg na bde ba dang / mnyen zhing 'jar ba dang / kham khum med cing blta ba tshigs dang bral ba'i rma la phan pa de lta bu dag bya'o/ / bcings nas de yi 'og tu ste/ / gnod pa bzlog phyir bsrung bar bya/ / de rnams la ni gtor ma sbyin/ / lag smi gu ha a ti gu ha/ / spang spos pra ma tsa ri ni/ / tsha tra a ti tsha tra dang / / dU ra ba shu dag yungs kar dag /

tib: rma bcing ba'i bar gyi las de dag byas nas/ de'i 'og tu nad pa de dag la gdon la sogs pa'i gnod pa bzlog pa'i phyir bsrung bar bya'o/ / yang gnod sbyin la sogs pa de rnams la gtor ma'i kha zas ci rigs par sbyin pa dang / rtag par dus thams cad du sman 'di dag spyi bor gdags par bya ste/ lag smi zhes bya ba sha mi dang / gu ha zhes bya ba kr-iSh+Na pa r+Ni dang / a ti gu ha zhes bya bas la pa r+Ni dang / spang spos zhes bya ba man ji ste/ ming gi rnam grangs dzA ti la zhes bya ba dang / pra ma tsa ri zhes bya ba bram aSh+Ti ka zhes bya ba'i shing dang / shu dag ste sman pa tsa dang / tsha tra zhes pa sha ta puSh+pa dang / a ti tsha tra zhes bya ba bi sha ni ki dang / dUr ba dang / yungs kar rnams gdags par bya'o/ / de nas snum gyi cho gar bshad/ nyin re'i kun spyod bshad pa bstan/ / zhes bya ba de'i 'og tu skyes bu dman ma de la snum gyi bshad pa zhes pa snum btung ba'i cho ga'i skabs su bshad pa/ kha la chu dron gyis kun tu spyod pa bya ba la sogs pa dang / nyin re zhing spyad par bya ba'i le'u'i skabs su bshad pa'i kun tu spyod pa ston cing bsgo bar bya'o/ /

tib: nad pa sman ma de rjes su mthun zhing goms pa'i kha zas zos pas myur zhing rings par rma 'tsho zhing bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ / de la nas la sogs pa ni bza' ba'i don du'o/ / sran chung la sogs pa ni sran khu yu sha dang tshod ma'i don du sbyar ro/ / tu ba ri ni sran ma a ru ka'o/ / ni shan ni ka dang / dzi ba na ti la sogs pa ni tshod ma'i don du'o/ / rgyam tsha dang se 'bru la sogs pa spos kyi don du'o/ / chu bskol ba bsgrangs pa ni btung ba'i don du'o/ / 'bras rnying pa ni lo gcig ma lon pa'i 'bras de'i chan no/ / snum can ni snum cung zad yod pa'o/ / de'i rjes la 'tshal nan ni chu tshan btung bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du skam sa'i sha 'ur bya la sogs pa'i sha bza' ba ste/

tib: de ltar rjes su mthun pa'i kha zas ji ltar 'os pa'i dus su ran zhing 'tsham par bza' ba dang / phan pa zos na bde blag tu 'ju zhing smin par 'gyur ro/ /

tib: 'bru sar pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan rma yod pa'i skyes bus spang bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du chang dang srog chags gsher sar gnas pa'i sha dang / 'o ma las gyur pa dang / zho dang / dar ba dang / phrum dang / thud la sogs pa dang bu ram shing las gyur pa ste/ bu ram phra mo la sogs pa dang / skyur dang / lan tshwa dang / tsha ba'i bza' btung dang / gzhan yang gang dag 'khru ba gcod cing 'gags par byed pa dang / tsha ba'i shas che ba dang / bsil ba dang / grang ba dang / lci ba de dag kyang spang zhing dor bar bya'o/ / 'bru sar la sogs sde tshan 'di/ / rma dang ldan pa'i nad kun skyed/ / ces bya ba la/ bshad ma thag pa'i 'bru sar pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni rma dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dman pa'i nad kun skyed pa ste/ nad gzhi gsum char skyed pa'am/ rma red cing 'drul ba la sogs pa nad skyed par byed pa yin no/ / chang ni rno ba tshe rtsub 'gyur/ / rma la myur du gnod par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ 'bru sar pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan 'di ni bshad ma thag par chang spang bar bya ba nyid yin par bstan zin pa las/ 'dir yang chang spang bar bstan pa ni shin tu nyes pa che ba'i phyir yang smos pa yin te/ 'bru sar pa la sogs pa zos pas rma la gnod par 'gyur mod kyi/ de bas kyang chang ni rno ba dang / tsha ba dang / rtsub pa dang / skyur ba yin pas de la gnod pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir rma la shin tu myur bar gnod par byed kyi/ gzhan dag ni de lta ma yin no/ / yang chang khyad par can rno ba dang / rtsub pa dang / skyur ba gang yin pa de nyid ni rma la shin tu myur bar gnod par byed pa yin gyi/ snum pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa gzhan dag ni de lta ma yin no/ / de yang rgyud gzhan las/ phal cher snum bcas mngar ba dang / shin tu rno dang rtsub ma yin/ / dngas shing btung bar sla ba dag / rgun chang dag las de mchog yin/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / de bas na chang snum pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa ni/ dman ma lan 'ga' zhig nyung zhing byin pa ni rma la gnod par mi 'gyur gyi/ chang rno ba dang tsha ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa 'di ni shin tu gnod pa yin no/ / zhes bshad par bya ba'i phyir/

rma de sman ba la ka dang / ur shi ras g.yab pa dang / rma 'di bskyod cing bskul bar mi bya ba dang / drag shul du gzugs shing brdeg par mi bya ba dang / sen mo la sogs pas 'phrug par mi bya'o/ / yang de bzhin du bskyod cing bskul ba'i tshe na yang bya ba thams cad du rma legs par bsrung zhing bag bya'o/ /

tib: snga ma bzhin du nyi ma gnyis pa la rma bkrol zhing bkru ba la sogs pa'i las mi bya ste/ de ltar byas na rma tshabs cher na zhing / mi bzad par na ba dang / rma mi 'byar zhing rmen bu skye ba dang / rma yun ring du zhig na 'tsho zhing 'drub par 'gyur ro/ /

rma'i nang du zhugs pa'i rma tshangs ras la sogs pa'i gos kyi dum bu rma'i nang du gzhug tu rung ba de snum ches pa dang / rtsub ches pa dang / de bzhin du dam zhing drag tu bcing ba dang / lhod drags pa dang / bzhag nyes pa dag mi bya'o/ / de bzhin du sman gyi lde gus rma glan pa yang / snum ches pa dang dam ches pa dang / lhod ches pa dang / bzhag nyes par mi bya'o/ / snum ches rma ni red par 'gyur/ / rtsub ches sha chad shin tu na/ / gas shing khrag ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ / dam dang lhod drags bzhag nyes pas/ / rma yi kha

snum shin tu drags shing shas che na rma red par 'gyur zhing rnag dang chu ser 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du rtsub ches pa ni sha bcad pa dang / shin tu na bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du pags pa gas pa dang / khrag 'bab cing 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du rma tshangs dang lde gu shin tu dam pa dang / shin tu lhod drags pa dang / bzhag nyes pas ni/ rma'i kha phan tshun 'drud cing 'dar ba dang thug par 'gyur ro/ / rma ni rnag bcas skrangs shing mtho/ / rgyu bcas rnag phugs 'chas pa dag / rma tshangs 'jam po nang gnas pa/ rma yi skyon ni dag par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ rma gang rnag dang bcas par gnas pa dang / de bzhin du skrangs shing mtho bar gnas pa dang / rgyu ba dang bcas pa ste/ sha la sogs pa rnag gis zos pas bu ga'i rnam pa ring du 'gro ba las/ rgyu dang bcas pa zhes bshad do/ / rnag ni phugs nang na 'chas shing 'thums pa yod pa ni rnag phugs 'chas pa ste/ de lta bu'i rma gang yin pa dag / rma tshangs 'jam po nang na gnas shing bcug pas rma'i skyon de dag dag cing sbyong bar byed pas de'i phyir/

skrangs pa ha cang ma smin pa la legs par ma brtags par gal te skrangs pa de mtshon gyis brtol bar gyur na/ smin cing rnags pa'i thabs kyis yang dag par gso bar bya ste/ de yang phal cher lan tshwa dang / skyur ba dang / tsha ba dang / dro ba'i lde gu'i sman rnams dang / de bzhin du zas smin cing rnags par 'gyur ba'i bza' ba dang / de bzhin du smin par 'gyur ba'i lo ma la sogs pa dag gis gso bar bya la/ de dag kyang rma la shin tu mi gnod par bya ba ste/ lan 'ga' rma smin par bya ba'i phyir/ rma la cung zad gnod pa btang du zin kyang skyon du mi 'gyur ba ni yod do/ / snad pa'i rma ni gsar du byung / / ral zhing kha bye 'phral

tib: btsem par bya ba ni rus tshigs gsum du gnas las goms pa gang yin pa dang / khrag skam po la sogs pa lag pas bsal zhing bton la/ de bzhin du sha chad mtshon gyis dbral te dum bur 'phyang ba de yang rang gi gnas su glan zhing sbyar ba dang / de bzhin du rus pa dang tshigs la sogs pa byung zhing 'bur ba slar gzhug pa dang / khrag gi rgyun gzags shing spyad la/ ci rigs par ras kyi skud pa'am/ shing shun a sman ta ka dang mur ba dang / gso ma la sogs pa'i skud pa 'jam po'am/

rma gang zhig kha'i phyogs na khrag med par gyur pa de ni cung zad tsam brud cing / mtshon gyis gtses la khrag dbyung ba dang btsem par bya ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ rma 'di 'byor zhing 'tsho bar byed pa ni khrag nyid yin pas na/ de phyung ste drub par bya ste/

bal gyi gos yin pas na bal gos te/ snam bu dang la ba'o/ / pags pa'i rnam pa 'jam zhing dro ba'o/ / dar ni zab dar te/ bcing ba gsum po 'di dag ni nus pa dro ba yin no/ /

bad kan dang tshil ches pa'i rma la ni/ zangs ma dang lcags la sogs pa glan zhing bcing bar bya'o/ / rkang lag gi rus pa chag grugs su gyur pa la ni/

tib: dbyibs kyi rnam pa rang gi ming ji skad btags pa dang / rjes su mthun pa'i chings ma sgye'u dang / bkra shis nas yan lag lnga'i bar lnga po de dag bcing ba'i don du sbyar bar bya'o/ / de dag kyang shubs ni mdzub shubs 'dra ba ste/ sor mo'i tshigs gsum pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ / bkra shis ni g.yung drung lta bu zur bzhi pa ste/ rus pa'i tshigs dang / smin ma dang / / nu ma'i bar dang / mchan ba ni khyad par du 'dug mi shes par bcing ba ste/ de ni lto ba dang brla'i rgyab tu glan zhing bcing bar bya'o/ / sgye'u ni so rtsi la sogs pa'i 'jud pa'i sgye'u phran te/ de ni sor mo dang pho mtshan tib: rma ma bcings na sha sbrang la sogs pas gtses par 'gyur zhing / de dang reg pa'i dbang gis 'tshe ba la sogs kyis gnod par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du rma de bcing ba med par snum gyis bskus na yang sman de yang yun ring du gnas par mi 'gyur zhing / sman gyi lde gu la sogs pa bskus pa yang yun ring por mi thogs par bskams pa'am lud par gyur pa'am/ de bzhin du legs bar bcos su zin kyang rma 'tsho zhing 'drub par dka' ba dang / gal te 'tsho zhing 'drub kyang sha mdog mi sdug par 'gyur ro/ / bcings na chag cing phye mar 'gyur/ / 'phres sam 'bur gyur dral gyur tam/ / rtsa dang rgyus pa chad gyur kyang / / rma ni myur du bde bar 'tsho/ / ldang dang nyal ba la sogs pa'i/ / spyod lam kun la gnod pa med/ / ces bya ba la/ rma legs par bcings shing bsdams pas ni/ chag cing phye mar grugs pa'am/ 'phres shing gnas pa las 'phyugs pa'am/ / 'bur zhing mtho ba'am/ dral zhing gas par gyur pa'am/ / rtsa dang rgyus pa chad par gyur kyang / rma bde blag tu myur du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du ldang ba dang mal na nyal ba la sogs pa'i spyod lam kun la yang gnod pa med par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: tanra traṇe kṛbhiyuktaṃ taraṇe sussāi dhāvane prakṣāṭane pūraṇe tadācchādane tañimittaṃ śītta | saptapaṇaudīnāṃ saco gobhūtrakaskitāḥ 1 vraṇe tasmin‌ cheṣaḥ prayojyaḥ | tathā sekaḥ pariḥ tasmina vraṇe knāgāmghunā śvāranincotato yena 1 sāsana | va̭ vraṇaṃ māṃspeśyā pracchādya chādari traṇramāṇasesthānamāṃsapiṇḍena sthagayiā karamīḥ [gajavāna 80. ha sīdhramava niharet‌ apanayet‌
tib: yang na rma de sha rlon rma'i tshad dang dbyibs 'dra ba'i sha'i dum bus bkag cing g.yogs la/ 'bu de de la chags pa na myur zhing rings par gdon par bya'o/ /

rma 'di ni nang na skyon dang bcas shing rnags la sogs pas khyab pas sman pas shing myur bar 'drubs shing 'byar bar bya ba'i phyir/ 'tshob pa'i sman bsku bar mi bya ste/ gang gi phyir sman de na ngan gnod pa dang bcas pas rma de 'tsho zhing 'byar yang sla zhing 'grams pa dang 'jig par 'gyur ba yin no/ /

skt: rūḍhe'pi vraṇe ajīrṇavyavāyādīm‌ paridāyīn‌. āturo civajayet‌ paridarat‌ 1 ajīṇebajaṃnādiṣidāryo'yaṃ vidhisādreṇātubaye prayalanenāuśiyaḥ māsān‌ ṣad‌ sapra vā
tib: rma 'tshob cing 'byor bar gyur kyang nad pa des ma zhu ba dang drag shul la sogs pa spang ngo / /
ma zhu ba dang / bud med dang phrad pa la sogs pa'i cho ga 'di ni rma 'tshob nas zla ba drug gam bdun gyi bar du bsrung zhing bsdam par bya'o/ /

rma'i gnas skabs gsal bar ma bstan pa'i tshul dang ming gang dag yin pa de dag byung zhing skyes par gyur pa na/ sman pas rlung la sogs pa'i nad gzhi la sogs pa'i stobs kyis rjes su 'brangs nas/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud phyi ma nas rgya cher bshad pa de legs par brtags shing dpyad la/ rma de gso ba'i thabs de dang des 'bad pa dang ldan pas gso bar bya'o/ / blos gzhung la ma brtags pa'i rang dga' dang / 'bad pa med pa'i sgyid zhan pas ni mi bya'o/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel pa/ tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas nye bar sbyar ba las/
@/ / sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba'i bar dum bzhugs so/ /

skt: asyārambhe'yaṃ sambandhaḥ | yathākaṣasnacche danamedanādīni ` karmāṇi karoti tathaivābhikṣāra svaviṣayaprayuktī kurutaḥ
tib: 'di bshad pa'i 'brel pa ni 'di yin te/ ji ltar gtsags bus dbug pa dang / gshags pa la sogs pa'i las byed pa dang 'dra bar me btsa' gdab pa dang / thal sman gnyis kyang rang gi yul la sbyar na gcad pa dang dbug pa la sogs pa'i las byed pas na de'i 'og tu 'di smos pa yin no/ / thal sman rnon po gtang ba dang / / me btsa' gdab pa'i las kyi sbyang ba yin pas na/ thal sman rnon po dang / me btsa' gdab pa'i las kyi cho ga ces bya ste/

de la gtsags spyad ni rtse mo dkyil 'khor 'dra ba la sogs pa'o/ / gtsags spyad dang rjes su 'dra ba ni srin bu pad pa la sogs pa ste/ de dag thams cad kyi nang na mchog ni thal sman yin no/ / ci'i phyir de mchog yin na/ gang gi phyir lus kyi phyogs dka' zhing dogs pa'i gnas rnams su yang gcad pa dang / dbug pa la sogs pa'i las byed par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du sna'i thor bu la sogs pa gtsags bu gdab par dka' zhing dogs pa rnams su yang gdab par dka' zhing bsgrub tu mi rung ba yang thal sman des bsgrub tu rung zhing rma la sogs pa'i nad mang po yang gso bar rung ba dang / de bzhin du shin tu gso dka' ba'i nad skran dang lto sbos pa la sogs pa rnams la yang btang du mi rung zhing / /

skt: saḥ kṣāraḥ peyaḥ; pātavyo'rastu tathā'na sade'damayau gusme tathodare
tib: thal sman rnon po de ni gzhang 'brum gyi nad dang / pho ba'i me drod nyams pa dang / rde'us 'gags pa dang / sbyar dug dang skran la sogs pa la btung du rung ba yin no/ /

thal sman rnon po de ni sme ba dang sha bkra la sogs pa la phyi rol nas byug cing bsku bar bya'o/ / sogs pa zhes smos pas ni de bsgrub par bya ba'i nad gzhan dag la yang bskur rung ba'i don to/ / khrag mkhris rlung can nad stobs chung / / rims dang tshad 'khru snying klad nad/ / skya rbab yi ga 'chus pa dang / / rab rib can dang slon khrus btang / / lus kun khyab pa'i 'or nad dang / / 'jigs dang sbrum ma zla mtshan 'dzag / pho mtshan mo mtshan skrangs pa dang / / byis pa rgan po zas ma zhu/ / rtsa bo che dang rus tshigs gnad/ / rus pa gzhon nu chu ba rtsa/ / lto srubs mgul ba lte ba dang / / sha srab phyogs dang rlig pa dang / / pho mtshan bu ga sen mo phrag /

skt: ubhayo'pi śrata vadahiḥparimājaine na yojyaḥ | pānepanayeona deyaḥ | pitte pitta dhike sakte rtavikāre ce vāyo vātaroge dhāñavache duve āture atisāre tathā hṛdroge pāṇḍvāmaye paṇḍusoge aścāvasocakāture karatasaṃśaddho kacharatavramanavireke ca tathā śrayathāṃ sabegātrage savīdnoccharane tathā mīrugarbhiṇyāmūtumalām‌ | proū-taphakhyoniṣu vakṣyamāṇottaratantre gahyarogavinñānīye didau be vṛddhe gatavayasi tathā dhama-nthādipu rāśaradeśeṣu nābhyanteṣu daśeṣa. aspamāṃse svaspapiṣadite tathā bṛṣaṇādiṣu tathākṣṇornetrayo vatmaisogādṛte vasmeregaṃ vajaṃdhisvāṅanyatra kṣāre yobhyaḥ | vatma̭segeṣu tu kṣāte yojya eva | tathā gīvepṇayaṣauduhine naca yojyaḥ || 5,.|| atra bale valavatīrayaṃkṇadacacainyāsyāna cintyam‌, demāddhiṣadāthavamdikṛyoḥ^valeḥ dyasya sthane cake hati pāṭdnāta, | nivāpya piṣṭa teneva pratīvāpe
tib: thal sman rnon po btung ba dang / bsku ba gnyis ka yang mi bya ba'i nad dmigs ni/ khrag nad can dang mkhris pa'i nad can dang / rlung nad can dang stobs chung ba dang / rims dang tshad pas 'khru ba dang / snying nad na ba dang / klad nad na ba dang / skya rbab kyi nad can dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad rab rib can dang / slon sman dang bkru sman gtang ba dang / lus dang yan lag thams cad skrangs pa dang / 'jigs pas nyen pa dang / sbrum ma dang / zla mtshan 'jag pa dang / pho mtshan dang mo mtshan skrangs pa'i rgyud phyi ma las gsang ba'i nad brtags pa'i skabs nas bshad pa lta bu dang / byis pa gzhon ches pa dang / rgan po na tshod 'das pa dang / de bzhin du rtsa bo che la sogs pa dang / sha srab pa'i phyogs dang / rlig pa la sogs pa'i phyogs dang / de bzhin du mig gnyis su mig mchu'i nad ma gtogs pa mig nad gzhan rnams dang / so ga tsha ba'i tshe dang / dgun grang ba'i tshe dang / dbyar char 'bab pa'i tshe dang / char 'bab cing yul rmus pa'i dus su gzhan gyi tshe thal sman rnon po btung ba dang / btang ba gnyis ka mi bya'o/ / mu ka ka na sha mya ka / chu shing pa ri ba tra ka / a shwa kar+Na 'dzam bu'i shing / / pa la sha dang a po ta/ / in dri br-ik+Sha arka dang / / nag ta ma la muk+ti ka / sring shing a pa marga dang / / ka ka dza ka tsi tra ka / ag ni man ta til bca' sga/ / rlon shing rtsa ba la sogs bcas/ / dum bur yongs su gtubs pa dang / / ko sha ta ka rnam bzhi dang / / nas kyi sog ma gra ma rnams/ / rlung med gnas su bsags nas de/ / rdo leb steng du so sor bzhag / mu ka ka yi phung po dang / / rdo thal rdo ni bcug par bya/ / de nas til gyi sdong bus bsreg / ces bya ba la/ shing mu ka nag po la sogs pa btus te/ dum bur yongs su gtubs la/ rlung med pa'i gnas su bsogs nas/ rdo leb kyi steng du phung por so sor bzhag pa dang / ko sha ta ka rnam pa bzhi dang / nas kyi sog ma dang gra ma rnams kyang rdo leb kyi steng du so sor bzhag pa dang / de bzhin du mu ka'i phung po dang / rdo thal gyi rde'u phra mo bcug nas/

gong du smos pa'i rdzas de dag tshig par gyur nas me shi ba dang rdo thal bsregs pa dang / thal ba logs shig tu so sor phye ste logs shig bzhag nas/ thal ba gzhan te/ thal ba bye gang mu ka ka'i thal ba de lhag mar blangs par bya ste/ sha mya ka la sogs pa'i thal ba cha mnyam par bya la/ mu ga ni cha gnyis su byas nas so sor dbye ste/ chu dang thal ba la sogs pa gcin srang stong dang bsres la dkrugs te/ / ras chen po'i tshags bzang pos de btsags la bzhu bar bya'o/ / ji srid kyi bar du bzhu bar bya zhe na/ dus ji srid na thal sman gyi rgyun 'byar bag dang / dmar ba dang dwangs pa dang / rno bar gyur pa de srid kyi bar du bzhus la/ thal ba'i dwangs ma de blangs nas thal ba'i tshigs ma bor te/ lcags sam zangs kyi snod bzang por sman mar btso ba'i tshul du bskol zhing gzar bus dkrugs shing btso bar bya'o/ / de nas 'tshod par byed pa der/ / rdo thal bsregs rdo'i dum bu dang / / nya phyis k+Shi ra pa ka dang / / dung gi lte ba lcags snod gzhug /

thal ba'i chu'i dwangs ma de 'tshod par byed pa der mu ka ka dang bsres la bsregs pa'i rdo thal gyi dum bu dang / nya phyis dang / k+Shi ra pa ka zhes bya ba rde'u ke ru dang / dung gi lte ba lcags snod du bcug pa me'i mdog ltar dmar bar yang dang yang du byas la/ thal sman gyi cha phul gang der bcug ste/ me bsad nas thal ba'i chu de nyid dang de zhib tu btags la/ lde gu de thal chu de'i nang du gzhug par bya'o/ / khyim bya rma bya bya rgod dang / / kang ka phug ron rtug pa dang / / bya dang rkang bzhi'i mkhris pa dang / / ba bla ldong ros lan tshwa rnams/ / zhib btags bcug bya/
de dag gi lde gu 'ba' zhig gzhug par ma zad kyi/ khyim bya la sogs pa'i rtug pa la sogs pa zhib tu btags la gzhug par bya'o/ /

de ltar lde gu bcug pa'i rjes la/ gzar bus thal chu'i khu ba de kun tu dkrugs shing bskyod par bya'o/ / gang tshe lbu ba bcas par khol/ / chu bur sbom ska lde gu 'dra/ / de tshe phab la grangs pa dang / / lcags snod bcug ste nas nang gzhug /

dus gang gi tshe thal sman de lbu ba dang bcas par khol zhing chu bur dang bcas pa dang / sla bag las ska zhing lde gu 'dra bar gyur la/ gzar bu la chags pa de'i tshe thab las phab la/ grangs pa dang / lcags kyi snod du bcug ste/ nas kyi nang du legs par sba zhing gzhug par bya ste/

thal sman 'jam po ni rdo thal gyi thal ba dang / rde'u la sogs pa ma btags par bsregs pa la thal chur de bcug cing gsur la/ de'i 'og tu slar phyir gdon par bya'o/ / rnon por snga ma bzhin bcug la/ / lang+ka ling+ka dan+ti dang / / shu dag bong nga tsi tra ka / swartsa ka dang khron bu dang / / shing kun ka rany+dza'i lo ma/ / ta la'i lo ma kha ru tsha'i/ / phye bcug / ces bya ba la/ thal sman rnon po sbyar ba la ni sngar bshad pa'i thal sman 'bring po sbyar ba bzhin du lde gu'i sbyor ba bcug pa dang / de bzhin du lang+ka ling+ka nas/ kha ru tsha'i bar zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma gzhug par bya'o/ / zhag bdun de bzhag bya/
thal sman de gsum char yang zhag bdun bzhag la/ de'i 'og tu gtang bar bya'o/ / rnon po de ni rlung bad kan/ / tshil skyes thor bu sogs la
thal sman rnon po de ni rlung bad kan dang / tshil las skyes pa'i thor bu ba dang / gzhang 'brum la sogs pa la gtang bar bya'o/ /
thal sman 'bring po ni thor bu la sogs pa 'di dag nyid kyi nad tshabs 'bring tsam du gyur cing shin tu 'phel ba ma yin pa la gtang bar bya'o/ /

thal sman 'jam po ni khrag dang mkhris pa las byung ba'i gzhang 'brum la gtang bar bya'o/ / mthu skyed phyir ni 'o ma chu/ / thal sman chu ni slar yang gzhug / ces bya ba la/ thal sman de mthu dang nus pa bskyed pa'i phyir ska bar gyur pa 'o ma dang / chu dang thal sman btsags pa'i chu slar yang gzhug par bya'o/ / shin tu rno min 'jam dang mnyen/ / 'byar bag sna rno dkar ba dang / / rtse can bde bar 'jil ba dang / / mi 'dzag byugs na nad mi che/ / thal sman yon tan bcu dang ldan/ / gtsags bu me btsa'i las kyang byed/ / ces bya ba la/ thal sman ni shin tu rno ba ma yin pa la sogs pa yon tan bcu dang ldan te/ de las kyang sna rno ba ni myur du khyab cing 'gro bar byed pa'o/ / rtse can ni steng nas brtsegs pa'am rwa can lta bur gnas pa'o/ / de bde bar 'jil ba ni skyur la sogs pa'i khu ba skyur pos myur du tsha ba 'jil zhing bsil bar byed pa'o/ / mi 'dzag pa ni 'dzag bag med pa'o/ / gzhan yang gtsags bu'i las bcad pa dang / dbug pa dang / dral ba dang / phyi ba la sogs pa yang byed la/ de bzhin du mi btab pas zhi zhing gso dgos pa'i nad kyang zhi bar byed pas na/

skt: saṃrambhāt‌ kṣobhāt‌ kṣaṇanātt‌ gātramācuṣaśaṣa tathā pīḍayanniva sarvataḥ sathaismin‌ anusaran‌gacchana. doṣāṃstassādhyānmūlato mūkhādunmūrayati uddharati svakīyaśakatyā | tathā karmāpi dāhādikaṃ takhā gataśjo nibṛttapīḍaḥ svayamevāsmanaivopayāmyati
tib: thal sman bsku ba ni kun tu dkrugs shing rlangs pas gzhibs pa lta bu dang / de bzhin du lus btsir ba lta bu dang / thams cad du nad kyi rjes su 'gro zhing snyegs pas des gso bar bya ba'i nad rnams rtsa ba nas 'byin par byed pa dang / de bzhin du nad bsil ba'i las tsha ba la sogs pa byas nas/ nad dang bral ba'i 'og tu rang nyid nye bar zhi zhing tsha ba med par 'gyur ro/ /

thal sman gyis gso zhing bcos pa'i nad ni mtshon gyis bcad cing gnyis su phye ba dang / mtshon gyis brud cing bdar ba dang / gtar ga byas pa'i rma dag la thal sman gyi thur ma gos kyi dum bu bkrus shing spangs pas dkris par thal sman bsgos te/ glan zhing byugs la de'i 'og tu grangs brgya'i bar du bsdad de phyi bar bya'o/ /

de la gzhang 'brum thal sman gyis gso bar bya la/ thal sman bskus la/ gos kyis g.yogs te/ rang gi lag pas dgab pa'i cha spyad bya'o/ / de yang grangs brgya'i bar du gzhug par bya'o/ / mig mchu'i nad la mig mchu bzlog /
mig mchu'i nang du nad dbyung ba la/ mig mchu gyen du bzlog ste/ mig 'bras nag po ras bal gyis bkab la/

mig chu der bsku ba de yang thal sman pad+ma'i lo ma tsam du srab tu bsku'i/ mthug par ni ma yin no/ / sna yi bu ga'i thor bu ni/ / nyi ma la bltas 'dug pa la/ / sna rtse legs par bteg nas ni/ / grangs ni lnga bcu'i bar du gzhag / ces bya ba la/ sna'i nang du thor bu byung ba la thal sman btang ba'i thabs ni/ nyi ma la kha bltas te 'dug tu bcug la/ de'i sna rtse mo legs par bteg cing bzlog la bskus te grangs kyi tshad lnga bcu'i bar du gzhag par bya'o/ / rna ba'i thor bu la de bzhin/ / zhes bya ba la/ rna bar thor bu byung ba la yang thal sman bskus nas snga ma bzhin du grangs lnga bcu'i bar du gzhag par bya'o/ /

skt: abhipyandīti kaṭadkartṛṇi māḥtyānnapā| sāni avraḍaya māñyāni kladunāya kaladanānam‌2 yadi ca sthigmṛravvāsakṣāradagdha na śīrthana| dhānyāgṅakījayaṣyādttiṭarāṭapayacataḥ | {takakaḥ samadhukrā vratā traṇarāpaṇa | sṛ0-yadi ca āradagyamayiṣyadibhimasisvanutaḥ sthiramṛrutādadḍhamṛlyādrogādhiṣrāna na rayina stu dharanyāmḍasya nījamavayavavidāvapten‌ tathā madhukanikhasyāmādepayet‌ | tikhkadaskau madharacaṣiyuno dhanānvito vraṇa ropaṇaḥ } 22||
tib: de ltar thal sman bskus pa'i 'og tu thur ma'i cha spyad kyis phyis la/ legs par tshig pa'am/ nyes par tshig pa rtogs par byas la/ legs par tshig na mar sar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bsku bar bya ba dang / 'o ma dang sbang rtsabs rang skyur dang zho ga chus dbal bsad cing grang ba bskyed la/ de'i 'og tu zhun mar dang bcas pa'i sman mngar ba dang 'jam pas byug par bya'o/ /
thal sman de la bad kan skyed par byed pa'i bza' btung dag bsrul zhing rnam par byang ba'i phyir sbyin par bya'o/ /

skt: rogavit‌ sthānaṃ lpayen‌ pradidyān‌ | dhānyāmḍasya kāñjikasya vījamavabayavo'dhamagaśritaḥ surājagala iva tasya vījasaṃjñā | tikhakalkaṃ dravapiṣṭaḥ tilaḥ samadhako madhuyaṣaeyā yukta dhṛtā nvitaḥ taraṇe kṣārakṣate ropaṇaḥ syāt‌
tib: gal te thal sman bskus pa'i nad rtsa ba brtan par gyur pas thal sman gyis bsregs shing / zas bad kan can zos kyang 'drul bar mi byed na/ de'i 'og tu 'u su dang / skyur gyi snyigs ma dang / shing mngar dang / til btags pa'i phye ma'i lde gus nad kyi gnas de bsku bar bya'o/ / 'dir skyur snyigs ni 'bras khu'i rtsab mo skyur po'i snyigs ma'am/ chang gi snyigs ma la bya'o/ / til gyi lde gu shing mngar bcas/ / mar gyis bskus na rma 'tsho byed/ / ces bya ba la/ til gyi lde gu ni til chu thags su byas pa'o/ / shing mngar dang bcas pa ni de dang lhan cig btags pa'o/ / mar gyis bskus pa ni de gnyis kyang mar dang bskus pa ste/ des ni thal sman gyis tshig pa'i rma 'tsho bar byed do/ / smin pa 'dzam bu ltar kun gnag / legs tshos/

smin cing tshos par gyur pa ni/ shing 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu ltar kun tu gnag pa ni legs par tshos pa yin no/ / de las go bzlog pa/ dmar zhing na ba g.ya' sogs byed/ / bsregs nyes yin te de slar bsreg / ces bya ba la/ legs par tshos pa'i mtshan nyid de las go bzlog pa'i 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu smin pa lta bur ma gyur pa dang / / thams cad tshig par ma gyur pa de ni bsregs nyes pa yin la/ de bzhin du dmar zhing na ba la sogs pa yang bsregs nyes shing ma tshig pa yin pas/ de ni slar yang bsreg dgos te/

nad kyi gnas kyi lus kyi phyogs bsregs drags nas/ de las khrag 'dzag par gyur ba dang / brgyal ba la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / sogs pa smos pas ni na ba dang / dmar ba dang / skrangs pa dang / rnag cing 'drul ba dang / me dbal la sogs pa bsdu'o/ /

gzhang 'brum bsregs pa'i gzhang khar bsregs drags pas ni khyad par bshang ba dang / gci ba 'gags pa'am/ de gnyis shas cher 'byung bar 'gyur ba'am/ khu ba zad cing gzhang kha 'byung bar 'gyur bas nges par gdon mi za bar 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /

skt: pakṃ seta pakvajāmbavasaṅkā saniṃ samyaṇdaradhaṃ bhavati
tib: snar thal sman gyis bsregs drags pas ni sna'i mtshul pa nyams shing 'jig pa dang / de bzhin du sna yo bar 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin du sna'i yul dri 'dzin par mi nus shing tshor ba med par 'gyur ro/ /

skt: kṣārādpyabhiḥ śreṣṭho uyāyān‌ garīyān‌ | tadagdhānāṃ rogāṇāmasaiḥprabhratīnāmasambhavāt‌ punara. nukhatteḥ ! tathā bheṣajādibhirasiddhānāṃ vyādhrīnāṃ | prasādhanāttasmādasiddheḥ
tib: de dang 'dra bas na de 'dra ste thal sman gyis bsregs pa'i sna ltar rna ba la sogs pa thal sman gyis tshig pa la yang rang rang gi yul 'dzin mi nus par 'gyur ro/ / sogs pa ni lce dang pags pa la sogs pa bsdu'o/ / 'dir ni mchog tu skyur ba blugs/ / shing mngar mar dang til btags byug /

tshig drags pa 'dir ni mchog gam khyad par du sgyur rtsabs la sogs pa'i khu ba skyur ba blugs pa dang / shing mngar dang mar dang til btags pas byugs pa dang / bza' btung la sogs pa rlung dang mkhris pa sel ba dang bsil bar bya ba'i spyod pa thams cad phan no/ /

gang gi phyir skyur ba ni reg pa bsil zhing grang ba yin pas na/ thal sman de dang 'dres shing 'brel par gyur na/ rgyu de'i dbang gis tsha ba dang / lan tshwa'i shas mang po dang bral nas myur du mngar ba nyid du 'gyur bas na/ de'i phyir skyur ba'i dngos po rtsab mo'i dngas ma la sogs pas tsha ba shin tu 'jil bar 'gyur gyi/ 'o ma la sogs pa mngar bas ni de lta ma yin no/ / de yang bsdus pa las/ thal sman ro ni skyur dang phrad/ / skad cig gis ni mngar bar 'gyur/ / zhes bshad pa yin no/ / me btsa' thal sman las mchog ste/ / des bsregs pas ni slar mi 'byung / / sman dang thal sman mtshon spyad kyis/ / ma grub pa yang grub par byed/ / ces bya ba la/ me btsa' btab pa ni thal sman pas kyang mchog ste/ des bsregs pa'i gzhang 'brum la sogs pa slar mi 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du sman la sogs pas gso ba ma grub pa yang des 'grub par byed pa yin pas na/ de'i phyir mchog yin no/ / pags pa sha dang rtsa rgyus dang / / tshigs dang rus sogs de la gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ me btsa' de yang pags pa la sogs pa bsreg pa'i phyir gdab par bya'o/ / sme ba mdze nad klad nad dang / / mgo bo'i gzhogs phyed na sogs la/ / lpags bsregs ras bal ba lang so/ / me shel mda' smyug sogs me gdab/ / ces bya ba la/ de la pags pa bsregs pa la sogs pa ras bal dang / ba lang gi so la sogs pas me btsa' gdab par bya'o/ / sme ba la sogs pa'i nad 'di dag ni rgyud phyi ma las shes par bya'o/ / gzhang 'brum rmen bu mtshan par rdol/ / bu ga rma longs la sogs la/ / sha bsreg spra tshil mar bsregs dang / / bu ram 'dzam bu'i chu yis bsreg / ces bya ba la/ gzhang 'brum la sogs pa'i nad rnams la ni/

skt: sa bābhischaragādiṣu dāhāya yojyate
tib: pags pa 'byar ba la sogs pa la ni rtsa bsreg par bya'o/ /

skt: tanna sakhagdāho maṣādiṣu godantādibhiyojya; | tirukāstikhakālaṭhaphān‌ maṣān‌ tāniva ` connatān‌ maṣebhyaśconnatatasāśarmakrīrāna sitāsitānivyetaduttaratantrāhaṇakṣayet‌
tib: bsreg par mi bya ba ni sngar thal sman btang ba bkag pa ste/ des 'jig pa dang / sbrum ma la sogs pa dang / de bzhin du nang na mtshon gyi zug rngu lus pa ma phyung ba dang / rma chen po byung ba dang / de bzhin du nang du khrag gzags pa dang / lto ba dral zhing gas pa dag la me btsa' mi bya'o/ /
nad kyi gnas legs par bsregs pa ni/ ba mar dang sbrang rtsi gnyis kyis bskus nas/ de'i 'og tu mar dang shing mngar la sogs pa'i lde gus bsku zhing byug par bya'o/ /

skt: sadāntaradarnārbhamāha-tasmādadagdhaṃ catuprakāram‌ | kathaṃ tuvthena tu dagdhalakṣaṇena sahaṃ | avimarya dagdhaṃ dahi kadācissamthak‌. dagdhalakṣuṇaṃ kadāvihudigdhalakṣaṇaṃ kadācicca tusthadgvalakṣaraṇaṃ sthāt‌
tib: me btsa' legs pa'i gnas kyi mtshan ma 'am rtags ni khrag mi 'byung zhing chod pa dang / gnas te sgra can du gnas shing chu bur gyi phre'u 'byung ba ste/ khrag las chu lta bu 'byung ba dang / ta la'i 'bras bu smin pa'am/ bya thi ba'i mdog 'dra ba dang / na ba'i tshabs chung zhing rma 'tsho ba sla ba yin no/ /
bag med cing ma dpyad par bsregs pa dang / bsregs nyes ba dang / de bzhin du bsregs drags pa dang / mtshos shing legs par ma tshig pa'i mtshan nyid dang bcas pa ste/

skt: tutthasya tutthad‌ gdhalakṣaṇāmāta kāyaṃ kāraḥ ṇopacārādevañuktam‌ | savagvivarṇāṃ satyayathamuṣyate ryate naca sphoṭānāṃ sathusattiriti | tusthadgdhasthānasya lakṣaṇaṃ yakkilinmātramevābhinā spaṣṭa tattṛtthadagdhamidyucyate suṣṭamiti yuśrutasya
tib: ma tshos pa'i mtshan ma ni pags pa'i mdog mi sdug par 'gyur ba dang / shin tu tsha ba dang / chu bur phra mo 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba yin no/ /
bsregs pa nyes pas ni chu bur shin tu che ba dang bcas pa dang / mi bzad par rab tu tsha ba yin no/ /

shin tu bsregs drags pas ni sha 'phyang ba la sogs par 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rtsa la sogs pa rab tu 'khums pa dang / dud pa 'khyims shing 'dug pa lta bu dang / rtsa la sogs pa 'khums shing nyams pa dang / skom dad skye ba dang / rma'i gting zab cing phugs ring ba dang / 'chi ba nyid du yang 'gyur ro/ /

skt: atidāhādrogādhiṣṭhānasya māṃsarasbanādyaḥ sayuḥ | samyagdgdhaliṅgaṃ tūktameva | tasya liṅga sthite rakta dayādinā tesmāttarpunanidiṣṭam‌
tib: ma tshos pa la mer phrad cing gdung bar bya ba dang / tsha ba'i sman gyi lde gu la sogs pa khrag zhu ba'i phyir bsku bar bya ste/ gang gi phyir khrag shin tu ska zhing 'thas par gyur na na bar 'gyur la/ zags shing zhu bar 'gyur/

skt: samyagdgdhe tavakṣīyādimirhepayet‌ dyatrāpi yojyam‌ | ādvakaidapayet‌ urva̭manattaraṃ pittavidradhivat‌ kiyā kāryeti rodhaḥ
atidgdhe drutaṃ śīghrameva savai bahirantaśca | bheṣajñaṃ pittavisaraṣaṃ iva kuyīt‌
tib: bsregs nyes par gyur pa la ni dro ba dang bsil ba'i sman rim gyis sbyar bar bya ste/ dang por dro ba'i sman bskus la/ de'i 'og tu bsil ba'i sman bsku bar bya'o/ / bsregs legs na ni cu gang dang / / blag sha tsan+dan btsag yug snam/ / sle tres bcas pa mngar bcas bsku/ / de'i 'og mkhris me dbal ltar spyad/ / ces bya ba la/ bsregs pa legs par gyur na ni/ cu gang la sogs pa nas/ sle tres kyi bar gyi sman btags pa mar dang bcas pa dang por bsku bar bya'o/ / de nas de'i 'og tu mkhris pa dang me dbal gso ba ltar spyad cing bsten par bya'o/ / bsregs drags mkhris pa me dbal gyi/ / cho ga thams cad myur du spyad/ / ces bya ba la/ bsregs drags pa la ni bza' btung dang / sman gyi lde gu byug pa la sogs pa'i cho ga mkhris pa dang / me dbal gso ba'i cho ga dang 'dra bar thams cad myur zhing rings par spyad par bya'o/ /

skt: snehadagdhe'titaraṃ rakṣaṃ yojayet‌ bhakṣataraprahaṇāca bāhulyena rūkṣam‌ 1 dehadeśādisāramyavaśāt‌ stigdhamapi yathāvasthaṃ yathābadyojayet‌
tib: snum gyis bsregs drags pa la ni bza' btung la sogs pa'i cho ga thams cad rtsub pa'i bag bya'o/ / 'ang zhes bya ba'i sgras ni de sman rtsub pa bsku ba 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ gong du bshad pa rnams kyang ci rigs par sbyar bar bya'o zhes bya ba'i don no/ /

skt: vaktavyaṃ yadṭhasatu tasya sarbasyoktatvādidaṃ | sthāne samāpyate niṣpādyate | kimūtaṃ sthānamra | aśṅkahdya | 1 psva 55 | | rahasyavat‌ | radsyamalathaṃ guhyarūpaṃ tadyasyāstīti ¦ tadrahasyavat‌ | kasya sāte hṛdayasya | hvaya vdaināṣaṭaṅgahadayañupalakṣyate | yathā satyabhāmā | bhāseti
tib: gsang ba'i sman dpyad kyi rgyud don gyis gsang zhing sba ba ste/ de lta bu'i gnas so/ / gang gi gnas she na/ snying po'i gnas te/ tshe'i rig byed yan lag brgyad kyi snying po lta bu ste/ ji ltar/
snying po yin pa dang 'dra bas na rgyud ma lus pa'i de kho na nyid du gyur pa'o/ / de lta bur 'dir rdzogs par byas shing mthar phyin par byas pa yin no zhes bya'o/ /

skt: kuta etaraṃsthānai ` rahasyavadilyāi-atreti | | yasmādra sthāne'tha sūtritāḥ sūcitāḥ | kibhūtāḥ | maramāstīkaṇataramatisamadhigamyāḥ | yataḥ asmistatre pratanyante vistāthante tasmādidaṃ sthāneṃ tatra̱ sabhbandhināmanyasthānānāṃ rahasyavaṃdiyukta bhavati
tib: gang gi phyir gnas 'dir don phra ba mdo tsam du bstan zhing blo rnon po dang ldan pa rnams la don gyi mdo gces pa 'dir bshad kyi/ rgya cher ni rgyud kun tu spros shing bstan pa yin no/ / de bas na gnas 'dir ni gnas thams cad dang rgyud kyi mgo lta bu yin no/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rnam par 'grel ba tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas nye bar sbyar ba las/
